title: Director, Technical Consulting (Salesforce & Tableau Next)
description:
**Description**
Salesforce is currently seeking a Director,Technical Consulting (Tableau Next) to join our Global Delivery Centre (GDC) team. We are looking for an experienced professional services leader who has experience in scaling professional services delivery centers across the world.
  
  
In addition The Director — Tableau Next is an execution-focused technical leader responsible for designing and delivering migrations from legacy Business Intelligence and reporting platforms (Cognos, Business Objects, MicroStrategy, Power BI, Looker, legacy Tableau Server) to Tableau Next. As a foundational member of the Strategic Migration CoE and Migration Factory, you will act as primary technical authority for the Tableau Next track — owning the solution design, data architecture, subscriber migration strategy, journey migration blueprint, and Data Cloud unified profile design. You will be owning the analytics platform architecture, legacy BI content migration strategy, data source re-architecture, governance model design and Tableau Next feature adoption roadmap.
  
  
You will combine deep Tableau expertise with strong data engineering and cloud data platform knowledge to ensure that dashboards, data sources, calculated fields, permissions and governance structures are migrated with full fidelity, improved performance and accelerated time-to-insight for the client's business users. This role is of people leader and 50% billable role, you will work with our customers and partners as a senior technical architect/program architect/CTO to solve critically important business challenges using Salesforce’s Cloud.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead a team of up to 8 direct reports, comprising Architects and potentially Managers, providing technical direction, mentorship, and performance leadership.
* Serve as a Senior/Principal Technical Architect for Analytics migration projects, contributing hands-on technical expertise and architectural leadership at approximately 50% utilization.
* Serve as the Technical Lead for Tableau Next migration workstreams, architecting the end-to-end transition from legacy BI platforms to Tableau Next — including dashboard migration, data source re-architecture, semantic layer design and governance model.
* Design the legacy BI content migration strategy — inventorying, assessing and prioritising all legacy reports, dashboards, datasets and calculated fields for migration, retirement or rebuild in Tableau Next.
* Architect the Tableau Next data source framework — designing live connections, published data sources, virtual connections, data policies and extract schedules optimised for performance and governance.
* Design the Tableau Next site and governance model — including project hierarchy, permission groups, content certification workflow, data quality warnings and usage analytics configuration.
* Own the cloud data platform integration architecture — designing connections between Tableau Next and Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Azure Synapse and Salesforce Data Cloud as analytical data sources.
* Lead the semantic layer and data model migration — translating legacy BI semantic models, universe layers (Business Objects) and subject areas (Cognos) into Tableau Next published data source designs and calculations.
* Define end-to-end data lineage for all analytics objects — mapping source data fields through transformation layers to Tableau Next calculated fields, ensuring business logic equivalence is preserved or improved.
* Lead functional and technical discovery workshops with client business intelligence, data engineering and business analytics teams to assess legacy report complexity, data source dependencies and user adoption patterns.
* Manage the functional depth of Source vs. Target systems — maintaining deep understanding of how legacy BI platform features (Cognos report types, Business Objects universes, Power BI DAX measures) translate to Tableau Next capabilities.
* Serve as a Trusted Advisor to the client, driving conversations with CDOs, Analytics leaders and Enterprise Architects to shape the Tableau Next migration roadmap, data governance strategy and self-service analytics vision.
* Establish best-in-class standards for the Tableau Next migration practice — building reusable dashboard migration templates, data source connection templates, naming convention standards and governance configuration playbooks as factory accelerators.
* Lead performance optimisation — profiling legacy dashboard performance baselines, designing Tableau Next data extracts and published data sources to meet or exceed baseline performance, and establishing performance monitoring.
* Lead cutover planning and execution — including legacy BI platform deprecation scheduling, user access migration, Tableau Next URL/bookmark migration for key dashboards and post-go-live self-service training.
* Identify and mitigate technical risks proactively — data source credential migration, calculated field logic parity gaps, row-level security re-implementation, extract refresh SLA continuity and legacy report complexity underestimation.
* Contribute to the Migration Factory by building reusable Tableau Next migration playbooks, dashboard assessment tools, data source templates and performance benchmarking scripts to reduce wave delivery time.

**Experience Requirements**

* 18+ years of experience leading Salesforce technical consulting projects and handling as individual contributors.
* 8+ years of people management experience
* Strong application design skills combined with strong data, integration, and security architecture skills
* Demonstrated experience migrating large BI content estates (500+ reports/dashboards) from legacy platforms to Tableau.

**Salesforce & Platform Certifications**

* Tableau Certified Architect (Preferred)
* Tableau Certified Data Analyst (Required)
* Salesforce Certified CRM Analytics and Einstein Discovery Consultant (Required)
* Salesforce Data Cloud Consultant (Preferred)
* Snowflake SnowPro Core or Advanced (Preferred)
* Databricks Certified Associate Developer (Preferred)
* dbt Analytics Engineering Certification (Preferred)

**Cross Cutting Qualifications**

* Proven expertise in executing complex data migrations — multiple end-to-end migration projects from legacy systems to Salesforce or vice versa.
* Integration Architecture (Must Have): Understanding of how data flows between systems and the mechanisms for high-volume data transport.
* Data Architecture & Management (Must Have): Expertise in ERD design, data cleansing, managing high volumes of data and Large Data Volume (LDV) strategies.
* Platform Security (Must Have): Knowledge of data encryption, field-level security, Shield and compliance-aligned data movement during migration windows.
* Identity & Access Management (Must Have): Understanding of user migration, permission set mapping, SSO and visibility model design.
* Sharing & Visibility (Must Have): How migrated data will be secured and accessed post-deployment.
* Platform Development (Must Have): Proficiency in Apex, Async Design, Governor limit, LWC components and Salesforce Flows.
* Excellent communication skills — ability to articulate complex migration strategies to both technical teams and C-suite business stakeholders.
* Ability to work in a factory delivery model — reusing and contributing to shared accelerators, playbooks and templates across concurrent wave teams.
* Proven ability to analyze, design, and optimize business processes via technology and integration
* Resourceful and innovative thinker who can work through and solve problems
* Adept at navigating/mediating conflict and fostering healthy dialogue
* Exceptional analytical skills - experience overseeing and managing business metrics, productivity, and outcomes

title: Placement Manager
description:
**About Medhavi Group:**
Established in 2013, Medhavi Group is a unified ecosystem comprising MSU and various skill- promoting organisations, dedicated to advancing skill development, vocational training, and industry- integrated higher education. With a strong outcome-driven approach, the Group has trained over 6 lakh learners, achieving more than 70% employability outcomes, and currently supports 20,000+ active students across its diverse programs. Medhavi Group continues to bridge the gap between education and employment by building scalable, industry-aligned talent pathways across India. Work Integrated Skill based Higher Education (WISE) is Medhavi’s flagship industry-integrated initiative built on the principle of “Industry as Campus.” It combines academic learning with structured on-the job training, ensuring students graduate with real work experience and industry-ready skills. Through deep, outcome-driven partnerships with over 300+ leading industry and skill partners across 26+ sectors including Hyundai, Mahindra, IHG Group, Nephroplus, Barbeque Nation, Nexus Select Malls, ClassPlus, Tata Electronics, Marriott, ITC, and others- WISE enables learners to acquire role- specific competencies directly within live business environments. WISE creates a demand-driven talent pipeline for industries that enhances employability, improves workforce productivity, and bridges the industry skill gap.

For more information, visit
**https://msu.edu.in/wise/**

**Role Overview:**

The Manager will be responsible for establishing and strengthening partnerships with healthcare institutions, hospitals, rehabilitation centers, mental health organizations, clinics, NGOs, and industry partners to facilitate On-the-Job Training (OJT), clinical postings, internships, fieldwork, and experiential learning opportunities for students of Psychology and Allied Health Sciences. The role also involves developing and managing Memorandums of Understanding (MoUs) with partner organizations to support student training, research, and industry engagement initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Industry Partnership Development**

• Identify, approach, and onboard hospitals, clinics, diagnostic centers, rehabilitation centers, mental health organizations, NGOs, and healthcare providers for student training and placement opportunities.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with industry stakeholders and healthcare institutions.

• Explore new opportunities for collaboration in training, internships, research, and skill development.

**2. OJT & Clinical Posting Coordination**

• Facilitate OJT, internships, clinical postings, field visits, and practical training for Psychology and Allied Health Sciences students.

• Coordinate with academic departments and industry partners to ensure timely placement of students.

• Monitor student attendance, performance, and compliance during training and clinical postings.

• Resolve issues related to student deployment and industry coordination.

**3. MoU Development & Management**

• Draft, process, and coordinate Memorandums of Understanding (MoUs) with hospitals, healthcare institutions, NGOs, and industry partners.

• Ensure timely renewal and maintenance of partnership agreements.

• Maintain records and documentation related to all industry collaborations and MoUs.

• Coordinate with legal, administrative, and academic teams for approvals and execution of agreements.

**4. Stakeholder Coordination**

• Act as the primary point of contact between the university and partner organizations.

• Organize industry meetings, partnership discussions, and review sessions.

• Facilitate communication among students, faculty members, and industry partners.

**5. Compliance & Documentation**

• Maintain a database of industry partners, clinical sites, and training organizations.

• Prepare periodic reports on student postings, industry engagement activities, and partnership outcomes. • Ensure compliance with university policies, accreditation requirements, and regulatory guidelines related to clinical training.

**6. Student Support & Career Development**

• Guide students regarding internship and clinical posting requirements.

• Support employability initiatives and facilitate industry interactions.

• Assist in organizing workshops, guest lectures, industry visits, and career-oriented activities.

**Qualifications & Skills Required:**

• Master's Degree in Psychology, Hospital Administration, Healthcare Management, Social Work, Allied Health Sciences, Business Administration, or a related field.

• Additional certifications in healthcare management or industry relations will be an advantage.

• 5 - 10 years of experience in industry relations, healthcare partnerships, training coordination, placement activities, or academic-industry collaboration.

• Experience in working with hospitals, healthcare institutions, NGOs, or educational institutions is preferred.

• Strong networking and relationship management skills.

• Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal abilities.

• Knowledge of healthcare and mental health ecosystems.

• Experience in drafting and managing MoUs and partnership agreements.

• Strong organizational and documentation skills.

• Proficiency in MS Office and database management.

**What We Offer**

• Opportunity to architect and scale a future-focused, industry-integrated higher education ecosystem.

• Competitive compensation with performance-linked incentives.

• Leadership role in a rapidly growing national skills and university platform.

• A collaborative, mission-driven environment.

• The opportunity to create a measurable impact on employability and workforce transformation at scale.

Medhavi Skills University is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Demonstrate a thorough understanding of complex information systems and apply it to client situations
* Create and demonstrate innovative insights for clients, adapts methods and practices to fit operational team needs & contributes to thought leadership documents

Demonstrate excellent project management skills, inspire teamwork and responsibility with engagement team members, and use current technology/tools to enhance the effectiveness of deliverables and services
* Facilitate discussions / knowledge sharing with key client personnel and contribute to EY’s thought leadership
* Demonstrate excellent project management skills, inspire teamwork and responsibility with engagement team members, and use current technology/tools to enhance the effectiveness of deliverables and services.

* Demonstrate deep understanding of the client’s industry and marketplace
* Lead consulting engagements that solve complex Cyber security issues
* Help mentor, coach and counsel their team members and help us build an inclusive culture and high-performing teams
* Maximize operational efficiency through standardization and process automation on client engagements and internal initiatives
* Monitor delivery progress, manage risk and ensure key stakeholders are kept informed about progress and expected outcomes
* Successfully manage engagement time and budgets
* Convey complex technical security concepts to technical and non-technical audiences including executives.
* Provide strategic and relevant insight, connectedness and responsiveness to all clients to anticipate their needs
* Support and drive the overall growth strategy for the Cybersecurity practice as part of the leadership team.
* Identify and drive development of market differentiators including new products, solutions, automation etc.
* Define, develop and implement strategic go-to-market plans in collaboration with local EY member firms in Americas, EMEIA and APAC.

Assist Consulting Partners & Senior Managers in driving the business development process on existing client engagements by gathering appropriate resources, gaining access to key contacts & supervising proposal preparation

title: Admission Advisor
description:
**Job Description**
**Admission Advisor – Builder (Pre-Sales Executive)**
**Company:**
ElevateMe
  
  
**Location:**
Ahmedabad (On-Site)
  
  
**Shift:**
7:30 PM – 4:30 AM IST (US Market)
  
  
**Department:**
Sales & Admissions
  
  
**Reporting To:**
Team Lead – Admissions
  
  
**About ElevateMe**
ElevateMe is a career acceleration platform helping international students and professionals in the United States secure high-paying technology jobs through structured career guidance, industry-focused training, technical mentorship, interview preparation, real-world project experience, and strategic job search support.
  
  
Our primary audience includes students and professionals on F1, OPT, and STEM OPT visas who are actively seeking opportunities in the U.S. job market.
  
  
**Position Overview**
We are looking for highly motivated and target-driven Admission Advisors (Builders) who can identify, qualify, and nurture prospective candidates before handing them over to the Senior Career Advisor (Closer) for enrollment discussions.
  
  
This role is a critical part of the sales process and requires individuals who can build trust, conduct meaningful discovery conversations, identify career challenges, create urgency, and schedule qualified candidates for detailed career consultations.
  
  
The Builder is not responsible for closing sales. Their primary responsibility is to generate qualified opportunities and ensure candidates attend their scheduled presentations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Lead Qualification & Discovery**

* Connect with prospective students and professionals generated through LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Instagram, referrals, inbound inquiries, and lead generation campaigns.
* Conduct structured discovery calls to understand the candidate's:

+ Current employment status
+ Visa status (OPT/STEM OPT/F1)
+ Job search stage
+ Target role and career goals
+ Current challenges and pain points
+ Interview readiness
+ Timeline and urgency

* Determine whether the candidate is qualified for ElevateMe's services.
* Categorize leads appropriately within the CRM.

**Need Identification & Need Generation**

* Identify gaps in the candidate's current job search strategy.
* Understand challenges related to:

+ Resume shortlisting
+ Lack of interview calls
+ Interview conversion issues
+ Communication challenges
+ Technical skill gaps
+ Career direction uncertainty

* Create awareness and urgency around the importance of structured career support.
* Position the value of the next consultation without using aggressive sales tactics.

**Presentation Booking**

* Schedule qualified candidates for detailed Career Trajectory Sessions with the Senior Career Advisor.
* Clearly communicate the purpose and value of the presentation.
* Confirm attendance and send reminders before scheduled meetings.
* Coordinate with Closers and Team Leads to ensure smooth handover.

**Presentation Attendance Management**

* Ensure candidates attend their scheduled presentations.
* Follow up with candidates before and after scheduled sessions.
* Participate in critical presentations when required.
* Reschedule no-shows and maintain engagement until the candidate completes the presentation.

**CRM Management**

* Maintain accurate CRM records for every interaction.
* Update:

+ Call outcomes
+ Candidate notes
+ Follow-up schedules
+ Discovery findings
+ Lead stage progression

* Ensure 100% CRM compliance and data accuracy.

**Team Collaboration**

* Work closely with:

+ Business Development Team
+ Lead Generation Team
+ Team Leads
+ Senior Career Advisors (Closers)

* Share market insights, candidate objections, and feedback to improve conversion rates.

**Daily Performance KPIs**
**Activity Metrics**

* 240 Outbound Calls per Day
* 180 Minutes Talk Time per Day
* Minimum 20–25 Meaningful Conversations per Day
* 100% CRM Update Compliance
* 95% Follow-Up Completion Rate

**Outcome Metrics**

* 4 Qualified Candidates per Day
* 4 Discovery Calls Completed per Day
* 4 Presentation Bookings per Day
* 60%+ Presentation Show-Up Rate
* Active Participation in Candidate Handover Process

**Monthly Performance KPIs**

* 80+ Qualified Opportunities Generated
* 80+ Presentation Bookings
* 60%+ Presentation Attendance Rate
* 20–25% Lead-to-Presentation Conversion
* 95% CRM Accuracy Score
* Consistent Follow-Up Compliance

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in any discipline.
* 1–5 years of experience in:

+ Inside Sales
+ Admission Counseling
+ EdTech Sales
+ B2C Sales
+ Telecalling
+ Lead Qualification
+ Career Counseling

Freshers with exceptional communication skills may also apply.
  
  
**Required Skills**
**Communication Skills**
Excellent verbal English communication with the ability to engage confidently with U.S.-based students and professionals.
  
  
**Discovery & Consultative Selling**
Ability to ask the right questions and uncover candidate needs.
  
  
**Active Listening**
Strong ability to understand candidate situations and build rapport.
  
  
**Objection Handling**
Ability to professionally handle concerns and resistance.
  
  
**CRM Proficiency**
Experience using CRM systems for lead tracking and sales management.
  
  
**Follow-Up Discipline**
Consistent and structured follow-up approach.
  
  
**Team Collaboration**
Ability to work effectively within a performance-driven sales environment.
  
  
**Ideal Candidate Profile**
**The Ideal Candidate**

* Is highly energetic and target-oriented.
* Can confidently engage with new prospects.
* Enjoys speaking with people and understanding their challenges.
* Has strong persuasion and relationship-building skills.
* Can create urgency without being pushy.
* Takes ownership of results and follows through consistently.
* Thrives in a fast-paced sales environment.
* Is comfortable working night shifts aligned with the U.S. market.

**Compensation & Benefits**

* Competitive Fixed Salary
* Attractive Performance Incentives
* Structured Sales Training
* Career Growth Opportunities
* Leadership Development Path
* Dynamic and Performance-Driven Culture

**Why Join ElevateMe?**
At ElevateMe, you will directly impact the careers of international students and professionals while building a rewarding career in sales and admissions. If you enjoy meaningful conversations, solving problems, and helping people move closer to their career goals, this role is for you.

* Interpret NCVET, UGC, AICTE and NEP 2020 guidance for institutional partners and translate it into practical implementation plans.
* Draft high-quality proposals, concept notes, MoUs and commercial offers for the introduction of new skill courses in schools, colleges and universities.
* Prepare tender and bid documentation for government skilling projects, including technical write-ups, compliance annexures and past-performance narratives.
* Own the pipeline end to end: prospecting, first meeting, proposal, negotiation, closure, and handover to delivery.
* Promote courses and partnership models independently, without day-to-day supervision, and be accountable for conversion targets.

**Qualifications & Skills Required:**

* Graduate in any discipline; a postgraduate qualification (MBA, MSW, M.A. Education, or equivalent) is preferred.

o NSQF structure, level descriptors and application.

title: Growth Manager
description:
Swiggy is India’s leading on-demand delivery platform with a tech-first approach to logistics and a solution-first approach to consumer demands. With a presence in 500+ cities across India, partnerships with hundreds of thousands of restaurants, an employee base of over 5000, a 2 lakh+ strong independent fleet of Delivery Executives, we deliver unparalleled convenience driven by continuous innovation. Built on the back of robust ML technology and fuelled by terabytes of data processed every day, Swiggy offers a fast, seamless and reliable delivery experience for millions of customers across India. From starting out as a hyperlocal food delivery service in 2014, to becoming India’s leading on-demand convenience platform today, our capabilities result not only in lightning-fast delivery for customers, but also in a productive and fulfilling experience for our employees.
  
  
**Job Description**
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants learning their business understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners' success. You'll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
  
  
**Job Description:**

* Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
* Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
* Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy’s products as solutions, not features
* Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
* Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants aren't growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
* Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
* Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Google sheet/WSP
* Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction 80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month

**Qualifications**
Graduate
  
  
**Additional Information**
**Experience & Background:**

* 0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in FMCG, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
* Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
* Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partners.
* Comfort with data, especially Excel—you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
* Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

**Visit our tech blogs to learn more about some the challenges we deal with: https://medium.com/swiggy-bytes**
**We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by the law.**

title: Senior Onboarding & Implementation Specialist
description:
**RunLoyal · Full-time · Coimbatore, India**

**Work Shift: US Working Hours — Mandatory**

**Experience: 4-6 years**

**About RunLoyal**

Do you care about the businesses that care for pets every day — and want to build software that helps them operate better?

Do you enjoy breaking complex systems, finding problems before customers do, and building automation that makes engineering teams faster and more confident?

If your answer is yes, RunLoyal could be the place for you.
  

RunLoyal is a fast-growing vertical SaaS technology company building modern software for the pet care industry. Boarding facilities, daycare centers, groomers, trainers and dog parks use our platform to run their businesses and give pet parents a better experience. We headquartered in Atlanta, GA.

An all-in-one platform: business management, a custom branded app for every customer, staff tools, payments, communications, reporting and Scout AI. Pets make it approachable. The software is the craft.

Our platform powers the day-to-day operations of pet-care businesses across boarding, daycare, grooming, training, memberships, payments, customer engagement, reporting, and facility operations.

As RunLoyal continues to scale its platform, customer base, and engineering organization, we are looking for a Full Stack Engineer who wants more than a traditional development role.

This is an opportunity to work on a real SaaS product, solve meaningful customer and engineering problems, and take ownership of features from idea to production.

You will work closely with Product, Engineering, QA, and other teams to understand the problem behind a requirement, contribute to technical decisions, build scalable solutions, validate them thoroughly, and support what you ship.

If you enjoy working in a growing product company where engineers are expected to think, build, improve, and own, this role is for you.

**What You'll Own**
**Customer Discovery & Solution Design**

* Become the customer's primary implementation contact after the Sales handoff.
* Lead structured discovery sessions with business owners and operational stakeholders.
* Understand customer workflows, services, pricing, memberships, packages, staffing, booking rules, payments, agreements, notifications, reporting, and operational requirements.
* Identify unclear, conflicting, or incomplete requirements before implementation begins.
* Translate business needs into the correct RunLoyal configuration.
* Recommend practical workflows and explain product limitations or alternatives when required.
* Escalate genuine product gaps to Product or Engineering with clear business context.

**Product Configuration & Data Migration**

* Configure customer environments based on approved requirements.
* Set up services, pricing, memberships, packages, staff access, booking workflows, policies, payments, and related settings.
* Work with customer data from Excel, Google Sheets, CSV files, and structured exports.
* Clean, normalize, transform, and map data into required import formats.
* Identify duplicate, incomplete, malformed, or inconsistent records.
* Validate imported customer, pet, membership, package, service, and other operational data.
* Complete post-import reconciliation and escalate discrepancies before go-live.

**Implementation QA, Training & Go-Live**

* Validate configured environments against approved customer requirements.
* Test realistic workflows covering booking, pricing, payments, memberships, staff access, services, and customer records.
* Identify configuration or data issues before they reach the customer.
* Conduct administrator and staff training.
* Explain workflows clearly to technical and non-technical users.
* Confirm readiness across configuration, data, users, payments, training, and operational processes.
* Drive customers through go-live and provide support during the initial launch period.
* Complete a structured handoff to Customer Success or Support after stabilization.

**Technical Troubleshooting**

You do not need to be a software engineer, but you should be comfortable investigating before escalating.

You will:

* Troubleshoot configuration and data issues independently.
* Use browser developer tools where helpful.
* Use SQL for data verification and investigation.
* Distinguish between configuration issues, data problems, integration behavior, product defects, and enhancement requests.
* Provide Engineering and QA with clear and reproducible issue details.

**Senior-Level Ownership**

* Manage complex, multi-location, or high-value implementations.
* Handle multiple onboarding projects concurrently.
* Identify implementation risks early and create mitigation plans.
* Act as an escalation point for complex onboarding issues.
* Review configuration and migration work completed by junior team members.
* Coach team members on discovery, data quality, solution mapping, and customer communication.
* Help improve RunLoyal's implementation standards, templates, documentation, and processes.

**What We're Looking For**
**Experience**

* **4–6 years of relevant professional experience**

  in SaaS implementation, customer onboarding, implementation consulting, solution consulting, business analysis, technical account management, or a related customer-facing role.
* At least
  **2–3 years of direct ownership of US based B2B SaaS implementations or similarly complex customer projects**

  .
* Independently managing customer onboarding via phone, customer training, and demos is a non-negotiable.
* Experience leading customers from discovery through configuration, migration, training, and go-live.
* Experience working directly with business owners, operational leaders, or senior stakeholders.
* Experience managing multiple implementation projects simultaneously.

**Core Requirements**

* Strong customer discovery and requirements-gathering skills.
* Ability to translate business workflows into software configuration.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent attention to detail and a strong implementation QA mindset.
* Advanced working knowledge of
  **Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets**

  .
* Experience with CSV-based data cleaning, mapping, transformation, and validation.
* Strong written and verbal English communication.
* Confidence leading customer meetings independently.
* Strong organizational and project-management skills.
* Ability to identify risks, manage dependencies, and communicate blockers clearly.
* Ability to work independently with limited supervision.
* Comfortable working
  **mandatory US business hours from Coimbatore**

  .
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Technology, Business, Computer Applications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Technical Skills**

The ideal candidate should have working knowledge of:

* Excel / Google Sheets
* CSV data handling and transformation
* SQL fundamentals
* Webhooks and integrations
* SaaS configuration concepts
* Browser-based troubleshooting
* Data validation and reconciliation
* CRM and project-management tools

You are not expected to code production software, but you should be technically confident enough to investigate problems before escalating them.

**Preferred Qualifications**

Experience in any of the following will be an advantage:

* US based B2B or vertical SaaS implementation.
* Multi-location or operational software.
* Customer data migrations.
* SQL-based validation or troubleshooting.
* API-based integrations.
* Payments or transactional systems.
* HubSpot, Jira, Asana, Notion, Monday.com, Intercom, Salesforce, or similar platforms.
* Mentoring junior implementation or onboarding specialists.
* Startup or scale-up environments.
* Pet-care, hospitality, scheduling, POS, healthcare, field-service, or appointment-based businesses.

You do not need experience with every tool listed above. Strong ownership, learning ability, customer judgment, and SaaS implementation experience matter most.

**Good to have**

* REST APIs
* JSON
* Relational database concepts
* Understanding of REST APIs, JSON, integrations, and webhooks at a functional level.

**What We'll Evaluate**

We will assess your ability to:

* Discover how a customer's business actually operates.
* Translate requirements into the right SaaS configuration.
* Own implementations from Sales handoff through go-live.
* Work carefully with customer data and prevent avoidable migration errors.
* Lead customer conversations and manage expectations professionally.
* Investigate technical issues before escalating.
* Manage multiple projects without losing track of decisions, risks, deadlines, or dependencies.
* Demonstrate senior-level judgment and ownership.

**Key Success Measures**

Success in this role will be measured through:

1. **Time to Go-Live**

   — Customers launched within agreed timelines.
2. **Implementation Accuracy**

   — Low configuration and migration errors after launch.
3. **Customer Onboarding CSAT**

   — Satisfaction with communication, implementation, and training.
4. **Go-Live Readiness**

   — Successful completion of configuration, migration, validation, and training.
5. **Early Customer Adoption**

   — Customers actively using agreed RunLoyal workflows after launch.

Additional measures may include migration accuracy, escalation quality, documentation completeness, handoff quality, and implementation backlog.

**Why Join RunLoyal?**

* Own customer implementations from kickoff through successful launch.
* Work directly with US business owners and operational leaders.
* Build expertise across a complex SaaS platform spanning scheduling, payments, memberships, customer operations, reporting, and integrations.
* Work closely with Product, Engineering, QA, Customer Success, and Support.
* Help shape RunLoyal's implementation processes as the company grows.
* Build a career toward roles such as Implementation Lead, Solutions Consultant, Solutions Architect, Implementation Manager, Technical Account Management, or Customer Success Leadership.

**Our Values**

**Kindness**

**Trust**

**Fearlessness**

**Discourse, Not Dissonance**

**Understanding, Not Consensus**

**Ownership**

**Curiosity**

**Ready to Own the Customer Journey?**

If you enjoy
**understanding businesses, solving complex problems, working directly with customers, managing meaningful SaaS implementations, and growing with a fast-moving product company**

, we would love to hear from you.

And yes—a genuine love for pets is always a plus. 🐾

title: Technical Product Specialist - Elektronica
description:
**Beschrijving**
Voor een internationale groep actief in het produceren en verdelen van die elektrische behuizingen, elektronische componenten en mechanische componenten verdeelt, ben ik op zoek naar een Technical Product Specialist. De klanten zijn onder meer productiebedrijven, machinebouwers, start-ups en engineeringbureaus uit verschillende sectoren.
  
  
Je focust op behuizingen: van standaardproducten tot aangepaste en volledig op maat ontwikkelde oplossingen. Je stelt technische offertes op en vertaalt bestellingen naar duidelijke documentatie voor productie en werkvoorbereiding. Je volgt aanvragen en bestellingen administratief nauwkeurig op en zorgt dat de nodige informatie en materialen beschikbaar zijn.
  
  
Je bent de schakel tussen klanten, buitendienstmedewerkers, productie, leveranciers en collega’s. Je bespreekt klantvragen, leest technische tekeningen en denkt mee over de toepassing van de behuizing, bijvoorbeeld voor klemmen of printplaten. Daarnaast voer je eindcontroles uit. In deze functie is er een belangrijke administratieve component en werk je dagelijks op locatie.
  
  
Af en toe ga je mee met een buitendienstmedewerker naar een klant, bijvoorbeeld wanneer een specifieke oplossing extra toelichting vraagt. De functie past bij iemand die graag administratief en klantgericht werkt, maar ook voldoende technische bagage heeft om klantvragen te begrijpen en met productie te overleggen.
  
  
**Profiel**

* Je combineert administratieve of salesgerichte ervaring met technische bagage.
* Je kunt technische tekeningen lezen en analyseren en hebt kennis van elektriciteit, zoals volt, ampère, klemmen en printplaten.
* Je bent nauwkeurig en gestructureerd in de opvolging van offertes, bestellingen en werkvoorbereidingsdocumentatie.
* Je bent vlot met ERP-systemen en IT-toepassingen.
* Je communiceert vlot in het Nederlands en Engels en hebt een goede kennis van het Frans.
* Je hebt bij voorkeur een bachelor denkniveau; een technische achtergrond in elektriciteit, elektronica of mechanica is een plus.
* Ervaring met Excel, SolidWorks, Fusion, MS Business Central of explosieveilige behuizingen is een plus. Je bent bereid dagelijks op kantoor te werken.

**Aanbod**

* Aantrekkelijk bruto salaris afhankelijk van ervaring (tot max 5.000 bruto)
* Een functie waarin je administratieve en salesgerichte vaardigheden combineert met technische kennis.
* Je werkt dagelijks samen met klanten, buitendienst, productie, leveranciers en collega’s.
* Voor klantbezoeken kun je een wagen gebruiken.
* Groeps-en hospitalisatieverzekering.
* Maaltijdcheques
* 26 vakantiedagen

title: Lead - Performance Marketing & SEO
description:
Allen Online is looking for a Head of Performance Marketing & SEO to own our paid and organic acquisition engine. This role drives high-quality leads that convert into enrolments, and not only app or traffic. You’ll manage a significant monthly budget, lead a team of specialists, and work closely with brand, sales, counselling, product, and content teams. Your success is measured by cost per enrolment and revenue, not just cost per lead.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Performance Marketing (Lead Generation)**

* Own the end-to-end paid acquisition strategy across Google (Search, PMax, YouTube, Demand Gen), Meta (Lead Ads, conversion campaigns), and emerging channels, with full accountability for lead volume, lead quality, and CPL/CPA targets.
* Build and optimise campaigns for lead actions: form fills, counselling bookings, free demo class sign-ups, scholarship test registrations, and callback requests.
* Optimise for down-funnel outcomes by feeding CRM signals (qualified lead, counselling done, enrolment) back to ad platforms via offline conversion imports and Conversions API.
* Plan budgets around academic seasonality: board exams, JEE/NEET result windows, new batch launches, and admission cycles. Scale aggressively during peak intent periods.
* Own landing page and lead form strategy, including A/B testing of forms, offers, and creatives to improve conversion rates without hurting lead quality.
* Run creative strategy with the design and video teams, including performance creatives for students and parents in English, Hindi, and some regional languages.
* Manage agency and partner relationships, including affiliate and lead-aggregator partners, with strict quality controls.

**SEO & Organic Growth**

* Own the organic strategy for Allen Online’s web properties: technical SEO, on-page SEO, content strategy, and link building.
* Capture high-intent exam queries (syllabus, cutoffs, mock tests, previous year papers, results, counselling) and convert that traffic into leads through well-placed CTAs and lead magnets.
* Drive programmatic and scalable content for exam, topic, and city-level pages.
* Prepare for AI-driven search, including visibility in Google AI Overviews and other AI answer engines.
* Work with the content team on editorial and faculty-led content.

**Analytics, Funnel & Leadership**

* Own full-funnel reporting: impressions, leads, qualified leads, counselling. enrolment, revenue, by channel, campaign, course, and geography.
* Work with sales and counselling leadership on lead scoring, lead routing, SLA adherence, and feedback loops on lead quality.
* Set up and maintain tracking via salesforce and other attribution tools.
* Build, hire, and mentor a team of performance marketers, SEO specialists, and analysts.
* Present clear, data-backed reports and forecasts to senior leadership.

**Key Metrics (KRAs)**

* CAC in terms of cost per qualified lead and cost per enrolment
* Lead-to-enrolment conversion rate
* Marketing-sourced revenue and ROAS
* Organic leads and organic share of total leads
* Keyword rankings and organic traffic for priority exam/course clusters
* Lead quality score, as agreed with the sales team

**What We’re Looking For**

* 7-9 years of experience, with deep hands-on expertise in lead-gen performance marketing (not just app install campaigns).
* A track record of managing large monthly ad budgets profitably.
* Real SEO experience- having owned organic growth for a content-heavy site, not just coordinated with an SEO agency.
* Strong grasp of CRM-ad platform integrations, offline conversions, and attribution.
* Analytical depth, comfortable with tracking and reporting tools
* Understanding of Indian student and parent decision-making, including Tier 2/3 and vernacular audiences.
* Experience working closely with sales or counselling teams on lead quality.
* Edtech experience (test prep, K-12, higher ed) is a strong plus.

title: Performance Marketing Manager- B2B Paid Media
description:
**About Mitigata**

Mitigata is India's first AI-native, full-stack cyber resilience company. Most businesses buy security, compliance, and insurance as three separate products from three separate vendors. We bring all three onto one platform, so a single partner can assess a client's risk, help prevent a breach, prove compliance, and cover the financial loss if an incident occurs.

Founded in 2023 and headquartered in Bengaluru, we are a team of 175+ serving 800+ customers across 25+ industries and 6+ countries, including India, the USA, the UAE, the UK, and Singapore. Our broking arm, Mitigata Insurance Brokers Pvt. Ltd., is licensed by IRDAI. We are backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, Nexus Venture Partners, Titan Capital, WEH Ventures,, along with founder-angels including Anupam Mittal (Shaadi.com) and Nitish Mittersain (Nazara).

Join us in building the first line of defence for Digital India, with products built in India for the world.

**Role Overview:**

We are hiring a Performance Marketing Manager to plan, run and scale Mitigata's paid acquisition across Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads and other B2B channels, with one goal: a steady flow of qualified pipeline for our sales team.

**Key Responsibilities :**

* Own paid media strategy and execution across Google Ads (Search, Display, YouTube, Performance Max) and LinkedIn Ads (Sponsored Content, Lead Gen Forms, Conversation Ads, Document Ads).
* Test and scale other B2B channels: Meta, Microsoft Ads, X, Reddit, programmatic and ABM platforms such as 6sense, Demandbase or RollWorks.
* Build account-based campaigns targeting named accounts, industries and buyer roles (CISO, CIO, CTO, IT and risk heads) in India and international markets.
* Plan and manage monthly budgets, bids and pacing to hit cost-per-lead, cost-per-SQL and pipeline targets.
* Set up and maintain conversion tracking, UTMs, GA4, Google Tag Manager, LinkedIn Insight Tag and CRM attribution (HubSpot / Salesforce).
* Write and brief ad copy, creatives and landing pages; run continuous A/B tests on audiences, offers and formats.
* Promote webinars, events, whitepapers and product launches, and run retargeting across the funnel.
* Work with sales on lead quality, qualification and feedback loops so spend follows revenue, not clicks.
* Report weekly and monthly on spend, CPL, MQL-to-SQL conversion, pipeline and ROAS, with clear recommendations.

**Key Skills & Qualifications :**

* 5+ years running paid campaigns for B2B companies, with direct, hands-on ownership of Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads accounts.
* Track record of generating qualified pipeline, not just leads, in long sales cycles with multiple decision-makers.
* Strong command of audience targeting, bidding strategies, budget management and campaign structure.
* Hands-on with GA4, Google Tag Manager, conversion APIs and CRM integrations (HubSpot or Salesforce).
* Comfortable with data: building dashboards in Looker Studio or similar, and turning numbers into decisions.
* Excellent copywriting and creative judgement for senior, technical audiences.
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business or a related field, or equivalent experience.

**Good to have:**

* **Brownie points:**
  experience running ads for cybersecurity companies - MSSPs, security vendors or SaaS security products.
* Experience marketing to BFSI, enterprise IT or regulated industries.
* Familiarity with ABM platforms (6sense, Demandbase, RollWorks) and intent data (Bombora, G2).
* Certifications: Google Ads, LinkedIn Marketing Labs, or HubSpot.
* Experience running campaigns across India, the Middle East, APAC or the US.

**What makes you a strong fit**

* You measure success in pipeline and revenue, not impressions.
* You test fast, kill what doesn't work and scale what does.
* You can explain complex security services in a single headline.
* You work closely with sales and take lead-quality feedback seriously.

**What We Look For**

Every role needs strong skills in its craft. Beyond that, the people who thrive at Mitigata tend to share a few traits:

* **You care about the problem.**
  Protecting businesses and people motivates you, and the impact of your work matters to you.
* **You think from first principles.**
  You question assumptions and reason through new problems instead of relying only on how things have always been done.
* **You take ownership.**
  You care about the outcome, not just the task, and step in where you are needed.
* **You act with integrity.**
  You are candid about mistakes and handle confidential information with care. Our clients trust us in their most difficult moments.
* **You learn quickly.**
  Threats, regulations, and our products change often. We value how fast you grow as much as where you are today.

**How We Hire**

Our process is structured and built to respect your time. It typically includes a recruiter conversation, a hiring manager conversation, and 3 to 5 interviews, one of which is a practical work sample based on real problems. We aim to reach a decision within 2 to 3 weeks of your first conversation and will keep you informed at every stage.

Every candidate is assessed on the same criteria, whatever their background. We handle your personal information with the same care we apply to our clients' data: we collect only what we need and share it only with the people involved in your application.

**Why Join Mitigata?**

*Protecting the businesses that power India's digital economy.*

* **Work that matters.**
  Cyber incidents hit real organisations, from hospitals disrupted by ransomware to directors facing liability claims to startups whose funding is put at risk after a breach. Your work helps protect their systems, their finances, and their reputation.
* **A distinctive model.**
  We combine cybersecurity, compliance, and liability insurance in one company, because protection works best when prevention and coverage go together.
* **Room to build.**
  We are building an AI-native platform and one of India's most comprehensive AI-driven Security Operations Centers, with real scope to solve problems from first principles.
* **Growth that follows impact.**
  We are early and growing quickly, so scope often expands faster than headcount. People who learn fast and take ownership see their responsibilities grow with them.
* **Startup pace, institutional foundations.**
  IRDAI-licensed, backed by leading investors, and trusted by 800+ customers, while still moving at the speed of a startup.
* Competitive compensation,
  **ESOPs**
  , and the opportunity to contribute to work with national impact.

If you want your work to protect the people and businesses behind India's growth, we would love to hear from you.
**Build for protection. Build for Bharat 🇮🇳**

Send your resume to vignesh.g@mitigata.com with the subject line Solutioning & Pre Sales

, positioning, and architecture across Yubi's product lines and business units with the Head of Marketing, and execute it quarter on quarter through campaigns, collaborations, events, podcasts, YouTube, and award submissions, with the support of agencies.

for routine tasks across brand and social workflows: scheduling, publishing, reporting, wherever required, and keep improving their output over time.

6.
**Track competitors and industry**
activity across brand and social on an ongoing basis, surfacing white space and gaps.

**Manage stakeholders**
across agencies, partners, legal and compliance, leadership, and cross-functional teams.

8.
**Manage budgets and vendors:**
agency contracts, campaign budgets, and social media tools, with an eye on cost-efficiency.

9.
**Measure and report on brand and social performance:**
share of voice, sentiment, engagement, reach, and ROI across platforms.

1.
**Brand & Campaign Strategy**
: brand positioning, architecture, and portfolio strategy, with hands-on experience planning and executing campaigns, launches, and events, backed by a continuous read on competitive and industry trends.

2.
**Social Media Strategy & Execution**

title: Brand & Social Media Lead
description:
**Company:**

Robocraze

**Location:**

Bengaluru

**Experience:**

3–4 years

**Compensation:**

₹6–7 LPA

**About the Role:**

As Brand & Social Media Lead, you will be responsible for the strategy, performance and creative quality of our social media channels and LinkedIn presence.

You will work with an existing team comprising social media associate and graphic designer's/video editors. Your role will be to guide the team, establish a high creative standard, improve performance, and ensure that branding and community building receive the attention they deserve.

We are looking for someone with a sharp eye for creativity, strong problem-solving skills, good analytical ability and the confidence to take decisions independently.

**This is not just a social media execution role. We need someone who can think strategically, lead creatively and take ownership of outcomes.**

**Key Responsibilities:**

1.
**Social Media Strategy & Performance**

* Develop and execute social media strategies across five brand pages and relevant LinkedIn profiles.
* Define content pillars, platform-specific approaches, monthly plans and measurable performance goals.
* Track key metrics such as reach, engagement, audience growth, content performance, website traffic and leads or conversions wherever relevant.
* Analyze performance to identify opportunities, improve content effectiveness and drive consistent growth.
* Conduct competitor research, monitor trends and identify relevant opportunities for the brand.
* Prepare regular performance reviews with actionable insights and improvement plans.

2.
**Creative Direction & Quality Control**

* Review and approve creatives, reels, videos, scripts, captions and campaign concepts before publication.
* Maintain high standards of visual quality, storytelling, copywriting, grammar, accuracy and brand consistency.
* Identify errors, weak messaging, repetitive ideas and opportunities to make content more engaging.
* Provide clear, constructive feedback to designers and video editors to improve creative output.
* Develop creative briefs, visual references and guidelines that help the team deliver consistently high-quality work.
* Ensure content is not just visually appealing but also relevant, memorable and aligned with brand objectives.

3.
**Brand Building & Creative Campaigns**

* Develop stronger brand narratives and distinctive content properties that improve brand recall.
* Plan creative campaigns around products, launches, industry trends and relevant occasions.
* Strengthen brand positioning through storytelling, thought leadership and differentiated content.
* Identify opportunities for founder-led content, collaborations, creator partnerships and other brand-building initiatives.
* Ensure consistency across different social media channels while adapting content to each audience.
* Proactively bring new ideas to the table rather than relying only on trends or routine product posts.

4.
**Community Building & Engagement**

* Develop a structured plan for building an engaged community around Robocraze and its brands.
* Encourage meaningful interactions with customers, creators, students, educators, makers and robotics enthusiasts.
* Explore user-generated content, community initiatives, collaborations and engagement campaigns.
* Establish processes for responding to comments, messages and relevant audience conversations.
* Identify opportunities to turn followers and customers into active brand advocates.
* Track meaningful community growth and engagement, not just follower counts.

5.
**Team Leadership & Execution**

* Guide and manage the existing social media associate and team of three graphic designers/video editors.
* Translate strategy into clear briefs, deliverables, priorities and timelines.
* Ensure the content pipeline runs smoothly, from ideation and production to approval, publishing and performance analysis.
* Review team output, maintain quality standards and ensure timely delivery.
* Coach team members, encourage creative thinking and help them improve their skills.
* Take responsibility for solving execution challenges and managing competing priorities.
* Reduce the need for senior management to review routine content and follow up on everyday deliverables.

**What We're Looking For**

* 3–4 years of experience in social media management, content strategy, creative strategy or brand marketing.
* Strong understanding of social media platforms, content formats, audience behavior and performance metrics.
* An excellent eye for design, visual storytelling, typography, composition, detail and creative quality.
* The ability to distinguish between content that simply looks good and content that actually works.
* Good analytical thinking, problem-solving ability and commercial awareness.
* Experience guiding designers, video editors, content creators or other creative team members.
* Strong communication, briefing and feedback skills.
* A proactive mindset, high ownership and the ability to work independently.
* The confidence to challenge weak ideas, suggest better alternatives and make informed decisions.

**Good to Have:**

* Experience working with D2C, e-commerce, consumer technology, electronics, STEM or education brands.
* Experience managing multiple social media accounts or brands simultaneously.
* A portfolio of campaigns, content formats or creative work demonstrating measurable results.
* Exposure to LinkedIn content strategy, founder branding, creator collaborations or community-led marketing.
* Familiarity with analytics tools, social media management platforms and basic creative tools.

title: Senior AEO & SEO Strategist
description:
Role: Senior AEO & SEO Strategist

Location: Pan India

Experience:
**5 to 9 years**

Immediate Joiners Only

JD:

**Senior AEO & SEO Strategist**

**Job Description & Required Skills**

**ROLE LEVEL**

**PRIMARY DISCIPLINES**

**OPERATING SCOPE**

**Senior Individual Contributor**

**AEO, SEO, Content, Technical**

**Global / Enterprise**

**Position Summary**

**The Senior AEO & SEO Strategist is responsible for improving how brands are discovered, understood, cited, and recommended across traditional search engines and AI-powered answer platforms.**

**This role combines technical SEO, content strategy, structured data, analytics, and AI visibility optimization. The ideal candidate understands that AEO and SEO are not separate disciplines, but interconnected parts of a single search and discovery ecosystem.**

**The strategist will use the AEO Intelligence Platform to measure demand, evaluate brand visibility, identify content and technical gaps, generate prioritized recommendations, and support deployment. They must also understand the broader AEO and SEO platform landscape and be able to validate findings through analytics, crawling, keyword research, and AI visibility tools.**

**This person will work across global markets, websites, content teams, developers, UX teams, analytics teams, and client stakeholders to create scalable AEO and SEO programs.**

**Core Responsibilities**

**AEO Strategy and Intelligence**

**Use the AEO Intelligence Platform to measure AI demand, brand mentions, citations, recommendation frequency, competitive visibility, and query-level performance.**

**Build query frameworks across research, problem-solution, purchase-intent, service, expertise, value, and location-based search behaviors.**

**Identify why brands, products, services, or locations are not being surfaced by ChatGPT, Google AI experiences, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot, Claude, and other AI platforms.**

**Translate platform findings into clear content, technical, data, and authority-building recommendations.**

**Evaluate how AI engines understand a brand’s products, services, differentiators, expertise, pricing, availability, and trust signals.**

**Monitor changes in AI discovery, answer-engine behavior, agentic commerce, AI shopping, and emerging search experiences.**

**Technical AEO and SEO**

**Conduct technical audits across crawlability, indexation, rendering, internal linking, canonicalization, redirects, metadata, page templates, JavaScript, page speed, and Core Web Vitals.**

**Evaluate whether important content is accessible and understandable to both search crawlers and AI systems.**

**Develop structured-data strategies using Organization, Product, Offer, Service, LocalBusiness, Article, FAQ, Review, Breadcrumb, and other relevant schema types.**

**Review JSON-LD implementation, entity relationships, product attributes, taxonomy, and machine-readable content.**

**Identify technical issues that limit AI retrieval, citation eligibility, search visibility, or content comprehension.**

**Partner with developers to define implementation requirements, acceptance criteria, quality-assurance processes, and validation plans.**

**Support migrations, redesigns, platform changes, and website launches while protecting both SEO equity and AI visibility.**

**Content AEO and SEO**

**Develop content strategies that directly answer customer questions throughout the discovery and decision journey.**

**Identify gaps in comparison content, buying guides, educational resources, product information, service expertise, local content, and problem-solution content.**

**Improve answer readiness by strengthening headings, summaries, definitions, supporting evidence, product details, trust signals, and contextual internal links.**

**Create content briefs that combine search demand, AI query behavior, customer intent, competitive gaps, and business priorities.**

**Ensure content clearly communicates brand differentiators, product benefits, materials, specifications, pricing, availability, warranties, expertise, and proof points.**

**Balance content designed for AI retrieval with user experience, brand voice, conversion performance, and traditional organic search requirements.**

**Establish scalable content standards across markets, languages, business units, categories, and website templates.**

**Integrated AEO and SEO Planning**

**Create unified AEO and SEO roadmaps rather than treating the disciplines as separate workstreams.**

**Identify shared deliverables across technical optimization, content development, structured data, authority, internal linking, analytics, and website architecture.**

**Prioritize opportunities based on visibility impact, customer demand, implementation effort, business value, and technical feasibility.**

**Build phased programs covering discovery, measurement, gap analysis, fix planning, content and technical creation, deployment, and ongoing optimization.**

**Ensure recommendations support organic rankings, AI mentions, citations, recommendations, traffic, engagement, and conversion performance.**

**Connect AEO and SEO initiatives with CRO, UX, merchandising, product data, paid media, and broader digital-commerce strategies.**

**Measurement and Reporting**

**Define KPIs for AI visibility, mention rate, citation rate, share of voice, query coverage, answer accuracy, organic visibility, traffic, engagement, and conversion.**

**Analyze performance using the AEO Intelligence Platform alongside GA4, Google Search Console, Adobe Analytics, BigQuery, Looker Studio, and other reporting tools.**

**Compare visibility across AI engines, search engines, competitors, markets, categories, and customer-intent groups.**

**Build executive-level reporting that explains current performance, key gaps, recommended actions, expected value, and implementation priorities.**

**Establish testing and monitoring frameworks to evaluate the impact of content and technical changes.**

**Connect AEO and SEO performance to commercial outcomes such as qualified traffic, leads, revenue, product discovery, store visits, and assisted conversions.**

**Global Program Delivery**

**Adapt AEO and SEO strategies for different countries, languages, search behaviors, regulations, market conditions, and technical environments.**

**Establish global standards while allowing for appropriate regional and local-market execution.**

**Collaborate with regional SEO teams, content specialists, developers, analysts, product owners, UX designers, merchandisers, and business leaders.**

**Educate internal teams and clients on the relationship between SEO, AEO, generative search, AI visibility, and agentic commerce.**

**Present complex technical and analytical findings in language appropriate for executive, marketing, content, and engineering audiences.**

**Help define best practices, operating models, governance processes, and quality standards for global AEO and SEO delivery.**

**Required Skills**

**AEO and AI Search**

**Strong understanding of answer engine optimization, generative search, retrieval systems, citations, AI recommendations, and large language model behavior.**

**Ability to analyze how AI engines discover, interpret, summarize, compare, and recommend brands.**

**Experience creating AI-focused query sets and evaluating results by intent, engine, topic, product, and competitor.**

**Understanding of entity optimization, semantic relationships, knowledge graphs, information retrieval, and machine-readable content.**

**Familiarity with AI visibility platforms and the broader AEO technology landscape.**

**Understanding of agentic commerce, AI shopping experiences, product feeds, and machine-readable product information.**

**SEO**

**Advanced technical SEO knowledge.**

**Strong understanding of on-page SEO, content optimization, keyword research, internal linking, site architecture, and search intent.**

**Experience with enterprise websites, ecommerce platforms, international SEO, and large-scale website programs.**

**Knowledge of JavaScript SEO, rendering, crawling, indexing, canonicalization, redirects, and website migrations.**

**Experience developing integrated SEO strategies that connect technical, content, authority, analytics, and user experience.**

**Content Strategy**

**Ability to convert customer questions and search behaviors into structured content plans.**

**Experience creating briefs for category pages, product pages, service pages, comparison pages, buying guides, FAQs, educational content, and local landing pages.**

**Strong understanding of content hierarchy, answer-first writing, topical authority, brand differentiation, and evidence-based content.**

**Ability to balance search visibility, AI visibility, customer experience, conversion, and brand voice.**

**Experience building scalable content standards across templates, markets, and teams.**

**Structured Data and Technical Implementation**

**Working knowledge of Schema.org, JSON-LD, structured data validation, and entity relationships.**

**Ability to define technical requirements for developers and review implementations for quality and accuracy.**

**Understanding of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, content-management systems, ecommerce platforms, APIs, data feeds, and website architecture.**

**Ability to distinguish among content, rendering, semantic, data-quality, and platform-level issues.**

**Familiarity with technical auditing and crawling platforms.**

**Analytics and Platforms**

**Experience with AEO intelligence and AI visibility platforms.**

**Working knowledge of Google Search Console, GA4, Adobe Analytics or Customer Journey Analytics, and BigQuery or another data warehouse.**

**Familiarity with Semrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog or Sitebulb, Botify, Conductor, Profound, or comparable tools.**

**Experience with Looker Studio, Tableau, Power BI, schema validation tools, and page-performance tools.**

**Familiarity with enterprise content-management and ecommerce platforms.**

**Consulting and Communication**

**Ability to translate complex AEO, SEO, technical, and analytical findings into clear business recommendations.**

**Strong executive presentation and storytelling skills.**

**Ability to create roadmaps, scopes, implementation plans, technical requirements, and measurement frameworks.**

**Comfort working with technical and nontechnical stakeholders.**

**Strong prioritization, project-management, and cross-functional leadership skills.**

**Ability to explain both what needs to change and why the change creates business value.**

**Preferred Experience**

**5–8+ years of experience in SEO, digital strategy, content strategy, ecommerce, analytics, or a related discipline.**

**Demonstrated experience supporting enterprise or global SEO programs.**

**Hands-on experience evaluating brand visibility across AI answer engines.**

**Experience supporting website redesigns, migrations, platform changes, or international expansion.**

**Experience working with ecommerce brands, retailers, service organizations, or complex multi-market businesses.**

**Experience partnering with engineering, UX, CRO, analytics, merchandising, and content teams.**

**Experience developing client-facing strategies, proposals, executive presentations, and business cases.**

**Familiarity with experimentation, A/B testing, conversion optimization, and measurement design.**

**Key Competencies**

**• Global AEO and SEO strategy**

**• Technical SEO and AI accessibility**

**• Content gap analysis**

**• Structured data and entity optimization**

**• AI demand and visibility measurement**

**• Competitive intelligence**

**• Query and intent modeling**

**• Ecommerce and product-data optimization**

**• Analytics and performance measurement**

**• Website migration and redesign support**

**• Cross-functional program delivery**

**• Executive communication**

**• Strategic prioritization**

**• Technical requirements development**

**• Quality assurance and implementation validation**

**Measures of Success**

**Increase brand visibility, mentions, citations, and recommendations across AI platforms.**

**Improve organic search visibility and qualified traffic.**

**Expand the percentage of strategically important queries where the brand is represented.**

**Improve how accurately AI engines understand the brand, its offerings, and its differentiators.**

**Reduce technical, content, semantic, and product-data gaps.**

**Move recommendations from analysis into implemented, measurable improvements.**

**Create scalable AEO and SEO standards across global markets.**

**Connect visibility improvements to customer engagement, conversions, leads, and revenue.**

**Help establish the organization as a leader in integrated AEO and SEO strategy.**

**Role Focus: This is a senior strategy and execution role for a practitioner who can connect AEO intelligence, technical SEO, content optimization, analytics, and global program delivery within one integrated operating model.**

title: Social Media Associate
description:
**About the Role**

* The objective is to build a channel that becomes a trusted authority in its category, drives organic discovery and develops a highly engaged audience through consistently valuable content.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Research & Content Discovery**

* Deep-dive into topics, industry developments, audience queries and emerging conversations to uncover interesting content opportunities.
* Identify information gaps and topics that are underserved or inadequately covered by existing creators.
* Understand what the target audience is searching for, discussing and struggling with.
* Develop research-backed content that delivers genuine insights and actionable value.

**Content Ideation & Scripting**

* Develop fresh, differentiated content ideas based on audience needs, research and emerging trends.
* Write compelling Instagram Reel scripts with strong hooks, engaging storytelling and clear takeaways.
* Simplify complex information into easy-to-understand, engaging and shareable content.
* Develop recurring content formats and IPs that establish the channel's identity and build audience recall.
* Ensure content balances educational value, entertainment and relatability.

**Instagram Growth & Algorithm Understanding**

* Develop a deep understanding of Instagram's content recommendation and distribution ecosystem.
* Understand what drives reach, watch time, retention, shares, saves, engagement and follower conversion.
* Experiment with hooks, storytelling structures, Reel lengths, formats and creative approaches to improve organic distribution.
* Study successful creators and emerging content formats to identify opportunities that can be adapted to our audience.
* Build content that earns distribution through genuine audience value rather than relying solely on trends or viral gimmicks.

**Content Execution & Publishing**

* Own the content pipeline from research and ideation to scripting, production coordination and publishing.
* Work closely with on-camera talent to ensure videos are engaging, credible and natural.
* Collaborate with editors and designers to translate content ideas into high-quality Instagram-native creatives.
* Ensure consistency in publishing while maintaining a high bar for content quality.

**Performance Analysis & Experimentation**

* Track and analyse Reel performance across reach, average watch time, retention, shares, saves, profile visits and follows.
* Understand why certain content performs well and identify patterns that can be replicated.
* Continuously test new content formats, hooks, topics and storytelling approaches.
* Use performance insights to improve the content strategy and accelerate organic channel growth.

**What We're Looking For**

* 1–3 years of experience in Instagram growth, social media, content strategy or content creation.
* Excellent research skills and a natural curiosity to explore topics in depth.
* Strong writing, scripting and storytelling abilities.
* A deep understanding of Instagram Reels, content discovery and audience behaviour.
* An instinct for identifying what makes content engaging, informative and shareable.
* An analytical mindset with a strong appetite for experimentation.
* Ability to independently take ownership of a channel and drive its growth.
* Experience working with educational, informational or creator-led Instagram accounts is a plus.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Building a credible and recognisable face-led Instagram channel.
* Consistently producing differentiated, research-backed and high-value Reels.
* Developing repeatable content formats that drive organic discovery.
* Improving reach, watch time, retention, shares, saves and follower growth.
* Establishing the channel as a trusted source of information within its category.
* If you enjoy going down research rabbit holes, understanding why content works and turning complex information into Instagram content that people genuinely find valuable, we'd love to hear from you.
