title: Brand & Communications Specialist -Fuels
description:
**What’s The Role**
Mobility is Shell’s largest customer-facing business, serving more than 32 million customers daily through a network of over 46,000 sites across 80+ countries. Delivering on our growth ambitions requires a strong customer-centric approach, ensuring every interaction reinforces Shell’s purpose of making customers’ journeys better.
  
  
The Marketing Implementation Lead - Fuels plays a pivotal role in driving brand and communications strategy for the Fuels and E-Mobility portfolio, supporting business objectives and commercial performance across the market.
  
  
This role is primarily focused on strengthening the positioning and differentiation of Shell’s Fuels portfolio, a key strategic priority for achieving business growth targets. As a critical member of the Mobility Marketing team, the incumbent will report directly to the Brands and Communications Manager and work closely with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver impactful marketing initiatives.
  
  
The position carries responsibility for managing significant Sales Promotion and Advertising (SP&A) investments, requiring a balance between effectiveness and efficiency to maximize return on investment. The successful candidate will contribute to business performance while building a distinctive, purpose-led brand that enhances Shell Mobility’s competitive advantage and customer preference.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Act as the custodian of Brand Share Preference (BSP) and High Quality Fuels (HQF) scores, driving initiatives that strengthen Shell’s premium fuel perception, increase differentiated fuel penetration, and expand market share.
* Integrated Marketing Communications: Plan and execute integrated marketing campaigns across digital, social, retail, and on-ground touchpoints to strengthen brand awareness, consideration, and customer engagement.
* Media Planning & Optimisation: Lead integrated media planning across traditional and digital channels, working closely with media agencies to optimise channel mix, audience targeting, reach, frequency, and media investments to maximise campaign effectiveness and ROI
* Support category managers with CVP creation/Customer offer development based on consumer insights and ensure the CVP is translated into ATL and BTL actions to deliver the desired results.
* Monitor and analyze media performance metrics to refine strategies and maximize ROI.
* Agency Management: Work with creative and media agencies, global & local teams to support Brand Development & Management for creating a differentiated proposition and driving the positioning for Shell Fuels
* Manage on-site communications Planogram across sites for fuels.
* Strengthen positioning and preference for premium fuels initiatives
* Lead customer research (qualitative and quantitative) to gain insights into market trends, customer preferences, and competitive landscape.
* Leverage consumer research, market intelligence, campaign performance data, and customer insights to identify growth opportunities, inform marketing strategies, and drive data-backed decision-making.
* Keep up with the trends in fuel retail industry

**What You Bring**

* Degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field; MBA is an advantage.
* Minimum of 3-6 years of experience in marketing, brand communications, or a related discipline.
* Proven expertise in brand management, integrated marketing, marketing communications, and campaign activation.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and storytelling skills.
* Strong stakeholder management capabilities with the ability to effectively engage both internal and external partners.
* understanding of the fuel retail industry and its evolving market dynamics.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate across cross-functional teams and Global stakeholders.
* Capable of managing multiple stakeholder requirements while ensuring alignment across teams and projects.
* Creative and resourceful thinker with the ability to deliver impactful marketing communications in challenging or constrained environments.
* Experienced in leveraging a mix of marketing channels, including targeted digital campaigns, public relations, influencer partnerships, and other innovative communication platforms.
* Agile and adaptable, with the ability to respond quickly to changing market conditions and business priorities within the dynamic fuel retail landscape in India.

**What We Offer**
You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You’ll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. You’ll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself.
  
  

* Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together.
* Continuously grow the transferable skills you need to get ahead.
* Work at the forefront of technology, trends, and practices.
* Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise.
* Achieve your balance in a values-led culture that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.
* Join an organisation working to become one of the most diverse and inclusive in the world. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientation, and life experiences to apply.
* Grow as you progress through diverse career opportunities in national and
* international teams.
* Gain access to a wide range of training and development programmes.

**After you submit your application, you will receive an email providing a link to an online assessment that is a mandatory part of the process. The email will come from HireVue - please check your spam/junk mailbox if you do not see the email. Once completed, your application will be reviewed to determine next steps. Thank you for your interest in Shell.**

title: Creative Strategist
description:
Vedantu is looking for a creative-first
**Creative Strategist**
who can drive the ideation, development and execution of compelling, performance-driven advertising creatives across digital platforms.

The ideal candidate will combine strong creative thinking, consumer understanding and storytelling abilities with a sound understanding of performance marketing. You will be responsible for translating audience insights and business objectives into impactful ad concepts, engaging scripts and high-performing creative campaigns.

This role requires someone who can think strategically, write compellingly and collaborate effectively with creative production teams to deliver advertising that captures attention, drives engagement and generates measurable business results.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Creative Strategy & Concept Development**

* Develop innovative advertising concepts, campaign themes, creative angles and messaging strategies aligned with business and marketing objectives.
* Research target audiences to identify their needs, pain points, motivations and purchase behaviour.
* Translate consumer insights into compelling creative concepts that resonate with different audience segments.
* Conduct competitor analysis and research emerging advertising trends, formats and creative approaches.
* Develop creative strategies across different products, audiences and stages of the customer journey.

**2. Ad Copywriting, Hooks & Script Development**

* Create engaging hooks, headlines, ad copies, calls to action (CTAs) and video scripts for digital advertising campaigns.
* Conceptualize short-form video ads, UGC-style content, customer testimonials, founder/teacher-led videos and promotional campaigns.
* Develop storyboards, content narratives and detailed creative briefs for designers, video editors and content creators.
* Experiment with different storytelling techniques, messaging angles and creative formats to improve audience engagement and conversions.

**3. Creative Production & Collaboration**

* Own the creative development process from initial ideation and conceptualization to briefing, production and final execution.
* Collaborate closely with designers, video editors, content creators and external creative partners to bring concepts to life.
* Ensure all creative assets align with brand guidelines, campaign objectives and target audience requirements.
* Oversee the development of a consistent pipeline of high-quality static, carousel and video advertisements.
* Review creative outputs and provide actionable feedback to maintain quality, consistency and effectiveness.

**4. Creative Testing, Analysis & Optimization**

* Develop structured creative testing strategies across concepts, hooks, messaging, formats, visuals and CTAs.
* Analyse campaign and creative-level performance to identify successful patterns, opportunities and areas for improvement.
* Continuously refine and iterate advertising creatives based on performance insights and audience response.
* Identify creative fatigue and proactively develop fresh concepts and variations to sustain campaign effectiveness.
* Maintain a structured creative repository documenting concepts, test results, performance insights and key learnings.

**5. Performance Marketing & Business Understanding**

* Develop a strong understanding of Meta advertising platforms and the role of creative assets in driving campaign performance.
* Work closely with performance marketing teams to launch, evaluate and optimize advertising creatives.
* Monitor relevant performance indicators, including CTR, CPL, CPA, conversion rates and ROAS.
* Evaluate creative effectiveness beyond engagement metrics by understanding its impact on lead quality, demo bookings, conversions and revenue.
* Leverage campaign insights, sales feedback and customer interactions to identify new creative opportunities and improve advertising effectiveness.

**What We're Looking For:**

* Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in Creative Strategy, Performance Creative, Advertising, Digital Content Strategy or a related field.
* Strong creative thinking, conceptualization and storytelling abilities, with a good understanding of consumer psychology and direct-response advertising.
* Excellent copywriting skills, particularly in developing attention-grabbing hooks, compelling ad copies, headlines and video scripts.
* Demonstrated experience conceptualizing advertising creatives for Meta, Instagram, Facebook or other digital advertising platforms.
* Understanding of performance-oriented creative formats, including UGC, short-form videos, testimonials and promotional advertisements.
* Experience collaborating with designers, video editors, content creators or creative production teams.
* Ability to interpret creative performance data and translate insights into actionable improvements.
* Working knowledge of Meta Ads and key performance marketing metrics.
* A portfolio demonstrating creative concepts, advertising scripts, campaigns or performance-driven creatives developed.

**Good to Have**

* Experience in EdTech, D2C, B2C or other consumer-focused industries.
* Exposure to lead-generation and customer-acquisition campaigns.
* Familiarity with creative tools such as Canva, Adobe Photoshop, CapCut or similar platforms.
* Understanding of the customer acquisition funnel and how advertising creatives influence purchase decisions.

**The Ideal Candidate:**

You are a creative thinker with a strong understanding of marketing and consumer behaviour. You enjoy identifying what motivates an audience, developing compelling advertising ideas and transforming those ideas into engaging creative assets.

You are curious, experimental and data-aware. You take ownership of the creative process, collaborate effectively with production teams and continuously look for ways to make advertising more impactful.

Most importantly, you understand that successful performance advertising begins with a strong creative idea — one that captures attention, communicates value and inspires action.

title: PR & Content Executive (LinkedIn & Brand)
description:
**The role:**

You will own our LinkedIn presence (company page and founder/leadership profiles) and build our PR and brand voice. We need someone who writes well, ships daily, and can explain a technical, data-heavy business in plain language.

**What you’ll do**

• Plan and write 4–6 LinkedIn posts a week for the company page and leadership profiles (thought leadership, data and AI commentary, product and dataset announcements, hiring and culture posts).

• Ghostwrite for founders and leaders in their own voice.

• Write press releases, media pitches, and bylines. Pitch to tech, AI, and startup media and manage follow-ups.

• Maintain brand voice, messaging, and visual consistency across LinkedIn, website, and sales decks.

• Run a monthly content calendar. Track impressions, engagement, follower growth and inbound leads, and report what worked.

• Support sales with content: case-study snippets, one-pagers and outreach-friendly posts.

• Track industry news, funding, and AI-data trends for timely commentary.

• Coordinate with design for carousels, creatives, and short videos.

**Requirements:**

• 1–2 years in PR, content marketing, or social media/brand writing (agency or in-house).

• A portfolio of LinkedIn posts you wrote, ideally with results (reach, engagement, follower growth).

• Strong English writing with a clear, sharp style. No filler, no jargon padding.

• Hands-on knowledge of LinkedIn mechanics: formats, hooks, posting cadence, analytics.

• Basic PR skills: press releases, media lists, pitching.

• Comfortable with Canva or similar, plus tools such as Notion, Buffer, or Taplio.

**Good to have**

• B2B, SaaS, AI, or data-industry experience.

• Experience with founder/executive personal branding.

• Basic video editing or short-form video skills.

• Familiarity with SEO basics and newsletters.

title: Junior CRM Specialist, AI-first (India)
description:

This AI capability is new to the team, and you will help shape how we build it.

The Customization Group is a global leader in mass customization and print-on-demand e-commerce. We manufacture up to 2.5 million unique, personalized products daily across production sites in Germany, Poland, the USA and Latvia. Millions of customers find us through our 20+ online shops and 1,000+ partner stores. AI applied to that scale of customer data is the opportunity this role gets to work on.

title: Head of Growth
description:

We operate at the intersection of AI and life sciences, combining machine learning with cutting-edge biology to help people measure, understand, and reverse their biological age. We’re building for the US market and looking for a growth leader who can scale the consumer application.

**The Role**

As Head of Growth, you’ll own go-to-market strategy and growth engine end to end. You’ll take what we’ve built and turn it into a multi-million-dollar business in the US, building the team, channels, and play books to get there. This is a high-ownership leadership role reporting directly to the founders.

**What You’ll Do**

* Design and execute US go-to-market strategy, from positioning and pricing to channel mix and launch

title: Account Manager
description:
uDot is building new possibilities for learning beyond sight.

Website: https://www.udot.tech/

For people who are blind or visually impaired, access to information has long depended on how well the world adapts to their needs. uDot is exploring a different possibility: one where tactile technology can open up new ways to discover, understand and engage with the world, supported by learning experiences designed to grow with those who use them.

We are looking for an Account Manager to help turn a new possibility in learning into a movement.

Experience: 3–6 years

Location: Bengaluru (Electronic City), onsite preferred

Function: Marketing & Communications

Reports to: Founders, working closely with the Marketing & Brand Lead

Travel: Required for conferences, institutional engagements and pilot-site visits

About uDot

uDot (Udot Braille Tech Pvt Ltd) is a Bengaluru assistive-technology and edtech startup. We have built a refreshable tactile display, a ~2,400-pin device that renders Braille, diagrams, graphs and even tactile animations, paired with a curriculum-aligned learning platform for blind and visually impaired students.

The platform assesses each student, places them at their real level and takes them through lessons, practice, games and assessments with audio, so they can learn Math and Science independently. Teachers can support many students without hand-making tactile material.

Why it matters: over 95% of blind children in India drop Math and Science by Grade 7, because there's no way for them to engage with these subjects independently. We're changing that.

uDot launched commercially in August 2026 and is already in live classrooms. At Blind People's Association, Ahmedabad, 25 blind and low-vision children learn on uDot as a timetabled subject. We're scaling across India, with an international pipeline opening up in the US and Europe.

uDot is now moving from building the technology to building the ecosystem around it.

This means working with educators, schools, institutions, accessibility organisations, corporate partners and international stakeholders, while developing the market and demonstrating the value of what we are building.

uDot is looking for an Account Manager to help build and run uDot's marketing function.

If you enjoy being close to innovation, working across disciplines and helping shape something from an early stage, this is an opportunity to do that. You will work closely with the founders and Marketing & Brand Lead to turn business and brand priorities into clear plans, briefs and execution.

This is a hands-on role in a growing company. You will move between research, writing, project management, content, digital platforms, events and external coordination.

The role will involve working across Indian and international markets, coordinating with internal teams, clients, partners and external specialists.

We are looking for someone who takes initiative, works independently and brings structure to an evolving function. Experience in education, learning or a related field is strongly preferred.

What you will own

1. Research markets and identify opportunities

• Research relevant markets, audiences, competitors and organisations in education and accessible technology.

• Identify relevant institutions, conferences, networks and opportunities in India and international markets.

• Turn research into useful insights and maintain a shared repository of findings and references.

2. Develop content and communication

• Create and coordinate content for uDot's website, LinkedIn, email, presentations, case studies and other marketing materials.

• Translate technical information into clear communication for different audiences.

• Work with the founders, internal experts, educators and partners to develop stories and materials that communicate uDot's work.

• Maintain content calendars and ensure consistency across channels.

3. Manage marketing projects

• Take projects from brief to delivery, managing timelines, feedback, approvals and deliverables.

• Coordinate with internal teams, agencies, freelancers and other external partners.

• Prepare briefs, review outputs and resolve routine issues independently.

• Maintain simple systems to keep projects, budgets and marketing assets organised.

4. Support institutions, partnerships and events

• Prepare presentations, proposals and other materials for schools, education institutions, CSR teams, foundations and international audiences.

• Coordinate conferences, demonstrations, institutional meetings and related communication.

• Manage event preparation and follow-ups, keeping track of contacts, conversations and next steps.

• Travel for conferences, institutional engagements and pilot-site visits as required.

The role supports partnership development through research, communication and follow-through. Key relationships and commercial decisions remain with the founders and relevant business leads.

5. Track momentum

• Maintain marketing plans, calendars, project trackers and basic budgets.

• Track relevant website, content, campaign and event performance, and share regular updates and recommendations.

• Use tools such as ChatGPT and Gemini to improve research, content development and productivity, while checking outputs for accuracy.

• Identify practical ways to improve marketing processes and workflows.

What is uDot looking for

Essential

• 3–6 years of experience in marketing, communications, content, brand or a related field.

• Strong writing, editing, research and presentation skills.

• Experience managing projects from planning through execution.

• Good organisation, project management and follow-through.

• Ability to work independently, take initiative and coordinate with different teams and external partners.

• Comfort working directly with founders in a growing organisation where processes are still evolving.

• Willingness to work across different marketing activities and travel when required.

Strongly preferred

• Experience in education, learning, edtech or a related field.

• Experience in a startup or small team.

• Ability to communicate complex technology clearly to different audiences.

• Familiarity with digital marketing tools, website platforms and basic analytics.

++ Advantage

• Practical use of AI tools such as ChatGPT and Gemini to improve the quality or efficiency of work.

• Evidence of initiative beyond assigned work, such as a self-started project, independent research or a process improvement.

• Experience working across Indian and international markets.

How we work

You will work closely with the founders and Marketing & Brand Lead. Strategic direction and brand priorities will be developed collaboratively; your role is to turn them into clear plans and consistent execution.

We value people who take ownership, think independently, learn quickly and follow through. Prior experience in accessibility is not essential, but an interest in inclusive learning and technology is important.

description:

About the Role

We are looking for a results-driven Senior Growth & Performance Marketing Lead to drive the brand's overall business growth, revenue acceleration, and marketing efficiency.

The role requires a strong understanding of business strategy, performance marketing, e-commerce, and marketing technology. The candidate will work closely with leadership to translate business objectives into actionable growth plans, identify new revenue opportunities, build scalable marketing systems, and drive measurable business outcomes.

The ideal candidate should combine strategic thinking with hands-on expertise in Meta Ads, Google Ads, Shopify, analytics, and digital growth ecosystems.

Key Responsibilities

1. Business Growth & Strategy

- Develop and execute growth strategies aligned with business objectives and revenue targets.

- Identify growth opportunities across D2C, marketplaces, quick commerce, and emerging channels.

- Drive revenue growth, customer acquisition, marketing efficiency, and profitability.

- Work closely with leadership to translate business strategy into actionable growth plans.

- Identify opportunities across product categories, customer segments, and distribution channels.

2. Performance Marketing

- Own performance marketing across Meta Ads, Google Ads, YouTube, and other relevant platforms.

- Develop full-funnel marketing strategies focused on customer acquisition, conversions, and revenue.

- Drive campaign optimisation, budget allocation, creative testing, and audience segmentation.

- Monitor key metrics including CAC, ROAS, MER, CTR, CVR, AOV, and marketing efficiency.

- Coordinate with creative teams and agencies to develop performance-driven campaigns.

3. Technology Stack & Shopify

- Build and optimise the marketing technology ecosystem to support business growth.

- Work closely with the website development agency to improve Shopify performance, functionality, and conversion.

- Evaluate and implement relevant Shopify apps, integrations, analytics tools, CRM platforms, and automation solutions.

- Ensure accurate tracking and integration across Shopify, Meta Ads, Google Ads, GA4, and other marketing platforms.

- Identify technology gaps and coordinate with internal teams, agencies, and vendors for effective implementation.

4. E-commerce & Customer Growth

- Drive website growth through CRO, landing page optimisation, PDP enhancements, and checkout improvements.

- Develop strategies to improve conversion rates, AOV, customer retention, repeat purchase rates, and LTV.

- Drive customer lifecycle marketing through CRM, WhatsApp, email, and marketing automation.

- Identify opportunities to improve customer experience and overall marketing efficiency.

5. Marketplace & Quick Commerce Growth

- Identify and drive growth opportunities across Amazon, Flipkart, Nykaa, Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart, and other relevant platforms.

- Develop channel-level growth strategies focused on revenue, visibility, conversions, and profitability.

- Coordinate with internal marketplace and business operations teams to drive execution.

6. Analytics & Stakeholder Management

- Establish growth dashboards and structured performance reporting.

- Analyse business performance, customer behaviour, channel contribution, and marketing efficiency.

- Translate data into actionable insights and growth recommendations.

- Coordinate with leadership, internal teams, agencies, and technology partners to ensure effective execution.

- Take ownership of growth initiatives from strategy and planning through execution and optimisation.

Required Skills & Qualifications

- 5+ years of experience in growth marketing, performance marketing, or digital marketing.

- Proven experience in scaling revenue for D2C, e-commerce, or consumer brands.

- Strong hands-on experience with Meta Ads and Google Ads.

- Experience with Shopify, website analytics, CRO, and marketing technology integrations.

- Understanding of CRM, marketing automation, customer acquisition, retention, and LTV.

- Strong analytical, strategic thinking, and problem-solving skills.

- Experience managing agencies, technology partners, and cross-functional teams.

- Ability to balance business strategy with hands-on execution.

What We Are Looking For

Someone who thinks beyond individual campaigns and focuses on overall business growth.

A professional who can understand business strategy, identify growth opportunities, build the right technology ecosystem, and drive execution with clear ownership and accountability.

The ideal candidate should be equally comfortable discussing revenue targets with leadership, analysing Meta and Google Ads performance, and coordinating with technology partners to build scalable growth systems.

Key Hiring Non-negotiables

1. Business Growth Ownership: Proven experience in scaling revenue and driving business outcomes.

2. Performance Marketing Expertise: Strong hands-on understanding of Meta Ads and Google Ads.

3. Technology & Shopify: Experience building and optimising marketing technology stacks, integrations, and e-commerce systems.

4. Strategic Execution: Ability to translate business strategy into actionable growth plans.

5. Growth Beyond Paid Media: Understanding of CRO, CRM, retention, marketplaces, quick commerce, and customer LTV.

title: ABM Specialist – Marketing Automation
description:
**Company:**
Synax Technologies

**Location:**
Hyderabad, India

**Experience:**
3–5 Years

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

About Synax Technologies

Synax Technologies is a Value-Added Distributor (VAD) specialising in cybersecurity solutions across the Middle East and Africa (MEA). We work with leading global cybersecurity vendors to help enterprises, BFSI institutions, telecom operators, and government organisations strengthen their cybersecurity posture.

We are looking for a highly analytical and technology-driven ABM Specialist who can leverage website visitor intelligence, prospecting tools, and marketing automation platforms to identify potential customers, convert anonymous website traffic into qualified leads, and build automated multi-channel engagement journeys.

Key Responsibilities1. Website Visitor Intelligence & Lead Identification

* Implement and manage website visitor identification and tracking platforms to identify companies visiting the Synax website.
* Analyse visitor behaviour, including pages visited, frequency of visits, time spent, and areas of interest.
* Identify high-intent accounts based on their website engagement and browsing behaviour.
* Convert anonymous website visitors into identifiable company accounts and potential business opportunities wherever data permits.
* Enrich identified accounts with relevant company information, decision-makers, contact details, and organisational insights.
* Develop processes to transfer qualified visitor intelligence into the CRM or prospecting platforms.

2. Account-Based Marketing & Prospect Intelligence

* Build and manage targeted account lists based on website visitor data, industry, geography, company size, and technology interests.
* Identify relevant decision-makers such as CISOs, CIOs, CTOs, IT Directors, procurement heads, and other business stakeholders.
* Use platforms such as Apollo.io and LinkedIn Sales Navigator to identify and enrich prospect information.
* Segment prospects based on industry, job role, account engagement, and potential buying intent.
* Develop personalised account engagement strategies for enterprise prospects across MEA.
* Monitor account-level engagement and identify opportunities for sales follow-up.

3. Marketing Automation & Multi-Channel Outreach

* Build end-to-end automated communication workflows using platforms such as Apollo.io, HubSpot, Brevo, Zapier, and Make.
* Automate personalised email and LinkedIn outreach to identified prospects and target accounts.
* Create intelligent workflows based on website visits, prospect engagement, lead scores, and buying signals.
* Set up automated follow-ups, conditional triggers, engagement-based segmentation, and workflow exit conditions.
* Integrate website visitor intelligence platforms with CRM, prospecting, and communication tools.
* Develop automated journeys that move prospects from initial identification to meaningful sales engagement.
* Ensure that outreach is personalised based on the prospect's industry, role, company, and demonstrated interests.

4. Intent Data & Account Signals

* Identify companies actively researching cybersecurity solutions and services.
* Monitor relevant buying signals, technology adoption, organisational changes, and other business triggers.
* Use intent data and website engagement insights to prioritise high-potential accounts.
* Build targeted prospecting campaigns around specific cybersecurity requirements and industry challenges.
* Translate account intelligence into actionable insights for the sales team.

5. Analytics & Performance Optimisation

* Monitor website visitor identification, account engagement, lead conversion, and outreach performance.
* Develop dashboards to track visitor-to-lead conversion and account engagement.
* Measure the effectiveness of automated workflows and identify opportunities for optimisation.
* Work closely with sales teams to ensure identified accounts and leads are followed up effectively.

Required Technical Skills

Candidates must have practical experience with the following tools and technologies:

* **Website Visitor Intelligence:**
  Leadfeeder (Dealfront), Lead Forensics, RB2B, Albacross, or similar platforms.
* **Prospecting & Data Enrichment:**
  Apollo.io, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Lusha, ZoomInfo, or similar.
* **Marketing Automation:**
  HubSpot, Apollo.io, Brevo, ActiveCampaign, or equivalent.
* **Workflow Automation:**
  Zapier, Make, API integrations, and webhook-based automation.
* **Analytics & Tracking:**
  Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console, and Looker Studio.
* **CRM:**
  HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, or similar platforms.

Mandatory Requirements

* 3–5 years of experience in B2B marketing, ABM, demand generation, or marketing automation.
* Strong hands-on experience with website visitor identification and account intelligence.
* Proven ability to identify target companies and enrich them with relevant decision-maker contacts.
* Strong expertise in building automated workflows across multiple platforms.
* Practical experience automating email and LinkedIn prospect engagement.
* Understanding of B2B prospecting, lead scoring, intent signals, and enterprise buying journeys.
* Ability to independently manage the complete process from visitor identification to sales-qualified lead generation.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience in cybersecurity, IT, SaaS, or technology marketing.
* Experience targeting international markets, particularly the Middle East and Africa.
* Understanding of enterprise cybersecurity products and services.
* Knowledge of AI-powered prospecting, data enrichment, and marketing automation.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Number of identifiable target accounts discovered through website visitor intelligence.
* Number of qualified decision-makers identified and enriched.
* Website visitor-to-lead conversion rate.
* Number of engaged and qualified target accounts.
* Automated outreach engagement and response rates.
* Marketing-qualified leads generated.
* Sales opportunities and pipeline contribution from ABM initiatives.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who understands how to build an intelligent, automated B2B lead generation ecosystem.

The ideal candidate should be able to identify companies visiting our website, understand their interests, discover the relevant decision-makers, enrich their contact information, and trigger personalised email and LinkedIn engagement automatically.

**This is a technology-driven ABM role, not a conventional email marketing position. We expect someone who can build, integrate, and manage the entire visitor-to-lead conversion process independently.**

**If you meet the above requirement, please email your CV to recruitment@synaxtech.com**

description:
PURPLE BUSINESSJOB DESCRIPTION — FOUNDER'S OFFICE (SOCIAL MEDIA & CONTENT GROWTH)

Founder's Office – Social Media & Brand Growth

Internship

**Reporting To:**
Supreet Venkata, Founder

About Purple Business

Purple Business is an emerging AI-powered business growth platform helping small businesses grow through intelligent marketing, advertising, customer acquisition, customer intelligence, and AI-powered automation.

We are building a platform that empowers small business owners to attract more customers, grow revenue, and make better business decisions using AI.

As we continue developing our product and preparing for launch, we want to build a strong social media presence, create meaningful relationships with small business owners, and establish Purple Business as a recognizable voice in the business and AI ecosystem.

We are looking for a
**creative, confident, and entrepreneurial individual to join our Founder's Office, focusing on Social Media, Content Creation, and Brand Growth.**

This role goes beyond managing social media accounts. You will work directly with the founders to develop our content strategy, create engaging videos, represent Purple Business on camera, build communities, and contribute to the company's overall growth.

**Important: This is an on-camera content creation role. You must be comfortable showing your face, speaking in videos, recording Reels, and becoming one of the recognizable faces of Purple Business.**

1. Roles & ResponsibilitiesA. Social Media Strategy & Founder Collaboration

1. Work directly with Supreet Venkata and the Founder's Office to develop Purple Business's social media strategy.
2. Understand the company's vision, product, target audience, brand positioning, and long-term objectives.
3. Participate in strategic discussions about brand awareness, content growth, customer acquisition, and community building.
4. Develop content strategies that resonate with small business owners, entrepreneurs, startup founders, and professionals.
5. Collaborate with the founders on important announcements, product launches, campaigns, and brand storytelling.
6. Identify creative opportunities to establish Purple Business as a recognizable brand across digital platforms.
7. Build content calendars, campaigns, and social media initiatives aligned with company priorities.

B. On-Camera Reels & Video Content Creation

1. **Actively appear on camera and create Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn videos, and other short-form content.**
2. Become one of the faces and voices representing Purple Business on social media.
3. Present educational, entertaining, informative, and promotional content related to small businesses, marketing, AI, and entrepreneurship.
4. Record talking-head videos, explainers, product demonstrations, interviews, and storytelling-based content.
5. Develop compelling video hooks, scripts, introductions, and calls to action.
6. Experiment with different presentation styles, storytelling formats, and engaging video concepts.
7. Collaborate with video editors, motion designers, and graphic designers to produce polished content.
8. Participate in founder-led videos, team collaborations, behind-the-scenes content, and other brand initiatives.
9. Continuously improve on-camera communication, storytelling, speaking confidence, and audience engagement.

**This role requires active participation in front of the camera, not just scripting, editing, or managing content from behind the scenes.**

C. Content Ideation, Storytelling & Creative Direction

1. Generate original and engaging content ideas for Purple Business's social media channels.
2. Develop storytelling formats that communicate the challenges and aspirations of small business owners.
3. Create compelling narratives around AI, advertising, customer growth, entrepreneurship, and business transformation.
4. Study successful content formats, viral hooks, audience engagement patterns, and emerging social media trends.
5. Experiment with educational content, opinion-based videos, interviews, relatable business situations, and product storytelling.
6. Help develop a distinct brand voice and content identity for Purple Business.
7. Collaborate with the design and video teams to turn creative ideas into engaging content.
8. Ensure content remains authentic, informative, visually consistent, and aligned with the company's brand.

D. Small Business Owner Interviews & Community Content

1. Identify interesting small business owners, entrepreneurs, cafe founders, restaurant owners, and other potential content collaborators.
2. Conduct interviews and conversations with business owners about their experiences, challenges, and growth journeys.
3. Create video content featuring real small business stories, entrepreneurial insights, and customer experiences.
4. Collaborate with the market research team to identify valuable topics and audience insights.
5. Develop content that encourages small business owners to participate in conversations and share their experiences.
6. Help build relationships with business creators, entrepreneurs, and relevant communities.
7. Explore opportunities for collaborative Reels, interviews, podcasts, and other content partnerships.

E. Social Media Management & Growth

1. Help manage Purple Business's presence across Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, Facebook, X, and other relevant platforms.
2. Coordinate content calendars, posting schedules, campaign planning, and content approvals.
3. Work with the social media team to improve engagement, reach, audience growth, and brand awareness.
4. Identify opportunities to grow the company's follower base and build a relevant audience of small business owners.
5. Experiment with organic growth strategies, creator collaborations, community engagement, and content distribution.
6. Analyze content performance and identify topics or formats generating meaningful engagement.
7. Track relevant metrics including reach, views, watch time, engagement, follower growth, profile visits, and qualified enquiries.
8. Prepare regular reports on content performance, experiments, and opportunities for improvement.

F. Product Marketing & Customer Acquisition

1. Develop a strong understanding of Purple Business's product features, AI capabilities, and customer benefits.
2. Create engaging content demonstrating how Purple Business helps companies grow.
3. Collaborate with the product and design teams to create feature explainers, walkthroughs, and launch-related videos.
4. Work with the Customer Growth & Traction team to understand customer acquisition priorities and target audiences.
5. Create content that encourages relevant business owners to learn more about Purple Business, join early-access programs, or explore the product.
6. Coordinate social media initiatives that contribute to brand awareness, inbound enquiries, and potential customer acquisition.
7. Translate research insights and customer pain points into content that communicates meaningful product value.

G. Founder's Office & Cross-Functional Collaboration

1. Actively participate in the Founder's Office and contribute to discussions involving company growth, branding, product positioning, and business strategy.
2. Work directly with the founder on content priorities, campaigns, and strategic communication.
3. Collaborate with the social media, graphic design, motion design, and video editing teams.
4. Work with the Market Research team to understand small business owners and develop research-backed content.

2. Key Expected Deliverables

Throughout your internship, you will work toward delivering:

1. **On-Camera Video Content:**
   Consistent participation in Reels, Shorts, explainers, interviews, and other video formats featuring you on camera.

new parents who read every label and want food they would eat themselves.

a large and growing share of our sales comes from marketplaces. You will build how Rorosaur wins there, not inherit someone else's playbook.

•    Keep brand defence and new-customer growth clearly split.

Blinkit, Swiggy Instamart and more

•    Brief the creative team on what each platform needs: images, videos, banners, listing content.

A clean account structure on Amazon and each quick commerce platform. Weekly reporting running on time. Wasted spend cut. Agency working to clear targets.

**6 months:**
TACOS falling month on month while total sales grow. A tested playbook for each quick commerce platform and city. A steady run of experiments with documented results.

**12 months:**
Marketplaces as Rorosaur's most predictable growth channel. Budgets planned by platform, product and season. Every new platform or city launched with a proven plan.

•    Live experience running ads on Blinkit, Swiggy Instamart or Zepto, and working with their account managers.

Nice to have

•    Food, baby, FMCG or personal-care brand experience.

•    Amazon DSP, Amazon Marketing Cloud or Flipkart Ads exposure.

•    Has set pricing, deals and stock plans with supply and operations.

•    Comfortable with SQL or Looker Studio.

How to apply

Send your CV to vishal@rorosaur.com with the subject line
**Marketplace & Quick Commerce Ads Manager, Rorosaur**
. In 3 to 4 lines, tell us about one account you grew: the platform, the monthly spend, what you changed, and what happened to sales and TACOS.

Shortlisted candidates get a short take-home task: audit a sample Amazon search term report and tell us where you would cut and where you would scale.

This role is central to fulfilling the mandate to embed intelligence and automation across marketing functions. You will identify inefficient processes, design solutions using Copilot, Claude, and automation platforms, and enable marketing teams to work smarter. You will report directly to the Marketing Operations leader and partner with marketing leadership, sales operations, and demand generation teams to deliver measurable business impact.
  
  
**The Role**
This is a hands-on role for someone who is comfortable building with AI tools, designing workflows, and solving real business problems. You will balance strategic thinking (what should we automate) with technical execution (making it work reliably). You will work in an environment where automation quality directly impacts campaign execution and where there is strong leadership commitment to AI-led transformation.
  
  

* Identify manual, repetitive, or inefficient processes across Marketing Operations and the business; design AI or automation solutions to improve them.
* Build, test, and maintain automated workflows using Copilot (via APIs and Copilot Studio), Power Automate, Workato, and other integration platforms, ensuring quality, reliability, and compliance.

* Monitor deployed solutions for performance, errors, and data quality issues; iterate and refine to keep systems reliable and effective.
* Create documentation, playbooks, and reusable templates so solutions can scale; maintain runbooks for common automation and use AI patterns.
* Train and support marketing operations and demand generation teams in using AI tools effectively and responsibly; deliver enablement programs on new capabilities.
* Evaluate Copilot and Claude for different use cases; understand their relative strengths and limitations; recommend which platform is best suited for specific automation tasks.
* Partner with marketing leadership, sales operations, and cross functional stakeholders to gather requirements and translate business needs into technical solutions; communicate across technical and non-technical audiences.

**What You'll Bring**

* 5-8 years of hands-on experience in automation, AI implementation, process improvement, or related technical roles.

* Practical experience with AI/LLM tools; strong prompt engineering skills and ability to craft effective prompts for different business tasks.
* Experience with APIs, webhooks, and system integration; ability to design and troubleshoot API-based workflows and data flows.
* Basic scripting ability (e.g., Python, JavaScript) to extend automation beyond no-code tools when needed.
* Strong analytical skills; ability to map business processes, identify inefficiencies, and design solutions that create measurable impact.
* Excellent communication skills; ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences and translate business requirements into technical solutions.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Claude API; familiarity with how Claude differs from Copilot for specific use cases.

What you get

• First-hire role, direct work with the founder, decision authority on campaigns.

• Funded testing budget, tools (tracker, spy tools, landing page builder) and a freelance creative budget.

Apply on LinkedIn. In the screening questions, tell us your best campaign: vertical, traffic source, monthly spend and ROI.

title: YouTube Creator Acquisition, Influencer Marketing & Creator Partnerships Executive — Fresher/Intern
description:
Location: Mumbai — Work from Office / Hybrid

Employment Type: Full-time / Internship

Experience: Fresher / 0–1 Year

About the Role

We are looking for an enthusiastic and proactive YouTube Creator Acquisition, Influencer Marketing & Creator Partnerships Executive – Fresher/Intern to help expand the creator ecosystem across LYKSTAGE and Social Gear.

This role is not limited to creator onboarding. You will be involved in creator acquisition, influencer outreach, creator relationship building, brand–creator partnerships, and creator onboarding across our platforms.

You will identify relevant YouTubers, influencers and digital creators, approach them, introduce them to LYKSTAGE and Social Gear, build relationships, and help creators become active on our platforms.

You will also work with the Social Gear Creator Console, helping creators understand how they can use the platform to participate in influencer marketing and connect with potential brand opportunities.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who follows the creator economy closely and wants hands-on experience in Influencer Marketing, Creator Partnerships, Creator Acquisition and Digital Media.

What You Will Be Doing

Creator Acquisition & Outreach

\* Research and identify relevant YouTube creators, influencers and digital creators across different content categories, languages, audience segments and markets.

\* Build and continuously expand a database of relevant creators.

\* Identify creators who could be relevant for LYKSTAGE as well as for brand–creator campaigns through Social Gear.

\* Reach out to creators through email, social media, phone, WhatsApp and other relevant channels.

\* Introduce LYKSTAGE, Social Gear and their respective creator opportunities in a clear and compelling manner.

\* Build relationships with creators rather than simply conducting one-time outreach.

\* Follow up consistently with interested and qualified creators.

Influencer Marketing & Creator Brand Partnerships

\* Develop an understanding of how brands, agencies and creators work together through influencer marketing.

\* Identify creators who may be suitable for specific brand campaigns.

\* Help maintain creator profiles and information relevant to potential brand partnerships.

\* Support the team in identifying creator opportunities based on content category, audience, language, geography and other campaign requirements.

\* Assist with creator–brand campaign outreach and coordination.

\* Communicate with creators regarding campaign opportunities and requirements.

\* Help build a strong and continuously growing creator partnership network for Social Gear.

\* Learn how influencer campaigns are sourced, matched, executed and managed.

LYKSTAGE Creator Onboarding

\* Explain the LYKSTAGE platform, its features and creator benefits to prospective creators.

\* Assist creators with account creation and channel setup.

\* Support creator verification and onboarding.

\* Help creators upload their initial content.

\* Encourage newly onboarded creators to become active and consistently upload content.

\* Answer basic creator questions and coordinate with internal product and operations teams when required.

\* Track creator onboarding, activation and content-upload status.

Social Gear Creator Console

\* Assist creators with onboarding to the Social Gear Creator Console.

\* Help creators understand how the Creator Console works and how they can make their profiles more discoverable for brand opportunities.

\* Ensure creator information, profiles and relevant content details are properly maintained.

\* Help creators understand the opportunity to participate in influencer marketing and brand campaigns through Social Gear.

\* Maintain accurate creator databases and onboarding records.

\* Support the team in building a high-quality creator network that can be leveraged for brand campaigns.

What We Are Looking For

We are particularly interested in candidates who have a genuine interest in YouTube, Influencer Marketing, Creator Partnerships and the digital creator economy.

You should have:

\* Strong interest in YouTube, influencers and digital creators.

\* Good understanding of different creator categories and audiences.

\* Familiarity with influencer marketing and how brands collaborate with creators.

\* Good communication and interpersonal skills.

\* Confidence communicating with YouTubers, influencers and content creators.

\* Strong research and internet-search skills.

\* Ability to identify relevant creators rather than simply collecting large numbers of profiles.

\* Good follow-up and relationship-building skills.

\* Ability to maintain Excel/Google Sheets and creator outreach trackers.

\* Strong organizational skills.

\* Self-motivation and a target-oriented approach.

\* Willingness to learn and take ownership.

A strong advantage if you have:

\* Any experience in Influencer Marketing.

\* Experience communicating with YouTubers, influencers or content creators.

\* Experience in Creator Partnerships or Brand Partnerships.

\* Experience with influencer outreach or creator acquisition.

\* Experience managing creator/influencer databases.

\* College-level experience working with creator communities, campus media, social media communities or digital marketing projects.

\* Internship or project experience with an influencer marketing agency, digital media company, advertising agency or creator-focused business.

\* Your own experience creating content or actively managing a YouTube/social media channel.

We value practical exposure and genuine familiarity with the creator ecosystem, even if it comes from internships, college projects, freelance work or personal initiatives.

For Interns

Students pursuing Marketing, Mass Communication, Media, Digital Marketing, Business Administration or related courses may apply.

Interns should have:

\* Strong interest in YouTube, influencers and digital creators.

\* Interest in Influencer Marketing and Brand–Creator Partnerships.

\* Good communication skills.

\* Willingness to research and contact creators every day.

\* Ability to maintain creator databases and outreach trackers.

\* Interest in learning how brands work with creators.

\* Enthusiasm to learn creator acquisition, influencer marketing and digital platform growth.

\* A proactive attitude and willingness to take responsibility.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Your performance will be evaluated based on both creator acquisition and creator engagement, including:

\* Number of relevant creators identified.

\* Quality of creators identified.

\* Number of creators contacted.

\* Creator response and engagement rate.

\* Number of qualified creators successfully onboarded to LYKSTAGE.

\* Number of creators successfully onboarded to the Social Gear Creator Console.

\* Number of verified and active creator profiles.

\* Creator activation and initial content uploads.

\* Number and quality of creators available for potential brand partnerships.

\* Creator follow-up and conversion rates.

\* Consistency and quality of communication.

\* Accuracy and maintenance of creator databases and outreach trackers.

\* Contribution to the growth and quality of the LYKSTAGE and Social Gear creator network.

What You Will Learn

This role will provide hands-on exposure to:

\* YouTube Creator Acquisition

\* Influencer Marketing

\* Creator Partnerships

\* Brand–Creator Partnerships

\* Creator Relationship Management

\* Influencer Outreach

\* Creator Onboarding

\* Social Gear Creator Console

\* Digital Media and Creator Ecosystems

\* Lead Generation and Prospecting

\* Creator Campaign Opportunities

\* Platform Growth and Engagement

\* CRM and Outreach Management

You will get exposure to both sides of the creator ecosystem: building the creator network and helping connect creators with potential brand opportunities.

Why This Role Is Different

You won’t simply be maintaining a creator database or sending onboarding messages.

You will be part of the process of building a creator ecosystem from the ground up—identifying creators, establishing relationships, bringing them onto LYKSTAGE, onboarding them to the Social Gear Creator Console, and helping create opportunities for creators to work with brands.

If you are someone who spends a significant amount of time on YouTube, follows creators closely, understands influencer culture and enjoys communicating with people, this role can provide strong practical exposure to the rapidly evolving Creator Economy and Influencer Marketing industry.

Employment Type

Full-time / Internship

Experience: Fresher / 0–1 Year

How to Apply

If you are genuinely interested in YouTube, Influencer Marketing, Creator Partnerships, Digital Media and the Creator Economy, and believe you can contribute to building the LYKSTAGE and Social Gear creator network, please send your resume and portfolio/profile link to:

hr@mymanhattancom.com

Please mention any relevant experience in Influencer Marketing, Creator Outreach, Creator Partnerships, Brand Partnerships, YouTube or Social Media in your application.

title: Cluster Lead
description:
FruitBowl Digital is a vibrant digital marketing agency founded in 2010, led by experienced industry experts and supported by a team of passionate professionals. Based in Mumbai, the company has quickly grown to handle national-level accounts and execute groundbreaking campaigns, establishing a reputation for innovation and creativity. We specialize in Social Media Management, Content Strategy and Creation, Branding, Web & App Design, Search Marketing, Media Planning, and Online Reputation Management. Committed to fostering a fun and dynamic work culture, we aim to leave remarkable digital footprints globally
  
  
**What is this role really?**
You’re the person who keeps a cluster of brands (4–5 clients) not just running, but growing, evolving, and doing better work every month.
  
  
You’ll be the go-to for clients, the bridge for the team, and the one who makes sure ideas don’t get lost in translation.
  
  
**What will you be doing?**

* ⁠ ⁠Be the main point of contact for your set of clients (aka the calm in the chaos)
* ⁠ ⁠Turn vague thoughts like “we need something fun” into clear, actionable briefs
* ⁠ ⁠Shape content strategy, what we say, how we say it, and why it matters
* ⁠ ⁠Work closely with copy, design, video, and performance teams to bring ideas to life
* ⁠ ⁠Make sure the work going out is something you’d actually be proud to put your name on
* ⁠ ⁠Spot opportunities for campaigns, moments, and growth before anyone asks

**Things that should excite you**

* ⁠ ⁠Thinking like a brand, not just a content calendar
* ⁠ ⁠Talking to clients without sounding like a deck
* ⁠ ⁠Turning confusion into clarity (your briefs should make life easier, not harder)
* ⁠ ⁠Knowing what’s good vs. what’s just “there.”
* ⁠ ⁠Keeping things moving without turning into a micromanager
* ⁠ ⁠Having opinions and backing them up

**What will your good day look like?**

* ⁠ ⁠A client call where you guide the conversation, not just respond to it
* ⁠ ⁠Your team gets a brief and goes “got it” instead of “huh?”
* ⁠ ⁠The work that comes back feels sharp, on-brand, and exciting
* ⁠ ⁠You catch an opportunity before it becomes a missed one

**A Not-so-great Day Looks Like**

* You’re stuck playing messenger between the client and the team
* ⁠ ⁠ Everyone’s unclear, and it shows in the work
* ⁠ ⁠You’re fixing things at the last minute instead of setting them up right
* ⁠ ⁠The work is going out… but it’s not really saying anything

title: Social Media Marketing Specialist

2. Agency Coordination

* Strong communication and coordination skills.
* Good understanding of content formats, social media algorithms, and engagement mechanics.
* Ability to manage multiple content pieces, timelines, and stakeholders simultaneously.
* Strong attention to detail and a good eye for content.
* Proactive, highly organised, and comfortable working in a fast-paced brand environment.

* Stronger engagement and visibility across relevant online communities.
* Faster identification and participation in relevant trends and conversations.
* High-quality, on-brand content across platforms.
* A growing and genuinely engaged Uni Seoul community.

title: Head of Marketing
description:
**About the Company**

i-TEK is one of India's leading AIDC and RFID technology organisations, with deep capabilities across RFID software platforms, intelligent edge devices and enterprise deployments.

With:

* Over 5 billion items tagged
* More than 1,000 customers
* Over 250 million scans processed every day
* Deployments across 3,000+ retail outlets
* Coverage across more than 10 million sq. ft. of warehouse space

i-TEK has built significant domain and technology expertise across retail, manufacturing, logistics and banking.

Our strategic offerings include:

* Garuda Vigil
* A comprehensive RFID and AIDC management software platform designed to provide enterprises with real-time visibility, control and intelligence across their operations.
* Skanix
* i-TEK's intelligent edgeware and device ecosystem, designed to connect the physical and digital worlds and enable scalable RFID and AIDC deployments.

As i-TEK enters its next phase of growth, our ambition is to evolve from being a leading Indian RFID/AIDC company into a globally recognised products and platforms business.

We are therefore looking to build a modern, AI-first marketing organisation capable of strengthening the i-TEK brand, creating global market visibility and generating measurable business opportunities.

**About the Role**

**HEAD - MARKETING & GROWTH**

**Location: Pune [on-site]**

**Experience: 10-16 years**

**Role Overview**

This is not intended to be a conventional marketing role.

The mandate is to create an AI-first, highly automated and outcome-oriented marketing engine that combines strong strategic thinking and creativity with technology, data and automation to deliver significantly higher output and business impact with a lean team.

The individual will own i-TEK's brand and positioning, corporate messaging, product marketing, content, digital presence, social media, demand and lead generation, events, analyst relations, public relations and marketing operations.

A particularly important responsibility will be building a scalable inbound and outbound demand-generation engine for India and international markets.

The successful candidate will work closely with Business/Sales, Product Management, Engineering and Customer teams to translate i-TEK's technology, products, domain expertise and customer successes into compelling market propositions.

This role provides an opportunity for an accomplished marketing leader to build the function from the ground up and, based on impact and organisational growth, potentially evolve into a broader CMO mandate.

**Responsibilities**

Brand Strategy, Positioning & Corporate Messaging

* Define and continuously sharpen i-TEK's overall brand positioning.
* Build a clear brand architecture covering i-TEK, Garuda Vigil and Skanixa.
* Develop differentiated positioning for relevant industries, customer segments and geographies.
* Establish consistent corporate messaging across all customer and market touchpoints.
* Build and govern comprehensive brand guidelines covering identity, tone, language, visual communication and usage.
* Ensure that i-TEK increasingly becomes recognised as a technology, products and platforms company rather than merely an RFID implementation provider.
* Ensure consistency of messaging across Sales, Product, website, social media, events, PR and analyst interactions.
* AI-First Marketing Operating Model
* Build marketing from first principles as an AI-first function, rather than adding AI to traditional marketing processes.
* Identify activities that can be automated or substantially augmented using AI.
* Establish an integrated marketing technology and AI toolset.
* Build automated workflows across research, segmentation, content development, campaign execution, personalisation, lead qualification, analytics and reporting.
* Use generative AI to dramatically increase the velocity and variety of high-quality marketing content.
* Use AI for account research, persona development, message variation and campaign optimisation.
* Build appropriate human review and governance mechanisms to protect brand accuracy, quality and intellectual property.
* Continuously measure productivity improvements delivered through AI and automation.
* Build a lean marketing organisation where human talent is concentrated on strategy, creativity, judgement, relationships and high-value decision-making.
* The measure of AI adoption should not be the number of AI tools deployed, but improvement in speed, quality, conversion, reach and cost of marketing outcomes.
* Demand & Lead Generation
* Build a measurable and scalable demand-generation engine supporting i-TEK's growth ambitions in India and international markets.

Inbound:

* Develop SEO and content strategies that generate relevant enterprise traffic.
* Build high-value content around RFID, AIDC, retail, manufacturing, supply chain, enterprise visibility and intelligent edge technologies.
* Develop landing pages, campaigns, webinars, reports and other mechanisms for lead capture.
* Optimise conversion from digital engagement to qualified opportunities.

Outbound:

* Define Ideal Customer Profiles and target account segments.
* Build account-based marketing approaches for high-value enterprise opportunities.
* Use AI and data tools for account research, segmentation and personalisation.
* Develop automated, multi-touch outbound campaigns.
* Continuously test messaging, personas, channels and calls-to-action.
* Build appropriate lead-scoring and qualification mechanisms.
* Marketing should be accountable not merely for the volume of leads but for qualified pipeline and eventual commercial outcomes.
* Segmentation, Targeting & Market Intelligence
* Define market segmentation across industries, geographies, customer size and use cases.
* Develop Ideal Customer Profiles and relevant buyer personas.
* Identify priority accounts and market opportunities in conjunction with Sales.
* Develop competitor intelligence and positioning.
* Track relevant technology, customer and industry trends

**About Jungle Technology**

Jungle Technology is the world's leading No-SDK, No-Code Branding Ad Network, built for mobile publishers who want to maximize revenue without engineering overhead.

Today, Jungle Technology powers monetization across 10,000+ apps, including 7 of the top 10 gaming publishers and 1 in 4 of the world's casual games. Trusted by leading publishers such as Easybrain, Amanotes, Supercent, Rollic, Fugo, Rovio, Bravestar, Tripledot, Miniclip, and Playsimple, we are redefining how mobile publishers monetize and grow.

As we continue to expand across global markets, we are looking for a Business Development Manager to strengthen our presence in India and drive growth through OpenRTB and programmatic advertising partnerships.

**Role Description :**

You own a portfolio of publishers and the revenue that comes out of it. Setup and trafficking are the baseline, not the job. The job is knowing why a publisher's ARPDAU moved, finding the next lever before they ask, and running the plan that gets them there.

**What You’ll Own :**

* **Inventory and delivery.**

  Ad units, placements, orders, line items, creatives and targeting in GAM. Accurate setup, clean delivery, nothing live unverified.
* **Performance.**

  Impressions, fill rate, eCPM, ARPDAU and LTV across your portfolio. Spot underdelivery, unfilled impressions and ad-serving issues before they show up in a publisher email.
* **Debugging.**

  Delivery discrepancies, VAST errors, video render failures, mediation conflicts. Find the actual cause, fix it, and close the loop with the partner.
* **Publisher relationships.**

  A large portfolio, managed directly. Optimization plans, quarterly growth plans, waterfall and floor recommendations, and the reviews where you walk them through the numbers.
* **Growth ideas.**

  New formats, new placements, new demand paths, mediation changes. You bring the idea, size it, test it, and show what it earned.
* **Product input.**

  You see what publishers actually need before anyone else does. Feed it back and shape what we build.

**What You Bring :**

* 2+ years in ad operations, publisher operations or app monetization
* Direct publisher-facing experience. You've handled accounts, not just tickets
* Fluency in mobile monetization economics: ARPDAU, LTV, eCPM, fill, retention impact
* Hands-on with mediation platforms (AppLovin MAX, LevelPlay, AdMob or similar) and waterfall management
* In-app and video advertising experience, including VAST tags and video ad serving
* Strong Sheets or Excel. You build your own analysis instead of waiting for one

**Good to have:**

AdX and programmatic experience, CTV or gaming supply, header bidding or Open Bidding exposure.

**Who You Are :**

Complete owner, not an executor. You treat your portfolio's revenue as your number.

A self-learner. Mobile monetization shifts every quarter and nobody will hand you a curriculum.

Data-backed by default. You bring numbers to the conversation, with publishers and internally.

**What You'll Get :**

* Real ownership of a publisher portfolio and the revenue behind it, early
* Budget for courses, certifications and learning programmes
* Company-paid health insurance and wellness benefits
* Flexible working, including remote for defined periods
* Annual salary review based on your contribution and company performance
* A lean team where your ideas ship in days, not quarters
* Conferences, industry events and team offsites

* Support media outreach and maintain relationships with journalists and publications

**5. Knowledge Management and Reporting**

* Track engagement and analytics across platforms and prepare regular reports for leadership and donors

**6. Monitoring, Analysis & Reporting**

* Generate monthly/quarterly communication reports to inform strategy refinement.

Requirements
  
  
  
**Qualifications and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Journalism, Mass Communication, English, Development Studies, or a related field

* Willingness to learn and adapt in a mission-driven environment.

As a Tele Caller, the team member will handle inbound and outbound calls, provide information about training programs, follow up with leads, support enrollment processes, and maintain accurate records in CRM or related tools. The position requires close coordination with sales, training, and marketing teams to support both content production and learner engagement.

**Qualifications**

* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
About SkillsNCR

SkillsNCR is an early-stage education and capability-building venture based in Gurugram. We are developing practical learning solutions for school students, parents and graduates, guided by a simple principle: understand the need before recommending a solution.

We are building the business, testing ideas and developing our customer base. This is an opportunity to work directly with the Founder and contribute visibly to the company’s growth.

About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on digital marketer who can manage multiple campaigns, create engaging content and turn marketing activity into relevant enquiries and measurable business outcomes.

You should be comfortable working inside advertising platforms—not just coordinating with agencies—and explaining your results through actual campaign data.

Your initial focus will be digital advertising, content and social media. As you demonstrate results and take on greater ownership, the role offers an opportunity to grow into broader marketing management across digital and offline channels.

What You Will Do

* **Manage paid campaigns:**
  Plan, launch, monitor and optimise campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads and, where relevant, LinkedIn Ads. Handle audience targeting, keyword research, ad copy, creative testing and budget allocation within approved limits.
* **Create content:**
  Develop social posts, carousels, basic graphics, short videos, reels and advertising creatives. Turn programme information and customer needs into clear, credible content.
* **Manage social channels:**
  Maintain a practical content calendar for Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn. Publish consistently, monitor responses and ensure enquiries reach the right person.
* **Generate and improve lead quality:**
  Run campaigns that attract relevant parents, students and other target audiences. Work with the Founder to understand lead quality, improve messaging and support progression towards consultations and enrolments.
* **Track and report performance:**
  Maintain campaign reports covering spend, qualified enquiries, cost per qualified lead and downstream conversions. Use analytics, tracking links and CRM records to distinguish clicks and form submissions from genuine customer interest.
* **Support offline marketing:**
  Help plan and promote school outreach, community activities, events and local partnerships. Connect offline activity with digital promotion, lead capture and measurable follow-up.

What We Are Looking For

You should have practical experience managing paid campaigns, ideally across
**Google Ads, Meta Ads and LinkedIn Ads**
, with results you can explain and substantiate.

Strong hands-on experience with
**Google Ads and Meta Ads is important; LinkedIn Ads experience is strongly preferred**
.

You should also be able to create usable content independently using Canva or similar tools, write clear copy, perform basic video editing and manage multiple campaigns without losing track of budgets or deadlines.

We value familiarity with Google Analytics, conversion tracking, spreadsheets and basic CRM processes, alongside clear communication in Hindi and English.

Experience in
**EdTech, education, tuition, admissions or local-service lead generation**
will be an advantage.

We are looking for someone who takes ownership, asks useful questions, learns from results and is comfortable working closely with the Founder in a small, early-stage team.

What Good Performance Looks Like

Success will be measured through relevant enquiries, improving campaign efficiency, reliable content delivery, accurate reporting and contribution to customer acquisition—not simply impressions, followers or the number of posts published.

Performance objectives will be agreed against the available budget, campaign baseline and business priorities.

Career Growth

This role offers the opportunity to progress towards
**Marketing Manager – Digital & Offline**
, with broader responsibility for marketing planning, campaigns, events, partnerships and brand-building.

Progression will depend on demonstrated performance, capability and business requirements. It is not an automatic promotion after probation.

Employment and Working Arrangement

This is a
**full-time employee position from the date of joining**
, with an initial
**three-month probation period**
.

The role requires
**in-person work in Gurugram**
and regular collaboration with the Founder. It is not a remote, freelance or internship opportunity.

How to Apply

Apply through LinkedIn with your resume. Please be ready to share one or two examples of campaigns you personally managed, along with content samples.

* Campaign examples should explain the objective, period, advertising spend, results and your individual contribution. Anonymised case studies or appropriately redacted reports are welcome; please do not share confidential client information.
