title: Product Stream Lead - Payment Exceptions & Investigations
description:
**Organization:**
At CommBank, we never lose sight of the role we play in other people’s financial wellbeing. Our focus is to help people and businesses move forward to progress. To make the right financial decisions and achieve their dreams, targets, and aspirations. Regardless of where you work within our organisation, your initiative, talent, ideas, and energy all contribute to the impact that we can make with our work. Together we can achieve great things.
  
  
**Job Title:**
Product Stream Lead - Payment Exceptions & Investigations
  
  
**Location:**
Bangalore
  
  
**Business & Team:**
Payments work brilliantly when everything goes right. The real test is what happens when they do not. A payment may be rejected, delayed, returned or held; a customer may send funds to the wrong account; an international payment may need to be traced or recalled; or an operations team may need to investigate an ambiguous payment state across multiple systems and external institutions. Today these journeys can span payment rails, customer and banker channels, payment platforms, operational work queues, case-management tools, risk teams and external financial institutions. We want to fundamentally change that experience.
  
  
Within the Payments Servicing Solutions Crew, we are shaping a channel-agnostic Payment Exception and Investigation capability that brings these journeys together. The ambition is one reusable product capability across Australian domestic and international payment exceptions - connecting customers, bankers, operations teams, payment platforms and external institutions while preserving clear system ownership and controls. This is an opportunity to build an enduring payments product, not simply deliver another workflow or operations screen. You will help shape a capability that can progressively move exception handling from manual investigation to intelligent assistance, straight-through processing and, ultimately, proactive exception prevention.
  
  
**Impact and Contribution:**
As Product Stream Lead - Payment Exceptions & Investigations, you will lead the product vision, strategy and evolution of this capability within the Payments Servicing Solutions Crew. You will connect customer insight, operational pain points, payments expertise, enterprise priorities, technology possibilities and risk considerations into a clear product strategy and executable roadmap.
  
  
You will lead across related squads and partner closely with Product Leads, Product Managers, Engineering, Architecture, Payments Operations, Digital Channels, frontline teams, Financial Crime, Risk, Legal and Compliance. You will create alignment around shared outcomes, make evidence-based investment and sequencing trade-offs, and ensure the product is run safely and sustainably.
  
  
The product vision extends beyond a new workbench. It is about creating an intelligent payment exception orchestration capability that can ingest and correlate events from multiple rails and channels, create a consistent case and investigation journey, orchestrate controlled resolution actions, provide transparent status back to customers and colleagues, and use data and intelligence to improve both resolution and prevention.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Define and communicate the product vision, strategy and multi-year roadmap for payment exceptions and investigations across domestic and international payments.
* Lead cross-squad prioritisation, sequencing and investment trade-offs, balancing customer value, operational efficiency, risk reduction, technology simplification and commercial outcomes.
* Build reusable product capabilities rather than point solutions for individual rails, channels, systems or operational teams.
* Deeply understand how exceptions arise across payment initiation, execution, settlement, investigations, trace and recall, returns, repairs, failed payments and servicing journeys.
* Shape simple experiences for retail and business customers, bankers/frontline colleagues, investigators and payment operations teams, with consistent status and required-action visibility across channels.
* Lead product outcomes for case and investigation management, event intake and correlation, workflow orchestration, operational work management, evidence and audit, communications and controlled resolution actions.
* Identify journeys that can move from manual handling to assisted resolution and straight-through processing, with clear policy, eligibility, approval and control boundaries.
* Partner with Engineering and Architecture to shape scalable APIs, event-driven integration, reusable channel experiences and clean ownership boundaries between servicing channels, exception orchestration and payment execution platforms.
* Explore practical applications of AI and agentic workflows for context reconstruction, classification, summarisation, investigation planning, next-best-action, response drafting and cross-case root-cause intelligence.
* Ensure AI-enabled outcomes are explainable, evidence-backed, auditable and appropriately bounded by human accountability and risk controls.
* Use customer, operational and product data to identify exception patterns and upstream causes, creating a prevention backlog that reduces avoidable exceptions over time.
* Define and own measurable outcomes including resolution time, STP rate, repeat contact, touches per case, queue ageing, SLA performance, customer-update timeliness, control effectiveness, colleague adoption and exception reduction.
* Coach and develop Product Leads and Product Managers, building strong product discipline and a culture of ownership, curiosity and continuous improvement.

**Essential Skills:**

* Bring significant product leadership experience, leading complex products or value streams from strategy through execution and value realisation.
* Have strong payments expertise, including domestic and/or international payments, processing, settlement and servicing.
* Understand payment ecosystems such as NPP, BECS/Direct Entry, BPAY, RTGS/HVCS, SWIFT and correspondent banking.
* Have experience across payment investigations and exceptions, including trace and recall, returns, repairs and failed or mistaken payments.
* Have built or transformed workflow, servicing, case-management or platform products within regulated financial services.
* Can turn fragmented processes and legacy journeys into scalable product capabilities, balancing long-term vision with pragmatic delivery.
* Have driven automation and straight-through processing across complex operational journeys.
* Bring strong commercial judgement and can make clear investment, prioritisation and scope trade-offs.
* Can influence across Product, Technology, Operations and Risk, embedding controls and operational resilience into product design.
* Are curious about AI and emerging technology, while distinguishing genuine customer and operational value from hype.
* Build high-performing teams and coach and develop product talent.

**Payments, Automation & Emerging Technology**
This is not an AI-first role. It is an opportunity to shape how automation and emerging technology can safely transform a complex, high-volume payments environment.
  
  

* Move journeys from manual handling toward intelligent assistance, bounded automation and straight-through processing.
* Determine where deterministic workflows are best and where AI can improve investigations, context-building and next-best actions.
* Explore agentic and orchestration approaches while retaining appropriate human oversight.
* Establish clear guardrails around approval, explainability, traceability, auditability, privacy and access.
* Use exception and outcome data to move from exception resolution toward exception prevention.

**The Mindset We’re Looking For**

* Think product, not project: Build enduring capabilities and measure outcomes, not just delivery.
* Start with the customer: Connect customer needs to the complex payments ecosystem behind them.
* Simplify complexity: Turn multiple rails, systems and stakeholders into a clear strategy.
* Own the outcome: Lead from strategy and discovery through delivery, adoption and value realisation.
* Challenge constructively: Question legacy processes with evidence, courage and respect.
* Collaborate without ego: Align Product, Engineering, Operations, Architecture and Risk around shared outcomes.
* Innovate responsibly: Pursue automation and AI while protecting trust, safety and human accountability.
* Lift others: Coach, share context and strengthen the wider product community.

**Education Qualification:**
Bachelors or Master's Degree in any stream

title: Principal Program Manager – SDR & ISR
description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.
  
  
By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real-time insights.
  
  
Today, 1,900+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role summary**
We are hiring a Principal Program Manager to run global programs for our SDR (Sales Development) and ISR (Inside Sales Rep) teams. This role drives outcomes across productivity, pipeline quality, hygiene, win rate, NAAR, retention, and expansion by building a strong operating rhythm, using data to spot issues early, and ensuring teams execute consistently.
  
  
You may not have direct reporting lines, but you will lead through influence and partner closely with Sales Leadership, RevOps, Enablement, Marketing, Customer Success/Renewals, Finance, and Systems teams.
  
  
**Key outcomes you will drive**

* Productivity: activity effectiveness, meetings created, pipeline generated, ramp speed
* Hygiene: CRM/data discipline, stage accuracy, clean handoffs and follow-ups
* Quality: better qualification, better account/persona targeting, higher quality pipeline
* Win rate: improved conversion through the funnel and better deal outcomes
* NAAR: focus on opportunities that drive higher revenue impact
* Retention: fewer churn risks through early signals and strong renewal execution
* Expansion: stronger upsell/cross-sell pipeline and execution in existing accounts

**What You Will Own**
**Global programs (SDR and ISR)**

* Design and run global programs that improve productivity, quality, hygiene, win rate, and NAAR outcomes.
* Set simple standards and targets by region/segment and drive weekly follow-through across time zones.
* Create playbooks that make execution consistent (account selection, persona targeting, messaging, qualification, and handoffs).

**Retention and expansion programs (ISR focus)**

* Build programs that improve renewals, retention, and expansion outcomes (upsell and cross-sell).
* Create simple ways to track renewal health and identify churn risk early (low adoption, unresolved issues, sponsor change, engagement drop).
* Drive consistent cadences for renewal forecasting and expansion pipeline, with clear action plans and owners.
* Partner with Customer Success and Renewals teams to improve handoffs, coverage, and account planning.

**Operating rhythm and executive governance**

* Run weekly/monthly cadences: productivity reviews, hygiene reviews, quality reviews, win rate reviews, and renewal/expansion reviews.
* Create clear dashboards and short weekly readouts for senior leaders: what changed, why it changed, and what actions are needed.
* Drive accountability by tracking actions, deadlines, and measurable outcomes.

**Analytics, reporting, process, and tools**

* Build and maintain trusted reporting using Excel/Google Sheets and dashboards; SQL/BI (Tableau/Power BI) is a plus.
* Strengthen the basics: CRM hygiene, funnel definitions, stage discipline, attribution, and forecasting inputs.
* Partner with Systems/RevOps teams to improve tool adoption and workflow efficiency (e.g., Salesforce, Outreach/Salesloft, Gong, ZoomInfo).
* Use data to identify where the funnel breaks and drive targeted enablement with leaders (messaging, discovery, objection handling, deal coaching).

**Cross-functional leadership (drive without authority)**

* Align SDR/ISR leaders, AEs, Customer Success, Renewals, Marketing, Enablement, and RevOps on shared goals and execution plans.
* Remove blockers, drive decisions, and ensure teams adopt the programs and standards.
* Communicate clearly and confidently with senior stakeholders across regions.

**Required Qualifications**

* 15+ years of experience, including meaningful experience in SaaS sales.
* Must have been an SDR and/or AE earlier in your career (quota-carrying experience required).
* Proven experience leading global sales programs that drive measurable outcomes (productivity, hygiene, quality, win rate, NAAR impact).
* Experience with existing-business motions: renewals, retention, and expansion (upsell and cross-sell).
* Strong analytical capability and comfort with funnel analysis and executive-ready reporting.
* Strong understanding of RevOps-level fundamentals: process rigor, definitions, hygiene, forecasting inputs, and operating cadence (title not required).
* Strong executive communication and ability to influence leaders across geographies and time zones.

**We focus on our mission**
: Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:
  
  

* Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified-CXM.
* Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.
* Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.

**We believe in our product**
: Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.
  
  
**We invest in our people**

Sprinklr believes that you should be able to get the type of care you need for your personal well-being when you need it. We offer you and your family voluntary healthcare coverage in countries where applicable. We believe it is important to take time off – it is essential for your mental and physical wellbeing. We provide Sprinklrites with paid time off to recharge and spend time with loved ones. We want to grow our talent with purpose. Our open Mentoring Program is designed to create meaningful connections that support growth and amplify our focus.

**Build People. Shape Culture. Create Impact.**
===============================================

**Are you someone who enjoys working with people, solving problems, and taking on new challenges? Do you dream of building a career in Human Resources, People Development, and Organizational Growth?**

If your answer is **YES**, then this **Management Trainee Program (MTP-HR)** is designed for you.

At Greendzine, we are building the future of warehouse mobility through our MOPTro platform. Behind every innovation is a team of talented people who make it possible. As a Management Trainee – HR, you won’t spend a year observing from the sidelines—you’ll actively contribute to talent acquisition, employee development, HR operations, and initiatives that shape our workplace culture.

MTP-HR is a **12-month program**, designed to transform fresh graduates into confident Human Resources professionals through hands-on experience, structured learning, and real-world HR responsibilities.

**What You’ll Learn**
---------------------

During the program, you will receive hands-on exposure to the complete employee lifecycle, from talent acquisition to employee development and engagement.

You will learn how to:

* Manage recruitment activities, including candidate sourcing, screening, interviews, and selection.
* Coordinate campus recruitment drives and talent acquisition initiatives.
* Manage employee onboarding, induction, and exit processes.
* Plan and coordinate employee training and development programs.
* Support competency assessments, performance appraisals, and career development initiatives.
* Develop and implement HR policies, procedures, and employee welfare initiatives.
* Organize employee engagement activities and workplace culture initiatives.
* Understand employee relations, grievance handling, and HR compliance.
* Work with HRMS platforms for employee records, attendance, leave, and HR operations.
* Collaborate with functional leaders to understand workforce requirements and support people development.

**Why Join MTP-HR?**
--------------------

* Learn directly from experienced entrepreneurs and business leaders.
* Work on real HR projects and employee development initiatives.
* Receive structured mentoring and continuous feedback.
* Gain hands-on experience across recruitment, learning and development, performance management, and HR operations.
* Collaborate with different functional teams and understand how people contribute to business success.
* Fast-track your HR career in one of India’s growing deep-tech startups.

**What’s Next?**
----------------

At the end of the program, your performance, strengths, learning agility, and interests will be evaluated. High performers will be offered full-time roles within the organization with accelerated career growth opportunities.

**Apply, if you are someone who is:**
-------------------------------------

* Curious, empathetic, and eager to learn.
* An excellent communicator with strong interpersonal skills.
* Passionate about working with people and developing talent.
* Organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple responsibilities.
* Self-driven, proactive, and willing to take ownership.
* Comfortable interacting with employees, candidates, and functional leaders.
* Interested in building a long-term career in Human Resources.
* Able to maintain confidentiality, professionalism, and integrity.

**More than a job, this is your opportunity to build your career while shaping the people, culture, and future of an innovative organization.**

**Join us. Learn. Grow. Empower People.**

#ThinkManomation #MOPTro #Greendzine

* Consistent academic record with a CGPA above 7.0 without any history of arrears.
* Fresh graduates passionate about building a long-term career in Human Resources.
* Strong communication, interpersonal, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
* Interest in talent acquisition, employee engagement, people management, and HR operations.

**Location:** HSR Layout, Bangalore

**Role Overview - Senior Product Manager**

As Senior Product Manager for Sri Mandir Web, you will own the end-to-end product lifecycle for building a fast, engaging, and trustworthy website that serves millions of devotees worldwide. This is a first-principles, high-ownership role, you will be expected to question existing assumptions, reimagine devotee journeys for the web (a fundamentally different medium from app), and build measurable, compounding growth loops around acquisition, engagement, and monetisation.

You will be especially responsible for how devotees are acquired, including through SEO. Reimagine how devotees experience the site pre and post-transaction in their journeys and turn a one-time visitor into a returning, engaged devotee.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

***Product Vision & Strategy***

* Define and own the Sri Mandir Web Product roadmap, grounded in first-principles thinking that works for Web audience.

* Identify the highest-leverage problems in the devotee journey by breaking them down to root causes, not surface symptoms.

* Work with Website P&L lead, to own the complete business flywheel and deliver retention and revenue outcomes

***Acquisition & Organic Growth***

* Own complete acquisition funnels with a strong focus on organic and SEO-driven growth alongside paid and referral channels.

* Partner closely with Analytics, CRM, Content, Marketing, Design and Engineering teams to define the site architecture that drives speed and enable discoverability at scale.

***Engagement & User-First Journeys***

* Apply deep, empathetic, user-first thinking to design web journeys that feel intuitive, trustworthy, and delightful for devotees

* Design and continuously refine post-transaction user flows, cross-sell and re-engagement journeys, that build habitual, repeat engagement

***Data-Driven Decision Making***

* Leverage analytics, cohort analysis, user research, and market insights to identify problems, size opportunities, and prioritise the roadmap.

* Set up and track KPIs across the funnel, traffic, conversion, ARPU, retention, and repeat transactions

***Ownership & Cross-Functional Leadership***

* Lead the product lifecycle from concept and requirements to launch and post-launch optimisation.

* Stay ahead of web/SEO trends, competitor moves, and emerging technologies to keep Sri Mandir Web at the frontier of devotional tech.

**What You Bring**
------------------

* Bachelors or Masters degree from Tier 1 premier institute — IIT, BITS Pilani, IIM, ISB preferred.

* Experience: Minimum 4+ years of B2C product management and growth experience, with measurable impact on Revenue, CRO LTV and Retention

* First-principles thinker: Demonstrated ability to solve ambiguous, complex problems from the ground up rather than relying on existing playbooks.

* Web acquisition & SEO: Product knowledge of SEO and organic acquisition levers (technical SEO, content strategy, site performance)

* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex, funnel-level datasets.

* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

**Bonus Points**
----------------

* Past founding or entrepreneurial experience.

* Hands-on experience with SEO/organic growth as a primary growth lever in a previous role.

* Experience managing products across Web platforms.

* Past experience building and growing e-commerce products.

title: Associate Director- Data Platform and BI Services
description:
**Job Purpose:**

We are seeking an experienced Associated Director- Data Platform & BI Services to provide technical leadership and service ownership across enterprise Azure Data Platform and Power BI services. This role will lead the delivery, governance, operation, and continuous improvement of Azure, Databricks, Data Lake, data engineering, integration, and Power BI capabilities, ensuring scalable, secure, reliable, and cost-effective services.

The role will oversee platform engineering standards, security and access controls, Power BI services, CI/CD, monitoring, performance, production operations, and service management, while driving automation, Generative AI, Agentic AI, and emerging technology adoption. As technical Product Owner, the Senior Manager will translate business requirements into prioritized platform capabilities and ensure solutions align with GSK-approved design patterns, security, engineering, and governance standards.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Platform, AI & Technology Leadership:**

* Lead enterprise and solution architecture for major commercial data, analytics, AI/ML, and Power BI initiatives.
* Lead technology delivery and platform enablement for major Commercial / Patient Data, Analytics, AI/ML, and Power BI initiatives.
* Drive AI and Agentic AI enablement, including AI agents, MCP servers, enterprise integrations, security, and governance.
* Ensure solutions follow GSK-approved architecture patterns, technology standards, security controls, and governance guidelines.
* Partner with Architecture, Security, Engineering, and Global Tech teams to obtain required technical reviews and approvals.
* Oversee infrastructure provisioning and ensure compliance with established enterprise platform and security standards.
* Drive cross-functional technical alignment and dependency management across US Commercial, Data, MDM, Engineering, Global Tech, and partner teams.

**Azure Data Platform & Engineering Leadership:**

* Lead and oversee Azure Data Lake Platform services, including Azure Databricks, ADF, ADLS, Unity Catalog, and related Azure capabilities.
* Ensure platform solutions adhere to approved enterprise design patterns, engineering standards, security controls, and GSK technology guidelines.
* Ensure solutions meet scalability, reliability, security, performance, operational support, and cost-efficiency requirements.
* Drive adoption of standardized, reusable, configuration-driven platform capabilities and integration patterns.
* Partner with Architecture and Engineering teams to ensure new solutions align with enterprise technology direction and platform standards.
* Promote consistent implementation practices across Data Lake, analytics, AI/ML, and downstream data services.

**Platform Governance & Technical Operations:**

* Manage platform user access, roles, permissions, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) groups, service principals, and access approval processes.
* Implement and maintain role-based access controls (RBAC) across Azure, Databricks, Unity Catalog, Power BI, Data Lake, and related platform services.
* Ensure appropriate access controls for data, workspaces, applications, service principals, storage, and platform resources.
* Oversee user onboarding/offboarding, access reviews, segregation of duties, privileged access, and remediation of access-related risks.
* Ensure platform configurations and operational processes comply with GSK security, governance, audit, and approved technical standards.
* Drive platform controls, audit readiness, automation, monitoring, technical risk remediation, and continuous improvement.

**Power BI Platform & Service Management:**

* Manage Power BI services including capacities, workspaces, gateways, semantic models, dataflows, reports, dashboards, and platform configurations.
* Oversee user access, roles, security groups, RLS, workspace provisioning, sharing, and approval processes.
* Establish technical standards for report development, semantic modeling, workspace management, deployment pipelines, and CI/CD processes.
* Govern the end-to-end report and semantic model lifecycle, including development, testing, deployment, certification, support, and retirement.
* Drive performance optimization, automation, monitoring, security, standardization, and cost-effective utilization of Power BI services.
* Ensure Power BI solutions integrate effectively with Databricks, Azure Data Lake, and enterprise data platforms while following GSK-approved technical, security, and governance standards.

**Technical Product Ownership & Requirements Management:**

* Lead technical product ownership for Data Platform and Power BI services, including platform roadmap, capabilities, enhancements, and modernization.
* Translate business needs into technical requirements, data flows, integrations, security requirements, platform dependencies, and acceptance criteria.
* Review technical requirements and user stories across Azure, Databricks, Data Lake, APIs, data pipelines, Power BI, and related platform services.
* Assess technical feasibility, dependencies, risks, security, performance, and operational readiness before implementation.
* Manage and prioritize backlog across new capabilities, technical debt, automation, platform enhancements, security remediation, and production support.
* Coordinate end-to-end technical delivery while ensuring alignment with GSK-approved standards, design patterns, security, and governance requirements.

**Platform Service Operations & Technical Leadership:**

* Lead day-to-day Data Platform and Power BI service operations, ensuring platform availability, reliability, performance, security, and operational readiness.
* Oversee JIRA backlogs, ServiceNow incidents, service requests, problem records, change requests, and operational support queues, ensuring appropriate prioritization and resolution.
* Drive resolution of complex technical issues across Azure, Databricks, Data Lake, data pipelines, integrations, Power BI, gateways, access, and platform services.
* Lead root-cause analysis (RCA), problem management, corrective/preventive actions, technical risk remediation, and recurring-issue elimination.
* Establish and monitor service KPIs, SLAs, platform health, incident trends, capacity/performance metrics, escalation paths, and operational dashboards.
* Coordinate production deployments, change management, release readiness, environment dependencies, and post-production support across engineering and support teams.
* Provide technical direction to Data Engineering, Power BI, platform, and support teams, ensuring consistent engineering, support, and operational practices.
* Partner with Cybersecurity, Data Governance, infrastructure, application, and business teams to resolve cross-platform dependencies, security issues, and production risks.
* Drive automation, monitoring, alerting, operational documentation, support procedures, and continuous service improvement to improve platform stability and supportability.
* Communicate service health, critical incidents, technical risks, dependencies, remediation plans, and platform priorities to leadership and key stakeholders.

**Platform Service Operations & Technical Leadership:**

* Drive innovation across Data Platform and Power BI services by evaluating and adopting emerging technologies, tools, and engineering capabilities.
* Lead POCs and technical evaluations across Generative AI, Agentic AI, AI-assisted development, data engineering, analytics, and platform automation.
* Identify opportunities to apply AI agents, MCP, RAG, intelligent automation, and AI coding capabilities to improve engineering productivity and platform operations.
* Promote automation across data pipelines, testing, deployment, monitoring, data quality, incident management, and operational support.
* Evaluate new capabilities within Azure, Databricks, Power BI, and the broader data/AI ecosystem for potential enterprise adoption.
* Define measurable success criteria, technical feasibility, scalability, security, cost, and business value for innovation initiatives before production adoption.
* Drive successful POCs toward production-ready, reusable, governed, and scalable enterprise capabilities in alignment with GSK standards.

**Required Skills & Qualifications:**

* 10+ years of experience in data engineering, data platforms, analytics, BI, or enterprise technology, with significant technical leadership and platform/service ownership responsibilities.
* Strong hands-on knowledge of Microsoft Azure, Azure Databricks, ADLS, ADF, Unity Catalog, and Power BI in enterprise-scale environments.
* Strong understanding of data engineering, data modeling, data integration, APIs, cloud platforms, security, scalability, performance optimization, and cost management.
* Experience managing Power BI services, including capacities, workspaces, gateways, semantic models, reports, security, refresh processes, deployment, performance, and production support.
* Experience with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), RBAC, security groups, service principals, user roles, access approvals, and platform/data access controls.
* Experience applying enterprise-approved design patterns, engineering standards, security controls, governance requirements, and reusable platform capabilities.
* Experience driving Generative AI, Agentic AI, automation, and emerging technology initiatives, including technical evaluations, POCs, enterprise integration, and production enablement.
* Demonstrated experience in technical product/platform ownership, including requirements, roadmaps, backlog prioritization, technical dependencies, delivery readiness, and cross-team execution.
* Experience with JIRA, ServiceNow, Azure DevOps/CI/CD, release management, incident/problem management, RCA, change management, monitoring, and production operations.
* Strong understanding of data governance, data quality, access management, security, and healthcare/pharma data domains.
* Strong technical leadership, communication, and stakeholder-management skills with the ability to coordinate across engineering, security, governance, analytics, infrastructure, support, and business teams.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience with Generative AI and Agentic AI technologies, including multi-agent systems, MCP, RAG, prompt engineering, LLM integration, and Responsible AI practices.
* Hands-on knowledge of modern AI engineering frameworks and tools such as LangGraph, LangChain, LangSmith, vector databases, and AI-assisted development tools.
* Strong understanding of modern data-platform concepts, including data products, data mesh, metadata-driven frameworks, self-service analytics, lakehouse patterns, and open table formats such as Apache Iceberg and Delta Lake.
* Experience with AI/ML platforms, MLOps, model lifecycle management, monitoring, and production AI solutions.
* Strong understanding of Power BI semantic models, DAX, data modeling, gateways, capacity/performance optimization, deployment pipelines, and enterprise BI governance.
* Knowledge of healthcare, patient, commercial, marketing, and real-world data domains, with an understanding of data privacy, quality, security, and governance considerations.
* Experience driving automation and reusable engineering capabilities across ingestion, data quality, testing, CI/CD, monitoring, operational support, and platform management.
* Ability to evaluate emerging capabilities across Azure, Databricks, Power BI, data engineering, and AI ecosystems and transition successful POCs into scalable, governed production solutions.
* Demonstrated technical leadership in driving engineering standards, reusable patterns, platform modernization, innovation, and cross-functional technology adoption.

**Skills**

Application Integrations, Application Programming Interface (API) Security, CI/CD, Cloud Engineering, Configuration Management (CM), Database Management, Data Engineering, Data Integration, Front-End Development, Internet of Things (IoT), Mobile Development, RESTful API Design, Security System Design, Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), Version Control, Web Development

**Why GSK?**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

title: Account Manager (SaaS) - Altium
description:
**Company Description**

Renesas is one of the top global semiconductor companies in the world. We strive to develop a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter world, and our goal is to make every endpoint intelligent by offering product solutions in the automotive, industrial, infrastructure and IoT markets. Our robust product portfolio includes world leading MCUs, SoCs, Analog and power products, plus Winning Combination solutions that curate these complementary products. We are a key supplier to the world’s leading manufacturers of electronics you rely on every day; you may not see our products, but they are all around you.

Renesas employs roughly 21,000 people in more than 30 countries worldwide. As a global team, our employees actively embody the Renesas Culture, our guiding principles based on five key elements: Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. Renesas believes in, and has a commitment to, diversity and inclusion, with initiatives and a leadership team dedicated to its resources and values. At Renesas, we want to build a sustainable future where technology helps make our lives easier. Join us and build your future by being part of what’s next in electronics and the world

 **Job Description**

For over three decades, Altium has been pioneering next-generation electronics design by continuing to develop innovative PCB design software that supports the engineering workflow. Altium offers a truly unified design experience to provide teams with all the tools they need to create successful electronic products - from concept to manufacturing. Through continuous research and development efforts, Altium remains dedicated to bringing comprehensive design capabilities to the mainstream to help engineers to make the most of modern technologies, successfully manage projects, and deliver intelligent, connected products.

Altium is growing and we are looking for an Account Manager to drive our growth in the assigned region. The primary role of the Account Manager is to build new customers and leverage relationships with existing customers to expand and upsell products and services.

**A day in the life of our Account Manager:**

* Build and nurture relationships with new and existing customers, identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling Altium’s solutions.
* Ensure high post-sales satisfaction, driving renewals and long-term partnerships.
* Meet or exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets.
* With deep dive Account Mapping, should be able to Present Altium’s value proposition through presentations accordingly to various stakeholders' personas in an Account/ organisation.
* Maintain detailed and accurate records of sales activities in Altium’s CRM system.
* Execute specialized projects such as call-out campaigns and customer data updates.
* Develop and implement strategies to expand Altium’s customer base and enhance market penetration.
* Track and manage subscription renewal dates within the assigned territory to maximize retention.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders, including marketing and customer success teams, to drive customer engagement and revenue growth.
* Stay up to date with industry trends, competitor activities, and Altium’s evolving product offerings.
* Office based in Bangalore with potential travel within India

  
**Qualifications**

**Who We’re Looking For**

* Bachelor's degree in business, communication, or a related field is desirable or a combination of equivalent education and experience.
* 10+ years of experience in SaaS software sales , preferably with a focus on annual subscriptions and maintenance contracts; ECAD, MCAD, or PLM experience is a strong plus.
* Proven leadership experience with a track record of successfully managing and coaching sales teams.
* Strong communication and negotiation skills with the ability to influence decision-makers at all levels.
* Self-driven and results-oriented with a passion for sales and business growth.
* Experience working with customers across PAN India is essential
* Proficiency in CRM systems such as Salesforce is highly desirable.
* Fluency in English is required; knowledge of additional Indian languages is a plus

  
**Additional Information**

Altium Limited, a part of the Renesas Group and headquartered in San Diego, California, is a global software company accelerating the pace of electronics innovation. We are redefining electronic product creation in a software-defined world with our industry-first cloud-based platform that unites every stakeholder and phase of electronics development.

From startups to world’s technology giants, our digital platforms give more power to PCB designers, supply chain, and manufacturing, letting them collaborate as never before. At Altium, our teams are empowered to innovate, collaborate globally, and help create the future of electronics development.

We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.

title: Events Manager
description:

* Greets customer during the event phase and hands-off to the Event Operations team for the execution of details.

* Adheres to all standards, policies, and procedures.

* Ensures billing accuracy and conducts bill reviews with the clients prior to processing the final bill.

* Manages group room blocks and meeting space for average to large-sized assigned groups.

* Ensures hourly employees understand expectations and parameters for event activities.

* Assists in the sales process and revenue forecasting for customer groups.

* Up-sells products and services throughout the event process.

* Forecasts group sleeping rooms and event revenue (catering and audio visual) for his/her groups.

* Reviews comment cards and guest satisfaction results with employees.

* Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals and/or managers.

* Assists in the development and implementation of corrective action plans.

* Take initiative to use his/her experience to improve service performance according to his/her evaluation of the issue and resolution.

* Works with the property staff and customers to address operational challenges associated with his/her group.

* Performs other duties as assigned to meet business needs.

At more than 100 award-winning properties worldwide, The Ritz-Carlton Ladies and Gentlemen create experiences so exceptional that long after a guest stays with us, the experience stays with them. Every day, we set the standard for rare and special luxury service the world over and pride ourselves on delivering excellence in the care and comfort of our guests.

Your role will be to ensure that the “Gold Standards” of The Ritz-Carlton are delivered graciously and thoughtfully every day. : Chennai - Hybrid

: 15-20 years

* Lead internal product and tool development initiatives to build reusable, scalable, and high-value AI assets and frameworks.

description:
**Delivery Owner**

  

**Ready to put your attention to detail to work, ensuring accurate orders, seamless deliveries and timely invoicing?**

**Want to combine your operations experience and analytical skills with AI tools to streamline workflows and drive process improvements?**

  

**About our Team**

The Corporate Markets – Pharma group is the leading provider of content based marketing services to the pharmaceutical, medical device, and biotech industries. We build on Elsevier’s strong content position and relationships with healthcare professionals to help our clients reach their desired audience with best-in-class clinical content that only Elsevier can deliver. We are leaders in what we do

  

**About the Role**

The Delivery Owner is primarily responsible for delivering Global Pharma products to customers. Typically specializing in one or more products while understanding deliverables across all of them, they work only on products approved by pre-delivery owners and ensure delivery is high quality and on schedule. Reporting to the Product Delivery Lead, they proactively flag delivery control issues, hand off deliverables with the agreed proof of delivery to Post-Delivery Owners for checks, and help document delivery procedures for old and new products. They strive to improve agreed KPIs through continuous improvement and standardized delivery across regions, may interact with customers to clarify deliverables, and manage multiple priorities, AI adoption and complexity while collaborating closely with Pre-Delivery Owners, Post-Delivery Owners and other Delivery Owners for end-to-end delivery.

  

**Responsibilities:**

* **Own end-to-end product delivery** from completion of pre-delivery approvals through successful customer delivery, building strong expertise in assigned Global Pharma products while remaining flexible to support other products as business needs and volumes require.
* **Ensure delivery readiness and compliance** by validating that editorial decisions, approvals, customer requirements and other prerequisites are complete before starting delivery, proactively challenging or escalating any gaps.
* **Manage stakeholders and delivery dependencies** by working closely with Pre-delivery and Post-delivery Owners and coordinating with publishers, printers, Journal Managers, Editors, Compliance and other relevant stakeholders to clarify requirements, resolve issues and ensure successful delivery.
* **Complete delivery closure and enable timely billing** by accurately documenting Proof of Delivery, providing the required information for invoicing and collaborating with Post-delivery Owners to resolve customer billing queries.
* **Track and control delivery performance** using appropriate tools and dashboards to monitor actual delivery times, turnaround times, volumes, quality, compliance and agreed metrics, supporting predictable delivery and revenue forecasting.
* **Drive continuous improvement, AI adoption and innovation** by identifying opportunities to simplify and standardise processes, reduce manual effort and duplication, and responsibly leverage approved AI, automation and existing Elsevier tools and dashboards to improve efficiency, accuracy, quality and predictability, while sharing successful practices and demonstrating measurable benefits.
* **Proactively manage priorities, workload and delivery risks** by keeping the Product Delivery Lead informed of status, timelines, dependencies and workload; escalating potential delays early; maintaining accuracy and process compliance during high-volume periods; and collaborating with other Delivery Owners to balance workloads and maintain continuity.
* **Define, document and continuously maintain delivery processes** for existing and new products, ensuring clear controls and hand-offs and keeping SOPs, RASCIs process documentation and product knowledge current, shareable and accessible through the agreed central knowledge repository.

Every day we perform better because of how we work together, as one team, each the best at what we do. Our teams are agile, collaborative, and committed to delivering—for each other, for our customers, and ultimately for the people who rely on the services we support.
  
  
Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

* We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.

**Job Responsibilities**

Lead the strategy, creation and scaling of a new generation of AI-powered products for the Clinical Research Organization (CRO) ecosystem. This role will define product vision and portfolio strategy while partnering deeply with AI/ML, GenAI and engineering teams to turn emerging technologies into secure, scalable and commercially viable products.

Key Responsibilities

* Establish product-market fit, success metrics, business cases and commercialization strategies.
* Drive build-vs-buy-vs-partner decisions for critical technology capabilities.

AI & GenAI Product Engineering
  
  

* Identify and productize opportunities across Generative AI, agentic AI, ML, predictive analytics, intelligent automation and AI-enabled workflows.

* Establish principles for responsible AI, security, privacy, governance, evaluation and human oversight in regulated clinical environments.

* Lead products from customer discovery and problem validation through MVP, product-market fit, launch and scale.
* Build rapid experimentation and feedback loops with customers, clinical experts and engineering teams.
* Balance speed of innovation with enterprise-grade reliability, security, compliance and scalability.

Customer & Market Leadership
  
  

* Engage senior pharmaceutical, biotech and CRO stakeholders to understand unmet needs and validate product opportunities.
* Convert customer insights, market trends and competitive intelligence into product strategy.
* Partner with commercial teams on positioning, pricing, packaging and go-to-market.

Product Organization & Cross-functional Leadership
  
  

* Establish scalable product management practices and operating mechanisms for the new business.
* Build and mentor a high-performing product organization as the portfolio grows.
* Create alignment across product, engineering, AI/data, clinical, commercial and executive stakeholders.
* Drive a culture of experimentation, customer obsession, technical excellence and measurable outcomes.

Success Measures
  
  

* A differentiated, scalable portfolio of AI-powered CRO products.
* Successful 0→1 launches and measurable product-market fit.
* Meaningful customer adoption and measurable business value.
* AI/GenAI capabilities successfully transitioned from experimentation to production-grade products.
* Strong integration of clinical expertise, proprietary data, AI and engineering capabilities.
* A scalable product organization capable of supporting a global business.

**Experience**

* 15 years of experience leading technology products, platforms or product businesses in complex enterprise environments.
* Proven 0→1 and product-scaling track record.
* Strong understanding of AI/ML, GenAI, agentic systems, data platforms and modern software engineering.
* Experience partnering deeply with engineering and technical leadership on architecture and product development.
* Strong customer discovery, product strategy, commercialization and executive communication skills.
* Experience in healthcare, life sciences, CRO, regulated industries or other data-intensive environments is highly desirable.

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.
  
  
No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

title: Technical Recruiter (Contract)
description:
Summary
  
  
Do you have a passion for helping others succeed? Do you genuinely believe that talent is the greatest asset of any company? As a member of Apple’s People group, you’ll help discover and develop our most important resource: our people. Together, we’ll search the world to build our collective of talented perfectionists, visionaries, and inventors. All the while, your efforts will maintain Apple as the most innovative company by striving to make us the most diverse — open to all people, all backgrounds, and all perspectives. And that’s just the beginning, because throughout Apple employees’ careers, you will continue to help them grow professionally and support them in work and life. Join the team and help build and keep the extraordinary talent it takes to make extraordinary products. We are looking for an experienced Technical Recruiter / Engineering Recruiter to join our team in Hyderabad on a contract basis. This role is responsible for providing the highest level of recruiting partnership to Apple's business leaders and candidates through our sourcing and selection processes, performing full lifecycle recruitment while maintaining excellent relationships. You will have the opportunity to work with an amazing, robust, and agile team responsible for hiring world-class talent. Apple has an exciting, high-performance culture. If you are results-driven, a self-starter, and ready to "Think Different," come join us! In this pivotal role, you will be instrumental in identifying, attracting, and hiring top-tier technical talent across various high-demand domains. You will act as a strategic partner to our hiring managers, leveraging market intelligence and data-driven insights to build exceptional teams that drive our innovation and success. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, possess a keen eye for talent, and are dedicated to delivering an outstanding candidate experience, we encourage you to apply. This is a contract position.
  
  
Description
  
  
As a Corporate Recruiter, you will be the cornerstone of our technical hiring efforts, owning and driving the end-to-end recruitment process for critical engineering and product roles. Your responsibilities will include: Strategic Talent Sourcing: Proactively source, engage, and attract top-tier technical talent from diverse channels, employing creative and effective strategies to build robust pipelines. You'll be the go-to person for finding the right profiles. Full-Cycle Recruitment & Candidate Engagement: Manage the entire recruitment lifecycle from initial candidate engagement through offer negotiation and onboarding, ensuring a seamless, positive, and engaging experience for all candidates. Hiring Partner Alignment: Conduct comprehensive intake meetings with hiring managers and leaders to deeply understand hiring profiles, define success metrics, and collaboratively develop effective sourcing and hiring strategies. Market Intelligence & Advisory: Provide data-backed insights on talent market availability, competitive compensation trends, and hiring best practices to influence and guide strategic hiring decisions. Data Analysis & Process Improvement: Analyse key recruitment metrics (e.g., conversion rates, time-to-source, time-to-hire) to evaluate pipeline health, identify bottlenecks, and proactively suggest process enhancements and optimizations. ATS Management & Communication: Maintain accurate and up-to-date records within our Applicant Tracking System (ATS), ensuring smooth communication and efficient workflow throughout the recruitment journey. Special Projects & Initiatives: Actively participate in and contribute to various talent acquisition and people-related special projects, helping to shape and refine our overall recruiting strategies and employer brand. Continuous Learning: Stay current with industry trends, best practices, and innovative sourcing techniques to maintain a competitive edge in the talent market.
  
  
Minimum Qualifications  
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 3 years of full-cycle recruiting experience, with a strong preference for candidates who have worked within the Technology sector
* Have a well-developed network of candidates and/or the skills to build the network quickly and comprehensively

  
  
  
Preferred Qualifications  
  
  

* Experience working in a global or rapidly scaling organisation.
* A passion for technology and staying abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies, and talent landscapes.
* Certifications in recruitment best practices or relevant recruiting tools.
* Experience with employer branding initiatives or talent marketing.
* Proven track record of successfully hiring for high-demand, specialised technical roles such as Software Engineering (Backend, Frontend, Full Stack), Product Management, Data Science, Machine Learning, or similar.
* Demonstrated ability to quickly ramp up, manage a high volume of requisitions, prioritise effectively, and operate autonomously to consistently hit challenging hiring targets.
* Excellent communication, influencing, and consultation skills, with a proven ability to build strong relationships and partner effectively with senior Hiring Managers and Leaders.
* Expertise in utilising Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and advanced proficiency with LinkedIn Recruiter for sourcing and engagement.

Morgan and Chase brands. **COSMIC BIOTECH PVT. LTD.**

**Role: Visual & Motion Designer**

**Department:** Brand & Marketing

**Location:** Hyderabad, Telangana (On-site)

**Employment Type:** Full-time (Work from Office)

**Working Days:** Monday to Saturday

**Working Hours:** 9:30 AM – 6:30 PM

**Reporting To:** Integrated Marketing Manager / CSO / CEO

**Creative Direction:** Market & Branding Strategist

**Hiring Priority:** High – Immediate Hiring

**ROLE SUMMARY**

Cosmic Biotech is looking for a creative, detail-oriented Visual & Motion Designer to bring our brands, products, and marketing campaigns to life through compelling visual communication.

The role involves creating visual assets across product packaging, digital campaigns, social media, paid advertising, websites, presentations and offline marketing materials.

Working closely with the Integrated Marketing Manager, Market & Branding Strategist, Content Creator and external creative partners, the designer will translate brand strategies and campaign briefs into high-quality, consistent and production-ready creative assets.

We are looking for someone with strong design fundamentals, a creative mindset and the ability to execute ideas efficiently across multiple brands and marketing initiatives.

**Your portfolio will be the primary selection criterion for this role.**

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Brand & Visual Communication**

* Execute visual communication in alignment with established brand guidelines.
* Maintain visual consistency across all brand touchpoints.
* Translate creative briefs and brand strategies into effective visual designs.
* Develop and adapt brand assets for different communication channels.

title: Senior Manager, Data Science
description:
**About Vanguard**
  
Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.

  

**Vanguard India**

Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients.

**Role Summary**

Lead a multidisciplinary team of data scientists and engineers building enterprise-scale AI evaluation and platform capabilities. The role will focus on AI/GenAI evaluation, evaluation harness engineering, scalable platform infrastructure, and production AI quality and observability. We are looking for a strong technical leader who can combine hands-on AI/ML and engineering depth with people leadership, while partnering across product, platform, architecture, and governance teams.

**Responsibilities**  
  
1. Assists and executes tactical plans to implement Vanguard's data science strategy to increase internal company performance and gain competitive advantage.
  
2. Manages a team of data scientists responsible for a portfolio of diagnostic, predictive, and prescriptive analytics projects to support data-driven business decision making. Supports the continuous evolution and strategy of Vanguard's data science capabilities.
  
3. Oversees and engages in deep dive diagnostic, predictive, and prescriptive analytics to support data-driven business decision making. Creates alternative model approaches to assess complex model design and advance future capabilities.
  
4. Identifies and diagnoses data inconsistencies and errors, documents data assumptions, and forages to fill data gaps. Provides coaching to data scientists.
  
5. Oversees the execution of large scale analytics projects. Applies significant quality control and risk assessment of the model, methodologies, outputs, and processes for major data science projects.
  
6. Engages with internal stakeholders to understand and probe business processes in order to develop hypotheses. Brings structure to requests and translates requirements into an analytic approach.
  
7. Leads and coaches test design, research design, and model validation. Provides statistical consultation services. Serves as the analytics expert on cross functional teams for large strategic initiatives and contributes to the growth of the Vanguard analytic community.
  
8. Evaluates new technologies and manages vendors engaged in big data analysis.

description:
**Title:**

**Overseas Manager India)**

Regional Director – India, Middle East & Africa (IMEA)

**Location:**
Mumbai, India

**Contract Duration:**
3-year local assignment with the option to extend to 5 years based on successful delivery of a range of milestones throughout the course of the assignment.

**Company**

Enterprise Ireland is the Irish Government’s enterprise development, trade and innovation agency, responsible for
supporting the growth, internationalisation and global competitiveness of Irish-owned businesses.
Established in 1998, the organisation plays a central role in Ireland’s economic development by helping ambitious Irish
companies start, innovate, compete, scale and connect with international markets. Through funding, strategic advisory
support, innovation programmes and market access, Enterprise Ireland works with businesses across their growth
journey, from high-potential start-ups and SMEs to established companies seeking to become global leaders.

Enterprise Ireland supports companies across a broad range of sectors, including technology, life sciences, engineering, financial and business services, food, sustainability and advanced manufacturing.

Today, Enterprise Ireland supports more than 4,000 Irish-owned businesses and has an international network spanning 42 overseas offices. Companies supported by Enterprise Ireland employ more than 232,000 people and generate €38.86 billion in exports, reflecting the organisation’s significant contribution to Ireland’s enterprise ecosystem and its ambition to make Irish exporting companies a primary driver of the Irish economy.

**Job Description**

The Director India is responsible for leading and delivering Enterprise Ireland’s strategy for the Indian market including Sri Lanka and Bangladesh building on the significant progress already achieved. This will involve the continued development and execution of sectoral and regional plans to deliver ambitious targets across all relevant sectors.

The role involves leading a small, diverse and highly motivated team of three, maximising client impact, fostering innovation / new ideas and ensuring full adherence to Enterprise Ireland’s organisational policies. This includes supporting the team in India to provide strategic advice to clients and to facilitate high-value introductions to buyers and key stakeholders to accelerate market development. Client Service Excellence is central to everything they do a deeply embedded culture of going the extra mile for their client companies, underpinned by world-class technology platforms such as Salesforce. The guiding principle of the Global Markets Division across its 40 offices worldwide, is: right client, right market, right time.

The successful candidate will represent Enterprise Ireland as a trusted custodian of its reputation in-market including media engagement, public speaking, and close collaboration with external stakeholders in India, as well as Team Ireland colleagues (The Irish Embassy in Delhi and the Consul General in Mumbai (where Enterprise Ireland is based), IDA, Bord Bia & Tourism Ireland).

This is a key leadership position and as a member of the IMEA management team, the candidate will be responsible for all in-market activities while also contributing to the further development & implementation of the company’s regional strategies and strengthening collaboration across the IMEA team, APAC colleagues & the wider Global Markets Division.

**Key Deliverables**

Develop and lead a high performance Team.

·      Lead the India team to achieve all strategic and operational targets, supporting both new market entrants and scaling companies to deliver sustainable export growth for Enterprise Ireland clients in India.

·      Lead, manage & coach the team to maintain high levels of engagement, performance & output including the active implementation of performance development and review processes.

·      Oversee the day-to-day operations of the office including budget management, payroll &

delivery against office targets.

Implement a range of services and solutions to support Irish company sales activities in the

region, leading to job growth in Ireland.

·      Lead the design and delivery of targeted in-market sector initiatives prioritising key clients to grow market share & ensuring full alignment with the priorities of sector teams in Ireland.

·      Develop and implement effective processes to prioritise client engagement & maximise impact supporting both new market entrants & established exporters to achieve greater scale in the

region.

·      Work closely with overseas and Ireland-based colleagues to identify high-potential and high-

engagement clients & to determine the most appropriate business models to support effective

market entry & preparation.

·      Collaborate with colleagues and the Education team in Ireland to support international student

recruitment & the partnership ambitions of Irish higher education institutions with Indian

universities in research & innovation.

·      Deliver a range of services & solutions aligned with the new operating model to support Irish

companies’ sales activities in target markets contributing to export growth & jobs in Ireland.

·      Provide direct, strategic advice to clients on key aspects of doing business in India, including channel to market, competition, local partnerships, establishing an in-market presence, recruitment, regulation & compliance.

·      Communicate market trends & opportunities to relevant exporters both internally & in the public domain ensuring clients are well informed on opportunities & the critical success factors for growing exports in India.

·      Help build client capability to credibly pursue sales opportunities with Enterprise Ireland support including identifying prospects for financial assistance under the Strategic Marketing Review, Market Research & Market Validation grants Funding & grants | Business Support | Enterprise Ireland

Gain a thorough understanding of the markets & build a network of contacts and supports in relevant sectors or service providers.

·      Build strong, collaborative relationships with the Department of Enterprise Tourism & Employment (DETE), Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade Policy (DFAT) and key stakeholders including IDA Ireland, Bord Bia & Tourism Ireland ensuring continued awareness of Enterprise Ireland’s priorities, objectives & opportunities for collaboration.

·      Establish & grow effective networks & relationships with relevant trade & economic bodies in India.

·      Build & nurture an extensive network of senior-level contacts across relevant buying organisations ensuring strong awareness of the range of world-class capabilities available from Ireland.

·      Develop and deepen expertise in key market sectors where Enterprise Ireland clients have significant capability & proactively share this insight with relevant clients and sector teams.

Deliver on all assigned corporate responsibilities.

·      Deliver on all organisational metrics & targets agreed with the Regional Director, IMEA.

·      Contribute actively as a member of the Enterprise Ireland IMEA Regional Management Team, proposing and implementing new initiatives, project ideas and market opportunities to drive export growth & job creation in Ireland.

·      Play a lead role in executing Enterprise Ireland’s five-year corporate strategy, highlighting the continued importance of the target market in delivering growth & scale for Enterprise Ireland clients.

·      Work collaboratively with relevant HQ colleagues to deliver an integrated & effective client engagement model.

·      Proactively engage with the Marketing and Communications team at HQ to deliver initiatives that raise the profile of Ireland, Enterprise Ireland & its clients across the market.

·      Lead by example in capturing relevant market & client information in organisational management information systems ensuring regular & accurate updates on Salesforce & in monthly reports.

·      Achieve budget management targets as set by the Regional Director, IMEA.

·      Represent Enterprise Ireland across media, Irish business associations & the extensive network of Irish-educated business alumni projecting a positive image of Ireland as a world-class international supply source.

**Functional Competencies:**

·      Demonstrated experience in leading and managing a team to deliver against targets, with proven teamwork skills and a strong track record of achieving results.

Proven expertise in building strategic networks including:

§ Key relationships with business leaders across the region;

§ Strong connections across trade bodies and other international agencies in the region;

§ Close, integrated collaboration with relevant sector divisions in Ireland.

Proven business development experience, including:

§ At least 10–15 years’ commercial or other relevant experience;

§ Strong commercial and marketing acumen, with a sound understanding of business models, sales processes & market development strategies;

§ A clear understanding of company growth stages and their corresponding needs;

§ Demonstrated experience in developing & implementing successful marketing, sales & business development strategies that drive business growth & international expansion;

§ Good knowledge & understanding of the major issues affecting business competitiveness & their potential impact on Irish companies operating in, or seeking to enter, the region.

·      Ability to work across multiple sectors, with knowledge & understanding of some or all of the key sectors relevant to the region.

·      Proven project management skills, including the ability to oversee & manage significant events such as inward & outward trade missions involving Government Ministers.

·      Ability to manage multiple competing priorities.

·      A high level of flexibility to travel across priority markets in support of Enterprise Ireland & client objectives.

·      Excellent communication & presentation skills.

title: Payments Cross-Currency Solutions Specialist - Vice President
description:
**Job Description**
**Job summary**
JPMorgan Payments is looking for a business development / solutions Vice President to execute our Cross-Currency Solutions growth strategy. FX and global payments are critical drivers of the international growth agenda for the Payments and FX business.
  
  
The Cross-Currency Solutions Vice President will drive the accelerated growth of the regional and cross-regional Cross-Currency Solutions P&L through a full range of sales and advisory activities.
  
  
The role serves as a subject matter expert in Cross-Currency Solutions, actively supporting client solution pitches, identifying opportunities for growth and digitalizing clients' workflows. The incumbent acts as an advisor and extension of sales for the Payment Sales Managers and Global Corporate Bankers, helping to win new business through Request for Proposals, Differentiated Solution Pitches and leveraging client relationships.
  
  
In addition, the role serves as the voice of the client—channeling client feedback and competitive intelligence back to our product partners to strengthen product and solution features. Cross-Currnecy Solution Specialists stay closely aligned to product governance, legal/compliance/regulatory requirements, market practice and technology/operational constraints. This proximity enables early validation of feasibility, reduces late-stage surprises and rework, and ensures solutions are productized in a way that can be replicated across clients and segments.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Distinct accountability and partnership model: Lead solution feasibility and productization strategy for regulated and complex payment / foreign exchange control-enabled flows, working in close partnership with: Product (owns product vision/roadmap and approval forums); Payments Sales (owns go-to-market execution, pipeline shaping and client engagement, as applicable)
* Drive the outlined strategy for growing the Cross-Currency APAC P&L for the assigned portfolio, leveraging existing JPMorgan relationship, developing new relationships with Corporate Banking and Payments Sales, and CDM Marketer.
* Sales enablement for simple cross-currency payment flows for a defined set of client portfolio: Train relevant coverage partners on cross-currency payment capabilities, including spot foreign exchange payment solutions available via supported payment platforms. This includes the end-to-end payment flow from initiation through automated payment processing, tracking and client reporting.
* Ownership of complex flow / foreign exchange control-enabled solutions: Serve as the primary solution partner for complex client needs, working with Sales (and other stakeholders when applicable) to configure or tailor existing capabilities. As a client-facing Vice President, drive organic growth by increasing penetration with existing clients and pitching solutions to new clients, including proposal responses and bundling of products & solutions, and educate clients on new ways of execution.
* Governance, legal and regulatory rigor (continuous, not episodic): Ensure governance and regulatory alignment are embedded throughout the client solutioning lifecycle. Stay current on product approvals, policy constraints, licensing/regulatory requirements and required controls—reducing late-stage surprises and minimizing rework when feasibility checks happen too late.
* Structured translation layer between Sales and Product: Convert pipeline signals, proposal inputs and client feedback into actionable product requirements, enhancement requests and prioritization inputs. Translate roadmap constraints into clear client positioning, field-ready enablement and guidance on what is feasible now vs. later. Work with Sales to maintain a healthy client pipeline, ensuring involvement across the sales cycle from opportunity identification through solution pitches and winning mandates. The role is expected to support multiple client segments and industries in India and translate requirements into scalable solutions.
* Coordination between Payments Sales, Corporate and Commercial Banks and CDM Markets for pro-active and target client calling, develop and present client relevant and thoughtful solution presentations and set-out pricing strategy for all of the Cross-Currency Solutions.

**Key Skills**

* Cross-border payments and FX expertise: strong understanding of cross-currency payment flows, foreign exchange, client implementation considerations and operating/processing constraints
* Regulatory and controls mindset: ability to operate effectively within governance frameworks, legal/compliance requirements, and local regulatory expectations applicable to cross-border transactions
* Advisory and Solutioning: capability to assess feasibility early, design repeatable solutions, and standardize patterns that can scale across clients and segments, while taking an consultative approach going beyond the standard product offering.
* Commercial acumen and client-facing leadership: strong executive presence, ability to influence outcomes, and proven experience supporting complex solution pitches and proposal responses
* Stakeholder management: demonstrated ability to drive alignment across Product, Sales, Technology, Operations, Implementation and Service teams
* Analytical and structured problem solving: ability to leverage data and structured thinking to prioritize opportunities, develop replication strategies, and deliver clear recommendations
* Globalized view: ability to recognize patterns across markets and segments, apply global standards with local expertise.

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Significant experience in cross-border payments, transaction banking/cash management and/or FX-related solutions
* Strong understanding of end-to-end payment flows and the practicalities of delivery and execution in a regulated environment
* Demonstrated experience partnering across Product, Sales and delivery organizations to deliver client outcomes
* Track record in complex client solutioning, commercialization and supporting proposal responses
* Understanding of APAC regulatory environment related to cash management, account services and foreign exchange
* BA or BS from a top-tier program or equivalent level education preferred
* Minimum of 8 years+ of relevant work experience
* Exceptional writing, verbal communication and client facing skills

**About Us**
JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.
  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.
  
  
**About The Team**
J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.
