This role is responsible for developing sales plans and establishing priorities, allocating resources effectively, and overseeing execution across teams. The successful candidate will apply deep functional expertise to complex business challenges and contribute to the development of sales strategy and policy.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Leadership and Direction - Identify and communicate the actions needed to implement the function's strategy and business plan within the business area or department; explain the relationship to the broader organization's mission, vision, and values; motivate people to commit to these tenets and do extraordinary things to achieve local business goals.
* Customer Relationship Development / Prospecting - Develop and implement relationship management plans for complex potential customer accounts to identify and build relationships with relevant decision-makers and influencers within the customer organization and to enable effective two-way flow of information and resolution of issues.
* Sales Opportunities Creation - Develop a personal network within the business sector and represent the organization at business sector events. Obtain market intelligence and enhance the visibility and reputation of the organization, its products, and its services.
* Sell Customer Propositions - Configure a complex product-and-services solution and associated contractual terms that meet the customer's mid- to long-term needs, taking input from relevant internal specialists. Present the solution to customer representatives and negotiate agreement within a predefined range of commercial parameters, or, alternately, review sales proposals from team members and authorize those that deviate from standard terms, escalating issues to senior management where appropriate.
* Promoting Customer Focus - Develop internal marketing plans and work collaboratively with other departments to improve internal relationships and build strong external customer relationships.
* Customer Relationship Management (CRM) Data - Oversee the implementation and maintenance of the CRM system within the area of responsibility, identifying and communicating opportunities for system improvement that may enhance the management of customer relationships.
* Performance Management - Manage and report on the performance of a substantial, diverse team; set appropriate performance objectives for direct reports or project/account team members and hold individuals accountable for achieving them; take appropriate corrective action where necessary to ensure the achievement of team/personal objectives.

title: Associate Manager - Sales & Marketing
description:
**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group:**
In recent years, we have evolved from a new player in power generation to India’s largest private thermal power producer, with a capacity of 15,250 MW and a 40 MW solar project in Gujarat. It has created a world-class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large-scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG-rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
Responsible for maximizing the sales and revenue of assigned products, mapping the market and trade flow for effective decision making, creating pricing strategy, and liaising with internal and external stakeholders for technical, commercial, and regulatory acceptance of the assigned product. Additionally, the candidate will lead the technical development of the assigned products and build a comprehensive product and market development plan in line with the organizational growth plan.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Associate Manager - Sales & Marketing**
**Sales Planning And Execution**
Align product sales strategies with business objectives to maximize revenue for acid, chemical, and byproducts.
  
  
Implement and manage effective sales plans, ensuring the achievement of sales targets for the assigned products.
  
  
Monitor market trends and adjust sales strategies to meet changing market demands and opportunities.
  
  
**Contract Management**
Negotiate and conclude long-term and spot contracts, ensuring favorable terms for the supply of assigned products.
  
  
Coordinate with internal teams to manage contract execution and compliance, mitigating risks associated with contractual obligations.
  
  
Develop and oversee the implementation of SOPs for contract management in collaboration with stakeholders.
  
  
**Stakeholder Engagement And Market Intelligence**
Liaise with internal and external stakeholders to ensure technical, commercial, and regulatory alignment for product acceptance.
  
  
Perform market mapping and analysis to inform pricing strategies and decision-making processes.
  
  
Build and maintain strong relationships with channel partners, suppliers, and customers to support product distribution and sales.
  
  
**Operational Efficiency And Cost Control**
Supervise inventory levels and implement measures for continuous product evacuation to optimize stock turnover.
  
  
Manage logistical operations to mitigate issues related to distribution, taxation, or other barriers to smooth product delivery.
  
  
Implement cost control initiatives to improve profit margins and operational efficiency for the product line.
  
  
**Digitisation And Automation**
Work closely with technology partners to integrate digital solutions and automate processes to meet current and future market needs.
  
  
Oversee the digital transformation of product management, enhancing efficiency and customer engagement.
  
  
**Team Leadership And Development**
Lead and mentor the product team, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and high performance.
  
  
Coordinate cross-functional training and professional development to enhance team capabilities and support organizational growth.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Educational Qualification:**
B.E./B.Tech (MBA desirable)
  
  
**Work Experience (Range Of Years)**
8- 10 years of relevant work experience in B2B marketing and sales of copper slag, cement raw materials such as granulated blast furnace slag, fly ash, aggregates, and/or air products & specialty chemicals

title: Entertainment Director
description:
As the Vice President – Entertainment Pricing, Planning, Supply & Ad Products, you will lead the end-to-end monetization strategy and product innovation for Company’s Digital Entertainment Ads business. The role will drive revenue growth through strategic pricing, supply planning, yield optimization, programmatic partnerships and the development of scalable advertising solutions.

You will work at the intersection of product, technology, sales and monetization, translating market opportunities and advertiser needs into innovative ad products and commercially impactful solutions.

**About The Team**

The Entertainment Product & Revenue Strategy (PRS) function plays a critical role in shaping the monetization of entertainment content. The team is responsible for pricing and packaging ad inventory, optimizing yield, strengthening supply architecture and introducing innovative advertising solutions that drive sustainable revenue growth for Company and deliver on customers changing objectives.

The function works closely with Product, Engineering, Ad Operations, Business Intelligence and Sales teams to build scalable solutions and strengthen Company’s position in the digital advertising ecosystem.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Monetization, Pricing & Supply Strategy
* Lead the pricing, planning and monetization strategy for the Digital Entertainment Ads business.
* Drive supply planning, inventory optimization and yield management to maximize revenue potential.
* Develop pricing frameworks, packaging strategies and commercial propositions aligned with advertiser needs and business objectives.
* Identify opportunities to improve monetization across devices, formats, audiences and content environments.
* Ad Product Innovation & Roadmap
* Own the roadmap for advertising offerings across devices and platforms, ensuring Company’s ad solutions remain competitive and future-ready.
* Drive the development and launch of innovative ad products, formats, targeting capabilities and advertising experiences.
* Translate market trends, advertiser requirements and business opportunities into scalable product initiatives.
* Partner with Product and Engineering teams to define priorities, manage dependencies and ensure timely execution.
* Programmatic Monetization & AdTech Partnerships
* Drive programmatic monetization strategy, including partnerships across DSPs, SSPs, exchanges and other ecosystem participants.
* Identify opportunities to strengthen programmatic yield, supply access and private marketplace offerings.
* Evaluate and enable new advertising technologies, monetization models and ecosystem partnerships.
* Ensure alignment between programmatic initiatives, commercial objectives and operational capabilities.
* Cross-Functional Execution
* Lead a high-performing team of individual contributors driving ad technology and product initiatives across multiple stakeholder groups.
* Collaborate closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Ad Operations and BI teams to deliver business-critical initiatives.
* Coordinate pilots, A/B testing, feedback loops and phased rollouts to validate solutions before scaling.
* Proactively identify risks, resolve execution roadblocks and ensure effective stakeholder alignment.
* Sales Enablement & Commercial Solutions
* Partner with Sales teams to develop and commercialize packaged propositions, custom solutions and strategic advertising offerings.
* Support strategic deals by translating product capabilities into compelling advertiser solutions.
* Work with relevant teams to resolve initial technology or implementation challenges and ensure smooth adoption.
* Enable Sales teams with clear positioning, product understanding and commercial use cases.
* Leadership & Governance
* Provide concise and structured updates to senior leadership on program progress, key decisions, dependencies and risks.
* Establish effective governance mechanisms to track priorities, milestones and business outcomes.
* Build a culture of ownership, innovation, collaboration and execution excellence within the team.
* Influence senior stakeholders across business, product and technology functions to drive outcomes in a complex and evolving environment.

**Skills & Attributes For Success**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant discipline with 12–15 years of experience in digital media, AdTech, programmatic advertising, product strategy, monetization, pricing or revenue strategy roles or management consulting experience.
* Strong people management experience, with a track record of building and leading high-performing teams.
* Hands-on experience in one or more of the following areas:

○ Ad product development and innovation

○ Pricing and packaging

○ Programmatic monetization

○ Yield and inventory management

○ New advertising formats and experiences

* Deep understanding of the digital advertising ecosystem, including DSPs, SSPs, exchanges, header bidding, private marketplaces and targeting will be preferred.
* Experience in digital video advertising, connected TV, streaming platforms or entertainment monetization will be an advantage.
* Experience working with cross-functional teams across Sales, Product, Engineering, Ad Operations and BI.
* Strong commercial acumen and the ability to translate product and monetization levers into measurable revenue impact.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management and influencing skills.
* Structured problem-solving approach, strong ownership mindset and the ability to operate effectively in ambiguous environments.
* Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution and operational rigour.

title: DGM - International Services
description:
**Description - External**
Lauritz Knudsen Electrical and Automation (A unit of Schneider Electric India Pvt. Ltd.) is a pioneering electrical and automation brand with a rich legacy of over 70 years in India. We offer a comprehensive portfolio of low-voltage switchgear, medium-voltage switchgear, automation solutions, software, and services catering to diverse segments, Buildings, OEM’s, infrastructure, and industry.
  
  
**Role Purpose**
Drive sustainable profitable growth for the International Solutions Business, powering profitable order acquisition, strategic account development, market expansion, and customer relationships across targeted international markets. The role will own the sales cycle from opportunity identification and solution positioning through techno-commercial negotiations, contract closure, handover to execution and collaborate with teams till the end of project cycle.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute the international sales strategy for Solutions Business in assigned regions and markets.
* Drive order intake, revenue, gross margin, and sales pipeline in line with annual business targets.
* Identify and develop opportunities with end users, EPC contractors, consultants and strategic accounts, particularly across energy, utilities, infrastructure, and industrial segments.
* Lead solution-based selling, translating customer technical requirements into commercially competitive offerings.
* Manage the complete sales cycle including lead generation, RFQ/tender review, bid strategy, pricing, proposal development, negotiations, and contract closure.
* Build senior-level relationships with key customers and develop account plans for strategic and high-potential accounts.
* Coordinate with engineering, proposal, execution, service, supply chain, legal, and finance teams to deliver competitive and compliant offers.
* Ensure appropriate commercial risk management covering payment terms, LDs, warranties, guarantees, contractual obligations, and project-specific risks.
* Monitor market trends, competitor positioning, customer investment plans, and upcoming projects to build a healthy medium- and long-term opportunity pipeline.
* Ensure strong opportunity management, forecasting discipline, and execution of sales priorities.
* Post project handing over to execution, full support & collaboration with execution team till the end of the project cycle

**Technical & Commercial Skills**

* Strong understanding of Lauritz Knudsen solutions, electrical/energy systems, industrial applications, and project business.
* Techno-commercial tender/RFQ evaluation and bid strategy.
* Pricing, costing, gross-margin management, and commercial risk assessment.
* Contractual understanding including Incoterms, payment instruments/LCs, performance guarantees, LDs, warranties, and international trade terms.
* Strong pipeline management, forecasting, and opportunity qualification capabilities.
* Working knowledge of CRM/BFO/SFDC or equivalent opportunity-management platforms, along with strong Excel and PowerPoint skills.
* Ability to interpret technical specifications, customer requirements, project documentation, and competitor offerings.

**Soft Skills**

* Strategic and entrepreneurial mindset with strong commercial acumen.
* Excellent negotiation, influencing, and closing skills.
* Strong executive presence and ability to engage senior customer/EPC stakeholders.
* Customer-centric and relationship-oriented, while maintaining commercial discipline.
* Strong collaboration, and stakeholder-management skills.

title: Product Marketing Manager
description:
As our Product Marketing Manager, you'll be the bridge between product, sales and the market. You'll shape how we position the software, plan and run its launch, and build the social media presence that drives awareness, sign-ups and adoption. This is a hands-on role for someone who has launched a software product before and knows how to turn features into a story people care about.

What you'll do

* **Own the product launch:** Plan and run the end-to-end go-to-market for our software, including launch timelines, messaging, assets, channels and success metrics.
* **Lead social media go-to-market:** Build and run the launch strategy across LinkedIn, Instagram, X (Twitter), YouTube and other relevant platforms, including content calendars, launch campaigns, teasers, demos and community engagement.
* **Positioning and messaging:** Define our value proposition, target personas and key messages, and keep them consistent across the website, social, ads and sales material.
* **Customer and market insight:** Research target customers, competitors and market trends, and feed what you learn back to the product team.
* **Content and creative:** Brief and create product videos, demos, explainer posts, case studies, landing pages and launch announcements, working with designers and content creators.
* **Paid and organic campaigns:** Plan and optimise paid social campaigns and organic growth, working with agencies or in-house teams where needed.
* **Sales enablement:** Create pitch decks, one-pagers, FAQs and battle cards that help the sales team sell effectively.
* **Measure and improve:** Track reach, engagement, leads, sign-ups, conversion and CAC; report on launch performance and iterate on what works.
* **Cross-functional collaboration:** Work closely with product, design, sales and customer success so that every launch is coordinated and on time.

What we're looking for

* **4–5 years of experience in product marketing**, ideally at a software, SaaS or tech company.
* **Proven experience launching a software product**, with at least one end-to-end launch you can walk us through, including what worked and what didn't.
* **Strong hands-on social media marketing experience**: launch campaigns, content strategy, community building and paid social on LinkedIn, Instagram, X and YouTube.
* Ability to translate technical features into clear, customer-focused benefits.
* Excellent writing and storytelling skills in English (other regional languages are a plus).
* Comfortable with data: you set KPIs, read analytics and make decisions from the numbers.
* Experience creating sales enablement material and working closely with sales teams.
* Organised and self-driven, able to manage multiple workstreams and deadlines in a fast-moving environment.
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications or a related field; an MBA is a plus but not required.

Tools you'll likely use

* Social media management
* Analytics: Google Analytics, platform-native insights, and dashboards
* CRM and marketing automation: HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce or similar
* Design and video: Canva, Figma or basic video editing tools

Pay: From ₹30,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Analyst- BCG Vantage
description:
Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

What You'll Do

As a Senior Analyst – BCG Vantage on our Client Focus path within BCG's Risk and Compliance Practice Area, your focus will be supporting the Risk Analytics team and will work in a growing global team, delivering value to clients via individual expertise and/or institutionalized BCG Vantage assets (products, tools, data, workshops, frameworks, surveys, domain-specific data and related expertise, etc.). You will contribute on cases and proposals by contributing relevant analysis and insights and help case teams create strong impact for clients. While contributing to client cases, workshops and proposals, occasional travel to serve clients onsite during staffing assignments is expected to understand client requirements, and design / develop solutions.

You will support commercialization efforts for the topic/sector working, in conjunction with business leaders, through contributing analysis and insights to proposals, client workshops and marketing materials. Additionally, as a Senior Analyst – BCG Vantage, you will contribute to developing intellectual property & assets for the business and assist in onboarding and training junior colleagues based on your topic/sector expertise. You will apply your subject matter knowledge to support project proposals, including outside-in analyses, competitive benchmarking, and maturity assessments. You will contribute to the development of client-ready deliverables, including presentations, white papers, maturity models, and regulatory trackers and will support ongoing knowledge curation efforts, including vendor landscape evaluations and toolkit development for the compliance and risk domain.

You will collaborate with case teams to support clients in identifying, assessing, and managing regulatory, financial, and non-financial risks across a range of domains (especially credit risk). You will conduct research and analysis on relevant regulations, risk and compliance frameworks, and industry benchmarks to generate actionable insights. You will liaise with specialized teams (e.g., BCG X, Risk Expert Consultants) to co-develop optimal solutions and ensure seamless delivery of projects and will work alongside consultants to collect, synthesize, and analyze case team learnings, contributing to the development of new knowledge assets such as case vignettes, frameworks, and methodologies.

The R&C PA helps clients to manage key risks strategically, to advance organizational resilience and establish a profound risk culture, by defining and transforming R&C operating models. We cover a diverse set of topics across financial and non-financial risks and assist in enabling clients' strategy through technical enablement with the help of our deep expertise in risk modelling, analytics and digitization.

  
  

What You'll Bring

* 2+ years of consulting experience in the Banking/Financial Services, Insurance (in India) sectors and Credit risk; candidates with consulting experience strongly preferred
* In lieu of consulting experience, 3+ years minimum industry experience required; 4-6+ years of industry experience strongly preferred in Banking/Financial Services, Insurance (in India) in financial risk and regulations - Credit Risk (required), additional Risk types (bonus)
* Degree requirement: Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Statistics, Public Policy, or Law
* Credential requirement: Financial Risk Manager certification administered by the Global Association of Risk Professionals or Chartered Financial Analyst
* Exposure to regulatory frameworks especially BASEL guidelines, Reserve Bank of India guidelines
* Fluency in written and spoken English, strong written and verbal communication skills, strong business acumen and problem-solving capabilities

Who You'll Work With

As a Senior Analyst – BCG Vantage on our Client Focus path, you will work face to face with clients and with BCG Project Leaders, Associates and Consultants. In the period between cases, you will collaborate with global topic leads and colleagues across BCG to bring expertise and capabilities to the service of our internal and external clients. Our team is made up a diverse pool of BCG Vantage positions that allow us to pursue exciting, innovative BCG Vantage careers.

Additional info

BCG Vantage is a powerhouse of expertise, seamlessly embedded within Practice Areas and markets to drive extraordinary impact. It equips BCG case teams and clients with cutting-edge expertise, proprietary assets, actionable data, and transformative insights that empower our case teams and enable our clients to achieve their aspirations.

With global experts across 20 Practices, covering more than 100 topics, sectors and offers, plus four focused geographic markets, BCG Vantage delivers unparalleled depth and breadth of insight & expertise. BCG Vantage consists of three career paths, each playing a crucial role in delivering value to clients, case teams and practice teams.  
  
**Client Focus (Embedded Expertise)**
  

* Integrates into client-facing teams to deliver direct client impact through expertise, know-how, and proprietary tools and assets

T**opic Activation (Sector Expertise with Proprietary Tool & Data Solutions)**  

* Combines deep domain insights with our know-how and proprietary assets to address targeted challenges directly with clients and project teams; co-creates insights on industry trends and functional topics, proprietary data and tools, and teams to codify IP that all enables BCG to deliver excellent business value with its clients

**Research (Practice Topic and Sector-Aligned Research and Insights)**  

* Delivers actionable research and insights tailored to the client project’s needs; works with qualitative and quantitative data, conducts research and provides synthesized results from sources including commercial data, public and open source, company and industry research, macro-economic, commodities and trade data.

**YOU'RE GOOD AT**

* Solving client problems through formulating relevant research and/or analytical approaches in Risk Analytics in an inquisitive and structured way
* Communicating with case teams and clients team members, in a credible and confident way
* Working collaboratively and effectively in a group dynamic often virtual, proficient in agile ways of working
* Being flexible and bringing a curious and creative mindset, open to new things and able to propose innovative ideas
* Navigating complexity and ambiguity

At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.

For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.

We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Head of South Asia
description:
**Head Of South Asia**

**Are you ready to shape the future of India’s petrochemicals and energy markets by turning powerful market intelligence into game-changing growth opportunities?**  
**Do you have experience in Leadership Role** ?

  

**About the Business**

At ICIS, our mission is to optimize the world’s resources. We help companies make strategic, sustainable decisions by bringing transparency to markets across the world. We create a comprehensive view of commodities markets, providing companies with the data and intelligence to successfully navigate across global value chains every day. Our customers benefit from instant access to price assessments, reports and forecasts, a dedicated news channel and supply and demand data. You can learn more about ICIS at the link below. https://www.icis.com/explore

**About our Team**

Our teams are fueled by curiosity, relentlessly pursuing better customer outcomes. We're on a mission to deliver unparalleled customer experience, excelling in communication. In a fast-paced environment, we thrive, embracing change with flexibility and composure under pressure. Our high-energy, self-motivated individuals are driven by a genuine desire to make a positive mark on our business. But that's not all we're creative problem solvers with an entrepreneurial spirit.

  
  

**About the Role**

ICIS is seeking an accomplished leader to lead the sales function, directing people leaders and professionals toward the achievement of departmental commercial objectives. This role is responsible for developing sales plans and establishing priorities, allocating resources effectively, and overseeing execution across teams. The successful candidate will apply deep functional expertise to complex business challenges and contribute to the development of sales strategy and policy.

  

**Responsibilities**

* **Leadership and Direction** - Identify and communicate the actions needed to implement the function's strategy and business plan within the business area or department; explain the relationship to the broader organization's mission, vision, and values; motivate people to commit to these tenets and do extraordinary things to achieve local business goals.
* **Customer Relationship Development / Prospecting** - Develop and implement relationship management plans for complex potential customer accounts to identify and build relationships with relevant decision-makers and influencers within the customer organization and to enable effective two-way flow of information and resolution of issues.
* **Sales Opportunities Creation** - Develop a personal network within the business sector and represent the organization at business sector events. Obtain market intelligence and enhance the visibility and reputation of the organization, its products, and its services.
* **Sell Customer Propositions** - Configure a complex product-and-services solution and associated contractual terms that meet the customer's mid- to long-term needs, taking input from relevant internal specialists. Present the solution to customer representatives and negotiate agreement within a predefined range of commercial parameters, or, alternately, review sales proposals from team members and authorize those that deviate from standard terms, escalating issues to senior management where appropriate.
* **Promoting Customer Focus** - Develop internal marketing plans and work collaboratively with other departments to improve internal relationships and build strong external customer relationships.
* **Customer Relationship Management (CRM) Data** - Oversee the implementation and maintenance of the CRM system within the area of responsibility, identifying and communicating opportunities for system improvement that may enhance the management of customer relationships.
* **Performance Management** - Manage and report on the performance of a substantial, diverse team; set appropriate performance objectives for direct reports or project/account team members and hold individuals accountable for achieving them; take appropriate corrective action where necessary to ensure the achievement of team/personal objectives.
* **Organizational Capability Building** - Use the organization's formal development framework to identify the team's individual development needs. Plan and implement actions, including continuing professional development specified by professional or regulatory institutions, to build their professional capabilities. Provide informal training or coaching to others throughout the organization in own area of expertise to enable others to improve performance and fulfill personal potential.
* **Policy Development and Implementation** - Develop procedures and interpret and apply policy for area of expertise to achieve specified outputs, or advise the wider business on application of policy, then monitor implementation of those procedures within the organization.
* **Business Planning** - Contribute to the development of annual and longer-term business plans; forecast performance against business key performance indicators (KPIs); develop business cases for key activities/projects; and estimate the financial and human resources required to deliver performance targets.
* **Budgeting** - Develop and/or deliver budget plans with guidance from senior colleagues.
* **Operational Compliance** - Monitor and review performance and behaviors within area of responsibility to identify and resolve noncompliance with the organization's policies and relevant regulatory codes and codes of conduct.
* **Sales** - Sell a range of products and services to significant customers and/or manage a sales team for a given area.
* **Sales Incentives Management** - Oversee the development and management of sales incentive programs across multiple sales teams, aligning incentives with the organization's broader sales strategies.
* **Stakeholder Management** - Develop and implement stakeholder engagement plans for projects to identify relevant stakeholders, to develop positive stakeholder relationships, and to ensure that each stakeholder has an appropriate share of voice.
* **Business Performance Metrics** - Control specific segments of the organization's business performance metrics, ensuring strategic alignment with financial goals and objectives.

  

**Requirements**

* **Experience** : Experience of planning and managing resources to deliver predetermined objectives as specified by more senior managers (Over 3 years to 6 years)
* **Leadership & Strategic Direction** – Proven ability to translate business strategy into priorities and drive commercial results.
* **Customer Relationship Management** – Strong capability to build and manage relationships with senior decision-makers across complex accounts.
* **Sales & Business Development** – Demonstrated expertise in prospecting, market intelligence, networking, and opportunity creation.
* **Solution Selling & Negotiation** – Proven ability to develop tailored solutions and negotiate complex commercial agreements.
* **Team Performance Management** – Strong experience setting objectives, managing performance, coaching teams, and developing capability.
* **Business Planning & Compliance** – Demonstrated ability to manage business plans, budgets, KPIs, policies, and regulatory requirements.
* **Stakeholder Management** – Proven ability to engage and influence internal and external stakeholders effectively.
* **Commercial & CRM Management** – Strong understanding of CRM effectiveness, sales incentives, and commercial performance metrics.
* **Understanding** -Strong understanding of India’s petrochemical, refining, energy, chemical, and associated industrial value chains.

  
  

**We know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:**

* Comprehensive Health Insurance: Covers you, your immediate family, and parents.
* Enhanced Health Insurance Options: Competitive rates negotiated by the company.
* Group Life Insurance: Ensuring financial security for your loved ones.
* Group Accident Insurance: Extra protection for accidental death and permanent disablement.
* Flexible Working Arrangement: Achieve a harmonious work-life balance.
* Employee Assistance Program: Access support for personal and work-related challenges.
* Medical Screening: Your well-being is a top priority.
* Modern Family Benefits: Maternity, paternity, and adoption support.
* Long-Service Awards: Recognizing dedication and commitment.
* New Baby Gift: Celebrating the joy of parenthood.
* Subsidized Meals in Chennai: Enjoy delicious meals at discounted rates.
* Various Paid Time Off: Take time off with Casual Leave, Sick Leave, Privilege Leave, Compassionate Leave, Special Sick Leave, and Gazetted Public Holidays.
* Free Transport pick up and drop from the home -office - home (applies in Chennai)

As the PM, you will define the roadmap and execution strategy for how customers discover, consume, prioritize, and remediate application security risk, while driving ideas to increase product adoption and grow the ASPM business.
  
  
This is a high-impact role at the intersection of Application Security, vulnerability management, and Agentic AI. You will work closely with Engineering and Design to turn ideas into scalable, customer-facing capabilities; validate them with customers; partner with Marketing on go-to-market execution; and work with Sales to drive adoption and business growth.
  
  
**What You’ll Own**

* Define the roadmap, execution plan and success metrics for ASPM.
* Build capabilities that help customers discover, prioritize, and remediate application security risk based on discovery, exploitability, application criticality, and business impact.
* Partner with Engineering and Design and Threat teams to build the intelligence foundation for ASPM, including data ingestion, normalization, correlation, enrichment, scoring, and AI-assisted experiences.
* Engage AppSec leaders, vulnerability managers, DevOps practitioners to uncover customer problems, validate solutions, and shape the ASPM roadmap.
* Shape how ASPM intelligence powers ETM, TruRisk, risk operations, and Agentic AI-driven decision-making.
* Partner with GTM teams on launches, enablement, positioning, and competitive differentiation.

**What Success Looks Like**

* ASPM becomes the application risk intelligence layer for ETM customers.
* Customers cut through application security noise and focus on the exposures that matter most.
* Qualys research and threat intelligence are transformed into scalable, actionable application security insights.
* ASPM drives adoption, expansion, and differentiation for ETM.
* AI and automation accelerate analyst productivity and decision-making without introducing black-box risk.

**Required Experience**

* Minimum 8 years of product management experience, including 5+ years in cybersecurity or enterprise SaaS.
* Experienced in one or more of the following domains: ASPM, API security, Web App Security (SAST, DAST, and SCA), Vulnerability Management
* Ability to work deeply with engineering, threat research, design, and security teams.
* Strong product judgment, customer discovery skills, and ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear customer value.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills for executive, customer, analyst, and internal audiences.
* Ability to learn quickly and keep up with fast changing AppSec domain
* Familiarity with CVE, CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV, MITRE ATT&CK, and related security frameworks.

**Preferred Experience**

* Some knowledge of Agentic AI and AI security would be highly preferred
* Prior hands-on experience as Application Security Analyst or Pen-tester is a big plus

**Why This Role Matters**
ASPM is a critical part of Qualys’ vision for Enterprise TruRisk Management. It brings together application findings, vulnerability management, Qualys research, asset context, and business risk to help customers move from reactive application security to proactive, risk-based Application Security Posture Management.
  
  
This role will help shape how Application Security, Vulnerability Management, AI, and automation come together to power the next generation of Application Security Posture Management.

title: Co-Founder
description:
**Company Description**
Trikonamiti Neural Labs is a deep-tech AI research company focused on precise, zero-error generation of STEM diagrams for visual computing, EdTech, and scientific publishing. The company is building Giyamiti, a neuro-symbolic AI engine that converts raw, hand-drawn sketches into geometrically perfect, scalable, editable SVGs. By combining neural pattern recognition with strict symbolic reasoning, Trikonamiti ensures mathematically faithful, non-hallucinated outputs. Its technology delivers absolute precision, high token efficiency, and is designed to power advanced visual reasoning tools, from one-click STEM diagrams to interactive 3D rendering and visual IDEs. The team is driven by a vision to merge neural perception with mathematical rigor to redefine how scientific visuals are created and used.
  
**Role Description**
The Co-Founder will play a core leadership role in shaping Trikonamiti Neural Labs’ strategy, product roadmap, and go-to-market initiatives. This full-time, hybrid role is based in New Delhi, with flexibility for partial work from home. Day-to-day responsibilities include defining and refining the company’s value proposition, collaborating with technical teams to align research and product features with market needs, and developing partnerships with EdTech platforms, publishers, and enterprise customers. The Co-Founder will lead fundraising and investor relations, drive sales and marketing efforts, and represent the company in conferences, customer meetings, and ecosystem events. This role also involves building and mentoring a multidisciplinary team, setting operational processes, and ensuring the company’s vision translates into scalable, commercially viable products.

* Strong analytical skills and data-driven decision-making capabilities to evaluate markets, product performance, and business models.
* Excellent communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and craft clear narratives for customers and investors.
* Proven experience in sales, with the ability to build relationships, negotiate contracts, and close strategic deals in B2B or SaaS environments.

* Demonstrated leadership skills, including team-building, cross-functional collaboration, and operational execution in an early-stage environment.

title: Associate Director– Private Sector Partnerships
description:
**1. POSITION VACANT: Associate Director– Private Sector Partnerships, Ipas Development Foundation, New Delhi**

**2. ORGANIZATION BACKGROUND:**

**Ipas Development Foundation (IDF)**
has been working in India since 2001 to strengthen the sexual and reproductive health (SRH) ecosystem. In close collaboration with national and state governments, and through partnerships with public health systems and civil society organisations,
**IDF**
works to enhance access to comprehensive abortion care and choice-based contraception.

**IDF’s**
work spans comprehensive abortion care, comprehensive contraceptive care, youth-focused sexual and reproductive health, technical assistance to the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, and research and evidence building. The organisation’s interventions reach over 500,000 women and girls annually, contributing to improved health outcomes and expanded reproductive choice.

**IDF**
has been consistently recognized among India’s
**Best NGOs to Work For**
by the
**Great Place to Work Institute**
since 2017 and has also been honoured as a Social Impact Icon. The organization has featured five times in the prestigious list of
**India’s Great Mid-Size Workplaces**
and has been recognized as one of
**India’s Best Workplaces for Women**
for three consecutive years.

For more information about
**IDF**
, please visit: https://www.ipasdevelopmentfoundation.org/

**3. JOB DESCRIPTION/ RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**IDF**
is seeking to recruit an
**Associate Director– Private Sector Partnerships**
to lead partner and stakeholder engagement for a project on Heavy Menstrual Bleeding (HMB) Care

Heavy menstrual bleeding (HMB) is common but remains under-diagnosed and under-treated. IDF is implementing the HMB Care Program across selected districts of Bihar and Uttar Pradesh.

The incumbent will lead coordination with strategic & technical partners, suppliers and other institutional stakeholders, while supporting provider engagement and monitoring key programme indicators to track progress towards strengthening the private-sector ecosystem for quality HMB care.

The position will report to the
**Chief Program Officer**
and work closely with
**IDF’s**
technical, research and evaluation, communications and state teams.

The role calls for a
**senior, relationship-oriented public health professional**
with the ability to engage credibly with professional associations, healthcare providers, suppliers and technical experts, and effectively coordinate diverse stakeholders to ensure strong partnerships and smooth programme implementation.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**A. Partnerships, Stakeholder Engagement and Technical Collaboration:**

(1) Serve as IDF’s primary senior-level point of contact with project partners at national, state and district levels, building on the existing relationship and engaging with its senior leadership,

(2) Coordinate with technical partners, and implementation partners on the development, review and dissemination of training packages, treatment protocols, job aids, clinical resources and provider communication on HMB management,

(3) Facilitate coordination with professional medical associations at district, state and national levels to support provider engagement, technical sessions, conferences, webinars and other professional forums.

(4) Engage with suppliers (manufacturers and distributors) and other relevant stakeholders on product availability, provider requirements, pricing transparency, training needs and emerging market challenges, while maintaining IDF’s neutrality and adhering to its guidelines on engagement with commercial entities;

(5) Participate in partner meetings and periodic reviews, document key decisions and track agreed actions to closure.

**B. Program Coordination and Implementation Support:**

(1) Translate programme priorities into activity plans, timelines and partner deliverables, and track progress against the internal workplan;

(2) Coordinate with IDF’s technical, research and evaluation, demand-generation and communications teams to ensure alignment across workstreams and timely completion of trainings and other activities;

(3) Work with the Bihar and Uttar Pradesh state teams to support key rollout decisions and the implementation of provider engagement, capacity-building and awareness-generation activities;

(4) Identify implementation bottlenecks and facilitate timely resolution, or escalation to management where required;

(5) Contribute to documentation of implementation experiences, good practices and lessons learned.

**C. Monitoring, Reporting and Learning:**

(1) Monitor agreed programme indicators and milestones relating to partner engagement, provider participation, technical material development, awareness activities, service delivery, referrals, and product availability and pricing, as relevant to the role;

(2) Coordinate with state teams, partners and IDF’s research and evaluation colleagues to obtain timely and reliable programme data;

(3) Review progress against indicators, identify gaps and flag issues requiring management attention or corrective action;

(4) Prepare periodic progress updates, partner review presentations and programme reports;

(5) Contribute to documenting programme learnings and evidence to inform improvements in implementation and potential replication in other geographies.

**4. QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE AND COMPETENCIES:**

**Qualifications:**

A postgraduate degree in public health, health management, social sciences, management or a related discipline.

**Experience:**

(1) At least 10–12 years of experience in public health, healthcare partnerships, private-sector health programmes, healthcare market development or related fields, including substantial responsibility for managing external partnerships and multi-stakeholder initiatives;

(2) Demonstrated experience of engaging professional associations or healthcare provider bodies and networks at a senior level, with tangible outcomes such as jointly developed technical materials, CMEs, conferences or webinars;

(3) Working understanding of women’s and reproductive health, family planning or related clinical service delivery, sufficient to engage credibly with medical professionals. Deep clinical expertise is not required;

(4) Experience of coordinating multiple partners and internal teams, tracking agreed actions to completion and working to a programme workplan and indicators;

(5) Strong report-writing, presentation and documentation skills;

(6) Familiarity with the health systems and private-provider landscape of Bihar and Uttar Pradesh;

(7) Experience of coordinating with government health systems; experience supporting provider capacity-building and technical-material development; exposure to monitoring and evaluation, digital-first demand generation or private-sector health market development.

**Key Competencies:**

(1) Senior stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to build trust with senior medical professionals and commercial partners;

(2) Strong coordination, follow-through and problem-solving skills across multidisciplinary teams and geographies;

(3) Excellent written and verbal communication;

(4) Sound analytical skills and comfort with indicators, data and progress tracking;

(5) Integrity, neutrality and sound judgement in dealings with commercial entities;

(6) Ability to work independently in an early-stage programme and to take decisions in consultation with field teams;

(7) Willingness to travel frequently;

(8) A strong interest in public health and women’s health and commitment to IDF’s mission and values.

**5. IDEAL CANDIDATE:**

The ideal candidate will be a senior, relationship-oriented public health professional with experience of working with professional associations or provider networks, an understanding of women’s and reproductive health, and the discipline to run a multi-partner; multi location programme to defined indicators.

S/he should be able to serve as a dependable senior-level interface with partners, engage with suppliers on market-related issues while safeguarding IDF’s neutrality, and coordinate effectively across IDF’s technical, research and state teams to ensure smooth programme implementation.

The role will suit someone who is comfortable with frequent travel, communicates clearly and credibly with both clinicians and programme teams, and has a genuine interest in IDF’s mission.

**6. COMPENSATION OFFERED:**

The gross compensation budgeted for the position is up to Rs. 25 lacs per annum. The offer made to the selected candidate shall be commensurate with qualifications, experience, and salary history.

**7. LOCATION: New Delhi**

The role requires frequent travel, primarily to Mumbai and programme districts in Bihar and Uttar Pradesh, potentially involving up to 8–10 days of travel per month.

**8. REFERENCE: AD-PSP-IDF**

This role focuses on building strong, trusted relationships and positioning Emerson’s Measurement Solutions portfolio within engineering standards, specifications, and project requirements before procurement begins. You will contribute directly to business growth by influencing project design decisions, strengthening customer partnerships, and enabling innovative, value-driven solutions across industries.
  
  
**In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:**

* Build and sustain strategic relationships with Global Engineering Centers and EPC stakeholders to position Emerson as a preferred partner.
* Drive early engagement in project lifecycles to embed Measurement Solutions products into specifications, standards, and material requisitions.
* Develop and execute structured account plans, including stakeholder mapping, project pipeline tracking, and qualification strategies.

* Lead technical discussions, workshops, and training sessions to build customer capability and strengthen product adoption.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date project and account information in CRM tools to support data-driven decision-making and forecasting.
* Provide insights on market trends, competitive positioning, and customer needs to inform strategy and innovation.
* Monitor and improve key performance indicators, including specification success rate, pipeline growth, and customer engagement outcomes.
* Develop and execute training plans for assigned Global Engineering Center, delivering awareness, application, and advanced technical training tailored to client seniority and discipline mix. Leverage Emerson’s training organization, Application Specialists, and Product Marketing. Position training as a strategic specification and preference tool. Track execution and measure outcomes including specification activity, stakeholder coverage, and client feedback.
* Partner with Global Strategic Account teams to align pursuit strategies, commercial positioning, and stakeholder messaging for shared accounts. Regularly share account and project pipeline updates and support the execution of global approved vendor list qualification, Global Frame Agreement utilization, and licensor engagement activities at the local Global Engineering Center level.

**Who You Are:**
You consistently deliver on commitments by following through on plans with accuracy and attention to detail while maintaining a strong focus on measurable outcomes. You build partnerships and work collaboratively across teams and functions, sharing knowledge and aligning efforts to achieve shared goals. You develop a deep understanding of customer needs and use that insight to create meaningful solutions that drive long-term value. You adapt your approach to identify new opportunities, think creatively, and respond effectively to evolving business and customer requirements.
  
  
**For This Role, You Will Need:**

* A bachelor’s degree in engineering or a relevant technical field (such as instrumentation, electrical, mechanical, or chemical engineering).
* A minimum of 8 years of related experience required; 10+ years preferred.
* Experience in industrial automation, process measurement, or related industries, with exposure to EPC or owner-operator environments.
* Understanding of the project lifecycle, including engineering design, specification development, and procurement processes.
* Experience engaging with engineering teams on technical specifications, vendor qualification, or project pursuit activities.
* Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and deliver engaging presentations or training sessions.
* Familiarity with CRM systems and a data-driven approach to managing pipelines and customer interactions.
* Willingness and ability to travel as part of the role.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and deliver technical training or product capability sessions to engineering audiences, including drafting structured, multi-level training plans.
* Experience engaging or coordinating with strategic or major account management teams on shared accounts including aligning pursuit strategies and sharing structured account intelligence.

**Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart:**

* Experience working with or within EPC organizations or Global Engineering Centers.
* Knowledge of Measurement Solutions technologies (flow, pressure, temperature, level, analytical, or systems) or similar product portfolios.
* Exposure to industries such as oil and gas, petrochemicals, power generation, or industrial manufacturing.

title: VP -Product
description:
**Job Description**
****POSITION DESCRIPTION****
apexanalytix is the world's leading provider of supplier onboarding, risk management and recovery solutions. Founded in 1988 and headquartered in Greensboro, NC, apexanalytix is a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Supplier Risk Management Solutions, recognized for both Completeness of Vision and Ability to Execute. More than 320 of the world's largest companies use our AI-native, Quantum Era-ready platform to protect over $9.5 trillion in annual spend.
  
  
apexanalytix is seeking an experienced Head of Product to own product strategy and execution across apexanalytix's full platform.
  
  
The portfolio spans three connected pillars — supplier onboarding, supplier risk management, and audit and recovery — delivered through a configurable enterprise platform, a self-service data validation and risk API business, and a supplier-facing community platform, with a substantial AI and automation capability underpinning all of them. apexanalytix has also been named Risk Management Company of the Year by SupplyTech Breakthrough and rated the top Supplier Relationship Management and Risk solution by Spend Matters.
  
  
This role sits at the center of the business — translating customer and market needs into a coherent, prioritized roadmap across that portfolio, and holding product managers and cross-functional partners in Engineering, Design and Go-to-Market accountable to it. This is a player-coach role: you'll set direction across the full portfolio while staying close enough to individual product areas to make sharp calls when it matters.
  
  
This role will lead a team of product managers covering apexanalytix's core product lines, working in close collaboration with Engineering, Sales, Customer Success and Marketing to ensure the roadmap reflects both customer value and business priority.
  
  
**The Portfolio**
Supplier management and risk platform. Multi-tenant enterprise SaaS covering supplier registration and onboarding, self-registration and invite flows, document collection and e-signature, validation gates, approval and status workflow, risk scoring and scorecards, segmentation, revalidation, ERP integration, tax and withholding validation, and consent management. This platform is delivered largely through configuration rather than code — dozens of distinct tenant-scoped configurable surfaces mean a significant share of what a client experiences as "the product" is a configuration decision, not a release.
  
  
QubitOn. A product-led, self-service data validation and risk API business with a published price list from a free tier through pay-as-you-go, Pro and Enterprise. Over 70 capabilities spanning data validation, banking and financial verification in 180+ countries, global tax ID and regulatory validation, business intelligence and golden-record matching, compliance and watchlist screening, risk scoring, monitoring and questionnaires — backed by 280M+ verified golden records from 1,000+ sources across 250+ countries. Packaged offerings include BankPro and Registration Essentials, and the platform is also delivered through a self-service developer portal.
  
  
Conductor. The supplier-side platform, serving our clients' suppliers and customers rather than the clients themselves: signup, identity and passkey authentication, invite and onboarding flows, invoice visibility and risk information. This is the second side of a two-sided market, with its own adoption dynamics.
  
  
Cyberrisk. Third-party and supplier cyber risk monitoring, adjacent to the supplier risk and TPRM capability in the core platform.
  
  
Audit, recovery and payment integrity. The accounts payable and contract compliance recovery audit practices — apexanalytix is the largest commercial AP recovery audit firm in the world — and firststrike® Fraud Detect, the duplicate payment prevention product that grew out of our audit algorithms and has run in daily client operations since 2006. A services-plus-software business with a contingency commercial model.
  
  
apexanalytix Learn. Subscription-based training and enablement.
  
  
AI-enabled capability. A significant AI and automation capability — document intelligence, conversational assistants, supplier intelligence, ESG scoring and AI-assisted audit — built and delivered by a separate AI & Automation organization. This role owns what is packaged, positioned and priced from it for clients, and the prioritized demand signal into that organization.
  
  
****Trusted Advisor****

* Leverages deep subject-matter expertise across apexanalytix's product portfolio to advise executive leadership on product strategy and investment trade-offs.
* Acts as the voice of the customer and internal advocate, ensuring insights from enterprise clients (many on the Global 2000) shape the roadmap rather than getting lost between teams.
* Partners with Engineering, Design and Go-to-Market leaders to translate business priorities into a shared, prioritized product roadmap.
* Roles and Requirements
* Owns end-to-end product strategy and roadmap across apexanalytix's core product lines, ensuring alignment with overall company strategy and value-creation priorities.
* Leads, mentors and develops a team of product managers, setting a consistent bar for discovery, prioritization and go-to-market execution across product areas.
* Partners with Engineering leadership to translate roadmap priorities into delivery plans, balancing new feature development against platform investment.
* Owns the commitment-to-delivery discipline: every commitment made to a client, prospect or analyst has a named owner, an entry in the delivery system of record, and a date Engineering has agreed to.
* Owns the configuration-versus-code boundary for the supplier management platform — deciding what becomes a configurable capability, what remains a per-tenant configuration, and what becomes a product feature — and is accountable for the long-run support and upgrade cost of that choice.
* Drives customer discovery and market research to validate product bets, working directly with enterprise customers, Sales and Customer Success.
* Owns the supplier-side product experience as a first-class concern with its own adoption metrics, not as a downstream consequence of client-side decisions.
* Defines and tracks product success metrics — adoption, retention, revenue impact, API consumption and supplier activation — and reports progress to executive leadership.
* Leads pricing and packaging decisions in partnership with Finance and Sales leadership across materially different commercial models: enterprise SaaS subscription, usage-metered self-service API with a published free tier, contingency-based recovery audit services, and subscription-based offerings such as apexanalytix Learn.
* Represents Product in executive reviews and with industry analysts, providing clear, data-driven narratives on roadmap progress and business impact.
* Champions a consistent product management practice — discovery frameworks, roadmap cadence, prioritization criteria — across the team.

**Required Skills**

* 10+ years of product management experience, including 4+ years leading and developing a team of product managers.
* Experience owning product strategy for a B2B enterprise SaaS platform, ideally serving large, complex enterprise customers.
* Direct experience with at least two distinct commercial models — enterprise subscription, usage-metered/API, marketplace or network, or services-attached.
* Experience with a self-service or product-led growth motion, including free-tier design, conversion funnel, usage-based pricing and developer experience.
* Experience with a highly configurable enterprise product, and a clear point of view on where configurability creates leverage and where it creates unmanageable divergence.
* Strong technical fluency — comfortable partnering directly with engineering leadership on architecture and platform trade-offs, even without a hands-on engineering background.
* Proven track record turning customer and market insight into a prioritized, well-communicated roadmap.
* Experience with pricing/packaging strategy and business-case development for new products or product lines.
* Strong executive presence — able to represent Product credibly in front of executive leadership, industry analysts and, as needed, the Board.
* Experience working with a distributed engineering organization across US and India time zones.
* Strong communication skills.

**Preferred**

* Experience in supply chain, procurement, accounts payable, fintech, audit, third-party risk or data/analytics domains.
* Experience with a two-sided or network product where adoption on the non-paying side determines the value of the paying side.
* Experience packaging and pricing AI capability as a product, including the guardrail, assurance and liability considerations that accompany it.
* Experience in regulated or attested environments (SOC 2, FedRAMP) where compliance shapes the roadmap.
* Education Levels/Credentials (Degree types and Emphasis) - Undergraduate degree required; MBA or other graduate business degree a strong plus but not required.

****Location****

* apexanalytix Headquarters (HQ) at Greensboro, NC, USA (hybrid).

****Travel required — occasional, including periodic travel to the Noida, India GCC and to enterprise clients.****
**Scope Boundaries**
****This role owns what gets built and why, for whom, and at what price. Engineering delivery and release execution sit with the VP, Head of Software Development; technical architecture with the Architect; platform strategy and infrastructure investment with the SVP, Global Head of Engineering & Infrastructure; security policy and compliance attestation with the CISO; and AI and automation delivery with a separate AI & Automation organization.****
Over the years, we’ve discovered that the most effective and successful associates at apexanalytix are people who have a specific combination of values, skills, and behaviors that we call “The apex Way”. Read more about The apex Way - https://www.apexanalytix.com/careers/
  
  
**Benefits**
At apexanalytix we know that our associates are the reason behind our successes. We truly value you as an associate and part of our professional family. Our goal is to offer the very best benefits possible to you and your loved ones. When it comes to benefits, whether for yourself or your family the most important aspect is choice. And we get that. apexanalytix offers competitive benefits for the countries that we serve, in addition to our BeWell@apex initiative that encourages employees’ growth in six key wellness areas: Emotional, Physical, Community, Financial, Social, and Intelligence. With resources such as a strong Mentor Program, Internal Training Portal, plus Education, Tuition, and Certification Assistance, we provide tools for our associates to grow and develop.

title: Brand Manager
description:
**Role overview:**

Own a D2C wellness/fitness brand end to end: growth, new products and profitability. Run it like a business, from concept to launch to contribution margin.

**Key responsibilities:**

* **Brand strategy:**
  Own the annual plan (revenue, growth, market share) across website, app, marketplaces and quick commerce; define positioning and decide which SKUs to scale, fix, reprice or discontinue.
* **NPD:**
  Lead launches from consumer insight to go-to-market (concept, formulation brief, pack, pricing) with R&D, sourcing, regulatory and manufacturers; write the business case and decide post-launch to scale, iterate or kill.
* **P&L:**
  Own revenue, gross margin, CAC, CM1/CM2/CM3 and marketing budgets; set pricing and promotions that protect margin; drive COGS reduction; run monthly business reviews.
* **Digital & retention:**
  Brief performance teams on Meta, Google and marketplace ads; own PDPs, listings, ratings and reviews; drive repeat through CRM, subscriptions and loyalty.
* **Cross-functional:**
  Manage creative, influencer and design partners; align with supply chain on forecasting; be the single point of accountability for the brand.

**Requirements:**

* 3–6 years of brand management in
  **D2C wellness, nutrition, supplements or fitness brands**
  (mandatory). FMCG/offline-only, agency, marketplace-seller or non-wellness D2C profiles will not be considered.
* Led at least 2–3 product launches end to end.
* Owned or co-owned a brand/category P&L with hands-on command of CM, CAC, ROAS and LTV.
* Strong knowledge of D2C channels: brand site/app, Amazon, Flipkart, Nykaa, Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart.
* MBA in Marketing from a reputed institute, or equivalent experience.

title: Brand Manager - Infant Formula, Nutrition
description:
**Main Purpose of the Job**

* Build and grow the medical and Consumer Healthcare brands in the portfolio through science-led, consumer-centric brand strategies.
* Lead Healthcare communications and medical outreach so the brands earn trust with consumers and healthcare professionals (HCPs).
* Drive brand performance through strong design communication, effective agency interactions, and close teamwork with Medical, Regulatory and Sales.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Brand planning: Build annual brand plans that fit the business plan. Cover category and brand analysis, consumer and HCP insights, competitor activity and spend effectiveness.
* Medical brand stewardship: Manage the positioning, claims and portfolio strategy for medical brands, keeping all communication scientifically sound and compliant.
* Healthcare communications: Create integrated campaigns across ATL, BTL, digital and point-of-care channels, with clear messages for both consumers and HCPs.
* HEP (Healthcare Engagement Programs): Plan and run HCP engagement programs such as CMEs, scientific detailing aids, conferences, KOL partnerships and doctor education initiatives.
* Medical outreach: Run outreach programs with doctors, nutritionists, pharmacists and clinics to build the brands' presence in prescriptions and recommendations.
* Pharmaceutical channel focus: Work with Sales and Trade Marketing to strengthen visibility, activation and recommendations at chemists and in pharma channels.
* Design communication: Lead creative development for packaging, visual identity, detailing aids, leave-behinds and digital assets. Make sure every touchpoint stays consistent with the brand.
* Agency interactions: Manage creative, medical communication, digital and media agencies end to end, from writing briefs to final delivery and measuring results.
* Cross-functional collaboration: Work with Medical Affairs, Regulatory, Legal and Supply Chain to get claim approvals, compliance sign-off and on-time launches.
* Innovation and renovation: Take new products and renovations from concept to launch, including concept testing, regulatory inputs and launch readiness.
* Performance tracking: Track market share, prescription and recommendation share, brand health, campaign results and PFME/A&P spend, and propose corrective actions.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Education: Post-graduate degree in Business Management (Marketing). A science, pharmacy or life sciences background is an advantage.
* Experience: 2–4 years in brand management within Consumer Healthcare, Pharmaceutical, OTC or Medical Nutrition. Hands-on experience with HCP engagement and healthcare communications is required.
* Capabilities:

+ Strong grasp of marketing fundamentals and P&L basics.
+ Good understanding of healthcare compliance and claims regulations.
+ Strong design sense and skill at briefing and managing agencies.
+ Excellent communication and stakeholder management.

title: Director, Market Reputation
description:
**DIRECTOR, MARKET REPUTATION, INDIA**

Location: Gurugram (New Delhi)

  

**WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK**

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

  

**WHERE YOU’LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM**

This role will lead the development and execution of an integrated India Market Reputation marketing strategy that strengthens Bain’s reputation, amplifies our thought leadership and supports Bain’s growth ambition in India. The strategy will align closely with Bain’s commercial priorities. It will build awareness and consideration of Bain in the highest-value business communities on topics relevant across clients, while reinforcing Bain’s perception as the leading consulting partner to boards and senior executives.

This role will add value by providing guidance to the India Office Head and the leadership team, and act as a strategic partner for senior marketing colleagues across the region. The individual will collaborate with other Marketing functions to achieve Bain firmwide marketing objectives. As part of this role, this individual will coach and develop marketing team members to build expertise and foster a culture of innovation to evolve our India marketing strategy.

  

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

1. Lead the development and execution of the marketing strategy. Define and develop enabling initiatives aligned to firmwide and regional growth priorities, in collaboration with the India Office Head and APAC Market Reputation Lead.

* Focus initiatives on strengthening and growing Bain’s presence in priority practices and themes defined with the Office Head
* Shape a clear view of the optimal mix and sequence of PR, digital, events, and content activities to grow Bain’s commercial visibility and leadership positioning
* Curate, adapt and amplify Bain’s global campaigns for India, while developing high-impact local campaigns that respond to the priorities of the India market
* Proactively collaborate with Practice Marketing, Account Marketing, and other Marketing functions to leverage strategic IP, insights, and assets, and ensure plans are aligned/complementary to achieve firm goals
* Optimize program investment across channels and campaigns throughout the year, phasing spend and reallocating funds as priorities evolve to maximize impact

2. 

Identify, prioritize, and project manage marketing campaigns and supporting activities

* Identify and cultivate the most relevant third-party partnerships, sponsorships, and conferences and events, building a high-caliber ecosystem of relationships with business associations, conference producers and media outlets that keeps Bain at the center of India’s most important business conversations

3. Own, plan and execute Market Reputation Marketing activities to amplify Bain’s presence and client engagement efforts:

* Events: Design and run a full calendar of market reputation events, webinars, and forums, and inform and support Events team efforts in market as needed
* PR & External Communications: In partnership with the regional PR team, manage all local PR activities to establish and grow Bain’s presence in the most influential business media (traditional and digital), manage collaboration with general media, premium publications and local PR agencies as needed.
* Leader visibility: Help frontline leaders build a public profile focused on expertise.
* Editorial: Tailor global content to local community needs, distribute in local market, and manage local agencies and providers
* Alumni: Develop and oversee local alumni segmentation and engagement strategy, including communications and events that complement Market Reputation, Practice and Account efforts

4. 

Develop and execute targeted marketing campaigns linked to strategic Bain IP and growth initiatives

* Design campaign calendars integrating PR, digital and events
* Create and amplify tentpole campaigns around flagship themes and practices (e.g. Applied Tech & AI, Transformation)
* Develop proactive and reactive media strategies, work with global/regional PR team to ensure Bain is top of mind with key local and international media
* Oversee relevance and impact of all digital channels: web content, LinkedIn partner profiles, social media amplification, etc.
* Lead sponsorship and co-branding: identify and negotiate high-value opportunities, manage co-brand partner relationships, and ensure Bain’s brand is represented with impact and consistency across co-branded events, content and campaigns

5. 

Develop and manage the targeting, tracking and engagement of executives in priority accounts

* Work with account heads to map, target, and engage key C-suite executives across top clients, ensuring contact mapping is up to date and that executives are regularly engaged with relevant, value-added marketing
* Proactively manage target lists
* Ensure teams updating the client CRM keep the database up to date
* Develop and update engagement dashboards for reporting to account heads and office leadership

6. 

Manage and coach marketing team members to build capabilities and deliver impact

* Drive skills development across key marketing channels (e.g., PR, digital, campaigns, events)
* Develop and deploy in-house and external resources in support of strategy
* Foster collaboration and ensure consistent use of global systems, technologies, assets, and best practices

7. 

Drive continuous innovation and improvement by identifying new opportunities, from activations and relationships to the evolution of our processes, and by harnessing AI to raise the speed, quality and impact of our work

8. 

Manage the budget and annual planning process

9. 

Manage collection of data on local market intelligence and Market Reputation KPIs, to track impact and report to the Office Head and Market Reputation lead

  

**ABOUT YOU**

Education

* Minimum undergraduate degree, specialization in marketing

Experience

* Minimum 12 years of relevant B2B marketing experience with a good understanding of technology
* Minimum 5 years of team leadership experience, including leading a team of 3-4+ and developing talent
* Professional services marketing experience, or other sectors with technology marketing experience
