title: Project Leader- Healthcare (MedTech)
description:
**ABOUT US:**

 

Bain & Company is a global consulting firm that helps the world’s most ambitious change makers define the future. Across 61 offices in 39 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition and redefine industries. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.

In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. BCN plays a critical role in supporting Bain's case teams globally to help with analytics and research across all industries, for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence or Bain intellectual property.

 

**WHO YOU WILL WORK WITH:**

This is a full-time position based in Bain’s Gurugram office and forms an integral part of the Healthcare & Life Sciences Centre of Expertise (HLS CoE). The HLS CoE provides specialized support to global consulting teams across the healthcare and life sciences value chain, enabling clients to make strategic business and investment decisions. The team partners closely with case teams as a thought-partner, delivering high-quality, industry-specific analytical products and expertise to address the most critical strategic questions facing Bain’s healthcare clients.

The HLS practice serves leading organizations across Pharmaceuticals, MedTech, Providers, Payers, Global Health, and Digital Health. As part of the HLS CoE, you will collaborate with teams across all major regions (EMEA, Americas, and APAC) in a fast-paced, dynamic environment—working closely with global Bain teams to deliver impactful results for our clients.

**Role:**

We are looking for a high performing Project Leader to lead a team of 3-4 members focused on MedTech (Medical Devices, Equipment’s, OEMs, Distribution etc.) as a subsector with HLS. A Project Leader (PL) is responsible for ensuring high quality delivery of projects while building strong client relationships and providing day to day coaching and mentoring to team members. The PL works with his/her team to build direction and work-plan, approach to problem solving, hypothesis generation by leveraging the research toolkit. 

 

In this role, you will lead a team comprising Associates and Analysts to deliver high-impact, client-ready proposals, case specific outputs, and go-to-market materials. You will also support the development of intellectual property (IP), thought leadership, and Bain’s internal capabilities. The role requires strong problem-solving skills, understanding of healthcare landscape, and the ability to manage multiple stakeholders across levels. The PL is also expected to participate in office initiatives such as recruiting, training, and business strategy.

**Key responsibilities**

* Lead a case/ proposal engagement for our MedTech clients
* Collaborate with Partners/case teams to deliver active cases and develop proposals with domain specific insights in a client ready format
* Engage with Practice leadership on evolving IP/existing products; and ideate in developing new products/IP for Healthcare clients
* Build a strong understanding of MedTech IPs and concepts within the team
* Drive structured problem solving and storytelling for client situations and ensure alignment with Bain’s quality standards
* Provide direct, day-to-day management to a group of 3-4 team members with limited guidance from the Manager
* Ensuring timely, high-quality delivery to clients through effective team management; creating hypothesis; defining deliverables and design outputs; drawing the structure and plan; prioritizing and setting daily timelines; reviewing the team’s output, providing feedback and ensuring quality control
* Identify and proactively engage on critical issues on projects and with clients; proactively resolve problems, remove roadblocks, and escalate issues as needed
* Is proficient at identifying and using the relevant analytical tools and ensures zero-defect in all work streams and ensures quality work delivery; Wherever needed, leverages advanced tools (Tableau, Alteryx, Python, R, SPSS) to improve team efficiency
* Foster collaboration with other BCN and global teams to ensure knowledge sharing
* Own and maintain client relationships

1. Understand client needs and situations and adapt to case expectations.
2. Communicate data, knowledge, and clearly explain insights and implications for the client to the entire team; Generate and screen realistic answers based on sound reality checks and recommend actionable solutions.
3. Effectively manage client and team meetings and deliver clear and professional presentations to the team, team leaders and managers/partners across the Bain system.

* Exerts strong positive influence over developing and retaining top talent

1. Develop professional development plans, provide coaching/training, recognize accomplishments of direct reports
2. Provides day-to-day coaching on work-planning, problem solving, hypothesis generation and research toolkit
3. Ability to build connect with the team members through a trust-based relationship at all levels is a must. Acts as a role model and brand ambassador of the Bain culture
4. Constructively engages in mutual feedback process with supervisor and direct reportees; provides concrete, regular and actionable feedback
5. Deliver performance reviews and recommends ratings

**ABOUT YOU:**

**1. Experience & Education**

* Undergraduate degree (bachelor’s in medicine, pharma, Biomedical, Biotechnology engineering or other science/medical related fields) with 5–8 years of relevant experience in a global professional services environment, with exposure to business research, analytics, and consulting in the MedTech/Healthcare domain
* Postgraduate degree (master’s or equivalent) with 3–6 years of relevant experience in MedTech consulting services
* Strong academic track record and demonstrated analytical excellence
* Proven experience in consulting or proposal development, preferably within the Healthcare and Life Sciences domain

 

**2. Leadership & Team Management**

* Demonstrated ability to manage and motivate teams, ensuring consistent delivery of high-quality outputs under tight deadlines
* Maturity to lead by example, balancing attention to detail with effective delegation
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across functions and geographies

 

**3. Core Skills & Personal Attributes**

* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to drive senior client and stakeholder discussions
* Ability to deal with ambiguity and translate open-ended ideas into practical, actionable results
* A strong team player with proven interpersonal skills and the ability to build trusted working relationships
* Proficient in both written and spoken English

 

**4. Domain & Technical Expertise**

* **Deep expertise across the MedTech value chain,**
  including market dynamics, customer segments, regulatory and reimbursement environments, key OEMs, portfolio optimization, and growth and competitive strategy, with a strong end-to-end perspective on the sector
* **Experience leading MedTech strategy engagements,**
  including growth strategy, portfolio rationalization, M&A commercial diligence, and post-merger integration
* **Ability to translate clinical, technical, and regulatory complexity**
  into clear, actionable strategic insights for senior executives
* **Strong understanding of MedTech commercialization and operating models,**
  including pricing, go-to-market design, sales force effectiveness, and lifecycle management
* **Strong analytical, problem-structuring, and project management capabilities,**
  with advanced proficiency in MS Excel and PowerPoint to deliver structured, high-impact outputs

 

**WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK:**

 We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We are currently ranked the #1 consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list, and we have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor's list for the last 12 years. We believe that diversity, inclusion and collaboration is key to building extraordinary teams. We hire people with exceptional talents, abilities and potential, then create an environment where you can become the best version of yourself and thrive both professionally and personally. We are publicly recognized by external parties such as Fortune, Vault, Mogul, Working Mother, Glassdoor and the Human Rights Campaign for being a great place to work for diversity and inclusion, women, LGBTQ and parents.

Co-Founder & Business Head (Enterprise Sales) – GCC Boutique Firm

**Role type:**
Co-Founder (equity-only to begin with) ·

Founder & CEO / Board ·
**Location:**
[Gurgaon / NCR – hybrid, with travel] ·

3 Nov 2026

**Please note upfront: this is an equity-only role to begin with.**
There is no cash salary at the start. Compensation is founder equity, with cash compensation introduced only once the company has funding or sustained revenue (see "What We Offer"). We are looking for someone who is ready to build on that basis.

About the Venture

We are building a boutique firm that helps global enterprises design, set up, scale and run Global Capability Centres (GCCs) in India. Our model combines GCC strategy and advisory, location and entity setup, talent and leadership hiring, Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT) and managed operations, so that a global parent can go from decision to a high-performing India centre fast, with low risk.

We are looking for a Co-Founder to own the commercial engine: the pipeline, the relationships and the revenue.

The Role

As Business Head, you will own go-to-market and enterprise sales end to end. You will open doors with CXOs of global enterprises, shape our offerings and pricing, close the first marquee clients, and build the sales and partnerships function that follows. This is a founding seat: you will help set strategy, culture, hiring and fundraising, not just hit a number.

What You Will Own

**1. Go-to-market and revenue**

* Define target segments (e.g., US, EU, APAC mid-to-large enterprises evaluating or expanding India GCCs), ICP and positioning.
* Build and own the pipeline from first conversation to signed contract; own the revenue plan and forecast.
* Design commercial models: advisory retainers, setup fees, BOT and managed-services pricing, success-linked fees.

**2. Enterprise relationships**

* Build and run senior relationships with CEOs, CFOs, CTOs, CHROs and global GCC/transformation heads.
* Lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and negotiations, including MSAs and SOWs.

**3. Ecosystem and partnerships**

* Build channels with real estate and workspace providers, legal/tax/compliance advisors, staffing and search firms, technology partners, state and city economic development bodies, and industry bodies.
* Create a referral and alliance engine so that pipeline does not depend only on personal networks.

**4. Build the commercial team**

* Hire and lead the first sales, solutions and marketing hires; set targets, playbooks and operating rhythm.
* Establish CRM, reporting and sales governance from day one.

**5. Founding-team leadership**

* Partner with the technical and delivery co-founder(s) on offerings, delivery readiness and client success.
* Contribute to company strategy, investor conversations, brand and thought leadership.

**Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow.**  
  
**For more information, visit** **WPP.com.**

**Role summary:**
=================

The Solution Consultant is a trusted advisor and hands-on solution partner within Professional Services. The role combines solution consulting, business and product analysis, technical understanding, stakeholder management, project management, and disciplined delivery thinking.

Working across agency and client teams, Product, Engineering, Growth, Enablement, Training, Support and delivery colleagues, the consultant discovers needs, shapes requirements, designs and demonstrates solutions, supports scoping and implementation, and feeds learning back into reusable patterns and product improvements.

Success means clients and WPP teams understand what is possible, requirements are clear before delivery starts, proven capabilities are configured appropriately, hand-offs are clean, and repeatable solutions can be deployed with less friction and faster time to value.

**Key responsibilities:**
=========================

**Discovery & requirements:**
-----------------------------

* Lead structured discovery with agency, client and internal stakeholders to understand objectives, users, workflows, data, constraints and expected outcomes.
* Analyse current-state processes, usage and needs, separating problems to solve from requested features.
* Translate needs into clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, solution specifications and, where required, scope inputs for statements of work.
* Identify dependencies, assumptions, risks and gaps early, and ensure the right Product, Engineering, Enterprise Solutions or Professional Services owners are engaged.

**Solution design & consulting:**
---------------------------------

* Map business needs to proven, ready-to-deploy WPP Open capabilities and recommend an appropriate foundation or configured solution.
* Design and present solution options that explain the value, trade-offs, dependencies and delivery implications in language suited to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Create and deliver demonstrations that show how selected WPP Open capabilities address the defined use case.
* Support business-case and value-realisation thinking by linking the proposed solution to measurable client or operational outcomes.

**Technical & platform expertise:**
-----------------------------------

* Build and maintain strong knowledge of WPP Open architecture, capabilities, agents, configuration options, data and integration touchpoints.
* Stay current on platform releases, capabilities and deployment guidance, and distinguish proven, scalable capabilities from functionality still in development or testing.

**Delivery partnership & quality:**
-----------------------------------

* Partner with Project Managers, Product Analysts, Deployment Specialists, Configuration Admins and implementation teams from scope through go-live and handover.
* Ensure solution intent, requirements and acceptance criteria remain traceable through configuration, testing and delivery.
* Support UAT, solution validation and issue resolution, escalating material scope, quality or dependency risks through the appropriate delivery route.
* Contribute to clear handovers into Enablement, Training or Support where those teams own the next stage of adoption.

**Project management & delivery coordination:**
-----------------------------------------------

* Develop and maintain clear delivery plans that define milestones, dependencies, ownership, decision points and critical path activities for assigned engagements.
* Coordinate day-to-day project activity across stakeholders, ensuring actions are tracked, blockers are surfaced early and progress remains visible to the right delivery and leadership audiences.
* Maintain disciplined RAID management, including proactive identification of risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies, with clear mitigation plans and escalation routes.
* Support governance routines such as status reporting, checkpoint reviews, decision logs and delivery readiness assessments, ensuring stakeholders have confidence in progress and next steps.
* Balance speed, scope and quality by making delivery trade-offs explicit, aligning expectations early and ensuring changes are assessed for impact before commitments are made.
* Drive clean closure by confirming acceptance criteria, documenting outcomes, capturing lessons learned and ensuring handover routes are agreed before the engagement is considered complete.

**Scale, product feedback & continuous improvement:**
-----------------------------------------------------

* Convert lessons from engagements into reusable solution patterns, templates, playbooks and configuration standards.
* Provide structured feedback to Product and Engineering on recurring client needs, friction, feature gaps and opportunities for improvement.
* Help standardise intake and scoping so requests arrive with the information needed to route and estimate work accurately.
* Use delivery and usage evidence to identify opportunities to improve solution quality, reduce avoidable effort and accelerate time to value.

**Stakeholder relationships:**
------------------------------

* Act as a credible, pragmatic bridge between business, product and technology stakeholders.
* Build trust through transparent recommendations, clear documentation, realistic commitments and proactive communication.
* Work collaboratively across WPP, maintaining client-team ownership of client relationships while providing the expertise needed to make good solution decisions.

**Skills & experience:**
========================

* 5+ years of experience in solutions consulting, business analysis, product analysis, implementation consulting or a comparable role, ideally within marketing technology or professional services.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capability, with experience turning ambiguous business needs into structured, actionable requirements and solution options.
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation and facilitation skills, including the ability to translate between technical and non-technical audiences.
* Experience working across product, engineering, delivery and commercial stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.
* Working knowledge of Agile delivery and backlog practices, including user stories, acceptance criteria and prioritisation.
* Ability to manage and coordinate the intake of features and change requests, clarifying need, priority, impact and ownership so requests can be translated into actionable outcomes.
* Understanding of digital marketing technology and related cloud, data, integration and workflow concepts.
* Experience with platform implementation, configuration, adoption or service design is advantageous.
* Experience with WPP Open, agent deployment, API integration, data modelling, Jira/Confluence or process-mapping tools
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, make sound trade-offs and maintain high-quality documentation and stakeholder communication.

**Working principles:**
=======================

* Client value first: recommend capability because it improves an outcome, not simply because it exists.
* Deliver what is available: favour proven, ready-to-deploy capabilities and be explicit about anything that is not yet scaled.
* Enable the enablers: design solutions and handovers so administrators, champions and enablement teams can sustain adoption.
* Client teams stay in control: provide expertise behind the scenes while respecting ownership of client conversations and ongoing relationships.

**The person:**
===============

You are curious, structured and commercially aware, with enough technical depth to be credible with engineers and enough empathy and communication skill to make complexity understandable. You are comfortable challenging unclear requirements, bringing the right people together and turning a good bespoke answer into a better repeatable pattern. Above all, you focus on outcomes: dependable delivery that builds trust, scalable ways of working and faster realisation of value from WPP Open.

**Who you are:**

**You're open*****:***we are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

**You're optimistic*****:*** we approach all that we do with confidence: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.

**You're extraordinary:** We are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.

  

**What we'll give you:**

**Passionate, inspired people** – we champion a culture of people that do extraordinary work

**Scale and opportunity** – we offer the opportunity to create, influence and deliver projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.

**Challenging and stimulating work** – unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers.

**We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.**

**WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.**

title: Learning and Development Executive
description:
Job description:

As the **Learning & Development (L&D) Executive**, you will drive the growth, service standard and compliance of our bar and restaurant teams. You will design, implement and evaluate training programs that elevate guest experiences, sharpen hospitality skills and ensure seamless daily operations across front-of-house (FOH) and back-of-house (BOH) staff.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Training Delivery & Design**

· Onboard new hires with a comprehensive introduction to company culture, brand values and service standards.

· Conduct regular workshops on guest relations, suggestive selling, upselling and complaint handling.

· Create standard operating procedures (SOPs) for steps of service, bar/mixology techniques and kitchen workflow.

· Partner with the Beverage Manager and Head Chef to design specialized product knowledge sessions (wine pairings, menu ingredients, allergy awareness).

**Compliance & Safety**

· Ensure 100% compliance with local health, food safety (HACCP/ServSafe) and responsible alcohol service regulations.

· Coordinate mandatory safety training, including fire drills, first aid and workplace safety protocols.

**Performance & Evaluation**

· Conduct mystery shopper audits and floor observations to identify service gaps.

· Build tailored development plans for supervisors, bartenders and floor staff to support internal promotion.

· Track training metrics, completion rates and the overall impact of programs on guest satisfaction scores.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

· **Experience:** 3-5 years of experience in hospitality operations (FOH, bar, or restaurant management), with at least 1 year dedicated to a training or supervisory role.

· **Knowledge:** Deep understanding of restaurant service flows, POS systems, inventory procedures, and food/beverage pairings.

· **Certifications:** Valid certifications in Food Safety and Responsible Alcohol Service are highly preferred.

· **Communication:** Exceptional public speaking, presentation and interpersonal skills.

Pay: ₹30,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Practice Head - Artificial Intelligence
description:
#### **Job Description:**

Flexsin is looking for a strategic and execution-oriented **AI Practice Head** to lead the organization's transformation into an **AI-First Digital Engineering Company**. The role will be responsible for defining AI adoption strategies across software engineering, project delivery, operations, management, sales, marketing, and customer engagements.

The AI Practice Head will establish AI governance, create AI-driven service offerings, identify monetization opportunities, build AI-powered products and accelerators, and drive AI adoption across all departments. The role will also be responsible for helping Flexsin's 100+ active clients leverage AI for business growth, operational efficiency, customer experience, and digital transformation.

The ideal candidate will combine strong technology leadership, business acumen, innovation mindset, and hands-on AI expertise to position Flexsin as a leading AI, digital engineering, and consulting partner.

#### **Responsibilities:**

### **AI Strategy & Transformation:** **- Define and execute Flexsin's AI vision, roadmap, governance, and adoption framework.** * **Drive the company's transformation into an AI-first organization.** **- Establish AI policies, best practices, security, compliance, and ethical AI standards.** **- Evaluate and adopt emerging AI technologies, platforms, and frameworks.**

### **AI-Powered Software Engineering:** * **Define AI usage standards for developers, architects, QA engineers, DevOps engineers, BAs, and project managers.** * **Establish best practices for AI-assisted coding, testing, documentation, code reviews, and DevOps automation.** * **Standardize usage of tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Microsoft Copilot, and other AI development platforms.** * **Create AI-driven delivery playbooks and productivity frameworks.**

### **AI-Driven Operations & Management:** * **Identify opportunities to leverage AI across HR, Finance, Administration, Sales, Customer Success, and Leadership functions.** * **Implement AI solutions to improve operational efficiency, reporting, analytics, forecasting, and decision-making.** * **Develop internal AI assistants and automation workflows for business functions.**

### **AI for Digital Marketing:** **- Define AI adoption strategies for SEO, GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), content marketing, social media, paid campaigns, and lead generation.** * **Create AI-powered workflows for content creation, keyword research, campaign management, audience targeting, and marketing analytics.** * **Improve digital marketing productivity, personalization, and performance through AI initiatives.**

### **Client AI Services & Consulting:** * **Develop AI assessment, consulting, implementation, and managed services offerings.** **-** **Identify AI opportunities across Flexsin's existing client base and new prospects.** * **Lead AI discovery workshops, readiness assessments, use-case identification, PoCs, and implementation strategies.** * **Support pre-sales, solution consulting, proposal creation, and client presentations related to AI initiatives.**

### **AI Products & Accelerators:** **- Identify market opportunities for AI-powered products and platforms.** * **Lead the design and development of reusable AI accelerators, frameworks, and industry solutions.** * **Drive innovation around AI agents, knowledge assistants, estimation tools, proposal automation, CRM intelligence, and other proprietary offerings.** * **Create revenue-generating AI products aligned with Flexsin's service portfolio.**

### **AI Center of Excellence (CoE):** * **Establish and lead Flexsin's AI Center of Excellence.** **- Create AI training, certification, and upskilling programs for employees.** * **Build and mentor a team of AI architects, AI engineers, prompt engineers, data scientists, and AI product specialists.** * **Promote a culture of innovation, experimentation, and continuous learning.**

### **Business Growth & Revenue Ownership:** * **Build AI practice offerings and go-to-market strategies.** **- Drive AI-related revenue growth and account expansion opportunities.** * **Develop strategic partnerships with AI technology vendors and platforms.** **- Define KPIs and measure business impact from AI investments and initiatives.**

**REQUIRED SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS** 
**- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or related field.** 

* **MBA or business management qualification will be an advantage.**
* **12+ years of experience in software engineering, digital transformation, consulting, or technology leadership.**
* **5+ years of hands-on experience in AI, Machine Learning, Generative AI, LLMs, or Intelligent Automation.**
* **Proven experience leading engineering, delivery, or technology consulting teams.**
* **Strong experience in creating service offerings, practice building, and revenue generation.**
* **Strong understanding of Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI, RAG, AI Agents, Prompt Engineering, and AI Automation.**
* **Experience with OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Azure AI, AWS AI/Bedrock, Microsoft Copilot, LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, and MCP ecosystems.**
* **Knowledge of cloud platforms including Microsoft Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud Platform.**
* **Strong understanding of software engineering, DevOps, data engineering, analytics, APIs, and enterprise architecture.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### **Leadership & Business Skills:** * **Ability to define and execute AI adoption strategies at organizational scale.** * **Strong consulting, stakeholder management, and client-facing skills.** * **Experience in building high-performing teams and Centers of Excellence.** * **Excellent communication, presentation, and strategic planning capabilities.** * **Ability to identify business opportunities and convert them into scalable AI solutions.**

### **Preferred Certifications:** **- Microsoft Azure AI Engineer Associate** **- Microsoft Applied Skills for Generative AI** **- AWS Machine Learning Specialty** **- Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer** **- Databricks Generative AI Certifications** **- Relevant OpenAI, Anthropic, or Enterprise AI certifications**

### **Success Metrics:** * **AI adoption across engineering, delivery, operations, and management functions.** * **Productivity improvement across teams through AI-driven workflows.** * **AI-generated revenue from consulting, implementation, and managed services.** * **Number of AI assessments, PoCs, and implementations delivered to clients.** * **Number of AI products, accelerators, and reusable solutions launched.** * **Employee AI certification and upskilling coverage.** * **Contribution toward positioning Flexsin as an AI-First Digital Engineering Company.**

title: National Sales Manager
company: Mahesh Edible Oil Industries Ltd. Kota
description:

We are looking for an experienced National Sales Manager to lead our sales operations across India through both General Trade (distributors, wholesalers, and retailers) and Modern Trade (organized retail chains and e-commerce/quick-commerce platforms). The role is responsible for driving national sales targets, expanding market presence, and building strong distribution and key account relationships.

Key Responsibilities

* Own and achieve national sales targets across GT and MT channels
* Appoint, develop, and manage a distributor network across states, ensuring consistent purchase, payment discipline, and market coverage
* Build and manage relationships with modern trade chains and e-commerce platforms, including product listings, trade terms, margins, and promotional planning
* Lead, mentor, and review the performance of Regional/Area Sales Managers and their teams
* Plan pricing, schemes, and promotional activities in coordination with management and marketing
* Monitor competitor activity, market trends, and pricing to stay competitive
* Ensure timely collections and healthy stock-and-sale cycles with distributors and chains
* Report on sales performance, market expansion, and business growth to senior management

Requirements

* 7-10 years of experience in sales, with at least 3-5 years in a Regional, Zonal, or National leadership role
* Prior experience in edible oil, FMCG food, or related consumer goods industry preferred
* Proven track record in General Trade distributor network management
* Demonstrated experience in Modern Trade / key account management (retail chains, e-commerce)
* Experience leading and developing large sales teams
* Graduate required; MBA/PGDM in Sales & Marketing preferred
* Strong negotiation, leadership, and analytical skills

What We Offer

* A senior leadership role in a growing edible oil manufacturing company

title: Content Manager
description:
**Content Manager**

**Ahmedabad | On-site | 3–4 Years’ Experience**

**We’re not looking for someone to “manage social media.”**

**We’re looking for someone who can make marketing happen.**

**At Hire4Higher Consulting, we work at the intersection of strategy, technology, AI and growth**
. We’re looking for a Content & Growth Marketing Manager who can take an idea, turn it into a sharp piece of content, build a campaign around it—and think about how it ultimately contributes to business.

You’ll have a lot of room to experiment.

And a lot of responsibility to make those experiments count.

**What you’ll own**

**Content**

* Own the content engine across LinkedIn, Instagram, blogs and other relevant channels.
* Turn business insights, industry developments, client conversations and emerging trends into content people actually want to read.
* Write sharp LinkedIn posts, opinion pieces, blogs, campaign narratives and marketing assets.
* Develop thought leadership for the leadership team and the Hire4Higher brand.
* Build content calendars—but don't become a slave to them. If something interesting happens today, we want to talk about it today.

**Marketing**

* Come up with marketing initiatives that can generate
  **attention, conversations and ultimately business.**
* **Conceptualise campaigns instead of simply executing briefs.**
* **Spot opportunities around trends, events, news, AI, technology and business conversations.**
* **Experiment with new channels, formats and ideas to grow reach and generate leads.**
* **Work with designers, video creators and external partners to turn ideas into campaigns.**

**Growth**

* Think beyond likes and impressions.
* Understand which content creates awareness, which creates conversations and which can create opportunities.
* Track what is working, figure out why, and double down.
* Help build marketing systems that can consistently contribute to the sales pipeline.
* Work closely with the founders/business team to identify opportunities where marketing can accelerate growth.

**What we'd like you to bring**

* **3–4 years of hands-on experience**
  in content marketing, digital marketing, social media, brand marketing or growth marketing.
* Excellent writing skills.
  **Really good writing skills.**
  You should know the difference between filling a LinkedIn post and making someone stop scrolling.
* A strong understanding of LinkedIn and how B2B brands can use it beyond corporate announcements.
* The ability to turn complicated business/technology ideas into simple, interesting narratives.
* Curiosity about
  **AI, technology, startups, business, marketing and what makes companies grow.**
* **Strong research skills and the instinct to find the interesting angle in a seemingly ordinary story.**
* **Comfort with analytics and the ability to connect marketing activity to business outcomes.**
* **The ability to work independently, take ownership and move quickly from “we should do this” → “it's live.”**

**You might be a great fit if...**

**You see a brand campaign and immediately think:**

**“Why did they do it this way?”**

**You read a business news story and think:**

**“There’s a LinkedIn post in this.”**

**You see a competitor doing something interesting and think:**

**“How could we do this differently?”**

**And when someone says**
*“we need more leads,”*
your first response isn't:

**“Let's post more.”**

**It's:**

**“What's the problem we're trying to solve?”**

**What this role is NOT**

**This isn't a role where your job is to:**

* Schedule posts all day.
* Copy whatever is trending.
* Chase vanity metrics.
* Wait for someone to hand you a content brief.
* Produce content for the sake of having something to post.

We want someone who can
**create the brief, not just execute it.**

**The opportunity**

**You'll work closely with the leadership team and have the freedom to shape how Hire4Higher shows up in the market.**

**If you're looking for a role where you can build things, experiment, have your ideas challenged, and see your work connect to actual business outcomes, this could be a good fit.**

**Location:**
Ahmedabad — On-site

**Experience:**
3–4 years

title: Head of E-commerce Marketplaces
description:
**Job Description – Head of E-commerce Marketplaces**

**Company:**
Helett Enterprises LLP

**Position:**
Head – E-commerce Marketplaces

**Department:**
Marketplace

**Experience:**
Minimum 6–10 years in E-commerce / Online Retail

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Industry:**
Electronics / E-commerce / Online Retail

**Language:**
English (Mandatory)

**Salary:**
Attractive salary package based on experience, expertise, and current industry standards. Final compensation and benefits will be discussed during the interview.

**1. About the Role**

Helett Enterprises LLP is looking for a highly experienced, strategic, and result-oriented
**Head of E-commerce Marketplaces**
to lead and manage the company's complete online marketplace business.

The candidate will be responsible for overall marketplace strategy, business development, revenue generation, profitability, advertising performance, account management, and team leadership.

This is a senior leadership position requiring strong hands-on expertise in Amazon Marketplace, along with experience managing multiple e-commerce platforms.

The selected candidate will be expected to take complete ownership of marketplace operations, establish business strategies, achieve ambitious revenue targets, improve profit margins, and build a high-performing marketplace team.

**Amazon Marketplace experience is mandatory.**

**2. Key Roles and Core Responsibilities**

**A. Overall Marketplace Business Leadership**

* Take complete ownership of the company's marketplace business, including sales, revenue, profitability, and operational performance.
* Develop and implement short-term and long-term marketplace business strategies.
* Prepare annual, quarterly, monthly, and weekly business plans with measurable targets.
* Establish revenue, sales growth, profitability, and market-share objectives.
* Identify business opportunities, new product categories, and potential marketplace expansion.
* Analyse business performance and take corrective action whenever targets are not achieved.
* Present regular business performance reports and strategic recommendations to management.
* Ensure marketplace operations align with the company's overall business objectives.

**B. Amazon Marketplace – Strategic and Operational Management**

* Independently manage and scale Amazon Seller Central and Vendor Central operations.
* Take responsibility for complete Amazon account management and business performance.
* Manage product listings, catalogue creation, variation listings, A+ Content, Brand Store, and product information.
* Develop strategies to improve product ranking, organic visibility, conversion rates, and Buy Box performance.
* Manage Amazon PPC campaigns, Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display advertisements.
* Plan and optimise advertising budgets to achieve profitable ROAS and ACOS targets.
* Monitor account health, policy violations, customer feedback, returns, cancellations, and operational issues.
* Develop strategies to improve product reviews, ratings, customer experience, and listing quality.
* Manage Amazon FBA, FBM, inventory replenishment, and fulfilment-related coordination.
* Monitor stock availability and coordinate with inventory and supply chain teams to avoid stockouts and excess inventory.
* Handle Amazon account escalations, policy compliance, and performance-related issues.
* Analyse competitor pricing, market trends, keywords, and product performance.
* Identify opportunities to improve sales velocity and marketplace profitability.

**C. Other E-commerce Platform Management**

* Lead and grow the company's business across Flipkart, Shopify, and other relevant e-commerce platforms.
* Develop individual growth strategies for each marketplace.
* Manage platform-specific product listings, catalogues, pricing, promotions, and advertising.
* Monitor sales performance, customer experience, returns, and operational efficiency across platforms.
* Explore new online sales channels and marketplace opportunities.
* Ensure consistent product information, brand positioning, and pricing strategies across platforms.
* Improve website traffic, conversion rates, customer retention, and direct online sales through Shopify.

**D. Sales, Revenue and Profitability Management**

* Take direct responsibility for achieving monthly, quarterly, and annual marketplace revenue targets.
* Develop strategies to increase sales volume, average order value, and product-level profitability.
* Monitor gross revenue, net sales, contribution margins, marketplace fees, logistics costs, and advertising expenses.
* Analyse product-wise and platform-wise profitability.
* Identify low-performing products and implement corrective strategies.
* Develop pricing and discount strategies without compromising profit margins.
* Prepare revenue forecasts and business projections.
* Identify opportunities to increase organic sales and reduce dependency on paid advertising.
* Ensure sustainable business growth rather than focusing only on revenue numbers.

**E. Advertising, Marketing and Brand Growth**

* Lead marketplace advertising and performance marketing strategies.
* Plan and manage PPC campaigns, sponsored advertisements, promotional campaigns, and seasonal sales.
* Set advertising budgets and monitor campaign performance.
* Improve ROAS, ACOS, TACOS, CTR, CPC, and conversion rates.
* Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and search-term optimisation.
* Work closely with the design and content teams to improve product images, videos, A+ Content, and listing quality.
* Develop strategies for product launches and new product marketing.
* Monitor campaign effectiveness and ensure marketing expenditure generates measurable business results.

**F. Product Launch and Business Expansion**

* Identify new product opportunities based on market demand, competitor analysis, and sales trends.
* Coordinate with product development, sourcing, procurement, and QC teams for new product launches.
* Prepare product launch plans, pricing strategies, advertising plans, and sales forecasts.
* Monitor new product performance during the initial launch period.
* Develop strategies for product portfolio expansion.
* Coordinate with management on international marketplace expansion and new business opportunities.

**G. Inventory, Supply Chain and Operations Coordination**

* Work closely with Inventory, Warehouse, QC, Finance, and Supply Chain departments.
* Prepare marketplace inventory forecasts based on sales trends and future demand.
* Ensure timely replenishment of Amazon fulfilment centres and other marketplace warehouses.
* Monitor stock ageing, slow-moving products, excess inventory, and stockout risks.
* Coordinate shipment planning with inventory and QC teams.
* Ensure products are properly inspected and ready before marketplace shipment.
* Monitor fulfilment performance, delivery issues, cancellations, and return rates.
* Develop operational processes to improve marketplace efficiency.

**H. Team Leadership and Performance Management**

* Lead, manage, and develop the complete marketplace team.
* Allocate responsibilities and establish clear departmental reporting structures.
* Set individual and team KPIs, targets, and performance expectations.
* Conduct regular performance reviews and ensure accountability.
* Identify training requirements and improve the team's technical and operational capabilities.
* Recruit and develop skilled marketplace professionals.
* Ensure coordination between Marketplace, Finance, Design, Inventory, QC, Customer Service, and Operations.
* Build a performance-driven culture focused on business results and continuous improvement.

**I. Reporting, Analysis and Management Review**

* Prepare daily, weekly, monthly, and quarterly marketplace performance reports.
* Monitor revenue, sales growth, profit margins, advertising expenditure, ROAS, ACOS, TACOS, and conversion rates.
* Prepare platform-wise, product-wise, and category-wise performance analysis.
* Identify gaps between targets and actual achievements.
* Present business performance, challenges, opportunities, and action plans to management.
* Develop data-driven recommendations for improving business performance.
* Maintain transparency and accuracy in all marketplace reporting.

**3. Mandatory Skills and Qualifications**

* Minimum 6–10 years of relevant experience in e-commerce and online marketplace management.
* Strong hands-on experience with Amazon Seller Central is mandatory.
* Experience in Amazon Vendor Central is highly preferred.
* Proven track record of independently managing and scaling marketplace businesses.
* Strong knowledge of Amazon PPC, advertising optimisation, SEO, catalogue management, and account health.
* Experience managing Flipkart, Shopify, and other e-commerce platforms.
* Strong understanding of revenue management, business profitability, pricing, and advertising ROI.
* Experience leading and managing marketplace teams.
* Excellent analytical, strategic planning, and decision-making capabilities.
* Strong knowledge of Excel, business analytics, reporting, and marketplace performance tools.
* Ability to work with management and independently take ownership of business targets.
* Excellent English communication and presentation skills.

**4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

The performance of the Head – E-commerce Marketplaces will be evaluated based on measurable business results, including:

1. **Revenue Achievement:**
   Achievement of monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets.
2. **Profitability:**
   Improvement in net contribution and product-level profit margins.
3. **Marketplace Growth:**
   Growth across Amazon, Flipkart, Shopify, and other platforms.
4. **Advertising Efficiency:**
   Improvement in ROAS, ACOS, TACOS, and advertising ROI.
5. **Organic Sales Growth:**
   Improvement in organic revenue and product rankings.
6. **Inventory Management:**
   Reduction in stockouts, excess stock, and inventory ageing.
7. **Product Launch Performance:**
   Successful launch and growth of new products.
8. **Account Health:**
   Maintaining healthy marketplace accounts and policy compliance.
9. **Team Performance:**
   Achievement of departmental and individual employee KPIs.
10. **Business Reporting:**
    Accurate reporting, forecasting, and timely management reviews.

title: Next Frontier Impact and Value Realization
description:

**Position Summary:**
The Assistant Director – Next Frontier Impact & Value Realization will lead the measurement, reporting and communication of Next Frontier's business impact across innovation investments, commercialization activities and emerging technology initiatives.
  
  
The role will establish clear frameworks, metrics and reporting mechanisms that demonstrate the value generated through Next Frontier activities, including client impact, adoption, commercialization outcomes, pipeline influence and market differentiation. The individual will work closely with Next Frontier leadership, service lines, sectors, alliances, EY.ai Labs and client-serving teams to identify, validate and showcase high-impact outcomes.
  
  
The role requires strong analytical, storytelling and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex innovation activities into clear business value narratives and executive-level insights.

* Lead the measurement, reporting and communication of Next Frontier impact across clients, sectors, service lines, super regions, alliances and EY.ai Labs activities.

* Develop executive-level reporting and insights that provide visibility into adoption, commercialization performance, pipeline influence, client outcomes and business value realized.

* Partner with account teams, sectors, service lines and innovation leaders to identify and validate high-impact client outcomes and commercialization successes.
* Build and maintain a centralized repository of client success stories, credentials, awards, metrics and reusable proof points.
* Analyze performance trends and develop recommendations to improve adoption, commercialization effectiveness and business impact.
* Translate quantitative and qualitative evidence into concise, outcome-focused narratives for leadership communications and strategic growth initiatives.
* Support strategic reviews, business planning activities and investment discussions by providing evidence-based performance insights.

**Impact Measurement & Performance Analytics:**

* Establish performance measures and value realization frameworks for Next Frontier initiatives and investments.
* Track adoption, engagement, commercialization outcomes and business impact across the portfolio.
* Develop dashboards and analytical reporting that provide timely and actionable insights for leadership.
* Monitor trends and identify opportunities to improve commercial outcomes and innovation adoption.
* Ensure consistency and accuracy of reporting methodologies and performance metrics.

**Strategic Storytelling & Communications:**

* Develop executive-ready narratives that clearly communicate the impact and value created by Next Frontier initiatives.
* Create leadership presentations, impact reports and strategic briefings for internal and external stakeholders.
* Develop award submissions, credentials, case studies and success stories based on validated outcomes.
* Translate complex innovation and emerging technology activities into compelling business-focused messaging.
* Support strategic campaigns and growth initiatives through evidence-based value narratives.

**Stakeholder Collaboration & Portfolio Support:**

* Build relationships across service lines, sectors, alliances, regions and innovation teams to gather impact data and success stories.
* Collaborate with leadership teams to define reporting priorities and strategic measures of success.
* Coordinate cross-functional efforts to identify and validate client outcomes and commercialization achievements.
* Support Next Frontier leadership with performance reviews, portfolio reporting and business planning activities.
* Drive continuous improvement of reporting processes, repositories and knowledge management assets.

**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**

* Strong understanding of innovation, emerging technologies and commercialization activities, with the ability to articulate their business value.
* Exceptional business writing, storytelling and executive communication skills.
* Experience developing executive presentations, credentials, case studies, award submissions and leadership reporting.
* Strong analytical capabilities with experience defining KPIs, performance measures and value realization frameworks.
* Ability to synthesize quantitative and qualitative information into actionable business insights.
* Experience developing dashboards and analytical reporting using tools such as Power BI and Excel.
* Strong programme and stakeholder management capabilities across complex, matrixed environments.
* Ability to independently manage multiple strategic initiatives and deliver high-quality outputs with minimal supervision.
* Strong collaboration and relationship-building skills across global teams and senior stakeholders.
* Ability to coach and guide analysts or junior team members supporting reporting and analysis activities.

**Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Analytics, Strategy, Finance, Technology, Engineering or a related discipline.
* 8–12 years of relevant experience in one or more of the following areas:
* Impact measurement and value realization
* Business performance management and reporting
* Strategic planning and business operations
* Executive communications and business storytelling
* Commercialization and go-to-market programs
* Innovation, emerging technology or transformation initiatives
* Consulting or professional services environments

**Additional experience preferred:**

* Experience building executive dashboards, reporting frameworks and performance management processes.
* Experience developing client success stories, credentials, case studies and growth-supporting content.
* Demonstrated success leading cross-functional initiatives and influencing diverse stakeholder groups.
* Experience collaborating with senior leaders and geographically distributed teams.
* Familiarity with emerging technology portfolios including Generative AI, Physical AI, Quantum Computing or related innovation domains.
* Experience within a professional services or consulting environment is highly desirable.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys operating at the intersection of innovation, technology, alliances and business growth.

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**

**Lead Solution Development and Portfolio Management**

You will play a central role in managing solution roadmaps and supporting teams throughout the development and commercialization lifecycle, ensuring alignment with strategic alliance priorities and measurable business outcomes.

  

**Key responsibilities include:**

* Manage solution roadmaps and ensure alignment with Microsoft Alliance strategic priorities.
* Support solution teams throughout the development, readiness and commercialization lifecycle.
* Drive governance processes that enable visibility, accountability, prioritization and decision-making.
* Track portfolio performance, progress against milestones, risks, dependencies and business outcomes.
* Help identify opportunities for investment, prioritization, acceleration and solution expansion.
* Success in this area means translating promising ideas into scalable solutions that create measurable value for EY, Microsoft and clients.

  

**Drive Cross-Functional Collaboration**

The Solution Manager acts as a connector across teams, helping align priorities, manage dependencies and maintain momentum across a complex global stakeholder network.

You will:

* Partner with Global Alliance leaders, Service Line leaders, Industry teams and Microsoft stakeholders.
* Facilitate alignment between business, technology, sales, delivery, alliance and marketing teams.
* Coordinate solution review sessions, governance forums, working groups and leadership updates.
* Proactively identify risks, dependencies and opportunities for collaboration.
* Build trusted relationships across a global, matrixed stakeholder environment.

  

**Support Innovation and Frontier Innovation Programs**

**You will:**

* Help facilitate ideation workshops, solution incubation activities and Frontier Innovation planning sessions.
* Support proof-of-concept initiatives, pilot programs and Client Zero engagements.
* Work with subject matter professionals to evaluate business cases, solution viability and market relevance.
* Help accelerate the transition from concept to market-ready offering.
* Contribute to the continuous evolution of EY’s Frontier Innovation operating model.

  

This role provides exposure to emerging technologies, including AI, cloud platforms, automation and next-generation business solutions.

  

**Enable Go-To-Market Success**

Developing strong solutions is only part of the journey; enabling market activation, adoption and measurable growth is equally important.

  

**You will:**

* Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Alliance teams and Solution Owners on activation plans.
* Coordinate development of solution collateral, demos, case studies, enablement content and marketplace assets.
* Support readiness and enablement activities for client-facing and business development teams.
* Track adoption, pipeline contribution, commercialization progress and related performance metrics.
* Contribute to co-sell initiatives and strategic growth programs with Microsoft.

  

**Deliver Insight Through Governance and Reporting**

**Responsibilities include:**

* Prepare executive reporting, leadership updates and portfolio dashboards.
* Monitor key metrics related to solution maturity, activation, adoption, funding and business impact.
* Support business reviews, governance meetings and leadership decision forums.
* Maintain reporting accuracy, governance discipline and compliance with agreed operating standards.
* Provide insights and recommendations that support prioritization, investment decisions and strategic growth.

  

**Skills and Attributes for Success**

We are looking for someone who brings a balance of strategic thinking, execution excellence, and relationship-building capabilities.

* Thrive in fast-paced, evolving and ambiguous environments.
* Enjoy turning ideas into tangible plans, outputs and measurable outcomes.
* Are comfortable managing multiple priorities, deadlines and stakeholder groups in parallel.
* Can influence outcomes without direct authority.
* Have a passion for innovation, technology, alliances and business transformation.
* Bring strong organizational, communication, governance and program management skills.
* Have a continuous improvement mindset, with a focus on simplifying, automating and scaling ways of working.

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 15+ years of relevant professional experience.
* Experience in program management, product management, solution management, consulting, technology transformation, innovation management or alliances.
* Proven experience working across complex, global and matrixed stakeholder environments.
* Strong communication, governance, project management and executive reporting capabilities.
* Experience coordinating cross-functional initiatives with clear outcomes, measurable impact and disciplined follow-through.

  

**What we look for**

* We are looking for individuals who are curious, collaborative and passionate about innovation. The ideal candidate is someone who enjoys connecting strategy with execution, can navigate ambiguity and is energized by working with diverse teams to create meaningful business outcomes.
* This role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to one of EY’s most important alliance ecosystems while helping shape innovative solutions that drive growth, transformation and long-term client value.

  

**What we offer**

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic global delivery network that plays a vital role in advancing EY’s growth strategy. Working across locations including Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK, GDS teams collaborate with EY service lines, geographies and sectors to deliver high-quality work for clients around the world. In GDS, you will have the opportunity to contribute to meaningful projects, collaborate with diverse teams and build capabilities across an expanding ecosystem of people, learning, technology and insights that support long-term career growth.

* **Continuous learning:** Develop the mindset, skills and confidence to adapt, grow and navigate what comes next.
* **Success, as defined by you:** Access the tools, flexibility and support to make a meaningful impact in the way that works best for you.
* **Transformative leadership:** Gain insights, coaching and experiences that help you grow into the leader the world needs.
* **Diverse and inclusive culture:** Be valued for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Senior Talent Acquisition Partner
description:
Vymo transforms how financial institutions manage their distribution networks and collections operations. Our AI-powered DMS and CMS platform serves 350,000+ users across 70+ global financial enterprises, enabling banks and insurers to optimize performance across their distribution channels, and empowering banks to drive operational excellence in collections.

**Why Global Leaders Choose Vymo**

Vymo partners with financial institutions through a comprehensive solution that combines deep domain expertise with cutting-edge technology. Our platform's human-centric design, coupled with enterprise-grade scalability and AI-powered intelligence, delivers measurable business outcomes while ensuring high user adoption and engagement.

**Recognition & Trust**

● Backed by $45M+ funding from Peak XV partners (formerly Sequoia), Emergence Capital, and Bertelsmann Investments.

● Trusted by leading global financial institutions including Berkshire Hathaway, AIA, AXA, SBI Life, HDFC Bank, Aditya Birla Capital, Tata AIA, ABSLI and many more!

● Recognized by Celent in their 2024 Distribution Management Solutions report, with an Advanced Functionality ranking.

● Featured in Gartner's Market Guide for Sales Engagement Applications and recognized as a

"Strong Performer" in Forrester's Sales Engagement Wave Report.

● Microsoft 'AI for All' award winner for innovation in artificial intelligence

**The Role**

We are looking for a high-agency
**Senior Talent Acquisition Partner**
who treats recruitment as strategic problem-solving.

In an AI first world, finding true talent requires moving beyond surface-level keywords. You understand how AI tools can amplify sourcing efficiency, but more importantly,
**you know how to cut through synthetic AI noise to identify rare, unscripted original thinking, authentic grit, and high-agency execution.**

You will partner directly with function heads to define success, leverage cutting-edge AI tools for deep talent mapping, guide candidates through high-conviction conversations, and protect Vymo's talent bar.

**What You Will Do**

**Search Design & Deep Intake**

* **Define Core Competencies:**
  Partner with hiring managers to set role expectations, 6-month deliverables, and firm vs. flexible requirements.
* **Filter Synthetic Applications:**
  Build intake strategies that test for unscripted problem-solving and original thinking rather than AI-polished resumes.

**AI-Leveraged Sourcing & Execution**

* **Scale Sourcing with AI:**
  Use AI talent tools and automated workflows to map target talent pools quickly, freeing up time for deep candidate evaluation.
* **Close Complex Roles:**
  Personally headhunt and close Vymo’s most critical, niche, and hard-to-fill positions.

**Evaluation & Hiring Bar Calibration**

* **Evaluate Original Thinking:**
  Design interview rubrics that test live adaptability and first-principles reasoning to separate real skill from AI-assisted submissions.
* **Ensure 90-Day Quality:**
  Track new hire performance through their first 90 days to refine interview evaluations and continuously raise the hiring bar.

**Talent Mapping & Proactive Pipelines**

* **Build High-Conviction Pools:**
  Identify top passive talent across target companies and build warm pipelines before roles open.

**Compensation Advisory & Closing**

* **Structure Winning Offers:**
  Guide hiring managers on market rates and equity structures to close top candidates and minimize counter-offers.

**Process Improvement & Playbooks**

* **Standardize Workflows:**
  Build assessment rubrics and train interviewers to evaluate raw talent, high agency, and cognitive agility.

**What You Will Bring**

**Experience and Fluency**

* **6+ Years Recruiting Experience:**
  Proven track record in B2B SaaS, tech, or fintech recruiting, with experience in agency and in-house roles.
* **AI Tooling & ATS Mastery:**
  Hands-on experience using AI sourcing tools, LinkedIn Recruiter, and ATS platforms like Greenhouse or Lever.
* **AI-First Sourcing & Filtering Mastery:**
  Deep proficiency with AI-driven talent discovery tools, automated outreach sequencing, and search automation to maximize productivity while maintaining personal, high-touch candidate engagement.
* **Niche Role Closures:**
  Demonstrated success sourcing and closing complex technical and business roles.
* **Negotiation & Closing:**
  Strong communication skills with experience handling complex offer negotiations and counter-offers.

**Mindset and Core Traits**

* **Signal-over-Noise Screening:**
  Ability to look past AI-formatted resumes and evaluate authentic problem-solving depth and individual contribution.
* **High Agency:**
  Proactive self-starter who identifies pipeline bottlenecks early and creates solutions without waiting for direction.
* **Pursuit of Original Thinking:**
  Values authenticity, intellectual curiosity, and raw execution power over polished corporate fluff.
* **Resilience & Grit:**
  Treats changing requirements and competitive talent markets as engaging puzzles to solve.
* **Talent Spokesperson:**
  Articulates Vymo’s mission and culture with genuine conviction to inspire top passive talent.

title: Talent Acquisition Partner - GTM
description:
Gushwork is building an Agent Operating System for small and mid-sized businesses around the world. It is modern business software where AI agents and humans work together. Business owners and leaders set the goals. They decide what each agent is allowed to do. Then they review the metric each agent delivers.
  
  
We started with an SEO agent. It owns one metric: organic leads. Once it ranks pages and brings in leads, it reports them back to the customer. We are now expanding into a Paid Ads agent and a Developer agent, each owning a metric the business cares about.
  
  
Our customers sell high-value goods and services and have fewer than 200 employees. Most of them are in industries that are not digitally native: manufacturers, industrial distributors, commercial services. They do not buy AI. They buy outcomes. Our job is to make agents reliable enough that a business owner can trust them with a number.
  
  
We are a team of about 90 people based in Bengaluru, backed by Lightspeed and SIG. If you want to help us build reliable agents that run real businesses , we would like to talk.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a proactive, execution-driven Talent Acquisition Partner to lead and own the full recruitment lifecycle across Gushwork. In this hands-on role, you will work closely with executive leadership, and hiring managers to define hiring strategies, build high-performing candidate pipelines, evaluate top talent, and close key offers.
  
  
Unlike traditional recruitment roles that are restricted to a single hiring silo, this position offers cross-functional breadth across technical, product, and business/GTM roles. As an early member of our talent team, you will leverage cutting-edge AI recruiting tools and recruitment analytics to drive speed, quality, and operational excellence while actively influencing company-wide hiring standards.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own end-to-end talent acquisition across all functions, driving candidates from initial outreach through offer rollout and seamless onboarding handoff.
* Leverage LinkedIn Recruiter, Naukri, specialized job boards, and creative/unconventional sourcing channels to map and engage top-tier passive candidates
* Partner closely with hiring managers and leadership to understand business needs, draft compelling position descriptions, and define targeted sourcing strategies.
* Oversee end-to-end interview scheduling,feedback collection, and candidate communication to deliver a good candidate experience.
* Lead compensation structuring, offer negotiations, and closing strategies to achieve high offer acceptance rates
* Actively integrate modern AI platforms and workflows into daily recruitment tasks to accelerate sourcing, candidate evaluation, role research, and operational output.
* Maintain meticulous pipeline hygiene and real-time updates within the Applicant Tracking System (ATS).
* Contribute to foundational talent initiatives, including employer branding campaigns, referral program design.
* Continuously refine internal hiring frameworks, rubric designs, and interviewing guidelines as Gushwork scales.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 3+ years of core recruitment experience, ideally within fast-growing software, SaaS, or high-tech product companies.
* Deep hands-on expertise using LinkedIn Recruiter, Naukri, GitHub, and other modern sourcing platforms.
* Hands-on experience administering modern Applicant Tracking Systems (e.g., Lever, Greenhouse or similar).
* Passionate about adopting AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude) to optimize recruitment workflows and boost hiring efficiency.
* Solid proficiency in Google Sheets for pipeline tracking, metrics reporting, and funnel analysis.
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with strong stakeholder management and negotiation capabilities.
* High agency, bias for action, and comfort managing high-volume, multi-disciplinary hiring in a dynamic startup setup.
* Prior experience hiring across Go-To-Market (GTM) functions such as Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Business Development.
* Exposure to building recruitment operations, interview rubrics, or employer branding from early stages.

**Why Join Gushwork?**

* You'll be part of an early team at a fast-growing company, with a lot of impact
* You'll get to work with really smart and helpful people
* We constantly adopt the latest technologies and stay close to the latest ai innovations
* Opportunity to influence the direction of the product and engineering culture
* Flexible PTO policy
* Unlimited ai usage
* Plus cool swag, a stocked pantry, and other benefits

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: VP Campus Recruiter
description:
**About the Role**

Our client, a leading global financial institution, is looking for two Vice President-level Campus Recruiters to own and evolve its early-careers hiring in India. One role will lead technology and engineering campus hiring; the other will lead non-technology (business, finance, operations and risk) campus hiring.

The firm expects every new hire to raise the benchmark, not simply add capacity. Campus hiring is therefore about fewer, sharper, more deliberate decisions: defining the right campuses, attracting the strongest talent from premier institutes, and running an assessment process that tests real depth rather than polished CVs. The role sits at the intersection of talent strategy, technical understanding and stakeholder influence, with AI embedded in how the work gets done.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the end-to-end campus hiring strategy and calendar for your track (technology or non-technology), from campus selection through offer and onboarding.
* Define and continuously refine the campus portfolio, using data and AI-enabled tools to decide which institutes, programmes and talent pools deliver the best quality and conversion.
* Build and sustain relationships with placement cells, faculty, alumni and student communities at premier engineering and management institutes (IITs, IIMs and comparable institutions).
* Lead employer branding and campus marketing, using AI tools and well-crafted prompts to create targeted, high-quality outreach, content and engagement campaigns.
* Partner with hiring managers and senior business and engineering leaders to understand role requirements in depth, challenge assumptions, and negotiate priorities.
* Design and run rigorous selection processes, including case, technical and AI-capability assessments, in collaboration with business interviewers.
* Assess candidates on practical ability, problem-solving, project ownership and potential, and on their willingness to adopt and apply AI in real work.
* Manage internship-to-full-time conversion, offer strategy, candidate engagement and drop-off reduction.
* Use the ATS and recruitment analytics to track funnel health, diversity, cost and quality of hire, and report insights to leadership.
* Coach and guide junior recruiters and coordinators, and work closely with HR, diversity and external partners.
* Pilot and scale new ways of working, including AI-led screening support, workshops, prompting exercises and hackathon-style engagement events.

**Requirements**

* 7–12 years of recruitment experience, with significant ownership of campus or early-careers hiring in India.
* Proven track record of hiring from IITs, IIMs and other top-tier institutes. Experience in financial services or global technology and banking environments is strongly preferred.
* Hands-on familiarity with AI tools in recruitment (sourcing, screening, content, analytics) and the ability to speak concretely about practical use cases, limitations and failures.
* Experience working with an enterprise ATS and recruitment technology stack.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, and a hands-on, ownership-driven working style.

If this sounds like you, please click apply or drop a note on aditisidana@aquissearch.com for a confidential chat.

* Interact with CXOs, Business Heads, HR Heads and senior management stakeholders.

* Provide regular search progress updates and market feedback.
* Manage interview coordination, feedback follow-ups and candidate engagement through the selection process.
