title: Human Resources Manager
description:
HR Manager – Recruitment, Team Building & HR Operations

**Alkara Water Solutions Private Limited | Kokapet, Hyderabad**

About Alkara

Alkara Water Solutions Private Limited is a manufacturer of water conditioners, descalers and advanced water treatment solutions, serving residential, commercial and industrial customers.

As part of our continued growth, we are strengthening our Hyderabad operations and looking for an experienced HR Manager who can take ownership of building and managing our team.

Role Overview

We are looking for a hands-on HR professional who can lead recruitment, team development and HR systems for our Hyderabad operations. The person will work closely with the Directors to identify manpower requirements, recruit the right people, establish company policies and systems, and ensure employees are accountable for their responsibilities and performance.

This role involves more than routine HR administration. The candidate should be capable of taking ownership of recruitment, team development and day-to-day HR operations as the company expands.

**Reporting to:**
Directors

Key Responsibilities

**1. Recruitment & Team Building**

* Take responsibility for building and expanding the Hyderabad team.
* Work closely with the Directors to understand business requirements and prepare hiring plans for different departments.
* Handle end-to-end recruitment for sales, marketing, service, technical, operations and support positions.
* Create and publish job advertisements on LinkedIn, Naukri and other recruitment platforms.
* Actively source candidates through job portals, referrals, recruitment agencies and professional networks.
* Shortlist candidates, coordinate interviews, conduct initial HR discussions and manage salary negotiations and offer letters.
* Recruit managers, team leaders, field sales executives, technical staff and support employees.
* Build a continuous pipeline of suitable candidates to meet the company's growing manpower requirements.
* Track recruitment timelines, hiring costs and joining ratios to ensure hiring targets are met.

**2. HR Policies, Systems & Administration**

* Establish HR policies, company rules and employee guidelines in consultation with the Directors.
* Set up proper systems for attendance, working hours, leave, employee conduct, reporting and performance management.
* Handle employee onboarding, documentation, payroll coordination and HR records.
* Ensure employees understand company policies and follow the required procedures.
* Maintain compliance with applicable labour laws and statutory requirements.
* Handle employee concerns, disciplinary matters and workplace issues.

**3. Employee Performance & Management**

* Work with department heads and the Directors to establish clear roles, responsibilities and performance targets for employees.
* Implement a structured system to review employee performance on a regular basis.
* Coordinate monthly performance reviews and track department-wise and individual performance.
* Work with the sales team and sales management to monitor targets, sales activity, productivity and performance.
* Identify employees who are consistently underperforming and coordinate improvement plans with the respective department heads.
* Maintain performance records and provide regular updates to the Directors.
* Support decisions relating to employee development, incentives, appraisals and performance improvement.

**4. Organisation Development**

* Work closely with the Directors to build the company's organisational structure as the business grows.
* Help establish reporting relationships, department responsibilities and management processes.
* Coordinate with department heads to ensure proper manpower planning and team development.
* Build a professional and accountable working environment.
* Develop structured induction and training processes for new employees.

Candidate Requirements

* 5–8 years of relevant HR experience with strong hands-on recruitment and team-building experience.
* Experience in manufacturing, consumer durables, building materials, solar, water treatment or related industries preferred.
* Must have experience building teams and managing recruitment independently.
* Proven experience hiring field sales professionals, managers, technical staff and non-IT employees.
* Experience using LinkedIn, Naukri and other recruitment platforms.
* Good understanding of HR policies, employee management and Indian labour laws.
* Experience implementing performance management systems and HR processes.
* Familiarity with HRMS, ATS and recruitment reporting systems.
* Strong communication, negotiation and people-management skills.
* Fluency in English and Telugu; Hindi preferred.

Compensation

* Fixed annual compensation: ₹7–11 LPA, depending on experience and suitability.
* Performance-linked bonus: Up to 10% of fixed annual compensation.

Job Details

* **Location:**
  Kokapet, Hyderabad
* **Work Mode:**
  Full-time, on-site
* **Working Days:**
  Monday to Saturday
* **Working Hours:**
  10:00 AM – 6:00 PM

Selection Process

Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a practical assignment outlining how they would build the Hyderabad team within the first 60 days. This should cover recruitment priorities, hiring channels, HR policies, onboarding and employee performance management.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can apply with their updated CV and a brief note highlighting:

* Their experience in building teams from scratch.
* The number of field sales, managerial and technical employees they have recruited.
* Their experience implementing HR policies and performance management systems.

We are particularly interested in candidates who have independently handled recruitment and can work closely with company leadership to build a strong, performance-driven organisation.

Whether it’s the sports turf, gym, focus zone or nap rooms, the campus is built to make everyday work more enjoyable. If you’d like to know more about life at Navi, our culture and employee benefits, head to our careers page: navi.com/careers/life-at-navi.

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
**Job Description:**

**Position: HR Manager (HR & Payroll)**

* **Location: On-site (Thane)**
* **Industry: IT Consulting Services**
* **Experience: 3–5 Years (Generalist HR with 2+ yrs direct payroll handling)**
* **Reports To: Managing Director**
* **CTC: ₹4.0 – ₹5.0 LPA**
* **Notice Period: Immediate Joiners or Max 15–30 Days**
* **Employment Type: Full-Time**
* **Working days: 5 days (onsite)**

About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on HR Manager to build and run the people function of our growing startup. You will own the full employee lifecycle, from hiring to exit, and make sure payroll and statutory compliance run accurately and on time. This is a high-ownership role: you will set up processes, policies and culture practices from the ground up while handling day-to-day execution yourself.

Key Responsibilities

1. Hiring & Onboarding

* Partner with founders and team leads to understand manpower needs and create hiring plans and job descriptions.
* Manage end-to-end recruitment: sourcing, screening, interview coordination, offer negotiation and closure.
* Build and manage talent pipelines through job portals, LinkedIn, referrals and recruitment agencies.
* Run smooth onboarding: offer letters, background verification, documentation, induction and system access.
* Track hiring metrics such as time-to-hire, cost-per-hire and offer-acceptance rate.

2. Employee Engagement & Retention

* Plan and run engagement initiatives, team events, recognition programs and festival celebrations.
* Conduct regular check-ins, pulse surveys and stay interviews to understand employee sentiment.
* Act as the first point of contact for employee concerns and resolve grievances fairly and confidentially.
* Track attrition, analyse exit trends and recommend retention actions.
* Help shape a positive, transparent and performance-driven culture.

3. Training & Development

* Identify skill gaps with managers and design training plans for technical, behavioral and compliance needs.
* Organize internal workshops, external trainings and learning programs within budget.
* Support the performance review process, goal setting (OKRs/KRAs) and feedback cycles.
* Maintain training records and measure the effectiveness of programs.

4. Monthly Payroll Management

* Own end-to-end monthly payroll: attendance and leave inputs, salary calculations, variable pay, reimbursements and deductions.
* Ensure accurate and timely salary disbursement and payslip generation.
* Process statutory deductions and filings: PF, ESI, Professional Tax, TDS and Labour Welfare Fund, as applicable.
* Coordinate with finance/accounts for payroll funding, reconciliation and reporting.
* Manage payroll software or vendors and maintain payroll data integrity.
* Handle employee payroll queries, Form 16 and investment declaration processes.

5. Full & Final (FNF) Settlement and Exits

* Manage the complete exit process: resignation acceptance, notice period tracking, handover, exit interviews and clearance.
* Calculate and process FNF settlements, including notice pay, leave encashment, gratuity, bonus and recoveries.
* Issue relieving and experience letters and ensure timely closure of statutory exit formalities.
* Capture exit feedback and share insights with leadership.

6. Employee Communication

* Draft and share clear HR communications: policy updates, announcements, holiday calendars, appraisal timelines and org changes.
* Maintain an HR helpdesk or channel for employee queries with fast turnaround.
* Support leadership in internal communication, town halls and change announcements.
* Create and maintain the employee handbook and HR FAQs.

7. HR Compliance & Policies

* Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws and statutory requirements, including the Shops & Establishment Act, PF, ESI, Gratuity, Bonus, Maternity Benefit and POSH.
* Draft, implement and update HR policies (leave, attendance, code of conduct, work-from-home, expense and exit).
* Maintain accurate employee records, contracts and personnel files; support audits and inspections.
* Constitute and maintain the Internal Committee (POSH) and ensure annual compliance and awareness.
* Keep track of statutory due dates and law changes, working with external consultants where needed.

Required Qualifications & Skills

* MBA/PGDM in HR or a related field (preferred) or a graduate degree with relevant HR experience.
* 3–6 years of experience in HR generalist roles, with at least 2 years of direct payroll handling.
* Strong knowledge of payroll processing and Indian statutory compliance (PF, ESI, PT, TDS, Gratuity).
* Experience with HRMS/payroll tools (e.g., Zoho People, Payroll or similar) and proficiency in MS Excel/Google Sheets.
* Proven experience in end-to-end recruitment and FNF processing.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with high attention to detail and confidentiality.
* Comfortable working independently in a fast-paced, ambiguous startup environment.

Good to Have

* Experience building HR processes and policies from scratch.
* Exposure to tech or product startups and scaling teams from 20 to 200+.
* Knowledge of performance management frameworks such as OKRs.

What We Offer

* High ownership and direct access to founders and leadership
* Opportunity to build the HR function from the ground up
* Learning-driven, flexible and collaborative work culture

* Ability to create accountability while enabling collaboration across organizational boundaries.

* High integrity and discretion when working with confidential workforce, contractual and commercial information

title: Manager – HR, India
description:
Established in Malaysia in 1991, MFE, a company of Doka, has evolved into a global leader of high-quality, efficient, and cost-effective aluminium formwork systems today. Acquired by Doka in 2024, MFE is driven by continuous product innovations and an unwavering commitment to quality and customer service.

With a presence in India through its Mumbai office, MFE is strengthening its position in one of the world’s most dynamic construction markets. From supporting local housing developments to enabling large-scale urban transformation projects, MFE is shaping the future of construction in India.

Expanding beyond its initial success in residential projects, MFE has established itself as a one-stop shop for monolithic solutions. Providing end-to-end support, from bespoke formwork design, which utilises in-house 3D software, to experienced on-site technical assistance, MFE's state-of-the-art, eco-friendly manufacturing facility in Malaysia covers annual formwork production capacity exceeding 1.5 million m².

With a strong focus on on-site training and support, MFE further enables clients to achieve rapid construction cycles, solidifying its vision to be a world-class formwork enterprise dedicated to quality, customer satisfaction, and continuous innovation.

As a customer-focused organisation, MFE understands that its greatest assets are its employees, which is why it is consistently looking for talented professionals who are keen to develop their careers in this dynamic industry. Having grown continuously, based on the strength of its products and its agility to anticipate market demand, MFE is looking for skilled candidates to join their rapidly growing team.

**Job Description**

**WHAT IF you could shape the HR function of a growing business while creating meaningful employee experiences and enabling sustainable organizational growth?**

MFE India is seeking a proactive, self-driven and hands-on HR professional to take ownership of the day-to-day HR function and support the growth of its business in India.

Reporting directly to the Head of HR, this role will be responsible for managing the complete HR function at the operational level, establishing robust and scalable HR processes, and partnering with business leaders to address current and future people requirements.

As the business enters its next phase of growth and expansion, this role will play an important part in building a robust and scalable HR infrastructure, strengthening people practices, driving employee engagement and ensuring effective HR delivery to support the organization's evolving needs.

We are looking for someone who has experience supporting business growth, can independently establish and implement HR processes, takes ownership of deliverables, and can balance strategic thinking with hands-on operational execution.

**What You'll Be Doing**

**1. Recruitment & Talent Acquisition**

* Drive end-to-end recruitment activities in collaboration with business leaders and hiring managers, ensuring timely fulfilment of manpower requirements.
* Develop and strengthen recruitment processes to support business expansion and evolving workforce requirements.
* Partner with stakeholders on workforce planning, manpower budgeting, hiring priorities and recruitment strategies.
* Explore and support campus recruitment initiatives, university partnerships and graduate hiring programmes to build a sustainable talent pipeline.
* Ensure effective onboarding and integration of new employees.
* Identify opportunities to improve recruitment efficiency, candidate experience and hiring processes.

**2. HR Operations & Employee Lifecycle**

* Own and manage day-to-day HR operations and the complete employee lifecycle, including onboarding, confirmations, employee movements, transfers and offboarding.
* Establish, implement and continuously improve HR policies, processes, procedures and documentation to support business growth.
* Coordinate payroll activities, ensuring timely and accurate payroll inputs, employee data and resolution of payroll-related queries.
* Maintain accurate employee records, HR documentation and personnel files.
* Ensure consistent and effective implementation of HR processes across the organization.

**3. Performance Management & Employee Relations**

* Drive the performance management cycle, including goal setting, performance reviews, feedback and performance improvement initiatives.
* Support managers in addressing performance-related matters and developing effective people management practices.
* Take ownership of employee relations matters, including grievance handling, disciplinary processes, conflict resolution and employee concerns.
* Provide guidance to managers on employee-related matters, ensuring consistency, fairness and adherence to company policies.
* Promote a culture of accountability, engagement and continuous improvement.

**4. Employee Engagement & Culture**

* Act as the primary HR contact for employees across MFE India.
* Drive employee engagement initiatives and foster a positive and inclusive workplace culture.
* Support employee communication, wellbeing, recognition and team-building activities.
* Proactively identify employee concerns and facilitate timely and effective resolution.
* Champion Doka’s values, leadership culture, Code of Conduct, and a respectful, inclusive working environment.

**5. Stakeholder Management & Business Partnering**

* Act as a business partner and trusted advisor to business leaders and functional managers on all HR-related topics.
* Understand business requirements and translate them into effective HR initiatives and solutions.
* Provide guidance on HR policies, people practices, employee-related matters and organizational development.
* Build strong working relationships with stakeholders at all organizational levels.
* Collaborate with the Head of HR and the wider HR team to ensure alignment with regional and group HR standards.
* Champion Doka's values, leadership culture and Code of Conduct, ensuring compliance with applicable local laws and regulations.
* Support change management initiatives, facilitate stakeholder buy-in and ensure effective implementation of people-related changes.

**6. HR Systems & Digitalization**

* Support HR digitalization initiatives and process improvement projects.
* Drive the effective implementation, utilization and adoption of HR systems and related technologies, including SAP, where applicable.
* Ensure accuracy and integrity of HR data and reporting.
* Identify opportunities to streamline, standardize and automate HR processes.

**7. Statutory Compliance & Reporting**

* Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws, statutory requirements and company policies.
* Coordinate statutory compliance activities and ensure timely completion of related obligations in collaboration with relevant stakeholders.
* Prepare and maintain HR dashboards, metrics and management reports to support business decision-making.
* Coordinate internal and external HR audits and ensure timely closure of observations.
* Monitor changes in applicable labour legislation and support implementation of necessary changes in HR policies and practices.

**Qualifications**

**What We're Looking For**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration or a related field.
* Postgraduate qualification in HR is preferred.

**Experience**

* 6–8 years of progressive HR experience in a generalist role.
* Demonstrated experience independently managing day-to-day HR operations for a site, business unit or organization.
* Experience supporting business growth, organizational expansion or a significant increase in workforce strength.
* Proven ability to establish, implement and improve HR processes, policies and practices.
* Strong experience in end-to-end recruitment, employee relations, performance management and employee lifecycle management.
* Experience in payroll coordination and statutory compliance.
* Proven stakeholder management and employee engagement experience.
* Exposure to campus recruitment, university partnerships or graduate hiring would be advantageous.
* Exposure to manufacturing, engineering, construction or industrial environments would be advantageous.
* Experience with HRMS implementation, SAP or SAP SuccessFactors would be an added advantage.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Strong ownership mindset and ability to operate autonomously whilst adhering to company standards.
* Ability to build and establish HR processes that can support business growth and organizational expansion.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
* Ability to successfully manage change, get buy-in from various stakeholders and build trustful relationships with personnel at all levels.
* Strong employee relations and problem-solving capabilities.
* Practical, hands-on and execution-oriented approach.
* Strong organizational, planning and prioritization abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple HR priorities independently in a growing business environment.
* Proficiency in HR reporting and HRMS systems.
* SAP HR/SAP SuccessFactors exposure will be an added advantage.

**Additional Information**

**Why Join Us?**

* Opportunity to establish and shape the HR function for a growing business.
* Play a key role in building scalable HR processes and supporting significant organizational expansion.
* Drive meaningful employee initiatives, strengthen people practices and contribute to HR transformation.
* Work closely with business leaders and the Head of HR in shaping the organization's people agenda.

With 1.6 billion cumulative policies facilitated, partnerships with Shopee, Lazada, Tokopedia, GCash, Telkomsel, and 100+ commercial and insurer partners Igloo is building the operating system for the future of insurance.

Igloo has raised over US$100 million in funding from investors including Eurazeo, Openspace Ventures, Tokio Marine, Cathay Innovation, and BlueOrchard. The company has been named Insurtech of the Year at the Asia Fintech Awards in 2023 and 2024, and won twin Insurance Asia Awards in 2025.

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced and hands-on Talent Acquisition professional to drive end-to-end recruitment across multiple markets, with a strong focus on technology and commercial hiring.

In addition to recruitment, you will support day-to-day HR operations, employee engagement activities and people-related initiatives, working closely with the broader HR team.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth technology startup, enjoys building teams and is comfortable taking on a variety of responsibilities.

**Key Responsibilities**

Talent Acquisition (Regional)

* Manage the full recruitment lifecycle across multiple markets, from sourcing and screening to interview coordination, offer negotiations and onboarding handover
* Partner with hiring managers and business leaders to understand hiring needs and develop effective recruitment strategies
* Drive technical hiring across Software Engineering, QA, Product Management, Data, DevOps and other technology functions
* Support commercial and corporate hiring, including Sales, Business Development, Partnerships, Operations and Finance
* Proactively identify and engage candidates through direct sourcing, LinkedIn, referrals and other recruitment channels
* Build and maintain talent pipelines for business-critical and hard-to-fill positions
* Conduct market mapping, salary benchmarking and talent research to support hiring decisions
* Manage multiple vacancies across different markets, functions and seniority levels while ensuring a positive candidate experience
* Maintain accurate recruitment records, monitor hiring progress and provide regular updates to stakeholders
* Identify opportunities to improve recruitment processes and leverage AI tools to enhance sourcing and hiring efficiency

HR Operations & People Initiatives

* Support day-to-day HR administrative and operational activities for the assigned market or office
* Assist with employee onboarding and offboarding, including documentation and coordination with relevant stakeholders
* Maintain accurate employee records and support HRIS data management
* Assist in employee engagement activities, internal communications and company events
* Support the implementation of HR policies, processes and initiatives as required
* Participate in HR projects and process improvement initiatives in collaboration with the broader HR team

**Requirements**

* Minimum 5 years of hands-on Talent Acquisition experience, preferably within high-growth technology startups or scale-ups
* Strong track record in technical recruitment, particularly across engineering, product and other technology-related positions
* Experience recruiting for commercial roles, including Sales, Business Development or Partnerships
* Proven ability to independently manage end-to-end recruitment, including direct sourcing, candidate assessment and offer negotiations
* Experience supporting recruitment across multiple markets or countries is highly preferred

The candidate must be able to successfully manage, prioritize and close searches against a timeline and have experience setting benchmarks, metrics, and understand how to prioritize to hit all customer SLAs. They will need to demonstrate an ability to prioritize their time, demonstrate pushback and a sense of urgency, and understand the value of providing amazing customer service.

Build and maintain network of potential candidates through proactive market research and ongoing relationship management

Articulate in writing a plan with deliverables, timelines and a formal tracking process
  
  
Sourcing and Candidate Engagement
  
  
Proactively source passive candidates using Boolean search, LinkedIn Recruiter, GitHub, X-ray search/Open web and other sourcing channels for remote sites
  
  
Conduct candidate outreach and engagement to build interest and assess right fit
  
  
Filter the right candidates during recruiter phone screen
  
  
Screening and Evaluation
  
  
Conduct on-phone and virtual candidate screening process to assess qualification and skill alignment
  
  
Use Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), LinkedIn Recruiter, Indeed, X-ray search/Open web, GitHub and other sourcing tools
  
  
Must-Have Skills
  
  
Boolean and Advanced Search
  
  
Create targeted Boolean strings to identify candidates with niche technical skills across LinkedIn, X-ray search/Open web, GitHub, trade forums and specialized job boards
  
  
Candidate Engagement for Passive Talent
  
  
Skilled at requirement gathering, sourcing and screening candidates in specialized technical fields
  
  
Articulate role-based value proposition to the candidate
  
  
Build strategies and brainstorm to create efficient and creative sourcing solutions for stakeholders
  
  
**Good To Have**
Market Intelligence: Understand the talent market to source the right talent from targeted organizations
  
  
Experience in any 1 or 2 Tech hiring domain will be an added advantage
  
  

* Experience of hiring Full stack, Back-end and Front-end engineers,
* Data Analytics including Data Scientist (AI/ML) and Engineers,
* Understanding of any 2-3 Programming languages or key tech stacks like Python, Java, SQL, ETL, data pipelines, Hadoop, Spark, Big Data, or similar technical landscape.

Key job responsibilities

The role holder will be a part of Global Strategic Sourcing (GSS) team, which is a central sourcing team for WW Amazon Talent Acquisition (ATA) team. **Preferred Qualifications**

The Human Resources and People Strategy team at Navi manages the entire employee lifecycle, from talent acquisition and HR operations to employee engagement and development. They partner closely with business teams to design and implement strategies that attract, retain, and develop top talent, ensuring a thriving, high-performance organisational culture.

About the Role

You will drive hiring for Collections and other SBO roles. You will be responsible for sourcing and screening candidates, managing the recruitment pipeline, coordinating interviews, driving follow-ups and closures, and maintaining accurate hiring trackers and reports. Additionally you will be managing the HR Operations of the span working in your region and supporting the City HR Head.

The role requires strong communication, ownership, attention to detail, and the ability to work with urgency in a fast-paced environment.

What we will expect from you

* Manage high-volume sourcing and recruitment for Collections and other SBO roles through job portals, referrals, and multiple sourcing channels to meet hiring targets.
* Drive end-to-end recruitment coordination, including interview scheduling, candidate follow-ups, offer closures, and joining formalities to ensure timely hiring.
* Act as the primary contact for new joiners, addressing queries and ensuring a smooth transition into the organization.
* Drive pre-onboarding engagement by keeping new hires informed, connected, and excited before their start date.
* Lead the end-to-end onboarding process, ensuring a seamless and engaging experience for new hires.
* Ensure all pre-joining formalities, including documentation, background verification, and buddy assignments, are completed before Day 1.
* Continuously improve and optimize the onboarding experience by collecting and analyzing feedback from new joiners.
* Oversee employee offboarding from all HR systems ensuring timely IT/Admin clearances and a smooth exit process.
* Drive employee engagement initiatives in your span
* Act as a trusted HR partner to address employee queries and resolve grievances

Must haves

* Minimum qualification: Graduation in any field
* Experience is no bar but 1-2 years of experience in HR and eager to pursue a career in end-to-end recruitment and HR Operations
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Have basic knowledge of MS-Office and Google workplace (Sheets, Docs and Slides)
* Adaptability: Readiness to learn quickly and adapt to a dynamic and fast-paced environment and strong organizational and multitasking abilities.
* Integrity: Commitment to upholding ethical standards and Employee-first mindset

Life at Navi

Life at Navi is fast-paced, ambitious and deeply collaborative. Beyond work, teams come together through sports, celebrations, offsites, music jams, team outings and many more shared experiences that make the journey exciting and memorable.

We believe people do their best work when they feel supported, through flexible leave policies, strong health and wellness benefits, free financial, legal and medical consultations, ESOPs and a workplace designed for both productivity and well-being.

Whether it’s the sports turf, gym, focus zone or nap rooms, the campus is built to make everyday work more enjoyable. If you’d like to know more about life at Navi, our culture and employee benefits, head to our careers page: navi.com/careers/life-at-navi.

title: Massive Charging - Recruitment Lead @ Gurgaon
description:
Massive Charging is hiring a
**Recruitment Lead**
at its Gurgaon Office to own end-to-end talent acquisition - sourcing, screening, interviewing, and closing. He/she will be reporting to the CEO.

**Massive Charging (**
https://massivecharging.com/) is building EV charging infrastructure in India - full stack, hardware to software - including the CMS, driver app, and APIs used by charge point operators, fleets, and cities across the country.

**The Role**

We're hiring a
**Recruitment Lead**
to build our talent acquisition function from the ground up. This isn't a role for someone who wants to run a well-oiled ATS someone else designed - there is no existing playbook here.

You'll be reporting directly to the CEO, with a mandate to design how MASSIVE finds, evaluates, and closes talent across engineering, operations, and business functions. If you want ownership over a real business function from day one - not a cog role inside a large TA team - this is that job.

**What You'll Do**

* Own end-to-end recruitment: sourcing, screening, interview coordination, offer negotiation, and closing, across all functions and levels.
* Build the recruitment engine from scratch - job description templates, interview scorecards, sourcing channels, applicant tracking process, and employer branding.
* Partner directly with the CEO and function heads to translate hiring needs into role specs and push back where a request is vague or unrealistic.
* Build and manage a pipeline across multiple open roles simultaneously, in a fast-moving startup environment where priorities shift.
* Represent MASSIVE's culture and values accurately to candidates - you are the first impression of the Company for every hire.
* Track and report hiring metrics (time-to-fill, source effectiveness, offer-acceptance rate) directly to the CEO.
* As the team grows, potentially hire and manage junior recruiting support.

**Who You Are**

* 3-5 years of recruitment experience, ideally with some exposure to building or scaling a hiring function (not just executing against an existing one).
* High agency - you don't wait for someone to fix the tool, approve the process, or hand you the budget before you get the role filled. You find a way, and you don't treat missing resources as a reason the job didn't get done.
* Excellent verbal and written communication - this is non-negotiable. You will be corresponding with candidates, negotiating offers, and reporting to the CEO; sloppy or unclear communication is disqualifying regardless of other strengths.
* A genuine passion for recruitment as a “craft”, not a fallback career choice. This is a builder role - someone doing this because they have to won't survive the ambiguity or put in the work to build process.
* Ownership and responsibility as a default mode of operating, not something that needs to be assigned.
* Self-starting, self-aware, and comfortable being self-critical - you'll often be the only person in the building who knows what "good" looks like for this function, so you need the judgment to know when your own process isn't working.
* Action-oriented with a deep-dive attitude - curious enough to actually understand the roles you're hiring for (EV hardware, software, and operations are technical domains; you can't recruit well for what you don't understand).
* Comfortable with a startup's pace and ambiguity - this is not a role with a fixed script.

**Deal-Breakers**

* No passion for recruitment as a function - this role is about building a team and a hiring culture, not filling requisitions on autopilot.
* Weak written or verbal communication of any kind.
* Discomfort with ambiguity or an expectation of a pre-built process to execute against.

***P.S. If you’ve already been through our HR round for this role, please don’t re-apply.***

title: Manager - Talent Acquisition
description:
**About the role**

Excitel Broadband provides fibre broadband to over a million homes across Delhi NCR, Rest of North, Bangalore and Hyderabad. Around 2,100 people work at Excitel, all on-roll, and roughly half are in field sales.

The Manager – Talent Acquisition hires mainly for Excitel's corporate roles from Assistant Manager to General Manager level, across functions such as technology, network, finance, marketing and HR. The role may also take on customer service and telesales hiring, and handles 10–15 positions a month. It also runs internal job postings and supports Excitel's employer brand. Success is judged on the quality of hires as well as speed and cost.

**Key responsibilities**

**Corporate hiring, AM to GM**

* Run end-to-end hiring for corporate roles from Assistant Manager to General Manager: briefing, sourcing, screening, interview coordination, offer and joining.
* Agree role requirements with hiring managers using the uniform JDs; challenge briefs that don't match the market.
* Close offers within the approved pay range; route exceptions through the TA lead.

**Customer service and telesales hiring**

* Run customer service and telesales hiring when assigned by the TA lead, through job portals, referrals and agencies.

**Sourcing and agencies**

* Source directly through LinkedIn, job portals, referrals and networks before using agencies.
* Brief and manage agencies for specialist or hard-to-fill roles.

**Internal mobility and employer brand**

* Run internal job postings so employees see and apply for openings first.
* Support employer brand on the careers page, job portals and LinkedIn, with Marketing.

**Candidate experience and reporting**

* Keep candidates informed at every stage and protect Excitel's reputation in the market.
* Report open positions, ageing, funnel conversion and source of hire to the TA lead.
* Track retention of hires at 90 days and 6 months.

**Key performance indicators**

Time to fill · Offer-to-join ratio · Direct sourcing share versus agency · Cost per hire · Internal fill rate · 90-day and 6-month retention of hires · Hiring manager satisfaction

**Technical competencies**

* Mid-to-senior hiring (expert): search strategy, direct sourcing, candidate assessment, offer negotiation and closing.
* Volume hiring: portal and referral-led hiring for customer service and telesales roles.
* Sourcing tools: LinkedIn Recruiter, job portals, referral programmes.
* Systems and data: applicant tracking or HRMS recruitment modules; funnel reporting in Excel.

**Experience and qualifications**

* 6–10 years in recruitment, including hiring for corporate roles from Assistant Manager to General Manager level.
* Exposure to customer service or telesales hiring an advantage.
* In-house or search-firm experience in telecom, internet, technology or consumer services preferred.
* Graduate; MBA or PGDM preferred.

**Leadership traits**

* Pushes back on unrealistic briefs with market data.
* Builds trust with senior candidates and hiring managers.
* Closes well; low offer drop-out.
* Fluent in English and Hindi.

We are looking for an exceptional senior, hands-on leader to lead the IMEA Contingent Workforce function. This is a highly visible position in a fast-paced professional services environment.

The role is accountable for the strategy, governance and end-to-end management of the region’s contingent workforce model, covering external talent access, procurement and vendor management, commercial frameworks, lifecycle service, data, technology and reporting.

* Responsible for the IMEA contingent workforce strategy, policies, operating model, standards and priorities
* Advise People and business leadership on the appropriate role and use of external workforce capacity
* Connect CWR population, deployment and utilization insights with broader staffing, recruiting and workforce discussions
* Responsible for the governance, control and exception framework, ensuring required standards and approvals are consistently applied
* Lead, coach and prioritize the CWR Operations Specialists and ensure resilient day-to-day service delivery
* Represent IMEA in relevant global CWR forums and align regional practices with global standards and local requirements

* Ability to create accountability while enabling collaboration across organizational boundaries.

* Highly self-motivated, pragmatic and willing to roll up their sleeves in complex, sensitive or operationally demanding situations

Klypup is a digitally native cloud services advisory company that helps organizations accelerate growth and strengthen business resilience through AI and AWS expertise. Noida, India (Work from Office)

Full-Time

**Experience Level:**
3 to 5 years

**The Mission**

Klypup is a fast-growing AI startup building products and automation systems that businesses actually use. We’re hiring our first dedicated HR person – there’s no HR department to join, you’ll build one. From hiring and payroll to compliance and culture, you’ll set up the people systems that help us scale.

**Startup HR, Done Our Way**

No layers of approvals. You’ll work directly with the founders, move fast, and wear many hats. We use AI and automation everywhere, including HR – but in a small team every mistake is felt, so you’ll get pay and compliance right and handle people matters with care.

**What You’ll Be Doing**

Hiring & Onboarding

· Own hiring end to end – job descriptions, sourcing, interviews, and offers

· Run a simple onboarding process – documents, NDA and IP agreements, tool access, and a buddy for every joiner

· Work closely with founders and team leads to hire great engineers and builders

Payroll & Compliance

· Run monthly payroll

· Manage leave, attendance, reimbursements, and exits, including timely full and final settlement

· Own the compliance calendar with our CA – TDS, ESIC, gratuity, EPF, and Shops & Establishments

· Set up POSH from scratch – policy, Internal Committee, and the annual report

Policies & Culture

· Write our first employee handbook – short, clear, and readable

· Set up lightweight OKRs, 1:1s, and reviews, and shape our culture through benefits, recognition, and team events

**What We’re Looking For**

Must-Haves

**· Minimum 3 years of HR experience,**
ideally including time at a startup

· Hands-on with payroll and at least one HRMS tool

· Working knowledge of Indian labour law – ESIC, EPF, gratuity, TDS, POSH, and the Labour Codes

· Strong English, comfort with Excel or Google Sheets, daily use of AI tools, and complete discretion with confidential data

Great to Have

· Experience as the first or only HR person at a company

· Experience hiring for tech roles at a SaaS or AI startup

· Exposure to HR or payroll for team members in the UAE or Singapore

Mindset

· Builder and owner. You set things up without waiting to be asked, and deadlines don’t slip.

· Scrappy and adaptable. No task is too small, and you move with shifting priorities.

· People-first. Approachable, fair, and trusted with difficult conversations.

Eligibility

· MBA/PGDM in HR or a related degree (or equivalent experience); freshers will not be considered

· Able to work full-time from our Noida office

**What You’ll Gain**

· Be the founding HR hire, working directly with the founders

· Real ownership, with a path to an HR lead role as the team scales

· A fast-paced environment with freedom to experiment and improve how things work

**Who Should Apply?**

· You have 3+ years in HR and want to build something, not just maintain it

· You care about getting the details right – and about how people feel at work

title: Senior Associate I- Human Resources (Kolkata)
description:
Senior Associate I - Human Resources (SBO) | Kolkata

About Navi

At Navi, our mission is to simplify finance for a billion people, through technology-first products built at scale.

Founded in 2018 by Sachin Bansal and Ankit Agarwal, Navi has grown rapidly across Loans, UPI, Insurance, Mutual Funds and Digital Gold – building products designed around speed, simplicity and customer experience.

Today, millions of customers use Navi for experiences like instant personal loans, fully digital home loan sanctions within minutes, low-cost mutual funds, instant credit lines in minutes, and one of India’s fastest-growing UPI platforms.

About the Team

The Human Resources and People Strategy team at Navi manages the entire employee lifecycle, from talent acquisition and HR operations to employee engagement and development. They partner closely with business teams to design and implement strategies that attract, retain, and develop top talent, ensuring a thriving, high-performance organisational culture.

About the Role

You will drive hiring for Collections and other SBO roles. You will be responsible for sourcing and screening candidates, managing the recruitment pipeline, coordinating interviews, driving follow-ups and closures, and maintaining accurate hiring trackers and reports. Additionally you will be managing the HR Operations of the span working in your region and supporting the City HR Head.

The role requires strong communication, ownership, attention to detail, and the ability to work with urgency in a fast-paced environment.

What we will expect from you

* Manage high-volume sourcing and recruitment for Collections and other SBO roles through job portals, referrals, and multiple sourcing channels to meet hiring targets.
* Drive end-to-end recruitment coordination, including interview scheduling, candidate follow-ups, offer closures, and joining formalities to ensure timely hiring.
* Act as the primary contact for new joiners, addressing queries and ensuring a smooth transition into the organization.
* Drive pre-onboarding engagement by keeping new hires informed, connected, and excited before their start date.
* Lead the end-to-end onboarding process, ensuring a seamless and engaging experience for new hires.
* Ensure all pre-joining formalities, including documentation, background verification, and buddy assignments, are completed before Day 1.
* Continuously improve and optimize the onboarding experience by collecting and analyzing feedback from new joiners.
* Oversee employee offboarding from all HR systems ensuring timely IT/Admin clearances and a smooth exit process.
* Drive employee engagement initiatives in your span
* Act as a trusted HR partner to address employee queries and resolve grievances

Must haves

* Minimum qualification: Graduation in any field
* Experience is no bar but 1-2 years of experience in HR and eager to pursue a career in end-to-end recruitment and HR Operations
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Have basic knowledge of MS-Office and Google workplace (Sheets, Docs and Slides)
* Adaptability: Readiness to learn quickly and adapt to a dynamic and fast-paced environment and strong organizational and multitasking abilities.
* Integrity: Commitment to upholding ethical standards and Employee-first mindset

Life at Navi

Life at Navi is fast-paced, ambitious and deeply collaborative. Beyond work, teams come together through sports, celebrations, offsites, music jams, team outings and many more shared experiences that make the journey exciting and memorable.

We believe people do their best work when they feel supported, through flexible leave policies, strong health and wellness benefits, free financial, legal and medical consultations, ESOPs and a workplace designed for both productivity and well-being.

Whether it’s the sports turf, gym, focus zone or nap rooms, the campus is built to make everyday work more enjoyable. If you’d like to know more about life at Navi, our culture and employee benefits, head to our careers page: navi.com/careers/life-at-navi.

description:
**About Medhavi Group:**
Established in 2013, Medhavi Group is a unified ecosystem comprising MSU and various skill- promoting organisations, dedicated to advancing skill development, vocational training, and industry- integrated higher education. With a strong outcome-driven approach, the Group has trained over 6 lakh learners, achieving more than 70% employability outcomes, and currently supports 20,000+ active students across its diverse programs. Medhavi Group continues to bridge the gap between education and employment by building scalable, industry-aligned talent pathways across India. Work Integrated Skill based Higher Education (WISE) is Medhavi’s flagship industry-integrated initiative built on the principle of “Industry as Campus.” It combines academic learning with structured on-the job training, ensuring students graduate with real work experience and industry-ready skills. Through deep, outcome-driven partnerships with over 300+ leading industry and skill partners across 26+ sectors including Hyundai, Mahindra, IHG Group, Nephroplus, Barbeque Nation, Nexus Select Malls, ClassPlus, Tata Electronics, Marriott, ITC, and others- WISE enables learners to acquire role- specific competencies directly within live business environments. WISE creates a demand-driven talent pipeline for industries that enhances employability, improves workforce productivity, and bridges the industry skill gap.

For more information, visit
**https://msu.edu.in/wise/**

**Role Overview:**

The Manager will be responsible for establishing and strengthening partnerships with healthcare institutions, hospitals, rehabilitation centers, mental health organizations, clinics, NGOs, and industry partners to facilitate On-the-Job Training (OJT), clinical postings, internships, fieldwork, and experiential learning opportunities for students of Psychology and Allied Health Sciences. The role also involves developing and managing Memorandums of Understanding (MoUs) with partner organizations to support student training, research, and industry engagement initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Industry Partnership Development**

• Identify, approach, and onboard hospitals, clinics, diagnostic centers, rehabilitation centers, mental health organizations, NGOs, and healthcare providers for student training and placement opportunities.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with industry stakeholders and healthcare institutions.

• Explore new opportunities for collaboration in training, internships, research, and skill development.

**2. OJT & Clinical Posting Coordination**

• Facilitate OJT, internships, clinical postings, field visits, and practical training for Psychology and Allied Health Sciences students.

• Coordinate with academic departments and industry partners to ensure timely placement of students.

• Monitor student attendance, performance, and compliance during training and clinical postings.

• Resolve issues related to student deployment and industry coordination.

**3. MoU Development & Management**

• Draft, process, and coordinate Memorandums of Understanding (MoUs) with hospitals, healthcare institutions, NGOs, and industry partners.

• Ensure timely renewal and maintenance of partnership agreements.

• Maintain records and documentation related to all industry collaborations and MoUs.

• Coordinate with legal, administrative, and academic teams for approvals and execution of agreements.

**4. Stakeholder Coordination**

• Act as the primary point of contact between the university and partner organizations.

• Organize industry meetings, partnership discussions, and review sessions.

• Facilitate communication among students, faculty members, and industry partners.

**5. Compliance & Documentation**

• Maintain a database of industry partners, clinical sites, and training organizations.

• Prepare periodic reports on student postings, industry engagement activities, and partnership outcomes. • Ensure compliance with university policies, accreditation requirements, and regulatory guidelines related to clinical training.

**6. Student Support & Career Development**

• Guide students regarding internship and clinical posting requirements.

• Support employability initiatives and facilitate industry interactions.

• Assist in organizing workshops, guest lectures, industry visits, and career-oriented activities.

**Qualifications & Skills Required:**

• Master's Degree in Psychology, Hospital Administration, Healthcare Management, Social Work, Allied Health Sciences, Business Administration, or a related field.

• Additional certifications in healthcare management or industry relations will be an advantage.

• 5 - 10 years of experience in industry relations, healthcare partnerships, training coordination, placement activities, or academic-industry collaboration.

• Experience in working with hospitals, healthcare institutions, NGOs, or educational institutions is preferred.

• Strong networking and relationship management skills.

• Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal abilities.

• Knowledge of healthcare and mental health ecosystems.

• Experience in drafting and managing MoUs and partnership agreements.

• Strong organizational and documentation skills.

• Proficiency in MS Office and database management.

**What We Offer**

• Opportunity to architect and scale a future-focused, industry-integrated higher education ecosystem.

• Competitive compensation with performance-linked incentives.

• Leadership role in a rapidly growing national skills and university platform.

• A collaborative, mission-driven environment.

• The opportunity to create a measurable impact on employability and workforce transformation at scale.

Medhavi Skills University is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Sourcing Partner
description:
ELLKAY started out providing connectivity solutions to laboratories and within a few years, grew to also provide data management solutions to ambulatory organizations. ELLKAY is now a trusted data management partner in five healthcare segments. ELLKAY’s solutions continue to serve laboratories and ambulatory practices and have expanded to empower hospitals and health systems, healthcare IT vendors, ambulatory practices, health plans, and other healthcare organizations with cutting-edge technologies and solutions that drive their growth and interoperability strategies.
  
  
Today, ELLKAY remains true to our core values, building strong partner relationships and offering unparalleled service and support while providing innovative, scalable solutions to the challenges our customers face in today’s data-rich world.
  
  
ELLKAY's experience, customer-focused approach, and reputation for innovation, speed, and accuracy differentiate ELLKAY as a premier partner for your interoperability needs and data management strategy.
  
  
**Job Description**
ELLKAY is scaling its India-based Talent Acquisition function to support business growth and increasing hiring demand across Engineering and non-engineering teams. The Sourcing Partner is a newly added role designed to bring greater speed, consistency, and velocity to the hiring process. The role will own sourcing and pipeline generation for both TA Partners across technical and non-technical requisitions, supporting hiring across India and the U.S.
  
  
This is a hands-on individual contributor role with end-to-end ownership of sourcing coordination, sourcing tools, pipeline data, and reporting. The successful candidate will proactively identify bottlenecks, improve sourcing effectiveness, and deliver clear, reliable recruitment MIS for India. While there are no direct reports today, this role is expected to establish the foundation for a sourcing team as hiring needs grow.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own sourcing and pipeline generation for open technical and non-technical requisitions across India and U.S. teams, aligned with business priorities and hiring targets.
* Partner daily with the TA Partner and Senior TA Partner to clarify requisition priorities, success profiles, sourcing strategies, and pipeline health.
* Run proactive, multi-channel sourcing campaigns using LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean/X-ray search, referrals, niche job boards, talent communities, and other relevant tools.
* Build and maintain a searchable candidate database and accurate sourcing trackers, ensuring timely updates across sources, requisitions, and candidate stages.
* Manage external sourcing vendors and agencies: communicate role requirements, track service-level agreements (SLAs), review submissions, and consolidate vendor performance.
* Coordinate candidate screening calls and provide interview scheduling and process support in close partnership with the TA Partners.
* Maintain a professional and consistent candidate experience through timely communication, clear status updates, and effective coordination from initial outreach through interview and offer stages.
* Track daily, weekly, and monthly sourcing activity and funnel performance, including source-wise pipeline, qualified submissions, time-to-first-submission, conversion rates, and source of hire.
* Prepare holistic, accurate recruitment MIS and dashboards for India, highlighting progress against hiring targets, pipeline health, offer-to-joining ratio, source effectiveness, and emerging risks.
* Monitor the impact of sourcing efforts on interview progression, offer outcomes, and candidate joining; identify trends and recommend practical improvements.
* Use sourcing technology and recruitment tools effectively; assess opportunities to improve productivity, data quality, and speed through better tool adoption and process discipline.
* Identify and escalate process gaps, delayed feedback, sourcing bottlenecks, or vendor issues to the Director – HR, with clear data and recommended actions.
* Contribute to standardising sourcing practices, reporting cadence, and operating processes so the function can scale with future hiring demand.

**What You’ll Need**

description:
**Role Overview:**
We are seeking a self-driven Skill Development Consultant to anchor our presence in Gujarat from Gandhinagar. This is an independent, ownership-heavy role: you will build and manage relationships with state government departments and missions, position our NSQF- aligned and credit-linked programmes with schools, colleges and universities, and convert those relationships into signed partnerships and funded programmes.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Build and sustain working relationships with different state bodies including the Department of Labour, Skill Development & Employment, Skill Development Missions, Directorate of Employment & Training, private schools and colleges and relevant district administrations.
* Track state and central scheme announcements, tenders, EOIs and RFPs; flag opportunities early and drive internal go/no-go decisions.

• Represent the organisation in departmental meetings, review committees, empanelment processes and government-convened workshops.

* Map proposed courses to NSQF levels and the relevant National Occupational Standards (NOS) and Qualification Packs (QPs)
* Coordinate with the academic team on credit transfer, ABC registration and embedding of vocational credits into school and higher education programmes.
* Interpret NCVET, UGC, AICTE and NEP 2020 guidance for institutional partners and translate it into practical implementation plans.
* Draft high-quality proposals, concept notes, MoUs and commercial offers for the introduction of new skill courses in schools, colleges and universities.
* Prepare tender and bid documentation for government skilling projects, including technical write-ups, compliance annexures and past-performance narratives.
* Own the pipeline end to end: prospecting, first meeting, proposal, negotiation, closure, and handover to delivery.
* Promote courses and partnership models independently, without day-to-day supervision, and be accountable for conversion targets.
* Maintain an accurate CRM/tracker of institutions, officials, opportunities and stage-wise status; report progress fortnightly.
* Liaise with training partners, assessment agencies and awarding bodies as required.
* Contribute to compliance documentation, MIS reporting and audit readiness for government funded projects.

**Qualifications & Skills Required:**

* Graduate in any discipline; a postgraduate qualification (MBA, MSW, M.A. Education, or equivalent) is preferred.
* 5–8 years in the skill development, vocational education or workforce development sector, with demonstrable ownership of government or institutional relationships.
* Domain knowledge (non-negotiable):

o NSQF structure, level descriptors and application.

o National Occupational Standards (NoS), Qualification Packs and QP/NOS codes.

o Academic credit alignment — NCrF, credit calculation, ABC, credit transfer into school and higher education.

o Working familiarity with NCVET, sector skill councils, and the central/state scheme landscape (PMKVY, Samagra Shiksha vocational education, NAPS/NATS, state skill missions).

**Language:**
Fluency in Hindi and English. Any 3 rd language will be useful

**Mobility:**
Willing to travel across states

**About Medhavi Skills University:**
Medhavi Skills University (MSU) is a government-notified private State Skills University established under a State Act in Sikkim in 2021, dedicated to advancing quality skill-integrated higher education and entrepreneurship. Recognised by the UGC and aligned with the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020, MSU is a pioneer in converging the skilling ecosystem with formal higher education through its “Industry as Campus” model. The University collaborates extensively with industries and Skill Development Institutes to deliver work-integrated degree programs embedding structured on-the-job training within the curriculum. MSU is a recognised Awarding Body under NCVET, empanelled with DGT, and serves as an anchor university partner with NSDC and the PMU of NSDC International- collectively reinforcing its demand-driven, industry-co-led academic framework. Ranked 4th among India’s Top Skill Universities in the Outlook ICARE Rankings 2025 and supported by over 11 defence partnerships along with multiple national recognitions, MSU stands among India’s leading skill-integrated higher education institutions. For more information, visit https://www.msu.edu.in/

title: Manager People Operations
description:
Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.
  
  
Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.
  
  
Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.
  
  
With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.
  
  
**Position Summary**
As the Shared Services Manager for People Operations, India, you will lead and scale Harness's India-based People Operations shared services function. You'll build, manage, and develop a team responsible for onboarding, offboarding, compliance administration, HRIS data integrity, and Workday operations, while serving as an India-based Workday super-user following our December 2026 go-live. You will also lead India-based coordination of U.S. H-1B and green card case administration, partnering closely with Harness' U.S. based People Operations team.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a player coach and combines proven people-management experience with genuine hands-on Workday expertise, is comfortable building scalable processes in an ambiguous, high-growth environment, and can represent India's operational needs to Harness’ global People Operations team and cross-functional stakeholders.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Hire, lead, coach, and develop a growing India-based People Operations shared services team, setting goals, KPIs, and SLAs for ticket resolution and case management
* Own end-to-end accountability for ticket SLA performance across the global ticketing system; build escalation procedures and reporting for leadership
* Drive India employment-law compliance for People Operations processes, updating policies and procedures as regulations evolve
* Ensure annual compliance training for the India location
* Partner with Talent Acquisition, Talent Management, and IT leadership to design and continuously improve onboarding and offboarding processes for India-based new hires and interns
* Own HR data integrity strategy within Workday, partnering with the broader People Operations team on India-specific configuration
* Serve as the senior India-based Workday super-user following go-live: lead troubleshooting, validate India-specific migrated data (offboarding records, change letters, EPF/supplemental leave, immigration documentation), and reduce dependency on external implementation partners
* Assist employees with obtaining travel visas for U.S. business travel
* Lead India-based coordination for U.S. H-1B and green card (PERM) case administration under the direction of Harness’ U.S. based People Operations team.
* Partner with People Business Partners to structure and absorb transactional work appropriately, freeing PBP capacity for higher-value partnering
* Represent India's process and staffing needs in the broader global shared-services and Workday transformation
* Manage escalations and complex employee issues, exercising judgment on when to involve legal, compliance, or senior leadership
* Deliver timely and accurate ticket resolution alongside the global People Operations team. Every team member dedicates a % of their time to resolving tickets and, by doing so, stays current on opportunities and delivers an exceptional employee experience

**About You**

* 7+ years of HR/People Operations experience, including at least 2+ years directly managing a team
* 4+ years of hands-on Workday experience
* Demonstrated experience building or scaling a shared-services or HR operations function
* Experience working in a global, matrixed environment, with an ability to handle complex problems independently
* Comfortable operating as a subject-matter expert and stakeholder into a cross-functional systems implementation project, not just as an end user of HR systems
* Excellent communication, coaching, and stakeholder-management skills
* Prior experience supporting or overseeing U.S. immigration processes (e.g., H-1B, green card/PERM) preferred
* High degree of discretion and judgment handling sensitive personal, immigration-related, and compliance documentation
* Excited to build and lead the employee-facing operations function for Harness's India presence, including driving our values internally and externally
* Ability to give and receive feedback from stakeholders and cross-functional partners and translate it into process improvements
* Highly organized and proactive, able to balance high-volume operational leadership with strategic project contributions

**Harness In The News**

* Accelerating Our Mission to Bring AI to Everything After Code
* Goldman Sachs leads investment in software delivery startup Harness at $5.5 billion valuation
* How Harness runs 16 “startups within a startup” at scale | Jyoti Bansal
* Harness Research Shows AI Visibility Crisis Fueling Security Nightmare
* Harness has been named to the Inc. Power Partner list for software delivery success

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex or national origin.
  
  
At Harness, we care about your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. For additional information on this topic, you can visit our privacy Portal: https://harness-privacy.relyance.ai/
  
  
**Note on Fraudulent Recruiting/Offers**
We have become aware that there may be fraudulent recruiting attempts being made by people posing as representatives of Harness. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers.
  
  
Please note, we do not ask for sensitive or financial information via chat, text, or social media, and any email communications will come from the domain @harness.io. Additionally, Harness will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid, or purchases to be made by a job applicant. All applicants are encouraged to apply directly to our open jobs via our website. Interviews are generally conducted via Zoom video conference unless the candidate requests other accommodations.
  
  
If you believe that you have been the target of an interview/offer scam by someone posing as a representative of Harness, please do not provide any personal or financial information and contact us immediately at security@harness.io. You can also find additional information about this type of scam and report any fraudulent employment offers via the Federal Trade Commission’s website (https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/job-scams), or you can contact your local law enforcement agency.

title: Human Capital Management-Bengaluru-Associate-Firmwide Compensation
description:
**Job Description**
**Who We Are**
The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc. is a leading global financial services firm providing investment banking, securities and investment management services to a substantial and diversified client base. Our Human Capital Management (HCM) division recruits, develops and rewards the people of Goldman Sachs, advising and implementing the strategies, processes and technologies that help our people advance professionally and drive productivity.
  
  
People Analytics sits within Reward & People Analytics and provides firmwide and regional management with workforce data, reporting and analysis across Headcount, Payroll, Attrition, Compensation and Talent. The team partners closely with Firmwide, Divisional and Regional leadership, Controllers, the Executive Office and regulators to turn complex HCM data into decisions.
  
  
**The Role**
This Associate role is central to driving data-informed talent decisions across the organization. You will own the end-to-end delivery of People Analytics outputs - combining strong analytical craft with storytelling to translate HCM data into actionable insight for senior stakeholders, including Regional HCM Heads, Divisional Heads, Chiefs of Staff and the Executive Office.
  
  
In line with the team’s operating model, we are looking for someone who does more than produce reports - an owner who can frame the “why” behind a request, form and defend a point of view, and use AI as leverage while retaining ownership of judgement and outcomes.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Analytics & Reporting Delivery
  
  

* Own outputs end-to-end: Deliver assigned People Analytics outputs - including EMEA compensation disclosures, year-end compensation reporting, headcount, attrition and payroll roll-forwards, and recurring stakeholder reporting - with a high standard of data accuracy and on agreed timelines.
* Deep-dive analysis: Conduct in-depth analysis of HCM data across talent processes (performance ratings, promotions, talent reviews, compensation) to identify trends, patterns and opportunities.
* Dashboards & tools: Contribute to the development, maintenance and validation of reporting dashboards and packs, including Power BI reporting and Business Objects / Anaplan outputs.
* Headcount & planning support: Coordinate headcount data and projections for capacity planning, location strategy and budgeting, partnering with the Executive Office and Real Estate teams.

**Stakeholder Engagement & Storytelling**

* Partner with senior leadership: Work directly with Regional HCM Heads, Divisional Heads, Chiefs of Staff and the Executive Office to understand business needs and deliver data-driven solutions.

**Insight, not just data**
: Develop compelling narratives and visualizations that translate complex data into clear implications and recommendations for senior audiences.
  
  

* Regulatory & disclosure support: Support strategic and regulatory workstreams such as EU Pay Transparency readiness, UK Gender Pay Gap and other regional compliance reporting.

Process Improvement & Ownership
  
  

* Automate and simplify: Identify and implement process improvements across recurring workflows (e.g., year-end comp, disclosure reporting), using tools such as Alteryx to standardize and automate validation and controls.
* Quality & controls: Apply structured quality-assurance and reconciliation practices to ensure accuracy and minimize restatements across published outputs.
* AI as leverage: Adopt approved AI use cases (e.g., drafting narratives, scenario modelling) to increase speed and scale, while owning the thinking and the outcome.
* Subject-matter expertise: Build and share knowledge to become a go-to resource for at least one critical process area.

**Essential**
Qualifications & Experience
  
  

* Up to 7 years of relevant post-qualification experience in analytics, reporting, management consulting, management & strategy, finance or HR analytics; MBA strongly preferred (top-tier consulting background a plus).
* Strong analytical mindset with a proven ability to work with large datasets and translate data into a clear, insightful and compelling story.
* Advanced Excel skills - comfort with complex formulas, pivot tables and macros.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, including experience preparing materials for senior stakeholders.
* Strong project management skills, attention to detail and the ability to prioritize and meet deadlines.

**Preferred / Advantageous**

* Experience with BI and data tools - Power BI / Tableau, Alteryx, Business Objects, Anaplan; scripting (Python, R, VBA) a plus.
* Familiarity with HR / HRIS data landscape and processes.
* Exposure to compensation and reward analytics, executive compensation or regulatory disclosures

*At Goldman Sachs, we commit our people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. We are committed to fostering and advancing diversity and inclusion, and we welcome applications from all backgrounds.*
