title: People Operations Associate
description:
**About Fam (previously FamPay)**

  

Fam is India’s first payments app for everyone above 11. FamApp helps make online and offline payments through UPI and FamCard. We are on a mission to raise a new, financially aware generation, and drive 250 million+ young users in India to kickstart their financial journey super early in their life.
  
  
We’re reimagining how the next generation experiences fintech—going beyond payments to build a lifestyle brand that blends money, identity, and everyday experiences into one seamless, intuitive journey.
  
  
Founded in 2019 by IIT Roorkee alumni, Fam is backed by some of the most respected investors around the world like Elevation Capital, Y-Combinator, Peak XV (Sequoia Capital) India, Venture Highway, Global Founder’s Capital and the likes of Kunal Shah, Amrish Rao as angel investors.

  
  

**About this Role:**

  

Behind every seamless workplace experience is strong people operations—and this role makes it all happen. You’ll own the moving parts that keep HR running smoothly, from payroll and compliance to ESOPs, benefits, documentation, and policies. If you enjoy bringing structure to complexity and finding smarter ways to make processes faster, cleaner, and more efficient, you’ll fit right in.

**On the Job**
• Manage end-to-end monthly payroll processing on Keka, including inputs, computation, disbursement, and reconciliation with full accuracy and timely delivery.
  
• Administer the ESOP programme by maintaining grant registers on EquityList and Excel, coordinating exercise requests, and communicating vesting milestones to employees.
  
• Ensure statutory compliance across PF, ESIC, PT, and gratuity through timely filings, audit-ready documentation, and proactive risk flagging.
  
• Own all employee documentation, including drafting, maintaining, and version-controlling agreements, offer letters, policies, and HR documents for accuracy and consistency.
  
• Manage employee benefits operations covering group health and term life insurance, including endorsements, renewals, and employee claims/query support.
  
 • Maintain POSH compliance by ensuring the Internal Committee is active, managing the complaints portal, and completing annual filings and case processes correctly.
  
• Track and implement policy updates based on labour law changes, ensuring internal policies remain current and effectively communicated to employees.
  
• Identify and implement automation opportunities in routine HR operations through tooling, AI-assisted workflows, and process redesign to reduce manual effort.**Must-haves (Min. qualifications)**
• End-to-end payroll management independently on Keka/equivalent tool management., including variable pay, reimbursements, TDS computation, and monthly reconciliation.
  
• Advanced Excel proficiency with compensation trackers, ESOP registers, and compliance dashboards using VLOOKUP, pivot tables, and nested formulas.
  
• Strong knowledge of statutory compliance including PF, ESIC, PT, gratuity, and labour law basics, with ability to identify issues needing legal escalation.
  
• Hands-on ESOP administration experience covering grant registers, vesting schedules, cliff tracking, exercise processing, and EquityList/equivalent tool management.
  
• Familiarity with POSH compliance, including Internal Committee setup, complaints portal management, and timely annual filings.
  
• Experience managing employee benefits such as group health and term life insurance, including endorsements, renewals, broker coordination, and claim support.
  
• Skilled in drafting and maintaining employee documentation including offer letters, employment agreements, policy documents, and HR correspondence with legal accuracy.
  
• Strong process orientation with proven ability to build workflows, maintain clean records, and manage high-volume deadline-driven HR operations.
  
• Demonstrated ability to maintain audit readiness across HR operations — records, filings, and documentation are kept in a state where they can withstand internal or external scrutiny at any point, not just during scheduled audits
  
**Good to have**
• Experience working in high-growth startup environments where HR operations scaled rapidly and processes were built or restructured dynamically.
  
• Proactive use of AI tools to automate repetitive HR tasks, including document drafting, policy summarisation, and tracker automation**Why join us?**
  

  
* **Own, refine, and build**
  — The foundational processes are in place, but there is significant scope to take ownership, sharpen what exists, and build new ones from scratch. You will not just be executing — you will be the one setting the direction for how People Ops runs at FamPay
  
* **Scale means scope**
  — We are growing fast, and the complexity of People Ops grows with it. Your role will evolve as we do
  
* **Make a real impact**
  — From compliance rigour to automating ops workflows, the work you do here will directly shape the employee experience at FamPay

  
  

**Perks That Go Beyond the Paycheck**

  

• Relocation assistance to make your move seamless.

  

• Free office meals (lunch & dinner).

  

• Generous leave policy, including birthday leave, period leave, paternity and maternity support, and more.

  

• Salary advance and loan policies for any financial help.

  

• Quarterly rewards and recognition programs, and a referral program with great incentives.

  

• Access the latest gadgets and tools.

  

• Comprehensive health insurance for you and your family, mental health support.

  

• Tax benefits with options like food coupons, phone allowances, car/device leasing.

  

• Retirement perks like PF contribution, leave encashment and gratuity.

  
  

**Here’s all the tea on FamApp ☕️**

  

FamApp focuses on financial inclusion of the next generation by providing UPI & card payments to everyone above 11 years old. Our flagship Spending Account, FamX, seamlessly integrates UPI and card payments, enabling users to manage, save, and learn about their finances effortlessly.

  
  

**Revolutionizing Payments and FinTech**

  

FamApp has enabled 10 million+ users to make UPI and card payments across India, removing the inconvenience of carrying cash everywhere. Users get to customise their FamX card with doodles, which lets them add a personal touch to their payments.

  
  

**Trusted by leading investors**

  

We’re proud to be supported by renowned investors like Elevation Capital, Y-Combinator, Peak XV (formerly Sequoia Capital India), Venture Highway, Global Founder’s Capital, and esteemed angels Kunal Shah and Amrish Rao.

  
  

**Join Our Dynamic Team**

  

At Fam, our people-first approach is reflected in our generous leave policies, flexible work schedules, comprehensive health benefits, and free mental health sessions. We don’t mean to brag, but we promise you’ll be surrounded by some of the most fun, talented and passionate people in the startup space.

  
  

Want to see what makes life at Fam so awesome? Check out our shenanigans at @lifeatfam 😛
  
  
**PS - We’re looking for someone with an AI-native mindset, who actively leverages AI in their day-to-day work, as we encourage and embed it across every level at Fam.**

  

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

description:
**Job Title**
Senior Global HR Specialist(6 months FTC)
  
  
**Job Description**
**So, who are we?**
IG Group is a FTSE 100 fintech operating across five continents, serving over 1.3m customers and handling billions of dollars in transactions – built on scale, trust, and proof. We didn't pivot to innovation; it's how we've always operated. What that means for the people who work here is real: genuinely complex problems to solve, the technology and resources to tackle them properly, and the kind of scope that's rare in established businesses.
  
  
The bar is high – bring a curious and forward-thinking mindset and we'll give you the platform to define what comes next.
  
  
Join us at IG – the future gets built here
*.*
**Your team**
You’ll join People Services, part of People Excellence at IG, supporting 3,000+ colleagues across the globe.
  
  
**Your role in the Team's Success**
This is a
**6-month fixed-term role**
focused on HR transformation projects. You’ll move our HR knowledge from OneNote into ServiceNow and test it thoroughly. You’ll also support the rollout of new HR systems. You need to be productive from week one and take full ownership of what you deliver.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Migrate HR knowledge from OneNote to ServiceNow, recreating each item accurately, in the right structure, and in clear language for employees and managers and HR
* Review the existing content as you migrate it, and flag outdated, incomplete, or conflicting procedures with a proposed fix
* Test every recreated knowledge item end to end, covering accuracy, completeness, navigation, and search. Log and track defects through to retest and sign-off
* Keep a clear record of migration status and testing results, and report progress and risks to your manager regularly
* Support the implementation of new HR systems, including test preparation, test execution, issue logging, and user acceptance testing
* Work with HR specialists, subject matter experts, and system owners across India, Poland, and the UK to validate content and resolve issues.

**What You'll Need**

* You work out what to do when something doesn’t fit. Source documents are often incomplete or inconsistent. When you hit a gap, you work out the right answer with the relevant expert or escalate with your analysis and a proposed solution. You never skip an item or carry it over unchecked.
* You own the outcome. You deliver your workstream to the agreed deadline and sign it off with evidence. If something is unowned, blocked, or at risk, you pick it up or raise it immediately.
* You flag risks early. If a deadline is at risk, you say so straight away and propose an alternative.
* You test like the end user. You ask whether a colleague with no HR background could follow the content and get the right answer, and you fix it if they couldn’t.

**Essential**

* 4+ years of hands-on HR operations or HR shared services experience, ideally in a multi-country environment
* Hands-on experience with ServiceNow, Salesforce, or a similar case management or knowledge platform
* Hands-on experience with Workday or SuccessFactors
* Experience in testing or quality assurance, such as test cases, UAT, defect logging, or retesting
* Strong written English (C1), with the ability to turn complex procedures into clear employee-facing content
* Proven track record of working independently from incomplete or ambiguous inputs.

**Nice to have**

* Experience building or maintaining a knowledge base or self-service content
* Experience with an HR system implementation or migration
* Experience supporting APAC or EMEA HR processes
* Experience in audits or documentation reviews.

**The Perks**
It really is more than a job. We think like a start-up, but we deliver like a FTSE 100 — so the bar is high, and we won't pretend otherwise. We work hybrid, which means three days in the office. We’ll recognize your talent and make sure that you can still have a life – at work, and outside of it. Networks, committees, awards, sports and social clubs, mentorships, volunteering opportunities, extra time off… the list goes on.
  
  
**Join us for this exciting journey. Apply now!**

**Talent Consultant- Manager**
If you are looking for a challenging and rewarding career experience as a Talent Consultant in a high-growth organization, we have a role here. At EY GDS we value wellbeing, curiosity and agility as an individual. We create teams of inspiring, teaming and belonging. We care for our business, society and client. Our purpose is building a better working world. Does that resonate with you? We look forward to working with you.

You will be responsible for supporting the Talent agenda for a business unit (GDS Operations) in EY GDS and will be the key point of contact for leadership on a range of talent related matters. **Ideally, you’ll also have**

* A professional accreditation or HR specialization certification

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.

* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.

title: Director Global HR M&A Strategic Deals Leader
description:
**Director, Global HR M&A Strategic Deals Leader**
Leading at Cognizant
  
  
This is a Leadership role at Cognizant. We believe how you lead is as important as what you deliver. Cognizant leaders at every level: Drive our business strategy and inspire teams around our future. Live the leadership behaviors, leading themselves, others and the business. Uphold our Values, role modeling them in every action and decision. Nurture our people and culture, creating a workplace where all can thrive.
  
  
At Cognizant, leadership transcends titles and is embodied in actions and behaviors. We empower our leaders at every level to drive business strategy, inspire teams, uphold our values, and foster an inclusive culture.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Director, Global HR M&A Strategic Deals Leader, you will make an impact by shaping the people strategy and execution for large-scale outsourcing, rebadging, transformation, and selected M&A opportunities across APAC. You will partner with Business Unit and SBU leaders, Solution Teams, Deal Architects, Legal, Compliance, Employee Relations, senior client stakeholders, and executive sponsors to support revenue-generating deals from pursuit through Day-1 integration and post-transfer execution.
  
  
You will also lead the APAC operations team responsible for workforce analysis, HR compliance, compensation and offer development, employee transfer documentation, transition governance, and operational support for rebadging and selected M&A transactions.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Lead HR workstreams for large, complex strategic outsourcing and rebadging deals from qualification, pursuit, and RFI/RFP response through negotiation, closure, and execution.
* Shape workforce transition and employee transfer strategies across APAC, balancing client requirements, employee experience, legal compliance, employment risk, and commercial objectives.
* Lead due diligence, employee consultation, compensation alignment, offer management, retention planning, transition readiness, Day-1 integration, and post-transfer activities.
* Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders, CHROs, Legal leaders, executive sponsors, and BU/SBU leaders; serve as the HR subject matter expert in client discussions, solution design, town halls, and executive presentations.
* Lead and develop Regional HR Strategic Deal Leads and the APAC rebadging operations team, establishing scalable operating models, controls, governance, reporting, execution frameworks, and consistent delivery quality.
* Consistently demonstrate the Cognizant Way to Lead, which means operating with Personal Leadership (building trust, collaboration, and inclusion), Organizational Leadership (driving vision and purpose, demonstrating a strategic and enterprise mindset, and creating and communicating a bold direction that inspires purpose), and Business Leadership (exemplifying client focus, managing ambiguity with accountability and results, and operating with financial acumen).

What you need to have to be considered
  
  

* 15+ years of progressive HR experience, including 8+ years supporting outsourcing, rebadging, HR M&A, or strategic deal programs.
* Proven experience partnering with business leaders on large-scale transformation, outsourcing, and revenue-generating engagements.
* Deep understanding of APAC labor laws, employee transfer regulations, workforce transition frameworks, consultation obligations, works council requirements, and employment risk mitigation.
* Experience leading geographically dispersed teams and providing coaching, governance, and execution oversight across regional strategic deal teams.
* Strong client-facing capability and executive stakeholder management experience, including participation in due diligence, negotiations, solution design, and executive presentations.
* Ability to lead workforce analytics, compensation benchmarking, offer development, HR compliance reviews, employee transfer documentation, transition governance, and reporting.
* Embodiment of the Cognizant Way to Lead: Leading Self, Leading Others, and Leading the Business.
* Embodiment of Cognizant's Values: Work as One, Dare to Innovate, Raise the Bar, Do the Right Thing, and Own It.

**Corporate Strategic Alignment**

* Engage with senior BU leads to align HR solution in coordination with business objectives and growth strategy
* Lead on the building and deployment of best practice to support strategic deals
* Align with cross functional teams to improve process efficiencies to achieve quicker revenue experience.
* Coach internal stakeholders and key decision makers on HR strategic deals processes and risk sensitivities
* Build systematic best practice and continuous improvement into Cognizant’s deal operating model.

**Global Team Development**

* Responsible for planning hiring upskilling and managing succession for team personnel
* Demonstrate and champion expected leadership behaviors
* Building a culture of development coaching and learning within the team
* Provide direct oversight career management and coaching support for senior leaders of the strategic deals team

These will help you succeed
  
  

* Experience in IT Services, Business Process Services, Consulting, or Global Capability Centers.
* Background supporting multi-country outsourcing, managed services, or digital transformation deals.
* Experience supporting transactions exceeding $50M in annual contract value.
* Exposure to the HR aspects of mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, or integration programs

Work model
  
  
This role is based in India, with Hyderabad or Chennai preferred. The specific working arrangement and office attendance expectations will be communicated during the hiring process and will be based on business, project, and client requirements.
  
  
The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you are engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured, we will always be clear about role expectations.
  
  
We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

title: Lead Total Rewards Partner
description:
**About Us**
Egis is a global organisation with over 23,500 employees worldwide. With our head office based in Paris, we offer global career opportunities, as well as offer rewarding careers for our people locally.
  
  
Egis is an organisation with a capacity to make meaningful industry and community change in the space of place-making, sustainability and creating connected cities. Different to other engineering firms, Egis offers true end-to-end capability across the entire design-to-operation lifecycle, offering advisory, architecture, engineering, design, asset management and operations services.
  
  
We are committed to creating great teams doing innovative work and would love
**you**
to join us to
**Impact the Future.**
**About The Role**
Role Purpose
  
  
Act as the analytical engine and trusted deputy to the Regional Head of Total Rewards, driving the design, delivery and governance of competitive, cost-effective and compliant Compensation & Benefits programmes across MESA. The role combines strong technical reward expertise with strong hands-on analytics and partnering with HR, Finance, Group Reward and business leaders as necessary.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities – Compensation**

* Job Architecture: Maintain job families, levelling and grade/title mapping; support job evaluation and consistent role governance across countries.
* Pay Bands & Structures: Build and refresh salary ranges (min/mid/max, spreads, midpoint progression); monitor compa-ratios and range penetration.
* Market Benchmarking: Manage salary survey participation (e.g., Mercer, Aon, Korn ferry) and job matching; deliver market positioning analysis by country, sector and level.
* Harmonization: Lead pay and grade harmonization for M&A, restructuring and legacy entities, including gap analysis, cost modelling and transition plans.
* Annual Salary Review & Incentives: Run ASR/merit cycles, budget modelling and merit matrices; support STI/bonus design, payouts.
* Pay Equity, Offers & Allowances: Conduct internal equity reviews; advise on offers, promotions and salary corrections; govern allowance and expat/mobility packages.

**Key Responsibilities – Benefits & Insurance**

* Insurance Programmes: Manage group medical, life and personal accident policies; lead annual renewals with brokers and insurers (RFPs, negotiations, plan design options).
* Claims & Cost Analytics: Analyse claims experience, loss ratios and utilisation trends; project renewal costs and recommend cost-containment levers.
* Statutory & Retirement Benefits: Ensure compliance with country requirements (e.g., End-of-service benefits, GOSI/pension schemes, mandatory health cover etc).
* Benchmarking, Wellbeing & Vendors: Benchmark benefits against market practice; support wellbeing and flexible benefits; manage broker/TPA SLAs, employee communications.

Key Responsibilities – Governance, Analytics & Partnering
  
  

* Policy & Governance: Draft and maintain reward policies, approval matrices and audit-ready documentation; ensure alignment with Regional & Group Reward frameworks.
* Reward Analytics: Build dashboards, cost models and scenario analyses; ensure HCM/HRIS reward data accuracy and integrity.
* Operations & Shared Services Partnership: As policy owner, partner with Operations and Shared Services teams who execute reward transactions; define clear process guidelines, controls and checks to ensure accurate, compliant and consistent delivery and data integrity.
* Partnering & Deputising: Prepare leadership-ready decks and approval notes; act as first point of contact for HRBPs and Finance, and deputise for the Regional Head when required.

What do we need from you
  
  
Candidate Profile
  
  

* 12+ years in Compensation & Benefits/Total Rewards, ideally with multi-country exposure across India and the Middle East.
* Hands-on experience with job evaluation methodologies (e.g., Mercer IPE, Korn Ferry Hay, WTW GGS) and salary surveys.
* Advanced Excel and data modelling skills; working knowledge of Power BI and HCM systems (e.g., SuccessFactors, Workday, Oracle).
* Strong analytical rigour and discretion; confident communicator who turns data into executive-ready insights and thrives in a lean regional team.

title: Benefits Operations Supervisor
description:
**About Rippling**
Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
  
  
Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.
  
  
Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.
  
  
We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.
  
  
**About The Role**
Benefits is one of Rippling's largest and most important product categories, and the Benefits Operations team is critical to getting companies enrolled in the right benefits. The team manages tens of thousands of enrollments every year.
  
  
Rippling is looking for an Operations Supervisor to lead a team of operations specialists to set new operational processes, contribute automation ideas, resolve process gaps and systems issues as they arise, communicate with customers and manually assist until the launch of the product automation, and to help root cause issues and contribute to fixes. This role will require very high ownership and cross-functional engagement across customers, vendors, carriers, and several internal departments such as product, engineering or Sales, and will drive a major impact on the success of Rippling's Benefits product.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Mentor and lead a team of operations associates, provide guidance to ensure smooth completion of tasks, and a great customer experience
* Oversee team operations, metrics / KPI reporting, tooling/product improvements
* Design and revise SOPs, and process documentation to set the team up for success
* Manage complex escalations and issues, communicate with customers or carriers throughout the duration of a project when issues arise
* Work with R&D and other internal stakeholders to root cause issues, come up with process/automation fixes, and help implement fixes to improve the customer experience

title: SPE-HR Operations
description:
**Job Summary**
Your primary responsibilities will include calculating monthly and quarterly commission payouts with high accuracy. You will analyze sales performance data track key metrics identify trends and provide actionable insights to sales leadership. You will also collaborate closely with Human Resources and Finance teams to ensure all compensation plans align perfectly with company budgets and strategic goals.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
The primary responsibility of a sales compensation analyst involves the daily administration and calculation of variable pay programs. You are responsible for accurately computing monthly quarterly and annual commission payouts and bonuses for the entire sales force. This requires cross referencing sales credits attainment metrics and closed deals against internal tracking and billing systems to eliminate payout errors. Additionally you must maintain and update incentive compensation management software with new hire profiles territory shifts and updated quotas to ensure the tracking system reflects current organizational structures.
  
  
Beyond routine administration this role requires deep analysis and strategic modeling to evaluate overall plan effectiveness. You will analyze performance data to see if current incentive structures drive the desired sales behaviors and run scenario models for proposed plans to forecast total spend and protect company margins. Building dashboards for leadership to track overall sales attainment trends and commission return on investment is also a key task. Furthermore you will ensure strict compliance with financial controls maintain proper documentation for all plan exceptions and draft official compensation plan terms and quota letters.
  
  
Finally a sales compensation analyst serves as the main point of contact for the sales team regarding their plan mechanics and commission statements. You will research and resolve commission inquiries and discrepancies quickly to maintain sales force trust and motivation. Conducting training sessions for new sales hires to help them clearly understand how their variable pay is calculated is another essential duty. Through clear communication and accurate math you ensure the sales team remains motivated while keeping the corporate budget secure.

title: Coupa System Specialist
description:
Category: Digital & IT

Location:
Bangalore, Karnataka, IN

**Company: Novo Global Business Services (GBS), Bangalore**

  

**Your impact begins here**

As Coupa System Specialist, you will keep Coupa and its SAP connections running reliably, so invoices move from receipt to payment with less manual work. With a primary focus on Coupa Invoicing, you will fix issues at the root, automate repetitive tasks and help shape digitalisation across the procure-to-pay process. Your work gives finance and procurement colleagues stable, secure systems they can rely on every day, across countries and functions.

  

**What you’ll bring**

* 10+ years of hands-on experience supporting and configuring Coupa, with strong expertise in Coupa Invoicing.
* A solid understanding of procure-to-pay, Accounts Payable, invoice matching, approval workflows and financial controls.
* Experience integrating Coupa with SAP, and an understanding of cross-module process and data dependencies.
* Practical knowledge of APIs, middleware, data mapping, interface monitoring and troubleshooting.
* Experience in application operations, incident and change management, testing and release support.
* The ability to spot automation opportunities and deliver measurable process improvements, including experience with Power Platform and AI tools.
* Strong analytical, communication, documentation and stakeholder management skills.

**Useful, but not essential:**

* A degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Finance or a related discipline, with 10–12 years of IT experience.
* Coupa certification, or relevant implementation and support experience.
* Experience with SAP ECC or SAP S/4HANA, integration platforms, and scripting or automation tools.
* Exposure to electronic invoicing, supplier enablement and multi-country invoice processing.

**What you’ll do**

You will own the day-to-day health of Coupa and its interfaces, and use what you learn to make invoice processing faster, more accurate and more automated.

* Run Coupa operations end to end: monitoring, configuration, maintenance and support. Own incidents, service requests, problems and changes, and resolve them within agreed service levels.
* Investigate root causes of recurring application and interface issues, and put preventive measures in place.
* Manage data flows between Coupa, SAP and other connected systems, covering suppliers, cost centres, general ledger accounts, tax codes, purchase orders, goods receipts, invoices and payment status. Define and maintain interface specifications, field mappings, validation rules and reconciliation procedures.
* Own the operational support and continuous improvement of Coupa Invoicing, from invoice receipt, validation, matching and approval through to transfer to SAP for posting and payment. This includes PO-based and non-PO invoices, credit notes and tax requirements.
* Design and implement enhancements and automation using APIs, integration tools, scripts or workflow capabilities, and translate business needs into functional and technical specifications.
* Coordinate releases, upgrades and regression testing, and keep documentation, procedures and controls current, in line with security, access, audit and change management requirements.

Success looks like stable Coupa operations, reliable SAP interfaces, fewer invoice exceptions, more touchless processing and timely incident resolution.

  

**Who you’ll work with**

You will join Digital Procurement Solutions in Enterprise IT & Quality. The department provides system support for Novo’s finance and procurement processes, keeping Procure-to-Pay solutions stable, secure and optimised so the business can operate efficiently across countries and functions.

Your closest partners will be Accounts Payable, Finance and Procurement colleagues, suppliers, SAP functional and technical teams, and middleware specialists. You will also work with global business partners in supplier management and HR, and with colleagues at HQ, to deliver scalable, future-proof integrations between SAP and Coupa.

The team works with an enterprise mindset, focused on long-term improvements that benefit the whole organisation. Psychological safety is central to how we work. It supports open dialogue, learning and strong performance, and it makes it easier to speak up when something is stalling.

  

**What you can expect here**

You will be trusted to own your area and make your voice heard, with the support of colleagues who share their expertise openly. The role gives you room to grow your skills in integration, automation, Power Platform and AI tools, while taking part in digitalisation initiatives from requirements gathering to adoption.

You will be part of a team that holds high standards, gives and receives honest feedback, and is recognised for delivering results.

  

**Start now**

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to make procure-to-pay faster, more reliable and more automated, apply for the Coupa System Specialist role by 17 November 2026.

title: Product Stream Lead - Payment Exceptions & Investigations
description:
**Organization:**

At CommBank, we never lose sight of the role we play in other people’s financial wellbeing. Our focus is to help people and businesses move forward to progress. To make the right financial decisions and achieve their dreams, targets, and aspirations. Regardless of where you work within our organisation, your initiative, talent, ideas, and energy all contribute to the impact that we can make with our work. Together we can achieve great things.

  

**Job Title:** Product Stream Lead - Payment Exceptions & Investigations

**Location:** Bangalore

  

**Business & Team:**

Payments work brilliantly when everything goes right. The real test is what happens when they do not. A payment may be rejected, delayed, returned or held; a customer may send funds to the wrong account; an international payment may need to be traced or recalled; or an operations team may need to investigate an ambiguous payment state across multiple systems and external institutions. Today these journeys can span payment rails, customer and banker channels, payment platforms, operational work queues, case-management tools, risk teams and external financial institutions. We want to fundamentally change that experience.

  

Within the Payments Servicing Solutions Crew, we are shaping a channel-agnostic Payment Exception and Investigation capability that brings these journeys together. The ambition is one reusable product capability across Australian domestic and international payment exceptions - connecting customers, bankers, operations teams, payment platforms and external institutions while preserving clear system ownership and controls. This is an opportunity to build an enduring payments product, not simply deliver another workflow or operations screen. You will help shape a capability that can progressively move exception handling from manual investigation to intelligent assistance, straight-through processing and, ultimately, proactive exception prevention.

  

**Impact and Contribution:**

As Product Stream Lead - Payment Exceptions & Investigations, you will lead the product vision, strategy and evolution of this capability within the Payments Servicing Solutions Crew. You will connect customer insight, operational pain points, payments expertise, enterprise priorities, technology possibilities and risk considerations into a clear product strategy and executable roadmap.

  

You will lead across related squads and partner closely with Product Leads, Product Managers, Engineering, Architecture, Payments Operations, Digital Channels, frontline teams, Financial Crime, Risk, Legal and Compliance. You will create alignment around shared outcomes, make evidence-based investment and sequencing trade-offs, and ensure the product is run safely and sustainably.

  

The product vision extends beyond a new workbench. It is about creating an intelligent payment exception orchestration capability that can ingest and correlate events from multiple rails and channels, create a consistent case and investigation journey, orchestrate controlled resolution actions, provide transparent status back to customers and colleagues, and use data and intelligence to improve both resolution and prevention.

  

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Define and communicate the product vision, strategy and multi-year roadmap for payment exceptions and investigations across domestic and international payments.
* Lead cross-squad prioritisation, sequencing and investment trade-offs, balancing customer value, operational efficiency, risk reduction, technology simplification and commercial outcomes.
* Build reusable product capabilities rather than point solutions for individual rails, channels, systems or operational teams.
* Deeply understand how exceptions arise across payment initiation, execution, settlement, investigations, trace and recall, returns, repairs, failed payments and servicing journeys.
* Shape simple experiences for retail and business customers, bankers/frontline colleagues, investigators and payment operations teams, with consistent status and required-action visibility across channels.
* Lead product outcomes for case and investigation management, event intake and correlation, workflow orchestration, operational work management, evidence and audit, communications and controlled resolution actions.
* Identify journeys that can move from manual handling to assisted resolution and straight-through processing, with clear policy, eligibility, approval and control boundaries.
* Partner with Engineering and Architecture to shape scalable APIs, event-driven integration, reusable channel experiences and clean ownership boundaries between servicing channels, exception orchestration and payment execution platforms.
* Explore practical applications of AI and agentic workflows for context reconstruction, classification, summarisation, investigation planning, next-best-action, response drafting and cross-case root-cause intelligence.
* Ensure AI-enabled outcomes are explainable, evidence-backed, auditable and appropriately bounded by human accountability and risk controls.
* Use customer, operational and product data to identify exception patterns and upstream causes, creating a prevention backlog that reduces avoidable exceptions over time.
* Define and own measurable outcomes including resolution time, STP rate, repeat contact, touches per case, queue ageing, SLA performance, customer-update timeliness, control effectiveness, colleague adoption and exception reduction.
Coach and develop Product Leads and Product Managers, building strong product discipline and a culture of ownership, curiosity and continuous improvement.  

  

**Essential Skills:**

  

* Bring significant **product leadership experience** , leading complex products or value streams from strategy through execution and value realisation.
* Have strong **payments expertise** , including domestic and/or international payments, processing, settlement and servicing.
* Understand payment ecosystems such as **NPP, BECS/Direct Entry, BPAY, RTGS/HVCS, SWIFT and correspondent banking** .
* Have experience across **payment investigations and exceptions** , including trace and recall, returns, repairs and failed or mistaken payments.
* Have built or transformed **workflow, servicing, case-management or platform products** within regulated financial services.
* Can turn fragmented processes and legacy journeys into **scalable product capabilities** , balancing long-term vision with pragmatic delivery.
* Have driven **automation and straight-through processing** across complex operational journeys.
* Bring strong commercial judgement and can make clear **investment, prioritisation and scope trade-offs** .
* Can influence across **Product, Technology, Operations and Risk** , embedding controls and operational resilience into product design.
* Are curious about **AI and emerging technology** , while distinguishing genuine customer and operational value from hype.
* Build high-performing teams and **coach and develop product talent** .

  

**Payments, Automation & Emerging Technology**

This is not an AI-first role. It is an opportunity to shape how automation and emerging technology can safely transform a complex, high-volume payments environment.

* Move journeys from manual handling toward **intelligent assistance, bounded automation and straight-through processing** .
* Determine where **deterministic workflows** are best and where AI can improve investigations, context-building and next-best actions.
* Explore **agentic and orchestration approaches** while retaining appropriate human oversight.
* Establish clear guardrails around **approval, explainability, traceability, auditability, privacy and access** .
* Use exception and outcome data to move from **exception resolution toward exception prevention** .

  

**The Mindset We’re Looking For**

* **Think product, not project:** Build enduring capabilities and measure outcomes, not just delivery.
* **Start with the customer:** Connect customer needs to the complex payments ecosystem behind them.
* **Simplify complexity:** Turn multiple rails, systems and stakeholders into a clear strategy.
* **Own the outcome:** Lead from strategy and discovery through delivery, adoption and value realisation.
* **Challenge constructively:** Question legacy processes with evidence, courage and respect.
* **Collaborate without ego:** Align Product, Engineering, Operations, Architecture and Risk around shared outcomes.
* **Innovate responsibly:** Pursue automation and AI while protecting trust, safety and human accountability.
* **Lift others:** Coach, share context and strengthen the wider product community.

  

**Education Qualification:**

Bachelors or Master's Degree in any stream

description:
* Permanent Contract

* Associate

About Us

  
  

Egis is a global organisation with over 23,500 employees worldwide. With our head office based in Paris, we offer global career opportunities, as well as offer rewarding careers for our people locally.

Egis is an organisation with a capacity to make meaningful industry and community change in the space of place-making, sustainability and creating connected cities. Different to other engineering firms, Egis offers true end-to-end capability across the entire design-to-operation lifecycle, offering advisory, architecture, engineering, design, asset management and operations services.

We are committed to creating great teams doing innovative work and would love **you** to join us to **Impact the Future.**

  
  

About the Role

  
  

Role Purpose

Act as the analytical engine and trusted deputy to the Regional Head of Total Rewards, driving the design, delivery and governance of competitive, cost-effective and compliant Compensation & Benefits programmes across MESA. The role combines strong technical reward expertise with strong hands-on analytics and partnering with HR, Finance, Group Reward and business leaders as necessary.

Key Responsibilities – Compensation

* **Job Architecture:** Maintain job families, levelling and grade/title mapping; support job evaluation and consistent role governance across countries.
* **Pay Bands & Structures:** Build and refresh salary ranges (min/mid/max, spreads, midpoint progression); monitor compa-ratios and range penetration.
* **Market Benchmarking:** Manage salary survey participation (e.g., Mercer, Aon, Korn ferry) and job matching; deliver market positioning analysis by country, sector and level.
* **Harmonization:** Lead pay and grade harmonization for M&A, restructuring and legacy entities, including gap analysis, cost modelling and transition plans.
* **Annual Salary Review & Incentives:** Run ASR/merit cycles, budget modelling and merit matrices; support STI/bonus design, payouts.
* **Pay Equity, Offers & Allowances:** Conduct internal equity reviews; advise on offers, promotions and salary corrections; govern allowance and expat/mobility packages.

Key Responsibilities – Benefits & Insurance

* **Insurance Programmes:** Manage group medical, life and personal accident policies; lead annual renewals with brokers and insurers (RFPs, negotiations, plan design options).
* **Claims & Cost Analytics:** Analyse claims experience, loss ratios and utilisation trends; project renewal costs and recommend cost-containment levers.
* **Statutory & Retirement Benefits:** Ensure compliance with country requirements (e.g., End-of-service benefits, GOSI/pension schemes, mandatory health cover etc).
* **Benchmarking, Wellbeing & Vendors:** Benchmark benefits against market practice; support wellbeing and flexible benefits; manage broker/TPA SLAs, employee communications.

Key Responsibilities – Governance, Analytics & Partnering

* **Policy & Governance:** Draft and maintain reward policies, approval matrices and audit-ready documentation; ensure alignment with Regional & Group Reward frameworks.
* **Reward Analytics:** Build dashboards, cost models and scenario analyses; ensure HCM/HRIS reward data accuracy and integrity.
* **Operations & Shared Services Partnership:** As policy owner, partner with Operations and Shared Services teams who execute reward transactions; define clear process guidelines, controls and checks to ensure accurate, compliant and consistent delivery and data integrity.
* **Partnering & Deputising:** Prepare leadership-ready decks and approval notes; act as first point of contact for HRBPs and Finance, and deputise for the Regional Head when required.
  

  

What do we need from you

  
  

Candidate Profile

* 12+ years in Compensation & Benefits/Total Rewards, ideally with multi-country exposure across India and the Middle East.
* Hands-on experience with job evaluation methodologies (e.g., Mercer IPE, Korn Ferry Hay, WTW GGS) and salary surveys.
* Advanced Excel and data modelling skills; working knowledge of Power BI and HCM systems (e.g., SuccessFactors, Workday, Oracle).
* Strong analytical rigour and discretion; confident communicator who turns data into executive-ready insights and thrives in a lean regional team.

title: Product Design Lead, AI Governance
description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

At Rippling, Design is central to our mission to free smart people to tackle hard problems. We build products that automate the operational complexity of running a business, from HR and payroll to IT and finance, so our customers can focus on what matters most.

As a Product Design Lead on the IT team, you’ll play a key role in shaping AI governance at Rippling. You’ll help IT and security teams understand how AI is being used across their organizations, manage risk, and enable employees to adopt AI safely.

You’ll own end-to-end product experiences across new 0-1 bets and evolving products. You’ll turn technically complex, ambiguous problems into clear workflows that balance ease of use, control, security, and trust.

Success in this role requires a designer who thrives in fast-paced environments, develops deep customer and domain expertise, and partners closely with Product, Engineering, Research, Data, go-to-market, and customer-facing teams. Designers at Rippling are product builders. AI isn’t just something we design, it’s fundamental to how we work, from exploration and prototyping to shipping customer experiences.

This role is based in Bangalore and will collaborate closely with teams across India and North America.

### **What you will do**

* Help define long-term and AI-first strategies for AI governance, translating ambitious product opportunities into clear experience goals.
* Own significant workstreams from discovery and problem framing through launch, learning, and iteration.
* Design new 0-1 experiences, improve and expand existing workflows, and execute the detailed work required to ship polished products.
* Design for IT administrators, security teams, technology leaders, and employees, making everyday workflows simple while preserving the control and depth advanced customers require.
* Shape interaction models for complex workflows involving permissions, risk, automation, and AI systems, accounting for dependencies, edge cases, and second-order effects.
* Build deep customer and domain knowledge through research, customer conversations, product data, competitive analysis, and feedback from go-to-market teams.
* Collaborate tightly with Product, Engineering, and Research to make high-velocity decisions, test assumptions, unblock dependencies, and ship with a high quality bar.

### **What you will need**

* 8+ years of end-to-end product design experience shipping complex, high-impact products from concept through launch and iteration.
* A portfolio demonstrating strong product judgment, systems thinking, interaction design, and visual craft, particularly in complex or ambiguous domains.
* Experience designing technically complex products with deep workflows, permissions, platform dependencies, or enterprise-grade controls.
* Strong interaction and visual design skills, including the ability to produce polished work across states and edge cases and communicate clear, build-ready specifications.
* Technical curiosity and comfort collaborating with engineers on AI systems, model behavior, evaluations, agentic workflows, MCPs, or related concepts. Expertise in every area is not expected.
* Active use of LLMs and AI-assisted prototyping tools, such as ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, or Claude Code, for research, synthesis, exploration, prototyping, or communication.
* Relentless customer focus, with a habit of investigating real behavior, validating assumptions, and solving meaningful problems.
* Excellent communication and storytelling, from crisp async writing to persuasive presentations that drive alignment and decisions.
* A track record of partnering effectively with Product and Engineering, managing multiple workstreams, unblocking dependencies, and owning timelines with minimal oversight.

**Director, Global HR M&A Strategic Deals Leader**

### **Leading at Cognizant**

This is a Leadership role at Cognizant. We believe how you lead is as important as what you deliver. Cognizant leaders at every level: Drive our business strategy and inspire teams around our future. Live the leadership behaviors, leading themselves, others and the business. Uphold our Values, role modeling them in every action and decision. Nurture our people and culture, creating a workplace where all can thrive.

At Cognizant, leadership transcends titles and is embodied in actions and behaviors. We empower our leaders at every level to drive business strategy, inspire teams, uphold our values, and foster an inclusive culture.

### **About the role**

As a Director, Global HR M&A Strategic Deals Leader, you will make an impact by shaping the people strategy and execution for large-scale outsourcing, rebadging, transformation, and selected M&A opportunities across APAC. You will partner with Business Unit and SBU leaders, Solution Teams, Deal Architects, Legal, Compliance, Employee Relations, senior client stakeholders, and executive sponsors to support revenue-generating deals from pursuit through Day-1 integration and post-transfer execution.

You will also lead the APAC operations team responsible for workforce analysis, HR compliance, compensation and offer development, employee transfer documentation, transition governance, and operational support for rebadging and selected M&A transactions.

### **In this role, you will:**

* Lead HR workstreams for large, complex strategic outsourcing and rebadging deals from qualification, pursuit, and RFI/RFP response through negotiation, closure, and execution.
* Shape workforce transition and employee transfer strategies across APAC, balancing client requirements, employee experience, legal compliance, employment risk, and commercial objectives.
* Lead due diligence, employee consultation, compensation alignment, offer management, retention planning, transition readiness, Day-1 integration, and post-transfer activities.
* Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders, CHROs, Legal leaders, executive sponsors, and BU/SBU leaders; serve as the HR subject matter expert in client discussions, solution design, town halls, and executive presentations.
* Lead and develop Regional HR Strategic Deal Leads and the APAC rebadging operations team, establishing scalable operating models, controls, governance, reporting, execution frameworks, and consistent delivery quality.
* Consistently demonstrate the Cognizant Way to Lead, which means operating with Personal Leadership (building trust, collaboration, and inclusion), Organizational Leadership (driving vision and purpose, demonstrating a strategic and enterprise mindset, and creating and communicating a bold direction that inspires purpose), and Business Leadership (exemplifying client focus, managing ambiguity with accountability and results, and operating with financial acumen).

### **What you need to have to be considered**

* 15+ years of progressive HR experience, including 8+ years supporting outsourcing, rebadging, HR M&A, or strategic deal programs.
* Proven experience partnering with business leaders on large-scale transformation, outsourcing, and revenue-generating engagements.
* Deep understanding of APAC labor laws, employee transfer regulations, workforce transition frameworks, consultation obligations, works council requirements, and employment risk mitigation.
* Experience leading geographically dispersed teams and providing coaching, governance, and execution oversight across regional strategic deal teams.
* Strong client-facing capability and executive stakeholder management experience, including participation in due diligence, negotiations, solution design, and executive presentations.
* Ability to lead workforce analytics, compensation benchmarking, offer development, HR compliance reviews, employee transfer documentation, transition governance, and reporting.
* Embodiment of the Cognizant Way to Lead: Leading Self, Leading Others, and Leading the Business.
* Embodiment of Cognizant's Values: Work as One, Dare to Innovate, Raise the Bar, Do the Right Thing, and Own It.

**Corporate Strategic Alignment**

* Engage with senior BU leads to align HR solution in coordination with business objectives and growth strategy
* Lead on the building and deployment of best practice to support strategic deals
* Align with cross functional teams to improve process efficiencies to achieve quicker revenue experience.
* Coach internal stakeholders and key decision makers on HR strategic deals processes and risk sensitivities
* Build systematic best practice and continuous improvement into Cognizant’s deal operating model.

**Global Team Development**

* Responsible for planning hiring upskilling and managing succession for team personnel
* Demonstrate and champion expected leadership behaviors
* Building a culture of development coaching and learning within the team
* Provide direct oversight career management and coaching support for senior leaders of the strategic deals team

### **These will help you succeed**

* Experience in IT Services, Business Process Services, Consulting, or Global Capability Centers.
* Background supporting multi-country outsourcing, managed services, or digital transformation deals.
* Experience supporting transactions exceeding $50M in annual contract value.
* Exposure to the HR aspects of mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, or integration programs

### **Work model**

This role is based in India, with Hyderabad or Chennai preferred. The specific working arrangement and office attendance expectations will be communicated during the hiring process and will be based on business, project, and client requirements.

The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you are engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured, we will always be clear about role expectations.

title: Assistant Manager- HRBP
description:
**Assistant Manager – HRBP**

Company: MrMed – Eazymed Technologies Pvt. Ltd.

Industry: HealthTech | E-commerce | Specialty Pharmacy

Location: Royapettah, Chennai

Qualification: MBA (HR / Human Resources preferred)

Experience: 5–8 years

Employment Type: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from Office – 6 days a week

  
  

**About** **MrMed**

MrMed is a fast-growing digital healthcare platform committed to making specialty and life-saving medicines accessible and affordable across India. We support patients battling chronic and critical illnesses by simplifying access to high-cost therapies and providing end-to-end assistance throughout their treatment journey.

  
  

At MrMed, we are driven by empathy, integrity, and a deep commitment to improving patient lives. We foster a transparent, collaborative, and growth-oriented culture where individuals are empowered to take ownership, innovate, and create meaningful impact.

  
  

**Role Summary**

We are looking for an experienced and people-focused Assistant Manager – HRBP to partner with functional heads and managers at MrMed and drive the people agenda across the employee lifecycle. The role involves understanding business goals and workforce needs, supporting workforce planning and talent acquisition, driving performance management and engagement, handling employee relations, and building HR processes and analytics in a fast-paced, startup environment.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

* **HR Business Partnering:** Partner with functional heads and managers to understand business goals, workforce needs, and people challenges, and provide practical HR solutions.

* **Workforce Planning & Budgeting:** Prepare manpower plans, identify hiring priorities, track headcount, and align workforce requirements with business budgets.

* **Talent Acquisition Coordination:** Work closely with the Talent Acquisition team on critical hiring, role prioritization, hiring timelines, and workforce requirements.

* **Performance Management:** Drive goal setting, OKRs/KPIs, mid-year and annual appraisals, performance reviews, and performance improvement plans (PIPs).

* **Employee Engagement & Retention:** Develop engagement initiatives, identify attrition risks, conduct stay and exit interviews, and improve employee retention.

* **Employee Relations & Grievance Handling:** Address employee concerns, resolve workplace conflicts, handle disciplinary matters, and ensure fair and consistent practices.

* **Organisation Development (OD):** Support organisation design, role clarity, competency frameworks, succession planning, and leadership development.

* **Learning & Development:** Conduct Training Needs Analysis (TNA), identify capability gaps, and coordinate functional and leadership development initiatives.

* **Compensation & Benefits:** Support salary reviews, compensation benchmarking, appraisal budgets, internal parity, and retention-related compensation decisions.

* **HR Policies & Compliance:** Develop and implement HR policies, maintain statutory compliance, and ensure consistent application of company policies.

* **Employee Lifecycle Management:** Manage onboarding, probation reviews, confirmation, internal movements, employee documentation, and exit formalities.

* **HR Analytics & MIS:** Track headcount, attrition, hiring performance, employee costs, engagement, and other people metrics to support data-driven decisions.

* **Stakeholder Management:** Work closely with founders, leadership, and functional managers to resolve people challenges and drive accountability.

* **Startup Agility & Execution:** Build and improve HR processes from the ground up, manage competing priorities, and execute effectively in a fast-paced environment.

* **HRMS & Process Automation:** Manage HRMS processes, maintain accurate employee data, improve HR workflows, and reduce manual work.

  
  

**Qualifications & Skills**

* MBA / PGDM in HR or Human Resources Management preferred.

* 5–8 years of experience in HR Business Partnering or generalist HR, preferably in a startup, e-commerce, healthcare, or fast-growing organisation.

* Strong understanding of HR Business Partnering, workforce planning and budgeting, and talent acquisition coordination.

* Hands-on experience in performance management (OKRs/KPIs, appraisals, PIPs), employee engagement, and retention.

* Sound knowledge of employee relations, grievance handling, and disciplinary processes.

* Exposure to organisation development, learning & development, and compensation & benefits.

* Working knowledge of HR policies, statutory compliance, and employee lifecycle management.

* Proficiency in HR analytics and MIS, with strong Excel skills and experience with HRMS tools.

* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work closely with founders, leadership, and functional managers.

* Startup agility – ability to build HR processes from the ground up, manage competing priorities, and execute in a fast-paced environment.

* Excellent communication, problem-solving, and people-management skills.

  
  

**What You Will Contribute**

* Act as a trusted people partner to business leaders, aligning HR priorities with business goals.

* Strengthen performance management, engagement, and retention practices across teams.

* Build scalable HR processes, policies, and data-driven reporting as the organisation grows.

* Support a fair, transparent, and compliant workplace culture that reflects MrMed’s values.

  
  

**Why Join MrMed?**

At MrMed, the right people practices help us support patients who depend on specialty and life-saving medicines. As part of a patient-focused digital healthcare platform, you will help build and retain the teams that make specialty healthcare more accessible and affordable.

You will work closely with founders, leadership, and cross-functional teams in a collaborative environment that values ownership, integrity, continuous improvement, and customer focus. This role offers the opportunity to shape HR processes from the ground up and contribute directly to the growth of MrMed.

  
  

**Note:** Interested candidates please share resumes to hr@mrmed.in

title: Human Resources Coordinator
description:
**About This Role**

The Human Resources Coordinator serves as a first point of contact for employees, providing timely and professional support for day-to-day HR questions and requests. This role handles queries related to payroll, benefits, onboarding, offboarding, timekeeping, HR policies, and other employee matters, while coordinating with the appropriate teams when further assistance is needed.

This fast-paced, employee-focused role requires strong communication, problem-solving, attention to detail, and the ability to manage sensitive HR matters while delivering a positive employee experience.

**What You'll Do**

1. Serve as the first point of contact for employees, handling day-to-day HR queries related to payroll, benefits, onboarding, offboarding, timekeeping, policies, and other HR matters.
2. Communicate with employees through email, phone, and chat to understand their questions or concerns, provide guidance, and resolve queries within the scope of the role.
3. Research and troubleshoot employee issues, and escalate or route complex queries to the appropriate HR, Payroll, Benefits, IT, or other teams for further resolution.
4. Support employee Onboarding and Offboarding activities, ensuring employees receive timely information and a smooth experience throughout the process.
5. Follow up on escalated queries as needed to ensure timely resolution and provide clear communication back to the employee.
6. Document employee inquiries, actions taken, and resolutions accurately in the HR service delivery platform.
7. Serve as a point of contact for full-time employees and Independent Contractors and provide appropriate HR support.
8. Handle and represent the company in exit-related matters, including employee questions and clarifications.
9. Gather and validate required employee documents and information.
10. Update employee information accurately in HRIS and PowerApps.
11. Support employment verification requests for current and former employees.
12. Troubleshoot HRIS account issues and login requests and coordinate with the appropriate teams for resolution.
13. Maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgment when handling sensitive employee information and concerns.
14. Provide project and administrative support to the HR team as needed to meet business needs.

**What You’ll Need to Succeed**

1. **2–3 years of experience in Human Resources, HR Operations, Employee Services, or a related field.**
2. Customer service experience
3. Proficient in Microsoft Office, especially Excel.
4. Strong verbal and written communication; effective at managing relationships and sensitive HR matters.
5. Skilled in prioritizing, multitasking, and meeting deadlines.
6. Capable of researching issues and delivering thoughtful solutions.
7. Passionate about helping others and creating a welcoming environment.
8. Discreet, patient, calm under pressure, and enjoys coaching and advising others.

* Track hiring metrics such as time-to-hire, cost-per-hire and offer-acceptance rate.

2. Employee Engagement & Retention

* Plan and run engagement initiatives, team events, recognition programs and festival celebrations.
* Conduct regular check-ins, pulse surveys and stay interviews to understand employee sentiment.
* Act as the first point of contact for employee concerns and resolve grievances fairly and confidentially.
* Track attrition, analyse exit trends and recommend retention actions.
* Help shape a positive, transparent and performance-driven culture.

3. Training & Development

* Identify skill gaps with managers and design training plans for technical, behavioral and compliance needs.
* Organize internal workshops, external trainings and learning programs within budget.
* Support the performance review process, goal setting (OKRs/KRAs) and feedback cycles.
* Maintain training records and measure the effectiveness of programs.

4. Monthly Payroll Management

* Own end-to-end monthly payroll: attendance and leave inputs, salary calculations, variable pay, reimbursements and deductions.
* Ensure accurate and timely salary disbursement and payslip generation.
* Process statutory deductions and filings: PF, ESI, Professional Tax, TDS and Labour Welfare Fund, as applicable.
* Coordinate with finance/accounts for payroll funding, reconciliation and reporting.
* Manage payroll software or vendors and maintain payroll data integrity.
* Handle employee payroll queries, Form 16 and investment declaration processes.

5. Full & Final (FNF) Settlement and Exits

* Manage the complete exit process: resignation acceptance, notice period tracking, handover, exit interviews and clearance.
* Calculate and process FNF settlements, including notice pay, leave encashment, gratuity, bonus and recoveries.
* Issue relieving and experience letters and ensure timely closure of statutory exit formalities.
* Capture exit feedback and share insights with leadership.

6. Employee Communication

* Draft and share clear HR communications: policy updates, announcements, holiday calendars, appraisal timelines and org changes.
* Maintain an HR helpdesk or channel for employee queries with fast turnaround.
* Support leadership in internal communication, town halls and change announcements.
* Create and maintain the employee handbook and HR FAQs.

7. HR Compliance & Policies

* Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws and statutory requirements, including the Shops & Establishment Act, PF, ESI, Gratuity, Bonus, Maternity Benefit and POSH.
* Draft, implement and update HR policies (leave, attendance, code of conduct, work-from-home, expense and exit).
* Maintain accurate employee records, contracts and personnel files; support audits and inspections.
* Constitute and maintain the Internal Committee (POSH) and ensure annual compliance and awareness.
* Keep track of statutory due dates and law changes, working with external consultants where needed.

Required Qualifications & Skills

* MBA/PGDM in HR or a related field (preferred) or a graduate degree with relevant HR experience.
* 3–6 years of experience in HR generalist roles, with at least 2 years of direct payroll handling.
* Strong knowledge of payroll processing and Indian statutory compliance (PF, ESI, PT, TDS, Gratuity).
* Experience with HRMS/payroll tools (e.g., Zoho People, Payroll or similar) and proficiency in MS Excel/Google Sheets.
* Proven experience in end-to-end recruitment and FNF processing.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with high attention to detail and confidentiality.
* Comfortable working independently in a fast-paced, ambiguous startup environment.

Good to Have

* Experience building HR processes and policies from scratch.
* Exposure to tech or product startups and scaling teams from 20 to 200+.
* Knowledge of performance management frameworks such as OKRs.

What We Offer

* High ownership and direct access to founders and leadership
* Opportunity to build the HR function from the ground up
* Learning-driven, flexible and collaborative work culture

title: Team Member - Group Wellbeing & People Insights
description:
**Function:**
Human Resources

**Reports to:**
Chief Talent Officer

**Location:**
Kurla, Mumbai

**Role type:**
Individual contributor; works with a wide network of HR, business and partner stakeholders

**Role Purpose:**

This role sits in the Corporate HR team and delivers firm-wide wellbeing programmes and firm-level people insights for senior leadership. It also provides analytical support to the Benefits team, coordinates HR data for regulatory and public disclosures, and contributes to priority HR projects.

The incumbent is expected to produce credible data and insights, run high-quality wellbeing programmes, and work effectively with business-unit HR teams without formal authority, while building expertise in benefits and total rewards.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Wellbeing Programmes & Wellspring (≈35%)**

* Run Wellspring, the firm-wide wellbeing learning platform, end to end: topic calendar, identification and briefing of expert faculty with partners, invitations and communication, session delivery and post-session feedback.
* Plan and run wellbeing campaigns that drive awareness and uptake of available benefits, such as annual health check-ups, teleconsultation and other health services.
* Measure the impact of wellbeing programmes (attendance, band and location mix, feedback / NPS, repeat participation) and share concise updates with HR leadership.
* Create employee-friendly wellbeing communication (mailers, FAQs, short explainers) in line with the firm’s tone and brand.
* Coordinate with wellbeing partners on programme content and quality, and use employee feedback to improve offerings.

**2. People Insights & Listening (≈25%)**

* Analyse group-level employee listening and engagement data (including the Tara listening platform) and translate it into concise insight notes for the CHRO, MD & CEO and Chairman.
* Run cohort analyses (tenure, band, function, location, gender) on engagement, attrition and wellbeing, and identify themes that require leadership attention.

**3. Benefits Design – Support (≈15%)**

* Support the Benefits team through the group medical insurance (GMC) renewal cycle: data preparation, claims and utilisation analysis, and preparation of options and presentations.
* Assist with benefits benchmarking against financial-services peers and provide research inputs for policy reviews.
* Help prepare cost, uptake and outcome analyses that feed into benefits and wellbeing business cases.
* Build working knowledge of benefits design, insurance and total-rewards principles as part of the role’s development path.

**4. Regulatory & Disclosure HR data (≈10%)**

* Coordinate HR data for regulatory requests (including RBI inspection and compliance data requirements) and for the human-capital sections of the Integrated Annual Report and ESG disclosures, consolidating inputs from business-unit HR, Talent Acquisition and Learning & Development.
* Maintain an HR Data Book with standard metric definitions, data sources, owners and prior-year submissions, so that figures are consistent, reconciled and request-ready.

**5. Strategic HR projects (≈10%)**

* Contribute to priority HR initiatives identified by the Chief Talent Officer from time to time, taking responsibility for defined workstreams: research, analysis, project planning, stakeholder coordination and delivery.
* Use these assignments to gain exposure across HR sub-functions and to senior leadership agendas, as part of the role’s development path.

**Success Measures (first 12 months)**

1. **Wellbeing & Wellspring:**
   Wellspring calendar delivered with participation and feedback tracked; improved uptake of key wellbeing benefits (e.g., annual health check-ups) against an agreed baseline.
2. **People Insights:**
   Regular leadership insight notes in place; recurring reporting standardised or partner-produced.
3. **Benefits Support:**
   Timely, accurate analytical support to the Benefits team through the GMC renewal cycle.
4. **Regulatory & Disclosure Data:**
   HR Data Book in place within 6 months; regulatory and annual-report data delivered on time, consistent and reconciled.
5. **Strategic HR Projects:**
   Assigned project workstreams delivered to agreed scope, quality and timelines.

**Person Specification**

1. **Education:**
   MBA / PGDM in Human Resources from a Tier 1 or strong Tier 2 institute
2. **Experience:**
   2–4 years post-MBA, including at least 2 years in HR analytics, employee engagement / wellbeing, HR governance or compensation & benefits; financial services / NBFC / banking exposure preferred
3. **Regulatory Exposure:**
   Exposure to preparing HR data for regulators, auditors, annual reports or ESG disclosures is an advantage
4. **Organisation Context:**
   Has worked in a matrixed organisation and delivered results without direct authority
5. **Analytical & Technical:**
   Advanced Excel and Power BI (or equivalent); strong data-validation discipline
6. **Programmes & Communication:**
   Experience running employee programmes or campaigns; writes crisp one-page notes for senior leadership and engaging, employee-friendly communication
7. **Behaviours:**
   Rigorous and detail-conscious; drive for results, influence without authority, collaborative across HR teams; eager to learn; high integrity with confidential data

**Career Path**

The role is designed as a launch pad within core HR. Over a 2–3 year horizon, successful incumbents can progress to roles such as Compensation & Benefits / Total Rewards, HR Business Partner etc.

***Piramal is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will be considered without regard to age, gender, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, or religion.***
