title: Talent Partner
description:
**Kulfi Collective**

**Talent Partner (Talent Acquisition)**

Role
**Talent Partner (Sr. Associate / Lead)**

Reporting to
**VP, Talent & Community**

Type
**Full-Time**

Location
**Worli, Mumbai (Hybrid)**

**THE KIND OF WORK YOU'LL SHAPE**

Remember Air? Sonny Vaccaro spotted Michael Jordan before anyone else. He pitched Jordan to Nike, and Nike to Jordan. That's the job.

We're not looking for a recruiter who fills roles when they open. We're looking for a talent partner who is always scouting, always pitching, and always finding the missing piece that makes the whole team think sharper.

**THE ROLE**

The role is across hiring, talent strategy, talent IPs and talent-first employer branding. Discovering exceptional talent is always on and runs alongside all of it, because each feeds the other.

Creatives, strategists, technologists, brand partnerships. Full-time and freelance. Your job is to raise Kulfi's talent density, not just fill seats.

**WHAT YOU'LL DRIVE**

**Discover, connect, pitch, close**

* Discover and speak to industry people every week, across India and internationally. Know what good work looks like and who's behind it, on LinkedIn, Instagram, X and Reddit
* Spot emerging and established talent doing career-defining work, and know exactly which person would elevate which team at Kulfi, and why
* Build relationships long before a role opens. Pitch talent internally with conviction, and pitch Kulfi externally as the next best place to work
* Close full-time hiring requirements and own the process end-to-end, from the moment a role opens to the day someone joins. Partner with hiring managers on what the team is actually missing
* Own the candidate experience, so every interaction feels thoughtful and personal

**Build talent strategy, IPs and programs**

* Work with the VP, Talent & Community to shape and build talent strategy: the programs that make Kulfi the employer of choice
* Conceptualise and run talent IPs like residencies, associate programs, internships and campus collaborations. Track the best of these nationally and internationally, bring the best ideas home, and build the systems that make them run brilliantly
* Meet talent where they are: campuses, communities and creative circles. Open them up to Kulfi so that when they look for their next move, Kulfi is their first choice
* Explore AI tools and workflows that make scouting, hiring and programs sharper and faster

**WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE DIFFERENT**

* This is a talent partner role, not a recruiter or coordinator role. You'll have real influence over who Kulfi becomes
* Proactive, not reactive. Your pipeline exists before the role does
* Strategy, programs and employer branding are part of the job from day one

* 1 to 3 years in talent acquisition, HR, partnerships, events, or any role that taught you to recognise and partner with great talent and build teams

* You know where the people are, and how to get to them
* You love meeting new people, hold conversations that keep them interested, and keep relationships warm long after the first chat

title: Seasonal MyHR Live Support Sr. Advisor
description:
**Description**
The My HR Live Support (MHLS) team is currently seeking to hire an MHLS Sr. Advisor to support our Tier 2 Specialty Operation. The MHLS Tier 2 Specialty Team primarily provides customer service to Amazon employees through phone, chat, ticketing, and cases related to payroll, disability, policies, among others. This role will act as a point of contact for the team, offering immediate assistance on complex issues and handling challenging contacts. The Sr. Advisors provide case consultations and overall resolution and support for all types of leaves of absence and disability life events to our Amazon employees. They are highly skilled in answering questions, obtaining the right information from SOPs and knowledge centers, providing direct support through different live and written channels, understanding the employee’s situation, applying appropriate benefits, responding to changing circumstances; and paves the way for a connected and trusted case management experience. The Sr. Advisor will also escalate trends to management to address any training or quality gaps identified.
  
  
The ideal candidate will possess exceptional communication and organizational skills, a keen attention to detail, the ability to prioritize in a fast-paced environment, strong relationship-building and influencing abilities, robust analytical and critical thinking skills, and a customer service focus that aligns with Amazon's global standards.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Respond to inquiries about disability and leave events, time-off, payments, and work-related situations available to employees.
* Inbound and Outbound phone, chat and case support through the Specialized Support Queues.
* Serve as a point of contact for employees to provide holistic case management services, including medical documentation review to adjudicate compliance with corresponding leave plans, federal and state laws and benefit plans as defined by Amazon.
* Critically assess and adjust the case management plan to an employee’s changing needs.
* Address and respond to sensitive situations in benefit of employee experience and attempt to de-escalate complex cases.
* Manage own workload effectively to meet productivity goals and escalate when significant changes or gaps in assigned workload arise.
* Troubleshoot issues and seek to remove barriers before, during, or after a leave event.
* Respond to employee impacting issues that may arise during the leave event and ensure the right communication and documentation occurs, even when information is limited.
* Use good judgement and rationale to balance process adherence with employee’s needs to analyze and decide on disability, leave and benefits requests.
* Facilitate a smooth return to work and ramp-back plan for employees returning to the workplace.
* Educate managers and business partners on employee concerns and needs prior to starting a leave or returning back to work.
* Communicate regular updates to employees and stakeholders both verbally and in writing.
* Ensure compliance with standard work, federal/state regulations, and company policy.
* Maintain system records to ensure accurate and timely information/documentation.
* Consult, coordinate and partner with our third-party administrator, local HR, Safety, Legal, Payroll, Benefits team members and other support units as appropriate.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree from accredited university or equivalent experience
* Demonstrated a strong customer obsession, ability to dive deep, bias for action, and high-level judgement on complex cases
* Intermediate proficiency in MS Word, Excel, Access, Outlook and PowerPoint
* Minimum of 1 year experience in customer service or Human Resource management or Case management or Leave & Disability management role
* Ability to work a flexible schedule, including night shifts, and willingness to work overtime or on the 6th day as needed

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 2 to 3 years of experience in Human Resource management or Case management or Leave & Disability management role
* Ability to apply critical thinking and identify issues for problem solving
* Ability to build strong relationships and influence others while working in a cross functional environment
* Experience providing guidance to employees or managers on leave of absence, disability plan, accommodation, human resources, benefits, or employee matters
* Experience working with confidential information.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. **Job Description**
– HR Executive (Recruitment)

**Company:**
The Monarch Enterprises

**Designation:**
HR Executive – Recruitment

**Location:**
Bhiwandi, Maharashtra

**Department:**
Human Resources

**Experience:**
1–4 Years

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a proactive and result-oriented HR Executive – Recruitment to manage end-to-end recruitment activities for blue-collar and white-collar positions. The candidate should have strong sourcing skills, good communication abilities, and the capability to close vacancies within defined timelines.

**Roles & Responsibilities**

1. End-to-End Recruitment

* Handle the complete recruitment cycle, from understanding manpower requirements to final candidate selection.
* Manage recruitment for blue-collar and white-collar positions.
* Coordinate interviews with department heads and hiring managers.
* Ensure timely closure of open positions as per recruitment TAT.

2. Candidate Sourcing

* Source candidates through Naukri, Indeed, LinkedIn, job portals, social media and employee referrals.
* Conduct initial screening and shortlist candidates based on job requirements.
* Maintain an active database of qualified candidates.
* Explore new recruitment channels to improve hiring quality.

3. Interview & Selection

* Conduct preliminary HR interviews and evaluate candidate suitability.
* Coordinate technical and managerial interview rounds.
* Follow up with selected candidates regarding salary negotiations, offer acceptance and joining dates.
* Ensure proper documentation before onboarding.

4. Joining & Onboarding

* Coordinate the joining formalities of selected candidates.
* Ensure collection and verification of required documents.
* Conduct joining formalities and HR induction.
* Maintain candidate joining and offer status reports.

5. Recruitment MIS & Reporting

* Prepare daily and weekly recruitment status reports.
* Track open positions, interviews scheduled, offers released and candidates joined.
* Monitor recruitment TAT and offer-to-joining ratio.
* Maintain recruitment trackers and candidate databases.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strong knowledge of end-to-end recruitment.
* Experience in blue-collar and white-collar hiring.
* Hands-on experience with Naukri, Indeed and LinkedIn.
* Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
* Strong candidate follow-up and coordination skills.
* Ability to manage multiple vacancies simultaneously.
* Good knowledge of MS Excel and recruitment MIS.
* Target-oriented with strong closing capabilities.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

KPI - Measurement

Vacancy Closure

Positions closed within agreed TAT

Interview Ratio

Qualified candidates shortlisted

Joining Ratio

Offers converted into actual joinings

Sourcing Productivity

Relevant profiles sourced daily

Recruitment TAT

Time taken to close vacancies

Data Management

Accuracy of recruitment MIS

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

* Graduate in any discipline; MBA/PGDM in HR preferred.
* 1–4 years of experience in recruitment.
* Manufacturing or industrial recruitment experience will be an added advantage.
* Immediate joiners preferred.

* Compensation & Benefits

title: Manager – HR, India
description:
**Company Description**

Established in Malaysia in 1991, MFE, a company of Doka, has evolved into a global leader of high-quality, efficient, and cost-effective aluminium formwork systems today. Acquired by Doka in 2024, MFE is driven by continuous product innovations and an unwavering commitment to quality and customer service.

With a presence in India through its Mumbai office, MFE is strengthening its position in one of the world’s most dynamic construction markets. From supporting local housing developments to enabling large-scale urban transformation projects, MFE is shaping the future of construction in India.

Expanding beyond its initial success in residential projects, MFE has established itself as a one-stop shop for monolithic solutions. Providing end-to-end support, from bespoke formwork design, which utilises in-house 3D software, to experienced on-site technical assistance, MFE's state-of-the-art, eco-friendly manufacturing facility in Malaysia covers annual formwork production capacity exceeding 1.5 million m².

With a strong focus on on-site training and support, MFE further enables clients to achieve rapid construction cycles, solidifying its vision to be a world-class formwork enterprise dedicated to quality, customer satisfaction, and continuous innovation.

As a customer-focused organisation, MFE understands that its greatest assets are its employees, which is why it is consistently looking for talented professionals who are keen to develop their careers in this dynamic industry. Having grown continuously, based on the strength of its products and its agility to anticipate market demand, MFE is looking for skilled candidates to join their rapidly growing team.

 **Job Description**

**WHAT IF you could shape the HR function of a growing business while creating meaningful employee experiences and enabling sustainable organizational growth?**

MFE India is seeking a proactive, self-driven and hands-on HR professional to take ownership of the day-to-day HR function and support the growth of its business in India.

Reporting directly to the Head of HR, this role will be responsible for managing the complete HR function at the operational level, establishing robust and scalable HR processes, and partnering with business leaders to address current and future people requirements.

As the business enters its next phase of growth and expansion, this role will play an important part in building a robust and scalable HR infrastructure, strengthening people practices, driving employee engagement and ensuring effective HR delivery to support the organization's evolving needs.

We are looking for someone who has experience supporting business growth, can independently establish and implement HR processes, takes ownership of deliverables, and can balance strategic thinking with hands-on operational execution.

**What You'll Be Doing**

**1. Recruitment & Talent Acquisition**

* Drive end-to-end recruitment activities in collaboration with business leaders and hiring managers, ensuring timely fulfilment of manpower requirements.
* Develop and strengthen recruitment processes to support business expansion and evolving workforce requirements.
* Partner with stakeholders on workforce planning, manpower budgeting, hiring priorities and recruitment strategies.
* Explore and support campus recruitment initiatives, university partnerships and graduate hiring programmes to build a sustainable talent pipeline.
* Ensure effective onboarding and integration of new employees.
* Identify opportunities to improve recruitment efficiency, candidate experience and hiring processes.

**2. HR Operations & Employee Lifecycle**

* Own and manage day-to-day HR operations and the complete employee lifecycle, including onboarding, confirmations, employee movements, transfers and offboarding.
* Establish, implement and continuously improve HR policies, processes, procedures and documentation to support business growth.
* Coordinate payroll activities, ensuring timely and accurate payroll inputs, employee data and resolution of payroll-related queries.
* Maintain accurate employee records, HR documentation and personnel files.
* Ensure consistent and effective implementation of HR processes across the organization.

**3. Performance Management & Employee Relations**

* Drive the performance management cycle, including goal setting, performance reviews, feedback and performance improvement initiatives.
* Support managers in addressing performance-related matters and developing effective people management practices.
* Take ownership of employee relations matters, including grievance handling, disciplinary processes, conflict resolution and employee concerns.
* Provide guidance to managers on employee-related matters, ensuring consistency, fairness and adherence to company policies.
* Promote a culture of accountability, engagement and continuous improvement.

**4. Employee Engagement & Culture**

* Act as the primary HR contact for employees across MFE India.
* Drive employee engagement initiatives and foster a positive and inclusive workplace culture.
* Support employee communication, wellbeing, recognition and team-building activities.
* Proactively identify employee concerns and facilitate timely and effective resolution.
* Champion Doka’s values, leadership culture, Code of Conduct, and a respectful, inclusive working environment.

**5. Stakeholder Management & Business Partnering**

* Act as a business partner and trusted advisor to business leaders and functional managers on all HR-related topics.
* Understand business requirements and translate them into effective HR initiatives and solutions.
* Provide guidance on HR policies, people practices, employee-related matters and organizational development.
* Build strong working relationships with stakeholders at all organizational levels.
* Collaborate with the Head of HR and the wider HR team to ensure alignment with regional and group HR standards.
* Champion Doka's values, leadership culture and Code of Conduct, ensuring compliance with applicable local laws and regulations.
* Support change management initiatives, facilitate stakeholder buy-in and ensure effective implementation of people-related changes.

**6. HR Systems & Digitalization**

* Support HR digitalization initiatives and process improvement projects.
* Drive the effective implementation, utilization and adoption of HR systems and related technologies, including SAP, where applicable.
* Ensure accuracy and integrity of HR data and reporting.
* Identify opportunities to streamline, standardize and automate HR processes.

**7. Statutory Compliance & Reporting**

* Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws, statutory requirements and company policies.
* Coordinate statutory compliance activities and ensure timely completion of related obligations in collaboration with relevant stakeholders.
* Prepare and maintain HR dashboards, metrics and management reports to support business decision-making.
* Coordinate internal and external HR audits and ensure timely closure of observations.
* Monitor changes in applicable labour legislation and support implementation of necessary changes in HR policies and practices.

  
**Qualifications**

**What We're Looking For**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration or a related field.
* Postgraduate qualification in HR is preferred.

**Experience**

* 6–8 years of progressive HR experience in a generalist role.
* Demonstrated experience independently managing day-to-day HR operations for a site, business unit or organization.
* Experience supporting business growth, organizational expansion or a significant increase in workforce strength.
* Proven ability to establish, implement and improve HR processes, policies and practices.
* Strong experience in end-to-end recruitment, employee relations, performance management and employee lifecycle management.
* Experience in payroll coordination and statutory compliance.
* Proven stakeholder management and employee engagement experience.
* Exposure to campus recruitment, university partnerships or graduate hiring would be advantageous.
* Exposure to manufacturing, engineering, construction or industrial environments would be advantageous.
* Experience with HRMS implementation, SAP or SAP SuccessFactors would be an added advantage.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Strong ownership mindset and ability to operate autonomously whilst adhering to company standards.
* Ability to build and establish HR processes that can support business growth and organizational expansion.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
* Ability to successfully manage change, get buy-in from various stakeholders and build trustful relationships with personnel at all levels.
* Strong employee relations and problem-solving capabilities.
* Practical, hands-on and execution-oriented approach.
* Strong organizational, planning and prioritization abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple HR priorities independently in a growing business environment.
* Proficiency in HR reporting and HRMS systems.
* SAP HR/SAP SuccessFactors exposure will be an added advantage.

  
**Additional Information**

**Why Join Us?**

* Opportunity to establish and shape the HR function for a growing business.
* Play a key role in building scalable HR processes and supporting significant organizational expansion.
* Drive meaningful employee initiatives, strengthen people practices and contribute to HR transformation.
* Work closely with business leaders and the Head of HR in shaping the organization's people agenda.

SEIL People & Organization (P&O)

At Siemens Energy India Limited, we are more than just an energy technology company. We develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. description:
**UNIONE GROUP | MOKSHA ENTERPRISES**

Job Description – MIS & Business Analyst

We are hiring an MIS & Business Analyst with 8–10 years of experience, strong BI skills and working knowledge of AI, for our Mumbai office.

**Position**

MIS & Business Analyst

**Company**

Unione Group and Moksha Enterprises

**Location**

Charni Road, Mumbai

**Working days**

6 days a week

**Experience**

8–10 years

**Must-have**

Strong MIS, BI tools, AI knowledge, analytical ability, business acumen

Role Summary

The MIS & Business Analyst turns raw business data into reliable reports, dashboards and insights that leadership can act on. You will own our MIS framework end to end, build BI dashboards, and use AI and automation to make reporting faster and smarter. We want a sharp analytical mind with strong business acumen who can tell management not just what happened, but why and what to do next.

Key ResponsibilitiesMIS and reporting

* Design, own and run the MIS framework: daily, weekly and monthly reports for sales, finance, operations and management

* Ensure data accuracy by reconciling across systems and fixing gaps at the source

* Prepare management reviews and performance packs with clear commentary on drivers, variances and risks

* Standardise report formats, definitions and KPIs across teams and businesses

BI and dashboards

* Build and maintain interactive dashboards in Power BI, Tableau or similar tools, with automated data refresh

* Create data models, queries and pipelines (SQL, Power Query, DAX) that pull from ERP, Tally, CRM and other sources

* Track KPIs such as sales, margins, inventory, collections, productivity and cost, and set up alerts for deviations

Business analysis

* Analyse trends, cohorts, profitability and demand to support pricing, planning and growth decisions

* Translate business questions into analysis, and analysis into clear recommendations

* Support budgeting, forecasting and business reviews with data-backed inputs

* Partner with business heads to define requirements for reports, tools and process improvements

AI and automation

* Apply AI tools and models to automate reporting, speed up analysis, detect anomalies and improve forecasting

* Identify high-value use cases for AI and automation across functions, and run them from pilot to adoption

* Use Python, Excel automation or no-code tools to cut manual effort and reduce errors

Stakeholder management

* Work with leadership, sales, finance, HR, supply chain and IT teams to gather requirements and deliver insights

* Train users on dashboards and self-serve reporting, and drive data-led decision-making across the organisation

title: Field HR HR & Business Partnering
description:
**ROLE PURPOSE**
----------------

Own HR delivery across VISL’s regions and business groups so that every region gets dependable, integrated HR and Administration execution. The role takes regional delivery, manager coaching, priority-setting and routine escalations off the CPO’s desk, so that central capacity is free for design and strategy, and VISL lives its promise of being a Local Growth Partner for its own people as well as its customers.

**KEY RESULT AREAS AND RESPONSIBILITIES**
-----------------------------------------

**Regional HR delivery and governance**

* Run a consistent operating rhythm for all regions: monthly reviews, dashboards, process standards and service levels.
* Ensure HR and Administration processes designed by the COE are executed the same way in every region, with local responsiveness.
* Be the escalation point for regional issues and resolve routine escalations without CPO involvement.

**Business partnering**

* Partner regional and cluster business heads and SCM, Operations and Sales leaders on workforce plans, organisation changes, productivity and talent risks.
* Translate business priorities into regional people plans and track them to closure.

**Talent availability and retention**

* Work with Talent Acquisition on the regional hiring demand plan, onboarding quality and offer-to-join conversion.
* Drive employee connect and retention actions; act early on attrition and early-tenure exits.

**Employee lifecycle, performance and compliance**

* Deploy the performance and talent cycle in the regions on time, with quality conversations and calibrated outcomes.
* Ensure fair, timely handling of grievances and disciplinary cases in line with VISL policy and the Code of Conduct.
* Ensure statutory and policy compliance at regional sites, with the COE compliance stream.

**Build the Field HR team**

* Lead, coach and develop the Regional HR team; set priorities and clear accountability.
* Build bench strength and succession for regional HR roles.

**Integration and change**

* Lead on-ground people integration for Purva, Midex and future acquisitions with the COE.
* Drive adoption of new HR processes in the regions and feed back what works and what does not.

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS**
------------------------------

* Regional process service levels and compliance adherence
* Time-to-fill and offer-to-join ratio for regional roles (with TA)
* Early-tenure attrition (first 90 / 180 days) and regretted attrition
* Performance cycle completed on time across regions
* Grievance and disciplinary case closure turnaround
* Regional engagement scores (e.g. GPTW Trust Index) and action-plan closure
* Regional HR team capability and succession coverage

**External**

* Corporate HR / Talent Acquisition
* Head – Administration
* Regional and cluster business heads; SCM, Operations and Sales leaders
* Finance and Payroll
* Recruitment and staffing partners
* Labour-law and compliance consultants
* Statutory authorities, through the compliance stream

**DECISION RIGHTS**
-------------------

* Sets regional HR priorities and allocates Regional HR capacity
* Resolves routine regional escalations
* Recommends regional hiring, organisation and people decisions to the CPO
* Exact financial and people authority to be confirmed against VISL’s Delegation of Authority

**QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE**

MBA / PGDM in HR or equivalent

  

**Experience**

15+ years in HR, including 6–8 years leading multi-location Sales HR profile for either a B2B, Consumer Products, BFSI, Telecom Sector Companies.

* Multi-state employee relations and labour-law practice
* Regional HR operating models and service governance

title: General Manager - Finance
description:
**Location:** Kharghar, Navi Mumbai, India  
**Department:** Finance & Accounts  
**Reporting To:** Managing Director / Board of Directors

**OVERVIEW**

The General Manager – Finance will lead the company's finance function and act as a strategic business partner to the senior leadership team. The role will oversee financial planning and analysis, project profitability, cash flow and working capital management, financial reporting, statutory compliance, treasury, capital expenditure planning and funding strategy.

The position requires a commercially oriented finance professional capable of strengthening financial controls, improving project-level financial visibility and supporting the company's growth and capital investment plans.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

*A. Financial Planning, Budgeting and Business Performance*

* Lead annual budgeting, periodic forecasting and long-term financial planning.

* Develop and monitor key financial indicators, including revenue, EBITDA, project margins, cash conversion, working capital and capital utilisation.

* Prepare monthly MIS, financial dashboards and performance reports for senior management.

* Analyse actual financial performance against budgets, identify variances and recommend corrective actions.

* Evaluate financial performance across service lines, projects and operating units.

*B. Project Finance, Costing and Commercial Control*

* Establish robust project-level costing, budgeting and profitability monitoring across marine surveys, offshore assignments and onshore projects.

* Monitor project revenues, direct costs, vessel and equipment utilisation, mobilisation expenses, subcontracting costs and overhead allocations.

* Work with operations and business development teams on bid pricing, tender costing, contract evaluation and commercial risk assessment.

* Monitor project billing, milestone-based revenue recognition, receivables and contract profitability.

* Identify opportunities to improve margins through cost optimisation, resource utilisation and operational efficiency.

*C. Treasury, Cash Flow and Working Capital Management*

* Manage cash flow forecasting, liquidity planning and banking relationships.

* Improve working capital efficiency through disciplined billing, collections, vendor payment management and contract-level cash flow monitoring.

* Oversee banking facilities, debt servicing, guarantees and other financing requirements.

* Establish appropriate treasury controls and maintain adequate liquidity to support business operations and expansion.

*D. Capital Expenditure and Funding Strategy*

* Lead financial evaluation and budgeting for vessels, survey equipment, specialised technology and other capital investments.

* Evaluate capital allocation decisions using financial modelling, investment appraisal, payback analysis and return-on-investment metrics.

* Support financing strategies involving internal accruals, bank borrowings, asset-backed finance and external equity.

* Coordinate with lenders, investors, financial advisers and other stakeholders on financing transactions and due diligence.

* Monitor capital expenditure against approved budgets, implementation timelines and expected financial returns.

*E. Accounting, Financial Reporting and Internal Controls*

* Oversee accounting operations, monthly and annual financial closures, preparation of financial statements and management reporting.

* Ensure appropriate accounting treatment for project revenues, operating costs, fixed assets, depreciation, leases and capital work-in-progress.

* Strengthen internal financial controls, approval matrices, procurement controls and expenditure governance.

* Coordinate statutory audits, tax audits, internal audits and financial due diligence processes.

* Ensure timely and accurate financial reporting in accordance with applicable accounting standards.

*F. Taxation, Statutory Compliance and Risk Management*

* Oversee direct and indirect taxation, GST, TDS, tax assessments and statutory filings.

* Ensure compliance with applicable corporate, tax and other regulatory requirements.

* Identify financial, contractual, tax and treasury risks and implement appropriate mitigation measures.

* Maintain robust financial documentation, audit readiness and compliance monitoring systems.

*G. Systems, Processes and Team Leadership*

* Develop standardised financial processes, reporting formats, standard operating procedures and delegated financial authorities.

* Improve ERP utilisation, financial automation, data integrity and reporting efficiency.

* Build, lead and mentor the finance and accounts team.

* Collaborate with business development, procurement, project execution and operations teams to strengthen financial discipline across the organisation.

**QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE**

* Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) preferred. CMA or MBA in Finance may be considered based on relevant experience and capability.

* Strong foundation in accounting, corporate finance, financial analysis and taxation.

* Approximately 12–18 years of progressive experience in finance and accounts, including substantial experience in a managerial or leadership role.

* Experience in project-based, asset-intensive or capital-intensive industries such as infrastructure, EPC, engineering services, marine services, energy or industrial equipment will be preferred.

* Demonstrated experience in financial planning, project costing, cash flow management, working capital, statutory compliance and financial controls.

* Exposure to capital expenditure evaluation, debt financing, banking facilities and fundraising will be an advantage.

* Experience in establishing financial processes and supporting business expansion is desirable.

**TECHNICAL SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES**

* Strong financial modelling, budgeting, forecasting and variance analysis skills.

* Commercial understanding of project contracts, tender costing, project margins and working capital cycles.

* Knowledge of Indian accounting standards, taxation, GST and statutory compliance.

* Proficiency in advanced Excel, MIS reporting and ERP-based financial systems.

* Strong analytical, problem-solving and decision-making abilities.

* Effective communication and stakeholder management skills, particularly with senior management, lenders, auditors and investors.

* High standards of integrity, accountability and financial discipline.

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS**

* Timely and accurate monthly financial reporting and financial closure.

* Improved project-level cost visibility, profitability monitoring and margin discipline.

* Effective cash flow forecasting, receivables management and working capital optimisation.

* Disciplined budgeting and financial governance of capital expenditure.

* Strong statutory compliance, audit readiness and internal financial controls.

* Timely evaluation and execution of financing requirements.

* Improved financial reporting systems, process efficiency and finance team capabilities.

* Effective financial support for the company's business expansion and strategic growth initiatives.

* What is your expected CTC (in LPA)?

title: Payroll Transformation Solution Owner - VOIS
description:
**Who We Are**
VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. #VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About This Role**
We are seeking a Payroll Transformation Solution Owner to lead the delivery and continuous improvement of enterprise payroll solutions. You will be accountable for business outcomes, product backlog priorities, cross-market alignment and the effective implementation of SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central Payroll.
  
  
The role requires end-to-end ownership of payroll transformation, from future-state process design and requirements definition through testing, cutover, go-live and early-life support. You will work across multiple markets, balancing global standards with local statutory and operational requirements, including those relevant to Germany, Portugal and South Africa
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own the payroll transformation workstream and product backlog, aligning priorities with business objectives, statutory obligations, delivery milestones and measurable value.Provide functional leadership for SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central Payroll or a comparable enterprise payroll platform.Define future-state payroll processes that balance global standards with market-specific statutory and operational requirements.Lead, coach and coordinate team members and cross-functional contributors, establishing clear accountability for deliverables.Partner with Product Managers, market payroll teams, HR, Finance, Technology, implementation partners and other stakeholders to agree requirements, decisions and delivery plans.Guide requirements through design, build, testing, cutover, go-live and early-life support.Proactively manage delivery risks, dependencies, controls and decisions.Ensure that data quality, information security, auditability, payroll controls, integrations and operational readiness are addressed throughout the solution lifecycle.Drive payroll simplification, standardisation, automation and continuous improvement while maintaining a positive employee and stakeholder experience.Apply JIRA and SAFe Agile practices to backlog management, sprint planning, Program Increment planning, progress tracking and transparent reporting.Explain complex payroll matters clearly and support informed decision-making among senior stakeholders and market teams

You have strong implementation experience in SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central Payroll, including responsibility for end-to-end delivery.You bring payroll implementation experience covering Germany, Portugal and South Africa, together with an understanding of country-specific statutory and payroll requirements.You have demonstrated leadership and people-management capability, including coaching, work allocation, performance support and delivery governance.You understand end-to-end payroll processes and their dependencies on Employee Central, Time and Attendance, Benefits, Finance and external service providers.You can manage stakeholders, negotiate effectively and support decisions within complex, multi-market environments.You can translate business needs into clear requirements and practical solution outcomes while maintaining appropriate controls and compliance.You have experience managing delivery partners and cross-functional teams through testing, cutover, go-live, stabilisation and continuous improvement.You are proficient in JIRA and have working knowledge of SAFe Agile or comparable delivery methodologies.You bring strong analytical, problem-solving, planning and risk-management skills.You hold a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Human Resources, Business, Finance or a related discipline.You have experience leading teams or managing a significant payroll solution or transformation workstream.You have worked within enterprise-scale, multi-country HR or payroll transformation programmes.
  
  
**Not a perfect fit?**
Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
  
  
**What's In It For You**
The opportunity to shape a multi-country payroll transformation and influence future-state payroll services.Ownership across the full solution lifecycle, including design, implementation, go-live, stabilisation and continuous improvement.Collaboration with payroll, HR, Finance and Technology specialists, market teams and implementation partners.Exposure to enterprise-scale SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central Payroll delivery in a complex international environment.The opportunity to lead teams, guide senior stakeholder decisions and deliver measurable improvements through standardisation and automation.

Advanced product ownership and backlog prioritisation within an enterprise payroll environment.Multi-country payroll solution design and statutory requirement management.Practical application of SAFe Agile, sprint planning and Program Increment planning.Enterprise payroll controls, integration governance, data quality and operational-readiness management.Cross-market stakeholder engagement and delivery-partner governance.Leadership across testing, cutover, go-live, early-life support and continuous improvement.Approaches for simplifying, standardising and automating global payroll services.

title: Senior HR Executive (Operations)
description:
**About Sleek**
Through proprietary software and AI, along with a focus on customer delight, Sleek makes the back-office easy for micro SMEs.
  
  
We give Entrepreneurs time back to focus on what they love doing - growing their business and being with customers. With a surging number of Entrepreneurs globally, we are innovating in a highly lucrative space.
  
  
We operate 3 business segments:
  
  

* Corporate Secretary: Automating the company incorporation, secretarial, filing, Nominee Director, mailroom and immigration processes via custom online robots and SleekSign. We are the market leaders in Singapore with :5% market share of all new business incorporations
* Accounting & Bookkeeping: Redefining what it means to do Accounting, Bookkeeping, Tax and Payroll thanks to our proprietary SleekBooks ledger, AI tools and exceptional customer service
* FinTech payments: Overcoming a key challenge for Entrepreneurs by offering digital banking services to new businesses

Sleek launched in 2017 and now has around 15,000 customers across our offices in Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia and the UK. We have around 600 staff with an intact startup mindset.
  
  
We have recently raised Series B financing off the back of >70% compound annual growth in Revenue over the last 5 years. Sleek has been recognised by The Financial Times, The Straits Times, Forbes and LinkedIn as one of the fastest growing companies in Asia.
  
  
Backed by world-class investors, we are on track to be one of the few cash flow positive, tech-enabled unicorns based out of Singapore.
  
  
**Mission:**
Support Sleek's mission to be the employer of choice for top talent by making sure every employee has accurate data and a seamless experience from their first day to their last.
  
  
**Outcomes:**
**Onboarding, probation and offboarding**

* Own end-to-end onboarding for new joiners: pre-boarding, Day 1 readiness, office registration and access and HRIS setup
* Track probation milestones, ensure managers complete reviews in a timely manner, and prepare confirmation outcomes
* Run a thorough and respectful offboarding process. This covers office deregistration, return of company assets, exit documentation and tax clearance, in line with HQ policies and local requirements

**HR Data, Payroll And Benefits**

* Keep OMNI (Sleek's HRIS) as the single source of truth, with employment changes reflected accurately and promptly
* Prepare and share monthly payroll movements with the Finance teams for each entity in scope, within established SLAs. Resolve any discrepancies promptly
* Administer employee benefits, including group insurance, flexi benefit claims, and respond to employee queries promptly
* Handle employee data in line with Sleek's data privacy policies and applicable regulations

**Statutory compliance and immigration**

* Ensure statutory contributions such as CPF and MPF are filed accurately and on time
* Prepare and submit tax clearance filings for leavers, such as IR21 (Singapore) and IR56F (Hong Kong), within statutory timelines
* Assist with work pass applications, renewals and cancellations, and the supporting documentation
* Roll out mandatory training, monitor completion, and escalate non-compliance promptly
* Prepare and submit mandatory government surveys, such as MOM labour market and wage surveys, accurately and on time for HR Manager review

**Employee documentation and HR cycles**

* Issue confirmation letters, increment letters and employment letters accurately and within established SLAs
* Support the increment and bonus cycles by preparing payroll data and issuing letters

**Engagement and workplace**

* Drive employee engagement initiatives at HQ that strengthen connection, morale and Sleek's culture
* Manage office matters, including the pantry, staff registration and deregistration, and the day-to-day workplace experience

**Requirements**
To do this, you will have a minimum of 3-5 years in HR operations experience and will most like be in located in
**Singapore, Hong Kong, Philippines, Malaysia or India.**
**Must Haves:**

* Strong familiarity with Google workspace environment, especially Google sheets and Slides
* Hands-on experience with statutory contributions, tax clearance filings and work pass administration (e.g. CPF/IR21/EP). MPF/IR56F experience is a strong plus
* Experience coordinating payroll inputs across multiple entities or countries
* Strong administrative discipline and attention to detail with HR data, systems and documentation. HRIS experience is preferred
* Excellent spoken and written English, with the ability to communicate clearly and professionally across diverse teams
* Comfortable using AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Gemini or similar) to support HR operations tasks such as drafting communications, analysing data and improving process efficiency
* Legal Work Authorization: Must have valid legal working rights in you country of residence,
* Workplace Arrangement: Comfortable with the applicable local working arrangement (Hybrid for Singapore and Hong Kong; Fully Remote for Philippines, Malaysia and India)

**Ownership and reliability:**
We take full responsibility for our work and outcomes. Ownership means proactively stepping up, following through on commitments, and seeing tasks through from start to finish without needing constant direction. Reliability is about being someone others can depend on—delivering consistently, meeting deadlines, and maintaining high standards. Together, this mindset builds trust within the team and ensures the community experience is always well-supported and dependable.
  
  
**Humility:**
There is so much we don't know. Humility allows for open-mindedness to feedback and a willingness to learn from others. It paves the way for collaboration and creates a positive work environment. It is a key ingredient of self awareness and emotional intelligence.
  
  
**Structured Thinking:**
Our business is complex with many layers (many services, many countries, many cultures). Regardless of whether you're more analytical or creative in nature, being able to show sound judgement is important to us. It ensures solutions are pragmatic and balance the needs of the organisation, team and customers.
  
  
**Analytical and data-driven:**
We make decisions based on insights, not assumptions. Being analytical and data-driven means using community metrics, feedback, and trends to understand what's working and what isn't. It helps us continuously improve engagement, optimise initiatives, and create more meaningful impact for our members and the business.
  
  
**Can have tough conversations in a positive way:**
It's not a matter of if, but when difficult interpersonal situations arise. Disagreement, conflict and disappointment are a given in a fast moving business where people care about their work. People that proactively have tough conversations with kindness build empathy, trust and great working relationships.
  
  
**The interview process**
The successful candidate will participate in the below interview stages. We anticipate the process to last no more than 3 weeks from start to finish.
  
  
Whether the interviews are held over video call or in person will depend on your location and the role.
  
  
**One Way Video Interview / TA Screening**
Selected candidates will be invited to complete a short, one-way video interview. Depending on the results, candidates may then progress to a :30-minute screening call with a member of our Talent Acquisition team to explore their experience and discuss the role in more detail.
  
  
**Technical Round:**
A : 90-minute technical deep dive with the hiring team covering your most recent roles and hands-on experience.
  
  
**Final Round:**
A :45 minute session with our Chief of Staff where they will dive into some of your recent work situations to understand how you think and work.
  
  
**Reference Verification**
Prior to final offer confirmation, we will conduct one professional reference check with your recent direct manager or supervisor. To keep the process moving smoothly, this step may be initiated during the final interview stages.
  
  
+++++
  
  
**Requirement for background screening**
Please be aware that Sleek is a regulated entity and as such is required to perform different levels of background checks on staff depending on their role.
  
  
This may include using external vendors to verify the below:
  
  

* Your education
* Any criminal history
* Any political exposure
* Any bankruptcy or adverse credit history

We will ask for your consent before conducting these checks. Depending on your role at Sleek, an adverse result on one of these checks may prohibit you from passing probation.
  
  
By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Data Privacy Statement for Candidates, found at sleek.com.
  
  
**Benefits**
Some other great things about working at Sleek...
  
  
Humility and kindness: Humility is a core attribute we hire for, which means we have a culture of not taking ourselves too seriously and being able to laugh. Kindness is also incredibly important. We are committed to creating and nurturing a diverse and inclusive environment.
  
  
Flexibility: You'll be able to work from home [2-3] days per week. If you need to start early or start late to cater to your family or other needs, we don't mind, so long as you get your work done and proactively communicate. You can also work fully remote from anywhere in the world for 1 month each year
  
  
Financial benefits: We pay competitive market salaries and provide staff with generous paid time off and holiday schedules. Certain staff at Sleek are also eligible for our employee share ownership plan and can share in the upside of our stellar growth trajectory as we work toward listing on a prominent stock exchange in the Asia Pacific region.
  
  
Personal growth: You'll get a lot of responsibility and autonomy at Sleek - we move at a fast pace so you'll be making decisions, making mistakes and learning. There's also a range of internal and external facing training programmes we run. We're also at the forefront of utilising AI in our space and are developing a regional centre of AI excellence. It is our intention that if you leave Sleek, you leave as a more well-rounded person and professional.
  
  
Sleek is also a proudly certified B Corp. Since we started our journey in 2017, we've been committed to building Sleek as a force for good. In just over 5 years, we've joined a community of industry leaders like Patagonia, Ben & Jerry's, and P&G who are building an inclusive, equitable, and a regenerative economy.

The Senior Manager will balance hands-on partnership on complex employee matters with the development of scalable, locally relevant people practices that help MongoDB grow without unnecessary complexity.
  
  
Based in Gurgaon, this role will use employee insight, people data, and strong partnership with business leaders and People teams to strengthen culture, manager capability, employee journeys, workplace experience, and operational excellence to support MongoDB’s continued growth and expansion.
  
  
Work Model: This is an in-office role based in Gurgaon, with an expectation to work from the office at least three days per week. This requirement may change based on business needs.
  
  
The Employee Experience Team is the trusted strategic HR partner designing and enabling a scalable, consistent, and sustainable employee experience worldwide. In partnership with Recruiting, Total Rewards, Talent Development, HR Shared Services, HR Business Partnering, Workplace, and Legal, the team supports the full employee lifecycle and creates capacity for higher-value work.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* India EEx Strategy Execution & Portfolio Leadership: In partnership with the India EEx leader, translate the India EEx strategy and operating agenda into a prioritized roadmap, clear ownership, governance, and measurable outcomes. Lead delivery across interdependent workstreams; surface trade-offs, risks, and decisions early; and keep execution aligned with global EEx priorities and local business needs
* Employee Lifecycle & Service Excellence: Provide senior oversight of the employee and manager experience across onboarding, probation, performance, leave and accommodations, internal mobility, and separation. Lead resolution of complex escalations and drive improvements in service quality, consistency, and employee journeys in partnership with HRSS and relevant People teams
* Employee Experience Insights & Outcomes: Set clear outcome measures for India EEx priorities and use employee listening, people data, service trends, and recurring case themes to identify systemic opportunities and risks. Convert insights into recommendations, prioritized action, and visible progress reviews with the India EEx leader and business stakeholders
* Manager, Talent & Leadership Effectiveness: Advise and influence managers and senior leaders on performance, feedback, team effectiveness, and values-based leadership. Partner with HRBPs and business leaders to embed earlier talent interventions—including talent reviews, retention, career growth, and critical-talent risks—into business planning and leadership routines
* Employee Relations, Investigations & Risk: Provide senior leadership on complex employee relations matters, investigations, mediation, and appropriate recommendations. Strengthen consistent, fair case practice; identify patterns and preventative actions; and support a safe, respectful workplace, including partnership on POSH processes where required
* India Compliance & Governance: Lead proactive identification and management of people-related compliance risks across India locations, maintaining current knowledge of central and relevant state-level employment requirements. Advise leaders, shape practical policy and process responses, and coordinate with Legal, Payroll, Benefits, HRSS, and Project teams on controls, escalations, and resolution
* Operating Model, Simplification & Technology: Lead cross-functional redesign of employee journeys and people processes to reduce complexity and create capacity for higher-value work. Drive adoption of standardization, self-service, automation, and AI-enabled tools where appropriate, in partnership with HRSS, global projects, and global EEx teams; balance efficiency with employee needs and local requirements
* Workplace, Culture & Community: Shape and deliver a connected, productive, safe, and inclusive site experience with Workplace and local leaders. Establish relevant ways to assess progress, strengthen hybrid ways of working and local culture, and operationalize global moments and campaigns with appropriate local nuance
* Enterprise Change & Operational Excellence: Lead complex, cross-functional change from problem definition through adoption and outcomes. Build scalable operating rhythms, clear escalation pathways, and strong governance; clarify ownership and make evidence-based recommendations on what to stop, simplify, standardize, localize, or scale
* Senior Leadership & Influence: Operate with sound judgment and enterprise perspective across a global matrix. Build alignment across leaders and teams without relying solely on formal authority; address friction constructively; disagree and commit; and model bold, direct, kind, and accountable leadership that fosters clarity, psychological safety, and effective decision-making
* Continuous Improvement: Anticipate changes in the business, workforce, employment landscape, workplace, and HR technology. Bring external and internal insights forward and adapt priorities and execution as EEx strategy and business requirements evolve

**Requirements**

* Experience: Master’s degree in HR or a related field, with typically 12+ years of progressive HR experience spanning employee relations, business partnership, performance and talent management, and HR operations. Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional programs and advising senior leaders is essential. Experience in a high-growth technology company or global matrix organization is preferred
* India expertise: Deep working knowledge of employment laws and relevant state-level requirements across India, with a track record of guiding senior stakeholders through complex employment matters, investigations, grievances, and risk decisions with sound judgment and discretion
* Strategic and operational leadership: Proven ability to translate strategy into a prioritized portfolio, lead multiple complex initiatives through ambiguity, influence cross-functional stakeholders, and deliver sustainable results while remaining close enough to operational detail to address critical issues
* Data, process, and technology fluency: Strong analytical capability and experience using employee insight and people data to set priorities, evaluate outcomes, identify root causes, and influence decisions. Demonstrated ability to lead process redesign and adoption of technology, automation, or self-service is advantageous
* Executive communication and influence: Exceptional written and verbal communication, with credibility to advise senior leaders and build alignment across functions, geographies, and levels of the organization
* Leadership effectiveness: Strong program and portfolio-management skills, commercial and organizational judgment, discretion with confidential matters, and the ability to prioritize, delegate through partnerships, and sustain progress in a fast-changing environment

**What Success Looks Like**

* You are a trusted advisor to India leaders and managers, known for sound judgment, clear communication, and practical solutions

* Employees and managers experience simpler, more consistent journeys and clearer support across key moments that matter

Join us in our journey of measuring progress to power human progress worldwide.

**The People Generalist is a key member of the People Team, responsible for delivering high-quality, consistent, and efficient operational HR support across the employee lifecycle. Reporting to the People Operations Manager, this role partners closely with People Business Partners and other People team colleagues to ensure the smooth execution of core People processes, compliance with policies and regulations and ensuring an excellent employee experience. The People Generalist provides hands-on support in all operational areas across the entire employee life cycle including data management, compliance, and offboarding, and offers ad hoc coordination and administrative support as needed.**

**This role will help support the role out and coordination of key People Team initiatives across ETS. Supporting our team in delivering continuous improvement, efficiencies and streamlining processes where possible.**

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

* Deliver day-to-day People operations (onboarding, offboarding, employee data management, HRIS administration, compliance), ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and collaboration with the wider People Team and relevant subject matter experts.
* Act as a first point of contact for employee queries, providing guidance on People policies, processes, and systems, escalating complex issues as needed.
* Support People Business Partners with operational delivery, including employee relations coordination, performance management, engagement initiatives, and process alignment.
* Maintain accurate employee records and documentation in line with data privacy and compliance requirements; assist with HR reports, analytics, and dashboards, partnering with HRIS and Total Rewards as relevant.
* Coordinate and support the administration of benefits, payroll, and other employee programes, collaborating with internal and external stakeholders if relevant in your country.
* Support the implementation and communication of People policies, procedures, and initiatives; participate in continuous improvement of People processes and employee experience.
* Provide administrative support for HR projects, audits, compliance activities, and the organization of People Team events, training, and meetings.
* Foster a culture of self-service, working with Internal Communications to ensure clear information for employees.
* Partner with stakeholder groups (e.g., IT, Finance, Marketing) to ensure People Team processes are effective, on brand, and aligned.
* Ensure adherence to internal controls, audit requirements, regulatory standards, and agreed SLAs for People Operations.

**Experience and Skills:**

**KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS**

* Basic understanding of financial concepts (e.g., budgets, cost drivers) to support HR-related administration and queries.
* Awareness of business context and priorities to help align day-to-day people practices with team needs.
* Ability to accurately handle HR data, maintain records, and assist with basic reporting.
* Recognizes issues or patterns in employee or team challenges and knows when to escalate for resolution.
* Developing commercial awareness and understanding of how HR supports business operations.
* Works collaboratively with colleagues across HR and other departments to deliver effective service.
* Supports change initiatives by helping with communications, gathering feedback, and assisting teams through transitions.
* Strong organizational and prioritisation skills; able to manage multiple tasks and respond to urgent needs.
* Practical problem-solving skills; able to suggest solutions to routine people-related challenges.
* Demonstrates initiative by using available information, tools and resources to respond to and resolve employee queries, seeking guidance only, when necessary, rather than waiting for direct instruction.
* Builds positive relationships with managers and employees, providing responsive and helpful support.
* Assists in the delivery of HR communications and training to support policy awareness and process adoption.
* Looks for opportunities to improve HR processes and employee experience through feedback and observation.
* Supports HR projects and programes through coordination and administration.
* Contributes to the documentation and improvement of HR processes and tools.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Business Administration, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* 3–6 years’ experience in an HR, People Operations, or administrative role, ideally in a fast-paced or complex environment.
* Experience supporting HR processes such as onboarding, data management, or employee relations is desirable.
* Exposure to HR systems and data management preferred.
* Experience working in a team-oriented, service-driven environment.
* Experience working in a global organization is preferred

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE**

* Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Business Administration, Organisational Psychology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* 1–3 years’ experience in an HR, People Operations, or administrative role, ideally within a global or matrixed organization.
* Experience supporting employee relations processes, such as handling queries, assisting with investigations, and supporting policy application.
* Basic knowledge of India employment legislation, statutory compliance, and regional HR practices (or willingness to learn).
* Exposure to working with cross-cultural teams or in international environments is an advantage.
* Ability to build trust and collaborate effectively with colleagues at all levels.
* Experience supporting or coordinating with HR centers of excellence (e.g., Talent Acquisition, Total Rewards, HR Operations, HRIS, Learning & Development).
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to provide helpful support to managers and employees.
* Professional certifications such as SHRM-CP, PHR, or India-specific HR credentials (e.g., NIPM, HRM India) are a plus but not required.

**This is a Contractual role for 10 months with possibility of extending to 12 months.**

**Hybrid with 3 days Onsite.**

title: Human Resources Generalist
description:
**HR Generalist — HR Operations & ERP Digitisation****Role Purpose**

Responsible for managing day-to-day HR operations and building structured, technology-enabled HR processes through ERP. The role will focus on employee records, attendance, onboarding, HR documentation, employee coordination and HR process digitisation.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **HR Operations:**

  Manage routine HR activities, employee records, documentation and day-to-day HR administration.
* **ERP & HR Digitisation:**

  Implement and manage HR processes, workflows and employee records through ERP; identify opportunities to automate manual activities.
* **Employee Lifecycle:**

  Manage joining formalities, onboarding, induction, employee documentation, confirmation, separation and exit formalities.
* **Attendance & Leave Management:**

  Monitor attendance, leave, late coming and employee records; ensure timely and accurate updates in ERP.
* **Payroll Coordination:**

  Coordinate monthly payroll inputs, attendance, leave, salary changes, deductions and employee-related data with Accounts.
* **HR Policies & Processes:**

  Develop, document and implement HR policies, procedures, formats and standard operating processes.
* **Recruitment & Hiring:**

  Coordinate job postings, candidate screening, interviews, follow-ups and joining formalities.
* **Employee Engagement:**

  Support employee communication, engagement activities, celebrations, feedback and employee welfare initiatives.
* **HR MIS & Reporting:**

  Prepare regular reports on headcount, attendance, attrition, recruitment, leave and other HR metrics.
* **Statutory & Compliance Coordination:**

  Maintain employee records and coordinate PF, ESI and other applicable labour-law compliance with management and external consultants.
* **Performance Management:**

  Coordinate employee KRAs, KPIs, performance reviews and confirmation processes.
* **Coordination & Support:**

  Act as the point of contact for employees and department heads for routine HR-related matters.

**Key Expectations**

* Accurate and updated employee records and HR documentation.
* Timely attendance, leave and payroll coordination.
* Structured and documented HR processes.
* Increasing digitisation of HR activities through ERP.
* Timely and accurate HR MIS and reporting.
* Smooth employee onboarding and exit processes.
* Effective recruitment coordination and follow-up.
* Consistent implementation of company policies and procedures.
* Strong employee coordination and confidentiality.

**Experience & Skills**

* **1–2 years of experience in HR / HR Operations / HR Generalist**

  , preferably in a manufacturing environment.
* Basic understanding of HR processes, employee lifecycle and HR administration.
* Working knowledge of MS Excel and HR software/ERP systems.
* Good documentation, coordination and follow-up skills.
* Understanding of attendance, payroll inputs, PF, ESI and basic statutory compliance.
* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple activities independently.
* Proactive attitude, ownership and willingness to build processes from the ground up.
* High integrity and confidentiality.

**Role Requirements**

* Full-time, office-based position.
* Six working days a week.
* Ability to coordinate with employees and departments across the factory and office.

description:
**Description**
The My HR Live Support (MHLS) team is currently seeking to hire an MHLS Sr. Advisor to support our Tier 2 Specialty Operation. The MHLS Tier 2 Specialty Team primarily provides customer service to Amazon employees through phone, chat, ticketing, and cases related to payroll, disability, policies, among others. This role will act as a point of contact for the team, offering immediate assistance on complex issues and handling challenging contacts. The Sr. Advisors provide case consultations and overall resolution and support for all types of leaves of absence and disability life events to our Amazon employees. They are highly skilled in answering questions, obtaining the right information from SOPs and knowledge centers, providing direct support through different live and written channels, understanding the employee’s situation, applying appropriate benefits, responding to changing circumstances; and paves the way for a connected and trusted case management experience. The Sr. Advisor will also escalate trends to management to address any training or quality gaps identified.
  
  
The ideal candidate will possess exceptional communication and organizational skills, a keen attention to detail, the ability to prioritize in a fast-paced environment, strong relationship-building and influencing abilities, robust analytical and critical thinking skills, and a customer service focus that aligns with Amazon's global standards.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Respond to inquiries about disability and leave events, time-off, payments, and work-related situations available to employees.
* Inbound and Outbound phone, chat and case support through the Specialized Support Queues.
* Serve as a point of contact for employees to provide holistic case management services, including medical documentation review to adjudicate compliance with corresponding leave plans, federal and state laws and benefit plans as defined by Amazon.
* Critically assess and adjust the case management plan to an employee’s changing needs.
* Address and respond to sensitive situations in benefit of employee experience and attempt to de-escalate complex cases.
* Manage own workload effectively to meet productivity goals and escalate when significant changes or gaps in assigned workload arise.
* Troubleshoot issues and seek to remove barriers before, during, or after a leave event.
* Respond to employee impacting issues that may arise during the leave event and ensure the right communication and documentation occurs, even when information is limited.
* Use good judgement and rationale to balance process adherence with employee’s needs to analyze and decide on disability, leave and benefits requests.
* Facilitate a smooth return to work and ramp-back plan for employees returning to the workplace.
* Educate managers and business partners on employee concerns and needs prior to starting a leave or returning back to work.
* Communicate regular updates to employees and stakeholders both verbally and in writing.
* Ensure compliance with standard work, federal/state regulations, and company policy.
* Maintain system records to ensure accurate and timely information/documentation.
* Consult, coordinate and partner with our third-party administrator, local HR, Safety, Legal, Payroll, Benefits team members and other support units as appropriate.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree from accredited university or equivalent experience
* Demonstrated a strong customer obsession, ability to dive deep, bias for action, and high-level judgement on complex cases
* Intermediate proficiency in MS Word, Excel, Access, Outlook and PowerPoint
* Minimum of 1 year experience in customer service or Human Resource management or Case management or Leave & Disability management role
* Ability to work a flexible schedule, including night shifts, and willingness to work overtime or on the 6th day as needed

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 2 to 3 years of experience in Human Resource management or Case management or Leave & Disability management role
* Ability to apply critical thinking and identify issues for problem solving
* Ability to build strong relationships and influence others while working in a cross functional environment
* Experience providing guidance to employees or managers on leave of absence, disability plan, accommodation, human resources, benefits, or employee matters
* Experience working with confidential information.

**Massive Charging (**
https://massivecharging.com/) is building EV charging infrastructure in India - full stack, hardware to software - including the CMS, driver app, and APIs used by charge point operators, fleets, and cities across the country.

**The Role**

We're hiring a
**Recruitment Lead**
to build our talent acquisition function from the ground up. This isn't a role for someone who wants to run a well-oiled ATS someone else designed - there is no existing playbook here.

You'll be reporting directly to the CEO, with a mandate to design how MASSIVE finds, evaluates, and closes talent across engineering, operations, and business functions. If you want ownership over a real business function from day one - not a cog role inside a large TA team - this is that job.

**What You'll Do**

* Own end-to-end recruitment: sourcing, screening, interview coordination, offer negotiation, and closing, across all functions and levels.
* Build the recruitment engine from scratch - job description templates, interview scorecards, sourcing channels, applicant tracking process, and employer branding.
* Partner directly with the CEO and function heads to translate hiring needs into role specs and push back where a request is vague or unrealistic.
* Build and manage a pipeline across multiple open roles simultaneously, in a fast-moving startup environment where priorities shift.
* Represent MASSIVE's culture and values accurately to candidates - you are the first impression of the Company for every hire.
* Track and report hiring metrics (time-to-fill, source effectiveness, offer-acceptance rate) directly to the CEO.
* As the team grows, potentially hire and manage junior recruiting support.

**Who You Are**

* 3-5 years of recruitment experience, ideally with some exposure to building or scaling a hiring function (not just executing against an existing one).
* High agency - you don't wait for someone to fix the tool, approve the process, or hand you the budget before you get the role filled. You find a way, and you don't treat missing resources as a reason the job didn't get done.
* Excellent verbal and written communication - this is non-negotiable. You will be corresponding with candidates, negotiating offers, and reporting to the CEO; sloppy or unclear communication is disqualifying regardless of other strengths.
* A genuine passion for recruitment as a “craft”, not a fallback career choice. This is a builder role - someone doing this because they have to won't survive the ambiguity or put in the work to build process.
* Ownership and responsibility as a default mode of operating, not something that needs to be assigned.
* Self-starting, self-aware, and comfortable being self-critical - you'll often be the only person in the building who knows what "good" looks like for this function, so you need the judgment to know when your own process isn't working.
* Action-oriented with a deep-dive attitude - curious enough to actually understand the roles you're hiring for (EV hardware, software, and operations are technical domains; you can't recruit well for what you don't understand).
* Comfortable with a startup's pace and ambiguity - this is not a role with a fixed script.

**Deal-Breakers**

* No passion for recruitment as a function - this role is about building a team and a hiring culture, not filling requisitions on autopilot.
* Weak written or verbal communication of any kind.
* Discomfort with ambiguity or an expectation of a pre-built process to execute against.

***P.S. If you’ve already been through our HR round for this role, please don’t re-apply.***
