title: Compensation Analyst
description:
**Job Description:**

**About ETS:**  
ETS is a global education and talent solutions organization enabling lifelong learners worldwide to be future-ready. For more than 75 years, we've been advancing the science of measurement to build benchmarks for fair and valid skill assessment across cultures and borders. Our worldwide impact extends through our renowned assessments including TOEFL®, TOEIC®, GRE® and Praxis® tests, serving millions of learners in more than 200 countries and territories. Through strategic acquisitions, we've expanded our global capabilities: PSI strengthens our workforce assessment solutions, while Edusoft, Kira Talent, Pipplet, Vericant, and Wheebox enhance our educational technology and assessment platforms across critical markets worldwide.

Through ETS Research Institute and ETS Solutions, we're partnering with educational institutions, governments, and organizations globally to promote skill proficiency, empower upward mobility, and unlock opportunities for everyone, everywhere. With offices and partners across Asia, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the Americas, we deliver nearly 50 million tests annually. Join us in our journey of measuring progress to power human progress worldwide.

The Compensation Analyst supports the design, administration, and evaluation of compensation programs that attract, retain and engage employees across the enterprise. The role ensures data integrity and compliance, and partners with HR and operational leaders to deliver total rewards programs and solutions that align with ETS's organizational priorities. The role will be heavily focused on compensation (70-80%), with some supporting employee benefits-related initiatives and processes.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

* Conduct job evaluations and market pricing; analyze survey data to recommend salary ranges, structures, and pay positioning by role, level, and location.
* Support job architecture and leveling work: define criteria (scope, complexity, decisions, impact), map roles to levels, and maintain job data quality.
* Support the annual compensation cycles: merit, promotion and incentive plans including data audit, budget review, support to stakeholders during the cycle and partnering with the payroll team to ensure accurate and timely payouts.
* Prepare compensation reports and analytics to help support informed decisions on hiring, promotions, off-cycle requests and retention.
* Ensure adherence to compensation policies, pay governance, and regulatory requirements; maintain audit trails and documentation.
* Participate in salary surveys and manage compensation database vendors.
* Provide excellent service support to internal customers (HR, leaders & employees).
* Maintain accurate Rewards data in both internal HRIS system and external vendor systems.
* Support the global benefits team with Indian benefits administration as needed.

  
**Experience and Skills:**

**KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS**

* Clear communicator able to translate methodology into practical guidance for managers and employees; commitment to transparency and equity.
* Solid understanding of compensation fundamentals, including job/level matching, market pricing, program design
* Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, AI (Copilot) and other tools
* Ability to effectively analyze, interpret data and create meaningful, understandable models, reports, metrics, and recommendations
* Excellent attention to detail & ownership
* Strong sense of urgency with the ability to handle multiple competing priorities.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE**

* Bachelors' Degree, in a related field
* 2-3 years of core compensation experience with hands-on market pricing, job evaluation, and annual planning; US compensation exposure preferred.

Senior Associate I - Human Resources (SBO) | Kolkata

About Navi

At Navi, our mission is to simplify finance for a billion people, through technology-first products built at scale.

Founded in 2018 by Sachin Bansal and Ankit Agarwal, Navi has grown rapidly across Loans, UPI, Insurance, Mutual Funds and Digital Gold – building products designed around speed, simplicity and customer experience.

Today, millions of customers use Navi for experiences like instant personal loans, fully digital home loan sanctions within minutes, low-cost mutual funds, instant credit lines in minutes, and one of India’s fastest-growing UPI platforms.

About the Team

The Human Resources and People Strategy team at Navi manages the entire employee lifecycle, from talent acquisition and HR operations to employee engagement and development. They partner closely with business teams to design and implement strategies that attract, retain, and develop top talent, ensuring a thriving, high-performance organisational culture.

About the Role

You will drive hiring for Collections and other SBO roles. You will be responsible for sourcing and screening candidates, managing the recruitment pipeline, coordinating interviews, driving follow-ups and closures, and maintaining accurate hiring trackers and reports. Additionally you will be managing the HR Operations of the span working in your region and supporting the City HR Head.

The role requires strong communication, ownership, attention to detail, and the ability to work with urgency in a fast-paced environment.

What we will expect from you

* Manage high-volume sourcing and recruitment for Collections and other SBO roles through job portals, referrals, and multiple sourcing channels to meet hiring targets.
* Drive end-to-end recruitment coordination, including interview scheduling, candidate follow-ups, offer closures, and joining formalities to ensure timely hiring.
* Act as the primary contact for new joiners, addressing queries and ensuring a smooth transition into the organization.
* Drive pre-onboarding engagement by keeping new hires informed, connected, and excited before their start date.
* Lead the end-to-end onboarding process, ensuring a seamless and engaging experience for new hires.
* Ensure all pre-joining formalities, including documentation, background verification, and buddy assignments, are completed before Day 1.
* Continuously improve and optimize the onboarding experience by collecting and analyzing feedback from new joiners.
* Oversee employee offboarding from all HR systems ensuring timely IT/Admin clearances and a smooth exit process.
* Drive employee engagement initiatives in your span
* Act as a trusted HR partner to address employee queries and resolve grievances

Must haves

* Minimum qualification: Graduation in any field
* Experience is no bar but 1-2 years of experience in HR and eager to pursue a career in end-to-end recruitment and HR Operations
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Have basic knowledge of MS-Office and Google workplace (Sheets, Docs and Slides)
* Adaptability: Readiness to learn quickly and adapt to a dynamic and fast-paced environment and strong organizational and multitasking abilities.
* Integrity: Commitment to upholding ethical standards and Employee-first mindset

Life at Navi

Life at Navi is fast-paced, ambitious and deeply collaborative. Beyond work, teams come together through sports, celebrations, offsites, music jams, team outings and many more shared experiences that make the journey exciting and memorable.

We believe people do their best work when they feel supported, through flexible leave policies, strong health and wellness benefits, free financial, legal and medical consultations, ESOPs and a workplace designed for both productivity and well-being.

Whether it’s the sports turf, gym, focus zone or nap rooms, the campus is built to make everyday work more enjoyable. If you’d like to know more about life at Navi, our culture and employee benefits, head to our careers page: navi.com/careers/life-at-navi.

**Chief Financial Officer (CFO) / Head – Finance, Accounts & Compliance**

**Industry:** Infrastructure Development

**Location:** Gandhinagar, Gujarat

**Reporting To:** Managing Director / CEO

**Experience:** 12–18 years

**Role Overview**

We are seeking an experienced and compliance-oriented finance professional to lead an organisation’s overall finance, accounts, taxation and statutory compliance functions. The individual will ensure timely regulatory filings, maintain accurate financial records, strengthen internal financial controls and manage project-related financial obligations.

The role requires strong knowledge of Indian taxation and statutory regulations, along with practical experience in infrastructure or EPC project finance, working capital management, banking operations and coordination with auditors, consultants and government authorities.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Finance, Accounting & Financial Reporting**

* Oversee end-to-end accounting operations, including general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable and bank reconciliations.
* Ensure timely closure of monthly, quarterly and annual accounts and prepare financial statements.
* Prepare MIS, financial reports and budget-versus-actual analyses.
* Monitor project-wise revenue, expenditure, profitability, outstanding receivables and financial performance.
* Establish appropriate financial controls, documentation standards and accounting procedures.

**2. Statutory & Regulatory Compliance**

* Ensure timely compliance with applicable provisions of the Companies Act, MCA/ROC requirements and other corporate regulations.
* Oversee GST returns, TDS/TCS, income tax returns, advance tax, tax audits and other applicable tax obligations.
* Ensure timely deposit of statutory dues and maintain accurate records of statutory payments and filings.
* Oversee applicable payroll, employment-related statutory obligations and labour-related compliance.
* Maintain a comprehensive compliance calendar, track filing deadlines and ensure proper documentation and record retention.
* Coordinate responses to notices, assessments, inspections and queries raised by tax authorities and other regulators.

**3. Infrastructure & Project Finance**

* Monitor project-wise budgets, costs, cash flows and profitability across ongoing infrastructure projects.
* Oversee project billing, running account (RA) bills, client certifications, retention money, mobilisation advances and receivables.
* Ensure financial documentation and contractual payment requirements are met for government and private-sector projects.
* Monitor vendor payments, subcontractor bills, purchase-related documentation and project expenditure against approved budgets.
* Support tender submissions through financial documentation, eligibility requirements, bid securities and other applicable financial compliance requirements.
* Identify cost overruns, billing delays, margin leakages and working capital risks, recommending corrective measures.

**4. Treasury, Banking & Working Capital**

* Manage cash flow forecasting, liquidity planning and working capital requirements.
* Liaise with banks and financial institutions for credit facilities, working capital limits, bank guarantees, letters of credit and other banking requirements.
* Monitor borrowing costs, repayment schedules, bank documentation and compliance with financing terms.
* Develop systems for timely collection of receivables collection and efficient fund utilisation across projects.

**5. Audit, Risk Management & Internal Controls**

* Coordinate statutory audits, tax audits, internal audits and other financial reviews.
* Ensure timely preparation of audit schedules, reconciliations, supporting documents and financial records.
* Implement internal control mechanisms to prevent errors, irregularities, unauthorised expenditure and financial leakage.
* Identify compliance gaps and implement corrective actions within stipulated timelines.
* Maintain proper documentation for contracts, tax filings, statutory payments, banking transactions and financial approvals.

**6. Budgeting, Cost Control & Strategic Support**

* Lead annual budgeting, financial planning and periodic forecasting.
* Analyse project estimates, cost structures, expenditure trends and profitability.
* Advise the management on financial risks, cash flow priorities, cost optimisation and resource allocation.
* Support business expansion, tender evaluation and project selection through financial analysis.
* Develop standard operating procedures for finance, accounting, taxation and compliance.

**7. Team & Stakeholder Management**

* Lead and supervise the finance and accounts team, ensuring clear responsibilities and accountability.
* Coordinate with project managers, procurement, HR, legal advisers, company secretaries, auditors, tax consultants and banking partners.
* Establish reporting routines and ensure timely submission of financial and compliance information to management.
* Maintain effective working relationships with clients, vendors, financial institutions and relevant government authorities.

The Sourcing Partner is a newly added role designed to bring greater speed, consistency, and velocity to the hiring process. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with end-to-end ownership of sourcing coordination, sourcing tools, pipeline data, and reporting. The successful candidate will proactively identify bottlenecks, improve sourcing effectiveness, and deliver clear, reliable recruitment MIS for India. While there are no direct reports today, this role is expected to establish the foundation for a sourcing team as hiring needs grow.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own sourcing and pipeline generation for open technical and non-technical requisitions across India and U.S. teams, aligned with business priorities and hiring targets.
* Partner daily with the TA Partner and Senior TA Partner to clarify requisition priorities, success profiles, sourcing strategies, and pipeline health.
* Run proactive, multi-channel sourcing campaigns using LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean/X-ray search, referrals, niche job boards, talent communities, and other relevant tools.
* Build and maintain a searchable candidate database and accurate sourcing trackers, ensuring timely updates across sources, requisitions, and candidate stages.
* Manage external sourcing vendors and agencies: communicate role requirements, track service-level agreements (SLAs), review submissions, and consolidate vendor performance.
* Coordinate candidate screening calls and provide interview scheduling and process support in close partnership with the TA Partners.
* Maintain a professional and consistent candidate experience through timely communication, clear status updates, and effective coordination from initial outreach through interview and offer stages.
* Track daily, weekly, and monthly sourcing activity and funnel performance, including source-wise pipeline, qualified submissions, time-to-first-submission, conversion rates, and source of hire.
* Prepare holistic, accurate recruitment MIS and dashboards for India, highlighting progress against hiring targets, pipeline health, offer-to-joining ratio, source effectiveness, and emerging risks.
* Monitor the impact of sourcing efforts on interview progression, offer outcomes, and candidate joining; identify trends and recommend practical improvements.
* Use sourcing technology and recruitment tools effectively; assess opportunities to improve productivity, data quality, and speed through better tool adoption and process discipline.
* Identify and escalate process gaps, delayed feedback, sourcing bottlenecks, or vendor issues to the Director – HR, with clear data and recommended actions.
* Contribute to standardising sourcing practices, reporting cadence, and operating processes so the function can scale with future hiring demand.

**What You’ll Need**
====================

* 4–6 years of experience in talent sourcing, recruitment coordination, or talent acquisition operations, preferably in a fast-paced or high-growth environment.
* Hands-on experience sourcing both technical/engineering and non-technical/business roles.
* Strong working knowledge of LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean/X-ray search, applicant tracking systems (ATS), job boards, referrals, and other sourcing channels.
* Experience maintaining sourcing trackers, recruitment dashboards, and funnel metrics, with strong attention to data accuracy and reporting discipline.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with TA colleagues, hiring stakeholders, external agencies, and candidates.
* Good stakeholder-management skills and the confidence to clarify requirements, follow up on actions, and raise risks proactively.
* A strong ownership mindset: able to manage competing priorities, work independently, and drive sourcing activity without waiting for direction at every step.
* Ability to work across time zones and support U.S.-based TA counterparts and hiring teams; familiarity with U.S. hiring practices is an advantage.
* A process-improvement mindset, comfort using recruitment technology, and the ability to translate sourcing data into clear insights and actions.

**Nice to Have**
================

* Experience managing sourcing vendors, agency SLAs, and consolidated vendor reporting.
* Experience in healthcare technology, SaaS, or another technology-led organisation.
* Exposure to improving sourcing workflows, adopting new recruitment tools, or building a sourcing function.

**How Success Will Be Measured**
================================

* Sourcing activity and qualified pipeline generated daily, weekly, and monthly across multiple channels, measured against agreed hiring priorities and targets.
* Time to first qualified submission, pipeline volume, source-of-hire effectiveness, and conversion at key stages of the sourcing funnel.
* Effective use of sourcing tools and technology to improve reach, productivity, and speed of delivery.
* Quality and timeliness of recruitment MIS for India, including accurate, actionable reporting on pipeline health and hiring progress.
* Improvement in candidate progression through interviews and offers, candidate communication, and offer-to-joining outcomes, in partnership with the TA Partners.
* Accuracy and currency of candidate databases, trackers, and dashboards.
* Proactive identification and resolution of sourcing bottlenecks, vendor issues, and process gaps.

**Why This Role Matters**
=========================

This role is being added to strengthen sourcing capacity and create greater speed and predictability in hiring as ELLKAY grows. It will establish a more proactive, metrics-led sourcing operation that helps the TA team meet business demand while maintaining a consistent. candidate experience.

**Additional information**

At ELLKAY, we are committed to operating as a hybrid workplace, offering employees flexibility in how they structure their time between in-office and remote work. We recognize the significance of fostering connections, collaboration, and creativity within our office culture and its positive impact on our business. Our philosophy of operating as a hybrid workplace underscores our dedication to enabling employees to tailor work-life balance to their individual preferences. For those who do not live within 40 miles of one of our offices, we are open to considering remote work for candidates whose skills and experience strongly align with the role. While we prioritize a hybrid work environment for most roles, we understand the importance of flexibility and are open to remote work for specific positions and specialized skill sets.

title: Senior Specialist - HR Payroll
description:
**Role: Senior Specialist – HR Operations & Payroll**
Function: Human Resources
  
  
Employment Type: Full-time
  
  
Location: GN Mills, Coimbatore / On-site [No work-from-home or Remote possibilities] Search VMax Health Tech in google maps for exact location.
  
  
Timings: 9.00 AM to 6.30 PM
  
  
We work Monday to Friday in the office, and Saturdays will be work-from-home. [
**6 day workweek**
]
  
  
Reports to: Head of HR
  
  
**Position Overview**
We are seeking a detail-oriented, high-ownership professional to lead our end-to-end payroll processing and core HR operations. In this role, you will act as the primary owner for payroll accuracy, statutory compliance, and day-to-day employee lifecycle operations.
  
  
The ideal candidate has proven hands-on experience independently executing end-to-end monthly payroll for an employee base of at least 400 members, coupled with a solid operational background in onboarding, leave/attendance administration, and HR documentation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Payroll & Compensation Management (Primary Focus)
  
  

* Independently execute end-to-end monthly payroll processing for 400+ employees, ensuring complete accuracy and strict adherence to cut-off schedules.
* Collate, validate, and process all monthly payroll inputs, including attendance, leaves, overtime, variable pay, arrears, incentives, salary revisions, and one-time deductions.
* Manage statutory compliance end-to-end, including accurate calculation, timely deduction, and filing of Provident Fund (PF), Employee State Insurance (ESI), Professional Tax (PT), and Tax Deducted at Source (TDS/Income Tax).
* Prepare and submit statutory returns, coordinate annual tax declaration verification, collect investment proofs, and issue annual Form 16s.
* Compute and process final settlements (Full & Final / F&F) for exiting employees within stipulated timelines, including gratuity, encashment, and statutory recoveries.
* Reconcile monthly payroll registers, bank transfer statements, and general ledger (GL) entries in coordination with the Finance and Accounts teams.
* Serve as the single point of contact for employee payroll queries, resolving disputes regarding tax, pay slips, deductions, and reimbursements promptly.

**HR Operations & Lifecycle Management**

* Manage seamless onboarding formalities, document verification, background verification (BGV) tracking, and master data creation in the HRMS.
* Administer employee life-cycle transitions, including confirmations, role changes, transfers, promotions, and exit management.
* Oversee the daily time, attendance, and leave management system, ensuring strict policy governance across all departments.
* Maintain complete, audit-ready physical and digital employee personnel files in compliance with internal data governance and local labor laws.
* Manage group insurance policies (GMC, GPA, GTL), overseeing end-to-end enrollment, additions/deletions, and claims support.
* Draft operational HR communications, including offer letters, appointment orders, confirmation letters, experience certificates, and internal policy circulars.
* Support internal, external, and statutory compliance audits by providing timely, error-free documentation and payroll reports.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Experience: 4 to 8 years of dedicated experience in core payroll processing and HR operations.
* Mandatory Requirement: Demonstrated track record of independently managing end-to-end payroll as an individual contributor for a headcount of at least 400 employees.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Commerce, Business Administration, or a related discipline; an MBA or postgraduate diploma in HR is preferred.

**Technical Proficiency**

* Advanced hands-on proficiency in modern HRMS/Payroll platforms (e.g., Darwinbox, Keka, ZingHR, greytHR, SAP SuccessFactors, or equivalent).
* Strong practical knowledge of statutory portals (EPFO, ESIC, Income Tax, State PT portals).
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, SUMIFS, logical formulas, data validation).

**Key Competencies**

* Meticulous Attention to Detail: Zero tolerance for calculation errors, data mismatches, and compliance lapses.
* Integrity & Discretion: Absolute commitment to maintaining strict confidentiality regarding compensation structures and sensitive employee data.
* Analytical Problem-Solving: Ability to independently interpret labor codes, tax brackets, and payroll discrepancies.
* Clear Communication: Professional verbal and written communication skills to liaise effectively with cross-functional teams, external auditors, and government bodies.

**Location:** Corporate Office, Kochi, Kerala  
**Employment Type:** Full-time

1. **Role Purpose**

The HR Technology Manager is responsible for driving the organization's HR digital transformation strategy by implementing, managing, optimizing, and integrating HR technology solutions.

The role will lead the effective utilization of HR Information Systems (HRIS), Human Capital Management (HCM) platforms, HR automation tools, analytics, and digital solutions to enhance employee experience, improve HR operational efficiency, and enable data-driven decision-making.

2. **Key Roles & ResponsibilitiesA. HR Technology Strategy & Transformation**

* Develop and execute the HR technology roadmap aligned with business and HR strategies.
* Drive HR digital transformation initiatives and process automation.
* Identify opportunities to digitize and streamline HR processes.
* Evaluate emerging HR technologies, AI-based HR solutions, and automation opportunities.
* Partner with HR leadership to define technology priorities and transformation initiatives.

B. **HRIS / HCM System Management**

* Manage and optimize HR technology platforms such as SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM, Workday, Darwinbox, or similar systems.
* Oversee key HR modules, including:
* Core HR and Employee Lifecycle Management
* Recruitment and Applicant Tracking System (ATS)
* Performance Management
* Learning & Development
* Compensation & Benefits
* Payroll and Time & Attendance
* Employee and Manager Self-Service
* Talent and Succession Management
* Ensure system configuration, functionality, upgrades, and enhancements.
* Manage system access, user roles, workflows, and approval hierarchies.

C. **HR Process Automation & Integration**

* Identify and implement opportunities for HR process automation.
* Drive integration between HR systems and payroll, finance, ERP, attendance, and other business applications.
* Work closely with IT teams and external vendors to ensure seamless system integration.
* Reduce manual interventions and improve process turnaround time.

D. **HR Analytics & Reporting**

* Develop HR dashboards, reports, and analytics to support business decisions.
* Establish HR metrics and KPIs covering:
* Headcount and workforce planning
* Attrition and retention
* Recruitment effectiveness
* Employee productivity
* Training effectiveness
* Performance and talent management
* Enable data-driven insights for HR leadership and business stakeholders.
* Ensure accuracy, consistency, and integrity of HR data.

E. **Project & Vendor Management**

* Lead HR technology implementation, enhancement, and migration projects.
* Manage project timelines, budgets, deliverables, and stakeholder expectations.
* Manage relationships with HR technology vendors and implementation partners.
* Conduct vendor evaluations, solution assessments, and contract reviews.
* Ensure successful implementation through testing, training, and change management.

F. **Data Security, Compliance & Governance**

* Ensure confidentiality and security of employee information.
* Establish appropriate system access controls and data governance standards.
* Ensure compliance with applicable data privacy, employment, and statutory requirements.
* Conduct periodic HR system audits and data-quality assessments.
* Coordinate with IT and information security teams on risk management.

G. **Stakeholder Management & Change Management**

* Act as a strategic partner to HR, IT, Finance, and business leaders.
* Drive adoption of HR technology solutions across the organization.
* Develop training programs and user guides for HR teams, managers, and employees.
* Manage change communication and stakeholder engagement.
* Provide ongoing support and ensure continuous improvement.

3. **Educational Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* MBA in HR, Systems, or Business Management is preferred.
* Relevant HR technology or HRIS certifications will be an added advantage.

4. **Experience & Technical Skills**

* 8–12 years of overall experience in HR technology, HRIS, HR operations, or digital transformation.
* 3–5 years of experience in managing HR technology platforms or HRIS implementations.
* Strong knowledge of HR processes and HR technology architecture.
* Experience with one or more platforms such as SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM, Workday, Darwinbox, or similar solutions.
* Knowledge of system integration, APIs, workflows, and automation.
* Proficiency in Power BI, advanced Excel, and HR analytics.
* Understanding of payroll systems, employee lifecycle processes, and HR data governance.
* Experience in project management and vendor management.

5. **Key Competencies**

* Strategic thinking and digital transformation mindset.
* Strong HR process and technology understanding.
* Project and program management.
* Analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Stakeholder management and influencing skills.
* Change management and communication.
* Vendor and relationship management.
* Innovation and continuous improvement orientation.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Gushwork is building an Agent Operating System for small and mid-sized businesses around the world. It is a modern business software where AI agents and humans work together. Business owners and leaders set the goals. They decide what each agent is allowed to do. Then they review the metric each agent delivers.
  
  
We started with an SEO agent. It owns one metric: organic leads. Once it ranks pages and brings in leads, it reports them back to the customer. We are now expanding into a Paid Ads agent and a Developer agent, each owning a metric the business cares about.
  
  
Our customers sell high-value goods and services and have fewer than 200 employees. Most of them are in industries that are not digitally native: manufacturers, industrial distributors, commercial services. They do not buy AI. They buy outcomes. Our job is to make agents reliable enough that a business owner can trust them with a number.
  
  
We are a team of about 90 people based in Bengaluru, backed by Lightspeed and SIG. If you want to want to help us build reliable agents that runs real businesses, we're excited to meet you!

title: Technical Account Manager
description:
## Who We Are
  
  
Testsigma is building the world's first Quality Intelligence Platform - AI-powered, agent-driven, and designed to make software testing intelligent rather than just automated. Our platform learns your application, your history, and your domain. It doesn't just generate tests - it understands risk, detects gaps, and gives teams the confidence to release.
  
  
## What This Role Is
  
  
We are growing fast, we are building toward a PLG motion, and the TAM who joins us now will own the technical health of our customers across every segment - making sure the platform they rely on is not just implemented, but genuinely driving value from day one.
  
  
The Technical Account Manager at Testsigma is the technical backbone of the customer journey. You own the technical health of your assigned accounts - onboarding, adoption, configuration, and ongoing technical engagement - and you coordinate across internal teams to make sure the customer gets what they need.
  
  
This is not a passive role. You assess each customer situation, determine what kind of intervention is needed, and pull in the right internal resource - whether that is TSE, ES, Product, or the commercial team. You are the one who sees the full technical picture of an account and acts on it.
  
  
You work across all customer segments - SMB, mid-market, and enterprise - in a 24x5 rotational environment. The complexity of what you handle changes with the account. The standard of ownership does not.
  
  
## What You Will Own
  
  
### 1. Technical Onboarding
  
  

* Own the end-to-end technical onboarding of new accounts across all segments - from kickoff through the customer's first production test suite and first-value milestone
* Run the technical kickoff covering the customer's environment, integration requirements, and 90-day technical milestones - do not begin configuration without this
* Close onboarding only when the customer has achieved a tangible technical outcome - not when the tasks are complete

### 2. Adoption and Technical Health
  
  

* Identify technical blockers to adoption within assigned accounts - configuration gaps, integration failures, user capability gaps
* Build account-specific technical adoption plans and execute them
* Monitor technical health signals across your portfolio - usage data, error patterns, engagement gaps - and act on them before they become customer-visible problems
* Communicate technical health proactively to relevant internal stakeholders so the right people can act at the right time

### 3. Technical Consulting and Problem Solving
  
  

* Act as the primary technical resource for complex customer use cases - diagnose the customer's environment, design the right approach, and execute it
* Lead technical customer interactions - calls, reviews, and deep-dive sessions - with a clear agenda and a follow-up summary sent within 24 hours
* Push back on technically infeasible or out-of-scope customer requests - clearly and early enough to matter
* Work in a 24x5 rotational shift environment supporting customers across global timezones

### 4. Cross-Functional Coordination
  
  

* Assess each customer situation and determine which internal team needs to be involved - TSE, ES, Product, or others - then coordinate and own the follow-through
* Come to every internal escalation with a structured problem statement, steps already tried, and relevant evidence
* Translate customer technical patterns into structured product feedback for the Product team - not individual complaints, but recurring themes with supporting data

### 5. Operational Discipline
  
  

* Keep technical account records and adoption data current at all times
* Send a summary within 24 hours of every customer interaction you lead
* Participate in weekly TAM team reviews with a prepared account technical status update

title: Sr. Commercial Relationship Manager

We are committed to creating a great product for our customers and a great work environment for our employees to succeed professionally and personally.
  
  
ServiceChannel is seeking a Senior Commercial Relationship Manager (Team Lead) to join our India Delivery Center (IDC) in Bangalore. This is a customer-facing, quota-bearing role that combines ownership of a portfolio of higher-value SMB / Small Commercial accounts with a player-coach responsibility to improve execution consistency across the IDC commercial team. The Senior RM partners closely with U.S.-based leadership to drive forecasting rigor, escalation handling, and operational excellence across the scaled coverage model.
  
  
This role will support our Global customer base with primary account ownership across United States (majority) and Europe (minority). The roles will scale to align to U.S. and Europe business hours; working with customers across all U.S. and European time zones.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and execute the end-to-end renewal and upsell process across an assigned portfolio, including proactive outreach, renewal planning, pricing execution, contract progression, and negotiations.
* Own expansion outcomes for the portfolio by identifying, qualifying, and executing upsell and cross-sell opportunities using structured commercial plays.
* Conduct customer-facing commercial conversations (renewals, pricing discussions, negotiations, and expansion conversations) with professionalism and strong business acumen.
* Act as a player-coach for the IDC commercial team: provide targeted deal support, coaching, and best-practice guidance on renewals and expansion execution.
* Serve as the first point of escalation for complex customer scenarios, commercial exceptions, or cross-functional blockers; coordinate resolution with Support, Billing / Collections, Implementation / Professional Services, Product, and U.S. Account Management leadership.

* Ensure consistent execution of playbooks, standard work, and segmentation rules across the IDC team; identify bottlenecks and opportunities to improve cycle time and customer experience.

title: [Evergreen] Technical Account Manager
description:
**Who we are**

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

**About the role:**

As a Samsara Technical Account Manager (TAM), you are the cornerstone of technical customer success. In this role, you will act as a trusted technical advisor, moving beyond traditional support to deliver measurable business value and drive the long-term adoption of the Samsara platform. Your mission is to proactively optimize your customers' technical health and mitigate risk, ensuring they achieve their desired outcomes.

This requires a unique blend of deep technical acumen, consultative problem-solving, and the ability to communicate with influence across both technical and executive stakeholders. You will build enduring customer relationships by translating their operational goals into powerful technical solutions. As the primary technical interface for your accounts, you will foster cross-functional collaboration with our Sales, Support, and Product teams to champion your customers' needs. During critical incidents, you will demonstrate ownership by managing customer communications and expectations through to a successful resolution.
  
  
***This is a hybrid position based in our Bengaluru office, requiring you to participate in an on-call rotation schedule to triage and manage high-severity issues and outages.***
**You should apply if:**

* **You want to impact the industries that run our world:**
  Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
* **You are the architect of your own career:**
  If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
* **You’re energized by our opportunity:**
  The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
* **You want to be with the best:**
  At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best.

**In this role, you will:**

* **Drive Customer Impact & Value Realization:**
  Go beyond technical support to consistently deliver measurable value. You will develop a deep understanding of your customers' business objectives and proactively align Samsara's solutions to help them achieve their goals, tracking and demonstrating technical ROI along the way.
* **Use AI to Transform the Customer Experience:**
  Leverage AI-powered tools and insights to anticipate customer needs, personalize engagement, and deliver faster, more proactive, and impactful outcomes.
* **Execute Transformational Technical Account Management:**
  Independently manage a portfolio of accounts, developing tailored success plans and identifying and mitigating risks to customer health. You will maintain accurate records of customer interactions and contribute to team-wide objectives.
* **Demonstrate Deep Technical Acumen & Samsara Expertise:**
  Be the primary technical point of contact, mastering Samsara's platform, including APIs, hardware, and software. You will advise customers on best practices and troubleshoot complex technical issues with proficiency.
* **Provide Consultative Problem Solving & Solutioning:**
  Employ a consultative approach to understand the root cause of customer challenges. You will own the technical ticket lifecycle, including technical escalations from report to resolution, and conduct root cause analysis to prevent recurrence and drive product improvement.
* **Communicate with Influence and Clarity:**
  Lead customer meetings, from technical deep dives to quarterly technical account reviews, with confidence. You will adapt your communication style to effectively engage with diverse audiences, from technical staff to non-technical executives.
* **Foster Cross-Functional Collaboration:**
  Partner effectively with Sales, Support, Product, and Engineering teams to advocate for customer needs and deliver a unified experience.
* **Demonstrate Ownership and Act as a Multiplier:**
  Embody a 'get it done' mentality by taking initiative on team projects and process improvements. You will actively contribute to our internal knowledge base and help onboard new team members, sharing best practices to enhance the entire team's capabilities.
* **Embody Samsara's Values & Principles:**
  Consistently champion and role model Samsara's core values and operating principles in every interaction, actively seeking feedback for continuous improvement

**Minimum requirements for the role:**

* **Experience:**
  7+ years experience in a technical, customer-facing role such as technical account management, solutions consulting, or customer success, with a demonstrated track record of success.
* **Education:**
    We welcome applications from candidates with a bachelor's degree in a technical field, or those who have gained equivalent expertise through practical experience in areas such as Computer Science, Engineering, or related fields.
* **Technical Proficiency:**
  Exceptional technical literacy with the ability to understand and troubleshoot complex hardware, software, and API integrations. A strong passion for technology and a commitment to continuous learning, including an interest in AI and its applications.
* **Bilingual:**
  English and Spanish is a must.
* **Customer Focus:**
  A data-informed approach to understanding customer needs and a demonstrated ability to build trusted, long-term relationships.
* **Communication:**
  Strong written and verbal communication skills in English and Spanish is required.
* **Collaborative Spirit:**
  A team player who thrives in a fast-paced environment and works effectively with internal teams to drive customer success.

**An ideal candidate also has:**

* Experience supporting global enterprise-level customers in a SaaS, IoT, or PaaS environment.
* Proven experience leveraging AI tools and methodologies in daily workflows to drive efficiency, generate customer insights, and improve overall customer success.
* Prior experience with Samsara, Salesforce, Zendesk, Jira, Gong, Gainsight, and Tableau.
* Basic Python coding skills are an asset for providing enhanced technical solutions

 

**Total Rewards**

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

**Flexible Working**

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

**Belonging at Samsara**

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

**Accommodations**

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

**Our Commitment to Authenticity**

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

**Fraudulent Employment Offers**

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

Sales owns the account relationship and commercial closure, SAs own the architecture, you own the AI funnel - bringing AI sales energy and expertise to uncover and qualify use cases, keep deals moving, and clear blockers, so that every AI opportunity converts to Order Booking faster.

**Handover & Customer Success:**

Leverage AWS, Microsoft and other partner programs - co-selling, funding, credits and joint events - to accelerate deals.

•
**3-5 years**
of experience in tech sales, pre-sales, sales support, customer success or business development for cloud, AI solutions, with a track record of contributing to pipeline growth and closed deals.

**enterprise sales teams**
across the sales cycle - from lead qualification to order booking.

**AI / GenAI concepts**

**consultative selling**
skills - able to uncover business problems, build value-based pitches and navigate multi-stakeholder buying cycles.

• Working knowledge of
**CRM tools**
(Zoho or similar), pipeline management and forecasting.

title: Key Account Manager
description:
We are looking for a commercially driven and results-oriented Manager – Key Account Management (Fitness & Sports Accessories) to manage and grow our business across ecommerce marketplaces, including Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, and other relevant online channels. The ideal candidate should have a minimum of 2+ years of experience in e-commerce account management, marketplace sales, or online business management, preferably within fitness accessories, sports goods, consumer products, or D2C brands. The role involves driving revenue growth, managing marketplace relationships, optimising product visibility, planning promotions, monitoring inventory availability, and improving overall business profitability.

**Responsibilities**

* **Marketplace Business Management**
* Manage and grow our fitness and sports accessories business across assigned ecommerce marketplaces.
* Develop and execute strategies to achieve sales targets, improve market share, and drive category growth.
* Manage day-to-day marketplace operations, including product listings, pricing, promotions, and account performance.
* Build strong working relationships with marketplace account managers and category teams.
* Identify business opportunities across existing products, new launches, and emerging fitness and sports categories.
* **Sales & Revenue Growth**
* Drive monthly and quarterly sales targets across assigned marketplaces.
* Analyse sales trends, conversion rates, traffic, and SKU-level performance to identify growth opportunities.
* Develop plans to improve product visibility, sales velocity, and conversion.
* Monitor competitor pricing, product assortment, ratings, reviews, and promotional strategies.
* Recommend actions to improve sales performance and strengthen our competitive positioning.
* **Category & Product Management**
* Manage product assortment across fitness and sports accessories, including resistance bands, gym accessories, yoga products, sports equipment, and other relevant categories.
* Monitor SKU-level performance and identify high-performing and underperforming products.
* Coordinate with category and product teams on new product launches, assortment expansion, and product positioning.
* Ensure product listings, images, descriptions, keywords, and catalogue information are accurate and optimised.
* Track customer feedback, ratings, reviews, and return reasons to identify opportunities for product and listing improvements.
* **Promotions & Marketing**
* Plan and execute marketplace promotions, discount campaigns, and seasonal sales events.
* Coordinate with performance marketing teams to improve product visibility through marketplace advertising.
* Monitor advertising performance, including ACoS, ROAS, and advertising-driven sales, wherever applicable.
* Support campaign planning for major marketplace events and fitness-related seasonal opportunities.
* Evaluate campaign effectiveness and recommend improvements to maximise sales and profitability.
* **Inventory & Supply Chain Coordination**
* Coordinate with the in-stock management and supply chain teams to ensure product availability across marketplaces.
* Monitor stock levels, sales forecasts, replenishment requirements, and inventory cover.
* Identify potential stockouts and work proactively to minimise lost sales.
* Support inventory planning for new launches, promotional events, and seasonal demand fluctuations.
* Track slow-moving and excess inventory and coordinate corrective actions with relevant teams.
* **Profitability & Commercial Management**
* Monitor product pricing, discounting, marketplace fees, and promotional costs.
* Analyse SKU-level sales and profitability to support business decisions.
* Identify opportunities to improve margins while maintaining competitive pricing.
* Work with finance and operations teams to resolve marketplace-related commercial and settlement issues, where applicable.
* **Reporting & Business Analytics**
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly sales reports and marketplace performance dashboards.
* Track key metrics such as revenue, units sold, average selling price, conversion rates, inventory availability, and profitability.
* Analyse category trends, competitor performance, and customer demand to develop actionable business plans.
* Present business updates and performance insights to leadership.
* **Cross-functional Collaboration**
* Work closely with marketing, supply chain, in-stock management, product, catalogue, finance, and operations teams.
* Ensure timely execution of marketplace campaigns, product launches, and replenishment plans.
* Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to resolve operational challenges and improve business performance.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Commerce, or a related field.

**Required Skills**

* Minimum 2+ years of relevant experience in Key Account Management, e-commerce, marketplace sales, or online business management.

title: Account Manager (SaaS) - Altium
description:
**Company Description**
Renesas is one of the top global semiconductor companies in the world. We strive to develop a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter world, and our goal is to make every endpoint intelligent by offering product solutions in the automotive, industrial, infrastructure and IoT markets. Our robust product portfolio includes world leading MCUs, SoCs, Analog and power products, plus Winning Combination solutions that curate these complementary products. We are a key supplier to the world’s leading manufacturers of electronics you rely on every day; you may not see our products, but they are all around you.
  
  
Renesas employs roughly 21,000 people in more than 30 countries worldwide. As a global team, our employees actively embody the Renesas Culture, our guiding principles based on five key elements: Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. Renesas believes in, and has a commitment to, diversity and inclusion, with initiatives and a leadership team dedicated to its resources and values. At Renesas, we want to build a sustainable future where technology helps make our lives easier. Join us and build your future by being part of what’s next in electronics and the world
  
  
**Job Description**
For over three decades, Altium has been pioneering next-generation electronics design by continuing to develop innovative PCB design software that supports the engineering workflow. Altium offers a truly unified design experience to provide teams with all the tools they need to create successful electronic products - from concept to manufacturing. Through continuous research and development efforts, Altium remains dedicated to bringing comprehensive design capabilities to the mainstream to help engineers to make the most of modern technologies, successfully manage projects, and deliver intelligent, connected products.
  
  
Altium is growing and we are looking for an Account Manager to drive our growth in the assigned region. The primary role of the Account Manager is to build new customers and leverage relationships with existing customers to expand and upsell products and services.
  
  
**A day in the life of our Account Manager:**

* Build and nurture relationships with new and existing customers, identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling Altium’s solutions.
* Ensure high post-sales satisfaction, driving renewals and long-term partnerships.
* Meet or exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets.
* With deep dive Account Mapping, should be able to Present Altium’s value proposition through presentations accordingly to various stakeholders' personas in an Account/ organisation.
* Maintain detailed and accurate records of sales activities in Altium’s CRM system.
* Execute specialized projects such as call-out campaigns and customer data updates.
* Develop and implement strategies to expand Altium’s customer base and enhance market penetration.
* Track and manage subscription renewal dates within the assigned territory to maximize retention.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders, including marketing and customer success teams, to drive customer engagement and revenue growth.
* Stay up to date with industry trends, competitor activities, and Altium’s evolving product offerings.
* Office based in Bangalore with potential travel within India

**Qualifications**
**Who We’re Looking For**

* Bachelor's degree in business, communication, or a related field is desirable or a combination of equivalent education and experience.
* 10+ years of experience in SaaS software sales , preferably with a focus on annual subscriptions and maintenance contracts; ECAD, MCAD, or PLM experience is a strong plus.
* Proven leadership experience with a track record of successfully managing and coaching sales teams.
* Strong communication and negotiation skills with the ability to influence decision-makers at all levels.
* Self-driven and results-oriented with a passion for sales and business growth.
* Experience working with customers across PAN India is essential
* Proficiency in CRM systems such as Salesforce is highly desirable.
* Fluency in English is required; knowledge of additional Indian languages is a plus

**Additional Information**
Altium Limited, a part of the Renesas Group and headquartered in San Diego, California, is a global software company accelerating the pace of electronics innovation. We are redefining electronic product creation in a software-defined world with our industry-first cloud-based platform that unites every stakeholder and phase of electronics development.
  
  
From startups to world’s technology giants, our digital platforms give more power to PCB designers, supply chain, and manufacturing, letting them collaborate as never before. At Altium, our teams are empowered to innovate, collaborate globally, and help create the future of electronics development.
  
  
We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.

title: Partnership Manager - Bangalore
description:

title: Delivery Manager
description:
The Delivery Manager is responsible for end-to-end client delivery outcomes, operational stability, and account growth within assigned accounts. This is a
**technically hands-on delivery leadership role**
: you will be expected to understand architecture, code quality, environments, and release pipelines well enough to guide engineers, challenge estimates, and lead technical conversations with client stakeholders. The role operationalizes the
**3M Strategy (Manage, Monitor, Mine)**
, ensures adherence to the
**Tiered Operating Model**
, and acts as the primary day-to-day delivery contact for clients. You will work as a
**peer**
with global counterparts, drive client satisfaction, and proactively identify risks and expansion opportunities.

Because many of our clients are based on the US West Coast, this role includes regular late-night coverage from India so that PST clients have a responsive, accountable delivery lead during their working day.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* 8+ years of delivery/project management in IT services or software engineering, with a hands-on technical background (developer, tech lead, architect, or DevOps/QA engineering) of at least 3 years
* Strong technical depth in modern software delivery: system design basics, APIs and integrations, databases, cloud (AWS/Azure), and CI/CD pipelines
* Ability to read and review code or technical designs and hold credible technical discussions with engineers and client architects
* Experience managing multiple clients simultaneously (shared PM model)
* Strong working knowledge of Agile, DevOps, and hybrid delivery models
* Proven ability to work with COEs (e.g., Modern Engineering, Integration, Cloud, ERP)
* Excellent client-facing communication and risk management skills, including experience working with US clients
* Familiarity with tools like Jira, Confluence, DevOps pipelines, and health dashboards
* Willingness and ability to work late-night hours (up to ~1:00–2:00 AM IST) for PST client coverage
* Willingness to come to the office on short notice and to travel as business needs arise
* A dedicated home workspace with reliable internet and power backup for remote work

**Preferred**

* Experience with staff augmentation ? value-add delivery transformation
* Background in one or more COE domains (e.g., legacy modernization, low-code, AI, Mulesoft, Kafka, AWS/Azure, data engineering)
* Hands-on exposure to test automation, security and compliance practices, and AI-assisted development
* PMP, CSM, SAFe, or relevant cloud/DevOps certification
* Prior experience in a peer delivery model with global teams

title: SAP AMS Service Delivery Manager
description:
ArchLynk stands at the vanguard of SAP Digital Supply Chain, Logistics, Business Planning, and Global Trade solutions, empowering businesses to build resilient, adaptive, and efficient supply chain ecosystems. As a trusted SAP Gold Partner, we have a proven track record of delivering best-in-class solutions and services, ensuring long-term success in an ever-evolving digital landscape. Headquartered in San Jose, California, we specialize in strategic planning, process optimization, and SAP solution deployment across the globe. Leveraging AI/ML-driven tools, seamless integrations, and custom developments, we help businesses navigate the complexities of global supply chain execution with cutting-edge innovation and expertise.
  
  
**Role Summary**
We’re seeking an experienced Senior SAP AMS Services Manager to lead our managed services portfolio across multiple SAP workstreams (e.g., S/4HANA, GTS, TM, IBP, EWM, BTP). You will be responsible for service delivery, customer success, financial performance, and continuous improvement across a portfolio of AMS accounts. This role combines people leadership, client engagement, operations management, and hands-on governance of ITIL processes and SAP run operations.
  
  
**What You’ll Own**
**Service Delivery & Governance**

* Own end-to-end AMS delivery (Incident, Service Request, Problem, Change, Release) leveraging ITIL and SAP best practices.
* Chair Service Reviews (weekly/Monthly/Quarterly) and drive SLA/OLA compliance, CSAT, and escalation management.
* Maintain the Service Catalog, RACI, runbooks, and playbooks; ensure auditable process adherence.

**Client Engagement & Success**

* Act as executive point of contact for 3 - 6 strategic AMS accounts; manage expectations, roadmap, renewals, and upselling.
* Translate business priorities into AMS backlogs and continuous improvement plans.
* Proactively identify risk, capacity constraints, and lead root cause and preventive actions.

**People & Capacity Management**

* Lead a blended global team; build staffing plans, on-call rotations, and skills matrices across L1/L2/L3.
* Coach leads and consultants, institute knowledge management, SOPs, and mentoring programs.
* Foster a culture of accountability, responsiveness, and consulting excellence.

**Financial & Commercial Management**

* Own portfolio P&L: utilization, gross margin, revenue forecasting, backlog, change orders, renewals.
* Ensure contract adherence (SLAs, service windows, holidays), rate card governance, and accurate capture of time/effort.
* Support presales for AMS proposals/SOWs, ROM estimates, and transition-to-support plans.

**Transition & Stabilization**

* Lead hypercare exit and service transitions from projects to steady state (KT plans, cutover to AMS, acceptance criteria).
* Define service boundaries, KPIs, and early-warning indicators to reach “run-stable” status quickly

* Bachelor’s degree in IT, Business, or a related field.
* 10+ years in SAP services with 5+ years in AMS leadership or Service Management roles.
* Excellent stakeholder management, clear and concise communication, conflict resolution, and executive presence.
* Broad SAP exposure across at least two domains (e.g., S/4HANA + one of GTS/TM/IBP/EWM/BTP).
* Strong command of ITIL v3/4 processes (Incident/Problem/Change/Release), RCA methods, and SLA design.
* Demonstrated success running multi-customer, multi-region AMS with measurable improvements in CSAT and SLAs.
* Experience managing financials (bookings/revenue/gross margin, utilization, bench, forecasting).
* Hands-on with ITSM tools (ServiceNow/Jira) and SAP ALM/SolMan/ChaRM.

**Additional Considerations**

* ITIL, PMP, PgMP, PMI-ACP, or SAP Activate certification is highly preferred.
* Presales experience for AMS/Run services and solutioning transition-to-support.
* Experience leading SAP programs in supply chain, logistics, manufacturing, or global trade industries.

**Why Join Our Team?**
Working at ArchLynk means joining a team fueled by collaboration, innovation, and teamwork. Our success is built on the talent, dedication, and passion of the people who drive our mission forward.
  
  
**What We Offer**

* Challenging projects with global organizations working on innovative technologies.
* Talented, passionate, intercultural, and multi-disciplinary teams - the best experts within the industry.
* Individual-centric career path and growth opportunities.
* Training and development opportunities.
* Flexibility and autonomy.
* Annual educational reimbursement for personal and professional development.

**Our People and Culture**
We are a global organization united by a shared purpose. While we celebrate our diversity and individuality, we thrive through collaboration, mutual respect, and unwavering support for one another. We seize every opportunity to exceed customer expectations and continually pursue excellence in all that we do.
  
  
At ArchLynk, we empower our team members with meaningful learning experiences, a flexible and inclusive environment, and the tools to grow and achieve excellence. If this resonates with the experience you seek, we invite you to join our team and embark on an inspiring journey with us.
  
  
We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and are committed to creating an inclusive environment. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, marital status, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status.

title: Relationship Manager
description:

products

title: Manager - Tax-TTC- AMS- Hyderabad/Bengaluru/Gurugram/Pune/Mumbai
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Manager - AMS - CLM**
The need for ongoing support and optimization of legal technology solutions is more critical than ever, empowering legal departments to maximize the value of their investments and ensure continuous improvement in service delivery. If you are passionate about enabling legal transformation through proactive application management and enjoy collaborating with dedicated professionals to help organizations achieve operational excellence, we invite you to join our team. Apply now!
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
Our Legal Business Services Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) practice is expanding its Application Managed Services team (AMS). As a CLM AMS Portfolio lead/Manager within the Application Managed Services (AMS) Team, you will manage multiple AMS projects within the CLM practice, ensuring client requirements are met and service levels are consistently maintained or exceeded. you will play a pivotal role in leading teams to deliver high-quality support, drive continuous improvement, and ensure the success of our clients’ business-critical applications throughout their transformation journey.
  
  
You will oversee and mentor cross-functional teams, coordinate with internal stakeholders, and foster strategic client relationships to deliver exceptional service. Your responsibilities include managing escalations, overseeing client communications, ensuring adherence to SLAs, and identifying opportunities for innovation and process optimization at scale. This role requires strong leadership, strategic thinking, and client management skills, along with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  
  
As a CLM AMS Portfolio Lead/Manager, you will contribute to the growth and success of Deloitte Tax LLP in a variety of way, including:
  
  
**Client Management**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for key client stakeholders, building trusted advisor relationships and ensuring client satisfaction.
* Prepare and present regular status reports to clients and internal stakeholders.
* Work closely with customers to answer questions about the features and capabilities of our product.
* Ensure proactive communication of upgrade plans and coordinate with clients and internal teams to minimize business disruption.

**Delivery**

* Lead and manage a team providing day-to-day support for CLM applications, including incident management, troubleshooting, and resolution of technical and functional issues of multiple AMS projects or PODs.
* Ensure compliance with SLAs, KPIs, and contractual obligations.
* Oversee the resolution of complex or escalated issues, providing guidance and direction to team members.
* Assist in the development and execution of test plans for system changes, enhancements, and new releases. Oversee quality assurance and ensure best practices are followed.

**Solutions**

* Design, configure, and implement changes or upgrades to CLM platforms (e.g., Icertis, Conga, DocuSign CLM, Agiloft), ensuring alignment with client requirements and best practices.
* Specialize in resolving issues pertaining to customer-specific configuration and third-party integration. Guide the team in providing innovative solutions and workarounds.
* Collaborate with clients and internal leadership to understand business objectives and translate them into system strategies, configurations, or enhancements.
* Stay current on CLM technology trends and best practices to provide innovative solutions to clients. Share insights and best practices with both clients and internal teams.

**Support**

* Document processes, configurations, and solutions to ensure knowledge transfer and continuity. Establish and maintain documentation standards across the team.
* Support user training and adoption activities, including the creation of user guides and training materials. Drive change management and adoption strategies for clients.
* Support resource planning, onboarding, and training for project teams.

**Project Management**

* Participate in continuous improvement initiatives to optimize CLM processes and system performance. Lead process improvement projects and champion innovation within the team.

**Cross Functional Teaming**

* Collaborate with clients and internal leadership to understand business objectives and translate them into system strategies, configurations, or enhancements.

**People Development**

* Support resource planning, onboarding, and training for project teams.
* Oversee the resolution of complex or escalated issues, providing guidance and direction to team members.

Our team’s multi-disciplinary approach combines technical and technology skillsets, enabling greater impact and efficiency within our client’s organization. TTC’s Legal Business Services team helps clients with operating model evaluation, roadmap development for a desired future state, data management solutions, automation opportunities, contract lifecycle management, legal entity management, and legal operating models. Learn more about Deloitte Legal Business Services.

Icertis certified ICI Administrator, Icertis Certified Functional Professional, Sirion Certified CLM Specialist)

* Familiarity with contract management processes and terminology.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple client relationships and lead cross-functional teams.
* Strong project management skills and experience with resource planning and team development.
* Willingness to work in shifts and travel on demand.

**Preferred:**

* Experience supporting legal teams or procurement teams with contract management
* Experience in working large-scale AMS or CLM projects and process improvement initiatives.
* Experience in business development, proposal writing, or pre-sales support.
* Experience in Customer Support or professional services in client-facing environment.
* Project management certification (e.g., PMP, Agile) or process improvement experience (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma), IT service management (e.g. ITIL)

We lead SAP's most complex customer engagements across the region, with high internal visibility and direct C-level access. This role involves up to 50% travel.
  
  
****Job Description:****
The Regional Delivery Executive (RDE) is a senior professional with deep (15+ years) program delivery experience. They need to have advanced, proven skills in executive communications, stakeholder management and a solid knowledge of the legal and commercial aspects of working with customers, particularly in distressed engagements. The purpose of this role is to ensure top-notch delivery. This means consistently meeting our customer commitments by grasping their needs. We package our solutions to create measurable business value within agreed timelines and budgets.
  
  
The Regional Delivery Executive must have the right qualifications, experience, and business knowledge. They will manage several large and high-risk projects and programs. These projects will involve various business units and service partners. They will also span across organizations and national borders. This position has a high level of responsibility and exposure within SAP, the industry, and our market leading customers. They are a senior professional with an entrepreneurial mindset and business acumen as needed for this complex role.
  
  
They Improve Knowledge Management In The Company. They Share Lessons Learned From Collaboration, Portfolio, And Program Work. They Also Develop Best Practices To Ensure Delivery Excellence. There Are 3 Focus Areas Of The Regional Delivery Executive:
  
  

* Prevention: A champion for Delivery Excellence and Adoption through Continuous Improvement programs:
* Actively contributes as an expert in the Communities
* Drives knowledge sharing across our delivery organisation with a focus on Lessons Learned
* Actively supports knowledge management activities
* Actively supports customers in achieving value of SAP solutions and enables rapid innovation adoption, in partnership with our Enterprise Architects
* Coach, mentor and develop CE&A delivery teams across APAC, with Focus on India
* Correction:
* Develop corrective plans on engagements identified as Early Warning
* Provide Governance and Thought Leadership to turn around a delivery engagement at risk of progression to escalation
* De-Escalation: Project / Engagement Escalations and Recovery
* Intervein, support and guide running de-escalations as needed across the region
* Manage senior stakeholders through the full escalation lifecycle
* Limit litigation and commercial liability through recovery activities

****Key Responsibilities & Tasks****
**Opportunity Management**

* Define appropriate delivery model for customer project/program/portfolio as a composition of pre-defined services, on-site and/or remote delivery – including Success Plans
* Work with Solution Centre and Bid Management teams to scope and estimate the engagement and its component projects/programs, with a goal to ensure maximum customer business value
* Drive and supports the adoption of Clean Core and SAP AI

**Delivery**

* Lead and own engagement-planning and program-planning activities
* Oversee the delivery of multiple projects related to successful engagement or program execution.
* Own the engagement and program plan and be in charge of delivery of its major elements including program’s business objectives, scope and solution within quality criteria, on time and budget.
* Drive quality in delivery, including clarity and transparency of the project or engagement health along with clear action plans where additional mitigation or management is needed.

**Sales and Business Development**

* Close work with EAs, SAE, SSA, MPs and product sales colleagues on large bids and proposals for new business.
* Oversee and lead the development of proposals, tenders, and or responses to requests for proposals associated with the program in order to win new deals for SAP with minimal risks.

**Coaching & Mentoring**

* Serve as a mentor and advisor to project managers. Help them with problems related to corporate and external politics. Support them in building client relations, ensuring project quality, and managing project risk during Delivery Engagements.
* Oversee effective engagement oversight and reviews to influence customer success.

**Knowledge Management**

* Organize knowledge capturing activities at programs and ensure retention on high quality intellectual capital for SAP Field Services practices.
* Participate in the development of project / program management best practices, examples, templates and SAP’s Program Management Methodology

Professional Training & Certification
