title: Account Director - CRM - MRD
description:
**Company Description**
It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
  
  
Join us to put AI to work for people.
  
  
**Job Description**
The Account Director – CRM – MRD will drive market success for ServiceNow's CRM and Industry Workflow solutions across Manufacturing, Retail and Distribution industries, with an additional responsibility to identify and develop CRM opportunities within the Global Capability Centre (GCC) ecosystem.
  
  
These solutions are built on ServiceNow's market-leading AI platform, enabling organizations to connect customer engagement, sales, service, field operations and enterprise workflows through a unified platform. By leveraging AI, data and automation, ServiceNow helps enterprises transform customer experiences, improve operational efficiency and accelerate business outcomes.
  
  
**What You Get To Do In This Role**

* Support territory strategy and planning to improve vertical understanding, account use-case targeting and execution across Manufacturing, Retail and Distribution accounts.
* Provide strategic input to Account Executives during account planning, identifying opportunities for CRM-led transformation and industry-specific workflow adoption.
* Ensure territory strategy and account recommendations are aligned with ServiceNow's Now Value principles and measurable business outcomes.
* Engage with customers to envision digital transformation opportunities, articulate business value and develop strategic transformation roadmaps in collaboration with account teams and partners.
* Drive AI-led CRM transformation conversations, helping customers understand how Agentic AI, AI agents, intelligent automation and workflow orchestration can transform business processes.
* Identify opportunities to leverage ServiceNow CRM capabilities across Sales, Customer Service, Field Service, Sales and Order Management, and industry-specific workflows.
* Additionally, identify and develop CRM opportunities within the GCC ecosystem, positioning ServiceNow as a strategic platform for GCCs looking to transform global sales, customer service, field operations and enterprise workflows.
* Engage with GCC leadership, business stakeholders and technology decision-makers to identify enterprise transformation opportunities and establish strategic relationships.
* Partner with Solution Consulting and Specialist Solution Consulting teams to develop capability roadmaps, solution positioning and differentiated customer value propositions.
* Coach Account Executives, ADRs and ACE teams on foundational CRM and industry solution capabilities to identify opportunities and effectively manage the sales cycle.
* Build strong relationships with customer business stakeholders and technology leaders to drive strategic solution adoption.
* Customize time allocation and engagement based on territory priorities, account opportunities and the needs of the broader sales organization.

**Qualifications**

* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
* 6+ years of relevant experience in enterprise solution sales, technology sales, CRM sales or an alternative customer-facing sales role.
* Strong understanding of CRM solutions, enterprise business processes and customer experience transformation.
* Demonstrated ability to articulate the business value and ROI of specialty solutions and lead complex solution sales opportunities.
* Understanding of AI concepts and their application in enterprise business processes, including Generative AI, Agentic AI, AI-powered automation and intelligent workflows.
* Ability to identify opportunities where AI can improve business decision-making, automate processes, enhance customer experience and deliver measurable business outcomes.
* Experience leveraging AI-powered tools, workflow automation or AI-driven insights to solve business problems and improve operational efficiency.
* Understanding of Manufacturing, Retail and Distribution business processes and industry-specific transformation priorities.
* Understanding of the GCC ecosystem and its evolving role in global enterprise transformation would be an added advantage.
* Strong consultative selling, stakeholder management, communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with Account Executives, Solution Consultants, Specialist Sales teams and ecosystem partners.

title: Business Manager- Car Commerce
description:
**Bengaluru (Indiranagar)**

**3–6 Years Experience**

**Reports to Business Head**

**About Lane**

Lane is building India's most trusted, tech-enabled driving and mobility platform — transforming how first-time drivers learn to drive and eventually buy their first car. We are India's first platform connecting certified driving instructors with learners.

In 18 months, Lane has delivered
**40,000+ hours of instruction to 4,000+ learners**

, supported by a certified instructor network across Bengaluru. We recently raised
**₹8.5 crore in pre-seed funding**

, led by Kae Capital, with participation from DeVC, Antler India, Panthera Peak, Titan Capital and other investors.

**The Vision**

Every Indian's relationship with a car starts with learning to drive. Yet, no single platform owns the entire journey. Lane is building a connected car ownership ecosystem:

**Learn to drive → Get licensed → Buy the right first car → Finance → Insure → Maintain → Upgrade.**

Our goal is to build a trusted relationship with customers throughout their car ownership journey, with driving education serving as the entry point. Our long-term vision is to help 1 million Indians find the right first car, targeting approximately ₹1,00,000 crore in vehicle GMV over the next decade. Our near-term ambition is to build a scalable Car Commerce business with
**5,000 vehicles and ₹500 crore GMV within 36 months**

, supported by repeatable unit economics.

**The Role**

We are looking for a hands-on
**Business Manager – Car Commerce**

to help build and scale Lane's car commerce business. You will work closely with the CEO and Business Head to manage vehicle supply, drive buyer conversions, build partnerships, and ensure smooth vehicle transactions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage day-to-day Car Commerce operations and category performance.
* Build and maintain vehicle supply through individual sellers, dealers and customer networks.
* Manage buyer enquiries, understand requirements and drive conversions.
* Coordinate vehicle inspections, pricing, documentation and delivery.
* Develop relationships with dealers, financing partners, NBFCs and insurance providers.
* Manage the complete transaction journey from enquiry to vehicle delivery.
* Track GMV, revenue, inventory, conversions and other business metrics.
* Maintain dashboards, analyse performance and improve operational processes.

**What We're Looking For**

* 3–6 years of experience in automotive retail, used-car sales, auto-tech, marketplaces or business operations.
* Understanding of vehicle pricing, inventory, dealer networks and used-car transactions.
* Experience in sales, business development, category management or operations.
* Strong negotiation, communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Good understanding of Excel/Google Sheets and business reporting.
* High ownership, problem-solving ability and comfort working in a fast-paced startup.

**Why Join Lane?**

* Build a new-age Car Commerce business from the ground up.
* Work directly with the founding and leadership team.
* Take ownership of business outcomes and growth.
* Gain exposure across sales, operations, partnerships and product.
* Grow with an ambitious mobility startup transforming India's first-car buying experience.

**Lane is the brand of Inlane Technologies Pvt. Ltd., a DPIIT-recognised startup based in Bengaluru.**

title: Program & Partnership Manager
description:
Category: Full-time

Starting date: Immediate

Location: Bangalore

**About Equilibrium:**

Equilibrium is a full-stack carbon removal developer building one of the largest high-integrity carbon portfolios from the Global South, with a ~20Mt CO₂ removal pipeline. We develop bankable, high-impact projects by integrating advanced climate science, an in-house digital MRV platform, and innovative blended finance.

Our portfolio spans across nature-based and engineered removal: on nature-based, we have large-scale agroforestry, regenerative agriculture, and mangrove restoration initiatives; on engineered removal, we are building India's leading biochar platform with large-scale commercial operations. Collectively, our projects span 120,000+ hectares and will support over 150,000 smallholder farmers and coastal communities.

Our work is backed by a $3M institutional seed round from Peak XV (formerly Sequoia) and Avaana Capital, and driven by a 95+ member team with deep expertise in climate science, carbon markets, and project operations.

**The Mission & Partnership:**

Join a pioneering partnership between a rapidly growing start-up and an established global leader in nature ecosystem services. Together, we are embedding GIS, data and technology into the intersection of finance and nature, driving the tech-integrated step change required to deliver environmental impact at scale.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**About the Role**

This role sits at the intersection of partnership management and program delivery. It will support the overall health and management of the partnership, and own the management of EQ teams to deliver shared outcomes across the partnership’s key workstreams, with a particular focus on the GIS workstream. The key partnership workstreams are:

* GIS Core Carbon Delivery
* GIS QA/QC
* Data & Systems
* Research & Development

This role will work closely with the internal and external workstream Leads to support work planning and prioritization and will lead the translation of those priorities into execution for the EQ team.

**Responsibilities**

**Partnership and Stakeholder Management (15%)**

* Act as the primary point of coordination for across external team leads, translating those into workstream priorities internally
* Lead workstream milestone reporting, working closely with external partners and leadership to define value-driving metrics
* Own regular communication, updates, expectations and follow-ups regarding the partnership and its ways of working
* Maintain visibility on partnership priorities, risks and opportunities
* Establish and maintain escalation protocols, ensuring issues requiring leadership intervention reach the appropriate forum
* Maintain the partnership ways of working primer and partnership management check-in cadence
* Work closely with the EQ Technical Lead to ensure technology requirements, developments and priorities remain aligned with workstream needs.

**GIS Workstream: Program & Delivery Management (50%)**

* Translate core carbon delivery project GIS needs into clear, shared workplans and priorities for the Equilibrium team, working closely with senior GIS experts
* Lead bandwidth planning, utilisation analysis, and work allocation for the EQ team
* Own GIS workplan tracking, ensuring project management data is up to date and smooth workplan progression between both teams
* Lead daily GIS stand-ups and support GIS work planning meetings
* Be the first point of contact for the EQ team regarding GIS work challenges and blockers
* Work with the Head of GIS to continuously improve GIS program delivery ways of working
* Proactively identify and resolve complex or ambiguous issues across the GIS workstream before they affect delivery

**QA/QC, Data & Systems, R&D Workstreams: Program and Delivery Management (20%)**

* Support the translation of workstream priorities into clear, shared workplans, aligning proactively with workstream leads before work begins to confirm scope, approach, prioritisation (within and across worksstreams), feasibility and resourcing across relevant EQ teams
* Monitor workstream progress, timelines, blockers and upcoming demand
* Drive timely resolution of internal blockers and dependencies.

**Team Management (15%)**

* Foster a collaborative, high-performing team culture for the partnership, and support team engagement and wellbeing
* Coordinate with the relevant EQ manager to conduct professional development planning for EQ team members so they are best placed to deliver on the workstream outcomes
* Liaise with external workstream leads to identify professional development opportunities for EQ team members, where appropriate, that enhance the partnership
* Provide day-to-day leadership and coaching to EQ team members, setting clear expectations and priorities aligned to workstreams

**What We’re Looking For:**

* 3-5 years of experience in program management, strategic operations, consulting or a similar role.
* Familiarity with GIS work, including how GIS teams plan and deliver projects
* Comfortable working with technical teams and translating business requirements into actionable work.
* Strong stakeholder and relationship management skills, with experience working across external clients and internal teams, including senior management
* Excellent project management and organizational skills.
* Ability to coordinate multiple workstreams and drive teams toward closure.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* High ownership, attention to detail and ability to operate independently in a fast-moving environment.

**Key Attributes**

* Holds yourself and others to the highest moral and ethical standards
* Owns problems end to end, solving them with sustainable, lasting solutions
* Curious and courageous in uncharted territory
* Uses intellect and street smarts to think ahead, evolve ideas and push boundaries
* Collaborates inclusively across organisational boundaries to deliver shared impact
* Builds trust over time, reading stakeholder nuance and investing in relationships for the long term
* Comfortable working with GIS, data and technology teams, with enough intent to have a technical grasp to drive decisions
* Down to earth, purposeful and humble in your approach

description:

**Job Title: Service Manager, Biomonitoring India**
The
**Service Manager, Biomonitoring India**
leads the BioMonitoring Field Service Engineering team across India and reports to the APeC Service Manager. This role is responsible for the full-service lifecycle, from instrument installation and qualification to preventive maintenance, repairs, contract renewals, and resolution of complex technical issues. The Service Manager drives service revenue and customer satisfaction, builds team capability, and serves as a key link between field operations, commercial sales, and global product management. This role will be based in Bangalore, India.
  
  
**Your Role**
**Team Leadership & People Management**

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of Field Service Engineers across India, setting clear performance objectives and conducting regular performance reviews.
* Build a high-performing team through effective onboarding, skills assessments, and individual development plans.
* Manage schedules, workloads, and capacity to maintain field coverage and timely customer response.
* Identify training needs and coordinate technical and soft-skills development programmes for employees, dealers, and third-party partners.
* Foster a culture of accountability, safety, and customer-centricity within the team.

**Service Operations & Delivery**

* Oversee the full-service lifecycle for the Company’s BioMonitoring instruments in India, including installation, Installation Qualification and Operational Qualification (IQ/OQ), preventive maintenance, repairs, and decommissioning.
* Implement and uphold standard operating procedures (SOPs) and service protocols to ensure consistent, compliant service delivery.
* Coordinate engineer scheduling and dispatch to meet customer needs and service level agreements (SLAs).
* Review and approve field service reports for accuracy, completeness, and regulatory compliance before submission to customers.
* Ensure readiness of spare parts, consumables, calibration standards, and service tools to support uninterrupted field operations.
* Act as the technical escalation point for complex instrument issues that cannot be resolved at the FSE level, coordinating with global product and applications teams as required.

**Customer Relationship Management**

* Act as the senior service point of contact for key pharmaceutical and biotech accounts, building long-term relationships with lab managers, quality and procurement stakeholders, and site leadership stakeholders.
* Hold regular business reviews with strategic customers to evaluate service performance, address concerns, and identify upsell and expansion opportunities.
* Drive customer satisfaction by monitoring post-service feedback, resolving complaints effectively, and implementing corrective actions where required.
* Support the sales organisation in pre-sales discussions, tender responses, and customer presentations that require service and technical expertise.

**Service Revenue & Contract Management**

* Own and deliver against the regional service revenue and contract revenue targets for the BioMonitoring Division.
* Drive growth of the service contract portfolio by proactively identifying renewal, upgrade, and cross-sell opportunities across the installed base.
* Develop and present commercial proposals for service contracts, IOQ services, and consumable programmes, and negotiate contract terms with customers.
* Review monthly revenue performance against plan, explain variances, and recommend corrective actions.
* Collaborate with the sales team on bundled commercial strategies that integrate service offerings with instrument and consumable sales.

**Asset, Installed Base & CRM Management**

* Maintain accurate and up-to-date Installed Base records for all the Company’s BioMonitoring instruments across India in Salesforce (SFDC).
* Ensure all service activities, opportunities, and customer interactions are recorded promptly and accurately in CRM.
* Oversee company-owned assets - including calibrators, laptops, mobile devices, and service tools — and maintain appropriate security, maintenance, and lifecycle records.
* Use Installed Base insights to proactively plan preventive maintenance campaigns, contract renewals, and instrument upgrade conversations.

**Compliance, Quality & GMP Adherence**

* Ensure all service activities comply with GMP regulations, customer site requirements, and the Company’s internal quality standards.
* Maintain calibration programmes, ensuring calibrators and reference standards are traceable, in-date, and correctly documented.
* Represent the service function during customer audits and regulatory inspections.
* Drive continuous improvement in service quality metrics, including first-time fix rate, mean time to repair (MTTR), and SLA compliance.

**Reporting, Budgeting & Business Administration**

* Prepare and present monthly service performance reports to regional management, covering revenue, SLA performance, team utilisation, and customer satisfaction.
* Manage the service department budget, including spare parts inventory, travel expenses, and third-party service provider costs.
* Ensure all team members adhere to company expense reporting guidelines and administrative processes in a timely and accurate manner.
* Contribute data-driven service revenue and headcount forecasts to annual budgeting and business planning.

**India Expansion & Third-Party Partner Management**

* Manage and develop relationships with authorised third-party service providers and dealers across India to extend service reach and capability.
* Define service standards and requirements for partner organisations, monitor performance, and provide technical guidance and training.
* Identify opportunities to expand the Company’s direct service footprint in high-priority Indian markets and develop business cases for additional headcount or capability investment.

**Events & Strategic Representation**

* Represent the Service function at regional trade exhibitions, customer seminars, product launches, and internal sales conferences.
* Support product demonstrations and participate in cross-functional meetings to provide the service perspective on new product introductions, product improvements, and customer feedback.

**Who You Are**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, Biomedical Science, Chemistry or a related discipline.
* Minimum 5–7 years of experience in field service, technical applications, or service operations within the life science instruments, medical devices, or GMP pharmaceutical sector.
* At least 2–3 years of experience leading or supervising field service or technical teams.
* Demonstrated experience managing service contracts, service revenue targets, and customer accounts.
* Solid understanding of GMP/GLP requirements and regulatory frameworks applicable to pharmaceutical and biotech customers.
* Experience with BioMonitoring, microbiology testing, environmental monitoring, or related instrumentation.
* Familiarity with ISO/IEC 17025, USP, or EP standards relevant to the division's product portfolio.
* Good track record of growing service contract portfolios and managing third-party service partner networks across India
* Proficiency in CRM platforms (Salesforce preferred) and MS Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word).
* Strong written and spoken English; proficiency in Hindi or additional regional Indian languages is an advantage.

**What we offer:**
We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!
  
  
Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

title: IN_ETAS_Regional Solution Field Manager – Embedded & Compute Middleware Solutions_IN
description:
**Company Description**
*ETAS provides innovative solutions for the development of embedded systems for the automotive industry and other sectors of the embedded industry. As a systems provider, ETAS supplies a multifaceted portfolio that covers the range from integrated tools and tool solutions to engineering services, consulting, training, and support. Holistic IoT security solutions are offered via ETAS subsidiary ESCRYPT. Established in 1994, ETAS GmbH is a 100-percent subsidiary of the Bosch Group, with international subsidiaries and sales offices in Europe, North and South America, and Asia.*
**Job Description**
Regional Head, ECM – India
  
  
Position Overview
  
  
The Regional Solution Field Manager / Regional Head for Embedded & Compute Middleware (ECM) is responsible for leading the ECM business in India.
  
  
The ECM portfolio comprises
**basic software, middleware, and configuration tools**
that enable cybersecurity as well as software and hardware abstraction across automotive embedded systems, ranging from traditional microcontroller-based ECUs to microprocessor-based domain controllers.
  
  
This role combines
**business ownership, market development, customer engagement, technical leadership, and people management**
. The position works closely with the Sales organization and global ECM teams to grow the business in India while ensuring that regional customer and market requirements are effectively represented within the global organization.
  
  
The position reports to the
**Head of Portfolio at Headquarters (HQ)**
.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Business & Financial Management
  
  

* Work closely with the Sales organization and take responsibility for regional TNS (sales) for the ECM portfolio in India.
* Assume business responsibility for all ECM product and service classes in the India region.
* Manage the regional budget, including effective cost planning and control.
* Drive sustainable business growth through appropriate commercial, technical, and market-development initiatives.

Business Development & Marketing
  
  

* Lead business development and marketing activities to expand the ECM business in India.
* Identify new market and customer opportunities and support the introduction and positioning of ECM products and solutions.
* Work closely with Sales and technical teams to develop compelling customer solutions and value propositions.

Strategy & Regional Portfolio Development
  
  

* Define and execute the ECM business strategy for India in close cooperation with HQ and in alignment with the global divisional strategy.
* Identify evolving market trends and customer needs in India and translate them into actionable regional priorities.
* Prioritize regional requirements and effectively communicate the voice of the customer to the global organization.
* Collaborate with global stakeholders to ensure alignment between regional market requirements and portfolio direction.

Customer & Technical Leadership
  
  

* Engage with customers on business and technical topics related to embedded automotive software and middleware solutions.
* Support customer discussions related to product introduction, technical support, solution proposals, and integration requirements.
* Provide leadership across customer-facing technical functions and ensure effective collaboration between regional and global teams.

People & Organizational Leadership
  
  

* Lead and oversee Field Application Engineers (FAEs), engineers, customer project managers, and customer technical support functions.
* Develop organizational capabilities required to support current and future ECM business needs in India.
* Provide effective people leadership, including recruitment, workforce management, performance management, and employee development.

Qualifications
  
  
B.E/B.Tech
  
  
Additional Information
  
  
**Required Qualifications**
Automotive & Technical Experience
  
  

* Experience working in the automotive industry or with automotive-industry customers, such as Tier suppliers, IT solution/service providers, tool vendors, or semiconductor companies.
* Minimum five years of experience in a technical role within an automotive-related business.
* Relevant technical experience in one or more of the following areas is preferred:

+ AUTOSAR Classic and automotive middleware/software platforms, particularly BSW, RTE, and MCAL – especially desirable.
+ CAN, Ethernet, and SOME/IP implementation.
+ ECU integration and validation.
+ Open-source software development.
+ Automotive cybersecurity.

Global Business Experience
  
  

* Experience working in a globally operating or foreign-affiliated organization, including collaboration with international offices and/or headquarters.
* Demonstrated ability to operate effectively across regional and global organizations and stakeholder groups.

Leadership & Management Experience
  
  

* Minimum three years of organizational leadership or management experience.
* Demonstrated experience in:

+ P&L/business management.
+ People management.
+ Recruitment and workforce management.
+ Performance management and evaluation.

**Additional Professional Experience**
Candidates must have
**at least three years of experience in one or more**
of the following areas:
  
  

* Business development, including product introduction support, technical support, product marketing activities, customer requirement gathering, and solution proposals – especially desirable.
* Product marketing and/or product planning – especially desirable.
* Technical sales or Field Application Engineering (FAE).
* Project management.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience with ETAS products and solutions.
* Strong understanding of the automotive embedded-software ecosystem and evolving software-defined vehicle architectures.
* Strong customer orientation with the ability to bridge business, technical, and organizational perspectives.
* Effective communication and stakeholder-management skills in an international environment.

Ideal Candidate Profile
  
  
The ideal candidate combines
**strong automotive embedded-software expertise with commercial and organizational leadership experience**
. The successful candidate will be comfortable engaging with customers on both business and technical topics, leading multidisciplinary regional teams, collaborating with global stakeholders, and taking ownership of business growth for the ECM portfolio in India.

title: Sr Customer Success Manager
description:
As a Senior Customer Success Manager, you will own a portfolio of Almabase’s most strategic and high-value enterprise customers. You will work closely with senior stakeholders on the customer side, drive measurable outcomes, and play a key role in improving our customer success playbooks and processes.
  
  
**Work Timing**
Our customer base is mostly situated in the US. Therefore, you are expected to work during US hours: 8am to 5pm EST.
  
  
**Work Location**
We expect all team members to work from the Bangalore office. We follow a hybrid work policy, requiring you to work from the office at least 2 days per week, and atleast 3-4 days during onboarding (first 3 months).
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* KPIs: onboarding (CSAT and time to first value), account retention, customer health, revenue expansion (influence), product adoption, and building advocates (Retention is a shared accountability with the Account Manager)
* Own the complete post-sales customer journey for a portfolio of Almabase’s largest and most complex enterprise customers (Onboarding → Adoption → Retention → Advocacy)
* Become a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders (Directors, VPs), helping them achieve measurable alumni engagement and fundraising outcomes. Build and maintain strong relationships with champions and key stakeholders
* Drive product adoption and customer outcomes by deeply understanding customer workflows, enabling customers through onboarding, training, and workshops, and solving complex use cases using the Almabase product
* Drive a structured engagement cadence, including regular check-ins and strategic business reviews (QBRs) focused on outcomes, ROI, and long-term alignment
* Own customer health and retention strategy — proactively identify risks, drive mitigation plans, and partner with the Account Manager to support successful renewals
* Identify and strategically position expansion opportunities within your accounts, and partner with the Account Manager to drive these opportunities forward
* Act as the primary escalation point for complex customer issues and work cross-functionally to drive timely resolution
* Own NPS for your portfolio — identify drivers of customer sentiment, close the loop on feedback, and drive targeted actions to improve NPS and build long-term advocacy
* Identify patterns across customers and contribute to improving customer success playbooks, processes, and product feedback loops
* Mentor and support other Customer Success Managers through call reviews, deal strategy discussions, and best practice sharing
* Collaborate with the Marketing team to build customer advocacy through case studies, testimonials, referrals, and community participation
* Proactively leverage AI to improve customer outcomes, streamline workflows, and scale customer success processes

An independent Customer Support team is responsible for responding to customers' questions while using the product. As a Sr CSM, you are expected to be a strategic consultant to your portfolio of customers, helping them achieve their business outcomes with Almabase.
  
  
What you bring
  
  
**Must have:**

* 3+ years of experience in B2B SaaS Customer Success roles, with at least 1 year working with US-based customers, managing communication and expectations across time zones
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build strong business relationships and engage effectively with senior stakeholders
* Strong problem-solving skills with a technical and analytical aptitude, and the ability to quickly understand and adapt to complex software products and their nuances
* Demonstrated ability to manage customer outcomes — including driving adoption, improving customer health, and supporting retention and expansion
* Proven experience working with multiple stakeholders within customer accounts, navigating complexity, and driving alignment
* Hands-on experience leveraging AI tools (such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gamma, Canva, Zapier AI, N8N) to improve workflows, enhance customer interactions, or scale processes

**Good to have:**

* Experience with customer success software or CRM (like HubSpot) would be helpful. We use Hubspot.
* Experience in a multi-product B2B SaaS environment.
* Startup or high-growth company experience.

**What will a typical quarter look like?**
At the beginning of each quarter, we will work with you to define a set of OKRs (Objectives and Key Results) aligned to your portfolio. These will focus on driving customer outcomes, improving account health, and identifying growth opportunities.
  
  

* Onboarding: You will own the onboarding experience for new enterprise customers in your portfolio. While the implementation team will complete the technical setup, you will ensure customers are successfully enabled, their intended programs are launched, and they achieve time to first value
* Retention: Renewals are owned by the Account Manager. As the CSM, you will own customer health and risk mitigation — proactively identifying risks, driving mitigation plans, and partnering with the Account Manager by providing strategic context, stakeholder insights, and potential blockers to ensure successful renewals
* Engagement & Adoption: For onboarded customers, you will drive a structured engagement strategy aligned with their goals. This includes deeply understanding customer workflows, mapping them to Almabase, enabling key stakeholders, conducting strategic QBRs, and driving sustained product adoption and stickiness
* Expansion: You will identify and strategically position expansion opportunities within your accounts by uncovering unmet needs and use cases. You will partner with the Account Manager to move these opportunities forward once intent is established
* Customer Outcomes & Advocacy: You will own NPS for your portfolio, close the loop on feedback, and drive targeted actions to improve customer sentiment. You will also identify and nurture advocates through case studies, referrals, references, and community participation
* System & Team Contribution: In addition to managing your portfolio, you will contribute to improving team-wide processes and playbooks. This could include identifying patterns across customers, refining engagement strategies, mentoring other CSMs, or working cross-functionally to improve how we deliver value to customers

**What will make you successful in this role?**

* Deeply understand customer pain points, workflows, and the broader alumni engagement and fundraising landscape. Be highly curious and conduct thoughtful discovery to align Almabase to customer goals
* Build strong, trust-based relationships with both champions and senior stakeholders (Directors, VPs), with the ability to influence conversations through strong executive presence and communication
* Develop a strong understanding of the Almabase product and its nuances, and effectively map customer needs to the right solutions — including hands-on guidance when required
* Demonstrate a strong ownership mindset — take end-to-end responsibility for customer outcomes, including navigating ambiguity and building structure where processes are still evolving
* Effectively manage complex enterprise accounts with multiple stakeholders, while staying disciplined, organized, and able to prioritize across a dynamic portfolio
* Identify patterns across customers, translate insights into scalable improvements, and proactively leverage AI to enhance customer outcomes and internal efficiency

**How will we set you up for success?**
**First 3 months — Onboarding**

* Build a strong understanding of the alumni engagement and fundraising space, including the competitive landscape, by going through past customer conversations and internal resources
* Gain hands-on familiarity with the Almabase platform through structured training and sandbox access, with the goal of understanding how different modules solve real customer use cases
* Shadow experienced CSMs on customer calls to learn how we run onboarding, drive adoption, and handle customer conversations
* Begin managing a small set of accounts, focusing on onboarding support, understanding customer workflows, and building initial relationships
* Get familiar with existing customer success playbooks and processes, and understand how we currently manage onboarding, engagement, and retention
* Start building relationships across teams (CS, Onboarding, Support, Product, Customer Experience) to understand how we collaborate and resolve customer issues

**3–6 months — Ownership & Impact**

* Take full ownership of a portfolio of enterprise customers, including driving onboarding outcomes, engagement, and adoption
* Start leading customer conversations independently, including check-ins and QBRs, with support and feedback from your manager
* Develop a strong understanding of your customers’ workflows and begin mapping them effectively to Almabase capabilities
* Identify early signals of customer risk and begin proactively working on mitigation plans in collaboration with the Account Manager
* Contribute to improving existing playbooks and processes based on your learnings from customer interactions
* Continue building cross-functional relationships and effectively collaborate to resolve customer issues and drive outcomes

**6–9 months — Scale & Influence**

* Confidently manage a portfolio of complex enterprise accounts, including high-impact and high-risk customers
* Lead strategic QBRs with senior stakeholders (Directors, VPs), aligning Almabase to their goals and driving long-term outcomes
* Drive improvements in customer health, product adoption, and NPS across your portfolio
* Identify and strategically position expansion opportunities, partnering effectively with the Account Manager
* Act as a trusted advisor to your customers and a key escalation point for complex issues
* Mentor other CSMs through call reviews, best practice sharing, and helping elevate overall team quality
* Proactively identify patterns across customers and contribute to improving customer success playbooks, processes, and product feedback loops.

description:

This is a great opportunity for someone who wants to get hands-on with the work, operate with real autonomy, and build things in crypto support that don’t exist yet.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Keep MoonPay covered 24/7 across in-house teams and outsourcing vendors, and hold partners to a high bar on quality and performance
* Run the queues and lead incidents, from the first alert through the post-mortem
* Partner with Product and Engineering to improve the product, walking them through real tickets and customer verbatims and driving fixes that matter
* Segment our customers and design the right experience for each, from white glove and escalations to goodwill programs
* Shape support policies that balance risk and customer value, and work with Compliance to execute them well
* Own support readiness for every new launch
* Spend real time in the queue, learning the work from the inside

**About You**

* Strong communication skills, with the ability to engage customers empathetically and with precision

* Based in Bangalore, or open to relocating to Bangalore
* Comfortable with rotating shifts, including nights, weekends and peak holiday season (5 working days a week)
* 4-7 years in cab or mobility operations (ride-hailing, rentals, corporate transport or travel companies), ideally in city operations or supply

description:

**About CREW**
CREW is Swiggy's premium travel concierge, built to take the stress out of planning and traveling for busy professionals. We help people plan and book a trip without the stress of using five different apps. We handle flights, hotels, visas, forex, cabs, insurance and trip planning in one place, with real people supported by AI tools. CREW is early-stage, so many of our processes are still being built.
  
  
**Job Description**
**About the role**
You own CREW's visa business end to end: every member gets the right visa, on time, with no surprises, and the visa team hits its numbers.
  
  
You will lead the team of Visa Experts, own our visa partners, and build the playbooks that make visas a smooth, predictable experience for premium members.
  
  
**What You Will Own**

* Visa delivery. Own every visa from first message to passport back in hand. Track turnaround time, approval rate and rejections, and fix what causes delays.
* The team. Hire, train and lead a team of Visa Experts. Set daily targets, run regular performance reviews and coach the team on quality and speed.
* Business targets. Own visa bookings, revenue and customer experience metrics. Work with the Destination Experts so every international trip is offered visa help.
* Country playbooks. Build and keep up to date document checklists, timelines and fees for every country we serve. Track embassy rule changes and update the team the same day.
* Quality checks. Set up document checks before submission so we avoid rejections. Study every rejection and stop it happening again.
* Partners. Choose and manage visa partners and service providers. Agree prices and service levels, review their performance and escalate when they miss.
* Peak season and urgent cases. Plan appointment slots and team capacity ahead of peak travel months, and run a clear process for urgent and express visas.
* Escalations. Be the final point of escalation for visa issues, including rejections, delays and re-applications.
* Data privacy and ethics. Make sure passports and personal documents are collected, stored and shared safely, in line with company policy and the law. Never cut corners on documents or declarations.
* Reporting. Share a daily and weekly view of applications, turnaround time, approvals and rejections with leadership.
* Process and automation. Spot manual, repetitive work (form filling, document checks, status tracking) and work with Product and Tech to automate it, including with AI tools

**Qualifications**
**Preferred background**

* Based in Bangalore, or open to relocating to Bangalore
* Comfortable with rotating shifts, including weekends and peak holiday season (5 working days a week)
* 4-7 years in tourist visa operations at a visa service company, travel company or visa application centre

* Deep, hands-on knowledge of visas for popular countries (Schengen, UK, US, Singapore, Canada, Australia, UAE, South-East Asia)

title: Job Title: Workflow Manager – In-Service Engineering Daily Repairs
description:
**Job Description:**

### **About Airbus In Service Engineering**

### **The In-Service Engineering department serves as the technical backbone of Airbus's customer support network, resolving over 200,000 repair and engineering queries annually for global airlines and Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul (MRO) organizations. When A/C structure is damaged, it requires a quick restoration. Typically, when this happens, passengers are waiting to take-off, and Airlines are losing money. We are developing engineers’ ability to establish and deliver, for all fleets, safe, timely and consistent solutions to the technical daily queries raised by the customer support for Technical issues in operations. Functioning in a high-volume, time-critical environment, the department delivers precise technical solutions and actionable repair data to maintain fleet airworthiness and minimize Aircraft-On-Ground (AOG) events. Rapid, reliable technical support is a fundamental pillar of Airbus's strategy to strengthen customer relations, maintain operational reliability, and build long-term trust.**

### **Position Overview**

We are seeking an **approachable, empathetic and resilient Workflow Manager** who combines a collaborative, humble mindset with strong analytical rigour to lead our In-Service Daily Repairs team (Fuselage). In this role, you will not perform repairs directly; rather, you will serve as the crucial operational anchor orchestrating our 24/7 support. You will manage incoming query backlogs, optimize engineering capacity, mitigate operational risks, and bridge communication across global Customer Service teams, subcontractors, and international Design Offices (BLR, EU, UK, China, USA ensuring seamless alignment, trust, and On-Time Delivery during high-pressure, time-critical situations

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **1. Stakeholder Liaison & Governance**

* Act as the core operational bridge between technical operations, account managers, engineering leads, and international design offices.
* Establish and drive robust governance and reporting intervals with Customer Services and global Design Offices (BLR/EU/UK/China/USA) to monitor performance and deliver value-add initiatives.
* Manage the expectations of internal Customer Service stakeholders demanding immediate resolution, balancing diplomacy with engineering constraints.
* Ensure a continuous feedback loop of in-service experiences, chronic maintenance issues, and significant fleet challenges back to management, suppliers, and design organizations.

### **2. Resource Capacity Planning & Risk Management**

* Track real-time engineering availability, shift patterns, and current workloads to ensure SLA (Service Level Agreement) compliance while proactively managing optimum utilization of the team.
* Project and anticipate operational risks stemming from resource capacity crunches, high-volume workload forecasts, or supplier disruptions, proactively proposing corrective actions.
* Analyze operational dashboards (utilizing Airbus data analytics tools like **Skywise** ) to identify processing bottlenecks (e.g., specific fleet or ATA backlogs) and recommend targeted team / engineer upskilling.

### **3. Workflow & Backlog Management**

* Efficiently route incoming technical queries from global customer services to the respective engineering teams based on the affected ATA chapters, ensuring strict adherence to Time and Quality targets.
* Prioritize the engineering backlog based on safety implications, operational urgency and airline tier rather than a "first-come, first-served" basis.
* Evaluate the priority and complexity of the incoming topics and manage them accordingly (e.g. distinguishing immediately between routine maintenance queries and high-pressure Aircraft on Ground (AOG) situations requiring swift escalation).
* Defining priorities in cooperation with the Customer Services teams.
* Keep track of the progress and manage any changes arising due to operational constraints
* Identifying and leading improvement initiatives to the workflow process looking for transverse harmonization

### **4. Continuous Improvement & Reporting**

* Monitor the key performance indicators such as OTD (On Time Delivery) and effort per unit to anticipate cost relevant effects, triggering relevant root cause assessments and corrective actions in case of deviation and/or anticipation of changes.
* Create clear, precise, and high-impact presentations on complex operational and technical topics for relevant stakeholders and forums.
* Propose, drive, and support process optimization and automation ideas to improve unit-cost reduction and daily operational efficiency.
* Use existing and past databases to better predict the operational capacity and optimum balance in resource availability. Anticipate the risks and propose the mitigation actions. Escalate timely to the right level as necessary.
Monitoring progress and ensuring On Time Delivery is met.  

  
  

**Required Skills & Qualifications**
------------------------------------

### **Education & Experience**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree (4-year program) in Aerospace, Mechanical, Electrical, Civil, Production, Industrial Engineering and Project Management (or equivalent).
* **Experience:** 10+ years of professional experience in airline operations, aerospace manufacturing, MRO, or fleet technical support role and project management.

  
  

### **Behavioral & Interpersonal Attributes**

* **Crisis Resilience:** Proven ability to remain calm, analytical, and clear-headed during high-pressure, time-critical AOG situations.
* **Customer Centricity** : A strong solution oriented with a genuine passion for solving complex operational challenges for global customers. Capability to translate customer requirements into operational deliverables and to prioritize
* **Communication & Collaboration** : Advanced interpersonal, negotiation, solving the conflicts without being authoritative, empathetic, being humble and presentation skills (oral and written English) tailored for a highly cross-functional and multicultural corporate environment. To collaborate well within a team to build the required trust, to work independently when required
* **Mindset:** An adaptable, reliable, and tenacious team player who embraces continuous learning and thrives on short-term (hourly) to long-term (yearly) operational challenges.

### **Technical & Operational Competencies**

* ***Mandatory:***
  + Strong foundational knowledge of commercial aircraft systems and familiarity across various **ATA Chapters** .
  + Understanding of Design, Stress, Methods & Principles, and Airworthiness requirements when designing aircraft structure
  + Experience with, or a strong aptitude for data analytics platforms and dashboard management (experience with **Skywise** is a distinct advantage).
  + Very good communication and influencing skills
  + Ability to manage high-volume task allocations, balance team bandwidth, and resolve operational bottlenecks to consistently ensure On-Time Delivery (OTD).
  + Prioritization of critical technical queries based on operational urgency and tracking Service Level Agreements (SLAs) through robust risk and escalation management.
* ***Recommended:***
  + High familiarity with standard aviation documentation (e.g., **AMM, SRM, IPC, MEL** ) and global regulatory frameworks ( **EASA, FAA** , etc.).
  + Ability to quickly master the specific technical competencies of the engineering team (Avionics, Structures, Propulsion, Cabin) and understand internal signature delegations/sign-off authorities.
  + Robust understanding of airline operations, maintenance environments, and aircraft leasing/service structures

### **Additional Requirements**

* Willingness and ability to travel internationally for business as required.

title: Data Management Support Specialist
description:
**Some careers have more impact than others.**

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realize their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of **Data Management Support Specialist**  
  
**Purpose of the role**  
  
To provide effective data management support to HSBC Asset Management teams by ensuring that investment, fund, account and investor data is accurate, complete, fit for purpose and available when required across relevant systems and processes.

The role will work closely with regional stakeholders across Investment Management, Client Services, Finance, Risk and Alternatives. It will support the management of instrument and security reference data, products, accounts, funds, NAVs, flows, revenues and regulatory indicators, while contributing to fund onboarding, product lifecycle management, portfolio risk and client reporting activities.  
  
**In this role, you will be:**

  

* Ensure seamless data ingestion, data quality and data support across the various platforms used by Asset Management, maintaining accuracy and completeness across all outputs, processes, systems and communications.
* Manage investor data datasets, including products, accounts, funds, holdings, NAVs, flows and revenues, and support the onboarding, validation and ongoing maintenance of fund accounts, investment accounts, separately managed accounts and fund product data across source and target platforms.
* Manage and validate investment data, including instrument, fund, holdings, valuation, transaction and reference data, across asset classes such as fixed income, equities, mutual funds, ETFs and alternatives.
* Perform data-quality monitoring, reconciliations, exception management, lifecycle-event processing and business-as-usual support for downstream consumers, identifying issues and supporting their timely resolution.
* Use SQL to extract, analyse and reconcile data across datasets, and support stakeholders during Systems Integration Testing (SIT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
* Apply a strong understanding of the end-to-end investment-management trade life cycle, particularly from a front-office perspective, and support processes relating to account events, investment restrictions, regulatory data and order-management systems. Experience with Bloomberg AIM would be advantageous.
* Build and maintain trusted relationships with stakeholders, including fund managers, analysts, production support teams and regional colleagues, ensuring that data-management support meets their requirements. Achieve results through effective collaboration, influence and persuasion, while exercising direct authority where appropriate.
* Manage multiple workstreams simultaneously, prioritising individual and team workloads effectively and seeking guidance when broader prioritisation decisions are required. Work effectively as an individual contributor and, where required, as a team player or lead; operate within the overall framework of Asset Management Operations; and establish goals, success criteria and performance measures to assess the success of major strategic initiatives.

**To be successful you will be:**

* Graduation degree in Finance or equivalent, with at least seven years’ experience in asset or investment management, including six or more years in Investment or Alternatives Operations.
* Strong knowledge of investment management data and processes, including transactions, holdings, instruments, accounts, funds, valuations, reference data and the end-to-end trade and account lifecycle.
* Experience managing account onboarding data, legal agreement linkage, position and cash reconciliations, and fund and securities data exceptions.
* Significant experience in data management and data quality, with strong SQL skills and the ability to reconcile information across multiple datasets and databases.
* Understanding of front-office tools, order management systems and decision-support platforms, preferably including Bloomberg AIM, Bloomberg, Reuters or IDC, across public and private asset classes.
* Strong analytical and numerical skills, with the ability to solve complex problems, manage competing priorities, work at pace and deliver accurate, complete outputs aligned with wider business objectives.
* Experience supporting SIT and UAT, working with internal and external auditors, maintaining control frameworks and records, and implementing audit and regulatory actions promptly.
* Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders, collaborate across regional and operational teams, share knowledge and promote a transparent, customer-focused team culture.

title: Sr. Product Security Response Engineer
description:
Sr. Product Security Response EngineerThis role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.

**Who We Are:**

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

**Job Description:**

**About our cybersecurity team**
================================

Are you ready to make an impact at one of the world’s leading tech companies? HPE’s Cybersecurity team is where you can do just that! We’re looking for a dynamic and experienced GRC specialist to join our Cybersecurity team. If you’re passionate about shaping the future of cybersecurity and ready for your next challenge, we’d love to hear from you.

As a **Cybersecurity GRC Platform Architect**, you will design, configure, integrate, and enhance the technology capabilities supporting cybersecurity governance, risk, compliance, and third-party risk management. You will translate complex requirements into scalable workflows, reliable data, actionable reporting, and practical automation.

You will independently deliver complex platform solutions, recommend technical approaches, and partner with cybersecurity, risk, compliance, policy, and IT teams. You will also establish reusable technical patterns and provide guidance to platform users and less-experienced contributors.

**What You’ll Do**

***Responsibilities:***

**Product Security Response**
-----------------------------

* Owning and driving complex product vulnerability cases from initial intake through technical resolution and disclosure readiness, maintaining clear status, evidence, decisions, ownership, and next actions.
* Triaging vulnerability reports for credibility, scope, affected products or versions, exploitability, potential customer impact, duplication, and completeness of supporting evidence.
* Reproducing reported vulnerabilities and validating proofs of concept in collaboration with product engineering, penetration testing, security research, and other technical specialists.
* Coordinating technical investigations with product teams, resolving information gaps, aligning on responsibilities, and keeping cases moving toward remediation and disclosure milestones.
* Assessing vulnerability severity using applicable scoring methods and available technical evidence while documenting assumptions, rationale, and unresolved questions.
* Supporting the development, review, and technical quality of customer-facing security advisories, vulnerability disclosures, remediation guidance, and related content.
* Engaging internal stakeholders and external vulnerability reporters or coordination partners to clarify findings, gather evidence, communicate status, and support coordinated disclosure.
* Applying knowledge of CVE, CWE, CVSS, MITRE, NVD, FIRST, and coordinated vulnerability disclosure practices to support accurate classification and reporting.
* Monitoring case queues and emerging demand, identifying cases at risk of delay, and helping maintain consistent execution across PSRT operating areas.
* Contributing across diverse product environments and adapting to differences in architecture, development practices, and organizational ownership.

**Vulnerability Investigation and Security Validation**
-------------------------------------------------------

* Performing hands-on technical analysis to reproduce vulnerabilities, validate exploitability, determine affected configurations or versions, and assess potential impact.
* Reviewing proof-of-concept code, logs, source code, configurations, system behavior, product architecture, and other evidence relevant to vulnerability investigations.
* Developing or adapting scripts, test harnesses, proofs of concept, and technical methods needed to validate findings and support remediation decisions.
* Conducting targeted security testing when vulnerability reports require deeper technical analysis or independent validation beyond the information submitted.
* Partnering directly with product engineering teams to understand product design, validate findings, support remediation, and perform retesting as appropriate.
* Producing clear technical findings that describe evidence, affected components, reproduction steps, security impact, and actionable remediation guidance.
* Defining investigation and testing approaches based on product architecture, threat models, reported vulnerabilities, known attack techniques, and areas of highest security risk.
* Distinguishing confirmed vulnerabilities from false positives, unsupported claims, configuration issues, or findings that require additional evidence.
* Escalating investigations to appropriate specialists when cases require expertise beyond the role’s technical domain.

**PSRT Process and Capability Improvement**
-------------------------------------------

* Identifying recurring vulnerability patterns, operational friction, process gaps, and opportunities to improve PSRT guidance, playbooks, templates, and technical practices.
* Contributing reusable scripts, tooling, integrations, and automation that reduce repetitive work and improve the consistency or quality of vulnerability response.
* Helping improve case documentation, evidence requirements, review practices, and quality checks across the response lifecycle.
* Supporting improvements to vulnerability intake, triage, reproduction, severity assessment, remediation coordination, advisory preparation, and case closure.
* Capturing reusable techniques and lessons learned so future investigations can be completed more efficiently and consistently.
* Using approved automation or AI-assisted capabilities where they provide practical value while validating outputs and preserving accountable human judgment.
* Measuring the effectiveness of process or tooling improvements and adjusting approaches based on operational results and team feedback.

**Technical Collaboration and Leadership**
------------------------------------------

* Leading significant vulnerability investigations or focused technical workstreams while remaining directly involved in hands-on execution.
* Providing technical guidance to engineers, case managers, and product teams on vulnerability analysis, evidence quality, severity assessment, remediation, and disclosure readiness.
* Reviewing technical findings, investigation approaches, and security communications for accuracy, completeness, and actionable guidance.
* Communicating complex findings, risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to engineering teams, security specialists, product leaders, and other stakeholders.
* Building productive working relationships across product engineering, PSRT, penetration testing, security research, and adjacent security teams.
* Mentoring less-experienced team members and sharing practical knowledge that strengthens the broader team’s vulnerability-response capability.
* Representing PSRT in cross-functional discussions and helping stakeholders reach evidence-based technical decisions.

**What you need to bring:**

**Education and Experience Requirements**
=========================================

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, cybersecurity, information systems, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Typically 6 to 10 years of relevant experience in product security response, application security, vulnerability management, penetration testing, incident response, security engineering, or closely related technical work.
* Demonstrated experience independently managing complex vulnerability investigations across multiple products, platforms, or technical environments.
* Strong ability to analyze vulnerability reports, proof-of-concept code, logs, source code, configurations, system architectures, and other technical evidence.
* Hands-on experience reproducing vulnerabilities, validating exploitability, assessing impact, and supporting remediation or retesting.
* Working knowledge of CVE, CWE, CVSS, MITRE, NVD, FIRST, and coordinated vulnerability disclosure practices.
* Experience authoring or reviewing security advisories, vulnerability disclosures, technical findings, or remediation guidance.
* Experience with Python or another scripting or programming language used to support security analysis, testing, or workflow automation.
* Familiarity with APIs, source control, CI/CD pipelines, containers, cloud environments, or modern software delivery practices.
* Strong knowledge of common software weaknesses, secure coding practices, threat modeling, and secure development lifecycle principles.
* Ability to lead significant technical work, exercise independent judgment, coordinate across teams, and influence decisions without relying on formal authority.
* Strong analytical, technical writing, and communication skills across engineering, security, product, and leadership audiences.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Experience working in a PSIRT or PSRT supporting enterprise technology products or services.
* Experience engaging vulnerability reporters, product engineering teams, disclosure partners, or vulnerability-coordination communities.
* Demonstrated experience planning and performing targeted penetration tests or security assessments in support of vulnerability investigations.
* Experience investigating vulnerabilities affecting applications, services, APIs, cloud environments, firmware, operating systems, networking products, or supporting infrastructure.
* Experience developing scripts, test harnesses, proofs of concept, integrations, or workflow automation for security operations.
* Familiarity with vulnerability management platforms, case-management systems, security-advisory publishing processes, or machine-readable advisory formats.
* Experience supporting high-impact or broadly disclosed vulnerabilities involving complex product ownership or cross-organizational coordination.
* Relevant security, cloud, application security, or software engineering certifications are valued but not required.

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

* Complex vulnerability cases are technically sound, well documented, and moved forward with clear ownership, timely stakeholder engagement, and evidence-based decisions.
* Product teams receive actionable findings, credible severity and impact assessments, and practical support through remediation and retesting.
* Security advisories and vulnerability disclosures are accurate, consistent, complete, and ready for customer communication.
* Investigations distinguish genuine product risk from false positives, incomplete reports, unsupported claims, and configuration-specific issues.
* PSRT casework becomes more consistent and efficient through improved playbooks, templates, technical methods, tooling, and knowledge sharing.
* Automation reduces repetitive work and improves response quality without weakening technical validation, traceability, or accountability.
* Cross-functional investigations remain coordinated, risks and delays are identified early, and cases continue progressing toward resolution.
* Less-experienced team members grow through practical mentoring, technical review, and shared investigation experience.

title: Product Management Intern
description:
**Product Management Intern – Identity Resilience**
===================================================

### **About the Team & Role**

The Product Management team at Rubrik drives forward our vision of delivering a market-leading platform that addresses the world’s most critical cyber resilience and data security challenges.

The **Identity Resilience** team is Rubrik’s fastest-growing business unit, operating with a high-velocity **"0-to-1"** charter. Today, modern cyberattacks almost exclusively weaponize identity systems. When identity fails, the entire enterprise halts. Our mission is to ensure enterprise identity environments are secure, observable, compliant, and instantly recoverable.

We are looking for a strategically sharp, technical, and execution-minded **Product Management Intern** for a high-impact **2-month internship** based in Bengaluru. As an intern, you will own a core strategic initiative – bridging enterprise customer pain points, competitive differentiation, and technical architecture to deliver a concrete product roadmap for next-generation identity protection.

### **What You’ll Do (2-Month Charter)**

* **Market Landscape & Threat Vector Analysis:** Benchmark the enterprise identity attack surface across hybrid environments. Map emerging threat vectors to potential resilience and recovery capabilities.
* **Customer Discovery & Pain Point Synthesis:** Work alongside PM and GTM mentors to analyze customer requirements, telemetry data, and enterprise security frameworks to pinpoint the highest-friction operational gaps for Security and IAM teams.
* **Feature Strategy & PRD Ownership:** Define the scope, user workflows, and success metrics for a targeted identity protection/recovery feature. Author a high-quality Product Requirement Document (PRD) balancing enterprise-grade depth with Rubrik’s trademark simplicity.
* **Cross-Functional Architecture Alignment:** Collaborate closely with Engineering, UX Design, and Architecture leads to evaluate technical trade-offs, define API/data pipeline requirements, and ensure feasibility.
* **Executive Strategy Pitch:** Conclude your internship with an Executive Product Readout to Senior Leadership, defending your business case, technical trade-offs, and proposed roadmap.

### **What You’ll Need**

* **Education:** Currently enrolled in a premier MBA/management program (IIM, ISB, or equivalent global top-tier business school) graduating in 2027/28
* **Technical Foundation:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or an equivalent engineering discipline. Prior product management or technical experience in enterprise systems, cloud platforms, or cybersecurity is a strong plus.
* **Systems & Security Thinking:** An understanding of enterprise software fundamentals; familiarity with core identity concepts is an advantage.
* **Problem Solving:** Comfort with ambiguity, structured thinking, and the ability to break complex, undefined problems into crisp, actionable requirements.
* **Communication & Influence:** Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to articulate technical trade-offs to senior product and engineering leaders.
* **Location:** Based in or willing to relocate to Bengaluru for the 2-month internship duration (Hybrid model).

### **What You’ll Gain**

* **True 0-to-1 Problem Ownership:** Direct ownership of a real-world, high-priority product problem in enterprise cybersecurity – not a back-burner sandbox project.
* **High-Stakes Leadership Visibility:** Regular 1:1 mentorship from seasoned Product Managers and a final presentation to Product & Engineering leadership.
* **Cybersecurity PM Expertise:** Hands-on exposure to cutting-edge identity governance, threat modeling, and resilience frameworks inside an enterprise security market leader.

**Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation**
----------------------------------------------------------------------

Rubrik (NYSE: RBRK) is the Security and AI Operations Company, delivering one platform built at the intersection of data, identity, and AI. The platform enables agentic cyber resilience and trusted AI operations for enterprises worldwide, built to recover before disruption strikes and stay a step ahead, so security is never the reason ambition stalls.

  

**Inclusion @ Rubrik**

At Rubrik, we are dedicated to fostering a culture where people from all backgrounds are valued, feel they belong, and believe they can succeed. Our commitment to inclusion is at the heart of our mission to secure the world’s data.

Our goal is to hire and promote the best talent, regardless of background. * Our Company: We are committed to building a merit-based organization that offers equal access to growth and success for all employees globally. Your potential is limitless here.
* Our Culture: We strive to create an inclusive atmosphere where individuals from all backgrounds feel a strong sense of belonging, can thrive, and do their best work. Your contributions help us innovate and break boundaries.
* Our Communities: We are dedicated to expanding our engagement with the communities we operate in, creating opportunities for underrepresented talent and driving greater innovation for our clients. Your impact extends beyond Rubrik, contributing to safer and stronger communities.
