title: [Evergreen] Technical Account Manager
description:
**Who we are**

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

**About the role:**

As a Samsara Technical Account Manager (TAM), you are the cornerstone of technical customer success. In this role, you will act as a trusted technical advisor, moving beyond traditional support to deliver measurable business value and drive the long-term adoption of the Samsara platform. Your mission is to proactively optimize your customers' technical health and mitigate risk, ensuring they achieve their desired outcomes.

This requires a unique blend of deep technical acumen, consultative problem-solving, and the ability to communicate with influence across both technical and executive stakeholders. You will build enduring customer relationships by translating their operational goals into powerful technical solutions. As the primary technical interface for your accounts, you will foster cross-functional collaboration with our Sales, Support, and Product teams to champion your customers' needs. During critical incidents, you will demonstrate ownership by managing customer communications and expectations through to a successful resolution.  
  
***This is a hybrid position based in our Bengaluru office, requiring you to participate in an on-call rotation schedule to triage and manage high-severity issues and outages.***  
  
**You should apply if:**

  

* **You want to impact the industries that run our world:** Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
* **You are the architect of your own career:** If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
* **You're energized by our opportunity:** The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
* **You want to be with the best:** At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best.

**In this role, you will:**

* **Drive Customer Impact & Value Realization:** Go beyond technical support to consistently deliver measurable value. You will develop a deep understanding of your customers' business objectives and proactively align Samsara's solutions to help them achieve their goals, tracking and demonstrating technical ROI along the way.
* **Use AI to Transform the Customer Experience:** Leverage AI-powered tools and insights to anticipate customer needs, personalize engagement, and deliver faster, more proactive, and impactful outcomes.
* **Execute Transformational Technical Account Management:** Independently manage a portfolio of accounts, developing tailored success plans and identifying and mitigating risks to customer health. You will maintain accurate records of customer interactions and contribute to team-wide objectives.
* **Demonstrate Deep Technical Acumen & Samsara Expertise:** Be the primary technical point of contact, mastering Samsara's platform, including APIs, hardware, and software. You will advise customers on best practices and troubleshoot complex technical issues with proficiency.
* **Provide Consultative Problem Solving & Solutioning:** Employ a consultative approach to understand the root cause of customer challenges. You will own the technical ticket lifecycle, including technical escalations from report to resolution, and conduct root cause analysis to prevent recurrence and drive product improvement.
* **Communicate with Influence and Clarity:** Lead customer meetings, from technical deep dives to quarterly technical account reviews, with confidence. You will adapt your communication style to effectively engage with diverse audiences, from technical staff to non-technical executives.
* **Foster Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Partner effectively with Sales, Support, Product, and Engineering teams to advocate for customer needs and deliver a unified experience.
* **Demonstrate Ownership and Act as a Multiplier:** Embody a 'get it done' mentality by taking initiative on team projects and process improvements. You will actively contribute to our internal knowledge base and help onboard new team members, sharing best practices to enhance the entire team's capabilities.
* **Embody Samsara's Values & Principles:** Consistently champion and role model Samsara's core values and operating principles in every interaction, actively seeking feedback for continuous improvement

**Minimum requirements for the role:**

* **Experience:** 7+ years experience in a technical, customer-facing role such as technical account management, solutions consulting, or customer success, with a demonstrated track record of success.
* **Education:** We welcome applications from candidates with a bachelor's degree in a technical field, or those who have gained equivalent expertise through practical experience in areas such as Computer Science, Engineering, or related fields.
* **Technical Proficiency:** Exceptional technical literacy with the ability to understand and troubleshoot complex hardware, software, and API integrations. A strong passion for technology and a commitment to continuous learning, including an interest in AI and its applications.
* **Bilingual:** English and Spanish is a must.
* **Customer Focus:** A data-informed approach to understanding customer needs and a demonstrated ability to build trusted, long-term relationships.

title: AI/ML Engineer
description:
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field.
* 8+ years of software development experience building enterprise-grade, customer-facing products and services, including at least 2 years of hands-on experience developing solutions using AI Agents, Skills, or Large Language Model technologies.
* **Strong hands-on programming experience with Python**, including object-oriented programming, asynchronous programming, concurrency, error handling, testing, packaging, and performance optimisation.
* Experience designing and implementing REST APIs and integrating internal and external services using structured JSON payloads, schemas, authentication, retries, rate limits, and resilient error-handling patterns.
* Experience building production-grade AI agents using frameworks such as Semantic Kernel, LangGraph, or LangChain.
* **Experience with agent orchestration and multi-agent architecture patterns**, including planning, tool selection, task delegation, workflow coordination, and communication between agents.
* Strong understanding of agent state, memory, context management, session management, checkpointing, and recovery for long-running or multi-step agent workflows.
* Experience designing and implementing agent evaluation frameworks, including quality, task completion, groundedness, safety, latency, reliability, and cost evaluations.
* Experience implementing AI guardrails, including input and output validation, prompt injection protection, access control, content filtering, structured responses, tool-use restrictions, and safe failure handling.
* Strong understanding of Large Language Models and transformer architectures, including attention mechanisms, tokenisation, context windows, model inference, and common model limitations.
* Experience with prompt engineering techniques such as system prompt design, few-shot prompting, structured prompting, tool or function calling, prompt templates, and prompt versioning.
* **Experience designing and implementing Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipelines**, including document ingestion, parsing, chunking, metadata enrichment, embedding generation, indexing, retrieval, re-ranking, citation, and response generation.
* Experience working with embeddings and vector databases or vector search platforms, including index design, metadata filtering, hybrid search, semantic search, and retrieval quality optimisation.
* Experience with context management and token optimisation techniques, including context selection, summarisation, compression, caching, prompt budgeting, and management of conversation history.
* Experience designing human-in-the-loop workflows for review, approval, exception handling, feedback collection, and escalation of sensitive or low-confidence AI decisions.
* Experience with model customisation techniques such as fine-tuning, instruction tuning, parameter-efficient fine-tuning, or model adaptation, along with the ability to determine when fine-tuning is appropriate compared with prompting or RAG.
* Experience with AWS or GCP and their core compute, storage, networking, identity, security, logging, and monitoring services.
* Hands-on experience with Amazon Bedrock or equivalent managed Generative AI platforms, including model integration, inference configuration, security, observability, and cost management.
* Experience containerising and deploying applications using Docker, with a sound understanding of container security, configuration, networking, resource management, and deployment fundamentals.
* Experience implementing CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions or equivalent platforms for automated build, test, security validation, packaging, and deployment.
* Experience with AI and model observability, including monitoring of latency, availability, token consumption, cost, retrieval quality, model responses, evaluation scores, safety events, and production drift.
* Strong knowledge of software architecture, design patterns, data structures, algorithms, distributed systems, and cloud-native application design.
* Experience with test-driven development and automated testing using frameworks such as pytest, including unit, integration, API, workflow, evaluation, and end-to-end testing.
* Strong understanding of security, privacy, responsible AI, data governance, and secure software development practices for enterprise AI applications.
* Excellent problem-solving, analytical, debugging, and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to diagnose issues across application, AI model, agent, data, retrieval, and cloud infrastructure layers.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain complex AI and software architecture decisions to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* High energy, a positive attitude, and a strong sense of ownership for delivering reliable and high-quality products.

**Below is the list of preferred experience:**

* Experience developing enterprise applications using Java or Go.
* Experience with multiple agentic AI frameworks, particularly Semantic Kernel, LangGraph, and LangChain.
* Experience implementing Model Context Protocol-based integrations or similar standards for connecting AI agents with tools, data sources, and enterprise systems.
* Experience with vector databases or vector-enabled data platforms such as Amazon OpenSearch Service, PostgreSQL with pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, or equivalent technologies.
* Experience with orchestration and deployment platforms such as Kubernetes, Amazon ECS, Amazon EKS, Google Kubernetes Engine, or serverless compute services.
* Experience with model and experiment tracking, prompt management, evaluation platforms, tracing, and LLM observability tools.
* Experience designing event-driven or asynchronous systems using messaging and streaming technologies such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, Amazon SQS, Amazon SNS, or Google Pub/Sub.
* Experience working with relational and NoSQL databases, including PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB, or equivalent technologies.
* Familiarity with responsible AI practices covering fairness, transparency, explainability, privacy, human oversight, and risk management.
* Experience improving AI application performance through semantic caching, request batching, streaming, model routing, fallback strategies, and inference cost optimisation.
* Experience with infrastructure-as-code technologies such as Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, AWS CDK, or equivalent tools.
* Experience working in a SaaS product environment with multi-tenant architecture, enterprise identity, authorisation, auditability, and data-isolation requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Ensure the timely delivery of secure, reliable, and high-quality AI software that meets business requirements and maintains predictable performance in production environments.
* Design and develop cloud-native AI applications, agentic workflows, and reusable AI platform capabilities using Python, REST APIs, Large Language Models, and cloud services.
* Architect agent-based solutions using Semantic Kernel, LangGraph, LangChain, or related frameworks, selecting appropriate orchestration, state, memory, context, and multi-agent patterns.
* Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipelines covering ingestion, document processing, chunking, embeddings, vector indexing, retrieval, re-ranking, grounding, citation, and response generation.
* Develop human-in-the-loop workflows that support review, approval, intervention, feedback, exception handling, and escalation for business-critical AI processes.
* Establish evaluation strategies and measurable quality criteria for agents, prompts, models, tools, and RAG pipelines, and integrate automated evaluations into the engineering lifecycle.
* Implement guardrails and security controls to reduce risks associated with prompt injection, sensitive data exposure, hallucinations, unauthorised tool usage, unsafe responses, and excessive agent autonomy.
* Optimise context usage, token consumption, latency, throughput, retrieval quality, model selection, and infrastructure cost while maintaining solution quality and reliability.
* Build and maintain REST APIs, asynchronous services, tool integrations, structured outputs, JSON schemas, and connectors required by AI agents and enterprise applications.
* Implement production monitoring and observability for AI applications, including application metrics, distributed traces, model interactions, agent execution paths, token usage, cost, evaluation outcomes, and safety events.
* Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or equivalent platforms, incorporating automated testing, AI evaluations, dependency scanning, container scanning, policy checks, and deployment validation.
* Deploy and operate AI services on AWS or GCP using appropriate containerised, managed, or serverless deployment patterns.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineers, guiding architecture, implementation, testing, debugging, secure development, and operational best practices.
* Conduct thorough design and code reviews, ensuring that implementations meet software quality, security, testability, observability, maintainability, and responsible AI standards.
* Collaborate closely with engineering teams, product managers, architects, security teams, data specialists, and stakeholders to define technical solutions, delivery plans, success criteria, and operational requirements.
* Evaluate AI models, frameworks, tools, and cloud services through structured prototypes and technical assessments, and recommend technologies based on quality, security, scalability, operability, and cost.

* Stay current with developments in Generative AI, agentic frameworks, Large Language Models, cloud AI services, evaluation methodologies, and responsible AI, applying relevant advances to improve product capabilities and engineering practices.

title: Partner Solutions Consultant
description:
Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work.

Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

**Our vision:** A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together.

### **About the Role:**

You'll work alongside diverse, cross-border teams and supportive colleagues who share knowledge and want to see you succeed. Wrike is rapidly expanding its global partner ecosystem, and we are looking for a Partner Solutions Consultant (PSC) to serve as the technical authority and strategic solution lead for our resellers, system integrators (SIs), and consulting partners. In this role, you will scale Wrike's footprint by empowering partners to independently identify, design, and close enterprise-grade work management opportunities. By bridging deep technical expertise with partner enablement and joint pre-sales execution, you will directly drive partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue growth across key global markets.

### **Your Impact:**

* **Scale Partner Independence:** Design, build, and deliver structured technical enablement programs, certification boot camps, and hands-on demo training to upskill partner pre-sales and professional services teams.
* **Accelerate Joint Pre-Sales:** Partner on high-impact, strategic enterprise opportunities to conduct in-depth discovery, configure bespoke proof-of-concepts (POCs), lead hands-on workshops, and navigate technical evaluations, RFPs, and infosec reviews.
* **Build Repeatable Solution Plays:** Co-develop industry- and department-specific solution packages (e.g., Enterprise PMO, Marketing Operations, Professional Services, Creative Workflows) and integration blueprints that partners can repeatedly bring to market.
* **Drive Ecosystem Alignment:** Act as the primary technical conduit between partner teams and internal Wrike stakeholders (Direct Sales, Solutions Consulting, Customer Success, and Product Management), ensuring direct visibility on roadmap requirements and partner-driven product feedback.
* **Measurable Value:** Directly influence partner pipeline velocity, quota achievement, productive utilization targets, and strategic Management by Objectives (MBOs).

### **Your Qualifications;**

* **5+ years of B2B SaaS pre-sales experience** in Solutions Consulting, Sales Engineering, or Technical Architecture, including **2+ years specifically in a partner-, channel-, or alliance-facing capacity**.
* **Demonstrated Channel Enablement Track Record:** Proven ability to coach, upskill, and influence third-party partner teams without direct line authority.
* **Enterprise Discovery & Presentation Acumen:** Exceptional ability to translate complex technical architectures into compelling business value for audiences ranging from technical administrators to C-suite executives.
* **Technical Breadth:** Strong foundational knowledge of REST APIs, webhooks, SaaS integration patterns, identity access management (SSO, SAML, SCIM), and enterprise data security/compliance standards.
* **Cross-Border Collaboration:** Experience supporting multi-region markets (e.g., ANZ, ASEAN, North America) with the flexibility to navigate varying time zones and regional/international travel as required.
* **Fluency:** Outstanding verbal and written English communication skills.

### **Standout Qualities:**

* **Domain Expertise:** Prior hands-on experience with Collaborative Work Management (CWM), Project Portfolio Management (PPM), or agile platforms (e.g., Wrike, Asana, Monday.com, Smartsheet, Jira, MS Project).
* **Partner Go-to-Market Literacy:** Practical understanding of channel sales operations, including deal registration mechanics, Market Development Funds (MDF), co-selling dynamics, and tier progression frameworks.
* **Consulting or SI Background:** Professional roots in management consulting, systems integration, or client-side professional services delivery.
* **Ecosystem Connectivity:** Deep familiarity with integrating work management solutions across core enterprise software suites (e.g., Salesforce, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Adobe Creative Cloud, ServiceNow).

### **Team Dynamics:**

You will report directly to the **Manager, Solutions Consulting**, joining a high-caliber global team of pre-sales specialists, enterprise architects, and partner advocates. You will work in close daily alignment with Channel Account Managers, Regional Sales Directors, and Customer Success leads, serving as the connective tissue between third-party partner practices and Wrike's core technical teams. Our culture is collaborative, self-directed, and performance-focused—rooted in shared technical excellence, mutual accountability, and celebrating joint ecosystem wins.

### **Our Work Style:**

* **Methodology & Environment:** We operate in a collaborative hybrid model in Bangalore, balancing independent strategic initiative with deep cross-functional teamwork across global time zones.
* **Tools & Stack:** Daily work centers on Wrike for work orchestration and portfolio management, integrated with Salesforce CRM, Slack, Zoom, standard API testing tools (e.g., Postman), and modern enterprise productivity suites (Microsoft 365, Google Workspace).
* **What Makes This Role Different:** Unlike traditional direct-sales SC roles where you win deals one customer at a time, this position functions as a force multiplier. You will architect solutions, mentor external sales and delivery practices, and build sustainable enterprise capabilities that generate long-term recurring value through trusted global partners.

Key responsibilities

* Lead end-to-end delivery for a medium-to-large program or multiple squads.

* Coordinate release planning and execution across squads and platforms.

* Provide executive-ready delivery transparency — status, risks, and decisions needed — as a single reliable view of what is in flight and at risk.

Carries meaningful people-influence responsibilities without direct reports: mentors and coaches project managers, leads cross-team without formal authority, participates actively in interviewing and hiring, and contributes input to performance and development conversations for people they coordinate. These behavioral markers are real and expected at this level even though the role has no people-management authority.

Required skills and competencies

* Advanced program / delivery management: planning, dependency and risk management, release coordination, and executive reporting.

* Technical fluency (e.g., cloud, microservices, APIs, CI/CD) sufficient to facilitate decisions — not a hands-on developer.

* Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, facilitation, negotiation, and conflict resolution.

* Ability to drive delivery across globally distributed onshore and offshore teams.

* Leadership and influence without formal authority; mentoring and coaching capability.

* Ability to resolve ambiguity and balance competing priorities and constraints.

Qualifications (education and experience)

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.

* 5+ years of project, program, or delivery management experience.

* Experience leading enterprise software delivery and scaled / Agile delivery environments.

* Demonstrated success managing complex, cross-functional programs and globally distributed teams.

* PMP, PgMP, SAFe, or equivalent certification strongly preferred but not required.

Reference marker only — not a qualification or leveling determinant; level follows scope and sustained accountability.

Success measures

* Multiple squads / a medium-to-large program deliver predictably against plan.

* Cross-squad dependencies and critical-path risks are managed proactively, not reactively.

* Leadership has a single, reliable, executive-ready view of what is in flight and at risk.

* Releases across squads are coordinated with minimal disruption and clear readiness.

* Raises delivery-management practice across the team through mentoring, interviewing, and standards.

Leadership behaviors

Customer Centricity Keeps delivery aligned to business priorities, contractual obligations, and candidate / client value across squads.

Raise the Performance Bar Sets high standards for delivery predictability and transparency; continuously improves how squads execute.

Exceptional Collaboration for Value Builds alignment across Product, Engineering, Architecture, QE, and Operations, and influences without authority.

Our Leaders Inspire Leads through expertise and judgment, mentors project managers, participates in hiring, and models delivery excellence.

India. Bangalore is the preferred location and Chennai is an option. Exact hybrid attendance requirements will be shared during the recruitment process.

* Result oriented leadership style, setting achievable goals and leading by example – linking commercial and technical arenas.

* In depth knowledge of TMForum’s Open Digital Architecture (ODA) and related ODA components along with TMForum Open APIs.

* Expertise and experience to provide thought leadership and guidance on resolving complex implementation and solution issues.

* Navigate complex client relationships and large transformation related challenges.
* Extensive RFP exposure - developing capability needs and supplier liaison.

**Ideally, you will also have:**

* Strong drive to excel professionally, and to guide and motivate others.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Dedicated, resourceful and able to work under pressure.

Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.

title: Account Manager
description:
**The Role**

You'll own a tiered portfolio of client accounts as their relationship owner from the day the sales handover lands, reporting to the Head of Account Management. This is not a delivery role: you carry no build work and no delivery team — your job is the client's success and the commercial outcomes that follow. On every account you work alongside a Forward Deployed Engineer and a Product Manager, and your accountabilities are three: client satisfaction, revenue, and expansion.

**The Bar**

Revenue — retention and expansion across your portfolio — is the top priority for this role, and client satisfaction is how you get there: accounts that genuinely succeed renew and expand as a natural consequence. Account-level CSAT and NPS sit on your scorecard alongside the revenue numbers, not as secondary goals but as how you know you are doing the job right. The lanes are explicit: you own the relationship and the commercial outcomes end to end; the Forward Deployed Engineer owns the solution and the build; the Product Manager owns product onboarding, enablement, and roadmap.

**What You'll Own**

1. **Own the client relationship from the sales handover.**
   Run the kick-off call and the kick-off narrative, land the success criteria and adoption targets with the client, and stay the client's first call from that day on.
2. **Own renewals end to end.**
   Run 90/60/30-day renewal cadences, maintain account health scores, build and activate save plans before at-risk accounts become problems, keep the forecast honest, and own the commercial paper — quotes, renewal contracts, and negotiation within delegated authority.
3. **Own expansion.**
   Run expansion discovery across the upgrade paths — Pulse to IQ, Daton to IQ, IQ Essentials to IQ Enterprise, usage-based upsell — spot the openings that client goals and competitor displacement create, and carry those deals to close.
4. **Own account-level CSAT and NPS — with the levers to back them.**
   Quarterback escalations: convene and drive cross-functional resolution to closure, while build quality stays with the Forward Deployed Engineer. During client UAT, hold the scope line — push back on creep, and run the workshops and demos that get users over the line.
5. **Drive adoption and value realization as the renewal engine.**
   Run trainings, articulate the why, what, and how of IQ modules and their value to each stakeholder, hold adoption reviews, introduce IQ to new stakeholders in the account, and make monthly and quarterly business reviews substantive commercial and strategic engagements — not status updates.
6. **Run the advocacy engine.**
   Enroll customers into CAP, and drive the referrals, testimonials, and business value discovery calls that turn satisfied clients into your best pipeline.
7. **Feed the voice of the customer into the roadmap.**
   Groom product asks across marketing, finance, customer, and supply-chain functions with the Product Manager, and pitch new features back into your accounts.
8. **Run your book's operating rhythm.**
   Implementation tracker, red-account updates, invoicing inputs — and keep Account Health current (and green): CSAT scores, expansion signals, renewal dates, churn reasons — logged by you, proactively.

**What Winning Looks Like**

**First 90 days:**
you know your book and its health scores, you've run your first kick-off and your first business reviews, and your renewal calendar is built with no surprises left in it.

**Steady state:**
renewals land predictably, you've closed expansion on real value, your accounts are reference-able — and referring — and account-level CSAT is strong quarter after quarter.

**Who Thrives Here**

Any of these backgrounds can get you in the room.

* 6–8 years in Account Management or Customer Success at a B2B SaaS or analytics company — with commercial ownership alongside relationship ownership.
* A portfolio you grew, not just maintained — specific renewal and expansion outcomes you personally ran and closed.
* CSAT or NPS in your scorecard alongside revenue metrics — you have owned client satisfaction as a number, not just a feeling.
* Ecommerce operating fluency: you understand what a DTC CFO wrestles with on channel margins and why a CMO is frustrated by attribution, and you don't need a primer on CAC, LTV, or repeat rates.
* Working literacy in the modern data stack — warehouse, BI, pipelines — enough to lead value conversations on Daton, Pulse, and IQ unaided.
* The ability to hold a commercial conversation — pricing, contract structure, ROI framing — directly with VP and C-suite buyers.

**It's an even stronger fit if you also bring:**

* HubSpot discipline that makes RevOps love you — health scores, pipeline hygiene, and forecasts they can trust.
* Experience managing new-client onboarding as a relationship owner — you know what a successful first ninety days looks like even when you are not doing the technical work.
* Hands-on comfort using AI tools like Claude to automate your own reporting and account prep.

* Sound Understanding of financial planning and wealth management products
* Knowledge of competitors and market place

* Excellent listening skills, with an inquisitive mind
* Strong ability to influence
* Self-drive and highly ambitious
* Good written and verbal communication skills
* Results-orientated & the ability to handle pressure
* Relationship building & management skills
* Understanding of competitive positioning
* Strong customer orientation & Focused on the brand
* Creative
* Comfortable with tight deadlines
* Attention to detail & Tenacious

**Technical Competencies:**

* Sound understanding of CBG product suite and associated technology platforms and operational procedures
* Understanding of regulatory guidelines on banking policies issued by RBI (local regulations in India) and local laws and regulations that impact businesses in general. Understanding of KYC requirements & Anti-money Laundering Policies are critical.
* Knowledge of financial markets and products to assist in meaningful dialogue with clients

**Work Relationship:**

* Close interaction with Branch managers to ensure consistent delivery of sales targets. Escalation to HR for poor performers & rewards to high performers.
* Close interaction with product teams to ensure suitable training for the team.
* Establish strong relationship with third party providers & other partners

**DBS India - Culture & Behaviors:**

* Ensure customer focus by delighting customers & reduce complaints
* Build pride and passion to protect, maintain and enhance DBS’ image and reputation
* Enhance knowledge base, build skill sets & develop competencies
* Execute at speed while maintaining error free operations
* Maintain the highest standards of honesty and integrity

Hyderabad-DBIL

Relationship Management

Regular

Full time

title: Chemistry account manager
description:
**Company Description**
Waters India Pvt. Limited is part of the global Waters Corporation, a leader in analytical instruments, chemistry, and software solutions for laboratories across pharmaceuticals, life sciences, food and environmental testing, and other industries. The company focuses on helping customers improve scientific outcomes through robust technologies, application expertise, and reliable service. Teams at Waters India collaborate closely with clients to optimize workflows, enhance data quality, and meet regulatory requirements. The organization emphasizes continuous learning, ethical business practices, and customer-centric innovation. Working at Waters India offers exposure to advanced laboratory technologies and the opportunity to contribute to impactful scientific and industrial applications.

**Role Description**
The Chemistry Account Manager is responsible for managing and growing relationships with customers using Waters chemistry products and solutions in and around Hyderabad. This full-time, on-site role involves engaging with laboratories and organizations to understand their analytical needs, recommend suitable chemistry and consumable solutions, and support them in achieving optimal performance from Waters systems. Day-to-day activities include visiting customer sites, conducting product presentations and demonstrations, coordinating technical discussions with internal application specialists, and preparing proposals and quotations. The role also includes tracking opportunities, managing the sales pipeline, negotiating commercial terms within company guidelines, and ensuring timely order closure. The Chemistry Account Manager collaborates with service, applications, and marketing teams to support installations, training, and ongoing customer satisfaction while maintaining accurate records in the CRM system and reporting market trends to management.

**Qualifications**

* Strong knowledge of analytical chemistry, chromatography (e.g., HPLC, UPLC), and laboratory workflows; ability to understand and discuss technical applications with customers.
* Proven account management or technical sales experience in scientific instruments, reagents, or laboratory consumables; ability to manage a sales territory and meet targets.
* Skilled in customer relationship building, stakeholder management, and consultative selling; comfortable interacting with laboratory staff, scientists, and decision-makers.
* Competence in using CRM tools, MS Office, and digital communication platforms; ability to prepare clear proposals, reports, and presentations.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; strong presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently in the field, plan visits, and prioritize opportunities; strong time management and problem-solving capabilities.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a related scientific discipline.
* Prior experience in the Hyderabad or broader regional market and familiarity with pharmaceutical, biotech, or analytical testing industries is an advantage.

title: Sr. Technical Program Manager, Amazon Business - External Integrations
description:
**Description**
Are you energized by building technology that makes life easier for business customers? Do you want to work at the center of enterprise commerce, connecting Amazon Business with the procurement, ERP, and finance systems that organizations run on? Would you thrive in a fast-paced, highly collaborative, start-up-like environment? If you answered yes to any of these, the Amazon Business System Integrations team is the place for you.
  
  
We are building the systems integrations capabilities that let business customers buy on Amazon Business directly from the systems they already use. This includes APIs, protocols, and partner connections that make procurement faster, more automated, and more reliable at global scale. Our teams design, launch, and operate these integrations with a wide range of partners, and each launch has to work securely and seamlessly across many different systems, regions, and customer needs.
  
  
The Amazon Business System Integrations team shares a passion for innovation, a love of solving complex challenges, and a desire to make a meaningful difference for customers. We are looking for people who are comfortable with ambiguity, enjoy solving hard problems at scale, and do well in a start-up-like environment.
  
  
We need a versatile, curious, and motivated Technical Program Manager to drive complex, cross-functional programs from concept to launch. You will partner with software engineers, product managers, scientists, and external partners to define scope, align stakeholders, manage dependencies and risks, and deliver high-quality integrations on schedule. You will build the mechanisms that keep programs on track, such as clear roadmaps, metrics, and operational reviews, and you will communicate status and trade-offs clearly to senior leaders.
  
  
If you are passionate about pioneering new technology, bringing structure to ambiguous problems, and delivering results for customers, we want to talk to you.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
You will own delivery of integration programs that connect Amazon Business with customer and partner procurement and ERP systems. That means defining scope, goals, and success metrics, building the roadmap, and keeping engineering, product, and partner teams aligned from kickoff through launch.
  
  
You will work closely with software engineers, product managers, and external partners to turn business needs into clear technical requirements. You'll understand the architecture well enough to question designs, flag risks, and help teams decide between approaches on APIs, security, and scalability.
  
  
You will manage dependencies, schedules, and risks across several teams. This includes running weekly status meetings and monthly business reviews, tracking open issues, and escalating blockers early with a clear recommendation.
  
  
You will define and track metrics such as partner onboarding time, adoption, error rates, and reliability, and use them to prioritize fixes. You'll also make sure each launch is operationally ready, with runbooks, monitoring, and support handoffs in place.
  
  
At the L6 level, you are expected to lead complex programs with little oversight, write clear program documents and updates for senior leaders, mentor other program managers, and improve team processes over time.
  
  
**About The Team**
Amazon Business System Integrations team connects Amazon Business with millions of business users and thousands of partner systems. We are driving API based shopping, protocols and agentic interactions.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 3+ years of software development experience
* 5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: AI Operations & Optimization Manager
description:
About IntouchCX
  
  
IntouchCX is a global leader in digital customer experience management, back office processing, trust & safety solutions, and AI services. For over 25 years, we’ve scaled with soul, building trusted long-term partnerships and empowering our people to drive positive change.
  
  
About the Job
  
  
The AI Operations Manager is responsible for leading the ongoing performance, quality, optimization, and evolution of digital and voice bot programs. This role serves as the primary partner-facing point of contact and leads a cross-functional team that may include Bot Quality Analysts, Data Analysts, Prompt Designers, and Bot Configuration and Development resources.
  
  
The AI Operations Manager translates bot performance data, quality findings, operational feedback, and customer experience observations into clear insights and prioritized recommendations. They own the operating cadence for the program, coordinate enhancement delivery, manage the change backlog, and measure the impact of improvements over time.
  
  
This role is both strategic and operational. The AI Operations Manager ensures that current bot performance is understood, issues are acted on, enhancements are delivered effectively, and a clear roadmap exists for future capability expansion.
  
  
As AI Operations & Optimization Manager, You Will…
  
  

* Serve as the primary partner-facing point of contact for all bot performance, quality, optimization, and enhancement activities while leading the overall operating rhythm (including weekly business reviews, monthly performance reviews, and quarterly executive reviews).
* Build strong working relationships with Client Partners, Operations, CX, Product, Technology, Analytics, and other key stakeholders, managing incoming partner requests and coordinating cross-functional support.
* Lead, direct, and set clear priorities for a multidisciplinary AI operations team (including Bot Quality Analysts, Data Analysts, Prompt Designers, and Configuration resources) to align effort toward common goals, continuous improvement, and measurable outcomes.
* Support the evaluation and calibration of Copilot, Agent Assist, RTG, and other AI-supported agent experiences across channels, partnering with Operations, CX, and Quality teams to align on standards.
* Diagnose whether performance opportunities are driven by persona and conversational behavior, prompt design, workflow configuration, knowledge sources, policies or operating procedures, system integrations, or data availability and quality.
* Prioritize recommendations and proposed backlog changes based on customer impact, business impact, risk, frequency, effort, expected benefit, and quantified operational metrics.
* Own and maintain the bot enhancement backlog.
* Coordinate enhancement delivery across Bot Quality, Prompt Design, Bot Configuration, Development, Analytics, Operations, and other support teams.
* Manage change control, approvals, release coordination, testing requirements, and stakeholder communication.
* Ensure enhancements are documented with clear objectives, expected outcomes, and success measures.
* Track recommendations from identification through approval, implementation, validation, and closure.
* Coordinate User Acceptance Testing with Bot Quality Analysts, Operations teams, and partner stakeholders.
* Establish and maintain reporting across bot performance, resolution, quality, experience, and compliance.
* Track key performance indicators such as containment and deflection, resolution rate, bot satisfaction and quality scores, intent-level performance, compliance, escalations, contact volume, and automation utilization.
* Monitor performance by intent, channel, use case, and customer journey to identify areas requiring additional attention.
* Measure performance before and after enhancements to determine whether recommended changes produced the expected outcome.
* Build trend reporting to demonstrate ongoing performance improvements and identify emerging opportunities.
* Manage the operating rhythm for bot governance.
* Leverage performance data, contact volume, customer intents, quality observations, and operational insights to build and maintain an AI optimization roadmap.
* Identify opportunities for expanding automation into new intents and customer journeys.
* Maintain a catalog of recommended future intents and automation opportunities.
* Assess prospects for expanded integrations, workflows, knowledge sources, personalization, and transactional capabilities.
* Partner with Product, Technology, Operations, and partner stakeholders to prioritize future bot capabilities.
* Balance short-term optimization with long-term AI strategy and capability expansion.
* Review agent operating procedures, policies, knowledge resources, FAQs, and other reference content used by bots and agents.
* Enhance bot knowledge coverage, accuracy, accessibility, and consistency.
* Recommend revisions to knowledge assets when inaccurate, incomplete, outdated, or unclear content impairs bot performance.
* Align bot workflows and knowledge repositories with current business processes and customer policies.
* Provide day-to-day guidance and direction to a multidisciplinary AI operations team.

As AI Operations & Optimization Manager, You Need…
  
  

* 5+ years of experience across BPO, customer experience (CX), operations, client services, quality assurance, analytics, continuous improvement, program management, or related disciplines.
* Proven track record of leading cross-functional teams and orchestrating initiatives across Operations, Quality, Analytics, Technology, Training, and Product.
* Strong client and executive stakeholder management experience, serving as a primary point of contact while managing expectations, strategic priorities, risks, and deliverables.
* Experience analyzing operational performance data to extract actionable insights, build business cases, and execute targeted intervention plans.
* Demonstrated ability to establish and drive an operational cadence, including weekly performance reviews, action tracking, KPI reporting, and Executive Business Reviews.
* Proven ability to prioritize competing initiatives based on customer impact, ROI, operational risk, and resource constraints.
* Advanced presentation and storytelling skills, with the ability to clearly articulate what happened, why it matters, recommended next steps, and measurable outcomes of interventions.
* End-to-end change management experience guiding initiatives from initial opportunity identification through operational rollout and impact measurement.
* Rigorous organizational skills and the ability to maintain clear ownership, manage interdependencies, and track timelines across complex workstreams.
* Ability to synthesize quantitative metrics, qualitative observations, stakeholder feedback, and technical diagnostic findings to uncover root causes and emerging trends.
* The capability to distill complex technical, AI, and analytical data into concise, high-impact narratives and recommendations tailored for diverse audiences.
* Strong leadership skills to cultivate trusted partnerships, resolve ambiguity, facilitate executive decision-making, and align cross-functional teams around shared KPIs.
* The capacity to balance competing roadmaps, resources, and dependencies to keep delivery teams focused on high-value, needle-moving initiatives.
* A deep sense of ownership and accountability to drive initiatives end-to-end from initial insight to verified business impact.
* An inquisitive mindset to challenge legacy assumptions, probe operational friction, test solutions, and iteratively drive continuous process optimization.
* A solid foundational understanding of conversational AI architecture, bot capabilities, dialogue workflows, knowledge bases, and AI quality metrics to effectively lead and coordinate technical and operational specialists.

IntouchCX will never ask for payment, money, financial or banking information during the recruitment process. We only communicate through official channels.
  
  
Should you receive a suspicious job offer, or posting, from anyone claiming to be an IntouchCX employee, please report it immediately to hr@intouchcx.com for review and validation.

title: Technical Manager (Java Platform, Engineering Delivery & Warehouse Automation)
description:
**Job Requirements**  

At Quest Global, it’s not just what we do but how and why we do it that makes us different. With over 25 years as an engineering services provider, we believe in the power of doing things differently to make the impossible possible. Our people are driven by the desire to make the world a better place—to make a positive difference that contributes to a brighter future. We bring together technologies and industries, alongside the contributions of diverse individuals who are empowered by an intentional workplace culture, to solve problems better and faster.

**## Role purpose**

The Technical Manager will lead the multidisciplinary engineering organization delivering the Next Generation Platform. The role owns delivery execution, people leadership, capacity planning, engineering effectiveness, and cross-workstream coordination across platform modernization, robotic controls, Edge/HMI, data acquisition, quality, and DevSecOps.

**## Key responsibilities**

* Convert the multi-year product and technology roadmap into executable release plans, team objectives, milestones, dependencies, and staffing plans.
* Lead engineers and technical leads across software development, QA, platform engineering, and related disciplines; create clear accountability and a healthy engineering culture.
* Coordinate delivery across Spring Boot modernization, modular services, platform setup, robotic applications, controls, Edge/HMI, operational insights, and data-platform initiatives.
* Own predictable delivery for the planned release cadence, including readiness reviews, pilot support, stabilization, and product-line rollout.
* Partner with Product Management and the Technical Architect to balance scope, sequencing, technical debt, risk, and business value.
* Manage capacity against roadmap demand, identify skill gaps, support recruitment, and make build/buy/partner recommendations when appropriate.
* Establish engineering metrics for flow, quality, reliability, security, and release readiness; use evidence to improve outcomes.
* Ensure teams follow appropriate design, coding, review, testing, documentation, security, and operational practices.
* Proactively manage delivery risks involving external teams, equipment availability, PLC/robot dependencies, customer pilots, and integration environments.
* Facilitate decisions and escalation across stakeholders while keeping teams focused on outcomes.
* Coach leads and senior engineers, conduct performance and development conversations, and build succession plans.
* Support budget, vendor, and partner management where applicable.

**## Required experience and capabilities**

* Minimum 12 years of software or product-engineering experience, including at least 4 years managing engineering teams or complex technical programs.
* Successful delivery of multi-team, multi-release platforms involving Java/Spring Boot, APIs, CI/CD, security, and distributed systems.
* Strong understanding of software architecture and engineering practices, with enough technical depth to challenge estimates, risks, and design decisions.
* Experience managing modernization alongside ongoing product delivery and operational support.
* Demonstrated workforce planning, hiring, coaching, performance management, and stakeholder-management capability.
* Strong program execution skills covering planning, dependencies, risk, change, quality gates, and release readiness.
* Experience in warehouse automation, robotics, industrial software, controls, or operational technology is highly desirable.
* Clear, concise communication with engineering teams, product leaders, business stakeholders, partners, and customers.

**## Core technical and leadership skills**

* Engineering management, workforce planning, coaching, hiring, and performance management
* Multi-team roadmap execution, release planning, dependency management, and risk management
* Java/Spring Boot platforms, APIs, microservices, and distributed-system fundamentals
* Agile product delivery, engineering metrics, quality gates, and release readiness
* DevOps/CI/CD, application security, automated testing, and production operations
* Warehouse automation, robotics, PLC/control systems, Edge/HMI, or comparable industrial domains
* Senior stakeholder, vendor, partner, and cross-functional program management

**## Success measures**

* Roadmap commitments delivered predictably with transparent scope, capacity, and risk.
* Teams staffed appropriately and able to work effectively across workstream boundaries.
* Improved engineering throughput without compromising safety, security, quality, or maintainability.
* Successful pilots and rollouts with controlled defect levels and timely stabilization.
* Strong engagement, retention, skills growth, and leadership depth within the engineering organization.

**## Preferred qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Automation, or a related discipline.
* Experience delivering products through a scaled agile or comparable iterative delivery model.
* Familiarity with product-line engineering and globally distributed development teams.

We are known for our extraordinary people who make the impossible possible every day. Questians are driven by hunger, humility, and aspiration. We believe that our company culture is the key to our ability to make a true difference in every industry we reach. Our teams regularly invest time and dedicated effort into internal culture work, ensuring that all voices are heard.

We wholeheartedly believe in the diversity of thought that comes with fostering a culture rooted in respect, where everyone belongs, is valued, and feels inspired to share their ideas. We know embracing our unique differences makes us better, and that solving the worlds hardest engineering problems requires diverse ideas, perspectives, and backgrounds. We shine the brightest when we tap into the many dimensions that thrive across over 21,000 difference-makers in our workplace.

title: Assistant Sales Manager
description:
**Are you our newest team member as an Assistant Sales Manager, Marine India ready to specialize, deepen your expertise, and make an impact within a dynamic and supportive team?**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

DESMI is a dynamic and innovative company where your ideas matter. We're building a culture that values collaboration, continuous learning, and making a difference. As an employee at DESMI, you'll have the opportunity to work on challenging projects, develop cutting-edge skills, and connect with a diverse team of talented individuals. If you're looking for a workplace where you can grow, contribute, and be inspired, DESMI is the place for you.

**Ideally, we are looking for someone who is:**
-----------------------------------------------

* **Commercially driven** with a strong focus on achieving sales targets and profitability.
* **Technically proficient** in marine equipment sales, especially pumps and related systems.
* **Self-motivated and accountable**, comfortable working independently and managing customer relationships across India.

**A glimpse into the role**
---------------------------

As Assistant Sales Manager, Marine India, you’ll be a key contributor to growing DESMI’s marine sales and business development in India. Your role mainly revolves around:

* **Sales & Business Development:** Generate new enquiries, develop sales opportunities, negotiate commercial terms, and convert opportunities into orders.
* **Customer Relationship Management:** Manage and grow key accounts including shipowners, ship-management companies, shipyards, OEMs, consultants, designers, agents, and marine traders.
* **New Account Acquisition:** Identify prospective customers, establish new business relationships, and expand market presence across India.
* **Project & Tender Sales:** Track newbuilding, retrofit, repair, and replacement projects; coordinate technical-commercial offers, tenders, and follow-ups to secure orders.
* **Revenue & Orderbook Growth:** Achieve assigned targets for order intake, invoicing, and orderbook, while maintaining healthy margins and timely order execution.
* **Market Intelligence:** Monitor competitor activities, customer requirements, upcoming projects, and market trends to identify growth opportunities.
* **Internal Coordination:** Collaborate closely with technical, service, operations, and finance teams to ensure customer satisfaction and successful order conversion.
* **Sales Tools:** Hands-on experience with Salesforce and quotation tools such as QPM and Infor.

**Your next opportunity starts here**
-------------------------------------

As a member of our marine sales team, we are looking for a technically skilled and commercially focused Assistant Sales Manager who is self-driven and has a deep understanding of marine equipment sales, especially pumps and related systems.

We also imagine that you:

* Possess a strong technical background with a Bachelor of Engineering in Mechanical, Electrical, or Mechatronics.
* Have 5 to 7 years of proven experience in technical sales or sales management within marine equipment, pumps, or rotating equipment sectors.
* Have excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills, with the confidence to motivate clients and close sales.
* Are willing to travel regularly across India to engage directly with customers.
* Have existing relationships with shipowners, ship managers, shipyards, OEMs, consultants, designers, agents, or marine traders, which will be a strong advantage.

**The perks of being at DESMI**
-------------------------------

At DESMI, we want you to feel supported, valued and motivated. That’s why we offer a range of benefits that make a difference – from flexibility and career opportunities to security.

Here are some of the benefits we offer our employees:

* **Skills development and career growth** - Opportunities for training, job rotation and internal mobility.
* **Private healthcare and life insurance** - Your well-being is important to us. We provide comprehensive private healthcare coverage, giving you access to quality medical treatment when needed.
* **On-site canteen** - Including a lunch buffet on subsidy basis.
* **Company sports & social activities** - Join events like cricket, table tennis, summer parties, and much more.

**What we’re about**
--------------------

But we’re more than just pumps. At DESMI, we believe teamwork and innovation drive success.

When you join DESMI, you can expect:

* A collaborative and supportive team environment.
* Opportunities for continuous learning and professional development.
* A chance to contribute your ideas and make a real impact.
* A company that values sustainability and innovation.

We are a flat organization with an open-door policy, where decisions are made together, and ideas are always welcome. Here, doers thrive – if you see an opportunity for improvement, you have the freedom to act on it.

As innovators in reliable and sustainable flow solutions, we serve a wide range of industries from Aquaculture and Defense to Green Technologies – the list goes on. Sustainability is highly appreciated while developing high-performance and long-lasting technologies that help industries adapt to evolving markets while reducing environmental impact.

**Ready to apply?**
-------------------

If you're a motivated and technically skilled individual seeking a challenging and rewarding career where you can contribute to a more sustainable future, we encourage you to apply!

Use the Apply button to submit your application. We are reviewing applications on a rolling basis and encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

If you have questions about the role, you are welcome to contact Stephen Raphael Muttath at strm@desmi.com.

title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer
description:
**Company Description**

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

 **Job Description**

**About the team**  
The Agentic AI team is a platform engineering group responsible for building ServiceNow's AI Agents framework, the foundational infrastructure that enables product teams and customers to create intelligent, autonomous agents. We design and develop agentic pipelines using Python and Java, delivering capabilities such as agent reasoning, memory, orchestration, and evaluation at enterprise scale. Beyond core platform development, engineers on this team have the opportunity to contribute to research initiatives in agent learning, agentic evaluation methodologies, and analytics. We embrace the rapidly evolving landscape of LLMs and Agentic AI while maintaining the reliability and performance standards required to operate at ServiceNow's scale.

**What you get to do in this role:**

Lead the design and architecture of AI solutions, shaping how reasoning, memory, and orchestration come together in production systems. Own end to end delivery from design through deployment, ensuring solutions are scalable, reliable, and performant. Work hands on with modern AI frameworks and open source SDKs, with a strong emphasis on prompt engineering and pipeline optimization. Stay current with emerging advancements in LLMs and Agentic AI, integrating relevant techniques into our platform roadmap.

Provide technical leadership by mentoring engineers, conducting code reviews, and defining best practices that foster a culture of innovation and quality. Partner with product managers, architects, and leadership to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions with measurable impact. Champion observability and evaluation for AI systems, building out logging, metrics, and automated evaluation frameworks for production workloads.

 **Qualifications**

**To be successful in this role you have:**

* Experience leveraging AI or critically evaluating how to integrate AI into work processes, decision making, and problem solving. This may include using AI powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
* 11 + years of experience designing and implementing complex enterprise applications, with proven success in conversational AI and NLP platforms.
* Strong development skills in Java and Python, including building production grade AI or ML systems.
* Hands on expertise in LLM powered applications and tooling, including frameworks such as LangChain and LangGraph and vendor APIs such as OpenAI and Anthropic.
* Deep understanding of agentic reasoning pipelines, evaluation frameworks, and advanced NLP techniques.
* Strong problem solving abilities with a bias for action, a customer first mindset, and the ability to operate effectively in fast paced environments.
* Demonstrated analytical skills in evaluating model performance, optimizing inference latency and cost, and improving system efficiency end to end.
* Proven ability to translate complex AI concepts into clear business value and communicate effectively with both technical and non technical stakeholders.
* Experience providing technical leadership and guiding successful AI or ML engineering projects across teams or domains.
* Bonus qualifications include publications, technical blogs, conference talks, or open source contributions in LLMs, GenAI, or AI systems engineering.

description:

Specialist, Software, Cloud Engineering

TheTechnical Analyst / Systems Analyst acts as the primary link between business stakeholders, vendors, and engineering teams to deliver and support technology solutions across regulated environments. This role is responsible for evaluating business requirements, implementing commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) applications, designing integrations, supporting cloud deployments, and ensuring solutions meet quality, security, and compliance standards.
  
The individual collaborates across product, engineering, validation, and business teams to drive solution delivery, manage vendor relationships, develop technical documentation, and support system implementations in AWS and on-premises environments. * Contribute to system design discussions, integration strategies, and API contracts.
* Drive configuration, parameterization, and environment readiness for releases.

* Coordinate technical due diligence, proof of concepts, and interoperability testing.
* Deploy vendor products in the environment and migrate them to higher environments, including SIT, UAT, and Production.

* Design and build Terraform infrastructure as code (IaC) to provision, pause, and terminate AWS resources.
* Automate configuration management and provisioning with Ansible playbooks and roles.
* Implement guardrails such as branch protection, code review workflows, quality gates, and rollback strategies.
* Collaborate with platform teams on deployment standards, secrets management, and approvals.

\*\*Custom Development and Integrations\*\*
  

* Design, build, test, and document custom scripts and components using Python and JavaScript.
* Integrate upstream and downstream applications using REST APIs.

\*\*Test Automation and Quality Engineering\*\*
  

* Define test strategies across unit, integration, API, UI, and end-to-end testing.
* Collaborate with testing teams or build and maintain automated test suites using Robot Framework and Tosca.
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines, including reporting and quality gates.

* Security assessments

* GxP SDLC documents
* Application administration SOPs
* Support models, structures, and SLAs

Independence – be comfortable executing activities and needs
  
Experience in algorithm development, numerical methods, and scientific computing
  
Experience with computational materials science methodologies
  
Familiarity with machine learning and deep learning concepts and applications
  
Experience with regression, neural networks, and frameworks
  
Strong background in thermodynamics, physics, and chemistry
  
Experience with process and multi-physics modeling, and implementation
  
Experience with OpenFOAM, ANSYS Fluent, COMSOL, and familiarity with the FEM, FVM, PFM methods and implementations
  
Experience with common modeling software, previous software development and Linux experience
  
Experience with Bash, Python, Perl/TCl/MATLAB, or C++
  
Experience with reports and presentations customized for users and leaders
  
Outstanding teamwork and experience with remote collaboration tools
  
Strong debug and problem-solving skills
  
Experience writing reports and conference papers
  
Excellent written and verbal communication
  
Background in semiconductor process development or integration is encouraged
  
Familiarity of using AI tools is a plus
  
  
**Experience:** 3+ years of modeling
  
  
**Education:** Master’s or Ph.D. in Applied Mechanics, Applied Chemistry, Applied Physics, Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related fields.

title: Customer Success Manager (Jewelry Industry)
description:
**About Frontier**
------------------

Frontier is a subsidiary of Fresh Prints. Fresh Prints is a New York-based, fast-growing, fully remote, 380-person company that has most of our team in India and the Philippines. A few years ago, Fresh Prints started helping other fast-growing companies build their teams. We got so good at it that we decided to spin out a new company to focus exclusively on that and call it Frontier.

Here at Frontier, we help companies grow full-time, cross-functional teams abroad. We hire the smartest people, and we place them in the best companies. We have placed over 800 hires across 50 different US-based startups and high-growth companies.

**About the Client:**
---------------------

EverSpark is a technology-forward custom jewelry manufacturing platform powering independent jewelry designers, retailers, and enterprise brands. Our platform enables customers to design, render, price, revise, approve, and manufacture custom jewelry through a seamless digital workflow.

We combine manufacturing expertise with modern software, AI-assisted design tools, and a high-touch customer experience to streamline the end-to-end custom jewelry process.

**Role Overview**
-----------------

We are hiring a **Jewelry Account Manager / Customer Success Manager** to manage customer relationships and guide clients throughout the custom jewelry design and manufacturing process.

This is a highly consultative, customer-facing role where you'll serve as the primary point of contact for customers. You'll help clients clarify design requirements, answer questions, coordinate with internal production teams, manage timelines, and ensure orders move smoothly from concept to delivery.

This role combines **customer success, project coordination, pricing support, and production management**, making it ideal for someone who enjoys both relationship management and operational execution.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, tech-savvy, an exceptional English communicator, and comfortable managing multiple high-value customer workflows in a fast-paced environment.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Customer Account Management**

* Manage inbound customer requests for custom jewelry pieces
* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts
* Communicate directly with customers via email, phone, and messaging platforms
* Ensure a high-touch, responsive customer experience

### **Requirement Gathering & Order Clarification**

* Review customer submissions and identify missing or unclear information.
* Ask thoughtful clarifying questions to fully understand customer requirements before production begins.
* Translate customer requests into clear, actionable instructions for internal teams.
* Guide customers through pricing, materials, manufacturing capabilities, and design trade-offs.
* Ensure customer expectations are aligned with operational capabilities and production timelines.

### **Production & Internal Coordination**

* Coordinate closely with CAD designers, production, and operations teams throughout the manufacturing process.
* Support CAD preparation and coordination by ensuring customer requirements are accurately translated into production-ready designs.
* Assist with quote preparation and pricing coordination while maintaining a high level of accuracy.
* Track order progress from design through manufacturing and final delivery.
* Ensure all required materials (e.g., stones, specifications, approvals) are received before production.
* Escalate production or technical issues when needed.

### **Customer Follow-ups & Workflow Management**

* Follow up on pending approvals, missing customer inputs, or stalled orders.
* Maintain accurate notes, customer communications, and order updates in internal systems.
* Ensure customer projects continue progressing smoothly through every stage of production.
* Support continuous improvement of internal workflows and customer processes.
* Identify opportunities to improve organization, efficiency, and customer experience using technology or automation.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Excellent written and spoken English.
* Strong verbal communication skills with a **neutral, easy-to-understand accent** suitable for communicating with US-based customers.
* Strong listening skills with the ability to ask thoughtful follow-up questions and communicate complex information clearly.
* **2+ years of experience** in Customer Success, Account Management, Client Services, Operations, or similar customer-facing roles.
* Experience managing multiple customer requests while working under tight deadlines.
* Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail.
* Tech-savvy and able to quickly learn new systems and software.
* Strong problem-solving skills with a proactive, ownership mindset.
* Demonstrated ability to improve workflows, solve problems independently, or take initiative beyond assigned responsibilities.
* Comfortable working US business hours.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience in jewelry, diamonds, gemstones, luxury products, or custom manufacturing environments.
* Experience working with **custom or bespoke jewelry manufacturing**.
* Experience with **CAD preparation, CAD coordination, jewelry production workflows, quote preparation, or pricing coordination**.
* Experience balancing customer service responsibilities with operational or production support.
* Experience working in fast-paced production environments with short turnaround times.
* Prior exposure to SaaS platforms, marketplaces, CRM systems, AI tools, or workflow management software.
* Experience at companies like **Rare Carat, Nivoda**, or similar jewelry or diamond technology companies is highly preferred.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**
---------------------------

* Friendly, empathetic, and professional communicator who enjoys building relationships with customers.
* Naturally curious and comfortable asking clarifying questions before making assumptions.
* Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail.
* Calm and confident when managing customer conversations.
* Comfortable balancing customer expectations with operational constraints.
* Able to manage multiple customer projects simultaneously while maintaining accuracy.
* Thrives in fast-paced environments with time-sensitive production schedules.
* Comfortable handling both customer-facing responsibilities and operational work such as pricing, CAD coordination, and production tracking.
* Demonstrates initiative by improving processes, building systems, or finding more efficient ways of working.
* Strong ownership and accountability - you naturally take responsibility for ensuring customer orders move forward.
* Excited to learn new technology and comfortable working with AI-enabled platforms and modern software.

**Work Details**
----------------

* **Preferred Location:** India / South Africa
* **Work Schedule:** US business hours (aligned to customer base)
* **Start Date:** As soon as possible

title: Client Service Manager – Equity

We combine professional advice with technology to help individuals make informed financial decisions and work towards their life goals.

You will own the clarity and accuracy of portfolio communication, keep backend equity operations running smoothly, and make sure client queries are resolved quickly and credibly. The ideal candidate is genuinely curious about equity markets, comfortable with numbers, and polished enough to engage with sophisticated, high-expectation clients.

• Prepare talking points and briefing notes ahead of client calls and review meetings

• Maintain a record of all client interactions, preferences, mandates, and risk profiles in the CRM

• Circulate daily or weekly market and portfolio-relevant updates to internal teams

7. Compliance & Risk Hygiene

• Ensure all client communication complies with regulatory and internal guidelines (including disclosures and record-keeping)

• Maintain confidentiality of client and portfolio data • Flag potential conflicts, errors, or compliance concerns immediately

Qualifications & Experience

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Commerce, Economics, Business, or a related field. NISM certification (X-A and XB) are a plus

• Experience in equity operations, portfolio servicing, client relationship management, or research support in an asset/wealth management or broking environment
