title: Community Relations Manager
description:
Role Purpose

We are looking for a hands-on manager to develop and manage,combining luxury client relations, community engagement and disciplined CRM management.

This person will take ownership of the participant experience—from someone first

subscribing to communications through to becoming an engaged member,

customer and advocate.

The role requires someone who can build genuine personal relationships while

maintaining the systems, follow-up processes and commercial awareness needed to

make the programme effective.

Key Roles and Responsibilities

1. Programme Development and Ownership

\* Translate Hueb Circle’s purpose into a clear operating plan, engagement calendar

and service standards.

\* Work with leadership to define the experience, benefits and communications

appropriate to subscribers, members and customers.

\* Develop clear onboarding journeys so participants understand what Hueb Circle

offers and how they can participate.

\* Identify meaningful reasons to join and remain involved, beyond discounts and

purchase incentives.

\* Maintain an annual programme calendar and manage agreed budgets, priorities

and delivery timelines.

\* Regularly review the programme and recommend improvements based on

feedback and results.

2. Community Engagement and Relationship Building

\* Act as the primary relationship contact for Hueb Circle participants.

\* Welcome new subscribers, members and customers with appropriate, personalised

communication.

\* Build an understanding of participants’ interests, preferences and connection to

Hueb.

\* Maintain regular contact through relevant messages, invitations and individual

follow-ups.

\* Encourage participation in brand experiences, conversations and events.

\* Identify engaged members and customers who could become advocates or

introduce others to the community.

\* Ensure interactions feel warm, thoughtful and consistent with a luxury brand.

3. CRM and Database Management

\* Own the day-to-day quality and organisation of the Hueb Circle database.

\* Maintain accurate profiles, contact details, communication preferences, interests,

purchase history and relationship notes.

\* Segment the database to support relevant communication and appropriate levels of

attention.

\* Establish processes for capturing new contacts from events, enquiries, referrals

and other approved sources.

\* Create reminders, follow-up schedules and workflows so relationship opportunities

are not missed.

\* Coordinate with technical support or external vendors on CRM configuration,

integrations and automation.

\* Follow company policies on consent, privacy, confidentiality and access to

customer information.

4. Member Communications and Content Coordination

\* Develop a communications calendar covering welcome messages, brand updates,

collection previews, event invitations and personalised outreach.

\* Write or coordinate polished, engaging communications across approved channels,

including email, telephone and messaging.

\* Work closely with the Creative Director and marketing team to maintain Hueb’s

tone, visual standards and brand identity.

\* Adapt communication to different audiences rather than sending the same

message to every contact.

\* Coordinate stories and content around design, craftsmanship, collections and the

people behind Hueb.

\* Monitor responses and adjust content, timing and frequency to improve relevance

and engagement.

5. Experiences, Events and Member Benefits

\* Propose and coordinate experiences that make participation in Hueb Circle

valuable.

\* These may include collection previews, intimate gatherings, designer

conversations, styling appointments, trunk shows and selected partner experiences.

\* Manage invitation lists, participant preferences and personalised follow-up.

\* Coordinate with sales teams, retail partners, venues and service providers as

required.

\* Recommend appropriate benefits and recognition for different participant groups,

subject to leadership approval.

\* Assess events through attendance, quality of engagement, feedback and

subsequent relationship development.

6. Customer Experience and Retention

\* Coordinate thoughtful follow-up after purchases and significant interactions.

\* Work with the relevant teams to ensure product enquiries, service requests and

concerns are handled promptly.

\* Maintain continuity of communication so customers know who is looking after them.

\* Identify opportunities for relevant recommendations, gifting support and future

appointments.

\* Re-engage inactive customers and members through considered, personalised

outreach.

\* Gather feedback and communicate recurring issues or opportunities to leadership.

7. Sales Coordination and Commercial Contribution

\* Recognise purchase interest and connect participants with the appropriate sales

contact.

\* Provide relevant relationship context so sales follow-up is informed and personal.

\* Track enquiries, appointments, referrals and purchases influenced by Hueb Circle.

\* Support repeat purchases and referrals while maintaining the trust and quality of

the community experience.

\* Coordinate carefully with retail partners and internal teams to respect existing

customer relationships and agreed channel arrangements.

\* Distinguish community engagement from immediate buying intent and manage

both appropriately.

8. Reporting and Continuous Improvement

\* Prepare a concise monthly dashboard covering programme activity, engagement

and commercial contribution.

\* Report on database quality, participation, customer feedback and outstanding

follow-up.

\* Identify which activities are building stronger relationships and which need

improvement.

\* Recommend practical changes based on evidence, rather than focusing only on

contact-list growth.

Ideal Candidate Profile

Ideally 4–7 years in one or more of the following:

\* Client relations or clienteling within fine jewellery, luxury fashion, watches or

premium lifestyle brands.

\* Membership management within private clubs or established communities.

\* Guest relations or personalised service within luxury hospitality.

\* CRM and retention roles involving substantial direct customer interaction.

Candidates should demonstrate personal ownership of relationships and follow-

through, alongside experience managing a structured programme or database.

Required Skills and Attributes

\* Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to build trust with discerning customers.

\* Strong written and spoken English.

\* Warmth, discretion, maturity and sound judgement.

\* Understanding of luxury service and personalised client attention.

\* Strong organisational skills and consistent follow-through.

\* Practical familiarity with CRM platforms, segmentation, reporting and

communication tools.

\* Ability to write polished, natural messages that do not feel generic or overly

promotional.

\* Commercial awareness without an aggressive sales approach.

\* Confidence coordinating across creative, marketing, sales and external partners.

\* Ability to work independently and take responsibility for execution.

\* Comfort supporting international stakeholders and occasional events across

agreed working hours.

Success Measures

Targets will be agreed with leadership. Performance should be assessed through a

balanced set of measures:

\* Growth in relevant, engaged subscribers and members.

\* Quality and completeness of CRM records.

\* Timeliness and consistency of onboarding and follow-up.

\* Member participation, response rates and event attendance.

\* Customer satisfaction and quality of feedback.

\* Reactivation of inactive relationships.

\* Qualified appointments, enquiries and referrals generated.

\* Repeat purchases and revenue influenced by the programme.

\* Delivery within agreed budgets and timelines.

Guidance

Need candidates who combine personal relationship-building ability, luxury service

standards and CRM discipline.

A background limited to social media management, digital advertising, database

administration or event logistics will not, on its own, meet the requirements of this

role.

Strategic Leadership and Industry Expertise

Commercial Operations and Governance

Operational Excellence and Global Collaboration

* Deliver consistent, high quality solutions.
* Ensure alignment with the Enterprise Target Operating model and location strategy.
* Foster a culture of collaboration and knowledge-sharing.
* Ensure compliance with legislative, regulatory, and contractual requirements.
* Promote continuous improvement through the adoption of LEAN principles.

* Champion strategic talent development and global upskilling initiatives using structured frameworks, including Individual Development Plans (IDPs) and the 70/20/10 model.

title: Payments Cross-Currency Solutions Specialist - Vice President
description:
**Job Description**
**Job summary**
JPMorgan Payments is looking for a business development / solutions Vice President to execute our Cross-Currency Solutions growth strategy. FX and global payments are critical drivers of the international growth agenda for the Payments and FX business.
  
  
The Cross-Currency Solutions Vice President will drive the accelerated growth of the regional and cross-regional Cross-Currency Solutions P&L through a full range of sales and advisory activities.
  
  
The role serves as a subject matter expert in Cross-Currency Solutions, actively supporting client solution pitches, identifying opportunities for growth and digitalizing clients' workflows. The incumbent acts as an advisor and extension of sales for the Payment Sales Managers and Global Corporate Bankers, helping to win new business through Request for Proposals, Differentiated Solution Pitches and leveraging client relationships.
  
  
In addition, the role serves as the voice of the client—channeling client feedback and competitive intelligence back to our product partners to strengthen product and solution features. Cross-Currnecy Solution Specialists stay closely aligned to product governance, legal/compliance/regulatory requirements, market practice and technology/operational constraints. This proximity enables early validation of feasibility, reduces late-stage surprises and rework, and ensures solutions are productized in a way that can be replicated across clients and segments.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Distinct accountability and partnership model: Lead solution feasibility and productization strategy for regulated and complex payment / foreign exchange control-enabled flows, working in close partnership with: Product (owns product vision/roadmap and approval forums); Payments Sales (owns go-to-market execution, pipeline shaping and client engagement, as applicable)
* Drive the outlined strategy for growing the Cross-Currency APAC P&L for the assigned portfolio, leveraging existing JPMorgan relationship, developing new relationships with Corporate Banking and Payments Sales, and CDM Marketer.
* Sales enablement for simple cross-currency payment flows for a defined set of client portfolio: Train relevant coverage partners on cross-currency payment capabilities, including spot foreign exchange payment solutions available via supported payment platforms. This includes the end-to-end payment flow from initiation through automated payment processing, tracking and client reporting.
* Ownership of complex flow / foreign exchange control-enabled solutions: Serve as the primary solution partner for complex client needs, working with Sales (and other stakeholders when applicable) to configure or tailor existing capabilities. As a client-facing Vice President, drive organic growth by increasing penetration with existing clients and pitching solutions to new clients, including proposal responses and bundling of products & solutions, and educate clients on new ways of execution.
* Governance, legal and regulatory rigor (continuous, not episodic): Ensure governance and regulatory alignment are embedded throughout the client solutioning lifecycle. Stay current on product approvals, policy constraints, licensing/regulatory requirements and required controls—reducing late-stage surprises and minimizing rework when feasibility checks happen too late.
* Structured translation layer between Sales and Product: Convert pipeline signals, proposal inputs and client feedback into actionable product requirements, enhancement requests and prioritization inputs. Translate roadmap constraints into clear client positioning, field-ready enablement and guidance on what is feasible now vs. later. Work with Sales to maintain a healthy client pipeline, ensuring involvement across the sales cycle from opportunity identification through solution pitches and winning mandates. The role is expected to support multiple client segments and industries in India and translate requirements into scalable solutions.
* Coordination between Payments Sales, Corporate and Commercial Banks and CDM Markets for pro-active and target client calling, develop and present client relevant and thoughtful solution presentations and set-out pricing strategy for all of the Cross-Currency Solutions.

**Key Skills**

* Cross-border payments and FX expertise: strong understanding of cross-currency payment flows, foreign exchange, client implementation considerations and operating/processing constraints
* Regulatory and controls mindset: ability to operate effectively within governance frameworks, legal/compliance requirements, and local regulatory expectations applicable to cross-border transactions
* Advisory and Solutioning: capability to assess feasibility early, design repeatable solutions, and standardize patterns that can scale across clients and segments, while taking an consultative approach going beyond the standard product offering.
* Commercial acumen and client-facing leadership: strong executive presence, ability to influence outcomes, and proven experience supporting complex solution pitches and proposal responses
* Stakeholder management: demonstrated ability to drive alignment across Product, Sales, Technology, Operations, Implementation and Service teams
* Analytical and structured problem solving: ability to leverage data and structured thinking to prioritize opportunities, develop replication strategies, and deliver clear recommendations
* Globalized view: ability to recognize patterns across markets and segments, apply global standards with local expertise.

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Significant experience in cross-border payments, transaction banking/cash management and/or FX-related solutions
* Strong understanding of end-to-end payment flows and the practicalities of delivery and execution in a regulated environment
* Demonstrated experience partnering across Product, Sales and delivery organizations to deliver client outcomes
* Track record in complex client solutioning, commercialization and supporting proposal responses
* Understanding of APAC regulatory environment related to cash management, account services and foreign exchange
* BA or BS from a top-tier program or equivalent level education preferred
* Minimum of 8 years+ of relevant work experience
* Exceptional writing, verbal communication and client facing skills

**About Us**
JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.
  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.
  
  
**About The Team**
J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Verdantis | Mumbai | On-Site

**About the Company**

Verdantis builds MRO360, an AI-native platform that helps maintenance, repair, and operations (MRO) teams in asset-heavy industries clean, enrich, reason over, and act on their spare parts, inventory, procurement, and reliability data.

**About the Role**

Our customers are large plants and refineries in energy, manufacturing, mining and CPG that run MRO360 and our MDM product is on top of SAP. Once Delivery hands over a live system, you own the account are the planners and buyers acting on the AI's recommendations, is the customer seeing the savings we promised, will they renew, and where is the next plant or module we should be selling them.

This is not a ticket queue or a relationship-management role. It is a commercial role with a number on it- net revenue retention earned by driving adoption. We are AI-native: the product makes recommendations on its own, and the strongest sign of a healthy account is a plant that has stopped arguing with them. You will also use AI heavily in your own work- usage analysis, QBR decks, value reports, renewal risk scoring and define how a one-person CS function covers a growing book without adding headcount at the same rate.

**What you do**

**Adoption**

* Take formal handover from Delivery at go-live with a written success plan per account: the business outcomes the customer bought (inventory reduction, duplicate elimination, stock-out avoidance), the personas who must use the product, and the usage metrics that prove it.
* Track adoption weekly from product usage data: recommendations generated, accepted, rejected, overridden by plant and by user. Call the customer when the curve flattens, not when the renewal is due.
* Run enablement for new users, new plants and new modules; turn recurring questions into help content and in-product guidance with the product team.
* Produce a quarterly value report per account that puts a currency figure on what the product delivered and presents it to the economic buyer.

**Renewal**

* Own every renewal from 180 days out: health score, risk flags, mitigation plan, commercial proposal, signature.
* Build the renewal risk model- usage, sponsor changes, support history, value delivered and review it with the Leadership monthly.
* Run escalations when things go wrong: pull in Delivery, Engineering early, keep the customer informed, and close the loop in writing.

**Expansion**

* Map each account: plants not yet live, modules not yet bought (equipment criticality, work order management, MDM alongside MRO360), and adjacent business units.
* Qualify expansion opportunities and either close them directly for in-contract add-ons or hand a warm, well-documented opportunity to the account executive for larger deals.
* Turn happy customers into references, case studies and speakers; keep a live list of who will take a call from a prospect.

**Building the function**

* Set up the CS tooling- health scoring, usage dashboards, renewal pipeline using the stack we have and AI where it saves time, rather than buying a CS platform on day one.
* Write the playbook as you go: onboarding checklist, QBR template, renewal cadence, escalation path. The second CS hire should be productive in two weeks because of what you documented.

**What we are looking for**

* 3-5 years in customer success, account management, implementation or pre-sales at a B2B SaaS company. Early in your career, with at least one renewal or expansion you personally carried to signature.
* Commercially minded: comfortable talking price, contract terms and ROI with a VP of Supply Chain or a plant head, and comfortable asking for expansion.
* Reads data before calling the customer: can pull usage numbers, build a health score in a spreadsheet, and tell the difference between a quiet account and a dying one.
* Uses AI daily and can show it: a QBR deck drafted from usage data, a value report generated from a template, a renewal-risk summary produced from support tickets. We will ask for examples.
* Curious about the domain: willing to learn what a reorder point, a material master or a criticality ranking is, because the customer conversation is about their plant, not our features.
* Write clearly and briefly- the value report, the escalation notes, the renewal email and run a meeting with an agenda and a next step.
* Comfortably being the only CS person for a while sets own priorities, asks for help early, does not wait for a process to exist.
* Willing to travel to customer sites, including internationally, around 20% of the time.

**Nice to have**

* Domain exposure to MRO, spare parts, plant maintenance, procurement or supply chain in process or heavy industry.
* Prior experience with SAP MM/PM or another EAM/ERP from the user side.
* Experience setting up CS tooling (Gainsight, ChurnZero, Vitally, or a home-grown stack) or defining a health-score model.
* Basic SQL or spreadsheet modelling for usage and value analysis.
* Prior work at an early-stage or scaling company where you built the function rather than inherited it.

**Who this role is not for**

* Someone who sees customer success as support with a nicer title. There is a revenue number here and you own it.
* Someone who is uncomfortable with commercial conversations or waits for Sales to handle anything involving money.
* Someone who needs a mature CS platform and a defined playbook before they can operate.
* Someone who treats AI as a demo feature rather than as the way they get their own work done.

title: Senior Technical Account Manager (L3)
description:
**Department:**
Sales
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Permanent - Full Time
  
  
**Location:**
Mumbai, India
  
  
**Description**
We are looking for an On-Site Technical Account Manager (L3) to act as a dedicated Resident Engineer for a major enterprise deployment. Working directly at the customer site, you will serve as the primary technical bridge between local operations, internal engineering teams, and vendor support to ensure high availability and rapid issue resolution.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Investigate and resolve escalated Hazelcast component issues. Lead root-cause analysis for P1, recurring and critical incidents with Hazelcast support, keep stakeholders informed and track permanent corrective actions through closure. When an incident closes, make sure the knowledge base captures the cause, permanent fix and lessons learned.
* Coordinate Hazelcast support cases for product bugs, patches and escalations; promptly notify RBI of critical defects or security vulnerabilities and track remediation and closure status.
* Recommend, configure and validate RBI-approved Hazelcast designs for high availability, resilience, throughput and scalability in line with Hazelcast guidance, working with L2 and developers on complex workflow, connector, integration and performance issues.
* Plan and carry out approved UAT, pre-production and production updates with impact and risk analysis, approved operating procedures, test and rollback plans, execution in approved maintenance windows and post-change validation.
* Advise RBI security teams on Hazelcast hardening; assess releases and patches and maintain upgrade, adoption and infrastructure-lifecycle roadmap recommendations.
* Work with RBI’s performance-monitoring team to establish baselines, diagnose bottlenecks and implement tuning and configuration improvements with measurable before-and-after results.
* Perform capacity planning and sizing and conduct periodic capacity and utilization reviews, including annual audits and corrective recommendations for threshold breaches.
* Maintain senior-level operating procedures and technical documentation; guide L1/L2 teams through knowledge sharing, current industry trends, best practices and thoughtful automation.
* Provide senior oversight for complex or escalated service requests, authorizations, coordination issues and configuration-backup concerns, while the L2 TAM owns routine handling. Help keep the agreed roles and responsibilities (RACI) and escalation matrix current, join remote, OEM and on-call coverage, and contribute to quarterly service-level reporting and RBI certification. The team supports unlimited cases, with response targets of 30 minutes initially and 1 hour ongoing for P1; 1 hour and 2 hours for P2; 4 hours and 8 business hours for P3; and 8 hours and 2 working days for all other cases.

**What You Have**

* Graduate qualification such as BE, BSc, MCA or equivalent; an engineering background is preferred.
* At least 6 years of relevant experience, including at least 5 years designing, implementing and upgrading Hazelcast or the directly relevant OEM product.
* Advanced Hazelcast architecture, configuration, high-availability, resilience and distributed-caching expertise, including security hardening and lifecycle management across UAT, pre-production and production.
* Demonstrated ownership of complex production incidents, P1 root-cause analysis, permanent corrective actions and OEM engineering/support escalations.
* Strong performance-tuning, capacity-planning, sizing, throughput and scalability skills supported by measurable validation.
* Ability to work with RBI stakeholders, developers and L1/L2 teams; communicate recommendations and approved decisions clearly and produce strong operating procedures, configuration records, root-cause analysis reports, roadmaps and knowledge-transfer guidance.
* Be prepared to share degree records, project dates, relevant experience and evidence of your Hazelcast or OEM association so Hazelcast can support RBI’s approval process.

About the Role
  
  
IDFC FIRST Bank is looking for a dynamic and entrepreneurial professional to drive growth of its NRI Banking business through strategic on-ground channel partnerships, distribution networks and business initiatives.
  
  
The individual will be responsible for identifying, developing and managing partnerships with institutions and organisations that can serve as effective customer acquisition channels for the NRI Banking business.

* Analyse market trends, competitor offerings and emerging customer acquisition opportunities.
* Develop business cases, partnership proposals, growth strategies and presentations for senior management.
* Collaborate with Product, Technology, Operations, Compliance, Marketing and Business teams to drive strategic initiatives from concept to execution.

An MBA or postgraduate qualification in Business, Finance or Management would be preferred.

* Improving partner activation, lead conversion and account funding.
* Developing repeatable partnership models across key domestic and international markets.
* Contributing to strategic initiatives that strengthen the overall NRI Banking business.

* 5yrs of Relevant experience

HCLSoftware is seeking an experienced enterprise sales professional to grow its business across Public Sector Banks in the Mumbai region.

The role requires a mature, consultative salesperson who can build senior customer relationships, identify business and technology requirements, and manage complex software opportunities through the procurement cycle. The candidate will be responsible for developing existing accounts, acquiring new business, and driving upsell and cross-sell opportunities across the relevant HCLSoftware portfolio.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Business Development and Revenue Ownership**

* Own sales targets for the assigned PSU banking accounts and territory.
* Develop quarterly and annual business plans with clear revenue objectives, account priorities and execution milestones.
* Identify new opportunities across bank headquarters, technology teams, business units and other relevant buying centres.
* Expand existing customer relationships through additional use cases, licence expansion, renewals where assigned, and cross-selling of relevant solutions.
* Maintain a balanced pipeline across near-term opportunities and longer-term strategic initiatives.
* Take ownership of opportunities from initial qualification through negotiation, closure and handover.

**2. Strategic Account Planning and Coverage**

* Develop and maintain comprehensive account plans for priority accounts.
* Complete 360-degree account mapping covering business priorities, technology landscape, existing deployments, procurement processes, competitors and partners.
* Build organisation charts identifying decision-makers, budget owners, technical evaluators, procurement stakeholders and influencers.
* Maintain account heat maps to identify current solution coverage, relationship gaps and growth opportunities.
* Establish a structured engagement plan for each account, including executive meetings, technical workshops and opportunity reviews.
* Build relationships across IT, information security, digital banking, operations, procurement and relevant business functions.

**3. Consultative and Value-Based Selling**

* Understand customer challenges and translate them into relevant software use cases and measurable business outcomes.
* Position solutions around customer priorities such as operational efficiency, security, automation, resilience and customer experience.
* Work with Sales Engineers and product specialists to conduct discovery sessions, presentations, demonstrations and proofs of concept.
* Develop business cases and proposals that clearly communicate solution value and commercial justification.
* Apply MEDDIC or the organisation’s prescribed sales qualification methodology to assess and advance opportunities.
* Build customer champions and secure access to economic buyers and key decision-makers.

**4. Tender, Bid and Procurement Management**

* Track relevant procurement opportunities, including RFIs, RFPs and tenders.
* Understand each bank’s evaluation criteria, approval process, procurement timelines and commercial requirements.
* Lead bid/no-bid discussions with internal stakeholders based on solution fit, eligibility, competitive position and commercial viability.
* Coordinate technical and commercial responses with Sales Engineering, product, finance, legal, bid management and partner teams.
* Ensure timely completion of bid documentation, internal approvals and submissions.
* Support clarification meetings, technical evaluations, commercial negotiations and contract finalisation.
* Follow applicable customer procurement requirements and company policies throughout the sales process.

**5. Partner and Ecosystem Management**

* Develop productive relationships with system integrators, channel partners and other relevant ecosystem participants.

You will drive customer experience, operational performance, people development and continuous improvement, while leading APAC’s contribution to our global follow-the-sun support model. This includes supporting the transition toward global queues, shared case ownership and seamless customer support across regions and time zones.

You will lead, coach and develop a diverse international team, building a high-performance culture focused on customer outcomes, accountability, collaboration and continuous development.

* Lead and develop the APAC Customer Support team, creating a high-performing, engaged and customer-focused organization with a strong culture of accountability, collaboration and ownership.

* Manage complex or high-impact customer escalations and identify recurring customer pain points, working cross-functionally to improve the broader customer experience.
* Lead APAC as an integral part of the global follow-the-sun support model, helping transition from regional ticket queues to global queues, shared case ownership and effective handover practices across regions.
* Partner closely with Support leaders in EMEA and the Americas to balance global workloads, capacity and skills, improve customer coverage and champion a global-first mindset.
* Drive transformation and continuous improvement by simplifying, standardizing and automating support operations, while championing the adoption of new technologies, tools, self-service capabilities and AI-enabled ways of working.
* Represent APAC within the Global Customer Support leadership team, partnering with Product, Engineering, Sales, Customer Success and regional Support leaders to establish consistent service standards, share best practices and provide clear insights on performance, customer trends, risks and opportunities.

* 5+ years of leadership experience within Customer Support, Technical Support, Customer Experience or a related environment, ideally within SaaS or technology.

* Experience operating within, or transitioning toward, a follow-the-sun or global support model, including global queues, cross-regional case ownership, workload and capacity management.
* Strong understanding of the APAC region, with experience working across different markets, cultures and time zones while building shared global accountability.
* Proven ability to manage operational performance through KPIs, data, coaching and continuous improvement, translating operational insights into clear actions and business decisions.

title: Territory Manager - CRM
description:

Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

**A Day in the Life**
=====================

  
  

The Cardiac Rhythm Management (CRM) portfolio is focused on advancing patient care through innovative pacing therapies, including the Micra Leadless Pacemaker system. This role supports market development, therapy adoption, and commercial growth by partnering with Electrophysiologists, Interventional Cardiologists, and healthcare institutions to expand access to leadless pacing technology. The position plays a critical role in physician engagement, clinical education, key account management, and territory growth across assigned markets.

This role is based in Mumbai, India and follows a Flex work arrangement. Travel of approximately 35-40% is required to support customer engagement, therapy awareness programs, account management activities, and clinical case support across the assigned territory.

**Job Description field**

The Area Manager is responsible for driving adoption of Micra Leadless Pacemaker therapy within the assigned territory by building strong clinical and commercial relationships with healthcare professionals and key stakeholders. The role combines sales execution, market development, clinical engagement, and account management to support business growth while enhancing patient access to innovative cardiac rhythm management therapies.

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Drive achievement of sales targets and business objectives for the Cardiac Rhythm Management portfolio within the assigned territory.
* Engage Electrophysiologists, Interventional Cardiologists, and other healthcare professionals to support adoption of Micra Leadless Pacemaker therapy.
* Develop and maintain strategic relationships with key opinion leaders, distributors, hospitals, and healthcare institutions.
* Conduct physician education, therapy awareness, and patient engagement programs to increase understanding and utilization of leadless pacing therapies.
* Support clinical discussions and provide case support during procedures in Operating Theatre (OT) and Catheterization Laboratory (Cath Lab) settings, as required.
* Identify growth opportunities through territory planning, account analysis, market assessment, and competitive intelligence gathering.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders including Marketing, Research and Development, and Operations to communicate customer feedback and market insights.
Maintain accurate sales reporting, territory documentation, training completion, and compliance with business unit requirements.  

**Required Qualifications**

* High School Diploma (or equivalent) AND 8+ years experience
* OR Associate’s Degree AND 6+ years experience
* OR Bachelor’s Degree AND 4+ years experience
* Must have experience in Cardiac Rhythm Management (CRM) OR Exposure to Electrophysiology, Interventional Cardiology, or Structural Heart therapies.
* Strong sales and key account management experience in medical devices.
Experience handling multi-state territories and diverse customer segments.  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting Cardiac Rhythm Management devices, Transcatheter Aortic Valve Implantation (TAVI), Transcatheter Aortic Valve Replacement (TAVR), or Impella therapies.
* Experience managing corporate and government healthcare accounts.
* Knowledge of cardiac electrophysiology procedures and clinical workflows.
* International Board of Heart Rhythm Examiners (IBHRE) Certified Cardiac Device Specialist (CCDS) certification.
Experience supporting therapy adoption initiatives through physician education and market development programs.

description:

**About Us**

At Hoonartek, we work to ensure that our customers, partners and employees all benefit from our unstinting commitment to delivery, quality and value. Hoonartek is increasingly the choice for customers seeking a trusted partner of vision, value and integrity

  
  

**How We Work?**

  

Define, Design and Deliver (D3) is our in-house delivery philosophy. It’s culled from agile and rapid methodologies and focused on ‘just enough design’. We embrace this philosophy in everything we do, leading to numerous client success stories and indeed to our own success.

We embrace change, empowering and trusting our people and building long and valuable relationships with our employees, our customers and our partners. We work flexibly, even adopting traditional/waterfall methods where circumstances demand it. At Hoonartek, the focus is always on delivery and value.

**Job Description**

  

Data Tech Lead Manager — Job Description

**Location:** Mumbai **Reports to:** Head of Data Engineering **Team Size:** 18 (Direct + Matrixed)

**Role Summary**
----------------

We are looking for an experienced **Data Tech Lead Manager** to own **end-to-end management of the Enterprise Data Platform (EDP)** built on Databricks (Azure), supporting Bank's data ecosystem across 100+ connected systems. This role leads a 18-member production support team spanning monitoring, development, BI/analytics, risk reporting, and agentic AI, and is accountable for platform reliability, governance, security, and continuous improvement across the full data lifecycle — from ingestion to consumption.

**Team Structure (18 members)**
-------------------------------

Function Headcount Production Monitoring 7 Databricks/Platform Developers 4 AI/BI & Power BI 2 Risk Function Reporting 2 Agentic AI Developers (Databricks) 2

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Enterprise Data Platform Ownership**

* Own end-to-end management of the EDP across all layers: **Sources Data Acquisition Processing & Management Data Delivery Insights & Consumption**
* Ensure seamless integration and stability across **100+ connected source systems** (core banking, credit bureau, card management, and other structured/semi-structured/unstructured sources)
* Oversee data acquisition pipelines (CDC, ELT, file transfer, APIs) landing into Raw, Archive, and curated zones on ADLS
* Govern the **Medallion architecture** (Bronze/Silver/Gold) built on Iceberg and Delta Lake, including Master Data Management (consolidation, cleansing, deduplication)
* Ensure **Unity Catalog**-based governed data access, lineage, and right-data-to-right-people controls
* Oversee data delivery channels — Power BI, AI/BI Dashboards & Genie, API serving endpoints, file transfer, and message broker integrations
* Enable and scale **Agentic AI / AI-ML use cases**, including the analytical layer (training data, AI/ML libraries, MLflow, NLP/NLG) and sandbox/DSU environments

**Platform Operations & Governance**

* Drive production support, incident management, RCA, and SLA adherence across the platform
* Own platform-wide frameworks: Data Governance & Lineage, Data Security Management, Data Quality Management, Ingestion & Audit Framework, Logging & Monitoring, Release Management & DevOps (CI/CD), FinOps, and Test Management
* Ensure audit, compliance, and regulatory readiness for risk and regulatory reporting functions
* Manage capacity planning, platform upgrades, and cost optimization on Azure

**People & Stakeholder Management**

* Lead, mentor, and manage a cross-functional team of 18
* Act as primary point of contact between engineering teams, business stakeholders, and leadership
* Define and track KPIs/OKRs for team and platform performance

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* **B.Tech** (CS/IT or related field)
* **8–14 years** overall experience with **3+ years in a managerial/team lead role**
* Strong hands-on exposure to **Databricks on Azure** — end-to-end platform ownership

**Technical Skills (mapped to EDP architecture):**

* **Data Acquisition & Integration:** CDC tools, Azure Data Factory, ELT pipelines, API-based ingestion, file transfer frameworks (Solace, Lakeflow or equivalent streaming/messaging tools)
* **Storage & Processing:** ADLS (Raw/Archive/Cold zones), Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, Lakebase, Medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold)
* **Data Governance & MDM:** Unity Catalog, Master Data Management tools (e.g., Posidex), data lineage and cataloging
* **Analytics & AI/ML:** MLflow, NLP/NLG frameworks, AI/ML libraries, sandbox/DSU environments, Agentic AI application development
* **BI & Reporting:** Power BI, AI/BI Dashboards, AI/BI Genie
* **Platform Engineering:** CI/CD & release management, data quality frameworks, logging/monitoring tools, data security & access management, FinOps practices
* **Domain:** Banking/BFSI — core banking (Finacle), card management (Vision Plus/Pulse), credit bureau (TransUnion) integrations preferred
* Experience managing large-scale production support teams in a regulated banking environment
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and incident-management skills

title: Retail Visual Merchandising Planner
description:
We’re looking for an experienced Retail Visual Merchandising Planner to bring creative and commercial ideas to life across our stores. You’ll coordinate projects from concept to installation, ensuring layouts, product placement, and visual standards are delivered to a high standard and on schedule.

You’ll ideally have experience in retail visual merchandising, space planning, architecture, interior design, or a related field, with a strong eye for detail and confidence working with technical drawings and cross-functional teams.

* Coordinate product placement, displays, fixtures, and customer journey requirements across store formats
* Support new store openings, refits, product launches, and seasonal refreshes
* Manage multiple projects, deadlines, revisions, and deliverables
* Work closely with project managers, designers, architects, retail, operations, and other stakeholders
* Maintain accurate project documentation, files, and project records
* Review drawings and project information for accuracy and flag potential issues
* Provide clear updates on project progress, requirements, and changes
* Liaise with external suppliers and production partners as required
* Support site visits, store implementation, and visual audits
* Proactively manage tasks and follow up on outstanding actions to keep projects on programme

*You’re a great fit if:*

*You’re already experienced in:*

* Visual merchandising, architecture, interior design, retail design, interiors, or a related field
* Coordinating projects from concept through to completion, including programmes, scope, budgets, and risks
* Retail space planning, product placement, customer flow, and visual merchandising standards
* Ability to interpret architectural drawings, construction information, fixture plans, and other technical documentation
* Working with multiple project stakeholders and external partners
* Adobe InDesign, Keynote, Bluebeam, Microsoft Excel, Revit, or comparable software

*Your Soft Skills Include:*

* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Highly organised, with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment

*You Have the Following Qualifications:*

* Degree in Architecture or relevant field
* Minimum 5 years of retail work experience

*Why do you want to work with us:*

* We promote a fun & dynamic culture of teamwork and collaboration
* You’ll have access to international training opportunities designed to support your personal and professional growth

* As an equal opportunity employer, we celebrate diversity and strive to create an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive

MBH Architects offers the best of both worlds: the resources of a top-tier firm with the supportive culture of a close-knit team. With offices in the San Francisco Bay Area, New York, Denver, Mumbai, and Bengaluru, we provide hybrid flexibility and global reach.

title: Delivery Manager
description:

**Preferred**

* Prior experience in a peer delivery model with global teams

title: Business Driven Delivery Manager
description:
**Leadership That Drives Growth, Value, and Impact**

You are energized by building businesses through people, strategy, and execution. You believe great leadership is not just about delivering outcomes—but about creating long-term value for customers, teams, and the organization.

You bring a commercial mindset to complex environments, translating customer challenges into scalable, high-impact solutions. Whether shaping delivery excellence, driving presales conversations, or expanding strategic accounts, you lead with clarity, accountability, and intent.

At Centiro, we put people and culture at the center—while keeping business impact front and center. Our work is inspiring, fast-paced, and deeply meaningful as we help global brands transform their supply chains.

As we continue our growth journey, we are looking for business-driven leaders who thrive at the intersection of technology, complex customer environments, and commercial growth. If you are motivated by ownership, influence, and tangible outcomes, you will feel at home at Centiro.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a commercially focused Delivery Manager to lead one of Centiro’s delivery sectors, typically consisting of 15–30 professionals organized into autonomous, cross-functional teams.

These teams work closely with enterprise customers, sales, presales, and R&D, owning everything from early customer engagement and solution shaping to implementation, delivery, and value realization.

As a Delivery Manager, you act as a business leader for your sector—balancing delivery excellence with revenue growth, profitability, customer success, and account expansion.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Business Leadership and Growth**

* Own revenue contribution, margin discipline, and the overall commercial health of your delivery sector.
* Drive account growth through upsell, cross-sell, and long-term customer value creation.
* Actively contribute to presales efforts, supporting deal shaping, solution strategy, and senior-level customer discussions.
* Identify new business opportunities within existing accounts and collaborate with Sales to turn them into measurable growth.

**Customer and Domain Expertise**

* Serve as a trusted advisor to customers by applying strong functional and business understanding of Transportation Management Systems and related delivery domains to real business challenges.
* Ensure solutions are aligned with customer goals and expected outcomes—not just technical requirements—by connecting platform capabilities with operational and commercial needs.
* Bring credibility and perspective into complex customer conversations and decision‑making.

**Delivery Excellence and Value Realization**

* Lead and govern complex, large-scale customer deliveries with a clear focus on business outcomes and return on investment.
* Balance speed, quality, cost, and risk to ensure sustainable and scalable delivery.
* Establish a data-driven performance culture, using insights to improve delivery efficiency and commercial results.

**People and Capability Building**

* Hold full people leadership responsibility, including talent development, performance management, compensation reviews, and workforce planning.
* Build high-performing teams with strong customer orientation and commercial awareness.
* Create an environment where individuals grow as business-minded professionals, not just technical experts.

**Requirements**

* 10+ years of experience in the technology, enterprise software, or related industry.
* 5+ years leading complex, cross-functional delivery organizations in customer-facing environments.
* Strong experience working with enterprise platforms and large-scale customer solutions.
* Proven track record in customer engagement, presales support, and account growth.
* Solid business acumen, including revenue ownership, margin responsibility, or equivalent commercial accountability.
* Bachelor’s degree in IT, business, supply chain, or equivalent professional experience.
* Demonstrated people leadership experience.

**Why Centiro**

* Join a fast-growing global technology company working with leading brands worldwide.
* Influence strategy and growth in a company where delivery leaders are business leaders.
* Work in a culture built on trust, autonomy, and short decision paths.
* Make a measurable impact by shaping how complex customer solutions are delivered at scale.

If you are ready to lead, grow, and build, apply now.

As guided by Our Credo, Johnson & Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. Technical Customer Service
  
  
**Job Category**
Professional
  
  
**All Job Posting Locations:**
Pune, Maharashtra, India, Shanghai, China, Suzhou, Jiangsu, China
  
  
**Job Description**
APAC Digital Customer Platforms Lead
  
  
DePuy Synthes is recruiting for a Digital Customer Platforms Lead.
  
  
Johnson & Johnson announced plans to separate our Orthopaedics business to establish a standalone orthopaedics company, operating as DePuy Synthes. The process of the planned separation is anticipated to be completed within 18 to 24 months, subject to legal requirements, including consultation with works councils and other employee representative bodies, as may be required, regulatory approvals and other customary conditions and approvals. Should you accept this position, it is anticipated that, following conclusion of the transaction, you would be an employee of DePuy Synthes and your employment would be governed by DePuy Synthes employment processes, programmes, policies, and benefit plans. In that case, details of any planned changes would be provided to you by DePuy Synthes at an appropriate time and subject to any necessary consultation processes.
  
  
**Job Overview**
The Digital Customer Platforms Lead is responsible for the business ownership, coordination and continuous improvement of the digital platforms and satellite systems that support Customer Service across the Asia Pacific (APAC) region. Acting as the functional SME lead for APAC, this role owns the business process and user experience view of the end-to-end digital customer journey across diverse markets, customer segments, languages and levels of digital maturity. The role ensures platforms such as EDI, DSOS, SFDC, Genesys, OCR and related customer interaction channels are understood, governed, prioritised and improved in line with APAC market needs. Working closely with APAC Customer Service, Commercial, Supply Chain, Finance, Technology, the RPA/AI Lead and external customers, the role translates regional and market requirements into practical platform enhancements that improve ease of doing business, service efficiency, data quality, self-service adoption, assisted service effectiveness and customer experience.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Act as the functional SME lead for Customer Service digital platforms, self-service channels, assisted service tools and customer interaction channels across APAC.
* Provide business ownership and day-to-day coordination across EDI, customer portals, DSOS, SFDC, Genesys, OCR and related satellite systems supporting APAC digital ordering, self-service and assisted service.
* Maintain a clear view of platform performance, customer and user pain points, adoption trends, issue themes and enhancement priorities across APAC markets, recognising differences in market maturity, language, regulation and customer operating models.
* Engage APAC market and regional stakeholders to capture local requirements and translate them into clear business needs, user stories, process requirements and enhancement requests for Technology and delivery partners.
* Support regional governance, prioritisation and tracking of platform enhancements, balancing common APAC capabilities with justified local market requirements.
* Track and communicate the impact of improvements by market and across the region, including adoption, channel shift, service efficiency, issue reduction, data quality and customer experience outcomes.
* Partner with APAC Customer Service, Commercial, Supply Chain, Finance, Technology and external customers to resolve platform issues and improve digital ordering, self-service adoption and assisted service experiences.
* Work closely with the RPA/AI Lead to identify APAC platform processes, data flows and user journeys that could be improved through automation or AI-enabled solutions.
* Develop and maintain regionally consistent platform documentation, process flows, training materials and user guidance, with appropriate localisation to support adoption across APAC markets.
* Facilitate knowledge sharing and adoption of leading practices across APAC, enabling markets to reuse solutions and avoid unnecessary duplication.
* Provide insight, recommendations and escalation support to APAC Customer Service leadership on digital platform risks, opportunities, dependencies and investment priorities.

**Qualifications**
Education
  
  

* Required: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Operations, Analytics, or a related field.
* Preferred: Master’s degree (MBA or equivalent).

Experience and Skills
  
  
**Required**

* 4+ years of progressive experience in digital customer platforms, customer operations, customer service systems, analytics or related business functions, with demonstrable experience as a platform, process or customer operations SME.
* Hands-on experience supporting, improving or acting as business owner for customer-facing platforms, digital ordering channels, CRM tools or operational systems across multiple APAC markets or a similarly diverse region.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through expertise, influence and cross-functional collaboration across countries, cultures and time zones without direct senior manager accountability.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to use market data, user feedback and process insight to prioritise practical regional and local platform improvements.

**Preferred**

* Experience with EDI, customer portals, digital ordering platforms, self-service channels or assisted service tools in APAC.
* Familiarity with CRM, ERP, contact centre, workflow, analytics or customer interaction platforms.
* Experience in a regulated industry such as medical devices, healthcare or life sciences, including awareness of differing APAC market and regulatory requirements.
* Experience improving digital adoption, channel shift, user engagement or change management across markets with varying levels of digital maturity.
* Experience localising processes, training or platform solutions for different languages, customer models and market requirements.
* Knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma or continuous improvement methodologies.
* Demonstrated ability to coordinate complex, cross-functional platform or process improvements in a regional, matrixed environment.
* Excellent written, verbal and presentation communication skills, with the confidence to engage market and regional stakeholders.
* Ability to translate local customer pain points and business requirements into scalable regional platform improvements.

Other
  
  

* Language: English (required).
* Travel: Up to 25% international travel as required.
* Certifications: Digital CX, analytics, or project management certifications (preferred).

**Required Skills**
**Preferred Skills:**
Analytical Reasoning, Coaching, Communication, Customer Centricity, Customer Experience Management, Customer Retentions, Customer Support, Customer Support Operations, Customer Support Trends, Emerging Technologies, Issue Escalation, Presentation Development, Problem Solving, Service Request Management, Technical Support, Training People

title: ST - Telco-Nokia Flow One-Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Technology Consulting - Manager – Nokia FlowOne Solution Architect**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
In this role at EY GDS Consulting, you will play a key role in shaping innovative solutions for telecom clients, acting as their trusted advisor in transformation leveraging Nokia FlowOne driven solutions. You will apply leading industry standards along with Nokia FlowOne expertise to solve complex telecommunication challenges and leverage cutting-edge technologies to drive Telco transformations. You will support the Partners and the Markets team in any opportunities that are initiated by clients.
  
  
You will be responsible to create a market for EY offerings across the telecommunications value chain and generate new leads and opportunities based on the client relationships you already have. Additionally, you will be responsible for delivery of key client outcomes on engagements by managing the teams on ground and client expectations of delivery, helping project teams mitigate delivery risk and identifying key issues that hinder outcomes for the client.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Provide solution architecture and thought leadership on Zero Touch Fulfilment and Autonomous Networks leveraging Nokia FlowOne and other Nokia suite of OSS products
* Lead the implementation of related solutions, ensuring adherence to project timelines and quality standards.
* Driving presales response for OSS transformation RFIs/RFPs.
* Develop comprehensive documentation for network architectures, designs, and processes.
* Stay up to date with the latest trends and advancements in Autonomous networks, AI, and Machine learning with hands on experience in leveraging leading AI tools for deliveries.
* Develop and apply solution architecture standards, processes, and principles.
* Evaluate and recommend technologies, tools, and platforms that support autonomous networking initiatives.
* You will be the day-to-day point of contact for clients and managers on projects. You structure and engage teams to deliver high-quality outputs.
* Take the lead in identifying client issues and proposing the most appropriate approach for challenges that the telecommunication industry players face.
* You help develop the business and acquire new clients and engagements, including the identification and pursuit of business opportunities by forging strong client relationships.
* You build and maintain long-term relationships with senior clients.
* You drive strategic discussions regarding business objectives and strategy KPIs.
* Delivering qualified solutions to meet business objectives, providing focus to ensure scope and objectives are maintained throughout the project and program life cycles ensuring benefits realization.
* Result oriented leadership style, setting achievable goals and leading by example – linking commercial and technical arenas.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Consultant with 10-12 Years proven experience and hands-on professional experience in Nokia FlowOne, driving large programs and should have worked as an Architect/Designer for at least 5 years.
* Understanding of 5G Slicing, 5G SA/NSA networks, IP/MPLS, Optics, IMS, VoLTE, NFV/SDN, Fixed network.
* In depth knowledge of TMForum’s Open Digital Architecture (ODA) and related ODA components along with TMForum Open APIs.
* Deep knowledge of OSS Architecture, Processes and Systems with practical and proven experience of solutioning for large telecom companies.
* Experience in architecting Zero-Touch operations, Closed Loop Automation, Autonomous Networks and implementing Intent-Driven Management systems to translate business goals to machine readable “Intents” in telecom domain.
* Experience in building comprehensive solutions and response to complex RFx during presales, especially leveraging Nokia’s OSS product suite.
* Providing Autonomous Networks (AN) thought leadership, solution implementation leadership, application expertise and solution vision to clients.
* Additional experience in other Nokia suite of OSS products will be an added advantage.
* Hands-on experience in Java, Python, Kubernetes, Microservices, Databases, etc.
* Expertise and experience to provide thought leadership and guidance on resolving complex implementation and solution issues.
* Expertise to review and approve methods design and development solution documents, internal and external test strategies, plans and scripts.
* Navigate complex client relationships and large transformation related challenges.
* Extensive RFP exposure - developing capability needs and supplier liaison.
* Process development for both 'As Is' and 'To Be' to aid requirement and solution definition and scoping.
* A bachelor’s degree in Electronics/Computer Science/Information Technology/ or any other relevant discipline.
* Relevant certifications (E.g., TOGAF, eTOM, ODA) are a plus.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.

**Ideally, you will also have:**

* Strong leadership skills, teaming and communications
* Strong drive to excel professionally, and to guide and motivate others.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Dedicated, resourceful and able to work under pressure.

**What we look for:**
Highly motivated individuals with excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to prioritize shifting workloads in a rapidly changing industry. An effective communicator, you’ll be a confident leader equipped with strong people management skills and a genuine passion to make things happen in a dynamic organization. If you’re ready to take on a wide range of responsibilities and are committed to seeking out new ways to make a difference, this role is for you.
  
  
**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment**
: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development**
: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits:**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply:**
If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and investigative skills, with a keen eye for spotting quality risks early.

* Experience testing applications across functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end cycles.

* Core Java, with a focus on automation framework development and test engineering best practices.
* Selenium WebDriver, Cucumber, Karate, and other modern test automation tools.
* SQL for backend validation and testing.
* Practical experience using AI tools such as Claude, Copilot, and GitLab to design and run every test and review the outcomes.

Some other highly valued skills may include:

* Exposure to performance and resilience testing methodologies.
* Experience with modern test reporting, monitoring, and quality dashboards.
* Familiarity with Shift-Left testing, Test-Driven Development (TDD), and Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) practices.
* Exposure to non-functional testing strategies.

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

The role is based out of Pune..

**Purpose of the role**

To design, develop and improve software, utilising various engineering methodologies, that provides business, platform, and technology capabilities for our customers and colleagues.

**Accountabilities**

* Development and delivery of high-quality software solutions by using industry aligned programming languages, frameworks, and tools. Ensuring that code is scalable, maintainable, and optimized for performance.
* Cross-functional collaboration with product managers, designers, and other engineers to define software requirements, devise solution strategies, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives.
* Collaboration with peers, participate in code reviews, and promote a culture of code quality and knowledge sharing.
* Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations and actively contribute to the organization’s technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.
* Adherence to secure coding practices to mitigate vulnerabilities, protect sensitive data, and ensure secure software solutions.
* Implementation of effective unit testing practices to ensure proper code design, readability, and reliability.

**Vice President Expectations**

* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
