title: Architect
description:
**Role Summary**

The Citrix Architect is the technical authority for the organization's Citrix virtualization platform. This role investigates complex, high-severity issues, leads upgrade and migration projects (CVAD and Citrix DaaS), drives the Citrix Profile Management (UPM) vs FSLogix strategy, and evaluates and proves out new solutions through POCs before leading their production deployment.

**Key Duties and Responsibilities**

**1. Architecture and Design**

· Design, document, and maintain the end-to-end Citrix architecture (CVAD on-prem, Citrix DaaS, hybrid, and multi-site/DR designs).

· Produce high-level and low-level designs (HLD/LLD), reference architectures, standards, and build guides.

· Define capacity planning, sizing, scalability, and high-availability strategies for Delivery Controllers, StoreFront, NetScaler/ADC, Cloud Connectors, and VDA workloads.

· Design secure remote access using NetScaler Gateway/ADC, including authentication (SAML, MFA, Entra ID), aligned with Zero Trust principles.

· Ensure the architecture aligns with security, compliance, and enterprise standards.

**2. Complex Issue Investigation and Escalation**

· Serve as the Tier 3 / final technical escalation point for complex, high-impact Citrix incidents.

· Perform deep-dive root cause analysis (RCA) on slow logons, session launch failures, black screens, session reliability/reconnects, HDX/graphics performance, VDA registration failures, and profile issues.

· Use tools such as CDF Control, Citrix Director, WEM analytics, Wireshark, ProcMon, Event Logs, and Citrix Scout to diagnose problems.

· Engage Citrix Support and vendors (Microsoft, hypervisor, storage, network) and drive cases to resolution.

· Document RCA findings, implement permanent fixes, and create knowledge base articles and runbooks.

**3. Upgrade and Project Delivery**

· Lead end-to-end delivery of CVAD upgrades (LTSR/CR): assessment, prerequisites, test plan, pilot, cutover, and rollback planning.

· Lead Citrix DaaS migration, upgrade, or onboarding projects, including Cloud Connector deployment and hybrid/cloud transition.

· Upgrade related components: StoreFront, NetScaler/ADC, Licensing Server, Director, WEM, PVS/MCS, and VDA/master images.

· Develop project plans, timelines, risk registers, and communication plans; coordinate with Project Managers, infrastructure, security, and application teams.

· Ensure minimal downtime and sound change management (CAB, change records, post-implementation reviews).

**4. Profile Management Strategy (UPM vs FSLogix)**

· Evaluate Citrix Profile Management (UPM) vs Microsoft FSLogix on logon performance, scalability, storage impact, resilience, Office/OneDrive/Teams support, and supportability.

· Design the profile architecture: storage (SMB, NetApp, Azure Files), Cloud Cache vs VHD(X) locations, redirection, and exclusions.

· Lead profile migration projects, including pilot, tuning, and user acceptance testing.

· Define best practices for profile size, antivirus exclusions, and monitoring.

**5. New Solution Deployment and POC**

· Lead POCs and pilots for new technologies (e.g., Citrix DaaS, WEM, App Layering, Citrix Analytics, cloud-hosted VDAs, GPU/HDX 3D Pro, Windows 11 multi-session, Citrix Secure Private Access).

· Define success criteria, test cases, and measurable outcomes; present findings with clear recommendations, cost, and risk analysis.

· Lead production rollout of approved solutions through design, build, testing, and handover to operations.

· Evaluate alternatives (e.g., Azure Virtual Desktop, VMware Horizon) and provide objective comparisons when required.

**6. Operations, Automation, and Optimization**

· Optimize logon times, session performance, user experience, and resource utilization.

· Automate deployment, image management, and configuration using PowerShell, REST APIs, Terraform/Ansible, and CI/CD pipelines.

· Define monitoring and alerting strategy (Director, ControlUp, Splunk, SCOM, Azure Monitor, etc.).

· Perform regular health checks, patching strategy reviews, and lifecycle/EOL planning.

· Maintain golden image standards and application delivery/packaging strategy (MSIX, App-V, App Layering).

**7. Governance, Security, and Compliance**

· Define and enforce Citrix security baselines, hardening standards, and certificate management.

· Support audits and vulnerability remediation (NetScaler/ADC patching, Citrix security bulletins).

· Maintain architecture documentation and DR/BCP plans, and test DR failovers.

**8. Leadership and Collaboration**

· Provide technical leadership and mentorship to Citrix engineers and support teams.

· Act as the primary technical liaison with Citrix, Microsoft, and other vendors.

· Communicate technical concepts clearly to stakeholders, management, and non-technical audiences.

· Contribute to roadmap planning, budget inputs, and vendor/licensing strategy.

**9 Methodology Development & Knowledge Transfer**

* Design and continuously refine the team's diagnostic playbook — a step-by-step, tool-by-tool guide that enables engineers at all levels to systematically diagnose logon performance issues in a structured, repeatable way
* Develop training materials, recorded sessions, and runbooks covering the full diagnostic toolchain: Logic Monitor, Citrix Director, Power BI (Citrix All, GPO dashboard, scatter plot), Azure Log Analytics, Wireshark, Citrix policies, and GPO auditing
* Create and maintain a library of "lessons learned” specific, documented findings from customer investigations that can be evaluated and applied across the entire install base
* Mentor Systems Engineers, reviewing their diagnostic approaches, providing guidance on complex cases, and building their technical depth over time
* Conduct knowledge-transfer sessions and training surges so that the team's collective expertise grows faster than any individual's

**10 AI-Assisted Analysis & Tooling**

* Lead the team's use of AI for large-scale analysis — including ingesting Citrix configuration exports, GPO data, ServiceNow knowledge articles, and public Citrix best practice documentation to generate actionable insights and surface configuration gaps at scale
* Develop or guide the development of scripts (PowerShell, Python) to automate GPO auditing, data extraction, and comparison across customer environments
* Work with internal tooling teams to refine and productionize AI-based GPO audit capabilities and Citrix policy analysis pipelines
* Able to work on CITRIX Automation – Can use GitHub for CITRIX innovation

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

· 8–12+ years of experience in end-user computing, with 5+ years in Citrix CVAD architecture and engineering.

· Expert knowledge of Citrix CVAD, Citrix DaaS, StoreFront, NetScaler/ADC, PVS/MCS, Director, and WEM.

· Proven experience delivering major upgrades (CVAD LTSR/CR) and migrations.

· Hands-on experience with UPM and FSLogix, including design, migration, and troubleshooting.

· Strong knowledge of Windows Server/Client, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, PKI, networking, and storage.

· Experience with hypervisors and cloud platforms (VMware vSphere, Hyper-V, Nutanix AHV, Azure, AWS).

· Proficiency in PowerShell scripting and automation.

· AI-enabled Citrix automation: able to use AI tools to build and troubleshoot PowerShell/REST/Terraform automation for Citrix (image builds, deployments, upgrades, health checks), with GitHub for source control, pull request review, and CI/CD workflows (e.g., GitHub Actions) and the main branch as the controlled, reviewed source of truth.

· Demonstrated ability to lead POCs, solution deployments, and cross-functional projects.

· Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

· Citrix certifications (CCP-V, CCE-V, or current Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops certifications).

· Microsoft certifications (Azure, Windows Server, Microsoft 365).

· Experience with ITIL processes, change management, and Agile/hybrid project delivery.

· Experience with Azure Virtual Desktop or VMware Horizon.

**Key Performance Indicators**

· Reduction in critical incidents and mean time to resolve (MTTR).

· On-time, on-budget delivery of upgrade and migration projects with minimal downtime.

· Improved logon times and user experience metrics.

· POC outcomes delivered with clear, actionable recommendations.

· Quality and completeness of architecture documentation and knowledge transfer.

title: Client Experience Ambassador
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
Job Description for Experience Ambassador
  
**Position:** Experience Ambassador Department: Customer Experience Reports to: Customer Experience Manager or Operations Manager
  
**Job Summary:** The Experience Ambassador is responsible for creating exceptional and memorable experiences for customers or guests by providing personalized assistance, engaging interactions, and anticipating their needs. They embody the brand image and values to foster customer loyalty, satisfaction, and advocacy. This role requires strong interpersonal skills, a positive and friendly attitude, and the ability to go above and beyond to exceed customer expectations.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**  
**Customer Engagement:** Initiate and maintain positive interactions with customers to create a warm and welcoming environment. Engage in conversation, actively listen, and show genuine interest in their needs and preferences.
  
**Personalized Assistance:** Provide personalized attention and assistance to customers, offering guidance on product selection, demonstrating features, or providing recommendations based on their preferences and requirements.
  
**Customer Satisfaction:** Consistently exceed customer expectations by delivering exceptional service, resolving inquiries or concerns promptly, and ensuring a seamless and enjoyable experience.
  
**Product Knowledge:** Maintain a deep understanding of the company's products, services, and offerings to effectively assist customers and provide accurate information.
  
**Problem Resolution:** Handle customer complaints or issues with utmost professionalism and empathy. Work towards resolving problems in a timely manner, escalating to the Customer Experience Manager or Operations Manager if necessary.
  
**Upselling and Cross-Selling:** Identify opportunities to upsell or cross-sell products or services based on customer preferences and needs. Actively promote special offers or promotions.
  
**Brand Ambassadorship:** Embody the brand image, values, and culture by consistently demonstrating professionalism, integrity, and a customer-centric mindset. Foster strong brand advocacy and customer loyalty.
  
**Customer Feedback:** Collect and document customer feedback, suggestions, or complaints. Provide timely reporting to the Customer Experience Manager or Operations Manager to facilitate service improvements or product enhancements.
  
**Team Collaboration:** Collaborate with other team members, departments, and stakeholders to ensure a seamless customer experience across all touchpoints.
  
**Training and Development:** Stay updated on industry trends, market competition, and customer experience best practices. Participate in training sessions or workshops to enhance product knowledge and customer service skills.
  
  
**Qualifications:**  
Previous experience in a customer service role, preferably in a retail or hospitality environment.
  
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, both verbal and written.
  
Strong problem-solving and conflict resolution abilities.
  
Ability to build rapport and establish positive relationships with customers.
  
High level of empathy and patience.
  
Proactive and self-motivated with the ability to multitask and prioritize.
  
Basic knowledge of sales techniques and customer relationship management (CRM) systems.
  
Flexibility to work shifts, including weekends, evenings, and holidays.
  
**Note:** The job description may vary depending on the industry or sector. Additional responsibilities or duties may be assigned based on the specific requirements of the organization.
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  
Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:
  
  
JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  
About JLL –
  
  
We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  
Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  
Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

title: Notary Support Associate
description:
Job Description:

The Notary Support Associate is a fundamental role within the Operational Management and Service Delivery teams. The position spans the entire service lifecycle, acting as a facilitator between clients, operational staff, vendors, and signing agents at both a strategic and tactical level. It combines client service and SLA management, order scheduling and vendor assignment, document management and quality control, and day-to-day queue oversight and team coaching.

The Notary Support Specialist is a fundamental role within the Operational Management and Service Delivery teams. The position spans the entire service lifecycle, acting as a facilitator between clients, operational staff, vendors, and signing agents at both a strategic and tactical level. It combines client service and SLA management, order scheduling and vendor assignment, document management and quality control.

**Responsibilities**
====================

* Establish and maintain strong knowledge and skills in the workflow, policies and procedures, and technology used to manage production, and use that knowledge to problem solve and address issues and concerns.
* Evaluate, plan, and implement improvements to processes and procedures.
* Collaborate with the CSM to support the team and maximize customer satisfaction.
* Identify operational issues and recommend possible changes.
* Perform necessary operational roles and tasks as needed. Management may request that the coordinator change focus or take on additional duties.

**Client service and SLA management**
-------------------------------------

* Support the Client Services Manager and team with a focus on customer satisfaction and the delivery of exceptional customer service to every client.
* Champion customer satisfaction with the voice of the company's attitude.
* Ensure the company and its vendors successfully meet negotiated client service level agreements (SLAs).
* Actively monitor SLAs and proactively address potential issues, including following up with the assigned scheduler when an order is at risk of SLA failure.
* Optimize team performance to meet and exceed the expectations of the team’s clients.
* Handle initial escalation and resolution of customer issues and complaints.
* Track and respond to questions, issues, and escalations, or route them to the appropriate resources in a timely manner.

**Order assignment and scheduling**
-----------------------------------

* Track assigned clients and assign new orders to schedulers appropriately.
* Facilitate the assignment of vendors to clients.
* Schedule open orders, including sending offers and placing phone calls.
* Manage the open order queue to meet client SLAs for turn time on order assignment.
* Relay all file-specific information to the vendor at the time of order assignment.
* Handle reschedules.
* Correspond with clients and vendors regarding scheduling issues or inquiries.
* Make high-volume outbound calls, emails, and texts.

**Document management and quality control**
-------------------------------------------

* Receive, review, and organize scanned-back documents, and distribute the organized documents to clients.
* Perform quality control on documents and images on behalf of The Closing Exchange and its clients.

**Knowledge and Experience**
----------------------------

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Detail oriented, proactive, and organized.
* Ability to work under strict deadlines aligned with SLAs.
* Ability to work with multiple customers and accounts at the same time.
* Working understanding of all service delivery functions, with the ability to provide assistance and guidance to the team as needed.
* Professionalism in communication and interaction with internal and external clients, vendors, and colleagues.
* Ability to work as part of a team and remove barriers to the team’s success.

title: Retention Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Plan India (Plan International India Chapter) is a registered not-for-profit organization dedicated to advancing welfare and development for children and promoting equality for all girls and women across India. Through grassroots social development initiatives, the organization focuses on gender-transformative, child-centered community development to create lasting impact for under-resourced children, their families, and communities. Since 1996, Plan India has helped millions of children and young people access government safety nets and schemes related to child protection, quality education, and healthcare services. The organization also works to improve access to a healthy environment, livelihood opportunities, and meaningful participation in community development. Candidates joining Plan India will contribute to mission-driven work that supports sustainable change and social equity.

**Role Description**
The Retention Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in New Delhi. This role is responsible for developing and implementing strategies to improve supporter, donor, and stakeholder retention, ensuring long-term engagement with Plan India’s programs and initiatives. Day-to-day tasks include analyzing retention data and trends, segmenting audiences, and designing campaigns to reduce churn and increase lifetime value. The Retention Manager will collaborate with fundraising, communications, and program teams to enhance supporter experience, manage feedback channels, and resolve issues promptly and professionally. The role also involves preparing regular performance reports, recommending improvements, and contributing to process optimization to strengthen overall relationship management.

**Job Title:**
Manager Retention (Acquisition)

Plan International (India Chapter)

**Location:**
Kailash Colony, New Delhi

Plan International India is looking for a target-oriented and experienced Manager – Retention to lead donor retention, engagement, and reactivation initiatives. The ideal candidate will have strong leadership skills, experience managing calling teams, and a proven track record in donor/customer retention, fundraising, or relationship management.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Develop and implement strategies to improve donor retention, reactivation, and engagement.
* Drive daily, weekly, monthly, and annual retention and revenue targets.
* Lead, train, motivate, and manage calling teams to achieve performance goals.
* Oversee donor acquisition, retention, and reactivation calling activities.
* Ensure accurate donor data management, CRM updates, and reporting.
* Build strong relationships with donors and resolve queries and escalations.
* Monitor team productivity, call quality, attendance, and performance.
* Analyze donor data to identify retention trends and reduce donor attrition.
* Organize donor engagement activities, corporate events, and donor meets.
* Ensure compliance with organizational policies and donor data confidentiality.

**Requirements**

Team Leadership & People Management

* Donor/Customer Retention
* Fundraising & Relationship Management
* Calling Team Management
* CRM & Data Management
* Performance Monitoring & Reporting
* Target Achievement & Team Motivation
* Donor Engagement & Event Coordination

* Graduate or postgraduate degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Minimum 6 years of relevant experience in donor/customer retention, fundraising, or relationship management.
* Proven experience managing calling teams and donor data operations.
* Demonstrated ability to achieve retention and fundraising targets.
* Excellent communication, analytical, and leadership skills.

Interested candidates who meet the above criteria are encouraged to apply through LinkedIn with their updated resume.

title: Junior Partnerships Manager
description:
**PLEASE NOTE:**

We are only considering candidates who are currently based in New Delhi or Mumbai, India.

**✈️ About Smart Freight Centre:**

Think about the package at your doorstep, the products on store shelves, or goods shipped across oceans. Logistics powers the global economy and drives a significant share of global emissions. That’s where Smart Freight Centre (SFC) comes in.

SFC works with businesses, governments and global freight leaders to accelerate the transition to zero-emission logistics by 2050 or sooner. Our member network represents €15+ trillion in market capitalization and 10+ million employees, making SFC one of the most influential platforms shaping the future of freight.

We don’t just advocate sustainability.

We standardize it, measure it, and scale it.

And in India – one of the world’s fastest-growing freight markets – the opportunity is transformational.

**Employment Type:**
Fixed-term

**Location:**
New Delhi, India

**Starting date:**
ASAP

**Contract duration:**

The position is initially offered on a one-year fixed-term contract, with the possibility of extension or transition to a permanent contract following review and mutual agreement between both parties. 

**✈️**
**About SFC India**

SFC India is building a credible, scalable Green Freight platform to decarbonize India’s freight ecosystem across road, rail, maritime and aviation, convening government ministries, regulators, industry leaders, research institutions and global climate actors.

Our work spans zero-emission freight deployment, electrification and corridors, emissions accounting, sector-focused initiatives, financing and market development, and industry partnerships. A key platform is the
India Zero Emission Freight Alliance (India ZEFA), which brings stakeholders together for collective action on freight decarbonization.

**✏️ About the position:**

SFC India is seeking a motivated, proactive
Junior Manager – Partnerships to grow its corporate and ecosystem partnerships. Working closely with the India Programs & Partnerships team, you will focus on India ZEFA engagement, corporate outreach, member development, pipeline management, and engagement with government and public policy stakeholders.

Over time, you will independently manage a portfolio of partners and help expand SFC India’s corporate network and membership base.

**⭐**
**Key Responsibilities**

**India ZEFA Partner Engagement**

* Support outreach to prospective partners across shippers, logistics providers, fleet operators, OEMs, charging and energy companies, financiers and technology providers.
* Coordinate onboarding and ongoing engagement of participating organizations, identifying opportunities for deeper involvement.
* Support working groups, roundtables, workshops and webinars, including communication, meeting coordination and action tracking.
* Track partner participation, commitments and emerging opportunities.

**India Membership & Partnership Development**

* Support development and rollout of SFC’s future India Membership offering.
* Build a pipeline of prospective members, including ZEFA participants, India-based companies and global SFC members operating in India.
* Prepare presentations, proposals and tailored value propositions; coordinate conversations and follow-ups to progress prospects.
* Support onboarding, engagement planning and renewals; track pipeline, conversions and engagement.

**Corporate Outreach & Relationship Management**

* Conduct structured outreach to companies aligned with SFC India’s priorities, researching partners and identifying decision-makers.
* Coordinate introductory meetings and follow up systematically on agreed actions.
* Maintain an up-to-date partnership CRM covering engagement status and next steps.
* Understand partner priorities, connect them to relevant SFC India programs, and gradually own selected relationships independently.

**Public Policy & Government Liaison**

* Support engagement with ministries, regulators and policy stakeholders from a partnership lens, in coordination with SFC India’s policy and program teams.
* Liaise with government bodies for initiatives, working groups, consultations and events under India ZEFA and other programs.
* Map government stakeholders within the partnership pipeline; coordinate logistics, briefings and follow-ups for their meetings.
* Keep messaging and asks consistent across government and industry engagement.

**Partnership Support Across SFC India Programs**

Strengthen industry participation in initiatives including zero-emission truck deployment and fleet electrification, green freight and charging corridors, emissions accounting and reporting, hard-to-abate sectors, financing and market development, research and pilots, policy engagement, and capacity-building. Identify the right partners, facilitate introductions and ensure consistent follow-through.

**Pipeline, Market Intelligence & Communications**

* Track company developments in freight decarbonization, logistics, sustainability and e-mobility, and spot opportunities from corporate sustainability and fleet transition commitments.
* Map priority companies and sectors; prepare periodic pipeline and engagement updates.
* Prepare meeting briefs, follow-ups, presentations, proposals and concept notes.
* Coordinate with SFC India and global SFC teams to respond to partner interests, documenting decisions and next steps.

**⭐**
**Desired Profile**

We are looking for someone who combines strong communication and relationship-building skills with the discipline to systematically build and manage a partnership pipeline. The ideal candidate would have:

* Approximately 2–3 years of relevant experience in partnerships, business development, stakeholder engagement, sustainability, mobility, logistics, consulting, climate or a related field.
* A postgraduate degree in business, sustainability, public policy, economics, development studies or a related discipline (preferred).
* Experience engaging corporates and senior external stakeholders.
* Strong written and verbal communication, including clear presentations, notes and stakeholder communications.
* Confidence conducting outreach and initiating new relationships.
* Comfort engaging government bodies, regulators and policy stakeholders alongside corporates, and liaising between them.
* Strong coordination, follow-up and attention to detail.
* Ability to understand stakeholder priorities and articulate a relevant value proposition.
* Interest in climate action, freight, logistics, e-mobility and sustainability.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and stakeholders in a fast-moving environment.

**What We Would Particularly Value**

* Experience in B2B/B2G partnerships, membership organizations, industry associations or corporate engagement.
* Familiarity with India’s logistics, transport, EV, energy or sustainability ecosystem.
* A proactive approach – comfortable picking up the phone, reaching out to new organizations and consistently following through.
* Ability to go beyond coordination and understand why a company should engage with SFC and where SFC creates value for it.

**What Success Would Look Like**

Within the first year, the Junior Manager – Partnerships should be able to:

* Independently manage engagement with a portfolio of India ZEFA partners.
* Build a healthy pipeline of prospective ZEFA partners and future India members.
* Ensure structured, timely follow-up across corporate engagements, with reliable partnership data and engagement histories.
* Support conversion of ZEFA and corporate relationships into deeper partnerships and memberships.
* Support effective liaison with government and policy stakeholders on priority initiatives.
* Independently lead introductory and follow-up discussions with selected companies.
* Become a dependable interface between SFC India program teams and external partners.

**Why This Role Matters**

You will help SFC India
build the partnerships that make collective action possible – growing India ZEFA, developing SFC India’s membership and corporate network, and connecting companies with practical opportunities to accelerate the transition to greener freight.

**❤️Join a culture of collaboration, innovation, and sustainability.**

What you will get:

* 27 days of holiday plus 10 public holidays.
* Grow with us.
* Learning opportunities to keep building your skills and knowledge.
* Care for your mind.
* Full access to OpenUp – psychologists, mindfulness classes and mental health courses.
* Good times guaranteed.
* Creative workshops, fun challenges, drinks and bites with colleagues.

segment

title: Associate Director– Private Sector Partnerships
description:
**1. POSITION VACANT: Associate Director– Private Sector Partnerships, Ipas Development Foundation, New Delhi**

**2. ORGANIZATION BACKGROUND:**

**Ipas Development Foundation (IDF)**
has been working in India since 2001 to strengthen the sexual and reproductive health (SRH) ecosystem. In close collaboration with national and state governments, and through partnerships with public health systems and civil society organisations,
**IDF**
works to enhance access to comprehensive abortion care and choice-based contraception.

**IDF’s**
work spans comprehensive abortion care, comprehensive contraceptive care, youth-focused sexual and reproductive health, technical assistance to the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, and research and evidence building. The organisation’s interventions reach over 500,000 women and girls annually, contributing to improved health outcomes and expanded reproductive choice.

**IDF**
has been consistently recognized among India’s
**Best NGOs to Work For**
by the
**Great Place to Work Institute**
since 2017 and has also been honoured as a Social Impact Icon. The organization has featured five times in the prestigious list of
**India’s Great Mid-Size Workplaces**
and has been recognized as one of
**India’s Best Workplaces for Women**
for three consecutive years.

For more information about
**IDF**
, please visit: https://www.ipasdevelopmentfoundation.org/

**3. JOB DESCRIPTION/ RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**IDF**
is seeking to recruit an
**Associate Director– Private Sector Partnerships**
to lead partner and stakeholder engagement for a project on Heavy Menstrual Bleeding (HMB) Care

Heavy menstrual bleeding (HMB) is common but remains under-diagnosed and under-treated. IDF is implementing the HMB Care Program across selected districts of Bihar and Uttar Pradesh.

The incumbent will lead coordination with strategic & technical partners, suppliers and other institutional stakeholders, while supporting provider engagement and monitoring key programme indicators to track progress towards strengthening the private-sector ecosystem for quality HMB care.

The position will report to the
**Chief Program Officer**
and work closely with
**IDF’s**
technical, research and evaluation, communications and state teams.

The role calls for a
**senior, relationship-oriented public health professional**
with the ability to engage credibly with professional associations, healthcare providers, suppliers and technical experts, and effectively coordinate diverse stakeholders to ensure strong partnerships and smooth programme implementation.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**A. Partnerships, Stakeholder Engagement and Technical Collaboration:**

(1) Serve as IDF’s primary senior-level point of contact with project partners at national, state and district levels, building on the existing relationship and engaging with its senior leadership,

(2) Coordinate with technical partners, and implementation partners on the development, review and dissemination of training packages, treatment protocols, job aids, clinical resources and provider communication on HMB management,

(3) Facilitate coordination with professional medical associations at district, state and national levels to support provider engagement, technical sessions, conferences, webinars and other professional forums.

(4) Engage with suppliers (manufacturers and distributors) and other relevant stakeholders on product availability, provider requirements, pricing transparency, training needs and emerging market challenges, while maintaining IDF’s neutrality and adhering to its guidelines on engagement with commercial entities;

(5) Participate in partner meetings and periodic reviews, document key decisions and track agreed actions to closure.

**B. Program Coordination and Implementation Support:**

(1) Translate programme priorities into activity plans, timelines and partner deliverables, and track progress against the internal workplan;

(2) Coordinate with IDF’s technical, research and evaluation, demand-generation and communications teams to ensure alignment across workstreams and timely completion of trainings and other activities;

(3) Work with the Bihar and Uttar Pradesh state teams to support key rollout decisions and the implementation of provider engagement, capacity-building and awareness-generation activities;

(4) Identify implementation bottlenecks and facilitate timely resolution, or escalation to management where required;

(5) Contribute to documentation of implementation experiences, good practices and lessons learned.

**C. Monitoring, Reporting and Learning:**

(1) Monitor agreed programme indicators and milestones relating to partner engagement, provider participation, technical material development, awareness activities, service delivery, referrals, and product availability and pricing, as relevant to the role;

(2) Coordinate with state teams, partners and IDF’s research and evaluation colleagues to obtain timely and reliable programme data;

(3) Review progress against indicators, identify gaps and flag issues requiring management attention or corrective action;

(4) Prepare periodic progress updates, partner review presentations and programme reports;

(5) Contribute to documenting programme learnings and evidence to inform improvements in implementation and potential replication in other geographies.

**4. QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE AND COMPETENCIES:**

**Qualifications:**

A postgraduate degree in public health, health management, social sciences, management or a related discipline.

**Experience:**

(1) At least 10–12 years of experience in public health, healthcare partnerships, private-sector health programmes, healthcare market development or related fields, including substantial responsibility for managing external partnerships and multi-stakeholder initiatives;

(2) Demonstrated experience of engaging professional associations or healthcare provider bodies and networks at a senior level, with tangible outcomes such as jointly developed technical materials, CMEs, conferences or webinars;

(3) Working understanding of women’s and reproductive health, family planning or related clinical service delivery, sufficient to engage credibly with medical professionals. Deep clinical expertise is not required;

(4) Experience of coordinating multiple partners and internal teams, tracking agreed actions to completion and working to a programme workplan and indicators;

(5) Strong report-writing, presentation and documentation skills;

(6) Familiarity with the health systems and private-provider landscape of Bihar and Uttar Pradesh;

(7) Experience of coordinating with government health systems; experience supporting provider capacity-building and technical-material development; exposure to monitoring and evaluation, digital-first demand generation or private-sector health market development.

**Key Competencies:**

(1) Senior stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to build trust with senior medical professionals and commercial partners;

(2) Strong coordination, follow-through and problem-solving skills across multidisciplinary teams and geographies;

(3) Excellent written and verbal communication;

(4) Sound analytical skills and comfort with indicators, data and progress tracking;

(5) Integrity, neutrality and sound judgement in dealings with commercial entities;

(6) Ability to work independently in an early-stage programme and to take decisions in consultation with field teams;

(7) Willingness to travel frequently;

(8) A strong interest in public health and women’s health and commitment to IDF’s mission and values.

**5. IDEAL CANDIDATE:**

The ideal candidate will be a senior, relationship-oriented public health professional with experience of working with professional associations or provider networks, an understanding of women’s and reproductive health, and the discipline to run a multi-partner; multi location programme to defined indicators.

S/he should be able to serve as a dependable senior-level interface with partners, engage with suppliers on market-related issues while safeguarding IDF’s neutrality, and coordinate effectively across IDF’s technical, research and state teams to ensure smooth programme implementation.

The role will suit someone who is comfortable with frequent travel, communicates clearly and credibly with both clinicians and programme teams, and has a genuine interest in IDF’s mission.

**6. COMPENSATION OFFERED:**

The gross compensation budgeted for the position is up to Rs. 25 lacs per annum. The offer made to the selected candidate shall be commensurate with qualifications, experience, and salary history.

**7. LOCATION: New Delhi**

The role requires frequent travel, primarily to Mumbai and programme districts in Bihar and Uttar Pradesh, potentially involving up to 8–10 days of travel per month.

**8. REFERENCE: AD-PSP-IDF**

**9. CONTACT INFORMATION:**

Team SAMS

Strategic Alliance Management Services P Ltd.

1/1B, Choudhary Hetram House, Bharat Nagar

New Friends Colony, New Delhi 110 025

Phone Nos.: 011- 4081 9900; 4081 9926

**10. APPLICATION PROCESS:**

Eligible candidates interested in the position are requested to apply through the SAMS recruitment platform using the link below by the prescribed closing date.

**Application Link:**
https://www.samsstc.com/Jobs/job-description/associate-director-private-sector-partnerships-ipas-development-foundation-new-delhi-delhi/883

November 21, 2026.

description:
**Company:**
UrbanWrk

**Location:**
Gurgaon & Hyderabad

3–6 Years

Client Experience & Centre Operations

**Working days:**
5 days (Monday to Friday)

**About UrbanWrk**

At UrbanWrk, we provide flexible workspace solutions designed for modern businesses. Our professionally managed workspaces combine thoughtful design, operational efficiency, and hospitality-led service to create environments that support productivity and collaboration.

With two decades of experience in commercial real estate, we offer tailored offices, studios, meeting rooms, and day passes to entrepreneurs and established enterprises.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a
**Client Experience Manager with a strong background in Front Office Operations at a 4-star or 5-star hotel**
. The ideal candidate will bring a strong understanding of premium guest services, front desk management, service standards, complaint resolution, and day-to-day operations.

In this role, you will lead the on-ground experience at our centre, ensuring seamless operations, exceptional client service, and consistently high standards of cleanliness, professionalism, and hospitality.

We are looking for someone who takes ownership, anticipates client needs, resolves operational issues proactively, and delivers a premium experience through attention to detail and disciplined execution.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Client Experience & Hospitality**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, visitors, and guests.
* Deliver a warm, professional, and seamless arrival and check-in experience.
* Maintain high standards of hospitality, presentation, and service delivery.
* Handle client concerns and escalations with empathy, urgency, and ownership.
* Build strong client relationships and support engagement initiatives and events.

**2. Centre Operations & Facilities**

* Manage the day-to-day operations of the centre and ensure smooth functioning.
* Conduct regular inspections to maintain cleanliness, upkeep, and operational readiness.
* Coordinate with facility management teams, technical teams, IT, and external vendors.
* Ensure timely resolution of maintenance issues and service requests.

**3. Handover & Operational Readiness**

* Coordinate with the Projects team during office handovers and fit-out completion.
* Track and close operational snags before and after client move-in.
* Ensure offices and common areas are fully prepared before clients occupy the space.

**4. Vendor Management & Administration**

* Maintain inventory of operational supplies and ensure timely replenishment.
* Track service requests and ensure timely closure through internal systems.
* Coordinate maintenance activities and vendor visits.
* Verify operational vendor invoices and support basic administrative reporting.

**5. Events, Revenue & Business Support**

* Support client engagement events and centre-level initiatives.
* Facilitate bookings and usage of meeting rooms, day passes, parking, and other chargeable services.
* Maintain accurate records of chargeable services and coordinate billing inputs with Finance.
* Support prospective client visits, centre tours, onboarding, and sales coordination.
* Identify opportunities to enhance client satisfaction and drive additional revenue.

**Mandatory Candidate Requirements**

* **3–6 years of total professional experience**
  , preferably in Front Office Operations.
* **Mandatory experience working in the Front Office Operations department of a 4-star or 5-star hotel.**
* Strong exposure to guest relations, front desk management, guest check-in/check-out, service recovery, and complaint handling.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, presentation, and customer service skills.
* Demonstrated ability to manage daily operations, coordinate across teams, and handle escalations independently.
* Strong attention to detail, ownership, and a service-oriented approach.
* Graduate in Hotel Management, Hospitality Administration, or a relevant discipline preferred.

**Important:**
Candidates without prior Front Office Operations experience in a 4-star or 5-star hotel will not be considered for this position.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience in premium hospitality environments with structured service standards.
* Exposure to facility operations, vendor coordination, or workplace management.
* Familiarity with ticketing systems, operational dashboards, inventory management, and basic billing processes.
* Prior experience in a premium managed office or coworking environment is an added advantage, but does not replace the mandatory hotel experience.

**Who Should Apply?**

If you have built your career in a premium hotel environment, understand the importance of exceptional guest experiences, and are ready to bring those hospitality standards into a modern managed workspace, we would love to hear from you.

description:

● Own channel-level targets across leads, approvals, disbursals, revenue and cost efficiency.

● 3–7 years of experience in digital lending, fintech, contact centre operations, growth, affiliate marketing or partnerships.

● Hands-on experience managing contact centre/BPO vendors, assisted sales or performance-driven customer engagement.

● Demonstrated ability to source and scale B2B/B2B2C or affiliate partnerships and deliver measurable business outcomes.

● Strong analytical skills with proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint; SQL and exposure to GenAI/agentic AI solutions are an advantage.

● Excellent stakeholder management, commercial negotiation and execution skills.

**What Success Looks Like**

● Higher lead-to-disbursal conversion through AI-led and assisted customer engagement.

● Improved vendor productivity and recovery of funnel drop-offs.

● Incremental disbursals and revenue from scalable external partnerships.

● Strong channel ROI, predictable business delivery and improved customer experience.

**Join us to build the next growth engine for digital lending at super.money.**

title: Change Management Consultant
description:
Manager / Senior Manager | Growth Office | NOIDA, Delhi NCR (2-3 days work from office)

ROLE MANDATE:

Improve front-end effectiveness by driving and sustaining changes in sales processes, behaviors, skills and ways of working, increasingly enabled by AI. This is a business-transformation role with strong organizational change management capability, not a communications-and-training coordination role. The Senior Manager will diagnose what needs to change, shape practical adoption strategies, activate stakeholders, and assess whether changes in process, technology and capability are producing the intended business outcomes.

**Description**

Primary outcomes

1. Front-end transformation and effectiveness

Translate business priorities and AI-enabled opportunities into clear implications for sales roles, workflows, handoffs, behaviors and skills. Diagnose whether gaps arise from process, capability, technology, data, leadership reinforcement or adoption.

2. Process-change impact

Establish current-state baselines, define the intended future state and track whether redesigned processes are improving quality, speed, consistency and user experience. Separate activity measures from evidence of behavioral and operational change.

3. AI tool and workflow adoption

Drive role- and persona-based adoption for platforms used by the sales organization, including Salesforce, Agentforce, SALESpad and the Market Intelligence Platform. Focus on integration into daily workflows, not stand-alone awareness campaigns.

4. Stakeholder ownership and reinforcement

Build sponsor alignment, manager reinforcement, change networks and clear ownership across Sales Leadership, Growth Office, Sales Operations, Capability Development, Technology, Data & AI and solution teams.

5. Scalable change practice

Create reusable diagnostic, impact-assessment, communication, readiness, adoption and measurement approaches that can be applied across multiple Growth Office initiatives.

The person who will succeed

* Business-outcome led: starts with the effectiveness problem, not the change-management deliverables.
* AI-first but human-centered: anticipates how AI changes work while addressing trust, confidence, role clarity and cognitive friction.
* Diagnostic and evidence-oriented: distinguishes symptoms from root causes and tests whether the intervention worked.
* Influential without authority: creates shared ownership in a matrix and constructively challenges one-size-fits-all requests.
* Hands-on and strategic: can shape an enterprise approach and personally facilitate discovery, design a plan, analyze results and brief leaders.
* Comfortable with ambiguity: brings structure to evolving tools, processes and stakeholder expectations without waiting for perfect information.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead discovery with sellers, sales leaders and enabling functions to understand pain points, workflow friction, stakeholder needs and readiness for change.
* Map current and future-state journeys, roles, decision points and handoffs across priority front-end processes.
* Conduct stakeholder, change-impact, readiness and resistance assessments; convert findings into a segmented change plan.
* Design persona-based adoption journeys for senior leaders, middle management, sellers, account teams and sales-support teams.
* Partner with process and technology owners to make the new behavior easier within the workflow, rather than relying only on communications or training.
* Create sponsor and manager activation plans, champion networks, listening mechanisms and reinforcement cadences.
* Define leading and lagging measures across awareness, readiness, usage, behavior, process performance and business outcomes.
* Use qualitative feedback, platform data, Salesforce data and process measures to identify friction and adapt the intervention.
* Produce concise, leadership-ready narratives on adoption, risks, decisions required and evidence of impact.
* Work as part of a pod with Sales Transformation & Enablement and Client/Market Intelligence colleagues, while maintaining clear ownership for change and adoption.

**Qualifications**

* 8+ years of relevant experience, with substantial ownership of enterprise change, workforce transformation, digital adoption, process transformation or human-capital advisory programs.
* Demonstrated work with commercial, sales, account-management or other front-office populations in a complex global organization.
* Experience translating technology or AI implementation into role, process, behavior and operating-model change.
* Hands-on use of change-impact, stakeholder, readiness, resistance, adoption and benefit-realization methods. PROSCI/ADKAR, Kotter, design thinking, Lean or process-improvement credentials are useful but are not substitutes for evidence.
* Comfort using CRM, platform-usage, workflow and employee-listening data to diagnose adoption and assess impact. Salesforce exposure is strongly preferred.
* Working understanding of Data, Analytics, Generative AI and Agentic AI in enterprise settings.
* Excellent facilitation, executive communication, structured problem solving and program management capability.

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on

to lead our regional Customer Support organization and contribute to our global support strategy.
  
  
You will drive customer experience, operational performance, people development and continuous improvement, while leading APAC’s contribution to our global follow-the-sun support model. This includes supporting the transition toward global queues, shared case ownership and seamless customer support across regions and time zones.

Being part of Zebra Nation means you are seen, heard, valued, and respected. Drawing from our unique perspectives, we collaborate to deliver on our purpose. You’ll have opportunities to learn and lead in a forward-thinking environment, defining your path to a fulfilling career while channeling your skills toward causes you care about—locally and globally.

Come make an impact every day at Zebra.

**What We're Looking For:**

We are seeking a results-driven and market-savvy Territory Account Manager to lead our POS (Point of Sale) and Kiosk solutions expansion in the India market. You will be responsible for driving revenue growth, building and nurturing long-term relationships with clients in the retail, Grocery Chain Store, CVS, Quick Service Restaurant (QSR), and Food & Beverage (F&B) sectors. * Identify, prospect, and acquire new clients (including national retail chains, CVS, regional QSR brands, and F&B operators) while maintaining and expanding existing customer relationships.

* Build and manage strategic partnerships with key ISVs, SIs, and VARs in India ecosystem to expand distribution channels and drive co-selling opportunities.
* Negotiate contracts, pricing, and service level agreements (SLAs) to ensure customer satisfaction and maximize profitability.
* Achieve and exceed quarterly/annual sales targets for revenue, new customer acquisition, and market share growth.
* Coordinate with the customer success team/Pre-sales engineering team to ensure seamless onboarding, implementation, and post-sales support, fostering long-term customer loyalty.
* Closely work with marketing to represent the company at industry events, trade shows, and networking functions in India to enhance brand visibility, build industry connections and capture valuable project leads, improve leads conversion to help sales revenue growth.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or master’s Degree or equivalent qualification.
* 5 to 8 Years of experience into managing Large Enterprise Accounts for QSR or F&B Vertical or into Offline Grocery chain.

**Preferred Qualification:**

* Industry Expertise: In-depth knowledge of industry trends, customer challenges, and competitive landscape.
* Sales Acumen: Strong understanding of sales processes, negotiation techniques, and closing strategies
* Understands policies and practices related to role and shares ideas for improvement.

We understand the importance of work-life balance and wellbeing, which is why we offer flexibility for our teams including: hybrid work, adaptable hours, Summer Flex Fridays, Focus Fridays, and an annual companywide well-being day to promote revitalization and success.

**Job Posting Statement:**

To protect candidates from falling victim to online fraudulent activity involving fake job postings and employment offers, please be aware our recruiters will always connect with you via @zebra.com email accounts. Applications are only accepted through our applicant tracking system and only accept personal identifying information through that system. Our Talent Acquisition team will not ask for you to provide personal identifying information via e-mail or outside of the system. If you are a victim of identity theft contact your local police department.

**AI Technology Statement:**

Zebra Technologies leverages AI technology to evaluate job applications using objective, job-relevant criteria. This approach enhances efficiency and promotes fairness in the hiring process. However, every decision regarding interviews and hiring is made by our dedicated team, because we believe people make the best decisions about people. For more on how we use technology in hiring and how we process applicant data, see our
Zebra Privacy Policy
.

title: Infrastructure Specialist
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

Your role Step into the engine room of enterprise technology, where every decision you make can shape how a customer’s systems perform today - and scale for tomorrow. You’ll dive deep into complex infrastructure environments, solving challenging technical problems, designing seamless integrations and ensuring systems run reliably at every level. Your expertise across networks, endpoints and mainframes, paired with a knack for logical problem-solving and clear documentation, will guide projects from concept to execution. Your solutions will make a real impact that customers notice and remember. In this role, you’ll balance hands-on delivery with long-term strategic planning. From analyzing issues and testing solutions to automating processes and integrating across platforms, your work will touch every layer of IT infrastructure. You’ll collaborate with Architects, Technicians and Project Managers, gaining broad exposure and continuous opportunities to grow your skills and influence. What you will do Analyze and Solve •Diagnose complex issues across servers, networks, cloud environments and systems to identify root causes •Recommend solutions that balance technical feasibility, timelines and customer priorities •Test, refine and automate processes to improve reliability, efficiency and repeatability •Assess risks proactively and implement strategies to prevent disruptions Design and Integrate •Plan end-to-end infrastructure solutions across platforms and technologies •Integrate systems in hybrid cloud and on-prem environments to ensure seamless operation •Automate workflows and processes to streamline delivery and reduce errors •Document architectures and procedures for hand-offs, knowledge sharing and operational continuity Collaborate and Deliver •Coordinate cross-functional teams including Architects, Project Managers and Technicians •Drive project delivery from initiation to completion with attention to quality and timelines •Communicate technical solutions clearly to customers and stakeholders •Build customer confidence by delivering tangible, high-impact results Grow and Advance •Expand technical expertise across cloud platforms, enterprise IT systems and emerging technologies •Earn certifications and qualifications while applying them on real projects •Pursue career paths toward Architect or Distinguished Engineer roles

**Who You Are**

Required skills and experience •Deep expertise within specific technology domain areas (e.g., software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) •Enterprise IT application experience •Hands-on experience in at least one of the following: software development, DevOps engineering, systems administration, or systems architecture in public cloud AWS domain •In-depth knowledge of Windows and Linux Operating System Preferred skills and experience •Familiar with a variety of IT concepts, practices, and procedures •Knowledge of design techniques, tools, and principals involved in production of precision technical plans, blueprints, drawings, and models •Logic and reasoning to identify the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, conclusions, or approaches to problems •Analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**  
If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

Or for an individual contributor, they lead organisation wide projects and act as deep technical expert and thought leader, identifying new ways of working and collaborating cross functionally. * Manage, coordinate and enable resourcing, budgeting and policy creation for a significant sub-function.
* Escalates breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Foster and guide compliance, ensure regulations are observed that relevant processes in place to facilitate adherence.

* Demonstrate extensive knowledge of how the function integrates with the business division / Group to achieve the overall business objectives.
* Maintain broad and comprehensive knowledge of industry theories and practices within own discipline alongside up-to-date relevant sector / functional knowledge, and insight into external market developments / initiatives.
* Use interpretative thinking and advanced analytical skills to solve problems and design solutions in often complex/ sensitive situations.
* Exercise management authority to make significant decisions and certain strategic decisions or recommendations within own area.
* Negotiate with and influence stakeholders at a senior level both internally and externally.
* Act as principal contact point for key clients and counterparts in other functions/ businesses divisions.
* Mandated as a spokesperson for the function and business division.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Sr. Director, Quality Assurance
description:
We are seeking a strategic, results-oriented **Senior Director, Quality Assurance** to lead quality strategy and execution across a global **Intellectual Property (IP)** portfolio of products, platforms, and services. This leader will modernize Quality Engineering practices and ensure delivery of secure, scalable, reliable products that improve customer outcomes.

Partnering with Engineering, Product, Operations, Security, Customer Success, and Executive Leadership, this role will embed quality as an organizational capability through automation, analytics, innovation, and data-driven decision making.

**About You - Experience, Education, Skills & Accomplishments**
---------------------------------------------------------------

### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.

* 18+ years of progressive experience in Quality Assurance, Quality Engineering, Software Engineering, or Technology Leadership roles.
* 8+ years of people leadership experience managing managers and global QA/Engineering organizations.
* Proven track record leading enterprise-scale quality programs supporting cloud, SaaS, data, AI/ML, and platform-based products.
* Demonstrated experience developing and executing strategic quality roadmaps aligned to business objectives.
* Experience driving large-scale test automation initiatives and quality transformation programs.
* Strong experience establishing enterprise quality governance, standards, metrics, and operational frameworks.
* Experience managing globally distributed teams across multiple geographies and time zones.
* Proven ability to influence executive stakeholders and drive organizational change.
* Strong understanding of Agile, Scrum, DevOps, CI/CD, and modern software development methodologies.
* Experience building and scaling Quality Engineering organizations in fast-paced product environments.
* Strong experience applying AI, automation, shift-left practices, and ROI-focused test planning to improve quality outcomes.

**It Would Be Great If You Also Have**
--------------------------------------

  

* Experience supporting intellectual property, legal technology, healthcare, financial services, or other highly regulated industries.
* Expertise in cloud-native architectures, microservices, distributed systems, and API-driven ecosystems.
* Hands-on knowledge of AI-assisted testing, machine learning validation, continuous testing, SRE, and quality practices for AI-powered products.

* Strong understanding of security testing, compliance requirements, privacy regulations, and risk management practices.
* Experience with performance engineering, resiliency testing, chaos engineering, and observability platforms.
* Relevant certifications such as ISTQB Advanced, Six Sigma, Lean, Agile Leadership, or Quality Engineering certifications.

**Technical Expertise**
-----------------------

  

* Deep understanding of modern quality engineering practices, including shift-left testing, risk-based testing, test strategy, test design, test data management, and defect prevention.
* Strong technical fluency across cloud-native architectures, SaaS platforms, microservices, APIs, event-driven systems, distributed applications, and data-intensive products.
* Experience defining automation architecture and toolchains across UI, API, integration, contract, performance, security, accessibility, mobile, and regression testing.
* Practical knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, release orchestration, environment management, observability, telemetry, and quality gates.
* Ability to leverage AI-assisted testing, self-healing test suites, analytics, predictive quality signals, and automation to improve coverage, speed, productivity, and release confidence.
* Strong grasp of secure-by-design and quality-by-design principles, including security testing, privacy considerations, audit readiness, compliance controls, and operational risk management.

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

  

* Define and execute the enterprise QA and Quality Engineering vision aligned to long-term business strategy.
* Advise executive leadership on quality risks, opportunities, trends, investments, and transformation priorities.
* Establish enterprise quality standards, governance forums, operating models, KPIs, SLAs, and release readiness criteria.
* Ensure compliance with security, regulatory, privacy, audit, and risk management requirements.
* Drive modern Quality Engineering practices, automation-first testing, AI-powered testing, and continuous quality across the SDLC.
* Oversee quality operations across product portfolios while improving processes, tools, productivity, and delivery performance.
* Improve release confidence and reduce defects, incidents, escalations, and operational risk through data-driven insights and root cause analysis.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Customer Success, Operations, Security, and Architecture teams to align quality objectives with business goals.
* Use customer feedback, support trends, and telemetry to improve product reliability, stability, usability, scalability, and performance.
* Build, lead, mentor, and develop high-performing global QA and Quality Engineering teams.
* Create a culture of quality, innovation, accountability, inclusion, continuous learning, succession readiness, and employee engagement.

**About the team**
------------------

The Quality Assurance & Quality Engineering organization ensures secure, reliable, scalable, high-quality products across the IP portfolio. The team partners with Engineering, Product, Data Science, Security, and Operations to embed quality throughout the SDLC and accelerate delivery through automation, continuous testing, AI-assisted testing, DevSecOps, predictive analytics, and continuous improvement.

title: Technical Service Manager
description:
Castrol is one of the world’s leading lubricant brands, serving customers and consumers in the automotive, marine, industrial and energy sectors. Castrol brands are recognised globally for their premium quality and high performance, shaped by the company’s commitment to innovation and cutting-edge technology. With products sold in more than 150 countries, Castrol has helped keep things moving on roads and racetracks, air, sea, and space for over 125 years.
  
  
Whether you're just starting out or ready for your next big move, you're in the right place to explore an exciting career with Castrol.
  
  
**Job Description**
About the Team
  
  
The Technical Services & Engineering team partners with the Sales organization to drive sustainable business growth by providing technical expertise, application support, and value-based solutions for industrial customers. The team supports customers across key industrial segments including steel, automotive, bearing manufacturing, metalworking, and general engineering industries, working closely with Sales, Marketing, Product Management, Supply Chain, and customer operations teams to deliver measurable business value and operational excellence.
  
  
Key Tasks
  
  

* Provide technical expertise and field-based engineering support to customers and the Sales team across industrial lubricant and metalworking fluid applications.
* Evaluate customer manufacturing processes, identify performance improvement opportunities, and develop value-based solutions that support new business acquisition and retention.
* Conduct product trials, technical assessments, and competitive benchmarking activities to support successful product conversions and competitive displacement opportunities.
* Develop technical business cases, value-selling proposals, and quantify cost-saving recommendations for customers.
* Perform root cause analysis and troubleshooting for lubrication and metalworking fluid-related challenges, ensuring timely resolution and customer satisfaction.
* Create and document customer success stories, case studies, and technical value demonstrations to support business growth initiatives.
* Deliver technical training programs and knowledge-sharing sessions for customers, distributors, and internal stakeholders.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support product implementation, application optimization, and continuous improvement initiatives across the region.

**Experience Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, Production Engineering, Metallurgy, Chemical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
* Proven experience in industrial lubricants, greases, high-performance lubricants, metalworking fluids, or technical services within the manufacturing or industrial sector.
* Strong knowledge of industrial lubricant technologies, including hydraulic oils, gear oils, greases, rust preventives, specialty lubricants, soluble oils, and neat cutting oils.
* Experience supporting industrial applications such as steel plants, rolling mills, TMT manufacturing, bearing manufacturing, automotive components, metal cutting, metal forming, or general engineering operations.
* Ability to conduct technical assessments, troubleshoot application issues, and perform root cause analysis in customer environments.
* Experience supporting product trials, implementations, and technical customer engagements.
* Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence both technical and commercial audiences.
* Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned region to support customers and business growth objectives.

title: Placement Manager
description:
**About Medhavi Group:**
Established in 2013, Medhavi Group is a unified ecosystem comprising MSU and various skill- promoting organisations, dedicated to advancing skill development, vocational training, and industry- integrated higher education. With a strong outcome-driven approach, the Group has trained over 6 lakh learners, achieving more than 70% employability outcomes, and currently supports 20,000+ active students across its diverse programs. Medhavi Group continues to bridge the gap between education and employment by building scalable, industry-aligned talent pathways across India. Work Integrated Skill based Higher Education (WISE) is Medhavi’s flagship industry-integrated initiative built on the principle of “Industry as Campus.” It combines academic learning with structured on-the job training, ensuring students graduate with real work experience and industry-ready skills. Through deep, outcome-driven partnerships with over 300+ leading industry and skill partners across 26+ sectors including Hyundai, Mahindra, IHG Group, Nephroplus, Barbeque Nation, Nexus Select Malls, ClassPlus, Tata Electronics, Marriott, ITC, and others- WISE enables learners to acquire role- specific competencies directly within live business environments. WISE creates a demand-driven talent pipeline for industries that enhances employability, improves workforce productivity, and bridges the industry skill gap.

For more information, visit
**https://msu.edu.in/wise/**

**Role Overview:**

The Manager will be responsible for establishing and strengthening partnerships with healthcare institutions, hospitals, rehabilitation centers, mental health organizations, clinics, NGOs, and industry partners to facilitate On-the-Job Training (OJT), clinical postings, internships, fieldwork, and experiential learning opportunities for students of Psychology and Allied Health Sciences. The role also involves developing and managing Memorandums of Understanding (MoUs) with partner organizations to support student training, research, and industry engagement initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Industry Partnership Development**

• Identify, approach, and onboard hospitals, clinics, diagnostic centers, rehabilitation centers, mental health organizations, NGOs, and healthcare providers for student training and placement opportunities.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with industry stakeholders and healthcare institutions.

• Explore new opportunities for collaboration in training, internships, research, and skill development.

• Coordinate with academic departments and industry partners to ensure timely placement of students.

• Monitor student attendance, performance, and compliance during training and clinical postings.

• Resolve issues related to student deployment and industry coordination.

**3. MoU Development & Management**

• Draft, process, and coordinate Memorandums of Understanding (MoUs) with hospitals, healthcare institutions, NGOs, and industry partners.

• Ensure timely renewal and maintenance of partnership agreements.

• Maintain records and documentation related to all industry collaborations and MoUs.

• Coordinate with legal, administrative, and academic teams for approvals and execution of agreements.

**4. Stakeholder Coordination**

• Act as the primary point of contact between the university and partner organizations.

• Organize industry meetings, partnership discussions, and review sessions.

• Facilitate communication among students, faculty members, and industry partners.

**5. Compliance & Documentation**

• Maintain a database of industry partners, clinical sites, and training organizations.

• Prepare periodic reports on student postings, industry engagement activities, and partnership outcomes. • Ensure compliance with university policies, accreditation requirements, and regulatory guidelines related to clinical training.

**6. Student Support & Career Development**

• Guide students regarding internship and clinical posting requirements.

• Support employability initiatives and facilitate industry interactions.

• Assist in organizing workshops, guest lectures, industry visits, and career-oriented activities.

• Master's Degree in Psychology, Hospital Administration, Healthcare Management, Social Work, Allied Health Sciences, Business Administration, or a related field.

• Additional certifications in healthcare management or industry relations will be an advantage.

• 5 - 10 years of experience in industry relations, healthcare partnerships, training coordination, placement activities, or academic-industry collaboration.

• Experience in working with hospitals, healthcare institutions, NGOs, or educational institutions is preferred.

• Strong networking and relationship management skills.

• Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal abilities.

• Knowledge of healthcare and mental health ecosystems.

• Experience in drafting and managing MoUs and partnership agreements.

• Strong organizational and documentation skills.

• Proficiency in MS Office and database management.

**What We Offer**

• Opportunity to architect and scale a future-focused, industry-integrated higher education ecosystem.

• Competitive compensation with performance-linked incentives.

• Leadership role in a rapidly growing national skills and university platform.

• A collaborative, mission-driven environment.

• The opportunity to create a measurable impact on employability and workforce transformation at scale.
