**Designation: Manager/ Sr. Manager – Carrier & Freight Commercial**

**Location: Gandhinagar**

**Role purpose**

This position owns the commercial relationship with every carrier the business uses — rate negotiation, lane allocation, contract renewal and freight cost assurance. It sits directly under the Head of Supply Chain & Logistics and is separate from trade and customs compliance, which is a distinct function. The role carries a monthly express freight spend running in the order of 23 crore, against which no contracted rate table currently exists for the India entities.

**Key responsibilities**

* Own every carrier contract end to end — FedEx across both India entities and the US entity, UPS, Emirates and new entrants — including a renewal and expiry calendar with a named owner against every date, so that no term lapses unnoticed.
* Negotiate and benchmark rates, and build the rate card baseline the business does not currently hold. Roughly 89% of monthly freight spend is un-baselined today.
* Own lane allocation — routing volume to the right carrier by cost, transit time and service level — and document the logic so it can be audited and repeated.
* Govern dimensional divisors, fuel and surcharge concessions across all carriers, including the US amendment concessions that expire in February 2027 and revert to list.
* Own freight cost assurance — charged weight against company record, invoice audit before payment, and recovery claims through to credit.
* Drive down accessorial and exception charges by working with operations on root cause, not only by validating them after billing.
* Monitor volume commitments and surge clauses against contractual thresholds, and flag a breach before the carrier does.
* Run carrier governance — quarterly business reviews, SLA reviews, escalation matrices and service remedies.
* Report carrier cost monthly into the business review and into the gross margin programme.
* Support the trade and customs compliance function on carrier-side documentation, without owning compliance itself.

**Required skills, qualifications and experience**

* 10 to 14 years in freight procurement, carrier management or logistics commercial, with direct hands-on negotiation with international express carriers.
* Demonstrated contract negotiation on an annual freight spend of 100 crore or above.
* Deep working knowledge of express pricing mechanics — dimensional divisors, fuel tables, accessorial structures, zone and lane pricing, earned discount tiers and volume commitments.
* Freight audit and recovery experience, including building and defending a claim against a carrier.
* Strong commercial analytics — able to build a cost model, defend it to Finance, and put it in front of a carrier without it being picked apart.
* Exposure across air, ocean and parcel modes; export-led businesses preferred.
* Able to hold a senior carrier relationship and a difficult commercial conversation without damaging it.
* Graduate. MBA or postgraduate qualification in Supply Chain, or CIPS or equivalent procurement certification, an advantage.

**What good looks like in the first 90 days**

* A complete rate card and contract baseline across every carrier, in one register.
* A renewal and expiry calendar with a named owner against each date, including the February 2027 surcharge cliff.
* The open recovery claim either closed or on an agreed, dated path with the carrier.
* Lane allocation logic documented and agreed with operations.
* A first view of accessorial spend by type, with the three largest reduction opportunities quantified.

**A Snapshot**
The Technical Specialist - Asset Management is responsible for operational support, configuration and enhancement of AirTrunk’s enterprise asset management solution using IFS. Reporting to the Service Owner, the role supports implementation and ongoing service delivery for asset registers, maintenance planning and work management across data centre and corporate environments. The specialist works with Facilities, Operations, Finance, Procurement and Technology teams to keep IFS stable, secure and fit for purpose, while maintaining accurate asset data, quality documentation and user knowledge.

* Provide Level 1 and 2 support for IFS incidents and service requests, escalating complex product or integration issues where necessary.

* Configure and maintain approved IFS EAM settings, asset structures, locations, maintenance plans, task lists, work order flows and related business rules.
* Support IFS environment administration, controlled configuration promotion, patching, upgrades and minor enhancements.
* Maintain system integrity, role-based access, auditability and compliance with security, segregation-of-duties and governance standards.

**Change Delivery & Testing**

* Deliver approved IFS changes and enhancements with asset process owners, implementation partners and technical teams.
* Prepare test scenarios and data; conduct unit and regression testing and support business-led UAT for workflows, integrations and reports.
* Ensure changes, migration loads and releases are documented, approved and deployed in accordance with SDLC and change-management processes.

**Asset Data & Knowledge Management**

* Maintain asset data standards, configuration records, mapping rules, reconciliation evidence, support procedures and change logs.
* Contribute troubleshooting guides, known issues and repeatable procedures to the asset management knowledge base.
* Support training and onboarding of users and support staff through clear process guides and accessible documentation.

**Collaboration & Continuous Improvement**

* Work closely with the Service Owner and Facilities and Operations stakeholders to improve asset lifecycle, maintenance and inventory processes.
* Participate in root-cause analysis and problem management; identify recurring data, workflow and integration issues and recommend corrective actions.
* Stay current with IFS updates and asset management practices, and identify appropriate opportunities for process optimisation and automation.

**Requirements**
**Essential:**

* Hands-on experience with IFS is required, preferably IFS Cloud or IFS Applications with Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) or maintenance functionality.
* 5–7 years’ experience supporting enterprise asset management, CMMS, ERP or other business applications in a technical capacity.
* Experience configuring or supporting asset registers, asset hierarchies, preventive maintenance, inspections, work orders or inventory processes.
* Experience supporting facilities, engineering, maintenance, data centre operations or another asset-intensive function.
* Strong understanding of system configuration, troubleshooting, asset data quality and support processes.
* Experience with incident, problem, change and release management practices, preferably in an ITIL-aligned environment.
* Ability to write clear, structured documentation and maintain configuration, data and knowledge records.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience working collaboratively with cross-functional teams in Agile, hybrid or traditional delivery environments.

**Desirable**

* IFS EAM training, accreditation or certification, or demonstrable commitment to formal IFS learning.
* Exposure to IFS maintenance planning, work order management, inventory, procurement or mobile workforce capabilities.
* Exposure to APIs, integration middleware, reporting, scripting or automation tools.
* Experience working in multi-country, data centre or fast-paced transformation environments.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Engineering, Computer Science, Business Systems or a related discipline.
* 5–7 years in technology, enterprise applications or asset management systems roles.
* Global or APAC experience is an advantage.

**Technical Assistance Center | Networking • Security • SD-WAN • SASE**

**Experience: 2+ years**

**Location**

**Bangalore / Chennai, India**

**Work Model**

**24x7 global support**

**About Versa Networks:**

At Versa Networks, we are redefining the future of networking and security through an industry-leading platform that

converges SD-WAN, Security and SASE into a unified architecture. Versa enables enterprises and service providers

worldwide to build secure, scalable and highly resilient networks across branch offices, data centers, cloud environments

and remote users.

We are looking for motivated and technically strong TAC Engineers who are passionate about networking, security and

troubleshooting. This is an opportunity to support global enterprise customers, work with cutting-edge technologies and build expertise in SD-WAN and SASE.

**Role Overview**

As a TAC Engineer / Senior TAC Engineer, you will provide technical assistance to global enterprise customers,

troubleshoot networking and security issues, and drive timely resolution of customer-reported problems. You will work

closely with customers, Engineering, Product and other support teams to diagnose and resolve issues across Versa's product portfolio.

The role requires strong networking fundamentals, analytical thinking, customer communication skills and the ability to investigate problems systematically.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Technical troubleshooting and case management**

• Handle and resolve technical support cases involving networking, routing, switching, security, SD-WAN and SASE.

• Analyze customer-reported issues, identify root causes and recommend effective technical solutions.

• Troubleshoot network connectivity, routing, traffic forwarding, VPN and application accessibility issues.

• Perform packet-level analysis using tcpdump, Wireshark and other diagnostic utilities; analyze system logs and debug

outputs.

• Manage assigned support cases independently, maintain customer communication and drive issues to resolution within

defined SLAs.

**Versa product support**

• Develop hands-on expertise in Versa products, including VOS, Versa Director, Versa Analytics, Concerto and Versa SASE.

• Troubleshoot SD-WAN overlay connectivity, IPsec tunnels, routing adjacencies, application traffic and security policies.

• Assist customers with configuration, deployment, upgrades and troubleshooting of Versa appliances.

• Build an understanding of product architecture and interactions between control plane, data plane and management

components.

**Collaboration, escalation and continuous improvement**

• Collaborate with Engineering to investigate potential product defects, validate fixes and confirm workarounds.

• Collect relevant logs, packet captures and diagnostic information before escalating issues; reproduce problems in lab

environments when required.

• Contribute to root cause analysis, knowledge base articles and troubleshooting guides.

• Share technical learnings and recommend improvements to support processes and customer experience.

title: Implementation Engineer
description:
Gushwork is building an Agent Operating System for small and mid-sized businesses around the world. It is a modern business software where AI agents and humans work together. Business owners and leaders set the goals. They decide what each agent is allowed to do. Then they review the metric each agent delivers.
  
  
We started with an SEO agent. It owns one metric: organic leads. Once it ranks pages and brings in leads, it reports them back to the customer. We are now expanding into a Paid Ads agent and a Developer agent, each owning a metric the business cares about.
  
  
Our customers sell high-value goods and services and have fewer than 200 employees. Most of them are in industries that are not digitally native: manufacturers, industrial distributors, commercial services. They do not buy AI. They buy outcomes. Our job is to make agents reliable enough that a business owner can trust them with a number.
  
  
We are a team of about 90 people based in Bengaluru, backed by Lightspeed and SIG. If you want to want to help us build reliable agents that runs real businesses, we're excited to meet you!
  
  
**About The Role**
Gushwork's content programmes run on our customers' own websites, on their domain, alongside everything else already there. Making that work means dealing with whatever infrastructure a business has accumulated over a decade: DNS configured by an agency that is no longer involved, a CDN nobody set up deliberately, redirect rules that predate the current marketing team. Every customer is a different version of that problem.
  
  
The Implementation Engineer owns it. The role sits closer to engineering, and combines hands-on technical setup with direct customer communication.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own the technical implementation for new customers end to end: review their environment, access, configuration and technical dependencies ahead of implementation, take the setup live, and verify the result.
* Work directly with customers to configure and validate setups, including calls with their in-house developers or agency partners as well as their marketing teams.
* Diagnose customer-specific issues across websites, APIs, networking and web infrastructure, and determine what can be resolved independently and what requires Engineering.
* Own the customer-facing communication end to end. Validate the fix, then explain what happened in language a non-technical stakeholder can act on.
* Establish where a customer's domain, DNS and hosting access sits, including on older setups where this is not documented, and confirm the results of automated checks before relying on them.
* Reduce recurring issues through documentation, improvements to the implementation process, and structured feedback to Product and Engineering.
* Partner with Customer Success, Engineering and Web Development to gather context on customer requirements and share technical findings.

**What We're Looking For**
This role requires two things together. Most candidates have one.
  
  

* Strong technical depth. Working knowledge of HTTP/HTTPS, DNS, domains, reverse proxies, CDNs, caching, SSL and basic networking, at a level sufficient to debug them rather than describe them.
* Strong written and verbal communication. In particular, the ability to explain a technical issue in simple language to somebody who is frustrated. This is roughly half the role.
* Willingness to work in US hours (6pm to 3am) — our customers are primarily based in the US, so the role requires flexibility to work in US time zones.

In addition:
  
  

* 2 to 5 years of experience. Candidates earlier in their career who have hands-on experience operating web infrastructure, including on their own projects, are welcome to make the case in their application.
* The ability to reason about two systems at once. Most answers here depend on how a customer's setup and our product interact, rather than on either in isolation.
* Strong investigative ability. Reading logs, configurations and documentation to form and test a hypothesis about an unfamiliar problem.
* The ability to make progress independently on an unfamiliar technical issue, rather than routing it onward as a first step.
* Ownership and follow-through, including holding several open issues at once without losing the urgent one.

**Good to have**

* Experience with reverse proxies, Cloudflare, DNS, CDNs, web servers, APIs or webhooks.
* Experience with WordPress or other website platforms.
* Familiarity with developer tools, browser and network debugging, logs, and basic scripting.
* Experience with SaaS products and customer integrations.
* Prior experience in Implementation Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Integration Engineering or a similar role.
* Documentation or help content you have written that measurably reduced a category of customer questions.
* Prior experience working US hours.

**Why you'll love us**

* You'll be part of an early team at a fast-growing company, with a lot of impact
* You'll get to work with really smart and helpful people
* We constantly adopt the latest technologies and stay close to the latest ai innovations
* Opportunity to influence the direction of the product and engineering culture
* Flexible PTO policy
* Unlimited ai usage
* Plus cool swag, a stocked pantry, and other benefits

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Senior Product Support Engineer
description:
**About The Role**
We are seeking a Senior Product Support Engineer to lead the resolution of complex customer and production issues across Bidgely’s platform. In this hands-on position, you will combine deep technical troubleshooting, customer communication, incident leadership, and continuous improvement.
  
  
You will serve as a trusted escalation point for high-impact issues, lead cross-functional resolution efforts, and partner with Engineering, SRE, Delivery, Product, QA, and Customer Success teams to enhance platform reliability and supportability. Additionally, you will mentor support engineers and help build a stronger, more proactive support function.
  
  
The ideal candidate is comfortable navigating ambiguity, leading high-pressure discussions, using data and logs to identify root causes, and driving corrective actions to closure.
  
  
What You Will Do
  
  
Technical Support and Incident Ownership
  
  

* Act as the primary escalation point for complex production issues and customer-impacting incidents.
* Take end-to-end ownership of assigned and escalated issues—from initial triage to resolution, communication, RCA, and preventive action.
* Lead internal war rooms, customer calls, and critical issue-resolution meetings, ensuring clear updates, decisions, owners, and next steps.
* Troubleshoot distributed applications, data pipelines, APIs, integrations, message queues, and cloud-hosted services.
* Analyze application logs, system metrics, traces, database behavior, and data flows to isolate faults and validate fixes.
* Investigate and resolve issues involving Kafka, RabbitMQ, Amazon SQS, or similar messaging and queueing systems.
* Maintain strong ticket hygiene and ensure support activity is documented according to agreed SLAs and operational standards.

Customer and Cross-functional Partnership
  
  

* Communicate clearly with customers, Customer Success, Delivery, and internal stakeholders during incidents and escalations.
* Partner with Engineering, SRE, Product, QA, and Delivery to resolve defects, reduce repeat incidents, and improve release readiness.
* Provide the support perspective during design reviews, feature planning, release planning, and post-release reviews.
* Identify customer-impacting risks before go-live and help ensure effective transitions of new capabilities to Product Support.
* Represent Product Support with credibility, urgency, and a strong ownership mindset.

Reliability and Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Proactively monitor platform health using tools such as CloudWatch, Grafana, Opsgenie, Datadog, or equivalent platforms.
* Identify recurring issues, alert gaps, false positives, operational bottlenecks, and manual support work.
* Drive improvements in monitoring, alerting, runbooks, knowledge articles, support workflows, and operational controls.
* Automate repetitive support activities using Python, Bash, SQL, or other suitable tools.
* Write high-quality root cause analyses that explain customer impact, timeline, contributing factors, corrective actions, and prevention measures.
* Track corrective actions to completion and verify that fixes have reduced risk or recurrence.

Team Capability and Knowledge Sharing
  
  

* Mentor Product Support Engineers and help them develop structured troubleshooting and incident management practices.
* Develop and maintain troubleshooting guides, RCA templates, playbooks, onboarding materials, and technical documentation.
* Share product, platform, and incident knowledge through reviews, training sessions, and team forums.
* Contribute to hiring, onboarding, and capability-building initiatives within Product Support.

What You Bring
  
  

* 7–10 years of experience in production support, technical support, application support, SRE, DevOps, or related customer-facing technical roles.
* Strong experience troubleshooting SaaS or enterprise applications in production environments.

* Effectively coordinate weekly governance calls with clients and provide timely status reports/dashboards.
* Develop and execute comprehensive test plans for system changes, enhancements, and new releases; ensure quality assurance and risk mitigation.

* Collaborate with clients and internal teams to address business needs and system enhancements.

**People Development**

* Mentor Consultants and junior team members, fostering knowledge sharing and skill development.
* Lead user training and adoption initiatives, including the development of training materials and delivery of workshops or sessions.

**Business Development**

* Identifying client needs for additional services or enhancements.

**The team**
At Deloitte Tax LLP, our Legal Business Services group within the Tax Technology Consulting (TTC) practice helps legal departments pursue a streamlined, transparent, and efficient legal function that enhances the core responsibilities of operations, contracting, compliance, reporting and planning, while also positioning Deloitte as a strategic business advisor for the digital era. As legal operations and contracting specialists, we help clients make appropriate operations and technology choices. Our team, the largest of its type, offers the necessary combination of skills, methodology and practical experience to help clients with contract lifecycle management, legal entity management, and legal operations services.
  
  
Deloitte TTC-LBS professionals are aligned across our global network of member firms to support our clients’ objectives and address their challenges. Our team’s multi-disciplinary approach combines technical and technology skillsets, enabling greater impact and efficiency within our client’s organization. TTC’s Legal Business Services team helps clients with operating model evaluation, roadmap development for a desired future state, data management solutions, automation opportunities, contract lifecycle management, legal entity management, and legal operating models. Learn more about Deloitte Legal Business Services.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Required:**- Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or a related field.
- 4+ years of experience in CLM system configuration, application management, system support, or technology consulting, with a focus on CLM or related platforms (e.g., Icertis, Conga, DocuSign CLM, Agiloft, etc.).
- Trained and certified on one or more platforms -

title: CCTV  TECHNICIANS
description:
CCTV & Network Engineer (ELV / Field Service)
  
D'VIBE PVT LTD • Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
  
About the job
  
We are looking for a CCTV and Networking Engineer to take ownership of surveillance and ELV installations from site survey through commissioning and long-term support. You will handle IP network integration, run preventive and corrective maintenance, and coordinate with clients, vendors, and internal teams to keep systems reliable and SLAs met.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
1. Installation & Commissioning
  
• Conduct site surveys and recommend camera placement, cabling routes, and network design.
  
• Install, configure, and commission IP/analog cameras, NVRs/DVRs, VMS, and PoE switches.
  
• Supervise cabling (CAT6/fibre), termination, labelling, and testing.
  
• Complete installations to drawings and BOQ, and prepare as-built documentation.
  
  
2. Network Integration & Configuration
  
• Configure IP addressing, VLANs, routing, and basic switching for surveillance networks.
  
• Integrate CCTV with access control, fire alarm, intercom, and other ELV systems as required.
  
• Set up remote viewing, port forwarding/VPN, and mobile/VMS client access.
  
• Troubleshoot bandwidth, latency, packet loss, and PoE issues.
  
  
3. Maintenance & Support
  
• Perform scheduled preventive maintenance (PM) visits and health checks.
  
• Diagnose and resolve faults on cameras, recorders, storage, switches, and cabling.
  
• Handle service tickets within SLA and maintain accurate service reports.
  
• Manage firmware updates, backups, and storage/retention checks.
  
  
4. Site Ownership & Coordination
  
• Act as the single point of contact for assigned sites.
  
• Coordinate with clients, IT teams, civil/electrical contractors, and OEM/vendor support.
  
• Manage material requirements, site stock, and RMA/warranty claims.
  
• Brief and guide junior technicians and helpers on site.
  
  
5. Documentation & Reporting
  
• Maintain IP schedules, network diagrams, asset registers, and handover documents.
  
• Submit daily/weekly progress and service reports.
  
• Obtain client sign-offs for commissioning and closure.
  
Required Skills & Qualifications
  
Education: Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Electronics, Electrical, IT, or a related field (ITI with strong experience may be considered).
  
Technical skills:
  
• Hands-on experience with IP CCTV brands (Hikvision, Dahua, CP Plus, Axis, Hanwha, etc.).
  
• Solid understanding of TCP/IP, subnetting, VLANs, DHCP, NAT, and PoE.
  
• Experience with managed switches (Cisco, D-Link, TP-Link, Netgear, or similar).
  
• Knowledge of structured cabling (CAT6, fibre splicing/OTDR basics) and testing tools.
  
• Familiarity with VMS platforms, NVR/storage sizing, and video analytics basics.
  
• Comfortable using laptop, crimping/testing tools, and network diagnostic utilities.
  
Good to have:
  
• CCNA, CompTIA Network+, or OEM certifications.
  
• Exposure to access control, biometrics, fire alarm, or PA systems.
  
• Experience with ticketing/CRM tools.
  
• Basic understanding of cybersecurity hygiene for IP cameras (password policies, firmware, port hardening).
  
Soft skills:
  
• Strong troubleshooting and ownership mindset.
  
• Clear communication with clients and vendors.
  
• Ability to work independently and manage multiple sites.
  
• Willingness to travel and handle on-call or after-hours support.
  
Key Performance Indicators
  
• SLA adherence and mean time to resolve
  
• First-time-fix rate
  
• Installation quality and timely commissioning
  
• Client satisfaction and repeat-call reduction
  
• Accuracy of documentation and reports

Atos designs, develops, and operates critical digital environments that drive performance, resilience and sovereignty, helping public and private organizations worldwide retain control over their data and infrastructures, while meeting regulatory requirements.
  
  
With more than 52,000 employees serving over 4,500 clients across 54 countries, Atos helps modernize core IT systems, accelerate cloud and data transformation, strengthen cybersecurity, and deliver secure digital workplace environments to support its clients, its employees and society. Atos also provides consulting and advisory services through its Atos Amplify brand.
  
  
A trusted partner in operating complex and mission-critical environments, Atos supports organizations across highly regulated and sovereign contexts.
  
  
**About Atos Group**
Atos Group is a global leader in digital transformation with c. 54,000 employees and annual revenue of c. €7.2 billion, operating in 54 countries under two brands - Atos for services and Eviden for products and systems. European number one in cybersecurity and a leader in cloud, Atos Group is committed to a secure and decarbonized future and provides tailored AI-powered, end-to-end solutions for all industries. Atos Group is listed on Euronext Paris.
  
  
**Work Location**
Bengaluru
  
  
**Experience**
5+ Years
  
  
**Role Overview**
Okta Support Consultant Primary Focus Okta operations, application integration, authentication security, and production support.
  
  
The Okta Support Consultant is responsible for providing operational and engineering support for the enterprise workforce identity environment.
  
  
The role focuses on maintaining secure and reliable authentication services, resolving incidents, implementing approved changes, onboarding applications, supporting identity lifecycle processes, and continuously improving operational controls.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Administer and support Okta Workforce Identity, including users, groups, application assignments, policies, roles, and tenant settings. Monitor Okta platform health, authentication events, MFA activity, agent status, and security alerts to ensure service reliability.
* Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot application integrations using SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SCIM, APIs, and provisioning technologies.
* Support MFA and passwordless authentication solutions, including Okta Verify, FastPass, Adaptive MFA, and phishing-resistant authentication.
* Manage user access lifecycle activities, including provisioning, deprovisioning, profile updates, entitlement management, and license optimization.
* Monitor and troubleshoot AD, LDAP, RADIUS integrations, directory synchronization, delegated authentication, and provisioning processes.
* Investigate and resolve complex authentication, federation, provisioning, certificate, and application access issues.
* Support critical incidents, perform containment actions, coordinate with stakeholders, and contribute to root cause analysis and remediation.
* Execute production changes through approved change management processes, ensuring proper planning, testing, implementation, validation, and communication.

**Required Skills And Experience**

* 5+ years of IAM experience, including 3+ years of hands-on Okta administration, engineering, or production support.
* Strong knowledge of Okta Workforce Identity, SSO, MFA, Universal Directory, authentication policies, and lifecycle management.
* Hands-on experience with SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SCIM, REST APIs, JIT provisioning, federation, and certificate management.
* Experience supporting Active Directory, LDAP, RADIUS, delegated authentication, and identity integrations.
* Proficiency in troubleshooting authentication and provisioning issues using Okta and related system logs.
* Good understanding of IAM security controls, RBAC, MFA, audit logging, certificate management, and least-privilege access.
* Experience with incident, problem, request, and change management in ITSM environments.
* Ability to create and maintain technical documentation, runbooks, knowledge articles, and audit records.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to engage technical and business stakeholders effectively.
* Ability to work independently, manage priorities, mitigate risks, and provide technical guidance to team members.

**Preferred Skills And Qualifications**

* Experience with Okta Workflows, API automation, reporting automation, and scripting using PowerShell or Python.
* Knowledge of Okta Access Gateway, FastPass, Adaptive MFA, Device Access, SIEM integration, and hybrid application integrations.
* Familiarity with ServiceNow and collaboration with security, audit, compliance, infrastructure, and application teams.
* Experience supporting identity and access management services in regulated or audit-driven enterprise environments.

**Preferred Certifications**

* Okta Certified Professional or Okta Certified Administrator.

**Support Model**

* The role is expected to support normal US business-hours operations and participate in severity-based escalation or on-call coverage for critical incidents when assigned.
* On-call coverage for Weekend, P1 and P2 events

title: Field Application Engineer (FAE) – India
description:
**Job Summary:**

We are seeking a proactive Field Application Engineer (FAE) to support our business expansion in India. This role is responsible for providing technical expertise and application support for industrial computing and edge AI solutions, working closely with the sales and engineering teams to deliver optimal solutions to customers. The ideal candidate will have strong technical knowledge in embedded and/or industrial systems, excellent problem-solving skills, and the ability to support customers throughout the design-in and deployment process.

**Major Job Responsibilities and Duties:**

1. Pre-sales Technical Support & Solution Design

I. Work closely with the India sales team to provide technical consultation and solution recommendations for customers.

II. Analyze customer requirements and propose suitable solutions based on ADLINK’s industrial computing, edge AI, or embedded platforms.

III. Support technical discussions, product demonstrations, and proof-of-concept (POC) activities.

IV. Assist in preparing technical documentation, proposals, and responses for RFQs/RFPs.

2. Application Engineering & Customer Support

I. Support customers during product evaluation, system design, and design-in stages.

II. Provide technical guidance for system integration, application development, and deployment.

III. Troubleshoot technical issues and assist customers in debugging and optimizing system performance.

IV. Deliver technical training and knowledge transfer to customers and partners when necessary.

3. Cross-functional Collaboration & Market Feedback

I. Collaborate with RMA teams to determine whether a product requires RMA processing. Collect detailed technical information from customers, including System configuration, Error logs, Operating environment, and Failure symptoms. Assist RMA engineers in conducting failure analysis and help identify whether issues are related to Hardware defects, Software bugs, Configuration errors, and Improper usage.

II. Work closely with product management and engineering teams to escalate and resolve complex technical issues.

III. Collect market insights and customer feedback to support product improvement and new solution development.

**Basic Qualifications:**

1. Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, or related field).
2. 3–6 years of experience in Field Application Engineering, Technical Support, or Embedded/Industrial System Engineering.
3. Familiarity with industrial PCs, embedded systems, edge computing platforms, or industrial automation solutions.
4. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills with a customer-oriented mindset.
5. Ability to travel domestically for customer visits, technical support, and project discussions.
6. Language: Fluency in English (spoken and written) is essential.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

1. Experience with industrial communication protocols (e.g., Modbus, EtherCAT, CAN, or similar).
2. Knowledge of Linux/Windows embedded systems, edge AI, machine vision, or industrial IoT applications.
3. Experience supporting system integrators or OEM customers in industrial or automation markets.
4. Self-driven, hands-on, and able to work independently in a fast-paced environment.

**Number of Openings: 2**

title: Avionics Technical Support Engineer
description:
**About Acron Aviation (Avionics – Aftermarket)**
Acron Aviation designs, engineers, and manufactures certified avionics systems that support safety-critical flight operations across commercial and military aviation. Our avionics portfolio includes surveillance, recorders, displays, and related systems developed in regulated environments and deployed on aircraft worldwide. Through our Aftermarket organization, we support operators, OEMs, and maintenance providers by delivering technical expertise, product support, reliability improvements, and lifecycle sustainment solutions that maximize system availability and customer value. This work requires close collaboration across engineering, operations, quality, and customer support teams to ensure safe, reliable, and effective in-service performance.
  
  
**Job Title**
**Avionics Technical Support Engineer – Aftermarket**
**Position Summary**
We are seeking a motivated Technical Support Engineer to provide high-quality technical support for a range of avionics systems, including flight recorders, electronic standby instruments, SATCOM, TCAS, and TAWS. This role is well-suited for candidates with a strong technical foundation and a passion for problem-solving who want to build deeper expertise in aviation technology.
  
  
As part of the technical support organization, you will assist customers with troubleshooting, maintenance, and operational guidance while collaborating closely with internal teams to resolve issues and improve product performance. The role also emphasizes the use of automation and AI to improve field service outcomes, including faster diagnostics, smarter maintenance workflows, and automated reporting, with a continuous improvement mindset focused on reducing repeat issues and improving uptime, quality, and response time.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as a primary point of contact for customer technical inquiries, ensuring timely and accurate support
* Assist in troubleshooting and diagnosing issues related to supported avionics products
* Use Salesforce to track, manage, and document customer interactions and support cases
* Support continuous improvement initiatives related to technical support processes and tools
* Participate in product reliability reviews and assist in identifying trends in failure modes
* Collaborate with engineering teams on root cause analysis and corrective actions
* Contribute to the development of service bulletins and technical documentation
* Assist in creating and delivering customer training related to product installation, maintenance, and repair
* Provide input for proposals, quotations, and product support agreements as required
* Travel internationally to customer sites and other Acron facilities as needed to provide on-site support and product training
* Communicate clearly and effectively with customers, peers, and leadership, delivering presentations appropriate to technical and non-technical audiences

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Aviation, or a related field, or equivalent technical experience
* 2–5 years of experience in technical support, avionics, or a related field preferred
* Basic knowledge of digital electronics and RF systems; familiarity with avionics systems preferred
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills and the ability to collaborate across teams
* Self-starter with a strong work ethic and willingness to learn and grow
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office
* Proficiency in Salesforce
* Experience using automation and AI tools to streamline workflows and improve operational efficiency
* Demonstrated a continuous improvement mindset, with the ability to evaluate processes and implement more effective ways of working
* Ability to adopt and promote automation and AI tools to improve team speed, quality, and execution

**Preferred Additional Skills**

* Experience supporting commercial avionics products in a customer-facing or technical support environment
* Familiarity with flight recorders, electronic standby instruments, SATCOM, TCAS, TAWS, or related avionics systems
* Experience preparing technical documentation, service bulletins, or customer training materials
* Exposure to reliability analysis, root cause investigations, and corrective action processes
* Experience working with airline, OEM, MRO, or aviation customers
* Understanding of aviation maintenance practices and operational environments
* Ability to work effectively across global teams and multiple time zones

title: Application Support Engineer
description:
**About The Role**
Greystar's teams make decisions that shape how we serve residents and investors worldwide, and they depend on technology that works. Our Global Technology team builds and runs the platforms behind that work: the analytics, AI-driven, and customer-facing products our teams use every day, along with the data foundation and business-critical reporting systems beneath them. Focused product teams, embedded with the business, keep that portfolio moving. As AI becomes core to how Greystar operates, the reliability of these products matters more every quarter. As a Support Engineer based in India, you will be the primary point of contact for Greystar team members around the world using any of these products. You will work closely with the product teams and our Cloud Engineering engineers, and partner with our IT Service Desk so product issues reach you and device or access issues reach them.
  
  
**What You'll Do Be The First Line Of Support**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for Greystar team members using any product built and run by Global Technology.
* Triage, prioritize, and resolve L1/L2 requests in ServiceNow, setting clear expectations on status and timing.
* Diagnose issues using logs, dashboards, and application behavior, and resolve them directly wherever possible.
* Escalate to Cloud Engineering or the owning product team with full context (repro steps, impact, logs, what has been tried) so nothing bounces back. Protect Product Health
* Monitor product health in Datadog (dashboards, monitors, alerts) and act on user impacting issues before users report them.
* Partner with product teams and Cloud Engineering during incidents: communicate status to users, support triage, and contribute to post-incident reviews.

title: Staff Technical Support Engineer - SASE ( NAM shift)
description:
**Our Mission**
At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. **The Team**
Customer Support - Our Customer Support team is critical to our success and mission. As threats and technology change, we stay in step to accomplish our mission. You will work directly with customers to troubleshoot and resolve complex issues in Prisma SD-WAN deployments across on-prem and cloud environments. 8+ years of experience in technical support, network engineering, or a related role

Experience troubleshooting real-world network issues (routing behavior, connectivity, stability, etc.)
  
  
Experience with packet captures, logs, and basic network debugging tools
  
  
Experience working in customer-facing situations, especially during critical or time-sensitive issues

Experience with SD-WAN platforms (Prisma SD-WAN or similar)
  
  
Exposure to cloud networking (AWS, Azure)
  
  
Familiarity with hybrid environments (on-prem + cloud)

title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Role Overview**
We are looking for a Cloud Support Engineer with basic knowledge of Linux and cloud infrastructure to assist with day-to-day infrastructure operations, monitoring, troubleshooting, and user support.
  
  
The candidate should understand Linux fundamentals, basic networking, virtual machines, storage, and cloud concepts. The role is suitable for someone who has foundational knowledge and is willing to learn through hands-on work under the guidance of senior engineers.
  
  
Basic exposure to a cloud platform such as Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), AWS, Azure, or any cloud is preferred. Practical lab experience, academic projects, or personal hands-on practice will also be considered.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**




+ Provide first-level support for Linux servers and cloud infrastructure, and escalate complex issues to senior engineers.
+ Perform basic Linux administration tasks such as checking server status, disk and memory usage, processes, services, logs, and file permissions.
+ Assist with cloud virtual machine operations, including basic provisioning, starting, stopping, restarting, and checking instance health under supervision.
+ Understand basic cloud networking concepts such as VCN/VPC, subnets, IP addresses, route tables, DNS, security rules, and firewalls.
+ Assist in monitoring server and cloud resource availability, performance, and utilization.
+ Review system logs and monitoring alerts, identify basic issues, and share clear findings with the senior support or infrastructure team.
+ Support routine tasks such as service checks, backups verification, file transfers, and basic configuration checks by following documented procedures.
+ Assist with troubleshooting connectivity, SSH access, disk space, service availability, and basic application-hosting issues.
+ Work with application, development, and infrastructure teams to support deployments and resolve basic environment-related issues.
+ Follow security practices for user access, SSH keys, permissions, passwords, firewall rules, and handling of credentials.
+ Maintain accurate support tickets, operational notes, checklists, and infrastructure documentation.

**Required Skills & Knowledge**




+ 0 to 2 years of experience in IT support, Linux administration, system administration, or cloud support. Freshers with strong fundamentals and hands-on lab practice may also apply.
+ Basic understanding of cloud computing concepts such as compute, storage, networking, regions, availability zones, and shared responsibility.
+ Basic Linux knowledge, preferably Ubuntu, Debian, or RHEL-based systems, including common commands such as ls, cd, cp, mv, grep, find, df, du, free, top, ps, systemctl, journalctl, and ssh.
+ Understanding of networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, IP addressing, subnetting basics, DNS, DHCP, ports, routing, ping, traceroute, and SSH.
+ Basic understanding of virtual machines, disks, snapshots, images, and backup concepts.
+ Ability to perform basic troubleshooting using logs, command-line tools, and documented procedures.
+ Basic knowledge of users, groups, file permissions, processes, services, package management, and disk management in Linux.
+ Awareness of security fundamentals such as least privilege, MFA, SSH key-based access, patching, firewall rules, and secure password handling.
+ Basic command-line scripting knowledge in Bash is preferred. Python or PowerShell familiarity is an advantage.
+ Good problem-solving skills, willingness to learn, and the ability to communicate technical findings clearly.

**Good to Have**




+ Hands-on exposure to OCI, AWS, Azure, or GCP through a job, internship, home lab, or training environment.
+ Basic familiarity with cloud consoles and services such as virtual machines, virtual networks, storage, IAM, and monitoring.
+ Exposure to web servers such as NGINX or Apache and basic application service management.
+ Basic familiarity with databases, Docker, Git, or CI/CD concepts.
+ Entry-level cloud or Linux certification, such as OCI Foundations, AWS Cloud Practitioner, Azure Fundamentals, or Linux Essentials.
+ Basic exposure to VPN/IPSec concepts, backup and restore procedures, and infrastructure automation tools.

**Educational Qualification**




+ Graduate or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related technical field. Candidates with relevant practical skills and lab experience may also be considered.
+ Linux or cloud training/certification is an added advantage, but not mandatory.

**Soft Skills**




+ Clear verbal and written communication.
+ Ability to follow instructions, procedures, and escalation processes.
+ Curiosity and willingness to learn Linux, cloud platforms, and infrastructure operations.
+ Attention to detail, ownership of assigned tasks, and proper documentation.

title: BMC Helix ITSM /CMDB Platform Administrator
description:
TransUnion's Job Applicant Privacy Notice
  
  
**Team Overview**
Global team responsible for the implementation, administration, maintenance, and continuous improvement of enterprise-wide IT Service Management (ITSM), Asset Management, and Business-Critical Communication platforms. The team ensures the availability, reliability, security, and strategic alignment of these services to support business operations across a global organization. This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week.
  
  
**Role Overview And Core Responsibilities**
Role Overview
  
  
The ITSM Platform Administrator is responsible for the administration, maintenance, enhancement, and operational support of the organization's enterprise IT Service Management (ITSM), Configuration Management Database (CMDB), Asset Management, and Critical Communications platforms. This role ensures the stability, performance, security, and continuous improvement of BMC Helix ITSM, CMDB/Asset Management, and MIR3 (OnSolve) solutions that support global business operations.
  
  
The ideal candidate possesses strong platform administration and troubleshooting skills, combined with a technical development background to design integrations, automate processes, develop custom reports, and deliver data-driven solutions that enhance service management capabilities across the enterprise.
  
  
Core Responsibilities
  
  
Platform Administration & Support
  
  

* Administer, maintain, and support BMC Helix ITSM, Asset Management, CMDB, and MIR3 (OnSolve) platforms.
* Monitor platform health, performance, availability, and capacity to ensure compliance with service level objectives.
* Perform system configuration, upgrades, patch management, and platform maintenance activities.
* Troubleshoot and resolve application, integration, and data-related issues in a timely manner.
* Coordinate with vendors, infrastructure teams, and business stakeholders to ensure platform reliability and continuous service improvement.

ITSM & Process Enablement
  
  

* Configure and support Incident, Problem, Change, Request Management, Knowledge Management, and Asset Management processes.
* Implement and maintain ITIL-aligned workflows, business rules, approvals, notifications, and automation capabilities.
* Support process optimization initiatives by identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, data quality, and user experience.
* Participate in platform governance activities, including change reviews, release validation, and system documentation.

CMDB & Asset Management
  
  

* Maintain the integrity, accuracy, and completeness of the Configuration Management Database (CMDB).
* Manage configuration item (CI) lifecycle processes, relationships, reconciliation, normalization, and discovery data integration.
* Ensure asset and configuration management best practices are implemented and maintained across the environment.
* Perform regular audits and data quality reviews to improve CMDB and asset data accuracy.

Critical Communication Platform Administration
  
  

* Administer and support the MIR3 (OnSolve) critical notification and emergency communication platform.
* Maintain notification groups, escalation procedures, templates, communication workflows, and contact data.
* Support emergency testing exercises and ensure communication processes remain operational and effective.
* Collaborate with business continuity, incident management, and operational teams to support critical communication requirements.

Development & Integration
  
  

* Develop and maintain small to medium-sized integrations between ITSM platforms and other enterprise applications.
* Create automation solutions using APIs, web services, scripting, and workflow technologies.
* Support data migration, synchronization, and interface development initiatives.
* Analyze business requirements and implement technical solutions that improve operational efficiency and data exchange.

Reporting & Analytics
  
  

* Design, develop, and maintain SQL-based operational, management, and compliance reports.
* Create dashboards, metrics, and performance reporting solutions that provide actionable insights to stakeholders.
* Support audit, compliance, and governance reporting requirements.
* Perform data analysis and validation to ensure report accuracy and consistency.

Documentation & Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Develop and maintain technical documentation, support procedures, and knowledge articles.
* Participate in platform enhancement projects and strategic initiatives.
* Recommend best practices, automation opportunities, and technology improvements.
* Stay current with industry trends, ITSM best practices, and platform capabilities.

**Preferred Qualifications**
**Required Knowledge And Experiences**

* Experience administering BMC Helix ITSM / Remedy ITSM / Service Now.
* Experience with BMC CMDB and Asset Management.
* Strong SQL development and reporting skills.
* Experience with REST APIs, integrations, and automation development.
* Knowledge on Python or Java or any other development Language.
* Knowledge of ITIL processes and service management best practices.
* Experience with data modeling, CMDB architecture, and data governance.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
* AI agent development experience.

**Analyst, Problem Management**

**Role Description Summary**
The Problem Management Analyst is responsible for driving the Problem Management process to improve availability and reliability of Intelsat products, services, and support. The primary objectives include incident prevention and/or minimizing incident impact. The problem analyst maintains information about Known Errors and Workarounds and drives continuous improvement through tracking and driving outcomes from recommendations associated to the register. This position evaluates continuous improvement opportunities to leverage business strategy with system, application, and process integration to support operations.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities / Key Result Areas**

* Schedule and facilitate a formal Post Incident Review or After-Action Review after the resolution of critical and major incidents.
* Perform extensive problem analysis, paying attention to detail of all current and previous problems to identify repeat issues or possible trends.
* Assign and track actions resulting from Post-Incident Reviews and proactive problem investigations, ensuring accountability and timely completion
* Address process and/or training gaps with applicable teams.
* Support the governance and execution of the Problem Management process and Problem Management lifecycle
* Proactively identify problems based on trend analysis from past incidents & monitoring data associated to possible performance deterioration
* Manage and monitor key metrics (SLA’s and KPI’s) from SES and customer perspective as they pertain to Problem Management
* Creates Executive Level Problem Summary and Reports
* Facilitates Problem Management reviews quarterly to review events with no root cause, continuous improvement items and reviews open tasks to determine relevance
* Perform any other functions or duties assigned to ensure workload balance and support
* Work with operational teams for chronic issues associated outages, bugs, network and service design issues, hardware, and software problems
* Drive processes that enable identification of chronic issues and establish expectations for resolution and prevention of recurring incidents
* Drive future solutions for continuous process improvement, design changes, vendor recommendations, automation capabilities, and process improvement opportunities
* Drive processes, methods and techniques for identifying problems and solutions.
* Update and/or archive Knowledge articles associated to the event or workarounds established.
* Provide weekly status report of all items determined to be chronic along with steps taken and next steps to bring resolution.
* Work on problems of diverse scope (low complexity to high complexity) where analysis of recurring issues requires evaluation of multiple operational, technical, and process-related factors

title: System Development Engineer I, Amazon
description:
**Description**
Amazon Selection and Catalog Systems (ASCS) builds the systems that host and run the world’s largest e-Commerce products catalog. We power the online buying experience for customers worldwide so they can find, discover, and buy anything they want. Our massively scaled out distributed systems process hundreds of millions of updates on the billions of products across physical, digital, and services offerings. To achieve this, we develop the algorithms and build the systems and tools to ensure the safety of the selection and maximize their impact on the Amazon top-line, all the while continuously growing the overall selection. We develop and apply technologies spanning parallel processing, storage, Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing, and Image Recognition.
  
  
You will be part of Services Support Team under Catalog Support and Programs (CSP) in ASCS Org. The mission of the Catalog Support and Programs (CSP) team is to provide a single point of contact for item-related problems and issues related to all retail and merchant catalog. As a member of ASCS team, you’ll play a key role in driving Amazon’s business. You will be responsible for providing Service Level issue support to all ASCS Engineering teams who built tier 1-3 systems and keep their software packages/configurations free from vulnerability, setup and monitor new metrics and alarms for their systems and drive root cause resolutions to the recurrent issues. You will build tools to improve operational efficiency.
  
  
This role requires an individual with excellent System/Tool coding abilities along with AWS services understanding. The successful candidate will be a self-starter, comfortable with ambiguity, have strong attention to detail, and will be comfortable accessing and working with data from multiple sources. The candidate should also have strong communication skills, enabling them to work with Engineering team to understand requirements and shape analytical deliverables. Candidate should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically and analytically about business, product, and technical challenges, with the ability to work cross-organizationally. A keen sense of ownership and drive is must. The role will work with a diverse set of data and cross-functional teams as well as use data to drive process improvement. An ideal engineer is one who enjoys discovering and solving ambiguous problems, can quickly learn complex systems, and enjoys building actionable insights from data.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* You handle all incoming system and service tickets with responsibilities covering multiple products, features and services.
* Software deployment support in staging and production environments.
* Given a defined problem, you deliver a solution which is logical, maintainable, that uses appropriate technologies, and is delivered on time.
* You learn current engineering best practices and get their designs, code & procedures reviewed, and incorporate feedback.
* You identify and scope problems and opportunities arising from technical discussions, calculate costs of proposed solutions, and make technical trade-offs.
* You contribute to operational excellence and perform troubleshooting to resolve defects.
* Drive Company Wide Campaigns and keep the Compliance risks (SAS, Shepherd etc.) for ASCS systems under control.

A day in the life
  
  
Big Picture: Solve problems at their root, stepping back to understand the broader context
  
  
Proactive: You display energy and initiative in solving problems.
  
  
Adaptable: You undertake a variety of tasks willingly. You switch from complex to routine tasks when required. You adapt quickly to new technologies and products.
  
  
Quality: You demonstrate appropriate quality and thoroughness.
  
  
Integrity: You act with personal integrity at all times
  
  
**About The Team**
Catalog Support and Programs (CSP) provides program management and WW user technical support as a single point of contact for issues related to catalog systems and tools. We own implementation of business logic and configurations for these services and systems. We increase selection by on-boarding new vendors, integrating new catalog feeds and by configuring new marketplace, merchant and category setups. We drive strategic cross-functional programs that span across multiple catalog engineering teams
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Experience in automating, deploying, and supporting infrastructure
* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Python, Ruby, Golang, Java, C++, C#, Rust
* Experience with Linux/Unix

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with CI/CD pipelines build processes

description:
**Job Description**
**Role Statement**
The ERP Second Level Support (RUN) Senior Analyst is accountable for ensuring advanced functional support and deep root-cause analysis for complex issues escalated from Triage and Junior Analysts, acting as the subject-matter expert for a specific Oracle EBS module.
  
  
This role contributes to stable operations by driving effective resolution, implementing preventive measures, and supporting continuous improvement of Oracle EBS processes. The Senior Analyst takes end-to-end ownership of complex tickets, designs and validates functional fixes and workarounds, and ensures structured ticket handover within the Follow-the-Sun model to deliver uninterrupted support coverage.
  
  
As a qualified first line of defense within the ERP Second Level Support team, this role partners with the Shift Manager, Domain Head, Junior Analysts, ERP Tech Factory, and ERP Product Specialists to ensure seamless escalation paths, high-quality resolution, and consistent service delivery aligned with the organization’s Run operating model.
  
  
**Key Duties**
Ticket Resolution & Backlog Management
  
  

* Take end-to-end ownership of complex tickets escalated from Triage and Junior Analysts, ensuring thorough analysis and resolution within SLA targets.
* Support prioritization and backlog management, especially for high-severity incidents, ensuring alignment with business impact and SLA requirements.
* Design, validate, and implement functional fixes and workarounds, confirming solution effectiveness with key business stakeholders.
* Generate structured ticket handover materials to ensure continuity in the Follow-the-Sun model.

Root-Cause Analysis & Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Perform in-depth root-cause analysis for complex or non-standard incidents, accurately identifying underlying functional and process failures.
* Define corrective actions and drive preventive measures to reduce recurring incidents and improve process stability.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying patterns, proposing configuration or process enhancements, and sharing findings with the broader team.

**Escalation & Collaboration**

* Promptly engage the ERP Product Specialist when additional expertise is required or challenges arise beyond functional scope.
* Escalate unresolved issues to ERP Tech Factory, providing comprehensive documentation of analysis performed and resolution attempts.
* Provide updates on solution design and technically resolved tickets to the Shift Manager and relevant stakeholders.
* Participate in cross-functional stand-ups to remove blockers and accelerate cross-module resolution.
* Coordinate cross-module and cross-team activities as assigned, ensuring alignment of timelines, dependencies, and deliverables across stakeholders involved in incident resolution or improvement initiatives.

**Governance & Knowledge Management**

* Maintain and enhance knowledge assets, including functional documentation, troubleshooting guides, and known-error records.
* Support regression, UAT, and hypercare testing to ensure operational readiness for releases.
* Drive the adoption of enabling technologies (ServiceNow, Oracle EBS, SharePoint) for efficient ticket tracking and resolution documentation.

**Required**
**Qualification and Experience**

* 3–5 years of experience in Oracle EBS functional roles with exposure to complex incident management.
* Established specialization in at least one Oracle EBS module (e.g., Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Finance, Services).
* Proven experience in handling complex, unstructured, or cross-module incidents.
* Deep understanding of end-to-end business processes related to the assigned Oracle EBS module.
* Advanced capability in conducting root-cause analysis and translating findings into actionable corrective measures.
* Proficiency in executing low-risk functional configurations following fit-to-standard principles.
* Strong analytical thinking and structured problem-solving skills.
* High sense of ownership and end-to-end accountability.
* Effective communication and stakeholder management, including in international contexts.

**Preferred**

* Experience working in Follow-the-Sun or shift-based global support models.
* Familiarity with ITIL-aligned incident management frameworks and tools (ServiceNow).
* Background in ERP support environments within manufacturing or industrial organizations.
* Knowledge of continuous improvement methodologies and preventive maintenance approaches.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* SLA compliance rate
* Mean Time to Resolve (MTTR)
* First Contact Resolution rate (FCR)
* ERP incident recurrence rate
* Ticket re-open rate
* Knowledge base contribution rate

**About Us**

Safety. Integrity. Respect. Teamwork. Inclusion.
  
  
**OUR STRATEGIC PRIORITIES**

* High-Performance Culture
* Customer Focus
* Operational Excellence
* Innovation
* Financial Strength

* Own it
* Act with urgency

Vertiv (NYSE: VRT) brings together hardware, software, analytics and ongoing services to enable its customers’ vital applications to run continuously, perform optimally and grow with their business needs. description:
Product Support Engineer

**BrightEdge | Technical Support | 1–3 Years Experience | EST Shifts - 4:30 PM to 1:30 AM IST**

**BrightEdge | Experience: 2–5 Years**

About BrightEdge

BrightEdge is a global leader in enterprise SEO and content performance technology, helping some of the world's largest brands improve their digital presence, increase organic search visibility, and drive measurable business outcomes. Our AI-powered platform enables enterprise marketing teams to optimize digital content and stay ahead of the evolving search landscape.

Role Overview

We are looking for a technically strong and customer-oriented Product Support Engineer to join our global support team.

In this role, you will provide technical assistance to enterprise customers using the BrightEdge platform. You will troubleshoot application issues, investigate data discrepancies, resolve API and integration challenges, and work closely with Engineering, Product, and Customer Success teams to ensure timely resolution of technical problems.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience supporting SaaS applications, writing SQL queries, testing REST APIs using Postman, and analyzing application logs to identify root causes.

Key Responsibilities

* Provide technical support to enterprise customers through ticketing systems, email, and other support channels.
* Investigate and resolve application-related issues involving platform functionality, reporting, dashboards, data processing, and user access.
* Write SQL queries to validate data, investigate discrepancies, and troubleshoot database-related issues.
* Test and troubleshoot REST APIs using Postman or similar tools.
* Analyze application logs, error messages, and system responses to identify root causes.
* Troubleshoot integration failures, authentication issues, API errors, and connectivity problems.
* Use browser Developer Tools and network inspection techniques to investigate web application issues.
* Manage customer cases end-to-end, ensuring SLA adherence, timely communication, and proper documentation.
* Escalate complex technical issues to Engineering and Development teams with detailed reproduction steps and supporting evidence.
* Maintain technical documentation, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge base articles.
* Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams to improve product quality and customer experience.

Required Qualifications

* 2–5 years of experience in Technical Support, Product Support, Application Support, Software Support, or a similar technical role.
* Hands-on experience troubleshooting enterprise SaaS applications or web-based software products.
* Working knowledge of REST APIs, HTTP methods, status codes, and API request/response structures.
* Practical experience using Postman or similar tools for API testing and debugging.
* Ability to write basic to intermediate SQL queries, including SELECT, JOIN, WHERE, and GROUP BY.
* Experience analyzing application logs, error messages, and technical issues.
* Familiarity with ticketing platforms such as Salesforce, Jira, Zendesk, ServiceNow, or similar.
* Understanding of HTTP/HTTPS, browser Developer Tools, and basic networking concepts.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a customer-first mindset.

Preferred Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Familiarity with relational databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or Oracle.
* Understanding of authentication concepts including SSO, OAuth, SAML, and RBAC.
* Exposure to JSON, XML, SOAP APIs, and integration troubleshooting.
* Basic understanding of cloud environments, DNS, SSL/TLS, firewalls, and proxies.
* Familiarity with Power BI or similar reporting tools, including dashboards, filters, and data refresh processes.
* Exposure to AI-assisted troubleshooting and technical documentation tools.

What We Look For

A proactive problem solver who takes ownership of customer issues, approaches troubleshooting systematically, communicates technical findings clearly, and enjoys learning new technologies. The ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with global cross-functional teams is essential.

title: Power BI Platform Support Administrator
description:
**Power BI Platform Support Administrator**

**Experience:**
6–10 years in BI platform support/administration, including 3+ years on Power BI Service.

**Role summary**

Administer and support the Power BI / Microsoft Fabric tenant and on-premises SSRS. Manage licences, workspaces, gateways and user access, and resolve access and performance issues for report developers and business users.

**Key responsibilities**

1. **License management**
   — issue, reassign and reclaim Power BI Pro / Premium Per User licenses via Microsoft 365 admin center or group-based licensing; track usage and renewals.
2. **User troubleshooting**
   — resolve access issues (workspace roles, app audiences, RLS/OLS, sharing, Entra ID groups) and performance issues (slow visuals, refresh failures, Direct Query latency, model size).
3. **Workspace assignment**
   — create and assign workspaces to Fabric capacity (F SKUs), Premium capacity or shared (non-Fabric) capacity; apply naming and ownership standards.
4. **Gateway configuration**
   — install and configure on-premises data gateways (standard mode and clusters); manage data source connections, credentials and gateway admins.
5. **Gateway updates**
   — apply monthly gateway releases; test, schedule and roll back if needed; monitor gateway health and logs.
6. **SSRS (on-prem)**
   — administer SQL Server Reporting Services: report server configuration, folder security, subscriptions, data sources, upgrades and SSL certificates; support Power BI Report Server where used.

**Additional responsibilities**

* **Tenant settings**
  — manage Power BI / Fabric admin portal settings (export, sharing, Copilot, Fabric item creation) in line with governance policy.
* **Capacity monitoring**
  — use the Fabric Capacity Metrics app to track CU usage, throttling and overloads; recommend scaling or workload moves.
* **Refresh management**
  — monitor scheduled refreshes; set up incremental refresh; troubleshoot credential and timeout errors.
* **Deployment pipelines**
  — support DEV/TEST/PROD promotion using Power BI deployment pipelines and Git integration.
* **Security and governance**
  — sensitivity labels (Microsoft Purview), endorsement (promoted/certified), audit and activity logs.
* **Automation**
  — PowerShell (MicrosoftPowerBIMgmt) and Power BI REST / Fabric REST APIs for inventory, access reports and licence audits.
* **Snowflake connectivity**
  — support Power BI connections to Snowflake (SSO, DirectQuery, gateway driver configuration).
* **User enablement**
  — maintain knowledge base articles, onboarding guides and office hours.

**Required skills**

* Power BI Service and Fabric administration; on-premises data gateway.
* Microsoft 365 / Entra ID user, group and licence management.
* SSRS administration.
* Working knowledge of DAX, Power Query and data modelling to diagnose performance.
* PowerShell and REST API scripting.

**Preferred skills**

* DAX Studio, Tabular Editor, Performance Analyzer, VertiPaq Analyzer.
* Fabric workloads: Lakehouse, Warehouse, Dataflows Gen2, Data Pipelines.
* ServiceNow/Jira ticketing; ITIL practices.
* Tableau or other BI tools (for migration support).

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT or related field.
* Preferred certifications: Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst (PL-300), Fabric Analytics Engineer (DP-600), Fabric Data Engineer (DP-700).

title: Payroll Operations Consultant - Product Solutioning
description:
**Role: Payroll Operations Consultant – Product Solutioning**
**Location: Hyderabad**
**Darwinbox**
is the fastest-growing HR technology platform, designing the future of work by building the world's best HR tech, driven by a fierce focus on employee experience and customer success, and continuous, iterative innovation. We are the preferred choice of 900+ global enterprises to manage their 2.5 million+ employees across 116+ countries.
  
  
Darwinbox's new-age HCM suite competes with local as well as global players in the enterprise technology space (such as SAP, Oracle, and Workday). The firm has acquired notable customers ranging from large conglomerates to unicorn start-ups: DP World, Masafi, DIFC, Abu Dhabi Department of Finance, Nivea, Starbucks, Swiggy, DLF, Crisil, CRED, Vedanta, Mahindra, Glenmark, Gokongwei Group, Mitra Adiperkasa, EFS Facilities Management, VNG Corporation, and many more.
  
  
Our vision of building a world-class product company from Asia is backed by marquee global investors like Microsoft, Salesforce, Sequoia Capital, and Lightspeed Venture Partners.
  
  
**About the role:**
As a Payroll Operations Consultant, you are the
**first line of support for our clients**
on everything payroll. Clients come to you with questions, edge cases, and issues - and they expect clear, confident answers, fast. Your job is to understand the query, troubleshoot it on the spot wherever possible, and drive it to a clean resolution while keeping the client informed at every step.
  
  
**This is a client-facing role at heart.**
You will spend your day in conversation - on calls, on chat, and over email - so you should be comfortable holding a discussion with a client, explaining what is happening, and following through until the matter is closed. When an issue turns out to be a product bug rather than a configuration or data question, you
**become the bridge**
to our product team: you raise it, chase it, and stay on it until it is fixed.
  
  
***What you’ll do:***

* Own client payroll queries end to end - receive them through Ask Darwin and other support channels, understand the underlying problem, and troubleshooting to resolve them as quickly as possible.
* Bring strong payroll fundamentals to every conversation - understand payroll processing, statutory components, wage codes, and common processing scenarios well enough to diagnose issues without handholding.
* Hold clear, confident client conversations - be comfortable getting on a call or a chat, walking a client through an issue, and setting the right expectations on timelines.
* Document minutes of meeting (MOM) for client discussions and circulate them , so that actions, owners, and timelines are captured and agreed.
* Send timely, proactive status updates to clients - keep them informed on open items rather than waiting to be chased.
* Unlock clients when they are blocked - identify what is holding up their payroll run and clear the path so they can proceed.
* Identify product issues and escalate them to the product team with clear, well-documented context - then follow up persistently and drive the fix to closure.
* Track all open items to resolution, ensuring nothing slips through and every query reaches a defined outcome.

***What we are looking for/Who should apply:***

* 3+ years of experience in payroll operations, payroll support, or a closely related finance/HR function .
* Solid, hands-on understanding of payroll - you can reason through a payroll query and know where things typically go wrong.
* A confident communicator who does not hesitate to talk to clients - comfortable on calls, on chatting, and in writing.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving instincts, with the ability to diagnose and resolve issues under time pressure.
* A genuine self-starter - you take ownership, chase issues down, and follow through to closure without being reminded.
* Comfortable documenting clearly - MOMs, status updates, and issue write-ups - and proficiency with Email, MS Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
* Willingness to learn HRMS/payroll technology systems; prior exposure to an HRMS platform is an added advantage.
* We are looking for people who take ownership, push through until the job is done, communicate clearly, adapt fast, are comfortable in front of clients, and have a bias for closing things out.

Your potential will never be wasted. You'll get the space and support to take your development to the next level. Every day, there will be opportunities to learn from peers and leaders through working on exciting, varied projects with real impact. And because our work spans so many different businesses, from Research and Product Development to Sales, you'll keep learning exciting new approaches.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking an experienced IT&D Senior Analyst – Core Infrastructure to support the design, implementation, and operational management of enterprise Data Center and Core Infrastructure across global and manufacturing environments. The role ensures secure, scalable, and high-performing infrastructure supporting business-critical applications, IT/OT integration, and cloud connectivity.It also drives infrastructure modernization across virtualization, hybrid cloud (Azure Local), storage, backup and disaster recovery, PKI, and automation, while ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, security, and compliance standards through close collaboration with internal teams and vendors.
