* Implement and manage virtualization platforms including VMware vSphere, vCenter, ESXi, and Azure Local environments.Support Windows Server infrastructure including Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, and core enterprise services.
* Manage backup and disaster recovery solutions using Veeam and Commvault to ensure business continuity and resilience.
* Support enterprise storage infrastructure including NAS platforms, replication, snapshots, storage virtualization, and performance optimization.
* Design and maintain PKI infrastructure including Certificate Authorities (CA), certificate lifecycle management, and encryption services.
* Support Citrix environments including Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops, Citrix ADC (NetScaler), and Citrix Cloud platforms.

* Support IT/OT integration initiatives across manufacturing environments ensuring secure and reliable connectivity.Contribute to disaster recovery, business continuity, and high availability architecture design and implementation.
* Drive automation, standardization, operational efficiency, and infrastructure modernization initiatives through DevOps and infrastructure-as-code practices.Collaborate with infrastructure, cybersecurity, cloud, manufacturing, application, and vendor teams for delivery and operational support.
* Monitor infrastructure performance, troubleshoot incidents, perform root cause analysis, and implement corrective actions.Develop technical architecture documentation (TAS), standards, governance reports, and operational metrics.
* Evaluate and recommend emerging technologies to enhance infrastructure performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.

The experience we're looking for
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.Strong experience with Windows Server environments including Active Directory, Group Policy, and DNS.
* Proven expertise in VMware virtualization technologies (vSphere, vCenter, ESXi) and Hyper-V.
* Experience with Azure Local and hybrid cloud infrastructure environments.Strong knowledge of enterprise backup solutions such as Veeam and Commvault.
* Hands-on experience with enterprise storage systems including NAS, replication, snapshots, and storage virtualization.
* Understanding of PKI concepts including Certificate Authorities, digital certificates, encryption, and lifecycle management.
* Experience with Citrix technologies including Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops, Citrix ADC (NetScaler), and Citrix Cloud.
* Good understanding of infrastructure security, disaster recovery, and business continuity principles.
* Knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks such as NIST and IEC 62443 is an advantage.Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with ability to work across technical and non-technical teams.

The skills for success
  
  
VMware virtualization, Windows Server administration, storage, backup & disaster recovery, hybrid cloud (Azure Local), PKI, Citrix, and infrastructure security, VMware vSphere, vCenter, ESXi, Hyper-V, Active Directory, DNS,Citrix, and Group Policy.

With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.
  
  
Equality

title: Network Support Engineer
description:
**About Opplane**

Opplane helps organizations unlock the value of their data in a world increasingly shaped by artificial intelligence, connectivity, and regulation.

We work with businesses across complex, data-intensive industries to turn fragmented or difficult-to-use data into trusted, actionable intelligence. Our work spans connectivity technologies, AI and data solutions for banking and fintech, and data governance and modernization.

Our founders and leadership team bring decades of experience in networking, wireless and telecom, having built and scaled multiple technology companies, several of them acquired by leading networking and technology players. Drawing on years of selling networking infrastructure, we are involved in building critical infrastructure for telecom operators, developing carrier-grade, software-based solutions that help them deliver secure, scalable connectivity to their enterprise customers.

**Why this role matters**

Our connectivity solutions run in the networks of major telecom operators. When their network teams raise an issue, they need a fast, competent response from someone who understands networking and stays calm under pressure.

You’ll be that first point of contact: taking client calls, working out what’s happening and driving issues to resolution, with the support of our senior network engineers. What you see in real client environments also matters beyond each ticket. Your input will help shape the new products we’re developing.

**What you’ll do**

* Be the first point of contact for client network teams, taking their calls and working issues through to resolution
* Troubleshoot issues across the IP layer, routing and authentication, using logs such as Syslog and the tools available
* Contact clients proactively when needed to gather information, test fixes or follow up on open tickets
* Escalate clearly and promptly to senior engineers when an issue needs deeper investigation
* Keep clients informed during critical issues, explaining what we’re seeing and what happens next
* Document issues, root causes and resolutions, and share the patterns you see with the team
* Build a solid understanding of our connectivity products and how they run in client networks

**What you’ll bring**

Experience and expertise

* 3+ years of experience as a network engineer, ideally in data centre environments
* Hands-on experience with virtualised compute environments
* Solid networking fundamentals, especially IPv4 and IP addressing, and how devices obtain and use network configuration
* Working knowledge of at least one routing protocol
* Familiarity with authentication protocols
* Ability to read and interpret logs such as Syslog
* Hands-on experience with network equipment from at least one vendor (e.g. Cisco, Juniper, Nokia or Ericsson)
* Good written and spoken English

How you work

* You stay calm and structured under pressure, including with demanding clients
* You’re curious and proactive, and you dig into problems rather than waiting for instructions
* You know when to keep going on an issue and when to escalate
* You communicate clearly with client operations teams and colleagues, on calls and in writing
* You learn quickly on the job and from the people around you

Nice to have

* Knowledge of mobile networks (4G/5G core, EPC, private mobile networks)
* Experience in a NOC, operator or managed services environment
* Relevant networking certifications

**What you’ll have the opportunity to do**

* Work directly with the network teams of major telecom operators on real production issues
* Build expertise in our connectivity products, including mobile network technologies, with support from senior engineers
* Help shape new products through what you learn from real client issue

**How we work**

Small team, big challenges, real ownership. At Opplane, you’ll work on software and technology across data, AI and connectivity, helping build solutions that address complex technical and business needs. You’ll have access to leadership, opportunities to contribute to technical decisions and room to influence how we approach problems and build our products.

Depending on your role, you may collaborate with colleagues, clients and stakeholders across the US, Portugal and India. Our work brings together different areas of expertise and perspectives, making it important to stay curious, exchange ideas and understand the challenges others are working to solve. We value people who take initiative, share their knowledge and bring new perspectives to the way we work.

Ultimately, it’s about bringing people and technology together to build solutions that meet today’s needs and anticipate tomorrow’s challenges.

**Interested?**

If this opportunity sounds like a good fit for your experience and the kind of work you want to do, we’d like to hear from you.

Apply to learn more about the role and how you could contribute to Opplane.

*Opplane is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of gender, gender identity, disability, religion, caste, age or background.*

title: IT Executive - Flight Simulator Operations
description:
Gen24 Flybiz offers comprehensive services for aspiring pilots, airlines, and training organisations. In 2025, the Avion Flight Training Centre Mumbai - operated by Gen24 - will be opened.

  

At our facility, pilots can train on state-of-the-art Full Flight Simulators (FFS) and Flight Navigation Procedures Trainer (FNPTII) devices. Currently, our centre operates two Airbus A320neo Full Flight Simulators from Avion and an A320 FNPTII for APS MCC training, built by Simnest. Over the coming years, we will expand to six to eight Full Flight Simulators, including additional Airbus A320s and Boeing 737 MAX devices, providing comprehensive training solutions for airlines and individual pilots.

  

**Tasks**

  

The IT Executive will be responsible for supporting, monitoring, and maintaining the complete IT infrastructure used in the operation of Level-D full-flight simulators. This includes system networks, simulator support computers, operating systems, backup systems, secure communications, and IT-based compliance processes as per DGCA and OEM guidelines.

  

Simulator IT Systems Support

  

  
* Manage and support simulator-related IT infrastructure, including host computers, IOS stations, server hardware, network switches, and storage.
  
* Support OEM tools, diagnostic applications, and monitoring software.
  
* Assist with simulator data loading, software updates, and database management.
  
* Perform routine backups and restoration of critical simulator configurations.
  

  

IT Infrastructure & Network Administration

  

  
* Administer LAN, Wi-Fi, firewalls, switches, and routers.
  
* Maintain secure connectivity between simulator systems and corporate networks.
  
* Implement cybersecurity policies as per DGCA and organisational standards.
  
* Monitor server performance, network health, and system uptime.
  

  

DGCA Compliance & Documentation

  

  
* Maintain IT documentation required for DGCA audits.
  
* Support the Quality Department during DGCA inspections and QTG runs.
  
* Ensure integrity and traceability of simulator data files.
  

  

Operational Support

  

  
* Provide real-time IT support during simulator sessions.
  
* Troubleshoot errors and coordinate with OEM support.
  
* Assist in preventive maintenance schedules.
  

  

General IT Support

  

  
* Maintain office IT systems, including desktops, laptops, printers, and AV systems.
  
* Support email systems, software installation, and licensing.
  
* Monitor antivirus and endpoint security systems.
  

  

**Requirements**

  

Essential

  

  
* Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, Electronics, or equivalent.
  
* 2–5 years of experience in IT support; aviation/simulator experience preferred.
  
* Strong knowledge of Windows/Linux OS, networking, backups, and cybersecurity.
  

  

Preferred

  

  
* Experience with flight simulators or OEM systems.
  
* Knowledge of DGCA regulatory requirements.
  

  

Key Competencies

  

  
* High attention to detail and accuracy.
  
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  
* Ability to work under pressure in a 24/7 environment.
  
* Excellent communication and documentation abilities.
  

  

Work Schedule

  

Shift duties may be required (24/7 simulator operations).

  

**Benefits**

  

**Become a part of Gen24**

  

Working at Gen24 means having a challenging job in a successful and entrepreneurial environment where initiative and a high degree of freedom in acting are basic principles. Working together within and between teams is essential for our success. Likewise, we cooperate closely with our partners and customers to achieve the best results. You will have significant influence and responsibility for the outcome of technically challenging projects.

  

Gen24 will create the conditions that enable you to truly grow as a (technical) specialist. We will do so by providing support, training, and opportunities to further develop your talents in a stimulating and inspiring environment.

  

Gen24 is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate our inclusive work environment and encourage people of all backgrounds and perspectives to apply. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
Data Center Operations designs, installs & maintains the world’s largest Cloud Computing Infrastructure. At ADSIPL, career progression is part of our environment. We want you to progress. If your career path is in Systems, Network or Database Engineering, Software Development or maybe AWS Support, Technical Operations or perhaps Project Management, we will create a development plan to enable you to succeed reaching those goals. A day in the life

* You will follow the instructions ticket-based environment and work on systematic problem resolution and perform routine operation activities on hardware, or spare parts, including rack install, server break/fix, rack decom etc.

* Show a strong aptitude for troubleshooting and problem solving

* Some tasks involve working within server and equipment enclosures where space is compact.
* Your role involves covering 24x7 shift rotation

We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

title: Senior Technical Account Manager (L2)
description:
**Department:**
Sales
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Permanent - Full Time
  
  
**Location:**
Mumbai, India
  
  
**Description**
We are looking for an On-Site Technical Account Manager (L2) to act as a dedicated Resident Engineer for a major enterprise deployment. Working directly at the customer site, you will serve as the primary technical bridge between local operations, internal engineering teams, and vendor support to ensure high availability and rapid issue resolution.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Investigate and resolve escalated Hazelcast component issues. Lead root-cause analysis for P1, recurring and critical incidents with Hazelcast support, keep stakeholders informed and track permanent corrective actions through closure. When an incident closes, make sure the knowledge base captures the cause, permanent fix and lessons learned.
* Coordinate Hazelcast support cases for product bugs, patches and escalations; promptly notify RBI of critical defects or security vulnerabilities and track remediation and closure status.
* Recommend, configure and validate RBI-approved Hazelcast designs for high availability, resilience, throughput and scalability in line with Hazelcast guidance, working with L2 and developers on complex workflow, connector, integration and performance issues.
* Plan and carry out approved UAT, pre-production and production updates with impact and risk analysis, approved operating procedures, test and rollback plans, execution in approved maintenance windows and post-change validation.
* Advise RBI security teams on Hazelcast hardening; assess releases and patches and maintain upgrade, adoption and infrastructure-lifecycle roadmap recommendations.
* Work with RBI’s performance-monitoring team to establish baselines, diagnose bottlenecks and implement tuning and configuration improvements with measurable before-and-after results.
* Perform capacity planning and sizing and conduct periodic capacity and utilization reviews, including annual audits and corrective recommendations for threshold breaches.
* Maintain senior-level operating procedures and technical documentation; guide L1/L2 teams through knowledge sharing, current industry trends, best practices and thoughtful automation.
* Provide senior oversight for complex or escalated service requests, authorizations, coordination issues and configuration-backup concerns, while the L2 TAM owns routine handling. Help keep the agreed roles and responsibilities (RACI) and escalation matrix current, join remote, OEM and on-call coverage, and contribute to quarterly service-level reporting and RBI certification. The team supports unlimited cases, with response targets of 30 minutes initially and 1 hour ongoing for P1; 1 hour and 2 hours for P2; 4 hours and 8 business hours for P3; and 8 hours and 2 working days for all other cases.

**What You Have**

* Graduate qualification such as BE, BSc, MCA or equivalent; an engineering background is preferred.
* At least 6 years of relevant experience, including at least 5 years designing, implementing and upgrading Hazelcast or the directly relevant OEM product.
* Advanced Hazelcast architecture, configuration, high-availability, resilience and distributed-caching expertise, including security hardening and lifecycle management across UAT, pre-production and production.
* Demonstrated ownership of complex production incidents, P1 root-cause analysis, permanent corrective actions and OEM engineering/support escalations.
* Strong performance-tuning, capacity-planning, sizing, throughput and scalability skills supported by measurable validation.
* Ability to work with RBI stakeholders, developers and L1/L2 teams; communicate recommendations and approved decisions clearly and produce strong operating procedures, configuration records, root-cause analysis reports, roadmaps and knowledge-transfer guidance.
* Be prepared to share degree records, project dates, relevant experience and evidence of your Hazelcast or OEM association so Hazelcast can support RBI’s approval process.

description:

1. **ROLE**

* The Change Coordinator is responsible for managing and overseeing all customer-related changes within the GOC team, with a primary focus on code upgrades and adherence to internal change management processes.
* This role ensures that all change activities are planned, documented, reviewed, and coordinated in compliance with both customer governance standards, customer availability and NTTGN internal change policies, NOCCP101.
* The Change Coordinator serves as the central point of contact for change control, code upgrade scheduling, Vendor maintenance, GOC-initiated Maintenance, and CAB participation, ensuring operational consistency and risk mitigation across all assigned customer accounts.
* Change Coordinators must be capable of efficiently planning and executing a high volume of upgrade activities.

1. **RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Change Coordination & Governance**

* Coordinate all customer change requests, maintenance and ensure alignment with internal and customer-specific change management frameworks.
* Plan, track, and oversee all change, maintenance activities across managed environment ensuring minimal disruption to the service which includes working with the Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) and change owners to document the impact assessments for all proposed changes ensuring clarity and completeness
* Represent NTTGN during Customer Change Advisory Board (CAB) meetings to present planned changes, maintenances and gain CAB approvals.
* Maintain complete and accurate documentation for all change activities, maintenances within the NTTGN ticketing system (Siebel) & customer ticketing system (Service-Now, Remedy etc.).

**2. Code Upgrade Ownership**

* Own the end-to-end coordination of customer code upgrades including planning, scheduling, coordination, validation, post-upgrade review and status update.
* Work with engineering and delivery teams to validate upgrade readiness and confirm backout procedures.
* Ensure that upgrade activities align with customer maintenance windows and service continuity standards.
* Track, report, and analyze code upgrade outcomes.

**3. Ticket Queue Management**

* Monitor and manage the change ticket, maintenance queues to ensure SLAs are met.
* Assign, prioritize, and follow up on change, maintenance tickets requiring change or release actions.
* Review open change, maintenance tickets for accuracy, completeness, and timely progress updates.
* Follow-up with customer on incident/event tickets in “customer time” upon Manager’s direction
* Escalate risks or delays to appropriate stakeholders to maintain compliance with service targets.

**4. Process Compliance & Continuous Improvement**

* Enforce compliance with NTTGN internal change control processes NOCCP101 across all technical teams.
* Perform quality checks on sharepoint information, NTTView reporting, device status in NTTGN tools, peer-reviews etc.
* Support internal audits by maintaining accurate change and upgrading documentation.

**5. Communication & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Serve as the liaison between internal teams, service delivery managers, project managers and customer contacts regarding change activities.
* Provide clear communication on change schedules, approvals, and risks to both internal and external stakeholders.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure awareness and readiness for all planned changes.

1. **TRAINING AND CERTIFICATION**

* Beginner level certification on Cisco (CCNA) or Aruba (ACSA) or Juniper (JCNIA).
* ITIL

1. **EXPERIENCE**

* More than 2 years of progressive, relevant experience and proven capability to work in a complex network environment.
* Prior experience and well versed in ITSM / Ticketing tool like Service Now or Remedy or Siebel etc.

1. **EDUCATION**

* Bachelors in engineering - Computers/Electronics/Communication or related field
* Graduate in Science/Math/IT or related streams with relevant technology experience

1. **OTHER SKILLS**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Technical telecommunications background
* Experience working in global team that provide 24x7 support to customers and willingness to operate during US Shift hours
* Knowledge of ITIL processes
* Reporting and analysis skills
* Ability to work with Account Teams, Customers, Service Delivery, and Operations
* Willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed to accommodate global team.
* Passionate about NTTGN’s Customers, willing to go the extra mile to ensure the highest level of customer satisfaction.

Research Connect is looking for a technically skilled and proactive IT Executive to manage day-to-day IT operations and provide Level 1 (L1) technical support to employees. The candidate will be responsible for troubleshooting hardware and software issues, managing Google Workspace (G Suite), handling email backups, maintaining laptops and IT equipment, and providing basic network and firewall support.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in IT support, system administration, email management, and troubleshooting.

* Manage Google Workspace (G Suite) accounts, including Gmail, Google Drive, and user access.
* Create, configure, and manage official email accounts.
* Handle email backup, restoration, migration, and data recovery.
* Manage email permissions, aliases, groups, and account security.
* Troubleshoot email delivery, login, synchronization, and configuration issues.
* Assist with Google Workspace administration and user management.

**2. Laptop & Desktop Troubleshooting**

* Diagnose and resolve laptop, desktop, and peripheral-related issues.
* Install, configure, and update operating systems, applications, and drivers.
* Troubleshoot hardware, software, connectivity, and performance issues.
* Manage laptop setup, formatting, maintenance, and employee system allocation.
* Maintain IT asset records, including laptops, chargers, accessories, and other equipment.

**3. Network & Firewall Management**

* Provide basic LAN, Wi-Fi, router, and internet connectivity support.
* Assist in firewall configuration, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
* Manage basic network security, access permissions, and connectivity issues.
* Monitor network performance and coordinate with service providers when required.
* Assist in maintaining network infrastructure and security policies.

**4. IT Support & Infrastructure**

* Provide L1 technical support to employees and resolve day-to-day IT issues.
* Troubleshoot Windows OS, MS Office, browsers, printers, and other applications.
* Manage software installation, licensing, updates, and configurations.
* Maintain IT documentation, troubleshooting logs, and support records.
* Coordinate with senior IT personnel for L2/L3 technical escalations.

**5. Backup & Data Security**

**Required Technical Skills**

* MS Office installation and troubleshooting.

title: Senior Application Analyst
description:
**Job Purpose**
To provide support services to end users through various channels as required. Troubleshoots and remediates issues impacting the operation of the technology infrastructure to ensure continuity of business. Installs, configures and monitors computer systems and networks for clients ensuring productivity is in line with set measures and client's adopted policies and procedures.
  
  
Key Result Responsibilities
  
  

* Drives the technical support team to carry out customer support properly and promptly, monitors servers and systems, takes ownership of reported issues, responds to enquiries, provides information and feedback ensuring problems are being recorded and tracked throughout the entire process.
* Maintains positive customer/working relationships with stakeholders, business users, suppliers, vendors and other technical teams to ensure improvements in the products and services provided to ISA clients and to resolve any issues related to maintenance.
* Provides technical/non-technical support to clients, conducts analysis, diagnosis and troubleshoots systems, network, hardware/software faults and bugs to resolve problems considering system capacity, limitations, etc.; applies metrics to monitor performance and measure key project criteria.
* Identifies resolutions to technical problems, carries out bug fixes for minor issues and applying patches channels unresolved issues in the right direction as necessary; responds within agreed time limits to call-outs.
* Assists with the development and implementation of processes and service level agreements of incidents management and service request management.
* Assists technical experts in planning, evaluating, testing, and implementing new technology such as systems and platforms. Participates in different projects as required.
* Contributes to the creation of support knowledge base by developing and communicating IT support manuals, technical notes and articles to clients in line with SLAs.
* Utilizes different communication channels to support or guide end users on the different enquiries and problems raised, these channels include: personal visits, telephone calls, e-mails, web, chat etc.
* Ensures proper recording and closure of all claims; generates timely reports of different nature to capture support services activities.
* Installs, configures, monitors and maintains computer hardware operating systems, applications and networks, replaces parts and upgrades existing ones when and as needed in line with agreed SLAs.
* Supports the roll-out of new applications (where applicable); sets up new users' accounts, profiles and passwords. Supports the clients during CR implementation (UAT and Training).
* Assists in establishing and maintaining a complete and accurate record of all IT assets within ISA. Establishes and maintains security, integrity, and business continuity controls and documents.
* Responds positively to operational needs by being on-call available for critical systems 24x7 support.
* Actively monitors application/IT performance using monitoring and controlling tools to ensure 24x7 availability
* Should be open to work on shifts based on team requirements

Key Result Responsibilities-Continued
  
  
**Qualifications (Academic, Training, Languages)**

* Bachelor Degree in Computer Engineering/Computer Science/Information Technology.
* ITIL Certified. (Not mandatory)
* Fluent in English Language.

Work Experience
  
  
5 years in IT Infrastructure support, service desk, 24x7 critical operations preferably in aviation.
  
  

* This job requires occasional duty travel for training and implementation purposes.
* Proven record in implementing and monitoring infrastructure projects.
* Proven skills in carrying out bug fixes for minor issues and applying patches (Basic knowledge in Java, Linux, API , Unix ,SQL ,Webservices ).
* Holistic IT Knowledge in heterogeneous technology environments - experience with different types of end-to-end technology stacks.
* Experienced in managing operations and technology platforms – both internally and externally hosted.
* Proven skills in analysing data, identifying pitfalls and recommending solutions.
* Possesses effective persuasive, negotiation, problem solving and decision-making skills.
* Employs technical expertise and interpersonal skills to execute new initiatives and achieve company’s objectives.
* Demonstrates the ability to contribute and successfully deliver against business strategy and set KPIs.
* Airline domain is preferred

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
**Job Description:**
Job Description: Technical Support Engineer
  
  
**Job Summary**
Serve as the first point of contact and trusted advisor for technical support issues for Symantec’s customers and partners, including Global Enterprise-level accounts. As a key member of the APAC Technical Support team, you will ensure that customers' complex technical issues are driven to a complete and satisfactory resolution. Customer interactions are conducted via phone, email, web, and occasionally face-to-face, strictly adhering to established customer response time commitments.
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities
  
  
Customer Support & Issue Resolution
  
  
  

* Provide advanced technical assistance to diagnose, analyze, and resolve unique and complex software, hardware, networking, and infrastructural issues in enterprise environments.
* Act as a trusted advisor on Symantec Security Products, managing your own schedule of cases, determining priority levels, and setting clear expectations with customers.
* Communicate procedural and technical issues effectively to internal and external stakeholders, including leading conference calls with customers and 3rd-party vendors.
* Use available support tools and analytical practices to evaluate identifiable factors and obtain solutions for problems of diverse scope.
* Maintain a high level of customer satisfaction and meet key performance indicators (KPIs) and relevant metrics.
* Must be comfortable working in a shift model.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Product Improvement
  
  
  

* Interface and collaborate with cross-functional organizations (Sales, Services, Systems Engineering, Product Management, and Product Development) to prioritize customer requests.
* Define and track bugs for the Development team and offer innovative ideas to improve overall product quality.
* Participate in product design reviews, technical reviews, beta product testing, and pre-release testing to provide feedback on new features and enhancements.
* Complete assigned projects, including process reviews, proof of concepts, product demos, and presenting at technical forums.

Documentation & Knowledge Management
  
  
  

* Thoroughly document all customer interactions, status updates, and resolutions in existing case management tools.
* Create clear, concise documentation (case management notes, technical tips, and white papers) and contribute to the Technical Support Knowledge Base to reduce future troubleshooting time and drive faster issue resolution.

Mentorship, Training & Professional Development
  
  
  

* Research a wide array of technical topics, developing an in-depth knowledge of operating systems, infrastructure technologies, the security ecosystem, and Symantec products.
* Collaborate with other support engineers by delivering in-the-moment coaching and guidance.
* Develop and deliver training on troubleshooting techniques, product updates, and skill refreshers for the support organization, product specialists, and partners.
* Take responsibility for personal career development through new product training, external/internal seminars, self-directed study, and seeking mentorship from senior staff and management.

**Technical Skills And Qualifications**
Education & Experience
  
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience in a related field.
* 10+ years of experience working with customers in a fast-paced, high-tech, support-related position or similar engineering role.

Certifications
  
  
  

* Must possess one or more of the following relevant industry certifications: MCSA, MCSE, CCNA, or CompTIA Security+.
* Additional certifications such as CCNP, CCIE, CCSP, and/or CISSP are highly desired.

Networking & Security
  
  
  

* Strong networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP (and TCP/IP stack), Packet Switching, Routing, and Network Topologies.
* Advanced knowledge of application and routing protocols including NAT, DNS, DHCP, HTTP, MMS, RTSP, FTP, IM, QoS, and RPC.
* Experience using telecom, packet sniffers, and networking tools such as Wireshark or SnifferPro.
* Working knowledge of remote access technologies and inter-operations, including RADIUS, ACE, VPNs, LDAP, NTLM, and firewalls.
* Working knowledge of Internet Services such as Web Services, Media Servers, Proxy services, browser, and media player operations.
* Experience with Symantec Network Protection products and/or other network-internet security products is desired.
* Familiarity with Intrusion Detection System brands and technologies, as well as Vulnerability Network Scanners, is an added advantage.

Operating Systems & Infrastructure
  
  
  

* Expert-level understanding of Windows Server Concepts, with required experience in Windows Server 2008 and 2012.
* Solid hands-on experience troubleshooting Windows OS and application-related issues (Windows Server/Client).
* Experience with Linux OS Administration is an added advantage.
* Strong working knowledge of Enterprise Level Infrastructure Technology, specifically Active Directory, DNS, and DHCP.
* Working knowledge of Windows Exchange and/or other Mail systems.

Database, Virtualization & Scripting
  
  
  

* Working knowledge of Relational Database principles and methodologies (e.g., SQL, Oracle).
* Knowledge of virtualization technologies (VMWare, Hyper-V) is an added advantage.
* Scripting or programming concepts are considered an added advantage.

Soft Skills & Competencies
  
  
  

* Advanced troubleshooting and debugging skills.
* Proven capability to own, drive, and take responsibility for issues.
* Ability to multitask, prioritize, and work well under pressure.
* Demonstrated leadership qualities.

title: Associate Technical Support Engineer
description:
At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.
  
  
**So, what’s the role all about?**
NICE Public Safety provides a cloud based enterprise product used by public safety and justice agencies. Our customers depend on this product for time sensitive work, so the system has to be available at all times.
  
  
We are looking for an Associate Technical Support Engineer to join our Cloud Operations team in Pune. This is an early career role for someone with 1 to 3 years of experience who wants to build a strong foundation in cloud monitoring and production support. The main purpose of the role is to watch the health of our product hosted on Microsoft Azure, respond to alerts, carry out first level troubleshooting and escalate issues to senior engineers with clear and complete information.
  
  
The person will work under the guidance of senior Technical Support Engineers and is expected to learn quickly, follow established SOPs and gradually take on more ownership. We also expect them to be curious about AI tools such as Claude and Copilot and willing to use them in their daily work.
  
  
**How will you make an impact?**

* Monitor production systems on Azure using tools such as Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics, Grafana and Kibana.
* Watch alert queues and dashboards, acknowledge alerts promptly and act on them as per the defined SOPs.
* Carry out first level troubleshooting by reviewing logs, metrics and recent changes, and document findings clearly.
* Raise and track incidents in the ticketing tool, escalate to senior engineers or Advanced Support on time and with complete information.
* Assist senior engineers during major incidents by gathering logs, running health checks and keeping notes.
* Help reduce false alarms by reporting noisy or misfiring alerts to the senior team.
* Use AI tools such as Claude and Copilot to help read logs, summaries incidents and draft updates.
* Write simple scripts to automate routine tasks such as reports and health checks, with guidance from senior engineers.
* Share clear and timely updates with internal stakeholders during incidents.
* Follow and help update SOPs, knowledge articles and troubleshooting guides.
* Meet the defined SLAs, KPIs and escalation processes.

**Have you got what it takes?**

* 1 to 3 years of experience in technical support, application support, NOC, production monitoring or cloud operations.
* Basic hands on exposure to Microsoft Azure and at least one monitoring or logging tool such as Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics, Grafana or Kibana.
* Basic understanding of cloud concepts, web applications and how client server systems work.
* Working knowledge of Windows or Linux, including reading logs and checking services and processes.
* Basic scripting ability in PowerShell, Python or Shell, or a strong willingness to learn.
* Familiarity with a ticketing tool such as ServiceNow or Jira.
* Comfortable using AI tools such as Claude, Copilot or ChatGPT for day to day technical work.
* Good written and verbal communication skills in English and the ability to explain a technical issue clearly to a senior engineer or a customer.
* Eager to learn, takes feedback well and follows processes carefully.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT or a related field (BE, BTech or BSc).
* Exposure to KQL queries in Log Analytics.
* Basic knowledge of REST APIs and how to test them.
* Awareness of Docker, Kubernetes or CI/CD pipelines.
* Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900) or ITIL Foundation certification.
* Interest in AI tools, prompt writing or building small automations.
* This role works in rotational shifts aligned to US time zones, including night shifts.
* The person will be part of a weekend on-call rotation shared across the team.
* The role is based in our Pune office and works with global teams.
* Work on a product that public safety and justice agencies rely on every day.
* Learn from experienced engineers and get hands on with the latest monitoring, automation and AI tools.
* Clear growth path to Technical Support Engineer and onward to Advanced Support, SRE, Cloud Operations or AI Operations.

**What’s in it for you?**
Join an ever-growing, market disrupting, global company where the teams – comprised of the best of the best – work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NiCE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate, innovative, and excited to constantly raise the bar, you may just be our next NiCEr!
  
  
**Enjoy NiCE-FLEX!**
At NiCE, we work according to the NiCE-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. Naturally, office days focus on face-to-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere.
  
  
**Requisition ID:11916**
**Reporting into:**
Tech Manager
  
  
**Role Type:**
Individual Contributor
  
  
**About NiCE**
*NICE Ltd. (NASDAQ: NICE) software products are used by 25,000+ global businesses, including 85 of the Fortune 100 corporations, to deliver extraordinary customer experiences, fight financial crime and ensure public safety. Every day, NiCE software manages more than 120 million customer interactions and monitors 3+ billion financial transactions.*
*Known as an innovation powerhouse that excels in AI, cloud and digital, NiCE is consistently recognized as the market leader in its domains, with over 8,500 employees across 30+ countries.*
*NiCE is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, neurotype, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other category protected by law.*

title: Supervisor Application Development & Support
description:
**Job Description**
**Role Statement**
The ERP Second Level Support (RUN) Senior Analyst is accountable for ensuring advanced functional support and deep root-cause analysis for complex issues escalated from Triage and Junior Analysts, acting as the subject-matter expert for a specific Oracle EBS module.
  
  
This role contributes to stable operations by driving effective resolution, implementing preventive measures, and supporting continuous improvement of Oracle EBS processes. The Senior Analyst takes end-to-end ownership of complex tickets, designs and validates functional fixes and workarounds, and ensures structured ticket handover within the Follow-the-Sun model to deliver uninterrupted support coverage.
  
  
As a qualified first line of defense within the ERP Second Level Support team, this role partners with the Shift Manager, Domain Head, Junior Analysts, ERP Tech Factory, and ERP Product Specialists to ensure seamless escalation paths, high-quality resolution, and consistent service delivery aligned with the organization’s Run operating model.
  
  
**Key Duties**
Ticket Resolution & Backlog Management
  
  

* Take end-to-end ownership of complex tickets escalated from Triage and Junior Analysts, ensuring thorough analysis and resolution within SLA targets.
* Support prioritization and backlog management, especially for high-severity incidents, ensuring alignment with business impact and SLA requirements.
* Design, validate, and implement functional fixes and workarounds, confirming solution effectiveness with key business stakeholders.
* Generate structured ticket handover materials to ensure continuity in the Follow-the-Sun model.

Root-Cause Analysis & Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Perform in-depth root-cause analysis for complex or non-standard incidents, accurately identifying underlying functional and process failures.
* Define corrective actions and drive preventive measures to reduce recurring incidents and improve process stability.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying patterns, proposing configuration or process enhancements, and sharing findings with the broader team.

**Escalation & Collaboration**

* Promptly engage the ERP Product Specialist when additional expertise is required or challenges arise beyond functional scope.
* Escalate unresolved issues to ERP Tech Factory, providing comprehensive documentation of analysis performed and resolution attempts.
* Provide updates on solution design and technically resolved tickets to the Shift Manager and relevant stakeholders.
* Participate in cross-functional stand-ups to remove blockers and accelerate cross-module resolution.
* Coordinate cross-module and cross-team activities as assigned, ensuring alignment of timelines, dependencies, and deliverables across stakeholders involved in incident resolution or improvement initiatives.

**Governance & Knowledge Management**

* Maintain and enhance knowledge assets, including functional documentation, troubleshooting guides, and known-error records.
* Support regression, UAT, and hypercare testing to ensure operational readiness for releases.
* Drive the adoption of enabling technologies (ServiceNow, Oracle EBS, SharePoint) for efficient ticket tracking and resolution documentation.

**Required**
**Qualification and Experience**

* 3–5 years of experience in Oracle EBS functional roles with exposure to complex incident management.
* Established specialization in at least one Oracle EBS module (e.g., Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Finance, Services).
* Proven experience in handling complex, unstructured, or cross-module incidents.
* Deep understanding of end-to-end business processes related to the assigned Oracle EBS module.
* Advanced capability in conducting root-cause analysis and translating findings into actionable corrective measures.
* Proficiency in executing low-risk functional configurations following fit-to-standard principles.
* Strong analytical thinking and structured problem-solving skills.
* High sense of ownership and end-to-end accountability.
* Effective communication and stakeholder management, including in international contexts.

**Preferred**

* Experience working in Follow-the-Sun or shift-based global support models.
* Familiarity with ITIL-aligned incident management frameworks and tools (ServiceNow).
* Background in ERP support environments within manufacturing or industrial organizations.
* Knowledge of continuous improvement methodologies and preventive maintenance approaches.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* SLA compliance rate
* Mean Time to Resolve (MTTR)
* First Contact Resolution rate (FCR)
* ERP incident recurrence rate
* Ticket re-open rate
* Knowledge base contribution rate

Safety. Integrity. Respect. Teamwork. Inclusion.

* High-Performance Culture
* Customer Focus
* Operational Excellence
* Innovation
* Financial Strength

**VERTIV BEHAVIORS**

* Own it
* Act with urgency
* Foster a customer-first mindset
* Think big and execute
* Lead by example
* Drive continuous improvement
* Learn and seek out development
* Promote transparent & open communication

**About Vertiv**
Vertiv (NYSE: VRT) brings together hardware, software, analytics and ongoing services to enable its customers’ vital applications to run continuously, perform optimally and grow with their business needs. Vertiv solves the most important challenges facing today’s data centers, communication networks, and commercial and industrial facilities with a portfolio of power, cooling and IT infrastructure solutions and services that extend from the cloud to the edge of the network. Headquartered in Westerville, Ohio, USA, Vertiv employs around 34,000 people and does business in more than 130 countries. Visit Vertiv.com to learn more.

title: Sr. Associate Customer Support Analyst (HCM, Talent, Compensation & Benefits)
description:
**Your work days are brighter here.**
We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.
  
  
**About The Team**
About the Team
  
  
At Workday, we bring technical rigor, customer empathy, and a spirit of fun to enterprise software. Our support team underpins operational excellence across Workday's digital experience, AI/ML platform, and Agent Factory initiative. Workday’s Agent Factory is our internal engine that builds, trains, and deploys autonomous AI agents to execute complex HR and Finance workflows, including expense processing, hiring, and workforce scheduling. We partner with core engineering to eliminate bottlenecks, maintain high platform availability, and ensure system reliability for our global customer base.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a customer-focused Senior Associate Support Analyst to drive incident resolution, root-cause analysis (RCA), and operational optimization across Workday’s enterprise platform and autonomous AI agent workflows. In this high-visibility role, you will analyze system metrics, investigate cloud-hosted ML service pipelines, evaluate LLM orchestration layers, and manage critical customer escalations within strict SLAs. You will also partner directly with engineering and data science teams to inform feature iteration and product optimizations. A key part of this role involves evaluating AI quality: reviewing chat histories and AI responses to spot mistakes, figure out why they happened, and turn those insights into simple improvements that make the AI clearer, smarter, and more reliable.
  
  

* Enterprise SaaS & Functional Domain Knowledge: Develop a foundational understanding of enterprise SaaS workflows (including Finance, HR, and Payroll) to assist in validating AI logic and verifying expected system behaviour.
* AI Concepts: Review AI chat logs and execution outputs to spot incorrect answers, hallucinations, or misunderstandings. Document findings and recurring patterns to support senior team members and engineering in refining prompt logic.
* Technical Troubleshooting: Utilize established troubleshooting playbooks, diagnostic dashboards, and monitoring tools to reproduce reported issues, gather relevant logs, and isolate basic software bugs.
* Technical Acumen: Run basic database queries (SQL), review application logs, and inspect API payloads to verify data flow, check system state, and assist with basic cloud workflow troubleshooting.
* Customer Advocacy: Monitor and respond to incoming support queues, maintain strict SLA commitments, and communicate clearly with users. Provide empathetic, plain-language updates to customers while issues are being investigated.
* Incident & Queue Management: Perform initial queue triage, classify issue severity, and route high-impact (P1) incidents to senior analysts or engineering teams using defined escalation pathways. Participate in weekend and holiday on-call rotations with team support.

**About You**
**Basic Qualifications**

* Proven expertise providing functional and technical product support across core ERP domains, specializing in Human Capital Management (HCM) modules including Talent, Compensation, and Benefits
* Work Experience: Minimum 1 year of experience in technical support, customer success, IT operations, software administration, or a technical internship.
* Proven expertise providing functional and technical product support across core ERP domains, specializing in Human Capital Management (HCM) modules including Talent, Compensation, and Benefits
* Technical & System Operations:

+ Minimum 1 year of hands-on experience using public cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
+ Minimum 1 year of experience accessing and reviewing system logs or monitoring tools (e.g., Datadog, Splunk, or cloud-native log viewers).

* AI/LLM Familiarity: Experience using, testing, or reviewing Large Language Model (LLM) outputs or prompt structures.

title: Integration Health Engineer
description:

You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.
  
  
We’re here to give power to the patient.
  
  
For nearly 20 years, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.
  
  
Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from
*seeking*
to
*getting*
. We don’t want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.
  
  
Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.
  
  
We are seeking a detail-oriented Integration Health Engineer to ensure the stability, performance, and reliability of our system integrations. This role focuses on monitoring, troubleshooting, and optimizing integrations between various applications, platforms, and third-party services. * Troubleshoot & Resolve Issues – Diagnose and resolve integration errors, API failures, and data flow disruptions in real-time.
* Maintain System Health – Ensure integrations remain functional, efficient, and up to date with minimal downtime.
* Log Analysis & Reporting – Review logs and alerts to identify root causes of failures and document resolutions.
* Optimize Existing Integrations – Identify inefficiencies in data processing and recommend improvements to enhance performance.
* Coordinate with Engineering Teams – Work closely with developers, DevOps, and IT teams to implement fixes and improvements.
* Ensure Compliance & Security – Adhere to industry standards and best practices, including data protection policies and system security.
* Document Processes & Solutions – Maintain thorough documentation of troubleshooting procedures, integration updates, and system workflows.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 2-4 years of experience with API monitoring, system health checks, and integration and network troubleshooting.
* Proficiency in SQL, Python, PowerShell, or Bash for log analysis and automation.
* Experience with monitoring tools such as Splunk, Datadog, or Prometheus.
* Strong problem-solving skills with a proactive approach to issue resolution.
* Creativity in problem solving.
* Excellent communication and teamwork skills to collaborate with developers and stakeholders.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize issues effectively.
* Experience working in integration support or system operations (preferred).
* Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) (preferred).
* Knowledge of incident management best practices (preferred).

**Benefits**

* An incredible team of smart and supportive people
* A competitive compensation package, including attractive medical insurance
* Amazing perks – think catered lunch every day, Ping Pong, etc.
* Daycare/creche facility for kids
* The chance to create a better healthcare experience for millions of patients!
* Corporate wellness programs with Headspace
* Cellphone and wifi reimbursement
* Competitive parental leave
* Sabbatical leave (over 5 years)
* Annual sponsored health check-ups
* Zocdoc is certified as a Great Place to Work 2025–2026

title: L3 Nutanix Administrator
description:
Job Description 2: L3 Nutanix Administrator
  
  

* Position Title: Nutanix Administrator
* Position Type: L3

* Grade: Contract

Position Summary
  
  
Looking for an experienced Nutanix L3 Administrator / SME responsible for managing, supporting, troubleshooting, optimizing, and designing enterprise Nutanix infrastructure. The role requires strong expertise in Nutanix AHV, Prism Central, Prism Element, storage, networking, VM lifecycle management, cluster administration, upgrades, performance troubleshooting, and Disaster Recovery (DR).
  
  
The candidate will handle L3 escalations, complex incidents, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), capacity planning, infrastructure changes, automation, and coordination with OEM/Nutanix support and other infrastructure teams.
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities1. VM & Cluster Administration
  
  

* Administer and support Nutanix AHV clusters in production environments.
* Manage VM creation, modification, migration, cloning, snapshots, and deletion.
* Perform VM CPU, memory, disk, and network configuration.
* Manage VM High Availability (HA), affinity/anti-affinity rules, and resource allocation.
* Troubleshoot AHV host and VM-related performance and availability issues.
* Perform cluster expansion, node addition/removal, node maintenance, and evacuation.
* Prism Management & Governance
* Complete administration of Prism Central and Prism Element.
* Monitor cluster health, alerts, capacity, and performance.
* Manage Nutanix clusters, hosts, containers, storage pools, and networking.
* Configure and manage Projects, Categories, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), and security policies.
* Troubleshoot Prism Central/Element connectivity and core service issues.
* Perform regular health checks and proactively identify infrastructure risks.
* Storage Optimization & Capacity Planning
* Manage Storage Pools, Storage Containers, and virtual disks.
* Monitor storage utilization, IOPS, latency, and throughput.
* Perform capacity planning, storage expansion, and performance troubleshooting.
* Manage storage optimization technologies including compression, deduplication, and erasure coding where applicable.
* Analyze storage consumption patterns and recommend optimization strategies.
* Upgrade Management & Maintenance
* Troubleshoot CVM, AHV host, and cluster health issues.
* Maintain cluster resiliency and redundancy.
* Plan and execute Nutanix AOS, AHV, Prism Central, and firmware upgrades.
* Perform pre-upgrade and post-upgrade health checks and validate cluster health before/after maintenance.
* Prepare implementation plans, rollback plans, and maintain compatibility/lifecycle documentation.
* Coordinate directly with Nutanix OEM support for complex upgrade issues.
* Networking & Multi-Hypervisor Support
* Configure and troubleshoot AHV Virtual Switches, bridges, VLANs, and network interfaces.
* Troubleshoot VM-to-VM, VM-to-network, and VM-to-storage connectivity, latency, and packet-loss issues.
* Coordinate with Network teams regarding VLAN, trunk, MTU, and routing configurations.
* Maintain knowledge of VMware vSphere/ESXi/vCenter (vDS, HA, DRS, vMotion, datastores) and Hyper-V.
* Support VM migration, infrastructure integration, and cross-platform migrations (VMware/Hyper-V to Nutanix AHV).

**Qualification & Experience RequirementsEssential Qualifications & Experience**

* Education: Any IT Graduate (BCA/MCA, BSc/MSc IT, BE, BTech).
* Work Experience: 6+ years of experience in an enterprise-level Nutanix and VMware environment.

Technical Skills & Competencies
  
  

* Demonstrated L3 support proficiency in enterprise Nutanix environments.
* Hands-on experience with OS deployment via templates (Windows Server 2012–2022, Linux RHEL/CentOS/Ubuntu).
* Strong knowledge of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP).
* PowerShell scripting for automation and management of repetitive administrative tasks.
* Ability to lead and mentor the Nutanix L2 Support Team for incident resolution and operational excellence.
* Strong understanding of security principles (patching, access control, vulnerability management, OS architecture).
* Knowledge of server backups, DR procedures, and High Availability frameworks.
* Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).

Desirable Certifications
  
  

* Nutanix Certified Professional - Multicloud Infrastructure (NCP-MCI)
* Nutanix Certified Advanced Professional - Multicloud Infrastructure (NCAP-MCI)
* VMware VCP / VCAP
* ITIL Foundation (Preferred)

Behavioral Skills
  
  

* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Customer-centric approach with solution-oriented thinking.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills (English, Hindi).
* Adaptable, dynamic, and capable of working in fast-paced environments.
* Strong interpersonal skills to collaborate constructively with developers, management, business clients, and vendors.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
MetAntz connects the top 1% talents to global opportunities. This is an exciting role with one of our customers working in the area of agentic software for digital shelf.
  
  
**Location**
Pune, India or remote
  
  
**About Our Customer**
We build agentic software for the digital shelf. Our customers are large global consumer brands. Our platform decides what their products should say on major online retail sites, writes it, and then measures whether it worked. That includes how products show up when shoppers ask AI assistants what to buy, which is changing faster than most brands can keep up with.
  
  
We are a small, profitable team growing quickly across the US and UK. Every person here owns something real.
  
  
**The role**
This is one role with two halves, and you need to want both.
  
  
**You build.**
You will own one part of the product end to end: design it, ship it, run it in production, and decide what it should become next. Not a ticket queue. A surface of the product with your name on it.
  
  
**You deploy.**
You will be the lead technical contact for one or more customers in the US and UK. You will sit in their working sessions, understand how their teams and catalogs actually work, get our system running on their data, and drive the engagement forward week to week. When something looks wrong on a customer's data, you figure out why.
  
  
The two halves feed each other. What you learn in a customer's account becomes the next thing you build. What you build is what you put in front of the customer.
  
  
You will travel to the US and UK a few times a year to present results to customer stakeholders and join their quarterly reviews: what happened, why, and what we do next. You lead those conversations.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Own a product area (for example AI shopping assistant visibility, content generation, data ingestion, or performance measurement) from design through production
* Ship working software quickly, with AI coding tools as a core part of how you build
* Lead day-to-day engagement with one or more enterprise customers across US and UK time zones
* Translate messy customer problems into clear technical work, and say plainly when a request is the wrong one
* Diagnose problems on live customer data and fix the root cause, not the symptom
* Present findings to senior customer stakeholders, including results they did not hope for

**What We Are Looking For**

* A strong computer science foundation: data structures, systems, databases, and the ability to reason about a problem before you code it
* 1 to 2 years of real engineering experience where you shipped things people used
* Strong Python and SQL
* Ownership: you finish things without being chased and notice problems nobody assigned to you
* Clear communication with non-engineers: you can explain a technical tradeoff to a brand manager in two minutes, in writing or in a room
* Good judgment about what you know and what you do not. You say "I don't know yet" when that is honest, then go find out
* Plus points: exposure to e-commerce or retail (catalogs, marketplaces, search, pricing, product content); comfort with LLMs and agent workflows in production

**What We Are Not Looking For**

* People who want to build only and hand the customer to someone else
* People who want to manage customers only and hand the building to someone else
* Long lists of frameworks and certifications. We care about what you built and why it worked

**Why this role**

* Ownership from your first month: a product area and a customer, not a backlog
* Direct exposure to some of the largest consumer brands in the world, at a stage where most engineers never get in the room
* Work at the edge of AI and commerce, on problems that do not have a playbook yet
* A small team where your judgment shapes the product and the company
* Competitive compensation and chance to work with leadership with global experience

title: Senior Software Solutions Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Senior Software Solutions Engineer to support NVIDIA AI Enterprise customers and deployments across cloud and datacenter environments. This is a dual role: (1) Support, triage and resolve complex customer software issues end-to-end, and (2) build software features, automation, diagnostics, reproducible test cases, and deployment tooling—to improve product readiness and scale support across enterprise environments.
  
  
You will work across compute and cloud-native technologies in CSP environments, including container platforms/orchestrators, enterprise system software, and GPU-accelerated AI frameworks and inference services used to run production AI workloads at scale. In this customer-facing role, you will work closely with customers and internal engineering teams to understand issues, explain root causes, drive resolution, and collaborate on fixes and improvements. Success in this role requires strong debugging skills, crisp communication, and ownership of technically deep escalations from inception to closure.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Develop and maintain product-facing features and deployment assets for AI Enterprise supportability (e.g., scripts, configuration guidance, Kubernetes manifests/Helm charts, and reproducible test cases)
* Develop and maintain Python-based tooling/automation (validators, log collectors, repro harnesses) to improve NVIDIA AI Enterprise deployment reliability across NGC and container orchestrators (e.g., Kubernetes)
* Contribute code-level fixes, patches, or pull requests (as appropriate) in collaboration with engineering to address customer-impacting issues and improve product readiness
* Support enterprise customers deploying NVIDIA AI Enterprise in datacenter and CSP environments, including Kubernetes-based and containerized production AI platforms
* Take ownership of customer issues from inception to resolution: reproduce in lab/cloud, collect diagnostics, provide mitigations, and partner with engineering on fixes
* Create high-quality bug reports and RFEs with clear repro steps, environment details (CSP/Kubernetes/GPU), impact analysis, and supporting artifacts
* Develop customer-facing and internal documentation (KBs, runbooks, deployment guidance) to improve time-to-value and reduce recurring issues
* Be on call one weekend per month in the event a customer has a Sev1 outage and requires engineering assistance

**What We Need To See**

* BS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience)
* 5+ years system software development and troubleshooting experience, ideally with some customer facing
* Strong computer science fundamentals and programming/scripting skills (Python required; Bash; Go/C++ a plus) to automate investigations and build diagnostics/repro tools
* Strong troubleshooting fundamentals (networking, concurrency, OS concepts) and a structured approach to isolating issues across application, platform, and infrastructure layers
* Deep understanding of at least two of the following: data centers/servers, distributed systems, virtualization, deep learning frameworks, containers (Docker/Kubernetes), hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), and CI/CD for reliable deployments
* Familiarity with GPU-accelerated AI/ML stacks and production model deployment/serving (e.g., NGC containers, CUDA/tooling concepts, inference serving such as Triton or similar)
* Deep Linux knowledge and comfort troubleshooting in production Linux environments; working knowledge of Windows is a plus
* Professional-level communication skills, interpersonal skills with a passion to solve problems

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Hands-on experience deploying and operating NVIDIA AI Enterprise components in production across on-prem or CSP environments
* Hands-on experience using AI coding assistants/tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, or similar) to accelerate debugging, automation, and test creation
* Experience operating Kubernetes-based platforms in production (cluster operations, upgrades, control-plane/data-plane failure modes)
* Strong performance debugging skills for GPU and cloud workloads (profiling, latency/throughput tuning) and familiarity with observability/tracing tools

description:

Shift: 24x7 operations, 3 rotational shifts
  
  
Employment Type: Full-time
  
  
Qualification: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field (preferred)
  
  
**Job Summary**
Leapswitch Networks is hiring a Cloud System Administrator to run, maintain and troubleshoot its CloudPe cloud infrastructure in a 24x7 environment. The role covers Linux and Windows server administration, Docker and Kubernetes workloads, dedicated servers, virtualization and Level 2 technical support. Hands-on experience with Linux, Docker, Kubernetes and Windows Server, plus strong Troubleshooting skills is mandatory. Knowledge of OpenStack is an added advantage. The System Administrator will work in 3 rotational shifts and must be able to handle incidents independently, keep services available and maintain secure, reliable operations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Linux and Windows Server Administration
* Install, configure, maintain and troubleshoot Linux distributions (RHEL/AlmaLinux/Rocky, Ubuntu, Debian) and Windows Server environments.
* Manage system services, users, permissions, storage, filesystems and server resources.
* Perform OS updates, patch management, log analysis and performance monitoring.
* Troubleshoot boot failures, service crashes, resource bottlenecks and server availability problems.
* Docker and Kubernetes
* Deploy, manage and troubleshoot Docker containers and container images.
* Operate Kubernetes clusters, including pods, deployments, services, ingress and networking.
* Troubleshoot container failures, resource limits and application connectivity issues.
* Monitor containerized workloads and maintain service availability.
* Cloud Infrastructure Management
* Deploy, configure and maintain CloudPe infrastructure and dedicated servers.
* Manage compute, storage, networking and virtualization resources.
* Monitor resource utilization and optimize infrastructure performance.
* Troubleshoot infrastructure-level issues affecting cloud services and virtual machines.
* Virtualization and Cloud Platforms
* Work with virtualization technologies such as KVM, VMware or Hyper-V.
* Troubleshoot VM provisioning, migration, networking and resource allocation issues.
* Assist with platform upgrades, maintenance and infrastructure expansion.
* Networking and Security
* Troubleshoot TCP/IP, routing, VLANs, bridges, bonding and network connectivity.
* Configure and troubleshoot DNS, SSL certificates, firewalls, VPNs and load balancers.
* Technical Support and Incident Management
* Provide Level 2 support for escalated cloud infrastructure and server issues.
* Handle incidents involving server failures, VM issues, storage, networking and service availability.
* Perform root cause analysis and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Coordinate with internal teams, vendors and customers to resolve issues.
* Take part in planned maintenance windows and shift handovers.
* Automation and Scripting
* Automate repetitive tasks using Bash/shell scripts and Ansible.
* Work with Terraform or similar infrastructure automation tools.
* Support deployment automation and CI/CD workflows.
* Monitoring and Documentation
* Monitor infrastructure health, availability, performance and resource utilization.
* Maintain technical documentation, troubleshooting runbooks and SOPs.
* Prepare incident reports, RCA documents and shift handover notes.
* Flag recurring issues and recommend reliability improvements.

**Mandatory Skills**
(Candidates must have all of the following. Profiles missing any of these should not be shortlisted.)
  
  

* Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in cloud infrastructure, server administration.
* Strong hands-on experience with Linux server administration.
* Strong hands-on experience with Windows Server administration.
* Hands-on experience with Docker (containers, images, networking, volumes).
* Hands-on experience with Kubernetes (clusters, pods, deployments, services, troubleshooting).
* Strong troubleshooting skills across OS, network, storage and application layers.
* Good understanding of networking: TCP/IP, DNS, firewalls, VPNs and SSL.
* Willingness to work 24x7 in 3 rotational shifts, including nights, weekends and holidays as per roster.

GOOD TO HAVE (ADDED ADVANTAGE)
  
  

* Knowledge of OpenStack a strong advantage.
* Experience with virtualization technologies such as KVM, VMware or Hyper-V.
* Experience with Ansible, Terraform and shell scripting.
* Experience with production infrastructure, high availability and performance tuning.
* Exposure to monitoring tools such as Zabbix, Prometheus or Grafana.
* Relevant certifications such as RHCSA/RHCE.

SHIFT AND WORK SCHEDULE
  
  
The Cloud team runs 24x7, and this role works in 3 rotational shifts (morning, evening and night).
  
  

* Shifts rotate as per the team roster; exact timings will be shared at the interview stage.
* Night shifts, weekend and public holiday duty are part of the rotation.
* System Admin must complete a proper shift handover, including open incidents and pending tasks.
* Availability for emergency escalations and planned maintenance windows may be required.

KEY COMPETENCIES
  
  

* Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting ability under pressure.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including incident updates and documentation.
* Ownership of incidents through to resolution and commitment to service availability.
* Ability to work independently on shift and collaborate with cross-functional teams.
