This is an early career role for someone with 1 to 3 years of experience who wants to build a strong foundation in cloud monitoring and production support. The main purpose of the role is to watch the health of our product hosted on Microsoft Azure, respond to alerts, carry out first level troubleshooting and escalate issues to senior engineers with clear and complete information.

The person will work under the guidance of senior Technical Support Engineers and is expected to learn quickly, follow established SOPs and gradually take on more ownership. We also expect them to be curious about AI tools such as Claude and Copilot and willing to use them in their daily work.

**How will you make an impact?**

* Monitor production systems on Azure using tools such as Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics, Grafana and Kibana.
* Watch alert queues and dashboards, acknowledge alerts promptly and act on them as per the defined SOPs.
* Carry out first level troubleshooting by reviewing logs, metrics and recent changes, and document findings clearly.
* Raise and track incidents in the ticketing tool, escalate to senior engineers or Advanced Support on time and with complete information.
* Assist senior engineers during major incidents by gathering logs, running health checks and keeping notes.
* Help reduce false alarms by reporting noisy or misfiring alerts to the senior team.
* Use AI tools such as Claude and Copilot to help read logs, summaries incidents and draft updates.
* Write simple scripts to automate routine tasks such as reports and health checks, with guidance from senior engineers.
* Share clear and timely updates with internal stakeholders during incidents.
* Follow and help update SOPs, knowledge articles and troubleshooting guides.
* Meet the defined SLAs, KPIs and escalation processes.

**Have you got what it takes?**

* 1 to 3 years of experience in technical support, application support, NOC, production monitoring or cloud operations.
* Basic hands on exposure to Microsoft Azure and at least one monitoring or logging tool such as Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics, Grafana or Kibana.
* Basic understanding of cloud concepts, web applications and how client server systems work.
* Working knowledge of Windows or Linux, including reading logs and checking services and processes.
* Basic scripting ability in PowerShell, Python or Shell, or a strong willingness to learn.
* Familiarity with a ticketing tool such as ServiceNow or Jira.
* Comfortable using AI tools such as Claude, Copilot or ChatGPT for day to day technical work.
* Good written and verbal communication skills in English and the ability to explain a technical issue clearly to a senior engineer or a customer.
* Eager to learn, takes feedback well and follows processes carefully.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT or a related field (BE, BTech or BSc).
* Exposure to KQL queries in Log Analytics.
* Basic knowledge of REST APIs and how to test them.
* Awareness of Docker, Kubernetes or CI/CD pipelines.
* Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900) or ITIL Foundation certification.
* Interest in AI tools, prompt writing or building small automations.
* This role works in rotational shifts aligned to US time zones, including night shifts.
* The person will be part of a weekend on-call rotation shared across the team.
* The role is based in our Pune office and works with global teams.
* Work on a product that public safety and justice agencies rely on every day.
* Learn from experienced engineers and get hands on with the latest monitoring, automation and AI tools.
* Clear growth path to Technical Support Engineer and onward to Advanced Support, SRE, Cloud Operations or AI Operations.

**What’s in it for you?**

Join an ever-growing, market disrupting, global company where the teams – comprised of the best of the best – work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NiCE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate, innovative, and excited to constantly raise the bar, you may just be our next NiCEr!

**Enjoy NiCE-FLEX!**

At NiCE, we work according to the NiCE-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. Naturally, office days focus on face-to-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere.

**Reporting into:** Tech Manager

(NASDAQ: NICE) software products are used by 25,000+ global businesses, including 85 of the Fortune 100 corporations, to deliver extraordinary customer experiences, fight financial crime and ensure public safety. Every day, NiCE software manages more than 120 million customer interactions and monitors 3+ billion financial transactions.*

### **Roles & Responsibilities**

Customer Support & Issue Resolution

* Provide advanced technical assistance to diagnose, analyze, and resolve unique and complex software, hardware, networking, and infrastructural issues in enterprise environments.

Documentation & Knowledge Management

* Thoroughly document all customer interactions, status updates, and resolutions in existing case management tools.
* Create clear, concise documentation (case management notes, technical tips, and white papers) and contribute to the Technical Support Knowledge Base to reduce future troubleshooting time and drive faster issue resolution.

Mentorship, Training & Professional Development

* Research a wide array of technical topics, developing an in-depth knowledge of operating systems, infrastructure technologies, the security ecosystem, and Symantec products.
* Collaborate with other support engineers by delivering in-the-moment coaching and guidance.

* Take responsibility for personal career development through new product training, external/internal seminars, self-directed study, and seeking mentorship from senior staff and management.

### **Technical Skills and Qualifications**

Education & Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience in a related field.
* 10+ years of experience working with customers in a fast-paced, high-tech, support-related position or similar engineering role.

Certifications

* Must possess one or more of the following relevant industry certifications: MCSA, MCSE, CCNA, or CompTIA Security+.
* Additional certifications such as CCNP, CCIE, CCSP, and/or CISSP are highly desired.

Networking & Security

* Strong networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP (and TCP/IP stack), Packet Switching, Routing, and Network Topologies.
* Advanced knowledge of application and routing protocols including NAT, DNS, DHCP, HTTP, MMS, RTSP, FTP, IM, QoS, and RPC.
* Experience using telecom, packet sniffers, and networking tools such as Wireshark or SnifferPro.
* Working knowledge of remote access technologies and inter-operations, including RADIUS, ACE, VPNs, LDAP, NTLM, and firewalls.
* Working knowledge of Internet Services such as Web Services, Media Servers, Proxy services, browser, and media player operations.
* Experience with Symantec Network Protection products and/or other network-internet security products is desired.
* Familiarity with Intrusion Detection System brands and technologies, as well as Vulnerability Network Scanners, is an added advantage.

Operating Systems & Infrastructure

* Expert-level understanding of Windows Server Concepts, with required experience in Windows Server 2008 and 2012.
* Solid hands-on experience troubleshooting Windows OS and application-related issues (Windows Server/Client).
* Experience with Linux OS Administration is an added advantage.
* Strong working knowledge of Enterprise Level Infrastructure Technology, specifically Active Directory, DNS, and DHCP.
* Working knowledge of Windows Exchange and/or other Mail systems.

Database, Virtualization & Scripting

* Working knowledge of Relational Database principles and methodologies (e.g., SQL, Oracle).
* Knowledge of virtualization technologies (VMWare, Hyper-V) is an added advantage.
* Scripting or programming concepts are considered an added advantage.

Soft Skills & Competencies

* Advanced troubleshooting and debugging skills.
* Proven capability to own, drive, and take responsibility for issues.
* Ability to multitask, prioritize, and work well under pressure.
* Demonstrated leadership qualities.

title: Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Role overview

The Infrastructure Engineer (Azure) is a hybrid remote role reports to the CTO and works across technology, operations and business teams in the US, Europe and Asia-Pacific.

Day to day, you will run and optimise Azure workloads, keep networking secure and reliable, resolve infrastructure incidents and service requests, and automate routine tasks. You will also write and maintain the IT and cloud policies that keep the environment secure, compliant and auditable, and lead capacity planning, disaster recovery and security reviews.

**Location:**
Hybrid / remote

**Reports to:**
Chief Technology Officer

**Employment type:**
Full-time

Key responsibilities

**Azure infrastructure and operations**

* Design, build and operate Azure environments, including virtual machines, App Services, Azure SQL, storage accounts, Key Vault and Azure Functions.
* Manage Azure subscriptions, management groups, resource groups and landing zones in line with the Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework.
* Monitor performance and availability using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics and Application Insights, and tune workloads for reliability and cost.
* Manage patching, backups and configuration for Windows and Linux servers, cloud and remaining on-premises.
* Resolve infrastructure incidents and service requests, and carry out root-cause analysis.

**Networking and security**

* Configure and secure Azure networking: VNets, NSGs, Azure Firewall, VPN gateways, Private Endpoints and DNS.
* Administer Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD): identities, groups, conditional access, MFA and Privileged Identity Management.
* Operate Microsoft Defender for Cloud and Defender for Endpoint, and act on security recommendations and alerts.
* Manage Microsoft 365 security settings, including Intune device management, email security and data loss prevention.

**Governance, policy and compliance**

* Write, implement and maintain IT and cloud policies, standards and procedures (see the next section).
* Enforce policy technically through Azure Policy, management group hierarchy, RBAC, tagging standards and resource locks.
* Maintain evidence and documentation for internal audit, regulators and counterparties, including due diligence questionnaires.
* Run periodic access reviews, security reviews and policy compliance reporting for the CTO.

**Automation and resilience**

* Automate provisioning and routine tasks using Terraform or Bicep, PowerShell and Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions pipelines.
* Plan and test disaster recovery and business continuity using Azure Backup and Azure Site Recovery.
* Lead capacity planning and cost management, using Azure Cost Management and reservations.
* Support new product and platform launches across US, European and Asia-Pacific markets.

Policies and standards you will own

You will draft, implement and review these policies with the CTO, IT team and compliance, and keep them current at least annually.

Policy / standard

**What it covers**

* Information security policy
* Overall security principles, roles and responsibilities
* Access control and identity policy
* Joiners, movers and leavers; MFA; least privilege; privileged access; access reviews
* Cloud governance and Azure usage standard
* Subscription structure, naming and tagging, approved services and regions, Azure Policy baselines
* Password and authentication policy
* Password rules, MFA, passwordless and service account credentials
* Network security policy
* Segmentation, firewall rules, remote access and VPN, change control on network rules
* Patch and vulnerability management policy
* Patching cadence, severity-based remediation timelines, exception handling
* Backup, disaster recovery and business continuity policy
* Backup scope and retention, RPO and RTO targets, DR test schedule
* Change management policy
* Change requests, approvals, testing and rollback
* Incident response policy
* Detection, escalation, communication and post-incident review
* Data protection and encryption policy
* Data classification, encryption at rest and in transit, key management, DLP
* Logging and monitoring policy
* What is logged, retention periods, alert ownership
* Acceptable use and endpoint policy
* Use of company devices, Intune compliance, removable media
* Third-party and vendor access policy
* Access for vendors, service providers and counterparties

Qualifications

**Required**

* 3+ years in infrastructure engineering or systems administration, with at least 3 years running production workloads in Microsoft Azure.
* Strong Azure skills across compute, storage, networking, Azure SQL, Key Vault and monitoring.
* Hands-on Microsoft Entra ID and Microsoft 365 administration, including conditional access, MFA and Intune.
* System administration skills: Windows Server and Linux configuration, patching, user management and performance tuning.
* Networking skills: routing, switching, VPNs, DNS and network performance monitoring.
* Network security skills: firewall configuration, access controls, encryption and security best practice.
* Proven experience writing and enforcing IT policies, standards and procedures, including through Azure Policy and RBAC.
* Experience with backup, disaster recovery and Azure Site Recovery.
* Strong troubleshooting skills on complex technical issues.

**Desirable**

* Microsoft certifications such as AZ-104 (Azure Administrator), AZ-305 (Azure Solutions Architect), AZ-500 (Azure Security Engineer) or SC-300 (Identity and Access Administrator).
* Familiarity with security frameworks such as ISO 27001, NIST CSF, CIS Benchmarks or SOC 2.

**Personal attributes**

* Clear written and verbal communication, including documentation for non-technical readers.
* Able to work independently in a remote setting and across time zones.
* Committed to security, reliability and continuous improvement, with a proactive approach to spotting risk.

title: Project Engineer
description:
**Position Summary**

The Project Engineer I – SharePoint & Build Quality is a member of the IT Project Team in India and reports to a Project Manager. The role has two primary focuses.

The first is SharePoint delivery: building SharePoint Online sites (primarily hub-and-spoke architectures), migrating content from other Microsoft 365 tenants and on-premises file servers, configuring and testing security groups, and ensuring every deliverable matches the specifications provided by the Project Manager. Testing, remediation, and documentation are core parts of this work.

The second is build quality control: reviewing standard operating builds for tools implemented in client environments against their SOP build sheets, validating that each build was completed correctly, and clearly reporting any gaps to the Project Manager.

Work is assigned from project plans and scheduled across multiple concurrent projects. Initially, the role works internally with the project team. As experience and confidence grow, the role will take on increasing direct client interaction.

**Key Responsibilities**

**SharePoint Site Builds**

Build SharePoint Online sites from Project Manager specifications, with a primary focus on hub and-spoke architectures. Configure site structure, navigation, document libraries, metadata, and permissions to the approved design. Confirm that the finished build matches the specification before handoff.

**Content Migrations**

Execute migrations of content from other Microsoft 365 tenants and on-premises file servers into SharePoint Online and OneDrive, using tools such as Sharegate or Microsoft Migration Manager. Support pre-migration planning and mapping, perform post-migration validation, and resolve migration issues. Document what was moved, what was excluded, and any exceptions.

**Security Groups and Permissions**

Set up Entra ID security groups, Microsoft 365 groups, and SharePoint permission groups as designed. Test that access works as intended for each user role, remediate anything that does not, and document the final permission model for handoff.

**Testing, Remediation, and Documentation**

Test each deliverable against the project specification. Remediate defects found during testing or by the Project Manager. Maintain implementation checklists and produce clear, consistent documentation for each build, migration, and permission design so the Operations Team can support it going forward.

**Build Quality Control (QC)**

Review completed standard operating builds for tools deployed to clients, such as but not limited to Barracuda, Sentinel One, ImmyBot, and KnowBe4, against their SOP build sheets. Validate that each item was completed correctly. Where a build does not match the SOP, document the specific gaps and communicate them to the Project Manager for remediation.

**Project to Operations Handover**

Ensure a smooth transition from Projects to Operations by delivering configurations, changes, and

documentation in standard format, and by supporting knowledge transfer activities as needed.

**Operations Support**

When project workload allows, contribute to the Operations Team on Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive, and Entra ID related tickets and troubleshooting, prioritized by business impact and urgency.

**Skills and Attributes for Success**

* Strong attention to detail, with the discipline to follow a specification or build sheet exactly and flag anything that does not match
* Consistent documentation and checklist habits
* Ability to manage assigned tasks across multiple scheduled projects and meet timelines
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
* Clear written communication for reporting test results, migration outcomes, and QC findings to the Project Manager
* Ability to work effectively with US-based teams across time zones
* Ability to work independently within a defined plan while coordinating with the project team

**Qualifications and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree, diploma, or equivalent qualification in IT or a related field
* 3+ years of hands-on experience with Microsoft 365 and SharePoint Online, including Teams, OneDrive, and Entra ID
* Experience building SharePoint sites and configuring permissions; hub-and-spoke site experience preferred
* Experience with SharePoint or Microsoft 365 content migrations preferred; familiarity with tools such as ShareGate, Bit-Titan, or Microsoft Migration Manager is a plus
* Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 security groups, governance, and PowerShell
* Experience following SOPs, build-sheets, or implementation checklists in an IT service delivery environment preferred
* Exposure to tools such as Barracuda, SentinelOne, ImmyBot, or KnowBe4 is a plus

**What We Look For**

* A reliable, process-oriented approach to project delivery
* Ownership of implementation quality and documentation
* Honest, timely reporting of issues and gaps
* Commitment to continuous learning and technical development

**Future Skill Development**

*Over time, and based on business needs and demonstrated performance, there may be opportunities to grow into areas such as SharePoint architecture, retention and compliance, Power Automate, Power Apps, and Power BI.*

title: Production Engineer
description:
**About Us**

PlusWealth Capital Management LLP is a proprietary high-frequency trading firm, active in multiple markets including equities, options and futures. **THINK. TECH. TRADE.**
If you share our vision, we'd love to have you on board.

**Role Overview**

In this role, you will be a strong software engineer with production-debugging and distributed-systems expertise, responsible for the reliability of our mission-critical trading platform. This is not simply triaging and closing incidents: you will diagnose, automate and permanently eliminate the underlying application issues. You will reproduce failures, read and modify production code to implement the fix, and add detection or prevention mechanisms so the same class of issue doesn't recur.

**What You'll Do**

* **Partner with traders.**
  Work directly with the trading desk to understand what they need from our systems, and turn that into fixes, tools and improvements.
* **Own production support.**
  Provide L1 and L2 support for live trading systems, diagnose issues under time pressure, and drive them to root cause.
* **Build a self-correcting support system.**
  Help design and implement tooling that detects, diagnoses and recovers from failures with less human intervention.
* **Grow our Python framework.**
  Extend and improve our in-house Python codebase, and help shape where it goes next.
* **Ship faster with AI.**
  Use AI-assisted development and automation to significantly cut the time it takes to get system changes into production.
* **Strengthen observability.**
  Contribute to our monitoring stack (Grafana, Prometheus, alerting) and report clearly on system status and health.
* **Be the technical face to brokers and exchanges.**
  Act as the primary technical contact for connectivity, certification and incident coordination.
* **Share on-call.**
  Take part in a periodic after-hours and early-morning coverage rotation.

**What We're Looking For**

Ideally, you come from the finance industry and bring:

* 3–5 years in a high-pressure production environment, diagnosing and resolving live issues on the fly
* A solid grasp of electronic trading and financial instruments: equities, futures and options
* Strong Unix/Linux skills and production-grade Python
* Hands-on experience with a scheduler or orchestrator such as Airflow
* Working experience with Grafana dashboards and alerting
* A good understanding of networking and operating-system fundamentals
* The ability to juggle several tasks at once in a fast-paced setting, with real ownership of outcomes
* Willingness to pick up work of any size, from a one-line fix to a new subsystem
* Clear, confident communication in English, with traders, engineers and external counterparties alike
* Curiosity, and a habit of solving problems in new ways rather than patching around them

**Nice to Have**

* SQL and experience working with relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred)
* Exposure to exchange connectivity or trading protocols on Indian or global venues
* Experience with Kafka, Prometheus or other parts of a modern observability and data stack

**Benefits & Perks**

* Competitive compensation and performance-based bonuses
* Flat organizational structure with high ownership and visibility
* Medical insurance covering you and your dependents
* Catered meals and snacks for all five working days in the office
* Generous paid time-off policies

*PlusWealth Capital Management LLP is an equal opportunity employer.*

We are a network and digital integrator that understands the entire value chain of the digital world, freeing our customers to focus on the strategic initiatives that shape their business.
  
  
Every day, you will collaborate with a team dedicated to providing consistent, sustainable global solutions, no matter where our customers operate. Technical Architecture and Design: Develop and maintain architectural blueprints and technical specifications for cloud system

Organize Roll Out Plan for Installation on Weekends/as per the Change Approval.

Need to have complete and in-depth knowledge of application architecture and associated Platforms
  
  
Setup potential industrialization under application perimeter
  
  
Improvise functionality, efficiency and availability of applications in scope
  
  
Ensure reliability of Production Plans and knowledge of impacting interfaces
  
  
Maintain timely communication with customer support teams.
  
  
Ability to handle escalations and outages for applications and keep accountability to achieve resolution at the earliest

Customer Technical Documents
  
  
Update ICOG’s and SOP portal with the latest documents.
  
  
Properly updating Knowledge Base Articles and Procedure Documents.

You bring a can-do attitude, tackle challenges head-on and challenge the status quo with new and innovative ideas.

title: Specialist - IT
description:
**Backdrop**
AVIZVA is a Healthcare Technology Organization that harnesses technology to simplify, accelerate, & optimize the way healthcare enterprises deliver care. Established in 2011, we have served as strategic enablers for healthcare enterprises, helping them enhance their overall care delivery.
  
  
With over 15 years of expertise, we have engineered more than 150 tailored products for leading Medical Health Plans, Dental and Vision Plan Providers, PBMs, Medicare Plan Providers, TPAs, and more.
  
  
**Overview Of The Role**
As a Specialist - IT, you’ll be responsible for providing day-to-day IT support to employees and ensuring timely resolution of technical issues. The role requires hands-on troubleshooting of Mac hardware and macOS applications, along with support for device configuration, IT service desk operations, and Microsoft Office 365 administration.
  
  
The position will also manage IT assets and inventory, maintain support documentation and compliance records, coordinate with IT vendors on billing, maintenance, renewals, and support activities, and prepare operational reports and dashboards.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Provide IT support to employees and resolve technical issues efficiently.
* Troubleshoot Apple hardware, including MacBooks, iMacs, and Mac mini, as well as macOS applications.
* Support Mac-compatible MDM solutions through policy creation, configuration management, and automated device configuration; Jamf Pro experience is preferred.
* Maintain IT support records, documentation, and operational activities in line with standard IT compliance requirements.
* Knowledge of IT Service Desk tools; Jira Service Management (JSM) experience will be an added advantage.
* Manage IT assets and inventory, maintain accurate records, prepare reports, and create visual dashboards and status reports.
* Coordinate with IT vendors for billing, maintenance, renewals, and support-related activities.
* Provide working-level support for Microsoft Office 365 administration.
* Analyze recurring technical issues and identify opportunities to improve IT support quality and operational efficiency.

**Skills & Qualifications**

* Relevant bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification in IT, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Hands-on experience in IT support, including VIP / executive support.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to resolve technical issues efficiently.
* Hands-on experience troubleshooting Apple hardware and macOS applications.
* Working knowledge of Mac-supported MDM solutions; experience with Jamf Pro is preferred.
* Knowledge of IT Service Desk tools, preferably Jira Service Management (JSM), is an advantage.
* Experience in IT asset and inventory management, reporting, and dashboard preparation.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Office 365 administration.
* Strong documentation, communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills.

title: IT Engineer (Technical Support & Infrastructure)
description:
**IT Engineer (Technical Support & Infrastructure)**

**Location:**
Gurugram, Haryana, India

**Work Mode:**
On-site

**Experience:**
2–4 Years

**About the Role**

We are looking for a customer-focused IT Engineer to support technical integrations, infrastructure, and troubleshooting across a technology platform. The role involves working with systems, APIs, databases, and cloud infrastructure to ensure reliable data synchronization and seamless system connectivity.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical troubleshooting skills with excellent communication and a client-facing approach to resolving technical issues.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide technical support and troubleshoot integrations across PMS, CRM, booking engines, and F&B systems.
* Monitor system performance, data pipelines, and API integrations to ensure reliability and real-time data synchronization.
* Collaborate with engineering and product teams to diagnose, escalate, and resolve complex technical issues.
* Support the onboarding of new clients by configuring technical environments and validating system connectivity.
* Document troubleshooting procedures, technical workflows, and system architecture.
* Manage API credentials, security protocols, and user access controls in line with data security requirements.
* Perform routine system audits, maintenance checks, and minor infrastructure updates.
* Serve as a primary technical contact for clients, ensuring timely resolution of issues and a positive support experience.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field.
* 2–4 years of experience in technical support, IT engineering, or systems integration, preferably in SaaS or technology.
* Working knowledge of RESTful APIs, JSON, and data synchronization processes.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Basic understanding of SQL databases and data troubleshooting.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, particularly in diagnosing software integration issues.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with a professional, customer-oriented approach.
* Fluency in English. Knowledge of additional languages used in Middle Eastern or international markets is an advantage.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Property Management Systems (PMS), such as OPERA, Mews, or Cloudbeds.
* Experience working in a fast-paced startup or early-stage technology company.
* Basic scripting knowledge in Python or JavaScript for troubleshooting and automation.
* Familiarity with ITIL practices and ticketing platforms such as Jira Service Management or Zendesk.

**What We Offer**

* An opportunity to work with innovative technology solutions.
* Hands-on exposure to integrations, APIs, cloud infrastructure, and systems.
* A collaborative environment with opportunities to develop technical and client-facing skills.
* Professional growth within a technology-driven organization.

title: Managed Services, Operations Lead
description:
AHEAD builds platforms for digital business. By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation.
  
  
At AHEAD, we prioritize creating a culture of belonging, where all perspectives and voices are represented, valued, respected, and heard. We create spaces to empower everyone to speak up, make change, and drive the culture at AHEAD.
  
  
We are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate based on an individual's race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law, whether actual or perceived.

Role overview
  
  
The EUS Operations Lead coordinates day-to-day service operations across assigned shifts, helping maintain critical-call coverage, support analysts with active escalations, and route urgent work to the right operational teams. The role promotes reliable handoffs and visibility of service health while ensuring operational ownership stays with the teams responsible for resolution.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Maintain critical-call readiness: Ensure the designated EUS/Service Desk P1 queues have active, named coverage throughout the shift, including planned breaks and handoffs. Provide overflow support when a P1 call rolls over, and promptly raise coverage or proficiency gaps through the appropriate operations leadership.
* Coordinate shift coverage: Confirm coverage for the current and incoming shifts, communicate gaps early, and coordinate available backup when unexpected absences occur. Escalate persistent staffing constraints rather than treating repeated lead coverage as the ongoing solution.
* Manage shift execution: Set shift priorities, review workload and coverage across queues, and ensure analysts understand the operational focus and escalation expectations for the shift.
* Coordinate analysts on shift: Monitor analyst availability and work allocation, help balance workload during volume spikes or absences, and ensure breaks and handoffs are coordinated without leaving critical queues uncovered.
* Support analyst performance and readiness: Provide in-the-moment guidance, reinforce documented procedures, and identify coaching or training needs for follow-up with the appropriate supervisor or manager.
* Lead shift handoffs: Ensure outgoing and incoming analysts exchange updates on open tickets, active escalations, queue conditions, and coverage risks so work continues smoothly across shifts.
* Respond to analyst escalations: Monitor the designated Service Desk escalation channel and provide timely operational guidance when an analyst needs help with an active customer interaction. Coordinate coverage among onduty leads so the channel remains supported during breaks and other planned absences.
* Route urgent incidents through the agreed channels: Ensure P1/P2

escalations received through the approved intake paths are relayed to the Urgent Escalations channel and tagged or handed off to the appropriate team. Reinforce use of shared escalation channels rather than relying on direct messages to individual lead
  
  
**Why AHEAD**
Through our daily work and internal groups like Moving Women AHEAD and RISE AHEAD, we value and benefit from diversity of people, ideas, experience, and everything in between.
  
  
We fuel growth by stacking our office with top-notch technologies in a multi-million-dollar lab, by encouraging cross department training and development, sponsoring certifications and credentials for continued learning.

**Comprehensive health insurance**
coverage for employees, with options to extend coverage to dependents
  
  
**Paid time off and company holidays**
, along with additional leave benefits as per policy
  
  
**Flexible work arrangements**
, supporting work-life balance
  
  
**Learning and development opportunities**
to support continuous growth and upskilling
  
  
**Employee wellness initiatives**
and programs focused on physical and mental well-being
  
  
**Retirement and statutory benefits**
in line with India regulations
  
  
**Inclusive and people-first culture**
, with a strong focus on collaboration and ownership

title: Lead Infrastructure - Intune Endpoint Engineer
description:
****About The Role:****
**Grade Level (for internal use):**
11
  
  
****About The Team****
The Digital Experience Endpoint Management team sits within the Digital Solutions group and provides architecture and engineering services for S&P Global's global workforce across desktops, laptops, mobile devices, and productivity applications. We value technical excellence and collaborative problem-solving, with deep expertise in the Microsoft ecosystem and enterprise Windows management. Our mission is to raise workforce productivity through modern, secure, and automated device management.
  
  
****About The Role****
You will be a senior hands-on engineer and subject matter expert for MAC endpoint management, owning the design and delivery of JAMF-based solutions across the enterprise. You will act as the engineering escalation point for our outsource partner, drive key endpoint modernization initiatives, and help shape the future of workplace technology at S&P Global.
  
  
****Primary Responsibilities****

* Administer MAC OS Devices, JAMF Management, device management, and Policy and Profile management across MAC Management toolset.
* Design and implement JAMF-based solutions for MAC workstations and mobile devices, ensuring performance, security compliance, and automated deployment
* Provide engineering expertise for complex MAC management requests and other endpoint management projects
* Re-package and deploy applications for Windows, macOS, and Linux using tools such as PSADT, AdminStudio, and PowerShell
* Design, deploy, and maintain JAMF Protect profiles and configurations.

****Secondary Responsibilities****

* Support macOS device management and cross-platform MDM solutions
* Collaborate with outsource partners on endpoint management initiatives and infrastructure projects
* Contribute to hardware standards, procurement processes, and enterprise workplace productivity technologies.

**Broader Impact**

* Provide engineering support to our outsource partner — reactively for complex issues and proactively for projects
* Ensure product engineering and lifecycle management processes are consistently followed
* Maintain and enforce enterprise standards, goals, and compliance requirements
* Act as SME on infrastructure projects and drive implementation of key enterprise initiatives
* Partner with business IT teams and stakeholders to identify problems and opportunities addressable through technology
* Influence future technology decisions and provide input on IT strategy, operations, and innovation.

****Basic Required Qualifications****

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field (preferred)
* 9+ years of experience in end-user computing with a focus on Windows environments
* Hands-on experience administering Microsoft Intune and managing Windows devices at enterprise scale
* Experience designing and deploying App Control for Business policies
* Proficiency with Group Policy, Configuration Manager (SCCM), and automated Windows deployment
* Deep experience with Windows hardware platforms including Dell, Lenovo, and Microsoft Surface
* Knowledge of Microsoft Endpoint Manager, Entra ID (Azure AD), and Microsoft 365 device management
* Familiarity with iOS and Android mobile device management through Intune
* Strong PowerShell scripting and Windows automation skills
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities for Windows-specific issues
* Excellent communication skills for working with end users and cross-functional teams
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment.

****Additional Preferred Qualifications****

* Experience with Windows Autopilot and modern device provisioning workflows
* Knowledge of Azure services such as Entra Connect, Conditional Access, and Identity Protection
* Familiarity with virtualization technologies such as Hyper-V, VMware, or Azure Virtual Desktop
* Experience with Windows security frameworks such as Microsoft Defender for Endpoint and compliance management tools
* Prior experience as an SME on Microsoft infrastructure projects
* Track record of driving enterprise Windows modernization and workplace productivity improvements
* Experience with Microsoft vendor relationships and enterprise licensing programs
* Demonstrated ability to influence technology decisions and provide strategic input on Windows-focused IT operations.

**Job Location: Noida/Gurugram/Bengaluru/Hyderabad**

title: Technical Consultant (Japanese Speaking)
description:
**Description**
Anaqua is looking for a Technical Consultant (Japanese Speaking) to support data conversion and system implementation projects for our Japanese-speaking client base. In this role, you will build data mappings, validate converted data, and oversee software installations, working closely with clients throughout the implementation lifecycle. Strong client management skills and fluency in Japanese are essential.
  
  
**You'll Love This Job If You Like To**

* Analyze data to create mappings used in data conversion.
* Create data maps, validate converted data, and identify and solve complex conversion issues.
* Oversee the complete installation of software, where applicable.
* Gather and translate business requirements into technical specifications.
* Manage client relationships throughout the implementation process, driving continuous improvement.
* Deliver presentations and manage meetings with clients and stakeholders.
* Work across a modern stack including SQL Server, ETL processes, and data migration tools.
* Collaborate within a high-performing, multi-project team environment.

**Requirements**

* BS/BA in Computer Science or a related field.
* Minimum of 5 years' experience, including experience working with a Japanese company.
* Excellent problem-solving, analytical and time-management skills.
* Knowledge of systems integration and the system development lifecycle.
* Proficient in SQL Server and ETL/data migration processes.
* Experience using Microsoft Office Suite, Visio, and Project.
* Excellent Japanese (JLPT N2) and strong English communication skills.
* Intellectual Property or software implementation experience an added advantage.

Anaqua, Inc. is a premium provider of integrated intellectual property (IP) management technology solutions and services. Anaqua’s AQX platform combines best practice workflows with big data analytics and tech-enabled services to create an intelligent environment designed to inform IP strategy, enable IP decision-making, and streamline IP operations. Today, nearly half of the top 100 U.S. patent filers and global brands, as well as a growing number of law firms worldwide use Anaqua’s solutions. Over one million IP executives, attorneys, paralegals, administrators, and innovators in large and medium-sized companies use the platform for their IP management needs. The company’s global operations are headquartered in Boston, with offices across the U.S., Europe, and Asia. For additional information, please visit anaqua.com, or on LinkedIn.

title: Infrastructure Engineer (Linux Platforms)
description:
Colt provides network, voice and data centre services to thousands of businesses around the world, allowing them to focus on delivering their business goals instead of the underlying infrastructure.
  
  
**Why we need this role**
The Infrastructure Engineer designs, builds, automates, tests and operates secure Linux-based infrastructure supporting critical telecommunications network services. Working from agreed architectural and engineering standards, the role deploys and maintains platforms supporting DNS, routing, identity, authentication, monitoring, observability and network-management capabilities.
  
  
The Engineer is responsible for reliable implementation, infrastructure automation, lifecycle maintenance, monitoring, incident resolution and continuous improvement. The role works across Network Engineering, Security, Infrastructure, Architecture and Operations and progressively develops ownership of defined platforms and services.
  
  
The role supports a distributed estate of hundreds of Linux systems across critical network, security, operational and business services.
  
  
**Platforms and Services**
The team designs, deploys, automates and maintains Linux infrastructure supporting:
  
  

* Authoritative, recursive and caching DNS services.
* Route reflectors and other routing control-plane services.
* Authentication, authorisation and accounting services.
* Identity management, directory and privileged-access integrations.
* Network observability, telemetry, logging and monitoring platforms.
* Network-management and automation services.
* Virtualised and, where appropriate, containerised infrastructure.
* Supporting services such as NTP, PKI, certificate management, secure repositories and configuration services.

**What You Will Do**
**Platform Engineering and Delivery**

* Build, configure, test and maintain Linux platforms using distributions such as RHEL and Ubuntu.
* Implement infrastructure from approved architecture, high-level designs, low-level designs and engineering standards.
* Execute platform deployments, upgrades, migrations, patching and decommissioning activities.
* Maintain accurate configuration, asset, dependency and lifecycle records.
* Participate in design reviews and identify practical improvements to platform standards and implementation approaches.

**Network-Critical Services**

* Deploy and maintain DNS platforms and support resolution, delegation, availability and security troubleshooting.
* Build and maintain Linux hosts supporting route reflectors and other routing control-plane services under approved network designs.
* Deploy and support authentication, authorisation, accounting, identity and directory services, including Red Hat and Oracle LDAP environments.
* Implement and maintain network observability, telemetry, logging, monitoring and network-management platforms.

**Automation and Efficiency**

* Develop and maintain automation using Ansible, Bash or Python and infrastructure-as-code principles.
* Identify repetitive operational activities and implement approved automation to reduce manual effort and error.
* Maintain consistent, reusable configuration and build standards across environments.

**Operations, Reliability and Lifecycle**

* Monitor platform service health, performance, capacity, availability and resilience.
* Implement health checks, dashboards, logs and actionable alerts as part of each platform deployment.
* Investigate incidents and alerts, contribute to root-cause analysis and implement agreed corrective actions.
* Test backup, restoration, failover and recovery procedures and record the results.
* Support platform currency, vulnerability remediation, upgrade and obsolescence plans.

**Security and Compliance**

* Implement and validate platform hardening in line with approved standards, including CIS-aligned controls where applicable.
* Maintain vulnerability remediation, access controls, secrets, keys, certificates and centralised audit logging.
* Produce and maintain evidence for internal controls, audit and compliance activities.
* Support security investigations and preserve relevant operational and forensic evidence.
* Escalate unsupported, end-of-life or non-compliant components and support agreed remediation plans.

**Collaboration and Documentation**

* Work with Network Engineering, Security, Infrastructure, Architecture, Operations and application teams.
* Produce and maintain implementation records, technical documentation, support models and operational runbooks.
* Share knowledge, contribute to team capability and progressively take ownership of defined services or technical components.

**Operational Support**

* Participate in the Infrastructure Operations on-call rota supporting priority incidents.

**What We're Looking For**
**Required Skills and Experience**

* Typically three to five years of experience in Linux administration or infrastructure engineering within enterprise or service-provider environments.
* Strong practical experience with enterprise Linux distributions, particularly RHEL and Ubuntu; experience with CentOS or successor-compatible distributions is beneficial.
* Experience with Ansible, Bash or Python scripting, configuration management and infrastructure-as-code principles.
* Working knowledge of TCP/IP, IPv4 and IPv6, DNS, routing principles and BGP.
* Working knowledge of network segmentation, firewalls, load balancing, NTP, PKI, TLS, certificates, authentication and identity services.
* Experience implementing monitoring, logging, alerting, backup, recovery and high-availability controls.
* Understanding of platform hardening, vulnerability remediation and CIS or ISO-aligned security practices.
* Strong troubleshooting, documentation, communication and teamwork capability.

**Desirable Skills And Knowledge**

* Experience supporting DNS, routing infrastructure, AAA, identity, network-observability or network-monitoring platforms.
* Virtualisation platforms such as VMware and KVM.
* Containerisation technologies such as Docker or Podman and understanding of Kubernetes concepts and operational practices.
* Enterprise storage technologies such as SAN and NAS.
* Experience with database environments.
* On-premises and cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud Platform.
* Basic Windows Server awareness.

**Leadership and Behaviours**

* Ownership: takes responsibility for assigned work and service outcomes.
* Technical capability: builds strong Linux and network infrastructure engineering expertise.
* Delivery focus: executes work reliably, safely and to agreed quality standards.
* Collaboration: works effectively within and across teams.
* Communication: documents work clearly and communicates risks and issues promptly.
* Adaptability and continuous improvement: responds well to operational challenges and seeks opportunities to improve services and processes.

**Preferred Qualifications / Education And Experience**

* Degree in Computer Science, Network Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant industry experience.
* RHCSA, RHCE, LFCS or a similar certification is beneficial or may be in progress.
* Relevant network, virtualisation or security certifications are also beneficial.

**Summary**
Linux and network infrastructure engineering role focused on the secure build, automation, operation, monitoring and lifecycle improvement of platforms supporting critical telecommunications network services.
  
  
**What We Offer You**
**Looking to make a mark?**
At Colt, you’ll make a difference. Because around here, we empower people. We don’t tell you what to do.
  
  
Instead, we employ people we trust, who come together across the globe to create intelligent solutions.
  
  
Our global teams are full of ambitious, driven people, all working together towards one shared purpose: to put the power of the digital universe in the hands of our customers wherever, whenever and however they want.
  
  
We give our people the opportunity to inspire and lead teams, and work on projects that connect people, cities, businesses, and ideas. We want you to help us change the world, for the better.
  
  
**Diversity and inclusion**

* Inclusion and valuing diversity of thought and experience are at the heart of our culture here at Colt. From day one, you’ll be encouraged to be yourself because we believe that’s what helps our people to thrive. We welcome people with diverse backgrounds and experiences, regardless of their gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, disability, neurodiversity, age, marital status, pregnancy status, or place of birth.

**Most Recently We Have**

* Signed the UN Women Empowerment Principles which guide our Gender Action Plan
* Trained 60 (and growing) Colties to be Mental Health First Aiders
* Please speak with a member of our recruitment team if you require adjustments to our recruitment process to support you. For more information about our Inclusion and Diversity agenda, visit our DEI pages.

**Benefits**
Our benefits support you through all parts of life, for both physical and mental health.
  
  

* Flexible working hours and the option to work from home.
* Extensive induction program with experienced mentors and buddies.
* Opportunities for further development and educational opportunities.
* Global Family Leave Policy.
* Employee Assistance Program.
* Internal inclusion & diversity employee networks.

**A global network**

**Job Description – IT Analyst**

**Company: iTech Ecommerce Pvt. Ltd.**

**Department: Backend**

**Job Location: Sector 4, Noida (no relocation)**

**Employment Type: Full-time**

**Key Responsibilities**

1. IT Support and Troubleshooting

 Provide first-level technical support to employees for hardware, software, network and

system-related issues.

 Diagnose and resolve issues related to desktops, laptops, printers, scanners, peripherals and

other office IT equipment.

 Troubleshoot operating system, application, email, login, and connectivity issues.

 Ensure timely resolution of IT requests and minimise disruption to daily business operations.

 Escalate complex technical issues to the relevant vendor or service provider and follow up

until resolution.

2. IT Infrastructure and Asset Management

 Monitor and maintain the company's IT infrastructure, including computers, network

devices, internet connectivity, and office systems.

 Maintain an updated inventory of IT assets, including device allocation, serial numbers,

configurations, and asset handovers.

 Coordinate the setup, configuration, and decommissioning of IT equipment for new joiners

and exiting employees.

 Track hardware repairs, replacements, warranties, and maintenance schedules.

 Support IT requirements across regional offices and coordinate with local teams whenever

required.

3. User Access and System Administration

 Create, configure, and manage employee user accounts and access permissions for

approved systems.

 Assist with official email setup, password resets, access issues, and account deactivation.

 Ensure access rights are granted and revoked in accordance with management approvals

and company policies.

 Support employees in using business applications and internal tools effectively.

4. Network and Information Security

 Troubleshoot LAN, Wi-Fi, internet connectivity, and basic network configuration issues.

 Support antivirus deployment, software updates, system patching, and routine security

checks.

 Follow company policies for data protection, access control, password management, and

secure handling of company information.

 Identify and report potential security risks, suspicious activities, and recurring system

vulnerabilities.

 Ensure company data and IT assets are handled securely during employee onboarding,

transfers, and exits.

5. Software, Vendors and IT Documentation

 Coordinate with software vendors, internet service providers, hardware suppliers, and

external IT support partners.

 Maintain records of IT incidents, service requests, resolution timelines, recurring issues, and

vendor follow-ups.

 Prepare periodic reports on IT assets, unresolved tickets, downtime, and support activities.

 Maintain documentation for system configurations, software licences, IT procedures, and

troubleshooting guidelines.

 Identify opportunities to improve IT processes, reduce recurring issues, and improve

employee productivity.

6. Employee Onboarding and Exit Support

 Prepare and configure systems, email accounts, and required software for new employees.

 Ensure IT equipment and approved system access are provided before the employee's

joining date, wherever applicable.

 Recover company IT assets and coordinate timely access revocation during employee exits.

 Maintain proper handover records and obtain necessary approvals for asset allocation and

recovery.

**Required Qualifications and Experience**

 Bachelor's degree or diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer

Applications, or a related field.

 1–3 years of experience in IT support, IT operations, desktop support, or system

administration.

 Good working knowledge of Windows operating systems, computer hardware, software

installation, and troubleshooting.

 Basic understanding of networking concepts, including TCP/IP, LAN, Wi-Fi, DNS, and DHCP.

 Familiarity with Microsoft Office applications, official email systems, and user account

administration.

 Knowledge of antivirus tools, system updates, data backup, and IT security best practices.

 Strong problem-solving, communication, coordination, and documentation skills.

**Preferred Skills**

 Experience supporting users across multiple office locations.

 Familiarity with IT ticketing systems, asset management tools, and remote support utilities.

 Basic knowledge of Microsoft 365 administration, Active Directory or Microsoft Entra ID, and

endpoint management tools.

 Experience coordinating with external IT vendors and managing service requests.

 Ability to prioritise issues based on urgency and business impact.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance will be assessed against the following parameters:

 Timely resolution of IT incidents and service requests.

 Reduction in recurring technical issues and business downtime.

 Accuracy and completeness of IT asset and software inventory records.

 Timely provisioning and deactivation of employee accounts and system access.

 Adherence to IT security policies and maintenance schedules.

 Timely completion of onboarding and exit-related IT requirements.

 Quality of documentation, vendor coordination, and employee support.

**Desired Candidate Attributes**

 A proactive, service-oriented approach to resolving technical issues.  Strong ownership and accountability for assigned tasks.

 Ability to communicate technical information clearly to non-technical employees.

 Good organisational skills and attention to detail.

 Ability to work independently while collaborating with internal teams and external vendors.

 Willingness to support business-critical IT requirements across locations, as needed.

Note: The candidate is expected to maintain confidentiality, follow company policies, and ensure the

reliable and secure functioning of the organisation's IT systems.

roles.
  
  

* Experience working with enterprise-scale products in customer-facing

environments.
  
  
B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or equivalent
  
  
technical discipline.
  
  
Technical Skills
  
  

* Strong product understanding and ability to validate complex system

workflows.

acceptable).

title: Lead Engineer - Infrastructure Systems
description:
****About The Role:****
**Grade Level (for internal use):**
11
  
  
****About The Team****
The Digital Experience Endpoint Management team sits within the Digital Solutions group and provides architecture and engineering services for S&P Global's global workforce across desktops, laptops, mobile devices, and productivity applications. We value technical excellence and collaborative problem-solving, with deep expertise in the Microsoft ecosystem and enterprise Windows management. Our mission is to raise workforce productivity through modern, secure, and automated device management.
  
  
****About The Role****
You will be a senior hands-on engineer and subject matter expert for Windows endpoint management, owning the design and delivery of Microsoft Intune-based solutions across the enterprise. You will act as the engineering escalation point for our outsource partner, drive key endpoint modernization initiatives, and help shape the future of workplace technology at S&P Global.
  
  
****Primary Responsibilities****

* Administer Microsoft Intune, Windows device management, and Group Policy across enterprise environments
* Design and implement Intune-based solutions for Windows workstations and mobile devices, ensuring performance, security compliance, and automated deployment
* Provide engineering expertise for complex Windows management requests and Microsoft endpoint management projects
* Re-package and deploy applications for Windows, macOS, and Linux using tools such as PSADT, AdminStudio, and PowerShell
* Design, deploy, and maintain App Control for Business (WDAC) policies.

****Secondary Responsibilities****

* Support macOS device management and cross-platform MDM solutions
* Collaborate with outsource partners on endpoint management initiatives and infrastructure projects
* Contribute to hardware standards, procurement processes, and enterprise workplace productivity technologies.

**Broader Impact**

* Provide engineering support to our outsource partner — reactively for complex issues and proactively for projects
* Ensure product engineering and lifecycle management processes are consistently followed
* Maintain and enforce enterprise standards, goals, and compliance requirements
* Act as SME on infrastructure projects and drive implementation of key enterprise initiatives
* Partner with business IT teams and stakeholders to identify problems and opportunities addressable through technology
* Influence future technology decisions and provide input on IT strategy, operations, and innovation.

****Basic Required Qualifications****

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field (preferred)
* 9+ years of experience in end-user computing with a focus on Windows environments
* Hands-on experience administering Microsoft Intune and managing Windows devices at enterprise scale
* Experience designing and deploying App Control for Business policies
* Proficiency with Group Policy, Configuration Manager (SCCM), and automated Windows deployment
* Deep experience with Windows hardware platforms including Dell, Lenovo, and Microsoft Surface
* Knowledge of Microsoft Endpoint Manager, Entra ID (Azure AD), and Microsoft 365 device management
* Familiarity with iOS and Android mobile device management through Intune
* Strong PowerShell scripting and Windows automation skills
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities for Windows-specific issues
* Excellent communication skills for working with end users and cross-functional teams
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment.

****Additional Preferred Qualifications****

* Experience with Windows Autopilot and modern device provisioning workflows
* Knowledge of Azure services such as Entra Connect, Conditional Access, and Identity Protection
* Familiarity with virtualization technologies such as Hyper-V, VMware, or Azure Virtual Desktop
* Experience with Windows security frameworks such as Microsoft Defender for Endpoint and compliance management tools
* Prior experience as an SME on Microsoft infrastructure projects
* Track record of driving enterprise Windows modernization and workplace productivity improvements
* Experience with Microsoft vendor relationships and enterprise licensing programs
* Demonstrated ability to influence technology decisions and provide strategic input on Windows-focused IT operations.

**Grade: 11 {9 to 14 years’ experience}**
**Job Location: Noida/Gurugram/Bengaluru/Hyderabad**
**Shift Time: 05:30 pm to 2:30 am IST {night shift}**
**Working Model: Hybrid, twice a week.**
**What’s In It For**

An all-in-one platform: business management, a custom branded app for every customer, staff tools, payments, communications, reporting and Scout AI. Pets make it approachable. The software is the craft.

Our platform powers the day-to-day operations of pet-care businesses across boarding, daycare, grooming, training, memberships, payments, customer engagement, reporting, and facility operations.

As RunLoyal continues to scale its platform, customer base, and engineering organization, we are looking for a Full Stack Engineer who wants more than a traditional development role.

This is an opportunity to work on a real SaaS product, solve meaningful customer and engineering problems, and take ownership of features from idea to production.

You will work closely with Product, Engineering, QA, and other teams to understand the problem behind a requirement, contribute to technical decisions, build scalable solutions, validate them thoroughly, and support what you ship.

If you enjoy working in a growing product company where engineers are expected to think, build, improve, and own, this role is for you.

* Become the customer's primary implementation contact after the Sales handoff.
* Lead structured discovery sessions with business owners and operational stakeholders.
* Understand customer workflows, services, pricing, memberships, packages, staffing, booking rules, payments, agreements, notifications, reporting, and operational requirements.
* Identify unclear, conflicting, or incomplete requirements before implementation begins.
* Translate business needs into the correct RunLoyal configuration.
* Recommend practical workflows and explain product limitations or alternatives when required.

**Product Configuration & Data Migration**

* Configure customer environments based on approved requirements.

* Work with customer data from Excel, Google Sheets, CSV files, and structured exports.

* Identify duplicate, incomplete, malformed, or inconsistent records.
* Validate imported customer, pet, membership, package, service, and other operational data.
* Complete post-import reconciliation and escalate discrepancies before go-live.

**Implementation QA, Training & Go-Live**

* Validate configured environments against approved customer requirements.
* Test realistic workflows covering booking, pricing, payments, memberships, staff access, services, and customer records.
* Identify configuration or data issues before they reach the customer.
* Conduct administrator and staff training.
* Explain workflows clearly to technical and non-technical users.
* Confirm readiness across configuration, data, users, payments, training, and operational processes.
* Drive customers through go-live and provide support during the initial launch period.
* Complete a structured handoff to Customer Success or Support after stabilization.

**Technical Troubleshooting**

You do not need to be a software engineer, but you should be comfortable investigating before escalating.

You will:

* Troubleshoot configuration and data issues independently.
* Use browser developer tools where helpful.
* Use SQL for data verification and investigation.
* Distinguish between configuration issues, data problems, integration behavior, product defects, and enhancement requests.
* Provide Engineering and QA with clear and reproducible issue details.

**Senior-Level Ownership**

* Handle multiple onboarding projects concurrently.
* Identify implementation risks early and create mitigation plans.
* Act as an escalation point for complex onboarding issues.
* Review configuration and migration work completed by junior team members.
* Coach team members on discovery, data quality, solution mapping, and customer communication.

title: Technical Product Specialist - Elektronica
description:
**Beschrijving**
Voor een internationale groep actief in het produceren en verdelen van die elektrische behuizingen, elektronische componenten en mechanische componenten verdeelt, ben ik op zoek naar een Technical Product Specialist. De klanten zijn onder meer productiebedrijven, machinebouwers, start-ups en engineeringbureaus uit verschillende sectoren.
  
  
Je focust op behuizingen: van standaardproducten tot aangepaste en volledig op maat ontwikkelde oplossingen. Je stelt technische offertes op en vertaalt bestellingen naar duidelijke documentatie voor productie en werkvoorbereiding. Je volgt aanvragen en bestellingen administratief nauwkeurig op en zorgt dat de nodige informatie en materialen beschikbaar zijn.
  
  
Je bent de schakel tussen klanten, buitendienstmedewerkers, productie, leveranciers en collega’s. Je bespreekt klantvragen, leest technische tekeningen en denkt mee over de toepassing van de behuizing, bijvoorbeeld voor klemmen of printplaten. Daarnaast voer je eindcontroles uit. In deze functie is er een belangrijke administratieve component en werk je dagelijks op locatie.
  
  
Af en toe ga je mee met een buitendienstmedewerker naar een klant, bijvoorbeeld wanneer een specifieke oplossing extra toelichting vraagt. De functie past bij iemand die graag administratief en klantgericht werkt, maar ook voldoende technische bagage heeft om klantvragen te begrijpen en met productie te overleggen.
  
  
**Profiel**

* Je combineert administratieve of salesgerichte ervaring met technische bagage.
* Je kunt technische tekeningen lezen en analyseren en hebt kennis van elektriciteit, zoals volt, ampère, klemmen en printplaten.
* Je bent nauwkeurig en gestructureerd in de opvolging van offertes, bestellingen en werkvoorbereidingsdocumentatie.
* Je bent vlot met ERP-systemen en IT-toepassingen.
* Je communiceert vlot in het Nederlands en Engels en hebt een goede kennis van het Frans.
* Je hebt bij voorkeur een bachelor denkniveau; een technische achtergrond in elektriciteit, elektronica of mechanica is een plus.
* Ervaring met Excel, SolidWorks, Fusion, MS Business Central of explosieveilige behuizingen is een plus. Je bent bereid dagelijks op kantoor te werken.

**Aanbod**

* Aantrekkelijk bruto salaris afhankelijk van ervaring (tot max 5.000 bruto)
* Een functie waarin je administratieve en salesgerichte vaardigheden combineert met technische kennis.
* Je werkt dagelijks samen met klanten, buitendienst, productie, leveranciers en collega’s.
* Voor klantbezoeken kun je een wagen gebruiken.
* Groeps-en hospitalisatieverzekering.
* Maaltijdcheques
* 26 vakantiedagen

title: Operations Manager
description:
**About PlayShifu:**

PlayShifu is one of the fastest-growing technology startups that creates AR-powered educational toys. “I wish I had them in my childhood” is the most common thought when one comes across our award-winning products. We have expanded our distribution worldwide to more than 35 countries and still counting. We are looking for an experienced Operations leader to build and run the supply chain that gets our products to kids across the globe, on time and at the right cost. If you are passionate about the consumer goods industry and have the growth mindset to take up a new challenge every day, read on!

**What you’ll do:**

* Own supply and demand planning for the company: build forecasts with Sales, Marketing and Product, and manage inventory levels across channels, geographies and the peak gifting season.
* Manage relationships with contract manufacturers, freight forwarders, customs brokers and 3PL warehouses. Hold them to TAT, SLA and on-time-in-full (OTIF) targets across geographies.
* Plan inbound and outbound logistics across ocean, air and parcel, balancing cost, speed and service levels.
* Manage fulfilment for retail and marketplace partners, including big-box retailers, distributors, and DTC e-commerce. This includes purchase order processing, routing guides, compliance and chargeback prevention.
* Work with Product, Quality, Finance and Sales to ensure product readiness, packaging, labelling and pickups for new launches.
* Ensure trade compliance: customs documentation, HS codes, duties and tariffs, and toy and electronics safety and certification requirements (e.g., CE, CPSIA, battery shipping regulations) in each market.
* Handle customer, partner and retailer escalations on operational issues, with clear root-cause analysis and corrective action.
* Drive cost optimisation across freight, warehousing and last-mile, and lead continuous improvement of processes, tools and dashboards.
* Lead, motivate and support a team in a time-sensitive, demanding environment, including career development plans and problem resolution for all direct reports.
* Run budget reviews and report cost plans, logistics spend and key operational metrics to senior management.
* Manage reverse logistics: returns, replacements, damages and warranty claims.

**What we are looking for:**

* 5-10 years of experience in operations, supply chain or logistics, ideally in consumer electronics, toys, D2C/e-commerce or a fast-growing consumer brand. Experience managing cross-border or multi-country operations is a strong plus.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work across time zones and with external partners.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Data-driven, well-versed in Excel/Google Sheets (pivots, lookups, modelling), with the ability to adapt to constant change in the toy and consumer electronics industry. Familiarity with ERP/WMS/TMS tools and BI dashboards is a plus.
* Good negotiation skills with vendors, freight partners and 3PLs.
* Good business acumen, with a proactive, ownership-driven approach to solving problems.
* Working knowledge of incoterms, customs processes and international shipping.

**What will you get:**

* Own and lead end-to-end operations and supply chain across 40+ countries, working directly with senior leadership to shape PlayShifu’s global fulfilment and scale-up strategy.
* Fast-track career progression.
* Be part of an ambitious, high-performing team building products loved by families across the world.
* Employee discounts on our products.
* Comprehensive health insurance for you and your dependents.
* Central office location, a fully stocked kitchen, endless snacks, team lunch, fun events, etc.
