Core Competencies
  
  
Leadership and Development
  
  

* Proven ability to motivate and develop high-performing teams
* Strong coaching and mentoring capabilities

* Change management and process improvement leadership

Customer and Operational Excellence
  
  

* Exceptional customer service standards and complaint resolution skills
* Process optimization and quality management experience
* Stakeholder management across multiple internal and external parties
* Crisis management and escalation handling expertise

Technical and Commercial Acumen
  
  

* Deep understanding of financial markets, trading products, and regulations
* Strong analytical skills with ability to interpret complex trading scenarios
* Commercial awareness and alignment with business objectives
* Risk management and decision-making authority

**What You’ll Need For This Role**

* 5+ years customer service experience with minimum 2 years team leadership
* Extensive client-facing experience managing complex, high-value customer relationships
* Experience managing remote or international team members
* Proven track record managing performance in target-driven environments
* Demonstrated success in complaint resolution and dispute management
* Strong understanding of consumer rights and financial regulations across multiple jurisdictions

Desirable
  
  

* Experience with complex financial products or similar regulated industries

We try to take a thoughtful approach to our ways of working as a company. We follow a hybrid working model with 3 days in the office – which we think balances the need to collaborate effectively and connect with each other. title: Middle Office Reconciliation Onboarding- Team Lead
description:
Who we are looking for
  
  
We are looking for an experienced and delivery-focused Team Lead to manage end-to-end client onboarding and conversion activities within the Middle Office Reconciliation Onboarding function. The role is accountable for translating business requirements into scalable reconciliation solutions, directing system and data readiness, overseeing testing and production deployment, managing delivery risks, and ensuring a controlled transition to business-as-usual operations.
  
  
The candidate will lead onboarding specialists and work closely with investment managers, custodians, fund administrators, business teams, technology partners, and reconciliation operations. Strong expertise in middle office reconciliation, data analysis, data mapping, TLM/TLP reconciliation platforms, project delivery, people leadership, and stakeholder management is required.
  
  
Why this role is important to us
  
  
The Middle Office Reconciliation Onboarding team supports the implementation of new investment managers and funds onto State Street’s reconciliation platforms. The Team Lead provides day-to-day delivery leadership and serves as the central coordination and escalation point across business, operations, technology, clients, and external data providers.
  
  
The role is critical to ensuring that cash, position, transaction, and market-value reconciliation requirements are accurately designed, configured, tested, deployed, and handed over to operations. It also promotes consistent delivery standards, effective risk management, team capability, process scalability, and a controlled, low-risk transition into live reconciliation services.
  
  
What you will be responsible for
  
  

* Lead assigned onboarding projects from requirement gathering through solution design, configuration, testing, production deployment, stabilization, and operational handover.
* Manage, coach, and develop onboarding specialists; allocate work, set priorities, monitor progress, and provide timely guidance.
* Establish project plans, roles, milestones, dependencies, controls, and success criteria for each implementation.
* Lead discussions with clients, custodians, fund administrators, operations, and technology teams to confirm reconciliation requirements, scope, assumptions, and delivery approach.
* Review and approve fund matrices, account structures, reconciliation types, data sources, frequencies, tolerances, matching criteria, workflows, and reporting requirements.
* Oversee analysis and validation of cash, position, transaction, and market-value data received through SWIFT messages, flat files, and custodian portals.
* Direct data analysis and mapping for non-SWIFT files and coordinate with ETL, technology, and deployment teams to establish scalable processing solutions.
* Oversee account, reconciliation shell, lead-account, match-rule, workflow, and static-data setup in BUAT and production environments.
* Plan and oversee functional testing, BUAT, DITL, conversion rehearsals, production parallel testing, and go-live readiness reviews.
* Act as the escalation point for complex reconciliation exceptions, configuration issues, delivery risks, client concerns, and cross-functional dependencies.
* Lead root-cause analysis and coordinate sustainable corrective and preventive actions with business, operations, and technology partners.
* Maintain oversight of project plans, open-item logs, Jira tickets, risk and dependency trackers, status reports, decisions, and implementation documentation.
* Provide concise reporting to management and stakeholders on delivery status, milestones, risks, controls, capacity, and critical decisions.
* Ensure procedures, reconciliation playbooks, configuration records, control evidence, and handover documentation are complete, current, and audit-ready.
* Oversee post-production stabilization and ensure outstanding issues, risks, and actions are tracked through closure.
* Maintain a robust operational-risk and control environment, including adherence to maker-checker controls, information-security standards, governance requirements, and escalation protocols.
* Monitor workload, quality, productivity, service levels, project capacity, and delivery performance; implement corrective action where required.
* Identify opportunities to standardize processes, strengthen controls, improve client experience, and reduce manual effort through automation and workflow improvements.
* Lead team training, cross-skilling, succession planning, knowledge management, and continuous capability development.
* Support system enhancements, strategic initiatives, operating-model improvements, audit activities, and management reporting as required.

What we value
  
  

* Strong understanding of middle office reconciliation, investment operations, and the investment-management lifecycle.
* Extensive hands-on experience with cash, position, transaction, and market-value reconciliation.
* Strong knowledge of TLM/TLP reconciliation platforms, including static setup, reconciliation configuration, matching rules, tolerances, exception workflows, and administrative functions.
* Experience in external custody data acquisition, SWIFT-message validation, file analysis, ETL data mapping, and production implementation.
* Demonstrated ability to lead end-to-end onboarding projects while managing multiple priorities, dependencies, and timelines.
* Proven people-leadership capability, including work allocation, coaching, performance support, knowledge development, and quality oversight.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to lead root-cause analysis and implement sustainable solutions.
* Effective stakeholder-management, influencing, negotiation, and escalation skills across global teams.
* Strong risk and control mindset, with experience maintaining audit-ready evidence and addressing operational or implementation risks.
* Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and executive-reporting skills.
* Ability to translate complex technical and operational matters into clear decisions, actions, and status updates.
* Strong attention to detail, sound judgment, accountability, and a consistent focus on delivery quality.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and working knowledge of project-tracking, workflow, data-visualization, and process-documentation tools.

**Education And Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Technology, or a related discipline.
* Approximately 7 or more years of relevant experience in middle office, reconciliation, investment operations, client onboarding, system implementation, or a related function.
* Prior experience leading a team, workstream, or complex implementation within a high-volume, global operating environment.
* Practical expertise using TLM/TLP or another recognized reconciliation platform.
* Experience managing relationships with custodians, investment managers, fund administrators, technology teams, and global operations stakeholders.
* Experience managing implementation risks, testing governance, production readiness, stabilization, and operational handover.

**Additional Skills**

* Experience with JIRA, SharePoint, Power BI, Power Query, Power Automate, or related workflow and reporting tools.
* Knowledge of Agile or Waterfall project methodologies.
* Demonstrated involvement in automation, system enhancements, process transformation, or operating-model improvement initiatives.
* Experience preparing management information, capacity views, performance metrics, and executive-level project updates.

**Shift Timings:**
EMEA/NA
  
  
**Location:**
Hyderabad/Bangalore
  
  
**About State Street**
**What we do.**
State Street is one of the world’s leading providers of financial services to institutional investors. From technology and product innovation to investment servicing, data and analytics, research, trading, and investment management, we help clients safeguard and steward investments around the world.
  
  
**Work, Live and Grow.**
We aim to create an environment where employees can perform at their best and continue to develop. Our benefits and development programmed vary by location and may include medical coverage, insurance, savings plans, flexible-work arrangements, learning opportunities, and educational support.
  
  
**Inclusion, Diversity and Social Responsibility.**
We value diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where employees can contribute and grow. We also support active engagement with communities through volunteering, charitable programmers, and employee networks.
  
  
****About State Street****
Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
  
  
We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. You will guide financial planning and governance, strengthen performance insights, and help build resilient, sustainable ways of working. * Leadership & Strategic Alignment: Run leadership forums that align strategy, risks, and priorities; embed quality assurance and cybersecurity considerations into decision-making to deliver measurable business value.
* Productivity & Resource Optimization: Track travel and productivity drivers; identify efficiency opportunities that redeploy resources to the highest-impact work.

**Essential Skills/Experience**

* 5–7 years of experience in IT portfolio operational management, with a proven track record of driving performance and operational excellence
* Proven experience in managing organizational change, developing central initiatives, and implementing improvement in execution programs
* Strong leadership and influencing capabilities, with the ability to advise and engage cross-functional teams to meet performance, reporting, and delivery objectives
* Familiarity with performance measurement tools, techniques, industry guidelines, and internal methodologies
* Advanced communication, analytical, critical thinking, and presentation skills, including proficiency in facilitation and information gathering

If you are ready to lead with clarity, elevate performance at scale, and turn operational excellence into real-world impact, send us your resume and take the next step today!

title: CTV Operations Manager
description:
**Who Are We?**
---------------

RZR is an AI-native advertising platform built for the next era of performance marketing. We operate at the intersection of machine learning, programmatic media, and full-funnel mobile growth, powering campaigns for some of the world's most ambitious advertisers. Our platform is purpose-built to deliver outcomes at scale, not just impressions.

We are a team of builders, operators, and technologists who believe the advertising industry is overdue for a fundamental rethink. We move fast, operate with a high degree of ownership, and hold ourselves to an exceptionally high standard of craft.

RZR is scaling aggressively with an active M&A pipeline and a platform vision that puts us on a path to becoming an industry leader. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at an inflection point and help shape what it becomes.

**Role Overview**
-----------------

As RZR's CTV Operations Manager, based in Bangalore, you will own the technical backbone of a business we are building from the ground up. CTV is one of our fastest-growing frontiers, and you will be the dedicated operator who makes it run: setting up, trafficking, and monitoring every Private Marketplace (PMP) and direct supply deal across platforms such as Beeswax, FreeWheel, Index Exchange, PubMatic, and Magnite.

You will work hand in hand with our CTV BD Lead. They source and negotiate partnerships; you own the technical execution behind every one of them, from integration and QA through to day-to-day performance monitoring. Along the way, you will help define how mobile performance advertising moves onto CTV, building process and frameworks rather than inheriting someone else's playbook.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone who knows programmatic supply operations, enjoys digging into data, and wants real ownership early in their career.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **PMP & Deal Management**

* Own the end-to-end technical setup, configuration, and QA of PMP deals with CTV supply partners
* Monitor PMP deal health daily, including fill rate, underdelivery, and pricing discrepancies, and drive resolution with supply partners

### **Supply Path Optimization**

* Optimize CTV supply paths across exchanges and SSPs to reduce redundant hops and improve win rate and margin
* Evaluate the technical and operational fit of new CTV supply partners, and lead their onboarding and integration

### **BD Partnership & Reporting**

* Serve as the technical and operational partner to the CTV BD Lead, owning trafficking, integration, and monitoring for every deal they source and negotiate
* Track and analyze CTV spend trends across partners, and proactively surface actionable insights before they become client-facing problems

**Required Skills and Experience**
----------------------------------

* Around 2 years of experience in programmatic ad tech, with hands-on exposure to CTV/OTT supply-side operations
* Direct experience setting up, managing, and troubleshooting onboarding of Publishers on CTV Ad Servers
* Experience managing and optimizing an extensive deal library of PMPs
* Working knowledge of Springserve, Publica, FreeWheel, Index Exchange, PubMatic, and/or Magnite
* Strong technical understanding of programmatic deal flows, including auction mechanics, supply path optimization, and header bidding
* Working SQL proficiency to analyze spend and performance data
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate operational data into insights a business development partner can act on

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with publisher-direct deals
* Experience in mobile advertising or working inside a DSP
* Familiarity with BI tools such as Looker or Tableau

**The RZR Code**
----------------

### **Our Values**

Our values define the company we want to be. They guide the decisions we make, the environment we create, and how we treat customers and each other.

* **Win with Customers:** We don't call it a win unless our clients win too. We earn long-term trust by putting their success at the center.
* **One Team:** No team wins when the company loses. We optimize for the company, not our function.

description:
**Job Description – Operations Manager (Government Liaisoning)**

**Department:** Operations  
**Experience:** 4–8 Years  
**Industry:** Real Estate / PropTech / Property Consultancy  
**Location:** Bangalore  
**Employment Type:** Full-time

**Job Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Operations Manager – Government Liaisoning to manage government coordination, property documentation, land-related approvals and operational activities. The candidate should have strong knowledge of Karnataka government departments, revenue procedures, land records and property registration processes.

The ideal candidate should be capable of independently handling government applications, coordinating with relevant authorities, managing field operations and ensuring timely completion of property-related documentation and approvals.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Government Liaisoning & Coordination**

* Coordinate with government departments such as Revenue Department, Taluk Office, BBMP, BDA, BMRDA, Sub-Registrar Office and Survey Department.
* Liaise with Tahsildars, Revenue Inspectors, Village Accountants and other government officials.
* Handle government office visits, application submissions and follow-ups.
* Maintain professional relationships with relevant government authorities.

**2. Land & Property Documentation**

* Handle and verify property-related documents such as RTC, Mutation, EC, Sale Deed, Gift Deed, Partition Deed, POA, Khata and Conversion Orders.
* Understand 11E sketches, Akarband, Tippani, Survey Sketch and other land records.
* Coordinate property document verification and identify discrepancies.
* Handle documentation related to rectification, cancellation and lease deeds.

**3. Government Approvals & Application Processing**

* Manage applications related to DC Conversion, land mutation, Khata transfer, land survey and property registration.
* Coordinate layout approvals, building plan approvals and other property-related permissions.
* Track application status and ensure timely submission and completion.
* Resolve application objections, documentation issues and procedural delays.

**4. Operations & Team Management**

* Manage daily operations and allocate responsibilities to team members.
* Supervise field executives and liaisoning coordinators.
* Monitor application progress and ensure timely completion within defined TAT.
* Coordinate with internal departments such as Sales, Legal, Technical and Customer Support.
* Handle escalations and improve operational efficiency.

**5. MIS & Reporting**

* Prepare and maintain application tracking reports, pending case reports and follow-up trackers.
* Monitor application turnaround time and team performance.
* Maintain records of government applications, approvals and customer documentation.
* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly operational reports for management.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 4–8 years of experience in Government Liaisoning, Real Estate Operations or Property Documentation.
* Strong knowledge of Karnataka government departments and land-related procedures.
* Practical experience coordinating with Revenue, Survey, Registration and Municipal departments.
* Good understanding of property documents and land records.
* Experience handling government applications and approval processes independently.
* Strong communication, coordination and negotiation skills.
* Ability to manage teams, field operations and multiple applications simultaneously.
* Good knowledge of MS Excel, MIS reporting and documentation management.

**Preferred Industry Experience**

* Real Estate Developers / Builders
* PropTech Companies
* Property Consultancy Firms
* Land Documentation and Legal Services
* Real Estate Advisory Companies

**Additional Advantage**

* Knowledge of Karnataka Land Revenue Act and Registration Act.
* Familiarity with Bhoomi, Kaveri and other Karnataka government portals.
* Law or Civil Engineering educational background.
* Experience handling land conversion, survey and mutation processes.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Timely completion of government applications and approvals.
* Reduction in pending applications and processing delays.
* Accuracy of property documentation.
* Effective coordination with government departments.
* Team productivity and operational efficiency.
* Timely MIS reporting and case-status updates.

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹80,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Lead Systems Operations Engineer
description:
**About this role:**

Wells Fargo is seeking a Senior Lead Systems Operations Engineer.

* Translate advanced technology experience, in-depth knowledge of the organizations tactical and strategic business objectives, the enterprise technological environment, the organization structure, and strategic technological opportunities and requirements into technical engineering solutions

* Strategically engage with all levels of professionals and managers across the enterprise and serve as an expert advisor to leadership

**Required Qualifications:**

* 7+ years of Systems Engineering, Technology Architecture experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

**Desired Qualifications:**

* Define and drive **enterprise observability standards**, including metrics, logs, traces, alerting, and service health dashboards.

* Partner with application, infrastructure, cloud, and support teams to improve **availability, performance, capacity, and resiliency**.
* Lead or contribute to **blameless post-mortems**, ensuring measurable and sustained reduction of repeat incidents.
* Translate complex technical and operational risks into **clear, data-driven guidance** for senior leadership.
* Mentor engineers and support staff on **reliability engineering, observability, and automation best practices**.

* Strong collaboration and partnering skills across platform, application, and support teams.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, high-impact production environment.
* Consistent delivery of high-quality reliability outcomes within expected timelines.
* High attention to detail, data-driven problem-solving, and operational rigor.
* Prior project or initiative leadership experience is highly desirable.

9 Nov 2026

title: Accounting Operations, Manager
description:
**Ready to be a Titan?**

ServiceTitan is looking for an Accounting Manager with strong leadership, communication, and critical thinking skills to join the GL team. This is a foundational role — the first in-house accounting hire in India — responsible for owning the full accounting operations for the India entity, managing the relationship with our outsourced accounting firm, and ensuring accurate and timely financial reporting. This position will work closely with the Senior Accounting Manager on key processes, policies, and building out the India accounting function. As the India team grows, this role will lead and expand the local accounting team.

**What you'll do**

* Own and manage the India entity accounting function, including operation of the general ledger system, journal entries, and month-end close activities while meeting global close deadlines.
* Reconcile, analyze, and resolve questions regarding assigned general ledger accounts timely and accurately, including multi-currency and complex bank accounts.
* Analyze monthly and quarterly financial results, providing flux explanations for significant variances to management.
* Oversee preparation of supporting schedules and footnotes for local financial statements in compliance with applicable accounting standards and regulatory requirements.
* Manage the fixed asset register, including capitalization, depreciation runs, asset disposals, and periodic physical verification; ensure proper classification and accounting treatment in line with company policy.
* Manage India statutory compliance including GST, TDS, Professional Tax, and other filings in coordination with the outsourced accounting firm and corporate tax team.
* Analyze differences between local statutory books and GAAP books (Indian Accounting Standards/US GAAP), including preparation of schedules supporting reconciling items.
* Monitor changes in Indian tax legislation applicable to the tech industry and assess potential impacts.
* Serve as the primary liaison between the corporate accounting team and the outsourced accounting firm, managing deliverables, deadlines, and information flow.
* Review and approve vendor invoices with correct GST treatment, TDS deductions, and GL coding; prepare India payroll accounting entries and statutory deductions.
* Act as the first point of contact for India-based employees on accounting-related queries, including expense reimbursements, payroll questions, and general accounting matters.
* Lead the local statutory audit process, including preparation of audit schedules, managing auditor queries, and coordinating with the outsourced firm and external auditors.
* Develop, maintain, and document accounting policies and procedures for the India entity; identify and drive process improvement and automation opportunities.
* Partner with the internal systems team on initiatives to enhance accounting accuracy and automation of accounting processes.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as Tax, FP&A, HR, and Legal.
* Support management in completing special projects and other tasks as assigned; contribute to building the India accounting team as the entity scales.

**What you'll bring**

* 7+ years of accounting experience with strong knowledge of Indian statutory and tax compliance (GST, TDS, Professional Tax, PF/ESI).
* Proven track record in operational accounting, including managing outsourced accounting providers; prior experience working with a US-based multinational and across distributed teams in multiple time zones.
* Solid understanding of Indian Accounting Standards and/or US GAAP accounting; experience reconciling local statutory books to GAAP books.
* Professional qualification preferred; CA (ICAI), ACCA or CPA.
* Experience in Workday Financials preferred; proficiency in Tally and Paybooks is a strong plus.
* Advanced user of Google Workspace and Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
* Comfort using AI tools (e.g. Claude, Copilot, or similar) to accelerate research, draft documentation, and support day-to-day accounting workflows.
* Ability to build or contribute to process automations and workflows — experience with tools such as Claude, Google Apps Script, or similar is a plus.
* Ability to identify and analyze problems and provide solutions independently and as a team player in a fast-paced environment.
* Excellent attention to detail, follow-up skills, strong work ethic, and accountability.
* Excellent communication skills and ability to work cooperatively and collaboratively with all levels of employees, management, and external agencies.

‌

**Be Human With Us:**

Being human isn’t about checking every box on a list. It’s about the experiences we have, people we meet, and the perspectives we share. So, if you have the skills but are hesitant to apply because of your background, apply anyway. We need amazing people like you to help us challenge the conventional and think differently about the problems that we’re solving. We’re in this together. Come be human, with us.
  
  
**Use of AI Technology:**

We use technology, including automated and AI-assisted tools, to support certain aspects of our recruitment process. These tools are designed to improve efficiency and enhance the candidate experience. AI tools are not used to make hiring decisions; all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams.

At ServiceTitan, we celebrate individuality and uniqueness. We believe that the convergence of fresh perspectives and experiences from all walks of life is what makes our product and culture so great. We do not discriminate against employees based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity or expression, age, disability, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws.

description:
**1. Cluster Operations Management**

* Ensure appropriate protocols for student and employee emergencies.
* Monitor security guards, transport staff, housekeeping teams, and other outsourced personnel.

* Monitor vehicle fitness, permits, insurance, GPS, route plans, and documentation.
* Review transport vendor performance and student/parent feedback.

title: Facility Manager (Technical)
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
Facility Manager Technical
  
  
Integrated Facilities Management — Corporate Solutions (Country, Region)
  
  
**What this job involves:**  
Prioritizing the facilities’ needs—always
  
  
A seasoned expert in the field, the Chief Engineer is on top of all the mechanical, electrical, plumbing and civil works needed in a facility. Likewise, you’ll play an essential function in reducing workplace-related risks by working on maintenance contracts, routine inspections and scheduled down times.
  
  
You will be in close contact with local authorities for all facility-related issues. Also part of your scope is to ensure that the facility is in total compliance with all legal and engineering standards. Likewise, you’ll spearhead the implementation of energy programs to cut utility cost.
  
  
You’ll assume the role of a senior facilities manager when needed—overseeing small renovation projects from initial phases to completion. You’ll also keep an eye out on the facilities’ engineering systems by periodically inspecting logbooks, checklists and maintenance schedules.
  
  
Establish Engineering & Operational procedures and roll out the same for site staffs.
  
  
Establish contacts with local authorities on the facility related issues and maintain the relationship. Responsible for all legal & authorities related compliances pertaining to facility & engineering systems.
  
  
Plan and manage the budgets for Engineering & Operational contracts.
  
  
Carry out Technical Audits for all installations at periodical intervals.
  
  
Review the maintenance/service practices of M&E Contractors to deliver quality work practices in line with the manufacturer recommendations.
  
  
Plan & take responsibility for smooth operations of all Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing installations and Civil works pertaining to the facility.
  
  
Responsible for planning a critical spares list for all installations as per manufacturer’s recommendations and inventory.
  
  
Responsible for development of all maintenance related schedules and shutdowns in consultation with Clients / OEMs.
  
  
Periodically inspect the logbooks, checklists and PPM schedules for a better management of Engineering systems.
  
  
Work towards the ‘ZERO’ down time and set up the practices to ensure the delivery of seamless service to Clients.
  
  
Responsible for ensuring landlord’s compliance on availability of all statutory obligations such as CEIG, Fire, Lift, Explosives and stability certificate.
  
  
Responsible for setting up the maintenance contracts to ensure the risk mitigation to the Client operations.
  
  
Assume the responsibilities of SFM, as and when required.
  
  
Implement the Energy management programs to reduce the cost on utilities.
  
  
Handle small renovation projects from initiation to completion. Little knowledge in Projects management is essential.
  
  
Reporting.
  
  
Responsible for weekly & monthly reports on M & E, covering the maintenance contracts, spare parts consumption, Incident reports, Improvement projects etc.
  
  
Energy management, saving opportunities, risk management & engineering systems audits.
  
  
Putting critical plans and reports in place
  
  
Planning is a big part of your mandate. In this role, you’ll take charge of planning and managing both engineering and operational budgets and contracts. Your expertise will also be essential in planning and developing a list of spare materials for all installations based on recommendations and inventories.
  
  
Performing various audits—including technical, cost savings, risk management and energy management--is part of your job as well. In addition, you’ll strive to keep down time at bay by setting up best practices that promote seamless service delivery to our clients.
  
  
Your analytical skills will also come in handy, as the role requires you to file both weekly and monthly reports on maintenance contracts, incident reports and improvement projects.
  
  
**Sound like you? To apply you need to have:**  
Years of industry experience
  
  
What we’re looking for is an electrical/mechanical/civil engineer with at least 12 years’ experience in the field. A post-graduate degree in engineering or business is also a big plus. Likewise, the ideal candidate will have more than five years’ experience in managing a contract of works. Furthermore, a strong knowledge of occupational safety requirements and improvement initiatives may help you land the job.
  
  
Undeniably superior soft skills
  
  
As the Chief Engineer, you’ll demonstrate your expertise in interacting with a wide range of clients and staff—that’s why impeccable people skills will be a handy talent. title: Facility Manager
company: Spacez Hospitality Foods and Pvt Ltd
description:
The Facility Manager will be responsible for designing, structuring, and streamlining operations across all Spacez properties. This role focuses on building strong operational systems, ensuring consistency in execution, and driving efficiency across maintenance, housekeeping, vendor management, and overall facility operations. The ideal candidate will take complete ownership of SOPs, planning, and timelines, ensuring all properties operate with high standards and clear processes.

What will you be doing at Spacez

* SOP & Process Development: Design and implement Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for all facility and property operations. Build structured processes to streamline day-to-day operations across properties. Continuously improve systems for efficiency, consistency, and scalability.
* Annual Planning & Scheduling: Create and manage yearly operational and maintenance calendars. Define clear timelines for all activities across properties. Plan and schedule: Preventive maintenance Annual deep cleaning cycles Weekly and periodic cleaning (carpets, curtains, chimney, etc.) Ensure timely execution through structured tracking systems.
* Vendor Management & Cost Control Identify, onboard, and manage vendors for maintenance and services. Standardize vendor pricing and cost structures. Track vendor performance and ensure accountability. Coordinate vendor payments with finance teams.
* Inventory & Asset Management Design systems for stock and inventory tracking across properties. Plan procurement cycles and ensure availability of required materials. Track maintenance and servicing of assets including AC units and equipment.
* Operations Structuring Build and streamline workflows between operations teams, caretakers, and vendors. Identify operational gaps and implement scalable solutions. Standardize processes to ensure smooth execution across all properties.
* Quality Control & Standards Develop checklists and frameworks for property readiness and quality standards. Ensure consistency in cleaning standards, property presentation, and branding elements (posters, visuals, etc.).
* Reporting & Tracking Develop structured reporting formats and dashboards. Track execution of schedules, maintenance, and compliance. Share regular insights and improvement plans with management.
* Team Enablement Support development of training frameworks for caretakers and operations teams. Create guidelines to improve performance consistency across properties.

What are your job requirements at Spacez

* Bachelor’s degree in Facilities Management, Hospitality, Engineering, or related field.
* Minimum 3 years of experience in facility management, operations, or process-driven roles.
* Strong ability to build and implement systems, SOPs, and workflows.
* Excellent planning, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Strong attention to detail and execution focus.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, reporting tools, and tracking systems.

Good to have

* Experience in hospitality, villa management, or multi-property operations.
* Prior experience in operations strategy or process-building roles.
* Exposure to vendor management and cost optimization.
* Understanding of maintenance planning and facility operations.
* Startup mindset with strong ownership and accountability.

title: HR Operations Coordinator and Office Manager
description:
**HR Operations Coordinator and Office Manager**

**MishiPay**

**Bangalore**

**Fixed CTC plus 20% variable bonus**

**About Us**

MishiPay is an international leader in next-generation checkout technology, helping retailers bring the convenience of e-commerce into physical stores. Our platform enables seamless in-store checkout through mobile self-checkout, kiosks, mPOS, RFID, and click-and-collect solutions.

We work with leading global retailers across multiple markets and continue to scale internationally. As a growing business, we are looking for a positive, empathic, proactive and highly organised HR Operations Coordinator / Office Manager to support our people operations and wider employee experience initiatives.

  

**Who Are We Looking For?**

**This role will suit a highly energetic, positive and upbeat individual, who has at least 3-4 years of HR Ops and Office Management experience within a busy, fast-paced growth environment, ideally startup or scaleup. You must be comfortable doing both HR Ops and Office Management, and willing to work the odd weekend or additional hours when necessary. You'll enjoy building relationships with the rest of the team both in Bangalore and internationally.**

**We're looking for someone who can progress, who wants to grow their career within HR Ops. It's essential you have exceptional English skills and at least 2 years of significant experience in KEKA HRIS. You will have used it to administer everything from employee absences, onboarding, offboarding to managing reports etc.** **It's absolutely essential that you're used to working at pace within a smaller/startup organization, ideally in tech.**

**We'd love to speak to you if you've also embraced AI to automate and streamline HR processes and procedures.**

**The Role**

This is a broad and hands-on role supporting HR operations and employee coordination across the business. You will work closely with leadership, the rest of the HR team and employees across multiple departments, helping to ensure smooth day-to-day HR administration while contributing to a positive employee experience. You will also support our busy office in Bangalore, organising office refurbishments, supplies, catering, and company events.

  

You will have previous relevant HR Operations and Office Management experience and you **MUST have prior experience in using and administering KEKA HRIS.** It's absolutely essential that you're used to working at pace within a smaller/startup organization, ideally in tech.

The role would suit someone who enjoys variety, takes ownership, is highly organised, and is comfortable balancing administrative responsibilities with people-facing coordination.

**Key Responsibilities**

**HR Operations**

* Support onboarding and offboarding processes for employees globally
* Prepare employment documents, HR letters, and maintain employee records on KEKA and within GSuite and Sprinto
* Manage and maintain accurate employee data within Keka HR
* Coordinate probation reviews, holiday tracking, attendance, and HR documentation through Keka
* Solve issues relating to Keka HR quickly and efficiently
* Assist with benefits administration and employee queries
* Assist with payroll coordination
* Support compliance processes and maintain confidential HR records
* Coordinate internal HR communications and company-wide updates
* Assist with employee engagement initiatives and wider people projects
* Deal with low-level ER issues, and escalate where necessary

**Office & Employee Coordination**

* Support the day-to-day coordination of the Bangalore and Pune office environments
* Coordinate office supplies, equipment, and vendor relationships for the India offices
* Manage office stock, kitchen supplies, snacks, and refreshments in India
* Coordinate with the office cook/catering arrangements for the Bangalore office
* Organise team events, socials, celebrations, and employee engagement activities for the Bangalore and Pune teams
* Support operational coordination relating to the Bangalore office where required
* Act as a key point of contact for Bangalore office-related queries and employee support

**Requirements**

As well as the experience listed above, you will also have:

* Previous experience within HR administration, HR operations & office coordination in a small or startup environment
* Previous hands-on experience using Keka HR is essential, at least 2 years
* Some experience in dealing with ER issues
* Strong organisational and administrative skills
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. You'll be a super-positive and upbeat person capable of building relationships across all regions and levels.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
* High attention to detail and discretion with confidential information
* Comfortable working independently and taking ownership of tasks
* Strong Microsoft Office / Google Workspace skills
* Previous startup or scale-up experience beneficial
* Strong experience in using various types of AI to automate processes
* A combination of commercial understanding and a people approach that will add value to a growing tech business
* Some understanding of India Employment Laws, specifically Karnataka

**What Will Make You Successful in This Role**

* Proactive and solutions-oriented mindset
* Comfortable operating in a fast-moving and evolving environment
* Strong people skills and a positive, approachable attitude
* Collaborative, calm under pressure and an empathic approach where needed
* Ability to balance structure and flexibility
* Strong follow-through and attention to detail
* Enjoys supporting both operational and employee experience initiatives

**Why Join Us**

* Opportunity to work closely with leadership within a growing international tech company
* Broad exposure across HR operations and employee coordination
* A collaborative and fast-paced environment with genuine ownership
* Opportunity to help shape employee experience as the company grows
* Competitive compensation and benefits

**We also offer:**

* Bonuses
* Unlimited holidays
* Hybrid Working (36 days WFH a year)
* Monthly Employee Awards
* A small monthly training budget
* Company events
* Free lunch in Bangalore
* MacBook
* Career progression and a chance to work with some of the brightest minds in tech

**Note**

We follow a direct hiring model and are not engaging with recruitment agencies for this role.

title: Operations Manager
description:
OPERATIONS MANAGER

Fabrimech Engineers Pvt. Ltd. | Ambattur, Chennai

ABOUT FABRIMECH

Fabrimech Engineers Pvt. Ltd. is an established engineering and manufacturing company based in Chennai, with a legacy dating back to 1966. We specialize in precision fabrication, sheet metal manufacturing and pressure equipment, serving customers across railway, industrial and international markets.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for an experienced and hands-on Operations Manager to lead manufacturing operations across our two factories in Ambattur, Chennai. The role involves managing approximately 150 people across both units, overseeing production, PPC, quality, on-time delivery and maintenance, while driving higher productivity, better capacity utilization and operational excellence. Reporting directly to the Managing Director, the Operations Manager will be responsible for strengthening operational systems, implementing data-driven performance management and building a strong second line of leadership.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Manufacturing & Operations

• Lead day-to-day operations across both manufacturing units.

• Oversee production, PPC, quality, on-time delivery and maintenance.

• Improve production output, capacity utilization and resource efficiency.

• Identify operational bottlenecks and implement corrective actions.

• Ensure production targets and customer delivery commitments are achieved.

Production Planning & Control

• Strengthen production planning, scheduling and execution.

• Monitor work orders, production progress and pending activities.

• Improve coordination between departments to ensure smooth operations.

• Drive improvements in on-time delivery and manufacturing efficiency.

Systems & Digitalization

• Drive the implementation of Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES).

• Establish live operational data tracking and daily MIS reporting.

• Strengthen ERP discipline and ensure timely and accurate data entry.

• Develop operational dashboards and performance monitoring systems.

Performance Management & Leadership

• Establish and monitor KRAs and KPIs across departments.

• Build accountability and performance discipline within the organization.

• Develop department heads and supervisors.

• Build a strong second line of leadership.

• Report operational performance, challenges and improvement initiatives directly to the Managing Director.

Continuous Improvement

• Implement Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma practices.

• Reduce rejection, rework, scrap and production lead times.

• Improve machine utilization and reduce downtime.

• Standardize processes and drive continuous improvement across both factories.

CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS

Essential Qualifications & Experience

• B.E. in Mechanical Engineering.

• Minimum 10 years of experience in manufacturing operations, including experience running a manufacturing plant.

• Experience in fabrication, pressure vessels, sheet metal, welding or export-oriented manufacturing.

• Strong understanding of production planning, quality, maintenance and factory operations.

• Experience in managing teams and driving operational performance.

• Hands-on, data-driven and execution-oriented approach.

• Strong leadership, coordination and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Skills & Knowledge

• Experience with Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma.

• Knowledge of ISO 9001 and EN 15085.

• Familiarity with ERP systems and Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES).

• Experience in railway, pressure vessel or heavy fabrication industries.

• Experience managing multiple manufacturing units.

LANGUAGE REQUIREMENTS

• Good communication skills in English, Tamil and Hindi.

WHAT WE OFFER

• An opportunity to lead operations across two manufacturing facilities.

• Direct interaction and reporting to the Managing Director.

• The opportunity to build systems and shape the future of a well-established manufacturing organization.

• Attractive compensation for the right candidate.

JOB DETAILS

Position: Operations Manager

Location: Ambattur Industrial Estate, Chennai

Experience: 10+ years

Qualification: B.E. Mechanical Engineering

Employment Type: Full-time

Work Arrangement: On-site

Reporting To: Managing Director

Joining Preference: Within 30 days

HOW TO APPLY

Interested candidates can apply through LinkedIn or share their updated CV at fme@fabrimech.com.

* We are looking for a leader who can take ownership, build strong operational systems and deliver higher manufacturing performance consistently.

title: Project Construction and Commissioning Manager
description:
**The opportunity**
The Project Construction & Commissioning Manager (PCCM) provides role-level leadership, coordination and control for the Construction & Commissioning scope across the project lifecycle. The PCCM supports tender handover, analyses the as-sold project basis, develops and maintains the Project Construction and Commissioning Management Plan, coordinates mobilization and resource planning, monitors schedule, cost, quality and HSE performance, represents Construction & Commissioning in relevant project forums, supports site take-over and demobilization activities, and ensures lessons learned are captured and shared for current and future projects. The role requires strong communicational skills, stakeholder management and interface leadership to align project management, engineering, procurement, site execution, installation, commissioning, customer representatives, subcontractors, the consortium partner and other external stakeholders. The PCCM is expected to build trust, maintain transparent communication, support timely decision-making and actively manage cross-functional interfaces to keep safety, quality, schedule and budget objectives aligned throughout the project lifecycle.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* The scope of the PCCM is to manage and coordinate Construction and Commissioning processes and activities related to project scope.
* The PCCM is office based supporting the accomplishment of the site execution and the management of the site which is performed by the site manager. The role require frequent travel to the sites, partners- and other Hitachi Energy- offices.
* Main Responsibility of the PCCM:
* Health, Safety and Environment (HSE) Management: Drives and leads HSE by example, promotes HSE as our license to operate.
* Quality Management: Drives and leads Quality by example.
* Communication / Interface / Stakeholder Management: Leads and manages key Construction & Commissioning project interfaces to ensure alignment, effective communication and successful project execution throughout the project lifecycle. Establishes and maintains effective working relationships with the Project Director, Project Engineering Manager, Lead Engineers, Project HSE Manager, Quality Manager, Supply Chain and other core project stakeholders.
* Leadership and Cultural Awareness: Demonstrates strong cultural awareness and adaptability leading projects executed in a global and multicultural environment.
* Subcontractor Management: Contributes to the development of the subcontracting strategy for the Construction & Commissioning scope based on tender assumptions, current project conditions, local market considerations and project delivery requirements.
* Documentation Management: Identifies Construction & Commissioning documents to be developed and delivered by the PCCM, including standard and project-specific deliverables. Develops the Project Construction and Commissioning Management Plan using the applicable template and based on tender handover, as-sold analysis, execution strategy, manning, subcontracting strategy and site infrastructure considerations. Coordinates the Construction and Commissioning Management plan with the relevant stakeholders. Revises the Plan when required through all project stages.
* Manpower Planning: Develops the initial mobilization plan based on tender assumptions, current project conditions, business priorities, staffing needs, budget and discipline input. Performs continuous resource planning for the Construction & Commissioning scope in coordination with relevant line managers and in line with the Project Construction and Commissioning Management Plan.
* Schedule Management: Leads the development of Construction & Commissioning schedule content and ensures relevant activities are included in project planning with feasible sequences, relationships and durations. Coordinates with project planning, site planning and relevant Construction & Commissioning disciplines to develop and maintain the project baseline for the PCCM scope.
* Cost Management: Takes responsibility for monitoring and reporting the Construction & Commissioning budget, forecast cost to complete and cost development within the PCCM scope.
* Constructability: Leads and drives the constructability process by ensuring Construction & Commissioning requirements are considered early in design, planning, procurement, logistics, safety, schedule and site execution preparation.
* Project Review: Leads preparation and coordination of the monthly Construction & Commissioning project review using the applicable digital project review, including Power BI based reporting where available.
* Coaching and Mentoring Tasks: Supports knowledge sharing, training and mentoring of fellow PCCMs and other Construction & Commissioning resources.
* Living Hitachi Energy’s core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.

**Your background**

* Bachelor's Degree in electrical- or mechanical- engineering with at least 10 Years relevant work experience.
* Candidate must already have a work authorization that would permit to work for Hitachi Energy
* Ability to work under pressure and on own initiative; Ability to prioritize and work against deadlines.
* Project financial authorities according to Delegation of Authority; Calling-up and delegating staff via line organization responsible Manager
* Material procurement on site, Adjustment of the infrastructure, Conditions for delegation of personnel, Off-shore cost forecasting.
* Initiate or hold back payments to suppliers based on their fulfilment or non-fulfilment of the terms of the contract together with Subcontracting Site Manager
* Award contracts and orders for the project in accordance with directives of the line organization & within the delegation of authority of the company.
* Influence the selection of people assigned by Line Management.
* Challenge the SIM regarding evolution of Site Activities including but not limited to Budget aspects
* Proficiency in both spoken & written English language is required.

title: Front Desk Manager
description:
**Company Description**
BRUNE Dermatology & Aesthetics is a patient-focused dermatology and aesthetic clinic committed to delivering high-quality skin care and cosmetic treatments. The clinic combines medical expertise with advanced technology to offer personalized treatment plans and a comfortable experience. Team members work closely with dermatology and aesthetic professionals to ensure that each patient receives attentive, organized, and efficient care. BRUNE values professionalism, clear communication, and a welcoming environment for all patients and visitors.

**Role Description**
The Front Desk Manager is a full-time, on-site role based at our clinic in Chennai. This role oversees the daily operations of the reception area, ensuring a smooth and professional experience for patients from arrival to departure. Key responsibilities include greeting and checking in patients, managing appointments and reservations, handling phone and in-person inquiries, and coordinating patient flow with clinical staff. The Front Desk Manager maintains accurate records, supports billing and payment processes, and ensures that front desk procedures are followed consistently. This role also involves training and guiding front desk team members, addressing patient concerns, and upholding clinic standards for customer service and confidentiality.

**Qualifications**

* Strong customer service orientation with a focus on Customer Satisfaction and professional handling of inquiries and concerns.
* Experience with Receptionist Duties, including greeting visitors, managing check-in/check-out, and maintaining a welcoming front desk environment.
* Excellent Communication skills, both verbal and written, to interact effectively with patients, visitors, and internal teams.
* Ability to manage Reservations and scheduling, including appointment coordination, calendar management, and follow-up confirmations.
* Prior experience in a clinic, hospital, spa, or hospitality front desk role is preferred.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills, with attention to detail and accuracy in records and documentation.

description:

**SLA, Reporting and Governance**

* Track response and resolution SLAs across all infra towers.
* Publish weekly and monthly SLA, KPI and backlog reports.
* Present service performance at monthly and quarterly governance reviews.
* Review monthly capacity, utilisation and performance reports for servers and databases.
* Maintain the RAID log for infrastructure services.
* Enforce ServiceNow ticket hygiene, CMDB accuracy and closure quality.

Incident, Escalation and MIM
  
  

* Attend MIM bridge calls for P1/P2 infrastructure and data platform incidents.
* Own client and internal escalations through to closure.
* Drive RCA, problem management and defect elimination plans.
* Coordinate with SecOps towers, OEM and hardware vendors, telecom carriers and client L3 teams.
* Drive repeat-incident reduction and alert tuning with the Command Center.

Change, Patching and Availability
  
  

* Govern change requests and maintenance windows across all infra towers.
* Track monthly OS, VMware, database and zero-day patch compliance.
* Oversee backup success, restore tests and DR / BCP drills.
* Oversee server, database and network builds and decommissions.
* Track platform software licences and expiry dates.

**Commercials and Contract**

* Own monthly invoicing inputs and reconciliation for infrastructure services.
* Track deliverables against SOW scope and contractual obligations.
* Raise and manage change requests for scope changes.

**Resourcing and People**

* Plan capacity, shift rosters and 24x7 on-call coverage.
* Hire, onboard and retain engineers; manage backfills and leave cover.
* Maintain the skill matrix and cross-skilling plan across pods.
* Run performance reviews, coaching and career plans for the team.

Compliance and Continual Improvement
  
  

* Ensure adherence to client infrastructure standards and security policies.
* Track OS hardening, system agent and audit-log compliance.
* Support internal and external audits with evidence.
* Drive automation of routine tasks, patching and deployments.
* Keep SOPs, runbooks and knowledge-base articles current.

* Windows Server and Linux / Unix
* Cisco routers, switches and WLAN controllers
* Firewalls & load balancers

* Databases (Oracle, MS SQL, Cloud databases)
* Datadog
* PagerDuty
* ServiceNow (ITSM, CMDB, reporting and dashboards)

**Processes and Frameworks**

* ITIL service management: incident, problem, change, request
* Disaster recovery and business continuity
* Automation and scripting: PowerShell, Bash, Python (good to have)

**Experience**

* 12+ years in IT infrastructure operations
* 5+ years as delivery lead in a managed services setup
* Led 24x7 multi-tower infrastructure operations for a global enterprise
* Managed onshore and offshore teams of 20+ engineers
* Exposure to AWS, Azure, Windows, Linux, , Oracle, SQL Server and Datadog

title: Technology Manager
description:
**About Revolut**
People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day.
  
  
As we continue our lightning-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.
  
  
**About The Role**
Our Technology team builds the systems and experiences that keep Revolut moving. From the infrastructure behind our innovative app to the features used by millions of people around the world, they bring sharp thinking, speed, and a focus on meaningful impact to everything they do.
  
  
We're looking for a Technology Manager to make sure our IT changes and tech ecosystem are safe and well-managed. You'll be working closely with our Operations and Product teams to keep projects on track.
  
  
Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Assessing initiatives that require IT changes
* Identifying dependencies, impact, and risks, and making sure they're properly analysed, tested, and managed
* Representing the Technology team in larger change and transformation programmes, and taking ownership of relevant tasks
* Building and optimising scalable processes to support our hyper-growth
* Leading and executing projects end to end
* Preparing reports and keeping directors and other stakeholders updated
* Resolving issues with management and stakeholders

**What You'll Need**

* 7+ years of experience in financial services or fintech, or at a leading technology or IT services provider
* Programme and project management qualifications, plus in-depth knowledge of their methods and principles
* A talent for breaking complex problems into smaller ones, and to enjoy working with data
* Risk awareness and an understanding of risk management frameworks, especially the three lines of defence model
* A solid grasp of technology within a financial services organisation, including modern tech stacks
* Knowledge of European financial services regulations, such as PSD2, GDPR, and the Digital Operational Resilience Act
* Experience partnering with executive teams and working closely with others to deliver results
* A background in retail banking and familiarity with Revolut's products and services
* Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills
* Sharp decision-making skills and the ability to analyse complex information, identify key issues, and drive resolutions

**Nice to have**

* Technology and change delivery experience at a leading global consultancy
* A track record of building or scaling the technology function of a financial services institution or fintech
* Relevant certifications, such as CCMP, ITIL, or PMP

Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.
  
  
**Important notice for candidates:**
Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.
  
  

* Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.
* Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

**We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process.**
If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.
  
  
By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

title: AVP-Risk (Credit & Cpty) and Performance Manager
description:
**Job Title: Assistant Vice President**
**Department: 2S Operations**
**About Business Line/Function**
**The Strategic Business Development and Transformation (SBDT) Team**
The SBDT team defines the regional go-to-market strategy and value proposition across all products and locations. The team manages the product portfolio, designs client solutions, and leads transformational initiatives across multiple product and solution domains. This function aligns the business with market, regulatory, and client requirements to drive optimal client satisfaction.
  
  
The SBDT team comprises several specialized units: Product and Solutions, Strategy and Business Management, Business Credit Advisors (BCA), Regulatory Watch.
  
  
To deliver strategic outcomes, the department collaborates closely with key internal stakeholders. Primary partners include the client coverage teams (Sales, Relationship Management, and Client Service) and the Service and IT delivery leadership (Client Delivery). Furthermore, the team maintains close working relationships with FIC, Global Markets, BNP Paribas Asset Management, and Wealth Management.
  
  
**Position Purpose**
**As the Securities Services (2S) footprint expands across the APAC region, the division is increasingly recognized as an industry leader. To support the growing franchise, we are seeking talented professionals to support the following functions:**

* Risk management – Business credit analyst (BCA) CIB2S BCA team is a team of experts in credit risk in post trade services of CIB2S. As experts, the team provides risk assessments for these activities to CIB2S Business, Credit analysts and RISK credit delegation holders in the context of credit requests and annual credit reviews. The team members also contribute to raising risk awareness across CIB2S. The team collaborates with all CIB2S locations, engaging with various business lines and functions across the organization.
* Performance Management Framework - The team oversees the following areas:

**Business Management**
: Managing governance and P&L monitoring, while contributing to strategic product development initiatives for APAC Client Lines.
  
  
**Strategic Leadership:**
Driving strategic initiatives, including business, location, and regional strategies, alongside comprehensive market reviews for CIB2S.
  
  
**Policy Alignment:**
Collaborating with Head Office to implement 2S policies and procedures affecting APAC SBDT.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Direct Responsibilities
  
  
**Risk Management**

* Credit Assessment: Review credit requests prepared by Coverage and Front Office teams, providing critical challenge when proposed activity structures or risk mitigants deviate from BNP Paribas Credit Policies.
* Limit Calibration: Calibrate requested credit limits to ensure alignment with risk appetite.
* Risk Advisory: Provide formal risk opinions to Credit Analysts and Credit Officers regarding specific requests.
* Committee Representation: Represent the Business in credit committees, working in partnership with Client Development.
* Governance & Compliance: Manage post-committee follow-ups with relevant stakeholders to ensure all pending conditions are met.
* Due Diligence: Participate in client due diligence processes as required.
* Legal Risk Analysis: Analyze the credit risk implications of amendments to legal agreements and provide strategic recommendations to decision-makers.
* Strategic Projects: Contribute to projects concerning CIB2S credit risk topics and portfolio analysis.
* Market Intelligence: Maintain proactive awareness of evolving CIB2S activities, regulatory environments and credit risk methodologies, disseminating key insights to Management and business partners.
* Country Risk Monitoring: Utilize existing framework (e.g., country envelopes) and develop enhanced methodologies for the holistic monitoring of risk exposures in sensitive jurisdictions.
* Product Development: Advise CIB2S Product teams on potential risk impacts during the product development lifecycle.

**Performance Management**

* Governance Support: supporting APAC Client Lines Executive Committee (Exco) governance through the preparation of decision-making analyses across a broad range of strategic topics.
* Strategic Initiatives: supporting regional strategic initiatives, including business, location, and regional strategies, market reviews, and market share analyses.
* Financial Management: Supporting Client Lines' financial reporting, headcount planning, cost management, and the budgeting process, alongside reviewing allocation keys and producing regional newsletters and dashboards.
* Profitability Optimization: Supporting initiatives to improve profitability for key regional clients and proposing actionable plans to enhance client and product margins.
* Committee Management: Assisting senior management committees, including the Client Line Board, APAC Business Committees, and Client Line Steering Committees—by preparing strategic documentation and action plans.
* Product Development: Contributions towards various regional product development initiatives.
* Stakeholder Liaison: Liaising with Head Office on SBDT-related matters as required.
* Ad Hoc Projects: Executing ad hoc tasks within the performance management remit.

**Technical & Behavioral Competencies**

* Proven expertise in credit or counterparty risk management within a financial institution or risk consultancy.
* Deep understanding of the Securities Services industry, its product suite, and the complexities of various financial instruments and their associated risks.
* Advanced analytical and presentation skills, with high proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, and the ability to manipulate large, complex datasets with rigor.
* Ability in strategic planning and business management, underpinned by strong, independent problem-solving skills.
* Exceptional ability to synthesize complex information and formulate concise, high-impact messages for stakeholders.
* Ability to navigate complex organizational hierarchies and engage confidently with senior leadership
* Strong interpersonal skills with a proven ability to work collaboratively within a team.

**Education Level:**
Bachelor’s degree or above
  
  
**Specific Qualifications:**
CA or FRM or CFA qualification is highly desirable.
  
  
**Technical Skills**
**Skills Referential (Required knowledge, skills and abilities)**




+ Credit & Cpty risk management and methodologies
+ Financial instruments and Risks
+ Proficiency in Power BI and familiarity with Design Thinking methodologies
+ Practical knowledge of Artificial Intelligence (AI) applications

**Behavioral Skills**




+ Excellent written and verbal communication skills
+ Ability to interact with senior management
+ Business storytelling
+ Project Management

**About BNP Paribas Group**
BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial & personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability.

At BNP Paribas, we passionately embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees are valued, respected and can bring their authentic selves to work. title: Chief of Staff - GBS
description:
Flex is the diversified manufacturing partner of choice that helps market-leading brands design, build and deliver innovative products that improve the world. A career at Flex offers the opportunity to make a difference and invest in your growth in a respectful, inclusive, and collaborative environment. If you are excited about a role but don't meet every bullet point, we encourage you to apply and join us to create the extraordinary.
  
  
The Chief of Staff (CoS) serves as a strategic partner and force multiplier to the Global Business Services (GBS) leadership team, driving alignment, governance, execution excellence, and organizational effectiveness across GBS Value Streams, Capability Services, and regional delivery centers. The role operates at the intersection of strategy, operations, transformation, and governance, translating leadership priorities into actionable outcomes while fostering collaboration across a complex, global, matrixed organization.
  
  
We are looking for key talent to take up the role of
**Chief of Staff - GBS,**
based in Chennai and reporting directly to GBS Global Head.
