title: Publications Specialist
description:
As a member of the Publications Management Team (PMT), the Publications Specialist (Senior Manager level) is primarily responsible for managing the development and execution of global publication plans for multiple products across various therapeutic areas. This role supports Scientific Publication Committees (SPCs), provides expertise on Pfizer publication policies, industry standards, and best practices, and oversees SPC budgets and vendors. A strong understanding of external publication guidelines and recommendations is required.
  
  
The ideal candidate is knowledgeable about current trends in scientific publishing and demonstrates a commitment to integrity, transparency, and quality. The Publications Specialist identifies opportunities to enhance processes, promotes consistent application of publication standards and policies, and helps ensure publication activities are conducted in accordance with internal requirements and external guidelines. This role operates with a high degree of independence and collaborates closely with colleagues across functions, geographies, and external partner organizations to support Pfizer's purpose of delivering breakthroughs that change patients' lives and to demonstrate Pfizer's values of Courage, Excellence, Equity, and Joy.
  
  
**Role Responsibilities**

* Responsible for execution of publication policy and process standards and communication of any policy and process changes, in collaboration with Publication Team Management and Legal
* Provides training and ongoing consultation to SPCs regarding publication policies, requirements, and guidelines
* Supports SPCs with publication planning and execution
* Coordinates the development of product publication plans within the established business planning cycle, applying publication planning experience and product knowledge to support informed planning and decision-making
* Serves as a consultant to the SPC on the selection of appropriate journals and congresses for scientific data submission
* Reviews contracts to ensure appropriate disclosures are applied and upholds transparency standards under the Sunshine Act
* Monitors and evaluates overall publication plan goals and objectives and makes recommendations for improvements where needed
* Works closely with the Medical leads of each SPC to ensure successful development and execution of the publication plan
* Identifies and drives metrics, process improvement, and sharing of best practices to further enhance the efficiency of the publication processes
* Establishes and manages assigned product publication budgets. Partners with Operations and Finance to maintain/monitor publication budget forecasts
* Collaborates with Pfizer Procurement regarding vendor selection, contracting and ongoing monitoring of vendor relationships
* Works in a vendor-facing role to communicate key information and requirements to publication agencies
* Works with publication agencies to educate them on established Pfizer publication policies and procedures
* Takes a lead role with vendors in facilitating issue resolution
* Maintains expertise in Pfizer's publication management system, providing guidance and support to publication agencies, SPC members, and cross-functional stakeholders to facilitate accurate record management and efficient publication execution
* Leverages approved technologies, including AI-enabled tools where appropriate, to enhance publication planning, operational efficiency, quality, and compliance
* Respectfully challenges practices, decisions or ideas to uphold integrity and ethical standards. Once decisions are made, fully supports and implements agreed upon courses of actions
* May engage with external professional and industry members to advance the profession

**Qualifications**

* Experience with the development and management of scientific publications coming from clinical trials, strong understanding of medical publication guidelines such as ICMJE, and basic knowledge of data analysis and/or study reporting
* Bachelor’s degree required. Advanced degree (PhD, PharmD or Masters) in science health preferred
* 5+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical or medical publications/communications industry, including 2+ years of experience in medical/scientific publications required
* Experience in facilitating cross-functional and matrixed teams
* Demonstrated ability to effectively work independently and produce quality results with few errors
* Strong interpersonal skills and negotiating capabilities
* Demonstrated ability to lead/manage multiple projects simultaneously and bring projects to successful completion. Routinely takes initiative
* Proficient organizational and time management skills
* Vendor management experience
* Projectmanagement experience
* Financial management experience
* Experience with publications management software and/or Salesforce preferred
* Excellent oral/written communication skills
* Demonstrated ability to design, develop and deliver effective presentations
* Demonstrated flexibility and willingness to embrace change
* Effective decision maker, analytical and solution-oriented

**Non-standard Work Schedule, Travel Or Environment Requirements**

* Ability to work effectively with global teams and participate in meetings across time zones, as needed to support business priorities
* Overnight travel up to 10% to attend team and department meetings and training

This role is posted in multiple locations. If you are applying for the role in an secondary job posting location where pay transparency regulations apply, your Talent Advisor will share the local pay information with you during the first interview.
  
  
Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates.
  
  
To learn more about acceptable and prohibited uses of AI during the recruitment process, please review our candidate AI-use guidelines available on Pfizer Careers.

title: Business Head
description:
**Role Objective:**

To lead the overall business with
**end-to-end P&L ownership**
and drive the transformation and growth of the Mechatronics business by
**scaling the business 3X over the next four years**
.

The Business Head will be responsible for developing and executing the business strategy across
**market expansion, customer acquisition, product portfolio, technology, operations, manufacturing, quality, supply chain and people**
, while strengthening profitability and building a scalable organization for sustainable long-term growth.

The role requires a strong business leader who can combine
**strategic thinking with execution**
, develop new customer and market opportunities, deepen relationships with existing customers, build differentiated technology capabilities and create a high-performance organization capable of supporting the targeted growth.

**Key Roles & Responsibilities**

**Business Strategy & 3X Growth**

* Develop and execute a comprehensive
  **4-year business strategy and roadmap**
  to achieve 3X growth in revenue and significantly improve business profitability.
* Identify and prioritize growth opportunities across
  **existing customers, new customers, new products, geographies and emerging applications**
  .
* Define annual business plans, revenue targets, profitability objectives and strategic priorities.
* Continuously evaluate market trends, customer requirements, technology changes and competitive landscape to identify new business opportunities.
* Build a robust pipeline of future business opportunities to support sustained growth beyond the four-year horizon.

**P&L Ownership & Financial Performance**

* Own the complete
  **P&L of the Mechatronics business**
  , including revenue, EBITDA, working capital and cash flow.
* Drive profitable growth rather than revenue growth alone.
* Improve contribution margins through
  **product mix, pricing, localization, cost engineering, productivity and operational excellence**
  .
* Establish strong financial discipline across budgeting, forecasting, cost control and investment decisions.
* Drive improvement in
  **ROCE and overall capital efficiency**
  .

**Customer & Market Development**

* Build and strengthen relationships with
  **key OEMs, Tier-1 customers and strategic accounts**
  .
* Develop a focused customer acquisition strategy to reduce customer concentration and diversify the business.
* Lead strategic customer engagements and participate personally in critical business development discussions.
* Identify opportunities for
  **new product introductions, platform nominations and long-term customer partnerships**
  .
* Build strong relationships with CXO-level stakeholders across customers and ecosystem partners.

**Product & Technology Strategy**

* Develop the future product and technology roadmap in line with evolving automotive and industrial requirements.
* Strengthen capabilities in
  **mechatronics, electronics, embedded systems, sensors, actuators, control systems and software-driven products**
  , as relevant to the business.
* Identify opportunities for
  **technology partnerships, strategic alliances, acquisitions or in-house capability development**
  .
* Ensure the product portfolio evolves from conventional products towards higher-value, technology-driven solutions.
* Improve speed-to-market and strengthen the organization's ability to develop and launch new products.

**New Business & Revenue Expansion**

* Drive new business development across
  **existing and new customers**
  .
* Identify adjacent markets and applications where the company's mechatronics capabilities can be leveraged.
* Develop strategies for entering new geographies and customer segments.
* Build a healthy balance between
  **core business growth and new-growth businesses**
  .
* Establish a structured mechanism for tracking RFQs, nominations, order book and future revenue visibility.

**Manufacturing & Operational Excellence**

* Ensure manufacturing capacity and capabilities are aligned with the planned 3X growth.
* Develop a scalable manufacturing strategy covering
  **capacity expansion, automation, productivity, technology and infrastructure**
  .
* Drive operational excellence through continuous improvement, lean manufacturing and digitalization.
* Improve
  **OEE, productivity, yield, cycle time and overall asset utilization**
  .
* Ensure manufacturing scalability without compromising quality, delivery or cost competitiveness.

**Supply Chain & Localization**

* Build a robust and scalable supply chain capable of supporting 3X business growth.
* Drive localization of critical components and technologies to improve competitiveness and reduce supply-chain risks.
* Develop strategic supplier partnerships and ensure adequate capacity for future growth.
* Improve procurement effectiveness through
  **cost engineering, VA/VE, localization and strategic sourcing**
  .
* Build resilience against supply disruptions and commodity/FX volatility.

**Quality & Customer Excellence**

* Establish a strong culture of
  **quality ownership and customer satisfaction**
  across the organization.
* Drive improvements in PPM, warranty, customer complaints and field quality.
* Ensure robust APQP, PPAP and quality systems for new product launches.
* Develop preventive quality mechanisms as the business scales.
* Personally engage in resolution of critical customer quality issues.

**Organization & Leadership Development**

* Build the organization and leadership capability required to support the 3X growth journey.
* Develop a strong second line of leadership across
  **Sales, Engineering, Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, Finance and HR**
  .
* Identify critical talent gaps and attract high-calibre leadership and technical talent.
* Establish clear accountability, KPIs and performance-management mechanisms.
* Build a culture of
  **ownership, speed, innovation, customer focus and execution excellence**
  .
* Develop succession plans for critical leadership positions.

**Transformation & Digitalization**

* Lead the transformation of the business from its current scale to a
  **larger, more structured and professionally managed organization**
  .
* Drive digitalization across manufacturing, engineering, supply chain, customer management and business analytics.
* Establish real-time business dashboards covering
  **sales, profitability, operations, quality, working capital and growth pipeline**
  .
* Simplify processes and improve organizational agility as the business scales.

**Governance & Risk Management**

* Establish strong governance mechanisms across business operations.
* Ensure compliance with statutory, customer, quality, ESG and corporate requirements.
* Identify and proactively manage business risks related to
  **customers, technology, supply chain, talent, capacity and financial performance**
  .
* Present regular business performance and strategic updates to the Board / Management.

**Candidate Requirements:**

* **20+ years of overall experience**
  , preferably in automotive, mechatronics, auto-components or related manufacturing businesses.
* Strong
  **business acumen**
  with end-to-end understanding of P&L, operations and commercial functions.
* Strong
  **Sales / Business Development experience**
  with proven success in business growth and new customer acquisition.
* Strong
  **core operational experience**
  , preferably with manufacturing, supply chain, quality and cost management exposure.
* Strong and established
  **connect with Automotive OEMs and Tier-1 customers**
  .
* Proven track record of
  **business growth, market expansion and customer relationship management**
  .
* Experience in
  **P&L ownership and driving profitable growth**
  .
* Strong leadership capability with the ability to
  **build teams and scale the business**
  .
* **Strong operational and sales orientation**
  with a strategic and execution-focused approach.
* Experience in
  **driving transformation and scaling a business**
  will be highly preferred.

Provides direction to teams on project work, setting priorities, and aligning with business needs. Guides teams on adjusting plans to accommodate resource or timeline changes.

* Involve commissioning team as when needed.

* Prepare Commissioning and SAT procedure.

* wastewater treatment processes.

* Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and training materials for
* treatment processes.
* Project know-how sharing to proposal / application team.
* Prepare man-hours estimation during projects presales.
* Ensure safety, health, and environmental compliance for all activities under their control.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's / master’s degree in chemical engineering is desirable.
* Min12 years of experience in process and application engineering in the water and wastewater industry is required for this position.
* Min 3 years of experience as Lead / Manager managing team of process engineers and P&ID designer / drafter.
* Familiar with various water and wastewater technologies.
* Understanding of membranes and membrane processes for water treatment.
* Excellent analytical thinking, teamwork, interpersonal/communication skills, writing and problem-solving capabilities.

* SLA & Quality Ownership: Own segment-level SLA, aging, and quality metrics across all in-scope AML workstreams; drive corrective action plans where targets slip.
* Escalation Resolution: Serve as the escalation point for complex Transaction Monitoring alerts, ambiguous typology matches, and cross-functional queries requiring judgment beyond Team Lead level.
* Calibration: Run regular calibration sessions with Quality Assurance to align on disposition standards for TM alerts, EDD assessments, and SAR quality.
* Capacity & Roster Planning: Plan shift rosters, leave, and capacity across teams in coordination with workforce management to maintain SLA coverage.
* Process & Regulatory Change: Translate updates to typologies, regulatory guidance, or internal policy into revised SOPs and floor communication, ensuring timely rollout.
* Performance Management: Conduct performance reviews, PIPs, and coaching plans for Team Leads; approve QA-driven coaching plans for analysts.
* MI & Reporting: Consolidate and present segment-level dashboards (volume, aging, quality, attrition, productivity) to the Manager on a weekly/monthly cadence.
* Stakeholder Coordination: Liaise with Compliance, Legal, and Training functions on case-specific queries, policy interpretation, and escalations requiring sign-off.

**What You Will Need**

* 10+ years of overall experience in AML/Financial Crime compliance operations, with at least 2 years directly supervising teams or Team Leads.
* Strong, demonstrable experience in Transaction Monitoring (TM) — alert investigation, disposition quality, and typology-based decisioning at a review/oversight level.
* Proven experience managing KYC/CDD, EDD, PEP Review, and SAR Filing workstreams concurrently, ideally in a multi-process AML operation.
* Experience managing SLA/quality performance across a segment
* Working knowledge of TM/case management systems (e.g., Actimize, SAS AML, Verafin) and reporting tools.

**What Would Be Nice To Have**

* Prior supervisory experience in a crypto/virtual asset transaction monitoring environment, including oversight of on-chain analytics or VASP-related due diligence.
* Working knowledge of blockchain analytics platforms (e.g., Chainalysis, Elliptic, TRM Labs) and how findings integrate into TM alert review.
* Familiarity with crypto-specific regulatory expectations (e.g., FATF Travel Rule, Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation) and their impact on SAR/STR quality.

title: Senior Manager, Procurement
description:
**Role: Sr. Manager, Procurement**
**Location: Sricity**
**Full/ Part-time: Full time**
**About Carrier**
Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure safe transport of food, life-saving medicines and more. Since inventing modern air conditioning in 1902, we lead with purpose: enhancing the lives we live and the world we share. We continue to lead because of our world-class, inclusive workforce that puts the customer at the centre of everything we do. For more information, visit corporate.carrier.com or follow Carrier on social media at @Carrier.
  
  
**About The Role**
Manager - Procurement & Supply Chain will be responsible for leading Procurement, Material Planning, Inventory Management, and Supplier Performance activities for the Chiller Product Line. The role requires driving operational excellence across the end-to-end supply chain while ensuring uninterrupted production, optimized inventory, cost competitiveness, and superior supplier performance.
  
  
The position will lead a team of procurement and planning professionals and collaborate closely with Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, Logistics, Finance, and Suppliers to achieve business objectives.
  
  
**The Role Is Accountable For**

* Ensuring uninterrupted production through effective supply chain and material planning strategies.
* Optimizing procurement costs, inventory levels, and working capital.
* Strengthening supplier performance, capability, and risk management.
* Driving supply chain efficiency, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.
* Leading and developing a high-performing procurement and supply chain team.
* Achieving key supply chain performance metrics including Line Fulfilment, Plan Fulfilment, Inventory Health, E&O Reduction, Supplier OTD, and SPPM.

**Job Responsibility**
**Procurement & Supplier Management**

* Lead procurement activities to ensure timely availability of materials while meeting cost, quality, and delivery objectives.
* Develop and execute supplier management strategies to improve supplier performance, competitiveness, and reliability.
* Drive supplier development initiatives focused on quality, delivery, capacity enhancement, localization, and continuous improvement.
* Conduct supplier capacity assessments and evaluate supplier readiness to support business growth and demand fluctuations.
* Identify, assess, and mitigate supply chain risks through robust business continuity and contingency planning.
* Lead supplier reviews and performance governance to ensure compliance with quality and delivery expectations.

**Material Planning & Inventory Management**

* Oversee material planning activities to ensure optimum inventory levels while maintaining production continuity.
* Manage inventory health including inventory turns, excess and obsolete (E&O) inventory, and working capital improvement initiatives.
* Lead shortage management and material recovery actions to prevent production disruptions.
* Drive implementation and continuous improvement of MRP planning processes.
* Ensure timely execution of engineering changes and new product introductions while minimizing inventory exposure and obsolescence.

**Operations & Supply Chain Excellence**

* Collaborate with Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering, and Logistics teams to ensure seamless execution of production plans.
* Drive process improvements through Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, Continuous Improvement, and Operational Excellence initiatives.
* Lead initiatives such as Milk-Run, Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI), inventory optimization, and supply chain digitalization.

**Cost & Productivity Management**

* Drive procurement productivity and cost reduction initiatives through negotiations, value engineering, localization, and strategic sourcing.
* Identify and implement opportunities to reduce total cost of ownership and improve supply chain efficiency.
* Support annual budgeting, forecasting, and cost management objectives.
* Drive working capital improvements through inventory optimization and supplier collaboration.

**Team Leadership & People Development**

* Lead, coach, and develop the Procurement and Supply Chain team to achieve departmental and organizational objectives.
* Establish clear goals, KPIs, and development plans for team members.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous learning, and operational excellence.
* Conduct regular performance reviews and succession planning activities.
* Build organizational capability to support business growth and future leadership requirements.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**
**The Role Will Be Measured On**

* Line Fulfilment
* Plan Fulfilment
* Inventory Turns
* Inventory Accuracy
* Excess & Obsolete (E&O) Reduction
* Supplier On-Time Delivery (OTD)
* Cost Savings & Productivity
* Supplier Risk Management
* Team Performance and Capability Development

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering; MBA/Supply Chain specialization preferred.
* 15-18 years of experience in Procurement, Materials Management, Supply Chain, or Manufacturing Operations.
* Proven experience managing Procurement, Planning, or Supply Chain teams in a manufacturing environment.
* Strong understanding of procurement, material planning, inventory management, supplier development, and supply chain operations.
* Hands-on experience with SAP or equivalent ERP systems, including procurement, inventory management, and MRP processes.
* Expertise in Inventory Management, Lean Manufacturing, Milk-Run, Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI), and Supply Chain Optimization.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Power BI, and data analytics tools.
* Demonstrated experience in cost reduction, supplier negotiations, and working capital improvement initiatives.
* Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional leadership capabilities.
* Experience in HVAC, Industrial Chillers, Capital Equipment, or Engineering Manufacturing industries will be an added advantage.

**Benefits**
We offer a competitive total rewards package that may include other benefits and wellbeing programs. Offerings vary by role and location and are designed to support employees’ health, security, and success.
  
  

* Make yourself a priority with flexible schedules, parental leave
* Drive forward your career through professional development opportunities
* Achieve your personal goals with our Employee Assistance Programme

**Our commitment to you**
Our greatest assets are the expertise, creativity and passion of our employees. We strive to provide a great place to work that attracts, develops and retains the best talent, promotes employee engagement, fosters teamwork and ultimately drives innovation for the benefit of our customers. We strive to create an environment where you feel that you belong, with diversity and inclusion as the engine to growth and innovation. We develop and deploy best-in-class programs and practices, providing enriching career opportunities, listening to employee feedback and always challenging ourselves to do better. This is The Carrier Way.
  
  
Join us and make a difference.

title: Lab Operations - Director
description:

Operations Group, Operations Group > Operations
  
  
****General Summary:****
We are seeking experienced Lab Operations lead to own and lead the strategy, planning, and execution of Qualcomm's lab infrastructure and operations across multiple engineering labs. This role is responsible for ensuring lab readiness, capacity planning, Test Equipment, infrastructure scalability, safety compliance, and operational excellence to support product development and validation activities.
  
  
The position oversees a team of lab engineers and technicians while partnering with engineering, facilities, IT, EHS, security, procurement, and suppliers to deliver reliable, secure, and scalable lab environments. Responsibilities include power, cooling, and space planning, test equipment deployment and support, lab capacity management, capital planning, and infrastructure modernization.

High School Diploma or equivalent and 12+ years of relevant operations experience with 2+ of those years involving leadership experience.
  
  

* Completed advanced degrees in a relevant field may be substituted for up to two years (Master’s = one year, Doctorate = two years) of work experience.

****Key Responsibilities****

* Lab Infrastructure Strategy, Planning & Capacity Management
* Define and execute lab infrastructure strategy across multiple engineering labs.
* Own power, cooling, space, and capacity planning to support current and future product roadmaps.
* Conduct feasibility studies, site assessments, and trade-off analyses for lab expansion, upgrades, and new builds.
* Develop demand forecasts, capacity models, and utilization plans to optimize infrastructure investments.
* Lab Operations & Engineering Enablement
* Lead day-to-day operations of engineering labs supporting validation, and product development.
* Own capital and expense planning, purchasing, warranty, calibration, and inventory shipment, import, EC components, bonding with a clear, auditable process across all labs.
* Ensure lab readiness, uptime, equipment availability, and operational excellence.
* Manage lab deployments, reconfigurations, scaling activities, and infrastructure modernization initiatives.
* Partner with engineering teams to ensure infrastructure, equipment, and resources are available ahead of key milestones.
* Drive efficient lab workflows, layouts, and utilization improvements.
* People Leadership & Program Execution
* Lead and develop teams of lab engineers, technicians, and outsourced resources.
* Drive workforce planning, capability development, and operational accountability.
* Own execution of capital and operational plans, budgets, procurement, and resource allocation.
* Ensure successful execution of roadmap-driven growth, consolidation, and transformation initiatives.
* Safety, Security & Compliance
* Serve as the accountable leader for lab ESD, EHS, physical security, and compliance programs.
* Maintain audit-ready processes, documentation, and infrastructure records.
* Drive compliance with safety, security, and regulatory requirements across all lab environments.
* Protect physical and intellectual assets through effective governance and control mechanisms.
* Lead risk assessments, corrective actions, and continuous compliance improvements.
* Cross-Functional Leadership & Stakeholder Management
* Partner with Engineering, Facilities, IT, Networking, EHS, Procurement, Finance, and external suppliers to deliver lab solutions.
* Influence decisions through technical expertise, business cases, and executive-level communication.
* Drive collaboration across global teams to establish best practices and scalable operating models.
* Serve as the primary escalation and decision point for infrastructure, capacity, readiness, and operational challenges.

****Minimum Qualifications****
Bachelor’s or Associate degree in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  
  

* 15+ years of experience in engineering support, silicon or hardware lab operations, lab infrastructure deployment, and laboratory management.
* Proven experience leading large-scale engineering labs supporting silicon bring-up, validation, and product development activities.
* Strong knowledge of lab infrastructure, including power, cooling, networking, test equipment, RF systems, and operational processes.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering with hands on experience managing and supporting R&D labs for large-scale engineering, validation, and silicon development programs within the semiconductor, networking, telecommunications, or high-tech industries.

description:

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
In this role at EY GDS Consulting, you will play a key role in shaping innovative solutions for telecom clients, acting as their trusted advisor in transformation leveraging Nokia FlowOne driven solutions. You will apply leading industry standards along with Nokia FlowOne expertise to solve complex telecommunication challenges and leverage cutting-edge technologies to drive Telco transformations. You will support the Partners and the Markets team in any opportunities that are initiated by clients.
  
  
You will be responsible to create a market for EY offerings across the telecommunications value chain and generate new leads and opportunities based on the client relationships you already have. Additionally, you will be responsible for delivery of key client outcomes on engagements by managing the teams on ground and client expectations of delivery, helping project teams mitigate delivery risk and identifying key issues that hinder outcomes for the client.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Provide solution architecture and thought leadership on Zero Touch Fulfilment and Autonomous Networks leveraging Nokia FlowOne and other Nokia suite of OSS products
* Lead the implementation of related solutions, ensuring adherence to project timelines and quality standards.
* Driving presales response for OSS transformation RFIs/RFPs.
* Develop comprehensive documentation for network architectures, designs, and processes.
* Stay up to date with the latest trends and advancements in Autonomous networks, AI, and Machine learning with hands on experience in leveraging leading AI tools for deliveries.
* Develop and apply solution architecture standards, processes, and principles.
* Evaluate and recommend technologies, tools, and platforms that support autonomous networking initiatives.
* You will be the day-to-day point of contact for clients and managers on projects. You structure and engage teams to deliver high-quality outputs.
* Take the lead in identifying client issues and proposing the most appropriate approach for challenges that the telecommunication industry players face.
* You help develop the business and acquire new clients and engagements, including the identification and pursuit of business opportunities by forging strong client relationships.
* You build and maintain long-term relationships with senior clients.
* You drive strategic discussions regarding business objectives and strategy KPIs.
* Delivering qualified solutions to meet business objectives, providing focus to ensure scope and objectives are maintained throughout the project and program life cycles ensuring benefits realization.
* Result oriented leadership style, setting achievable goals and leading by example – linking commercial and technical arenas.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Consultant with 10-12 Years proven experience and hands-on professional experience in Nokia FlowOne, driving large programs and should have worked as an Architect/Designer for at least 5 years.
* Understanding of 5G Slicing, 5G SA/NSA networks, IP/MPLS, Optics, IMS, VoLTE, NFV/SDN, Fixed network.
* In depth knowledge of TMForum’s Open Digital Architecture (ODA) and related ODA components along with TMForum Open APIs.
* Deep knowledge of OSS Architecture, Processes and Systems with practical and proven experience of solutioning for large telecom companies.
* Experience in architecting Zero-Touch operations, Closed Loop Automation, Autonomous Networks and implementing Intent-Driven Management systems to translate business goals to machine readable “Intents” in telecom domain.
* Experience in building comprehensive solutions and response to complex RFx during presales, especially leveraging Nokia’s OSS product suite.
* Providing Autonomous Networks (AN) thought leadership, solution implementation leadership, application expertise and solution vision to clients.
* Additional experience in other Nokia suite of OSS products will be an added advantage.
* Hands-on experience in Java, Python, Kubernetes, Microservices, Databases, etc.
* Expertise and experience to provide thought leadership and guidance on resolving complex implementation and solution issues.
* Expertise to review and approve methods design and development solution documents, internal and external test strategies, plans and scripts.
* Navigate complex client relationships and large transformation related challenges.
* Extensive RFP exposure - developing capability needs and supplier liaison.
* Process development for both 'As Is' and 'To Be' to aid requirement and solution definition and scoping.
* A bachelor’s degree in Electronics/Computer Science/Information Technology/ or any other relevant discipline.
* Relevant certifications (E.g., TOGAF, eTOM, ODA) are a plus.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.

**Ideally, you will also have:**

* Strong leadership skills, teaming and communications
* Strong drive to excel professionally, and to guide and motivate others.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Dedicated, resourceful and able to work under pressure.

**What we look for:**
Highly motivated individuals with excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to prioritize shifting workloads in a rapidly changing industry. An effective communicator, you’ll be a confident leader equipped with strong people management skills and a genuine passion to make things happen in a dynamic organization. If you’re ready to take on a wide range of responsibilities and are committed to seeking out new ways to make a difference, this role is for you.
  
  
**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits:**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.

description:
**Senior AI Lead / Director – AI Programs & Solutions | SRM Tech | Chennai - Hybrid**

**About SRM Tech**

SRM Technologies is a global digital and engineering partner delivering capabilities across data and AI, enterprise platforms, embedded and platform engineering, supply chain, and design-to-manufacturing services.

We work across high-impact industries such as Mobility, Life Sciences, Healthcare, and Logistics, supporting enterprises across North America, APAC, and Europe in building intelligent, future-ready ecosystems and driving transformation at scale.

As a Great Place to Work®-certified organization, we are committed to creating an environment where people can learn, grow, and thrive. We believe empowered individuals drive innovation, deliver value to customers, and play a meaningful role in shaping our collective success.

At SRM Tech, every contribution matters, and we are always looking for passionate individuals who are eager to shape their careers with us.

**Role Overview**

As a Senior AI Lead – AI Programs & Solutions, you will lead SRM Tech’s artificial intelligence programs, client engagements, and proprietary AI tool development initiatives. The role combines technical expertise with executive leadership, focusing on Go-To-Market (GTM) strategies, enterprise AI delivery, and positioning SRM Tech as a trusted partner in AI transformation.

You will lead multidisciplinary teams, manage strategic client relationships, and drive the adoption of Generative AI, Agentic AI workflows, and scalable AI/ML platforms. Experience in the Life Sciences / Pharmaceutical domain is a strong advantage.

**Work location**
: Chennai - Hybrid

**Preferred Experience**
: 15-20 years

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic Leadership & GTM Execution**

* Define and execute Go-To-Market (GTM) strategies for AI offerings, accelerators, and solution frameworks.
* Lead client presentations and present technical solutions, translating business challenges into actionable AI roadmaps.
* Lead internal product and tool development initiatives to build reusable, scalable, and high-value AI assets and frameworks.

**Program Oversight & Delivery Excellence**

* Oversee end-to-end delivery of complex AI/ML programs, ensuring timely, high-quality execution aligned with business objectives.
* Manage cross-functional teams comprising data engineers, data scientists, ML engineers, and solution architects.
* Establish delivery governance, quality assurance, and best practices across AI programs.
* Serve as the primary AI subject matter expert in client discussions, discovery workshops, and steering committee meetings.

**Technical & Innovation Leadership**

* Drive the adoption of Generative AI architectures, including Agentic AI, LangChain, LangGraph, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Large Language Models (LLMs), and Vector Databases.
* Provide architectural oversight for scalable data pipelines and platforms, including Apache Spark, Kafka, and Databricks.
* Guide the development and implementation of classical ML and NLP models across cloud and hybrid environments.
* Mentor and develop AI engineering and data science teams, fostering technical excellence and innovation.

**Life Sciences / Pharmaceutical Domain**

* Apply Life Sciences domain knowledge across commercial operations, market access, clinical insights, and omnichannel analytics to develop industry-specific AI solutions and accelerate time-to-value for clients.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 15+ years of overall experience in IT / Software Engineering.
* 6+ years in dedicated AI/ML leadership or architecture roles.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline.

**Leadership & Strategy**

* Proven experience in client management, executive presentations, and C-level stakeholder engagement.
* Experience in defining AI offerings, supporting pre-sales activities, and driving GTM expansion.
* Demonstrated ability to build, mentor, and manage delivery teams across multiple projects.

**Technical Expertise**

**Generative AI & Modern AI Stack**

* Expertise in Generative AI platforms, Agentic AI architectures, RAG frameworks, LLMs, fine-tuning, and Vector Databases.

**Core AI/ML & Data Engineering**

* Strong foundation in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, and statistical modeling.
* Proficiency in Python and ML frameworks, including PyTorch, TensorFlow, and scikit-learn.

**Data & Cloud Platforms**

* Experience with enterprise data platforms and technologies, including Databricks, Apache Spark, Kafka, and cloud-native services across AWS, Azure, and GCP.

**AI Delivery & Governance**

* Experience in MLOps, CI/CD for AI, model monitoring, and automated deployment pipelines.

**Preferred Domain Experience**

* Life Sciences / Pharmaceutical domain experience, particularly in commercial AI use cases, field productivity tools, patient/HCP journey orchestration, and market access operations.

*SRM Tech is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We make all hiring decisions based on merit, without bias or discrimination, in line with applicable laws.*

Bruhat Logistics is a Singapore-headquartered international freight forwarding and project cargo logistics company, specializing in providing customized and efficient logistics solutions across global markets.

With an established international presence across Asia, the Middle East, Europe, Africa, and the Americas, we offer end-to-end multimodal transportation solutions through air, sea, and land.

At Bruhat Logistics, we are committed to delivering reliable, innovative, and customer-focused logistics services while providing our employees with opportunities for professional development and industry exposure.

Job Description

We are looking for a proactive, detail-oriented, and enthusiastic **Operations Executive** to join our Operations & Documentation team. The selected candidate will be responsible for coordinating shipment activities, managing import/export operations, maintaining shipment documentation, and ensuring smooth communication between clients, vendors, and internal teams.

The role offers an excellent opportunity to gain practical exposure to international freight forwarding operations, particularly Air and Sea Imports.

* Handle day-to-day shipment operations and ensure smooth execution of freight forwarding activities.

* Monitor shipment progress and provide regular updates to clients regarding shipment status, transit schedules, and delivery timelines.

* Coordinate with vendors and logistics service providers to plan and execute shipments according to client requirements.
* Identify and resolve shipment-related challenges, operational delays, and unexpected issues through effective crisis management.
* Ensure timely preparation, verification, and maintenance of shipment-related documents.
* Maintain accurate shipment records and operational reports.
* Work closely with the Sales, Pricing, and Documentation teams to ensure seamless coordination and customer satisfaction.
* Ensure operational activities are completed within agreed timelines while maintaining service quality.

Required Skills & Competencies

* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong coordination and interpersonal skills.
* Basic understanding of logistics, supply chain management, or freight forwarding operations.
* Good problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
* Ability to handle multiple shipments and prioritize tasks effectively.
* Proficiency in MS Office, particularly Microsoft Excel and Outlook.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Customer-focused approach with the ability to work collaboratively across teams.
* Willingness to learn international shipping procedures and operational documentation.

What We Offer

* Exposure to international freight forwarding and project cargo operations.
* Opportunities to work with global clients, vendors, and overseas teams.
* Practical learning in Air and Sea operations.
* A collaborative and professional work environment.
* Opportunities for continuous learning, skill development, and career growth within the logistics industry.

* Flexible schedule
* Provident Fund

title: Senior Manager, Fraud Operations - India
description:
Ascensus is the leading independent technology and service platform powering savings plans across America, providing products and expertise that help nearly 16 million people save for a better today and tomorrow.
  
  
**Job Summary:**
Ascensus is seeking an experienced Senior Manager, Fraud Operations – India to manage, lead and develop India-based fraud operations team and work in close partnership with the parent company’s Fraud Operations team in the United States. The role will support the effective detection, investigation, mitigation, and prevention of fraud and financial crime through disciplined case management, strong operational controls, timely escalation, insightful reporting, and continuous improvement.
  
  
This is a hands-on leadership role suited to a fraud operations professional who has previously managed a similar function or team. The Senior Manager will translate priorities established with U.S. stakeholders into clear team objectives, ensure consistent execution, and foster a collaborative, accountable, and high-performing culture. The role will balance risk mitigation, operational efficiency, quality, and client experience while ensuring adherence to applicable policies, procedures, governance requirements, and data-protection expectations.
  
  
**Job Functions, Essential Duties And Key Responsibilities**

* Manage the day-to-day delivery of fraud investigation and fraud operations activities performed by the India team, ensuring timely, accurate, and consistent case outcomes.
* Own departmental performance, including fraud losses, service levels, productivity, quality, employee engagement, and operational effectiveness.
* Lead, coach, and develop team of fraud investigators and/or analysts; set clear expectations, allocate work, monitor capacity, provide regular feedback, and support skill development.
* Partner closely with the U.S. Fraud Operations team to align on operating procedures, investigation standards, priorities, service expectations, escalation protocols, and risk-treatment decisions.
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators, risk metrics, and reporting to evaluate program effectiveness and support executive decision-making.
* Serve as a senior escalation point for significant fraud events, regulatory matters, and business critical risk issues.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, internal policies, governance standards, and investigative procedures.
* Build and maintain relationships with industry partners, vendors, law enforcement, and external stakeholders to strengthen fraud prevention and response efforts.
* Responsible for protecting, securing, and proper handling of all confidential data held by Ascensus to ensure against unauthorized access, improper transmission, and/or unapproved disclosure of information that could result in harm to Ascensus or our clients.
* At Ascensus we are guided by our Core Values of People Matter, Quality First and Integrity Always®. They inspire us every day to prioritize an environment of respect for those we serve and one another and should be visible in your actions on a day-to-day..

**Supervision**

* Lead and develop team leads, and Fraud Investigators, creating a culture of accountability, engagement, and operational excellence.
* Create an inclusive and collaborative environment in which team members raise concerns early, share knowledge, and take ownership of outcomes.
* Work effectively in a matrixed, cross-cultural environment, building trust and alignment with U.S.-based fraud leaders and subject-matter experts.

**Experience, Skills And Knowledge Requirements**

* 10+ years of progressive experience in fraud investigations, fraud operations, financial crime, risk management, or a related financial-services environment.
* Minimum 3 years of direct people-management experience, preferably leading a team of fraud investigators, analysts, or comparable operations professionals.
* Proven experience leading large-scale fraud investigation or fraud operations functions with responsibility for strategy, performance, and results.
* Demonstrated success developing leaders, building high-performing teams, and driving organizational effectiveness.
* Experience owning operational performance, service delivery, workforce planning, financial results, and risk outcomes.
* Strong knowledge of fraud typologies, fraud risk management frameworks, and financial crime trends.
* Proven ability to influence executive stakeholders and drive enterprise-wide initiatives.
* Exceptional leadership, communication, strategic planning, and change management skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, accounting, risk management, criminal justice, technology, or a related discipline; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* Professional certification such as Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE), Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist (CAMS), or equivalent fraud / financial-crime credential is preferred.
* Experience with fraud case-management platforms, data analytics, operational dashboards, quality-assurance programs, and investigation reporting.
* Experience supporting retirement services, financial services, payments, banking, insurance, or other regulated customer-account environments is desirable.

**We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.**
*Be aware of employment fraud. All email communications from Ascensus or its hiring managers originate from @ascensus.com*
*or @futureplan.com*
*email addresses. We will never ask you for payment or require you to purchase any equipment. If you are suspicious or unsure about validity of a job posting, we strongly encourage you to apply directly through our website.*

title: Assistant General Manager- Works Manager-Service & Bodyshop
description:
Job Description – AGM (Service & Body Shop)1. Position Details

**Job Title:**
**Assistant General Manager (AGM) – Service & Body Shop**

**Department:**
After-Sales / Service Operations & Body Shop

**Reporting To:**
Chief Executive Officer (CEO)

**Location:**
Trimulgherry, Secunderabad

**Industry:**
Automobile / 4-Wheeler Dealership

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time | On-Site

2. Job Purpose

To lead and manage the overall After-Sales operations, including General Service, Mechanical Repairs, Body Shop, Paint Shop and Customer Service functions.

The AGM will be responsible for driving business growth, workshop productivity, labour sales, body shop revenue, profitability, customer satisfaction and operational excellence while ensuring compliance with OEM standards, company policies and statutory requirements.

3. Key Responsibilities

**A. Workshop & Service Operations Management**

* Oversee day-to-day operations of the General Service and Mechanical Workshop.
* Ensure optimum utilization of manpower, service bays, tools, equipment and workshop infrastructure.
* Monitor workshop loading, job allocation, vehicle repair progress and delivery commitments.
* Drive workshop productivity, labour efficiency, bay utilization and turnaround time (TAT).
* Ensure adherence to OEM repair procedures, service standards and operating guidelines.
* Identify operational gaps and implement corrective measures to improve workshop performance.

**B. Body Shop & Insurance Operations**

* Manage end-to-end Body Shop and Paint Shop operations.
* Monitor accident repair processes, job allocation and vehicle delivery timelines.
* Coordinate with insurance companies, surveyors and customers for claim approvals and settlements.
* Drive insurance claim conversion, accident repair business and body shop revenue.
* Ensure quality repairs, proper paint finish and timely vehicle delivery.
* Monitor rework percentage and improve first-time-right repair performance.
* Control material consumption, repair costs and body shop profitability.

**C. Customer Satisfaction & Relationship Management**

* Ensure a consistent and superior customer experience across Service and Body Shop operations.
* Monitor customer complaints, escalations and resolution timelines.
* Drive improvement in Customer Satisfaction Index (CSI), customer retention and repeat business.
* Review customer feedback and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Ensure effective coordination between Service Advisors, Body Shop Advisors and customer-facing teams.

**D. Financial & Business Performance**

* Achieve monthly and annual targets for workshop revenue, labour sales and body shop business.
* Monitor service absorption, labour productivity, efficiency and operating expenses.
* Drive revenue growth while maintaining operational profitability.
* Control warranty, goodwill, rework and other operational costs.
* Prepare and review monthly business plans, budgets, forecasts and performance reports.
* Analyse business performance and take corrective action wherever required.

**E. Team Leadership & Manpower Development**

* Lead and manage Service Advisors, Technicians, Workshop Supervisors, Body Shop Advisors, Denters, Painters and other support staff.
* Set performance targets and monitor individual and departmental productivity.
* Conduct regular performance reviews, coaching and development sessions.
* Identify training requirements and ensure technical and behavioural skill development.
* Build a performance-driven culture focused on accountability, discipline and continuous improvement.
* Ensure adequate manpower planning and optimum workforce utilization.

**F. Process, Quality & OEM Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with OEM standards, dealership processes, safety guidelines and statutory requirements.
* Conduct regular workshop audits, quality inspections and process reviews.
* Implement process improvements to enhance operational efficiency and repair quality.
* Maintain workshop housekeeping, 5S, safety and cleanliness standards.
* Ensure proper documentation and adherence to warranty and service procedures.

**G. Inventory & Resource Management**

* Coordinate with the Parts Department to ensure timely availability of spare parts and consumables.
* Monitor tools, equipment, workshop infrastructure and maintenance requirements.
* Ensure effective control of consumables, paint materials and other workshop resources.
* Minimize resource wastage, vehicle idle time and operational bottlenecks.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated based on the following parameters:

* Overall Service and Workshop Revenue
* Labour Sales Achievement
* Body Shop and Paint Shop Revenue
* Insurance Claim Conversion
* Workshop Productivity and Labour Efficiency
* Bay Utilization
* Customer Satisfaction Index (CSI)
* Customer Retention and Repeat Business
* Accident Repair Turnaround Time (TAT)
* Rework and First-Time-Right Repair Percentage
* Employee Productivity and Manpower Utilization
* Warranty Compliance and Cost Control
* Overall Departmental Profitability

5. Educational Qualification

* Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Automobile or Mechanical Engineering.
* MBA or relevant management qualification will be an added advantage.

6. Experience Requirements

* 10–15 years of overall experience in Automobile After-Sales Operations.
* Minimum 8 years of experience in managerial roles such as Service Manager, Workshop Manager, Works Manager, Body Shop Manager or equivalent.
* **Mandatory:**
  Proven experience managing both Service Workshop and Body Shop operations.
* Strong exposure to 4-wheeler automobile dealership operations.
* Experience with Maruti Suzuki, Hyundai, Tata Motors, Mahindra, Kia, Toyota or other reputed passenger vehicle brands will be preferred.

7. Skills & Competencies

* End-to-End Service and Workshop Operations Management
* Body Shop, Paint Shop and Insurance Claim Management
* Business Development and Revenue Generation
* Workshop Productivity and Profitability Management
* Customer Relationship and Escalation Management
* Team Leadership and Manpower Development
* Financial Planning, Budgeting and MIS Analysis
* OEM Process and Quality Compliance
* Operational Planning and Process Improvement
* Strong Communication, Analytical and Decision-Making Skills

8. Preferred Candidate Profile

We are looking for a result-oriented automobile professional with strong leadership experience in managing both Service Workshop and Body Shop operations.

The ideal candidate should have the ability to drive revenue growth, improve workshop productivity, manage insurance operations, enhance customer satisfaction and lead large teams while maintaining high standards of operational efficiency, repair quality and profitability.

title: Senior Manager, Scientific and Operations Intelligence - Obesity
description:
Senior Manager, Scientific and Operations Intelligence
  
  
**Obesity Intelligence & Analytics | Amgen India**
**Reports to:**
Director, Scientific and Operations Intelligence
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
This is an India-based global role supporting Amgen's global obesity business. The Senior Manager will help shape the capability and translate its vision into high-quality intelligence work across scientific and operational priorities, including Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, R&D, Supply Chain, and Operations.
  
  
The Senior Manager will lead one or more priority initiatives from problem framing through recommendation, applying data, analytics, structured thinking, and practical judgment to help stakeholders understand implications, evaluate options, anticipate risks, and act with clarity.
  
  
Success requires the ability to navigate ambiguity, structure complex business questions, and translate them into high-quality analytical work through a combination of direct contribution, team leadership, and partner collaboration. Strong analytical judgment, scientific curiosity, business acumen, and stakeholder management are essential.
  
  
As the capability grows, the Senior Manager will help coach Managers, Senior Associates, Associates, and partner resources while raising the quality, speed, and usefulness of the team's analytical delivery.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead Priority Scientific and Operations Intelligence Initiatives
* Translate priorities into clear initiative plans, stakeholder alignment, and measurable deliverables.
* Own multiple strategic initiatives end-to-end, including analytical recommendations and decision support for prioritized strategic initiatives.
* Apply analytics and intelligence to scientific and operational priorities across Amgen's global obesity organization.
* Manage regular-cadence progress, stakeholder inputs, partner contributions, and issue escalation.
* Surface questions, execution issues, trade-offs, and implications early enough to influence the work and the choices in front of leaders.
* Ensure outputs are practical, timely, and useful rather than theoretical, overly academic, or status-reporting oriented.
* Scientific, Medical and Evidence Analytics
* Partner with Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, R&D, and evidence-generation stakeholders to apply structured problem solving to high-priority analytical needs and strategic priorities.
* Synthesize scientific, clinical, and medical information into clear recommendations that reflect the implications of emerging evidence, regulatory developments, competitive activity, and scientific innovation.
* Support understanding of evolving treatment paradigms, patient needs, evidence gaps, and scientific developments across obesity and related therapeutic areas.
* Review analytical outputs for accuracy, logic, clarity, and relevance to the stakeholder question being addressed.
* Supply Chain, Operations and Readiness Analytics
* Support analytical needs related to supply chain, manufacturing, operations, launch readiness, and organizational preparedness.
* Develop analytical assessments of demand signals, supply readiness, operational execution, and readiness milestones.
* Partner with Supply Chain and Operations leaders to support scenario planning, risk mitigation, and readiness assessments.
* Assess operational risks, supply constraints, timing considerations, and strategic dependencies early enough to influence planning, readiness, and execution.
* Translate operational complexity into practical implications that stakeholders can understand and act upon.
* Analytical Delivery and Initiative Leadership
* Structure ambiguous business questions, define the analytical approach, and guide work from initial problem framing through recommendation.
* Coordinate work across internal team members, external partners, vendors, and subject-matter experts to ensure high-quality delivery.
* Challenge assumptions, pressure-test analyses, and ensure conclusions are supported by evidence and sound logic.
* Synthesize diverse information into practical recommendations that help stakeholders evaluate options, understand trade-offs, and determine clear next steps.
* External Landscape and Emerging Opportunities
* Monitor scientific, competitive, regulatory, policy, healthcare-system, and market developments that may influence obesity strategy, execution, operations, or future opportunities.
* Assess how emerging trends, opportunities, and risks may influence scientific, medical, operational, and business priorities.
* Support stakeholders in evaluating potential response options.
* Establish practical approaches that improve awareness of important external developments without creating unnecessary reporting burden.
* Team Leadership, Coaching and Quality
* Coach Managers, Senior Associates, Associates, and partner resources as the team scales and the portfolio of work expands.
* Set clear expectations for analytical quality, structured problem solving, stakeholder communication, and delivery discipline.
* Create an environment that promotes intellectual curiosity, analytical rigor, accountability, and encourages the team to think beyond assigned deliverables toward the underlying business problem.
* Develop future leaders by strengthening judgment, communication, business acumen, and fostering an inclusive, collaborative, high-performing team culture.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Doctorate degree and 4+ years of relevant experience; OR
* Master's degree and 6+ years of relevant experience; OR
* Bachelor's degree and 8+ years of relevant experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced degree in Business, Strategy, Analytics, Public Health, Life Sciences, Medicine, Pharmacy, Engineering, Economics, or a related field.
* 8+ years of experience in strategy, business insights, analytics, consulting, business operations, Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, R&D strategy, supply chain strategy, or related functions within pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, healthcare, or life sciences.
* Experience leading complex analytical initiatives from problem framing through recommendation in a global, matrixed environment.
* Strong understanding of pharmaceutical development, healthcare ecosystems, scientific and medical strategy, supply and operational readiness, and business decision-making processes.
* Ability to work hands-on with data and analyses while also guiding internal team members, external partners, or vendors.
* Experience synthesizing large volumes of information into clear, actionable recommendations for senior stakeholders.
* Comfort reviewing analytical approaches, challenging methodology, identifying data quality issues, and improving the clarity of outputs.
* Experience with scientific, clinical, medical, supply, operations, external intelligence, or healthcare data sources is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to operate in ambiguity, influence stakeholders, and manage competing priorities without over-reliance on formal authority.
* Strong structured problem solving, executive communication, storytelling, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience coaching analysts, managers, consultants, or partner resources is preferred.
* Strong intellectual curiosity and passion for solving complex scientific, operational, and business problems.

description:

The ideal candidate will bring extensive experience in clinical research operations and the imaging Contract Research Organization (CRO) industry, along with strong expertise in CT, MRI, and/or PET imaging. This individual will drive departmental strategy, optimize imaging systems and workflows, strengthen team capabilities, and support the successful delivery of clinical imaging services throughout the clinical trial lifecycle.
  
  
**Requirements**
Key Responsibilities
  
  
  

* Contribute to the strategic direction of the Imaging Operations and CTIS departments, including defining annual goals, objectives, and growth initiatives
* Lead, mentor, and develop the CTIS team, fostering a collaborative, accountable, and high-performance work environment
* Drive the enhancement and optimization of imaging systems, including Medidata, PACS, OsiriX, and Clindex, while exploring opportunities to integrate AI into operational workflows in collaboration with AI leadership
* Review and improve departmental processes, procedures, training programs, support structures, and performance standards to strengthen efficiency and compliance

* Perform additional responsibilities as required to support departmental and organizational objectives

Education and Experience
  
  
  

* Master's degree or equivalent qualification, preferably in Business Administration, Healthcare Management, Life Sciences, or a related field
* Certification or qualification as a Radiology Technologist
* Demonstrated expertise in CT imaging, with experience in MRI and/or PET imaging
* Minimum of 8 years of experience in clinical research operations, including leadership responsibilities
* Minimum of 6 years of experience in the imaging CRO industry

Must-Have Skills
  
  
  

* Radiology Technology
* CT Imaging
* Oncology
* Clinical Research Operations
* Imaging Operations Management
* Team Leadership and Development
* Regulatory Compliance and Quality Management
* Clinical Trial Imaging Workflows

Good-to-Have Skills
  
  
  

* MRI Imaging
* PET Imaging
* Imaging Systems and PACS
* Medidata, OsiriX, and Clindex
* AI Integration in Clinical Workflows
* Clinical Trial Management Systems
* Image Transmission, Processing, and Analysis

Required Competencies
  
  
  

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
* Strong strategic and tactical thinking, with the ability to translate departmental objectives into operational outcomes
* Exceptional attention to detail and a consistent commitment to quality, accuracy, and procedural compliance
* Ability to understand complex clinical research protocols and operate effectively within a regulated clinical research environment
* Strong coaching, mentoring, and people-development capabilities
* Ability to manage projects and collaborate with diverse teams and stakeholders across departments and regions
* Service-oriented, flexible, and proactive approach to addressing internal and client requirements
* Excellent prioritization, multitasking, time management, and organizational skills

Team Values and Culture
  
  
The role requires a strong commitment to advancing patient care through medical imaging and supporting clinical research that improves the lives of patients, particularly those affected by cancer. The successful candidate will demonstrate integrity, accountability, intellectual curiosity, collaboration, and a consistent commitment to excellence.
  
  
They should be comfortable working within a dynamic global team, supporting colleagues, solving complex problems, meeting deadlines, and continuously improving operational practices. Quality, ethical conduct, teamwork, and patient-focused outcomes must remain central to all activities.

title: Telecaller Floor Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Anytime Diesel is India’s leading doorstep fuel delivery and fuel management company, transforming how businesses access and control their energy needs. Powered by advanced technology, including IoT-enabled systems, GPS tracking, geo-fencing, AI, and data-driven fuel intelligence, the company delivers safe, tamper-proof, and on-time diesel across India. Serving 10,000+ clients in sectors such as infrastructure, healthcare, retail, hospitality, and residential complexes, Anytime Diesel focuses on reducing downtime, preventing fuel theft, and improving transparency. Its solutions include smart fuel storage tanks, Diesel Cube systems, and Fuelistic IoT logistics technology, creating an integrated fuel management ecosystem built for safety, compliance, and operational control. Through the Fuel for Trees initiative, Anytime Diesel aligns fuel delivery with environmental responsibility, supporting sustainable progress.

**Role Description**
The Tele caller Floor Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in the Greater Hyderabad Area, responsible for leading and managing a team of tele callers to ensure high-quality customer interactions and efficient call operations. This role oversees daily calling activities, monitors performance metrics, and implements call scripts and guidelines to improve conversion rates and customer satisfaction. The Tele caller Floor Manager coordinates call schedules, assigns targets, and provides regular coaching, feedback, and training to team members. The role also involves handling escalations, collaborating with sales and operations teams to align communication with business goals, and generating reports on call outcomes, lead status, and team productivity. The Tele caller Floor Manager maintains discipline on the floor, ensures adherence to company policies, and supports a positive, goal-oriented work environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Team Management & Floor Operations

● Lead, supervise, and motivate the telecalling team to achieve daily, weekly, and

monthly targets.

● Allocate leads, customer follow-ups, and calling activities among team members.

● Monitor attendance, punctuality, login hours, break schedules, and overall floor

discipline.

● Conduct daily team briefings, performance reviews, and regular feedback sessions.

● Support team members in handling difficult customer conversations and achieving

performance targets.

● Identify training needs and improve individual and team productivity.

2. Call Monitoring & Performance Management

● Monitor call quality, call recordings, customer interactions, and follow-up discipline.

● Track key performance indicators such as daily calls, connected calls, qualified leads,

conversions, and follow-up completion.

● Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly performance reports for management.

● Maintain team dashboards, calling reports, lead trackers, and customer databases.

● Identify performance gaps and implement corrective actions to improve results.

● Ensure adherence to calling scripts, communication standards, and company

processes.

3. Customer Engagement & Lead Management

● Ensure timely follow-ups with prospective and existing customers.

● Guide the team in explaining Anytime Diesel’s services, fuel delivery process, pricing,

and business benefits.

● Improve lead qualification, customer activation, repeat business, and customer

retention.

● Handle customer complaints, escalations, and service-related queries professionally.

● Ensure accurate recording of customer requirements, call outcomes, and follow-up

commitments in the CRM or designated tracker.

● Coordinate with the sales team to convert qualified leads into business opportunities.

4. Sales & Business Coordination

● Drive team targets related to lead generation, customer onboarding, service adoption,

and business conversion, as applicable.

● Coordinate with Sales and Operations teams to address customer requirements and

delivery-related concerns.

● Follow up on inactive customers, pending enquiries, and potential repeat orders.

● Identify opportunities to improve customer engagement and increase business

through structured calling campaigns.

● Ensure that customer commitments are communicated accurately and aligned with

operational feasibility.

5. Process Improvement & Reporting

● Develop and standardize calling processes, scripts, escalation matrices, and follow-up

procedures.

● Analyse calling data to identify bottlenecks and recommend process improvements.

● Maintain accurate records of team performance, lead status, customer feedback, and

escalations.

● Share daily performance updates and periodic MIS reports with the reporting manager.

● Ensure compliance with company policies, customer data confidentiality, and

professional communication standards.

Required Skills & Competencies

● Strong team leadership and floor management skills.

● Excellent verbal communication and interpersonal skills.

● Ability to manage targets, productivity, and performance metrics.

● Strong customer handling, objection handling, and escalation management skills.

● Proficiency in MS Excel or Google Sheets, CRM tools, and reporting dashboards.

● Good analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.

● Strong follow-up discipline, time management, and organizational skills.

● Ability to work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.

Eligibility Criteria

● Minimum 5+ years of overall experience in tele calling, tele sales, customer support, or

call center operations.

● At least 2+ years of team-handling or floor-supervision experience preferred.

● Experience managing a team of tele callers in a target-driven environment.

● Prior experience in B2B tele calling, lead generation, customer onboarding, logistics,

fuel, mobility, or service operations will be an advantage.

● Graduate in any discipline preferred.

● Immediate joiners or candidates with a short notice period may be preferred,

depending on business requirements.

Why Join Anytime Diesel?

● Opportunity to work with a growing, technology-enabled fuel delivery business.

● Exposure to B2B customer engagement and business operations.

● Opportunity to lead a team and contribute directly to business growth.

● Dynamic work environment with scope for professional development.
