title: Vice President
description:
**Team Leader - Reinsurance Operations (Facultative & Treaty)**

**Role Purpose**

The Team Leader - Reinsurance Operations (Facultative & Treaty) is responsible for managing end-to-end operational activities related to Facultative and Treaty reinsurance operations. The role ensures operational excellence, regulatory compliance, process efficiency, and effective coordination among both Fac and Treaty divisions. The incumbent will lead a team of operations professionals, oversee transaction processing, ensure adherence to service standards and timelines, and drive process improvements to support business growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Reinsurance Operations Management**

* Lead and oversee day-to-day operations relating to Facultative and Treaty reinsurance business.
* Establish and maintain operational controls to ensure accuracy and efficiency.
* Monitor operational deliverables and service-level agreements (SLAs) to ensure timely execution.
* This role will also involve creation of reports, formats as per global reporting requirements by coordinating with international colleagues.

**Facultative Reinsurance Operations**

* Oversee processing and administration of facultative placements across various lines of business.
* Coordinate placement documentation between insurers, brokers, and reinsurers.
* Ensure issuance and maintenance of placement slips, cover notes, confirmations, and contractual records.
* Monitor facultative premium bookings, collections, settlements, and outstanding balances.
* Support claims administration and facilitate communication among stakeholders for facultative claims.

**Treaty Reinsurance Operations**

* Supervise treaty administration activities including proportional and non-proportional treaty arrangements.
* Ensure accurate treaty setup, maintenance, and validation within operational systems.
* Review treaty statements, premium bordereaux, commission calculations, and settlement records.
* Manage treaty accounting and reconciliation activities with clients and reinsurers.
* Coordinate treaty renewal activities and ensure timely execution of operational requirements.

**Technical Accounting and Financial Administration**

* Oversee premium processing, collections, remittances, and settlement activities.
* Ensure accurate preparation and reconciliation of accounts, statements, reports.
* Monitor outstanding receivables and payables and coordinate collection activities.
* Collaborate with finance teams to ensure timely closing and reporting.

**Contract Administration and Documentation**

* Ensure accurate maintenance and filing of treaty and facultative agreements.
* Monitor completeness and quality of contractual documentation.
* Manage document management systems and operational records.
* Ensure compliance with contractual obligations, regulatory requirements, and internal policies.
* Maintain audit-ready documentation and records.

**Process Improvement and Operational Excellence**

* Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, productivity, and service quality.
* Implement process standardization and best practices across operations.
* Drive automation and digital transformation initiatives where applicable.
* Develop and monitor operational KPIs, dashboards, and management reports.
* Participate in business process reviews and operational enhancement projects.

**Risk, Compliance and Governance**

* Ensure adherence to regulatory requirements, company policies, and operational procedures.
* Implement appropriate controls to mitigate operational and financial risks.
* Support internal audits, compliance reviews, and risk assessments.
* Monitor and report operational incidents and process exceptions.
* Promote a culture of accountability, governance, and control.

**Team Leadership and People Management**

* Lead, motivate, and develop the Reinsurance Operations team.
* Allocate workloads and ensure optimal utilization of resources.
* Conduct performance reviews and provide coaching and mentoring.
* Identify training needs and support capability development.
* Foster a collaborative, customer-focused, and high-performance culture.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Accuracy and timeliness of facultative and treaty transactions.
* Achievement of operational service-level agreements (SLAs).
* Premium and claims settlement turnaround times.
* Reconciliation and accounting accuracy.
* Client and reinsurer satisfaction levels.
* Outstanding receivables and settlement performance.
* Process efficiency and productivity improvements.
* Audit and compliance outcomes.
* Team engagement and performance metrics.

**Desired Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in insurance, Commerce, Finance, Business Administration, or related discipline.
* Professional qualifications such as AIII, ACII, CPCU, or equivalent will be preferred.

**Experience Required**

* 8-12 years of experience in Reinsurance Operations, Technical Accounting, Reinsurance Broking Operations, or Insurance Operations.
* Strong experience of handling both Facultative and Treaty reinsurance operations.
* Experience managing premium processing, treaty administration, claims handling, and reconciliation activities.
* Prior team leadership or supervisory experience preferred.

title: Inventory Manager
description:
**INVENTORY MANAGER**

**The Opportunity**

Aliens Tattoo is one of India's leading premium tattoo brands, with a ₹45 Cr business and a clear line of sight to ₹500 Cr by 2030. With an expanding network of studios, India's largest tattoo school and a growing home-service business, maintaining efficient inventory management is critical to our growth.

As we scale towards 100 locations across India and select international markets, we are looking for an Inventory Manager who can build and lead a structured, technology-driven inventory function. This role will be responsible for ensuring that the right materials, equipment, consumables and assets are available at the right location, in the right quantity and at the right time. The objective is to establish complete inventory visibility, minimise wastage, improve stock accuracy and ensure uninterrupted operational support across the organisation.

**The Mandate**

You will own end-to-end inventory management across the organisation, covering the central warehouse, studios, departments, tattoo school and new studio launches. You will establish standardised inventory processes, manage stock planning and replenishment, oversee warehouse operations, ensure accurate stock movement and maintain complete records of company-owned inventory and assets.

You will lead the central warehouse through a Warehouse Executive reporting to you and work closely with Procurement, Finance, Studio Operations and other functional heads to ensure inventory accountability and availability across all locations.

**What You'll Be Doing**

**Inventory Planning & Management**

You will develop and implement inventory plans based on consumption patterns, business requirements and projected demand across all locations. You will establish and maintain minimum, maximum and safety stock levels for different inventory categories, ensuring timely replenishment across studios and departments. You will monitor stock ageing, slow-moving inventory, dead stock, expiry dates and excess inventory while establishing standard inventory norms for different studio formats and operational requirements. You will also ensure that inventory records accurately reflect stock quantities, values, categories and location-wise availability.

**Warehouse & Central Store Management**

You will manage the day-to-day operations of the central warehouse, including inward stock, storage, picking, packing and dispatch. You will ensure that all incoming materials are physically verified against purchase orders and delivery documents, with accurate maintenance of Goods Receipt Notes (GRN), inward and outward registers and stock movement documentation. You will implement FIFO/FEFO practices wherever applicable and ensure appropriate storage, handling, labelling and identification of inventory. Maintaining warehouse discipline, stock accuracy and material accountability will be a key responsibility.

**Multi-Location Inventory Management**

You will monitor inventory availability across all operational studios and ensure uninterrupted supply of essential materials and consumables. You will establish standard inventory requirements for each studio based on its size, format and consumption patterns, while coordinating stock transfers and replenishment between locations. You will conduct periodic inventory audits across studios, investigate discrepancies and ensure that all studio teams follow standard inventory reporting and stock management procedures. You will proactively identify recurring stock shortages, excess consumption and inventory losses and implement corrective measures to improve overall inventory efficiency.

**New Studio & Expansion Inventory Planning**

You will be responsible for planning inventory and equipment requirements for approximately 20 new studio openings annually. You will ensure that all essential materials, equipment, furniture and operational supplies are available before each studio launch. You will develop and maintain standard inventory and asset checklists for different studio formats, coordinate inventory allocation and movement for new locations and ensure that inventory readiness is aligned with the company's expansion calendar.

**Inventory Audits, Controls & Reporting**

You will conduct monthly physical stock verification and reconcile inventory against system records to maintain high levels of inventory accuracy. You will ensure complete documentation of stock receipts, issues, transfers, adjustments and returns while tracking inventory losses, damages, shortages and excess stock. You will prepare monthly dashboards covering inventory value, stock ageing, consumption, stock-outs and replenishment trends. You will continuously identify opportunities to optimise inventory holding costs and reduce wastage. You will also maintain a centralised asset register covering purchase details, allocation, location, condition and warranty information, ensuring that all inventory and asset records remain accurate and audit-ready.

**Systems, Process & Team Management**

You will implement and maintain inventory management systems and standard operating procedures to establish consistency across all locations. You will drive inventory digitisation and real-time stock visibility, ensuring clear accountability for stock handling and reporting at studio and warehouse levels. You will lead, train and develop the Warehouse Executive while coordinating with Procurement and Finance to align purchasing requirements with actual inventory needs. You will continuously identify opportunities to improve inventory processes, strengthen controls and build a scalable inventory management function that supports the organisation's expansion.

**What We're Looking For**

You should hold a graduate degree, preferably in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Commerce, Operations or Materials Management, with 6–10 years of relevant experience in inventory management, warehouse operations or supply chain management. At least two years of experience independently managing inventory across a multi-location business is expected.

You should have proven experience managing central warehouses and distributed inventory operations, along with a strong understanding of inventory planning, stock reconciliation, FIFO/FEFO, GRN, stock audits and warehouse processes. Experience working with ERP or inventory management systems and reporting dashboards is essential. You should possess strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with the capability to identify inventory inefficiencies, reduce stock losses and establish effective inventory controls.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable establishing processes, maintaining accurate records and driving operational discipline across multiple locations. Strong coordination, communication and team management skills are essential, along with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.

title: Store In-Charge - Setup & Inventory Management
description:
**Store In-Charge :**
Supply Chain & Inventory | Manastu Space

**Experience: 5+ Years**

**About Manastu Space**

Manastu Space is a leading Indian space-tech company specialising in green propulsion systems. Founded by IIT Bombay alumni, we develop full-stack manoeuvrability solutions for modern satellite missions and launch vehicles.

Our hydrogen-peroxide-based green propulsion technology aims to make space operations safer, more sustainable and cost-efficient.

Join us as we build technologies at the intersection of advanced engineering, applied research and space safety.

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced
**Store In-Charge**
who can establish and independently manage our store and inventory function from the ground up.

This is not just a routine storekeeping or inventory management position. The person will be responsible for building the complete store management system, introducing standard operating procedures (SOPs), establishing inventory controls, implementing material traceability and ensuring audit readiness.

Currently, material management is handled as an additional responsibility within the Purchase function. We need someone who can take ownership, create structured processes and establish a disciplined, systematic store operation.

**Your primary responsibility will be to BUILD the store function first and then RUN it efficiently.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Store Setup, SOPs & Process Development**

* Assess existing material storage, movement and documentation practices.
* Establish store management procedures covering material receipt, inspection, storage, issue, returns, rejection and stock reconciliation.
* Implement material coding, rack/bin identification, labelling and location-wise inventory management.
* Introduce and sustain 5S practices across the store.

**2. Material Receiving & Incoming Inspection**

* Manage incoming materials against purchase orders and specifications.
* Implement Goods Receipt Notes (GRN) and ensure proper inspection and documentation before accepting materials into stock.
* Coordinate with Procurement and technical teams for discrepancies, rejected materials and pending inspection approvals.
* Ensure materials are released only after the required clearance.

**3. Inventory & Stock Management**

* Maintain accurate stock registers, material records and inventory reports.
* Conduct physical stock verification and periodic cycle counting.
* Monitor minimum/maximum stock levels, reorder points, safety stock and material consumption.
* Identify expired, excess, dead and slow-moving inventory.

**4. Material Traceability & Storage Compliance**

* Maintain batch, lot, heat number and serial number traceability wherever applicable.
* Ensure supplier test certificates and supporting documentation are available for traceability.
* Manage storage conditions for chemicals, ESD-sensitive components and other controlled materials.
* Implement shelf-life monitoring and First Expiry First Out (FEFO) practices.

**5. Asset & Scrap Management**

* Maintain asset tagging, physical verification and asset registers.
* Track AMC, warranty and maintenance-related records.
* Manage rejected, non-conforming, expired and scrap materials with appropriate segregation and disposal documentation.

**6. ERP, MIS & Audit Management**

* Manage inventory transactions and material records through ERP/inventory systems.
* Prepare monthly stock, shortage, ageing and discrepancy reports.
* Define material and inventory process requirements for the planned ERP implementation.
* Maintain audit-ready documentation for internal, statutory and customer audits.

**Essential Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Materials Management or Supply Chain. Diploma holders may be considered based on substantial relevant experience.
* Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience managing stores/inventory in pharmaceutical, chemical, defence, aerospace or precision manufacturing environments.
* **Must have experience setting up a store, inventory system or incoming inspection process from scratch.**
* Practical experience with GRN, incoming inspection, stock reconciliation and inventory control.
* Knowledge of batch/lot/serial traceability and supplier test certificates.
* Experience handling chemicals, hazardous or controlled materials, including storage, segregation and disposal documentation.
* Working knowledge of inventory planning, reorder levels, MOQ, minimum-maximum levels and safety stock.
* Experience with ERP/inventory systems, Tally and advanced Excel.
* Ability to independently develop SOPs, registers and store management processes.

Good to Have

* Exposure to AS9100, ISO 9001 or equivalent quality management systems.
* Knowledge of hazardous waste management, disposal manifests and e-waste processes.

**What Success Looks Like**

In your first three months, you will be expected to assess existing inventory, complete physical stock verification, establish store documentation, implement material identification and introduce structured receiving and issuing processes.

Over the first year, you will build a fully functional, traceable, controlled and audit-ready store management system.

**Location & Benefits**

📍 Pawane MIDC, Navi Mumbai (on-site). The Narivali test site is also covered through the Pawane store.

* Employee Medical Insurance
* Group Personal Accident Cover
* Provident Fund & Gratuity
* Annual, Planned & Sick Leave
* Maternity & Paternity Leave
* Two Work-from-Home Days per Month

title: Client Service Manager – Equity
description:
About Fintoo

Fintoo is a SEBI-registered Investment Adviser and a fee-based financial planning firm offering holistic financial planning, investment advisory, global investing and tax advisory services. Our philosophy is simple: planning comes before execution, and client interests come first. We combine professional advice with technology to help individuals make informed financial decisions and work towards their life goals.

Role Overview

We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Operations & Client Relationship Manager to support our equity team. This is a hybrid role that sits between the investment team, the client facing team, and our Ultra High Net Worth (UHNI) clients. You will own the clarity and accuracy of portfolio communication, keep backend equity operations running smoothly, and make sure client queries are resolved quickly and credibly. The ideal candidate is genuinely curious about equity markets, comfortable with numbers, and polished enough to engage with sophisticated, high-expectation clients.

Key Responsibilities

1. UHNI Client Communication & Relationship Management

• Act as a point of contact for UHNI clients on portfolio performance, holdings, and market developments

• Communicate performance updates clearly, including returns, attribution, benchmark comparison, and drivers of gains or drawdowns

• Convey action items from the investment team (rebalancing, entry/exit levels, corporate actions, rights/buyback/open offer decisions) and follow up to ensure timely client response

• Prepare talking points and briefing notes ahead of client calls and review meetings

• Maintain a record of all client interactions, preferences, mandates, and risk profiles in the CRM

• Handle sensitive client matters with discretion and professionalism

2. Backend Operations & SOP Management

• Execute and monitor day-to-day equity operations in line with documented SOPs

• Coordinate trade instructions, order execution confirmations, settlement, and reconciliation with brokers, custodians, and the back office

• Ensure client portfolios match mandates, investment guidelines, and compliance limits

• Track and process corporate actions (dividends, splits, bonuses, rights issues, mergers)

• Review, update, and improve SOPs; flag process gaps and propose efficiency improvements

• Support audit, compliance, and regulatory documentation requirements (KYC, risk profiling, suitability records)

3. Platform Integration & Systems Support

• Support integration and day-to-day use of portfolio management, order management, CRM, and reporting platforms

• Ensure data flows accurately between trading platforms, custodians, and internal systems

• Perform periodic data reconciliation (holdings, cash, prices, transactions) and escalate discrepancies

• Coordinate with IT/vendors on platform issues, upgrades, and testing (UAT)

• Document workflows and maintain user guides for internal teams

4. Portfolio Performance Reporting

• Prepare periodic (monthly/quarterly) and ad hoc portfolio performance reports for UHNI clients

• Include holdings, allocation, sector/market-cap exposure, realized and unrealized P&L, XIRR/TWRR, and benchmark comparison

• Add concise commentary on market conditions, portfolio positioning, and outlook, in consultation with the research team

• Ensure all reports are accurate, consistently formatted, and delivered on schedule

• Build and maintain dashboards and templates to improve reporting speed and quality

5. Internal Coordination with Client-Facing Teams

• Serve as the equity subject-matter contact for relationship managers and wealth advisors

• Respond to equity-related queries on stocks, portfolio positioning, research views, and market events

• Translate research and portfolio manager views into clear, client-ready language

• Maintain an internal FAQ/knowledge base of common client queries and approved responses

• Escalate complex or high-impact queries to the investment team promptly

6. Research & Market Support

• Track market news, earnings, sector trends, and regulatory changes relevant to client holdings

• Assist the research team with data compilation, earnings summaries, and model updates as needed

• Circulate daily or weekly market and portfolio-relevant updates to internal teams

7. Compliance & Risk Hygiene

• Ensure all client communication complies with regulatory and internal guidelines (including disclosures and record-keeping)

• Maintain confidentiality of client and portfolio data • Flag potential conflicts, errors, or compliance concerns immediately

Qualifications & Experience

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Commerce, Economics, Business, or a related field. NISM certification (X-A and XB) are a plus

• Experience in equity operations, portfolio servicing, client relationship management, or research support in an asset/wealth management or broking environment

• Working knowledge of equity markets, corporate actions, and portfolio performance measures (XIRR, TWRR)

• Strong Excel skills; familiarity with portfolio management, OMS, and CRM platforms

• Excellent written and verbal communication; able to explain performance and market views clearly to senior clients

• High attention to detail, ownership mindset, and strong discretion with confidential information

title: Senior Manager - Demand Planning, S& OP and Inventory Management
description:
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Senior Manager to own demand planning, S& OP and inventory management for
  
  
our portfolio of 7+ private beauty and personal care brands.
  
  
The business operates across eight channels — our own platform, general trade, modern trade, EBOs,
  
  
marketplaces, quick commerce and D2C
  
  
This is an ownership role. You will run forecasting and S&OP end to end, own network inventory health,
  
  
and build the planning system that lets the business grow without adding planners. It will suit someone
  
  
who has built a planning process from a weak base, not only operated a mature one.
  
  
What you will do
  
  
Demand planning. Own the forecast at SKU, brand, channel and warehouse level. Build forecasting logic
  
  
that reflects how different brands actually behave — high-SKU seasonal makeup does not plan like
  
  
steady-demand hygiene. Run weekly demand sensing, track bias by channel, and complete the shift
  
  
from primary-sales to secondary-sales-based planning.
  
  
S&OP.
  
  
Run the monthly cycle end to end — demand consolidation, supply reconciliation, gap resolution
  
  
and executive review. Chair brand-level reviews with sales, brand and supply stakeholders, bringing
  
  
genuine challenge to the numbers rather than collating them. Own the constrained plan and its sign-off.
  
  
Inventory management. Own network inventory health and DOH at warehouse, brand and SKU level.
  
  
Set coverage norms and safety-stock logic rather than managing by exception. Reduce inventory without
  
  
trading away fill rate. Own liquidation and expiry control for a shelf-life-constrained portfolio.
  
  
Supply coordination. Convert the demand plan into a rolling procurement plan with manufacturing
  
  
partners — PO coverage, lead times, MOQ and capacity constraints — and manage supply risk with
  
  
named mitigations.
  
  
Systems and automation. Move recurring planning reporting onto automated pipelines with the
  
  
analytics team, and shape the forecasting toolset so planners spend their time on judgment rather than
  
  
assembly.
  
  
Team. Lead and develop team, and build a function that runs reliably whoever is in the room.
  
  
What we are looking for
  
  

* 4-7 years in supply chain, with at least 2 years owning demand planning or S& OP as the

accountable person
  
  

* Multi-brand, multi-channel CPG, FMCG or beauty experience; beauty or personal care an

advantage
  
  

* Has planned across both offline distribution and e-commerce, not one or the other
* Has chaired S&OP with senior stakeholders and driven real decisions through it
* Strong grounding in statistical forecasting and inventory theory, with the judgment to know

when to override the model
  
  

* Strong Excel, SQL and Power BI or equivalent; exposure to a planning tool such as o9, Kinaxis,

Blue Yonder or Anaplan is plus
  
  

* MBA or equivalent preferred

The traits that matter most here: the instinct to build systems rather than carry a function personally,
  
  
the willingness to hold a position with commercial stakeholders when the forecast disagrees with them,
  
  
and comfort operating at speed in a business where process maturity is being built while the business
  
  
grows exponentially
  
  
**About Company**
Founded in 2011, Purplle has emerged as one of India’s premier omnichannel beauty destinations, redefining the way millions shop for beauty. With 1,000+ brands, 60,000+ products, and over 7 million monthly active users, Purplle has built a powerhouse platform that seamlessly blends online and offline experiences.
  
  
Expanding its footprint in 2022, Purplle introduced 6,000+ offline touchpoints and launched 100+ stores, strengthening its presence beyond digital. Beyond hosting third-party brands, Purplle has successfully scaled its own D2C powerhouses—FACES CANADA, Good Vibes, Carmesi, Purplle, and NY Bae—offering trend-driven, high-quality beauty essentials.
  
  
What sets Purplle apart is its technology driven hyper-personalized shopping experience. By curating detailed user personas, enabling virtual makeup trials, and delivering tailored product recommendations based on personality, search intent, and purchase behavior, Purplle ensures a unique, customer-first approach.
  
  
In 2022, Purplle achieved unicorn status, becoming India’s 102nd unicorn, backed by an esteemed group of investors including ADIA, Kedaara, Premji Invest, Sequoia Capital India, JSW Ventures, Goldman Sachs, Verlinvest, Blume Ventures, and Paramark Ventures.
  
  
With a 3,000+ strong team and an unstoppable vision, Purplle is set to lead the charge in India’s booming beauty landscape, revolutionizing the way the nation experiences beauty.

description:

PDG empowers individuals in every role to grow, lead, and leave a lasting impact.

Join us to build the digital future of Asia Pacific.

For more information, visit
**www.princetondg.com**
or follow us on
**LinkedIn**
.

**We Are Looking For**

Lead SME Electrical & Transition is responsible for ensuring 100% availability, reliability, compliance, and safe operation of all electrical infrastructure within the data center. The role leads transition from Projects to Operations and governs lifecycle management of critical power systems.

**Main Duties and Responsibilities**

* Manage Electrical Infrastructure: Oversee MV, HV, LV systems including Transformers, DG Sets, UPS, STS, PDUs, Busducts, Panels, and Protection Relays ensuring resiliency is intact.
* Lead Transition & Commissioning: Ensuring operations representation in Testing & Commissioning (T&C) during project life cycle. Validate SLDs, load lists, relay settings, and system redundancy prior to Go-Live. Sharing feedback to engineering team on various operations challenges.
* Develop SOP / MOP / EOP: Create and validate all operational documentation aligned with data center design and reliability standards. Define sequence of operations in line with customer requirement and design aspects.
* Reliability & RCA: Lead Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for electrical incidents. Implement preventive and corrective action plans and conduct FMEA where required. Derive MTTR/MTBF
* Service Planning: Develop maintenance strategy, service cycles, and asset lifecycle plans for critical electrical equipment.
* Compliance & Audits: Ensure adherence to CEIG, NBC, Electricity Rules, and ISO standards (20000, 27001, 22301, 45001, 50001). Support external and internal audits.
* Client & Stakeholder Management: Represent organization in technical discussions, resolve technical queries (TQs), NCRs, and manage OEM coordination.
* Team Leadership: Recruit, mentor, and technically guide electrical O&M teams.
* Budget & Vendor Oversight: Review BOQs, technical specifications, and ensure minimal variation during execution.
* Safety Governance: Ensure strict compliance with LOTO procedures, electrical work permits, and high-voltage safety standards.
* Availability: Provide technical leadership during critical outages and major incident command situations.
* Ensuring handover of documentation by both project team and OEM/SI/vendor completed post IST.
* People management: Support in team recruitment and training ground team on design, technical and process parameters.

**Process:**

* Lead Incident, Change, and Problem Management processes for electrical domain.
* Ensure transition documentation and as-built drawings are validated.
* Review ETAP studies (Load Flow, Short Circuit, Arc Flash, Harmonics).
* Ensure redundancy validation and load balancing logic.

**Safety:**

* Ensure adherence to electrical safety standards and high-voltage protocols.
* Conduct periodic safety audits for panels, breakers, and DG areas.
* Ensure strict compliance with permit-to-work systems.
* Monitor risks related to arc flash, fault levels, and switching operations.

**Other Requirements**

* Travel within the country would be required on need basis to drive projects / operations.
* The nature of profile may require long hours beyond mandated office hours.
* May require working on some weekends and public holidays

**Minimum Qualification**

* B.E./B.Tech/M Tech in Electrical Engineering

**Minimum Years of Experience**

* 15 to 20 years overall along with 7-8 years in core electrical, 7-8 years in data center and 7-8 years as team lead

**Soft/ Behavioural Skills**

* Strong decision-making under pressure
* Leadership & mentoring capability
* Client-facing confidence
* Leading team of transition management from different domain line HVAC, BMS

**Technical Skills**

* Lead resolution of critical electrical failures including black building events, UPS transfers, DG synchronization issues, breaker trips, and relay mal operations with detailed RCA.
* Strong understanding of HV/MV/LV power distribution, redundancy architecture, and failover sequencing in mission-critical environments.
* Expertise in protection coordination, fault level analysis, arc flash studies, and relay setting validation (ETAP or equivalent tools).
* Deep technical knowledge of Transformers, DG systems (AMF & Sync), UPS, STS, PDUs, Busducts, and switchgear panels.
* Proficient in load balancing, redundancy validation, commissioning tests, IR testing, thermography, and breaker injection testing
* Develop and maintain technical documentation including SLDs, load lists, relay settings, switching procedures, and SOP/MOP/EOP

title: Head Sourcing Non-IT India
description:
**At Chain IQ, your ideas move fast.**
Chain IQ is a global AI-driven Procurement Service Partner, headquartered in Baar, Switzerland, with operations across main centers and 16 offices worldwide. We provide tailored, end-to-end procurement solutions that enable transformation, drive scalability, and deliver substantial reductions in our clients' indirect spend. Our culture is built on innovation, entrepreneurship, ownership, and impact. Here, your voice matters - bold thinking is encouraged, and action follows ambition.
  
  
**At Chain IQ, your ideas move fast.**
Chain IQ is a global AI-driven Procurement Service Partner, headquartered in Baar, Switzerland, with operations across major global centres and 16 offices worldwide. We provide tailored, end-to-end procurement solutions that enable transformation, improve scalability, and deliver meaningful reductions in our clients’ indirect spend.
  
  
Our culture is built on innovation, entrepreneurship, ownership, and impact. Here, your voice matters. Bold thinking is encouraged, and action follows ambition.
  
  
**A leadership role where you can make a visible impact**
Are you an experienced sourcing leader who enjoys being close to the client, solving operational challenges, and helping teams perform at their best?
  
  
We are looking for a
**Head Sourcing for India**
to serve as the client’s
**single operational point of contact**
for sourcing delivery across the country.
  
  
The client is a major real estate owner and operator with an extensive portfolio of commercial properties across India. This creates an exciting and varied sourcing environment covering construction, refurbishment, fit-out, engineering, facilities management, property operations, and related corporate services. These service categories are included within the client’s procurement scope.
  
  
This is more than a traditional team-management position. You will have the opportunity to shape how sourcing services are delivered across India, strengthen engagement with client stakeholders, and build a joined-up delivery model across Pune, Mumbai, Bangalore, and other key locations.
  
  
You will act as the central link between the client, sourcing teams, procurement operations, category specialists, and Chain IQ leadership. You will bring clarity to priorities, remove delivery obstacles, and ensure that the team consistently delivers high-quality and commercially strong outcomes.
  
  
**Why this role matters**
**In This Position, You Will**

* Be the primary operational sourcing contact for a major real estate client in India.
* Lead and coordinate sourcing delivery across multiple cities and stakeholder groups.
* Gain broad exposure to construction, facilities management, engineering, property operations, and corporate services.
* Shape the operating rhythm, governance, and service standards for the India account.
* Coach and develop a diverse team of sourcing professionals.
* Lead complex and high-value sourcing initiatives directly when required.
* Work with regional and global stakeholders in an international procurement environment.
* Drive tangible improvements in service quality, client satisfaction, process discipline, savings, and operational efficiency.

**Role Purpose**
The Head Sourcing role will have overall operational responsibility for sourcing delivery in India and will act as the principal point of coordination for the client.
  
  
You will oversee the sourcing pipeline, establish clear priorities, allocate work across the team, and ensure that projects progress in accordance with agreed timelines and service standards. You will also provide hands-on sourcing and commercial support for complex or sensitive requirements.
  
  
A key feature of the role will be translating client priorities into clear actions for the delivery team. You will work closely with stakeholders across the client’s commercial property portfolio to understand requirements, provide sourcing guidance, manage escalations, and maintain confidence in the service.
  
  
As the team’s senior operational leader, you will create an environment of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement while ensuring that resources are deployed flexibly across locations and categories.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Client and Stakeholder Leadership**

* Act as the client’s single operational point of contact for sourcing delivery across India.
* Build trusted relationships with client procurement, business, property, construction, facilities, and corporate-services stakeholders.
* Establish a regular engagement rhythm covering sourcing priorities, pipeline progress, risks, escalations, and upcoming demand.
* Translate client requirements into clear sourcing plans, deliverables, ownership, and timelines.
* Manage operational issues proactively and coordinate timely resolution across the relevant teams.
* Provide clear and concise updates to client and Chain IQ leadership.
* Represent Chain IQ professionally in client meetings, reviews, and governance forums.

**Sourcing and Commercial Delivery**

* Lead end-to-end sourcing initiatives ranging from routine renewals and quotation exercises to complex tenders and strategic projects.
* Develop fit-for-purpose sourcing strategies based on business requirements, market conditions, commercial risks, and project complexity.
* Manage RFIs, RFQs, RFPs, supplier evaluations, commercial clarifications, negotiations, and award recommendations.
* Structure commercially sound deals that balance cost, service quality, delivery risk, compliance, and operational requirements.
* Lead negotiations to achieve competitive pricing, improved commercial terms, and measurable client benefits.
* Support contract development using approved templates and work with legal or subject-matter experts where required.
* Ensure sourcing decisions are supported by appropriate analysis, documentation, and governance.

**Real Estate, Construction and Facilities Sourcing**

* Provide sourcing leadership across categories such as construction works, fit-out, engineering services, property management, integrated facilities management, cleaning, security, landscaping, maintenance, utilities, and other property-related services.
* Work with technical and operational stakeholders to define requirements and develop appropriate supplier evaluation criteria.
* Understand the practical considerations of sourcing services across active commercial properties.
* Support the evaluation of suppliers based on commercial competitiveness, technical capability, service coverage, compliance, capacity, and delivery risk.
* Maintain awareness of relevant India supplier markets, commercial models, cost drivers, and category developments.
* Identify opportunities to consolidate demand, standardise specifications, improve supplier coverage, and strengthen commercial leverage.

**Team Leadership and Operational Management**

* Lead, coach, and develop sourcing professionals supporting the India account.
* Set clear expectations for ownership, responsiveness, quality, and stakeholder communication.
* Allocate workload across Pune, Mumbai, Bangalore, and other locations according to demand, capability, and capacity.
* Monitor the sourcing pipeline, project status, ageing items, risks, dependencies, and delivery commitments.
* Provide hands-on guidance for complex tenders, negotiations, stakeholder challenges, and supplier issues.
* Conduct quality reviews of sourcing strategies, tender documents, evaluations, recommendations, and commercial outcomes.
* Promote collaboration across sourcing, procurement operations, category teams, and client-facing colleagues.
* Support recruitment, onboarding, knowledge transfer, and capability development.
* Create a team culture built on accountability, transparency, client focus, and continuous improvement.

**Governance and Continuous Improvement**

* Ensure that sourcing activities comply with client policies, delegated authority requirements, contractual commitments, and Chain IQ standards.
* Drive consistent use of approved sourcing tools, templates, processes, and reporting methods.
* Maintain accurate and current project information, including statuses, actions, risks, savings, and supporting documentation.
* Identify recurring delivery issues and implement practical corrective actions.
* Improve operational workflows, reporting quality, workload visibility, and stakeholder communication.
* Support the development of efficient and scalable sourcing practices across India.
* Identify opportunities to use digital procurement tools, eSourcing, automation, and data insights to improve delivery.

**What You Bring**

* A university degree or equivalent professional qualification. MCIPS or another relevant procurement qualification would be advantageous.
* Typically, 8 or more years of sourcing, procurement, category management, or commercial experience.
* Relevant experience in real estate, construction, engineering, facilities management, property operations, or related service categories.
* Previous experience leading a sourcing or procurement team in a client-facing environment.
* Demonstrated ability to act as a senior operational contact and build trusted relationships with demanding stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of end-to-end sourcing, competitive tendering, supplier evaluation, commercial negotiation, and contracting.
* Experience managing complex sourcing projects with multiple stakeholders, technical requirements, and tight deadlines.
* The confidence and credibility to influence senior stakeholders and constructively challenge unclear or changing requirements.
* A hands-on leadership style and willingness to become directly involved when projects require additional support.
* Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage a varied portfolio of sourcing initiatives simultaneously.
* Sound commercial judgement, analytical ability, and attention to detail.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience working across multiple Indian cities, business units, or property locations would be beneficial.

**The Leadership Style We Are Looking For**
You will be successful in this role if you are:
  
  

* Client-focused: You understand stakeholder needs and communicate with clarity and confidence.
* Accountable: You take ownership of outcomes and ensure commitments are followed through.
* Commercial: You recognise value beyond price and can structure balanced, sustainable deals.
* Pragmatic: You can simplify complexity and turn issues into practical actions.
* Collaborative: You bring together teams across cities, functions, and categories.
* Decisive: You can prioritise, address escalations, and maintain momentum.
* Development-oriented: You enjoy coaching people and building a stronger sourcing capability.
* Comfortable with change: You can lead in an evolving environment and help others navigate new ways of working.

**Join a truly global team**
We offer a dynamic and international environment where high performance meets real purpose. You will have the opportunity to lead an important client relationship, influence procurement delivery across a major India property portfolio, and develop a sourcing team with broad exposure to complex and business-critical categories.
  
  
If you are looking for a role where you can combine
**client leadership, team development, operational ownership, and hands-on sourcing**
, this is an opportunity to make a visible and lasting impact.
  
  
**Chain IQ – Create. Lead. Make an impact.**
**Join a truly global team.**
We offer a dynamic and international environment where high performance meets real purpose. We're proud to be Great Place to Work-certified and even prouder of the people who make that possible. Let’s shape the future of procurement - together.
  
  
**Chain IQ – Create. Lead. Make an impact.**

description:

Quality Control Manager

**Department**

Quality Assurance & Quality Control

Head of Operations / Director

Navi mumbai

**Role Objective**

To ensure that products manufactured by Anil Engineering comply with customer specifications, applicable quality standards, and regulatory requirements while driving continuous improvement initiatives to enhance product quality, reliability, and operational efficiency.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Quality Assurance**

- Establish, implement, and maintain quality control procedures and inspection plans.

- Ensure adherence to customer specifications, drawings, and applicable quality standards.

- Conduct incoming, in-process, stage-wise, and final inspections of products.

- Prepare and maintain inspection reports, quality records, and documentation.

- Ensure traceability and compliance with quality management systems.

**2. Process Improvement**

- Identify quality issues and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).

- Conduct root cause analysis using quality tools such as 5 Why, Fishbone Diagram, and Pareto Analysis.

- Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance product quality and process efficiency.

- Monitor quality performance indicators and reduce rejection, rework, and customer complaints.

- Participate in Kaizen and Lean Manufacturing initiatives.

**3. Customer and Vendor Quality**

- Handle customer complaints and ensure timely closure through corrective actions.

- Coordinate with vendors and suppliers to ensure incoming material quality.

- Conduct supplier quality evaluations and audits.

- Support customer inspections, third-party inspections, and quality audits.

- Ensure compliance with customer-specific requirements.

**4. Team Management**

- Lead and supervise QC inspectors and quality personnel.

- Develop and implement training programs on quality standards and inspection procedures.

- Promote a culture of quality awareness and continuous improvement.

- Ensure effective communication and coordination with production, stores, and engineering departments.

**5. Quality Management System**

- Ensure compliance with ISO 9001 and other applicable standards.

- Support internal and external audits and ensure closure of audit observations.

- Maintain quality manuals, procedures, and records as per organizational requirements.

- Participate in management review meetings and quality improvement initiatives.

title: Senior Manager – Events
description:
**About the Role**

At Straive, events are a vital driver for pipeline generation, brand positioning, and executive

engagement across North America, Europe, and India. While the Marketing Director owns overall

event strategy, portfolio prioritization, and final event selection, the Senior Manager – Events will

serve as the operational engine—owning end-to-end execution, pre-event commercial readiness,

workflow automation, financial governance, and delivery.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. End-to-End Event Execution & Process Automation (35%)**

● Deliver turnkey operations for conferences, executive roundtables, dinners, and trade shows

across North America, Europe, and India.

● Build and scale reusable SOPs, workback templates, risk logs, and operational dashboards to

eliminate manual coordination.

● Run weekly progress cadences with internal teams and external partners; proactively flag risks to

ensure on-time delivery.

● Manage all on-site and virtual event logistics: booth fabrication, AV/tech, signage, collateral

shipments, badge allocations, and meeting rooms.

● Partner with content and digital teams to ensure timely collateral delivery and execute pre-,

during-, and post-event social media amplification.

● Maintain a central repository of all event communications, meeting notes, contracts, and spend

history.

● Undertake domestic travel within India for on-site management as required.

**2. Vendor & Agency Management (20%)**

● Serve as primary operational liaison for international and domestic event organizers, booth

builders, and agencies.

● Ensure 100% fulfillment of contracted sponsorship deliverables (booth specs, signage, speaking

slots, lead retrieval apps).

● Partner with Procurement to negotiate competitive terms and identify cost savings across logistics

and production.

● Manage international agency workflows across US and European time zones with professional,

cross-cultural diplomacy.

**3. Stakeholder Coordination & Pre-Event Readiness (20%)**

● Drive pre-event commercial readiness so sales teams arrive with pre-scheduled, qualified

meetings and clear objectives.

● Partner with P&L heads and hunters (S&R, DAAiS, EdTech) to thoroughly vet attendee lists, target

accounts, and suggest high-fit events.

● Collaborate with SDR teams on target account mapping, pre-event outreach, and verified meeting

schedules.

● Enforce strict creative lead times with Project Management, Content, and Design teams to prevent

last-minute collateral rushes.

● Maintain and broadcast the consolidated global and domestic events master calendar.

**4. Budget, Procurement Management & Financial Discipline (15%)**

● Maintain tight budget governance: track approved budgets, committed spend, actuals, and

forecast variances across all events.

● Automate and drive smooth payment workflows to guarantee on-time disbursements for

organizers and vendors.

● Manage end-to-end procurement workflows with Legal and Finance (vendor onboarding, NDAs,

SOWs, PO generation).

● Maintain an organized audit trail of all contracts, POs, invoices, and payment receipts.

**5. Lead Management, SDR Follow-Up & Event ROI Tracking (10%)**

● Manage lead capture, ensure badge scan data hygiene, and enforce rapid lead upload into

HubSpot CRM.

● Drive post-event accountability: coordinate prompt handoffs to SDRs, monitor follow-up cadences,

and verify CRM data accuracy (sales/SDRs retain ownership of deal progression).

● Track and report monthly event impact: Cost per qualified meeting (CPQM), target-account

engagement, event-influenced MQLs/SQLs, and pipeline velocity.

● Lead structured post-event debriefs and consolidate commercial feedback into actionable ROI

summary decks.

**Candidate Profile & Requirements**

● Experience:
**6–7+**
years in B2B marketing, including 5+ years of dedicated, hands-on B2B

event management across global conferences, sponsorships, and agencies (preferably in

IT/BPS, tech, or professional services).

● Execution Rigor & Process Building: Proven track record of owning full operational delivery and

designing reusable workflows, templates, and dashboard systems.

● Commercial Alignment: Strong understanding of enterprise sales cycles; experienced in

partnering with SDRs and commercial teams on target-account vetting and pre-scheduled

meetings.

● Tools & Systems: Hands-on proficiency with HubSpot CRM and database/spreadsheet tools for

lead and pipeline tracking.

● Financial Discipline: Practical experience managing corporate procurement, SOW/PO lifecycles,

and budget variance reporting.

● Communication & Mobility: Clear executive communication across senior internal stakeholders

and international partners (US/EU time zones). Willing to travel domestically across India as

needed.

Job Description:
  
  
**Manager, Business Continuity**
Russell Investments is seeking an experienced
**Manager, Business Continuity**
to join the Global Risk Management (GRM) team.
  
  
The successful candidate will play a key role in identifying, assessing and mitigating business continuity and operational resilience risks across Russell Investments globally, while providing management oversight of the Mumbai Business Continuity team.
  
  
Reporting to the Senior Manager, Risk Program Management, this role will be responsible for strengthening the firm's business continuity framework, supporting operational resilience and ensuring alignment with applicable risk management standards and regulatory expectations.
  
  
**Years Of Experience**

* 5–7 years of progressively responsible experience in Business Continuity, Operational Risk, Operational Resilience, Disaster Recovery or related disciplines, preferably within an investment management firm, investment consulting firm or bank.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field; professional certifications such as CBCP, MBCI, ISO 22301, CISA or similar are preferred.
* Strong knowledge of industry standards and frameworks, including ISO 22301, FFIEC guidance, NIST and operational resilience frameworks.
* Strong stakeholder management, facilitation, project management and executive communication skills.
* Experience working with GRC tools such as MetricStream, ServiceNow or Archer.

**Responsibilities**
**Business Continuity Program Management**

* Lead the design, implementation, maintenance and continuous improvement of the enterprise Business Continuity Management (BCM) programme.
* Develop and maintain business continuity policies, standards and procedures aligned with industry best practices and regulatory expectations.
* Facilitate Business Impact Analyses (BIAs) to identify critical business processes, recovery priorities, dependencies and recovery objectives.
* Ensure business continuity plans (BCPs) are documented, current and regularly reviewed across all business units.
* Partner with Technology, Cybersecurity, Facilities and business teams to strengthen enterprise resilience capabilities.
* Ensure alignment between BCM, disaster recovery, cyber resilience and operational risk management programmes.
* Provide leadership, coaching and development support to Mumbai-based team members in line with Russell Investments' matrix management model.

**Testing & Exercising**

* Develop and manage the annual business continuity and disaster recovery (BC/DR) testing and exercise programme.
* Coordinate tabletop exercises, simulations and recovery tests to validate business continuity and recovery capabilities.
* Track and oversee remediation activities arising from exercises, testing and audits to ensure timely closure.

**Crisis Management & Incident Response**

* Support and coordinate crisis management activities during business disruptions.
* Maintain crisis management protocols, escalation procedures and communication frameworks.
* Serve as a key advisor to senior leadership during incidents requiring business continuity plan activation.

**Core Values & Competencies**

* Strong interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across all levels of management.
* Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.
* Proactive approach to problem-solving, with sound judgement and decision-making capabilities.
* Resourceful and collaborative team player who can also work independently, demonstrate initiative and take ownership.
* Customer-focused, action-oriented and committed to delivering results.
* Forward-thinking, with a commitment to continuous learning and identifying opportunities for improvement.
* Ability to exercise discretion and maintain strict confidentiality.
* Demonstrates Russell Investments' values of integrity, valuing our people, exceeding client expectations, and embracing intellectual curiosity and rigour.

title: Manager - Fund ops, Finance and Investor Relations
description:
**About the job**

Cedar Hill Capital is the region’s leading early-stage FinTech venture capital fund, primarily focused on enterprise technology investments in the Financial Services space. The INR ~200 Cr fund is on track to achieve Final Close shortly, and has already completed a few initial investments.

The fund is built on the legacy Cedar Consulting (www.cedar-consulting.com) and IBS Intelligence (www.ibsintelligence.com) platform, which comprises over 60 years of research and consulting experience for Banks and Technology players globally.

The fund GP, Sahil Anand, in his prior role, co-created the region’s only FinTech Lab, which has demonstrated a strong track-record of accelerating 65+ FinTechs across the region (www.cedaribsifintechlab.com).

The fund is independently structured, follows a classic LP-GP model, and is backed by leading institutional and family office investors across the region

**Responsibilities**

We are looking for a sharp, detail-oriented manager to anchor the operational backbone of our CAT II AIF. This is a broad, high-ownership role that sits at the intersection of fund operations, finance, regulatory compliance, and investor relations. The ideal candidate has prior experience in an AIF, NBFC, or investment management firm and is comfortable working in a lean, high-accountability environment.

**1. Fund Operations**

* Own end-to-end fund administration including capital calls, drawdowns, distributions, and NAV computation in coordination with the fund administrator and custodian.
* Maintain and reconcile the investment register, portfolio valuation workings, and fund-level waterfall calculations on a periodic basis.
* Manage documentation and execution workflows for new investments, follow-ons, and exits, including term sheets, subscription agreements, and board resolutions.
* Coordinate with registrar, custodian, fund administrator, legal counsel, and auditors to ensure smooth operational closure of all fund activities.
* Track portfolio company reporting timelines and consolidate data for internal investment committee reviews and quarterly portfolio updates.

**2. Finance & Accounts**

* Oversee fund-level accounting including maintenance of books, preparation of management accounts, and coordination with auditors for statutory and tax audits.
* Manage fee calculations including management fees, carried interest, and hurdle computations in line with the PPM and LPA provisions.
* Track fund expenses, vendor payments, and ensure timely filing of GST returns, TDS, and other applicable direct and indirect tax obligations.
* Prepare financial statements for the fund entity and any associated SPVs, ensuring compliance with applicable accounting standards (Ind AS / IGAAP as applicable).
* Support the preparation of annual budgets, cash flow forecasts, and expense reports for management and trustee review.

**3. Compliance**

* Ensure ongoing compliance with SEBI AIF Regulations 2012 and circulars, including periodic filings, disclosures, and reporting obligations to the regulator.
* Maintain and update the fund’s compliance calendar; coordinate with legal counsel on amendments to fund documents and regulatory submissions.
* Oversee KYC/AML processes for existing and new investors, ensuring documentation is complete and refreshed as per PMLA and SEBI requirements.
* Liaise with the fund trustee, compliance officer, and legal advisors on any regulatory queries, show cause notices, or ad hoc SEBI communications.
* Monitor changes in SEBI, RBI, FEMA, and income tax regulations relevant to AIF operations and proactively flag implications to the investment team.

**4. Investor Relations**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for LP queries on capital accounts, tax documents, portfolio updates, and fund-related communications.
* Prepare quarterly and annual investor reports including portfolio performance summaries, capital account statements, and fund-level financial highlights.
* Coordinate the preparation and dispatch of capital call notices, distribution notices, and tax certificates (Form 64C/64D) within stipulated timelines.
* Maintain the investor data room and ensure all fund documents, NAV reports, and compliance certificates are current and accessible to LPs.
* Support fundraising efforts by preparing data room materials, responding to LP due diligence requests, and coordinating onboarding of new investors.

**Qualifications**

* CA, MBA (Finance), or CFA with 4–7 years of relevant experience in an AIF, NBFC, PE/VC fund, or Big 4 advisory firm.
* Strong working knowledge of SEBI AIF Regulations, PMLA/KYC requirements, and fund accounting principles.
* Prior experience handling SEBI filings, investor reporting, and coordination with fund administrators and custodians.
* Proficiency in Excel; experience with fund administration software or accounting tools is a plus.
* Excellent written communication skills; ability to draft investor communications, compliance memos, and board presentations independently.

Shop Floor Quality Oversight
  
  

* Serve as Teva's on-site quality representative, maintaining a strong quality presence across CMO site operations.
* Participate in daily production and operational review meetings to provide quality oversight and ensure alignment with production objectives.
* Monitor adherence to cGMP requirements, approved procedures, and quality standards through routine shop floor engagement.

title: Assistant Operations Manager
description:
Job Description - Assistant Operations Manager

Job Description – Assistant Operations Manager

About Pinch

The last decade and a half has been dedicated to the rise of convenience in every way. Organisations, one after the other, have created products and services which make the life of customers convenient. Yet the pain, pressure and stress of the modern world has not really reduced, leave aside going away.

At Pinch, our dream is to transform the physical environment of a family and help them create space for the truly important things, allowing them to focus on themselves and their mental well-being to build a meaningful life, filled with purpose and joy. We wish to build a home management system, which not only does the daily chores, seamlessly and effortlessly, but also preempts the needs of our customers, enhances their lifestyle in every aspect while giving them the peace of mind to focus on achieving more in life. From full housekeeping to a quick tidy up or a dog walk, Pinch is available for the families all the time. We work as an extension of our customers’ family and bring to the table what is best for them.

With our monthly plan, we combine services such as housekeeping, maintenance, food & nutrition management, grocery resupply, laundry management, etc. tailored to the unique needs of each family. On top, a dedicated Lifestyle Manager helps them with any miscellaneous home requests, from decorating home with fresh flowers to arranging a repairman for the broken washing machine, to planning details of the next holiday, taking care of children or the elderly. Basically, anything and everything our customers and their families would need to live a comfortable, convenient, healthy, guilt-free, and inspired life.

The Role

We are looking for a proactive and hands-on Assistant Operations Manager to manage end-to-end operations across our managed properties in multiple locations. The role will focus on ensuring that operational processes are implemented effectively on the ground, properties are maintained to the expected standards, and teams have the support and resources required for smooth day-to-day functioning.

The role will involve extensive travel across our property locations, including Kalsubai, Mahabaleshwar, Goa and other destinations where Pinch manages properties. You will coordinate closely with the Mumbai office, working with the team to implement operational requirements, resolve on-ground challenges and ensure consistency across properties.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys being on the ground, managing people and processes, solving problems independently, and taking ownership of operations across locations.

What You Will Do

1. End-to-End Property Operations

* Oversee the day-to-day operations of assigned properties across multiple locations.
* Ensure that properties are operationally ready, well-maintained and managed in accordance with Pinch’s standards.
* Conduct regular property visits and inspections to identify gaps, resolve issues and ensure operational readiness.
* Monitor housekeeping, maintenance and the overall functioning of properties.

2. On-Ground Execution and Implementation

* Take ownership of implementing operational processes, guidelines and initiatives communicated by the central operations team.
* Ensure that operational standards and processes are consistently followed across all assigned properties.
* Identify operational gaps and take timely corrective action.
* Follow through on action items to ensure that decisions and plans are translated into effective on-ground execution.

3. Team and Stakeholder Coordination

* Coordinate closely with the Mumbai office on operational requirements, priorities and ongoing initiatives.
* Work with on-ground teams, property staff, vendors and service partners to ensure smooth day-to-day functioning.
* Ensure that teams across locations understand their responsibilities and adhere to defined processes.
* Act as the key point of coordination between the central operations team and the properties under your responsibility.

4. Property Maintenance and Issue Resolution

* Coordinate maintenance activities, repairs, vendor visits and other property-related requirements.
* Take ownership of resolving operational issues and escalating matters that require additional support or intervention.
* Monitor recurring issues and work towards implementing long-term solutions.
* Ensure that property-related concerns are addressed within appropriate timelines.

5. Travel and Multi-Location Operations

* Travel extensively to properties across locations, including Kalsubai, Mahabaleshwar, Goa and other destinations as required.
* Conduct regular site visits to assess property conditions, review operations and support on-ground teams.
* Manage operational requirements across locations and ensure that each property receives adequate attention.
* Be flexible with travel schedules and stay arrangements based on operational priorities.

6. Reporting and Operational Accountability

* Share regular updates with the Mumbai operations team on property status, ongoing issues and action items.
* Maintain clear records of site visits, maintenance requirements, operational gaps and their resolution.
* Track pending tasks and ensure timely closure through regular follow-ups.
* Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, service delivery and property management practices.

What We Are Looking For

* Prior experience in property operations, hospitality operations, facilities management, hotel operations or a similar operational role.
* Strong execution skills and the ability to manage multiple operational requirements simultaneously.
* A hands-on approach with the ability to independently assess and resolve on-ground challenges.
* Strong coordination and communication skills to work effectively with central teams, property staff, vendors and service partners.
* Good organisational skills, attention to detail and a strong sense of ownership.
* The ability to work across multiple locations and adapt to changing operational requirements.
* Willingness to travel extensively and spend significant time at property locations.
* A practical, solution-oriented mindset with the ability to work in a fast-paced environment.

What Success Looks Like

* Properties operate smoothly and consistently meet defined operational standards.
* Operational processes are implemented effectively across all assigned locations.
* Property-related issues are identified, addressed and resolved in a timely manner.
* On-ground teams are well-coordinated and supported.
* The Mumbai operations team has clear visibility into property performance, pending requirements and ongoing challenges.

Location and Travel

The role will involve close coordination with our Mumbai office and extensive travel across Pinch-managed properties.

Candidates should be comfortable with frequent travel, on-site problem-solving and managing operations across geographically dispersed properties.

title: Service Desk Manager
description:
**Greetings for the Day…!!!**

We are looking for a
**Service Desk Manager**
for one of our esteemed clients in
**Bangalore/ Pune/Ahmedabad**
having experience into
**Service Desk Management , ITIL | ServiceNow | SLA/KPI Management | Incident Management | Team Leadership | Infrastructure Support | CSAT | Service Improvement .**

**Exp: 15+ years ( Min 3 Years as a Manager on Paper)**

**Location:Pune/ Bangalore/ Ahmedabad**

**CTC: Up to 25 LPA**

**Shifts : - US Shifts**

Job Description: -

**Role Summary**

The Service Desk Manager owns end-to-end delivery of the IT service desk (voice, chat, email, portal ) for a 24/7 managed services engagement. The role leads Team Leads and Service Desk Analysts, acts as the escalation point for incidents and requests, and is accountable for SLA/KPI achievement, customer satisfaction, quality, cost and team health. The Manager partners with the client’s senior leadership and Wipro delivery leadership to drive predictable, compliant and continually improving service.

**Key Responsibilities**

•
**Operations & SLA:**
Own day-to-day service desk operations; ensure SLA, OLA and KPI adherence (FCR, MTTR, abandon rate, backlog ageing, reopen rate, CSAT).

•
**Escalation & Major Incidents:**
Act as escalation point for all requests, incidents and complex user issues; lead Major Incident bridges, communications and post-incident reviews.

•
**Resource & Shift Planning:**
Plan staffing, shift rosters, forecasting and utilization across rotating, night, on-call and weekend shifts; work with WMG/TA on demand, ramp-up and attrition backfills.

•
**People Leadership:**
Lead, coach and mentor Team Leads and analysts; set KRAs, run performance reviews and succession plans; manage attrition, engagement and skill development.

•
**Process & ITIL Governance:**
Define and mature incident, request, problem and change processes aligned to ITIL; review the service catalog, escalation matrix and knowledge base for continuous service improvement (CSI).

•
**Automation & Shift-Left:**
Drive shift-left, self-service, chatbot/virtual agent, automation and knowledge-centered service to deflect volume and improve first-contact resolution.

•
**Client Management & Reporting:**
Lead weekly/monthly service reviews, QBR inputs and executive dashboards; analyze ticket trends to present insights and corrective actions to client and Wipro leadership.

•
**Governance & Compliance:**
Ensure compliance with contractual commitments (SOW/MSA), information-security policies, internal and external audits, and Wipro systems and processes (WiproOne, DigiQ, HR/IT systems, legal and compliance requirements).

•
**Financials & Continuity:**
Manage project financials, utilization and cost optimization within the engagement budget; support business continuity and DR planning for the service desk.

•
**Cross-Functional Collaboration:**
Collaborate with L2/L3, infrastructure, security, vendor and application teams to ensure seamless hand-offs and faster resolution.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, IT or Computer Science (or equivalent); MBA is an advantage.

• ITIL 4 Foundation certified (mandatory); ITIL Intermediate/Managing Professional, HDI or PMP preferred.

• Strong command of ITSM processes (Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Knowledge) and tools such as ServiceNow, Remedy or equivalent, with telephony/ACD and WFM tools.

• Hands-on understanding of end-user technologies: Windows, macOS, Microsoft 365, identity/MFA, VPN, endpoint and collaboration tools.

• Proven capability in people management, conflict resolution, attrition control and building high-performing teams.

• Strong analytics and reporting skills, with ability to communicate with numbers to senior stakeholders.

• Excellent client-facing, negotiation and executive communication skills.

**Key Competencies**

• Ownership and closure orientation; follows through on commitments with discipline.

• Calm decision-making under pressure during major incidents and escalations.

• Customer-centric mindset with continual improvement and innovation focus.

• Strategic planning, forecasting and cost-awareness.

**Working Arrangement**

• 24/7 managed services engagement (rotating shifts, night, on-call, weekend coverage).

• Core business hours aligned to US Pacific Time Zone; fully work-from-office.

• Client location: Hyderabad, India; ODC locations: Bangalore and Chennai.

**Success Measures**

SLA/KPI compliance, CSAT, FCR and ticket-deflection improvement, backlog ageing, attrition and bench/utilization, audit and compliance adherence, and delivery of CSI and automation initiatives

Thanks & Regards,

* Knowledge of quality control tools
