title: Lead - Security & Employee Services
description:
**About Us -**
At Alfa Laval, we always go the extra mile to overcome the toughest challenges. Our driving force is to accelerate success for our customers, people, and planet. We make it happen by having dedicated people with a curious mind. Curiosity is the spark behind great ideas. And great ideas drive progress. As a member of our team, you thrive in an open inclusive workplace, based on diversity with a sense of belonging. This is where you can make a difference by constantly building bridges to the future with sustainable solutions that have an impact on our planet’s most urgent problems. Making the world a better place. Every day.
  
  
Please feel free to peruse our website www.alfalaval.com
  
  
Alfa Laval in India is looking for a Lead – Security Management and Employee Services
  
  
**Purpose Of The Role**
As
**Lead – Security Management and Employee Services**
, you will own and strengthen Alfa Laval India’s
**site security and workplace protection framework**
across locations—ensuring the safety of people, protection of assets, and continuity of operations. You will lead service partners and internal coordination to deliver secure, compliant and efficient operations across
**physical security systems (CCTV, laser monitoring, etc.), employee transport governance, visitor management (VMS), internal housekeeping coordination, office maintenance inside the building, and seating arrangements**
.
  
  
This is a leadership role that requires a calm, decisive operator who can build strong governance, run risk-based controls, and continuously improve security and workplace readiness through metrics, audits, and stakeholder alignment.
  
  
**Scope of Services**

* Security (including site security of all locations – CCTV, laser monitoring, etc.)
* Employee transport
* Visitor Management System (VMS)
* Housekeeping (internal)
* Office maintenance (inside the building)
* Seating arrangements

**Key Responsibilities**
**Site Security Operations (Multi‑location Governance)**

* Lead end‑to‑end security operations across all locations, ensuring consistent standards, trained guards, and readiness for incidents and escalations.
* Establish and maintain a security governance rhythm: daily checks, weekly audits, monthly dashboards, and quarterly vendor reviews.
* Maintain site security documentation and readiness (post orders, SOPs, incident logs, escalation matrix).

**Physical Security Systems Ownership (CCTV / Perimeter Monitoring)**

* Own performance and uptime of CCTV and perimeter/laser monitoring systems, including vendor AMCs, preventive maintenance, and downtime/escalation handling.
* Ensure camera coverage adequacy, recording retention discipline, access controls (where relevant), and evidence retrieval processes for investigations.
* Build a “secure-by-design” approach for new seating layouts and workplace changes (security sightlines, entry/exit controls).

**Employee Transport Governance**

* Own employee transport safety and governance: vendor compliance, route and timing discipline, escalation handling, and incident management.
* Drive transport controls aligned to workplace safety expectations (driver verification where applicable, vehicle checks, adherence to site rules).

**Visitor Management System (VMS) & Front‑door Controls**

* Own the VMS process end‑to‑end: visitor entry approvals, documentation, badges, movement controls, and data hygiene.
* Ensure consistent visitor experience with the right balance of hospitality and security—clear signage, queues control, and escalation routes.

**Workplace Readiness: Internal Housekeeping & Office Maintenance (Inside Building)**

* Coordinate internal housekeeping services to ensure clean, safe, and professional work areas aligned to site standards.
* Drive timely closure of office maintenance inside the building (minor repairs, workplace issues, vendor follow-ups) through a structured ticketing/escalation process.
* Run routine workplace audits focused on safety, hygiene, and readiness (e.g., walk-throughs, common areas, high traffic zones).

**Seating Arrangements & Workplace Coordination**

* Lead and govern seating arrangements—move planning, access readiness, coordination with internal stakeholders, and minimal business disruption.
* Ensure seating changes align with security and visitor controls (restricted zones, secure storage areas, emergency exits not blocked).

**Incident Management, Investigations & Continuous Improvement**

* Act as the first line of leadership for incidents (security breaches, transport issues, visitor escalations), ensuring quick response, accurate documentation, and closure with preventive actions.
* Conduct root cause reviews for repeated issues (e.g., system downtime, recurring visitor/transport deviations) and implement corrective/preventive measures.

**Vendor Leadership, Commercial Discipline & Compliance**

* Lead performance of security, CCTV/perimeter monitoring, transport, housekeeping, and maintenance vendors through SLAs, scorecards and QBRs.
* Validate vendor bills against performance, rosters, and contracted scope; identify efficiency and cost optimization opportunities without compromising security posture.

**Key Interfaces**

* Internal: Administration/HR Ops, Facilities, QHSE, IT (for VMS/CCTV integration where applicable), Finance, Procurement, Site Leadership, Employees.
* External: Security agency, CCTV/perimeter monitoring vendor, transport vendor, housekeeping vendor, office maintenance service partners.

**Success Measures (KPIs)**
**Security Systems & Coverage**

* CCTV/perimeter monitoring uptime; incident evidence retrieval turnaround time.

**Security Operations**

* Incident response time; repeat incident reduction; audit scores across locations.

**Transport Governance**

* On‑time performance; incident rate; escalation closure time.

**VMS Performance**

* Visitor processing time; compliance adherence; data accuracy and reporting completeness.

**Workplace Readiness**

* Housekeeping audit scores; office maintenance ticket SLA compliance; seating move success rate (on-time, zero disruption).

**Vendor Governance & Cost**

* SLA adherence, billing accuracy, and improvement savings delivered.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Education: Graduate in any discipline (preferred: security management/operations/administration).
* Experience: Typically 8–12 years in corporate/site security operations and vendor governance; experience with multi‑site operations preferred.
* Strong hands‑on exposure to CCTV and perimeter monitoring, visitor management (VMS), and employee transport governance.
* Experience coordinating internal housekeeping and office maintenance inside building operations.
* Preferred (adds strong differentiation): exposure to security audits, crisis response drills, and structured incident management.

**Leadership Competencies**

* Safety-first & risk-based thinking: anticipates threats and closes gaps before incidents occur.
* Calm under pressure: structured response during incidents; clear communication and escalation discipline.
* Vendor leadership: drives accountability through data, SLAs and coaching rather than constant firefighting.
* Service mindset: balances strong controls with a welcoming workplace experience for employees and visitors.
* Execution rigour: sets standards, runs audits, and ensures closure with measurable outcomes.

To help us achieve this we apply Pymetrics assessments, and upon application you will be invited to play the assessment games.

**Department:**
Operations & Maintenance

15–20 Years

B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical / Electrical / Chemical Engineering or equivalent.

Job Purpose

To lead and manage the overall Operations & Maintenance (O&M) of a Waste-to-Energy (WTE) plant, ensuring efficient plant operations, maximum availability, optimum power generation, effective waste processing, equipment reliability, cost optimization and compliance with statutory and environmental regulations.

Key Roles & Responsibilities

**1. Overall Plant Operations**

* Lead and manage day-to-day operations of the Waste-to-Energy plant.
* Ensure smooth and uninterrupted plant operations as per defined capacity and performance parameters.
* Monitor waste processing, segregation, feeding, combustion and power generation activities.
* Ensure achievement of plant availability, operational efficiency and power generation targets.
* Monitor plant performance through operational KPIs and implement improvement measures.

**2. Maintenance Management**

* Oversee preventive, predictive and breakdown maintenance of plant machinery and equipment.
* Ensure maximum equipment availability and minimize plant downtime.
* Manage maintenance of boilers, turbines, generators, conveyors, cranes, shredders, material handling systems and auxiliary equipment.
* Develop annual maintenance plans, shutdown schedules and maintenance budgets.
* Ensure timely availability of critical spares and effective vendor management.

**3. Waste Processing & Power Generation**

* Ensure effective handling and processing of Municipal Solid Waste (MSW).
* Monitor waste quality, calorific value, moisture content and feed consistency.
* Ensure efficient combustion and steam generation.
* Monitor boiler performance, turbine efficiency and electricity generation.
* Identify opportunities to improve plant efficiency and optimize fuel and energy consumption.

**4. Team & Manpower Management**

* Lead and manage operations, maintenance, electrical, mechanical and instrumentation teams.
* Define responsibilities and monitor team performance.
* Ensure adequate manpower deployment and technical training.
* Build a culture of operational excellence, safety and accountability.

**5. Safety & Environmental Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with CPCB, SPCB, environmental and pollution control regulations.
* Monitor emissions, ash handling, wastewater treatment and other environmental parameters.
* Ensure implementation of HSE policies and safe working practices.
* Coordinate statutory inspections, audits and regulatory requirements.

**6. Budget & Cost Management**

* Prepare and manage annual O&M budgets.
* Control operational and maintenance costs.
* Monitor consumables, spare parts, manpower and energy costs.
* Optimize plant operating expenses without compromising safety and performance.

**7. Stakeholder & Management Coordination**

* Coordinate with municipal corporations, government authorities, technology providers and contractors.
* Review plant performance and submit periodic MIS reports to senior management.
* Handle operational challenges and ensure timely resolution of plant-related issues.

Desired Candidate Profile

* 15–20 years of relevant experience in Operations & Maintenance of Waste-to-Energy plants, MSW processing facilities or power plants.
* Strong hands-on experience in WTE plant operations and maintenance.
* Experience in boiler, turbine, generator, combustion systems and material handling equipment.
* Knowledge of preventive, predictive and breakdown maintenance.
* Experience in managing plant capacity, power generation, plant availability and operational KPIs.
* Strong knowledge of environmental, safety and statutory compliance.
* Proven experience in leading large technical and operational teams.
* Candidates with direct experience in MSW-based WTE plant O&M will be strongly preferred.

Key Skills

* Waste-to-Energy Plant Operations
* Municipal Solid Waste Management
* Plant Operations & Maintenance
* Boiler & Turbine Operations
* Power Generation
* Mechanical & Electrical Maintenance
* Preventive & Predictive Maintenance
* Plant Performance Optimization
* HSE & Environmental Compliance
* Budgeting & Cost Control
* Team & Stakeholder Management

* Support client governance meetings and operational review discussions.

title: Head of Operations / Demurrage / Despatch
description:
Castrol is one of the world’s leading lubricant brands, serving customers and consumers in the automotive, marine, industrial and energy sectors. Castrol brands are recognised globally for their premium quality and high performance, shaped by the company’s commitment to innovation and cutting-edge technology. With products sold in more than 150 countries, Castrol has helped keep things moving on roads and racetracks, air, sea, and space for over 125 years.
  
  
Whether you're just starting out or ready for your next big move, you're in the right place to explore an exciting career with Castrol.
  
  
**Job Description**
**About the team:**
You will establish and lead Castrol’s independent global Marine & Shipping Operations function, ensuring safe, compliant, reliable and commercially competitive movement of liquid-bulk and finished-goods cargoes. As the functional leader, you will own the voyage operations/execution, operations and financial settlement. You will lead a geographically distributed team and partner with Supply Chain, Procurement, Finance, HSSE, Legal and Digital to protect supply continuity, manage marine and commercial risk, optimise freight expenditure and build a scalable global capability.
  
  
Establish governance for charter-party terms, laytime and demurrage, claims, freight settlement and contractual performance, working with Procurement, Legal, Finance and insurance partners to minimise leakage and manage commercial exposure.
  
  
**Key tasks:**

* Global Shipping Operations Leadership & Operating Model
* Establish and lead Castrol's global Shipping Operations, providing functional leadership across voyage operations/ execution, marine assurance, vetting, and port clearance.
* Design, implement, and continuously improve the target operating model, governance framework, decision rights, and performance standards for global marine operations
* Build a scalable, resilient, and future-ready global marine capability that supports Castrol's long-term supply chain strategy and growth ambitions.
* Develop organisational capability, talent, succession plans, and operational excellence standards across the global shipping network.
* TSA Transition & Business Readiness
* Serve as the business owner for Shipping Operations throughout the TSA period and lead the transition to an independent Castrol operating model.
* Deliver a controlled and successful TSA exit while maintaining uninterrupted service, supply continuity, safety, and compliance.
* Lead change management, knowledge transfer, capability development, and operating readiness activities across people, processes, systems, and governance.
* Establish sustainable operating procedures, controls, escalation pathways, and service expectations for post-TSA operations.
* Commercial, Chartering & Operational Performance
* Own the global marine operations strategy and execution, balancing cost, capacity, risk, service, and supply continuity.
* Drive freight optimisation, operational efficiency, and service reliability across Castrol's global marine network.
* Govern commercial shipping activities including chartering strategy, contract portfolio management, charter-party governance, freight procurement, and vessel utilisation.
* Establish and manage performance metrics covering cost, service, utilisation, demurrage, claims, safety, compliance, and customer service outcomes.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives that enhance competitiveness, resilience, and value delivery across marine operations.
* Stakeholder, Partner & Industry Leadership
* Partner closely with Procurement, Planning, Manufacturing, Finance, HSSE, Legal, Compliance, Digital, and Supply Chain teams to optimise business outcomes.
* Build and sustain strategic relationships with shipowners, brokers, terminals, agents, marine service providers, insurers, and assurance partners.
* Influence senior leaders on marine risk, commercial strategy, operating model design, and investment decisions.
* Represent Castrol externally within the marine and shipping ecosystem, strengthening industry relationships and ensuring access to best practices, innovation, and market intelligence.

**Experience required:**

* Required:
* Significant leadership experience in marine, shipping, chartering, or maritime operations, gained within tanker, chemical, lubricants, energy, liquid bulk, or related global shipping environments.
* Proven track record leading complex global marine operations, including chartering, voyage execution, vessel vetting, marine assurance, port operations, or shipping governance.
* Demonstrated success building, transforming, or leading operating models, including large-scale business transformations, TSA exits, outsourcing arrangements, organisational redesign, or capability stand-up activities.
* Strong commercial acumen with experience balancing freight cost, service performance, supply continuity, operational risk, and customer requirements within a global shipping environment.
* Deep understanding of maritime regulations, vessel vetting, sanctions compliance, marine assurance, HSSE requirements, and global trade compliance frameworks.
* Experience leading geographically dispersed teams and influencing across multiple functions, cultures, external partners, and executive stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity, manage operational crises, and make sound decisions in safety-critical and time-sensitive environments.
* Strong analytical, digital, and data-driven decision-making capabilities, with experience leveraging technology to improve operational performance, governance, and visibility.
* Bachelor's degree in Maritime Studies, Marine Transportation, Supply Chain, Engineering, Logistics, Business, or a related discipline.
* Preferred:
* Experience within oil & gas, lubricants, chemicals, liquid bulk, or tanker shipping sectors.
* Experience with commercial chartering, freight procurement, charter-party negotiation, voyage management, demurrage, claims, and marine commercial governance.
* Experience selecting, implementing, or operating marine digital platforms, voyage management systems, Control Tower solutions, or transportation visibility technologies.
* Strong understanding of geopolitical risk, sanctions management, marine insurance, marine assurance, and business continuity planning.
* Professional maritime qualifications such as Master Mariner, Chief Engineer, Institute of Chartered Shipbrokers (ICS), or equivalent industry-recognised qualifications.
* Experience managing strategic relationships with shipowners, brokers, terminals, marine service providers, classification societies, insurers, or assurance providers.
* You will work with : Regional Chartering Leads, Marine Vetting & Clearance Specialists, and Global Supply Chain and Logistics leadership, partnering across Procurement, Finance, HSSE, Legal, Compliance, Digital & IT, Commercial, and regional Supply Chain teams. You will also collaborate with external stakeholders including TSA providers, ship owners, charterers, brokers, terminals, vetting agencies, port authorities, and marine service partners, supporting marine sourcing and contracts, freight cost management, budgeting and performance tracking, system selection and integration, and the safe, compliant, and efficient delivery of marine operations.

Privacy
  
  
The Castrol entity recruiting for this role is the data controller for the personal information you provide. We use it to assess your application and to manage the recruitment and onboarding process. We may share it with service providers who support our recruitment, and it may be transferred to other Castrol entities internationally under appropriate safeguards. We keep it only for as long as necessary. For details of how we use your information and your data protection rights, contact privacy.response@castrol.com.
  
  
*We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, socioeconomic status, neurodiversity/neurocognitive functioning, veteran status or disability status. Individuals with an accessibility need may request an adjustment/accommodation related to Castrol recruiting process (e.g., accessing the job application, completing required assessments, participating in telephone screenings or interviews, etc.).*
*If you are selected for a position and depending upon your role, your employment may be contingent upon adherence to local policy. This may include pre-placement drug screening, medical review of physical fitness for the role, and background checks.*

You bring a commercial mindset to complex environments, translating customer challenges into scalable, high-impact solutions. Whether shaping delivery excellence, driving presales conversations, or expanding strategic accounts, you lead with clarity, accountability, and intent.

* Balance speed, quality, cost, and risk to ensure sustainable and scalable delivery.

**People and Capability Building**

If you are ready to lead, grow, and build, apply now.

**What You’ll Do**
Eaton announced, on June 11, 2026, the intent to combine its Mobility Group (including both the Vehicle and eMobility segments) with a new company. We expect to complete this process by the end of the first half of 2027. The compensation and benefits that will initially be offered for this position are based on Eaton's plans, programs and practices. If you are offered and accept this position and are actively employed by the Mobility Group when the transaction closes, the new company will provide further details to employees concerning compensation and benefits at that time.
  
  
The incumbent will be primarily responsible for overseeing daily logistics operations related to SEZ, Customs (Import/Export), and DTA transportation. This includes managing the logistics team, handling incoming materials, ensuring accurate GRN processing, and coordinating temporary storage and issuance activities.
  
  
"
  
  

* Day to day Import/Export shipment clearance at customs (duty free / duty paid)
* IUT (Inter Unit / SEZ to SEZ goods Transfers)
* De-bonding of assets/ Scrapping
* Service Invoices for GRN & Endoersment
* Coordinating with Shipping Agencies, Freight Forwarders and Customs House Agents for timely clearance and delivery of Shipments.
* Online TRC closing
* Support to Finance, vendors, SCM team, Users, Inward team, SEZ desk for the shipment related issues, Invoice issues.
* Invoice verification prior to shipments & GRN and SEZ endorsement process
* Online BOE, Shipping bill and TRC submission
* Tracking & managing expenses withing budget
* Ensuring timely agreements with all the vendors
* Ensuring all the processes are being mapped in SOP`s
* Controlling inward store activities and managing the store team
* Keeping record of Import/bond to bond/IUT/loan basis/Indigenous documents to respective Bond
* Documentating all the data points & preperation of MIS
* Tracking & improvising logistics KPI`s"

**Qualifications**
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Science /Commerce /engineering from an accredited university/institution.
  
  
Min. 08-10 years of relevant experience in logistics including import/export, SEZ transactions, and DTA operations.
  
  
**Skills**
"
  
  

* Subject Matter Expertise in SEZ logistics and customs processes
* Ability to Manage custum clearance of goods
* Experience in handling issues related to SEZ & Custom & providing its resolution
* Familiarity with operational SOPs
* Hands on at SEZ & Custom online transactions"

"
  
  

* Good communication and conflict resolution skills
* Data analytical / Problem Solving skills
* Good on Excel, Power point & soft skills
* Proficiency in Oracle and logistics approval tools
* Time management and punctuality"

title: Staff enterprise technology engineer
description:
**Entity**
Technology
  
  
**Job Family Group**
IT&S Group
  
  
**Job Description**
**You will work with**
You will lead a multidisciplinary team of Identity and Access Management engineers, working alongside product managers, engineering leaders, architects, cyber security leaders, control owners, audit and compliance teams, vendors, and business collaborators.
  
  
Together, you will provide secure, reliable, compliant, and understandable enterprise identity services for workforce, application, machine, privileged, and partner identities.
  
  
**Let Me Tell You About The Role**
As a Staff Identity and Access Management Manager, you will be accountable for the organisational capability, workforce, operating model, performance, risk, cost, and sustained outcomes of an enterprise Identity and Access Management team.
  
  
Your team’s responsibilities will span consumer adoption, service operation, identity-lifecycle execution, user-facing workflows, access governance, control operation, audit and compliance evidence, service continuity, and continual improvement.
  
  
You will establish the environment, expectations, capabilities, and management system that enable engineers to deliver consistently across the full Identity and Access Management lifecycle.
  
  
The organisation works across Identity and Access Management capabilities such as identity governance and administration, authentication, directory services, privileged access management, identity protection, federation, digital trust, Public Key Infrastructure, and supporting identity infrastructure.
  
  
You will balance security, control effectiveness, service reliability, user experience, workforce sustainability, and business priorities while maintaining clear accountability across Product Management, Engineering, Architecture, Cyber Security, Risk, Compliance, and service teams.
  
  
What you will deliver
  
  

* Establish and communicate a clear mission, direction, operating model, and set of outcomes for the Identity and Access Management team.
* Build and sustain a diverse, capable, engaged, and accountable organisation with the skills required to support the complete identity lifecycle.
* Own workforce strategy, organisational design, capacity planning, succession, recruitment, retention, development, and deployment of employees and third-party resources.
* Translate Core Security Platforms priorities into an achievable portfolio of team objectives, commitments, measures, and improvement outcomes.
* Ensure the team provides secure and effective consumer adoption, service operation, identity-lifecycle execution, access governance, operational controls, audit evidence, and service continuity.
* Establish clear ownership, decision rights, issue paths, service expectations, and working relationships across adjacent teams and fields.
* Ensure operational integrity and compliance with approved architecture, security policies, engineering standards, data requirements, operational procedures, and regulatory controls.
* Maintain oversight of significant identity incidents, service risks, control failures, evidence deficiencies, audit findings, and remediation commitments.
* Ensure critical incidents and control failures receive effective leadership, collaborator communication, accountableissuen, and sustained remediation.
* Establish performance measures covering delivery, adoption, service quality, lifecycle completion, restoration, controls, evidence, user experience, workforce health, cost, and continual improvement.
* Use service data, operational experience, audit results, control performance, and collaborator feedback to improve priorities and influence platform roadmaps.
* Ensure new or changed identity services enter operation with appropriate ownership, documentation, monitoring, controls, evidence, support arrangements, and lifecycle accountability.
* Drive automation, self-service, standardisation, reusable practices, knowledge management, and recurrence prevention.
* Lead the team’s financial plans, budget, resource allocation, sourcing decisions, vendor relationships, and third-party performance.
* Create an inclusive and psychologically safe environment in which people can raise risks, challenge decisions, learn from failure, and improve how work is performed.
* Set clear performance expectations and ensure leaders and engineers receive important objectives, feedback, coaching, development, and recognition.
* Develop leadership and technical capability throughout the organisation and maintain credible succession for critical roles.
* Represent the Identity and Access Management organisation in senior governance, investment, risk, assurance, audit, operational, and workforce forums.

What you will need to be successful
  
  
**Experience And Qualifications**
A bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in computer science, engineering, cyber securityfield, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  
  
Significant professional experience in Identity and Access Management, cyber security, enterprise technology, platform services, or a related field.
  
  
Demonstrated experience leading multidisciplinary technology teams in a large, sophisticated, or regulated enterprise environment.
  
  
Experience handling workforce capacity, organisational capability, performance, budgets, vendors, third-party resources, operational risk, and delivery commitments.
  
  
Broad solid understanding across multiple Identity and Access Management areas, such as:
  
  
Identity governance and administration
  
  
Enterprise authentication and federation
  
  
Directory and identity lifecycle services
  
  
Privileged access management
  
  
Passwordless and certificate-based authentication
  
  
Business-to-business and partner identity
  
  
Identity protection and risk-based access
  
  
Public Key Infrastructure and digital trust
  
  
Machine and application identity
  
  
Supporting Domain Name System and identity infrastructure
  
  
Experience leading organisations accountable for secure technology adoption, service operation, identity lifecycle, operational controls, evidence, compliance, or audit support.
  
  
Experience working with senior technology, cyber security, risk, compliance, audit, vendor, and business collaborators.
  
  
**Technical Skills We Need From You**
Broad understanding of enterprise identity architecture, identity lifecycle, access governance, authentication, privileged access, federation, certificate services, and Zero Trust principles.
  
  
Ability to understand how identity platforms, applications, infrastructure, data, controls, user workflows, and business processes interact at enterprise scale.
  
  
Strong understanding of operational integrity, service management, control execution, audit evidence, risk management, service transition, and continual improvement.
  
  
Ability to evaluate technical and operational risks, ask effective questions, and ensure decisions are made by the appropriate accountable authority.
  
  
Ability to use service, control, financial, workforce, delivery, and user-experience measures to advise priorities and assess organisational performance.
  
  
Understanding of automation, application programming interfaces, workflow orchestration, data analysis, monitoring, and self-service as methods for improving identity services.
  
  
Ability to communicate sophisticated technology, risk, control, and investment matters clearly to senior technical and nontechnical audiences.
  
  
**Essential Skills**

* Organisational leadership: Build the structures, capabilities, relationships, and environment required for sustained performance.
* People leadership: Set clear expectations and develop people through coaching, feedback, opportunity, accountability, and recognition.
* Strategic judgement: Balance security, service, control, workforce, financial, technical, and business considerations.
* Outcome accountability: Remain accountable for organisational results while preserving clear ownership across fields.
* Operating-model field: Establish enforceable decision rights, lifecycle boundaries, measures, governance, and working practices.
* Risk leadership: Create transparency around incidents, control failures, service risks, evidence deficiencies, and remediation.
* Financial stewardship: Allocate resources and handle costs, vendors, and third parties in alignment with priorities and value.
* Influence: Align senior collaborators across organisational boundaries and resolve challenging priorities constructively.
* Inclusive leadership: Create an environment where diverse perspectives improve decisions and people can perform at their best.
* Continuous improvement: Convert operational learning, audit results, workforce feedback, and service data into durable organisational improvements.

**Skills That Set You Apart**

* Experience leading global Identity and Access Management teams in a regulated or compliance-intensive organisation.
* Experience transforming identity services, operating models, workforce structures, sourcing arrangements, or service performance.
* Experience leading through major incidents, material control failures, significant audits, complex remediation, or enterprise identity change.
* Experience improving identity user experience, operational controls, audit evidence, automation, or self-service at scale.
* Experience handling substantial budgets, strategic vendors, and blended employee and third-party workforces.
* Professional certifications in identity, cyber security, information systems auditing, risk, service management, or leadership.
* Ability to translate sophisticated operational and technical conditions into clear executive decisions and organisational action.

title: DPS APAC Digital Customer Platforms Lead
description:
At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.com.
  
  
As guided by Our Credo, Johnson & Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson & Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.
  
  
**Job Function**
Customer Management
  
  
**Job Sub Function**
Technical Customer Service
  
  
**Job Category**
Professional
  
  
**All Job Posting Locations:**
Pune, Maharashtra, India, Shanghai, China, Suzhou, Jiangsu, China
  
  
**Job Description**
APAC Digital Customer Platforms Lead
  
  
DePuy Synthes is recruiting for a Digital Customer Platforms Lead.
  
  
Johnson & Johnson announced plans to separate our Orthopaedics business to establish a standalone orthopaedics company, operating as DePuy Synthes. The process of the planned separation is anticipated to be completed within 18 to 24 months, subject to legal requirements, including consultation with works councils and other employee representative bodies, as may be required, regulatory approvals and other customary conditions and approvals. Should you accept this position, it is anticipated that, following conclusion of the transaction, you would be an employee of DePuy Synthes and your employment would be governed by DePuy Synthes employment processes, programmes, policies, and benefit plans. In that case, details of any planned changes would be provided to you by DePuy Synthes at an appropriate time and subject to any necessary consultation processes.
  
  
**Job Overview**
The Digital Customer Platforms Lead is responsible for the business ownership, coordination and continuous improvement of the digital platforms and satellite systems that support Customer Service across the Asia Pacific (APAC) region. Acting as the functional SME lead for APAC, this role owns the business process and user experience view of the end-to-end digital customer journey across diverse markets, customer segments, languages and levels of digital maturity. The role ensures platforms such as EDI, DSOS, SFDC, Genesys, OCR and related customer interaction channels are understood, governed, prioritised and improved in line with APAC market needs. Working closely with APAC Customer Service, Commercial, Supply Chain, Finance, Technology, the RPA/AI Lead and external customers, the role translates regional and market requirements into practical platform enhancements that improve ease of doing business, service efficiency, data quality, self-service adoption, assisted service effectiveness and customer experience.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Act as the functional SME lead for Customer Service digital platforms, self-service channels, assisted service tools and customer interaction channels across APAC.
* Provide business ownership and day-to-day coordination across EDI, customer portals, DSOS, SFDC, Genesys, OCR and related satellite systems supporting APAC digital ordering, self-service and assisted service.
* Maintain a clear view of platform performance, customer and user pain points, adoption trends, issue themes and enhancement priorities across APAC markets, recognising differences in market maturity, language, regulation and customer operating models.
* Engage APAC market and regional stakeholders to capture local requirements and translate them into clear business needs, user stories, process requirements and enhancement requests for Technology and delivery partners.
* Support regional governance, prioritisation and tracking of platform enhancements, balancing common APAC capabilities with justified local market requirements.
* Track and communicate the impact of improvements by market and across the region, including adoption, channel shift, service efficiency, issue reduction, data quality and customer experience outcomes.
* Partner with APAC Customer Service, Commercial, Supply Chain, Finance, Technology and external customers to resolve platform issues and improve digital ordering, self-service adoption and assisted service experiences.
* Work closely with the RPA/AI Lead to identify APAC platform processes, data flows and user journeys that could be improved through automation or AI-enabled solutions.
* Develop and maintain regionally consistent platform documentation, process flows, training materials and user guidance, with appropriate localisation to support adoption across APAC markets.
* Facilitate knowledge sharing and adoption of leading practices across APAC, enabling markets to reuse solutions and avoid unnecessary duplication.
* Provide insight, recommendations and escalation support to APAC Customer Service leadership on digital platform risks, opportunities, dependencies and investment priorities.

**Qualifications**
Education
  
  

* Required: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Operations, Analytics, or a related field.
* Preferred: Master’s degree (MBA or equivalent).

Experience and Skills
  
  
**Required**

* 4+ years of progressive experience in digital customer platforms, customer operations, customer service systems, analytics or related business functions, with demonstrable experience as a platform, process or customer operations SME.
* Hands-on experience supporting, improving or acting as business owner for customer-facing platforms, digital ordering channels, CRM tools or operational systems across multiple APAC markets or a similarly diverse region.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through expertise, influence and cross-functional collaboration across countries, cultures and time zones without direct senior manager accountability.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to use market data, user feedback and process insight to prioritise practical regional and local platform improvements.

**Preferred**

* Experience with EDI, customer portals, digital ordering platforms, self-service channels or assisted service tools in APAC.
* Familiarity with CRM, ERP, contact centre, workflow, analytics or customer interaction platforms.
* Experience in a regulated industry such as medical devices, healthcare or life sciences, including awareness of differing APAC market and regulatory requirements.
* Experience improving digital adoption, channel shift, user engagement or change management across markets with varying levels of digital maturity.
* Experience localising processes, training or platform solutions for different languages, customer models and market requirements.
* Knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma or continuous improvement methodologies.
* Demonstrated ability to coordinate complex, cross-functional platform or process improvements in a regional, matrixed environment.
* Excellent written, verbal and presentation communication skills, with the confidence to engage market and regional stakeholders.
* Ability to translate local customer pain points and business requirements into scalable regional platform improvements.

Other
  
  

* Language: English (required).
* Travel: Up to 25% international travel as required.
* Certifications: Digital CX, analytics, or project management certifications (preferred).

**Required Skills**
**Preferred Skills:**
Analytical Reasoning, Coaching, Communication, Customer Centricity, Customer Experience Management, Customer Retentions, Customer Support, Customer Support Operations, Customer Support Trends, Emerging Technologies, Issue Escalation, Presentation Development, Problem Solving, Service Request Management, Technical Support, Training People

* Lead and continuously improve quality management systems, processes, and governance to drive operational excellence and compliance.

title: Category Head (Corporate SCM)
description:

Responsible to formulate and drive a consistent approach towards all sourcing, purchasing and tendering activity within the Manufacturing category ensuring value add through cost savings. Oversee timely and cost-effective development of components as per desired standards. Inculcate the culture of developing Long Term Suppliers to help cater to Varroc's commercial interests

**1. Category annual planning**

▪ Proactively participate in the annual business planning meetings of the concerned BU to understand plans and derive material requirements

▪ Determine capacity basis the derived material need; devise a strategy to ensure timely and cost-effective fulfillment of the capacity requirement

▪ Work with the Global CSCO (Chief Supply Chain Officer) to finalize cost savings targets for the category aligned with business requirements

title: Director, IT Service Management
description:
**Your work days are brighter here.**
We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.
  
  
**About The Team**
The IT Service Management team is the cornerstone of business operations at Workday. This team defines, develops, and maintains critical capabilities to enable all IT and business teams to deliver outstanding internal IT services to Workday teams and customers. This includes responsibility for platforms like ServiceNow, New Relic, LogicMonitor and more to enable effective service management and deliver resilient IT Operations. The team is highly skilled, innovative, and strives to constantly improve efficiency by automating and streamlining operations, reducing manual effort, and developing intuitive, scalable solutions.
  
  
**About The Role**
As the Director of IT Service Management, you will play a leading role in defining the ITSM platform strategy and establishing IT product support standards across the organization. You will drive the adoption of ITSM practices to deliver operational excellence and maximize the value of the ITSM platform. You will champion the evolution of service delivery, ensuring all IT services are aligned with business needs and that all support activities adhere to established best practices and compliance requirements.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Champion ITSM and automation capabilities partnering with other IT and business teams such as End User Services, HR, Legal, Finance and Real Estate.
* Lead a team of skilled engineers, analysts and configuration experts harnessing the collective power of an impactful team.
* Develop and implement comprehensive application management policies and procedures to optimize service delivery and drive operational excellence.
* Champion the adoption of ITSM processes across all enterprise business applications to ensure consistency, reliability, and security.
* Define, own, and report on key metrics to track and communicate progress toward increasing efficiency, service maturity, and resilience.
* Partner with compliance, legal, SOX and audit teams to track, report and ensure compliance metrics for critical business operations
* Lead sophisticated cross functional efforts to transform operations and drive automation leveraging innovative technologies including AI to drive efficiency and realize significant cost savings
* Manage relationships with external service providers and vendors to ensure continuous improvement of service quality in a cost-effective manner.
* Partner with audit and compliance teams to track, report on, and ensure process adherence for all critical IT operations, maintaining an audit-ready posture.

* 8+ years of leadership experience in IT Service Management or Business Application Service Delivery in a large global organization.
* 8+ years of experience leading globally distributed teams that support a 24x7 operations model.
* 8+ years of hands-on experience with ServiceNow
* 15+ years of technical experience in IT software development and operations.

* Demonstrated experience leading the transformation of IT Operations practices, processes, and capabilities over time in a large-scale environment, with a strong understanding of ITSM practices and the ability to articulate implementation strategies.

* Excellent verbal and written communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate technical solutions to a variety of audiences and across multiple levels of the organization.

title: Aluminum Fabrication Supervisor
description:
**🌊 Job Opening: Aluminum Fabrication Supervisor**

**🕒 Full-time | On-site & Workshop / Project Site**

**Location: - Chakan, Pune**

About the Role

We are looking for a skilled and hands-on
**Aluminum Fabrication Supervisor with 2+ years**
of experience in aluminum fabrication, preferably in the marine or boat manufacturing industry.

The candidate will be responsible for supervising aluminum fabrication activities at the workshop as well as on-site during boat construction, assembly, installation, and outfitting. The role involves managing fabrication teams, coordinating with design and production departments, ensuring quality workmanship, and executing aluminum structural fabrication and installation as per engineering drawings and project requirements.

**Key Responsibilities:-**

1. Supervise day-to-day aluminum fabrication activities, including cutting, bending, rolling, welding, fit-up, and assembly.
2. Oversee fabrication of aluminum boat hulls, decks, cabins, bulkheads, railings, brackets, supports, and structural components.
3. Supervise aluminum fabrication and installation work at workshop facilities as well as project sites.
4. Coordinate and execute on-site aluminum structural fabrication, modification, repair, and installation activities.
5. Ensure fabrication and installation work is carried out as per engineering drawings, GA layouts, and fabrication drawings.
6. Coordinate with the nesting team for cutting plans, material utilization, and minimum material wastage.
7. Supervise MIG and TIG aluminum welding activities and ensure proper weld quality and structural integrity.
8. Monitor dimensional accuracy, alignment, fit-up, welding quality, and finishing of fabricated components.
9. Coordinate with design, production, hull assembly, electrical, and outfitting teams during different stages of boat manufacturing.
10. Manage manpower, including welders, fabricators, fitters, and workshop technicians.

11. Monitor daily production targets, work progress, manpower allocation, and fabrication schedules.

12. Identify and troubleshoot fabrication-related issues, including welding defects, dimensional mismatches, distortion, and alignment problems.

13. Ensure proper material handling, storage, tools, machinery, and consumables management at workshop and site.

14. Conduct quality inspections and ensure compliance with fabrication standards and project specifications.

15. Maintain fabrication progress reports, material consumption records, inspection reports, and daily work updates.

16. Ensure workplace safety, housekeeping, and safe working practices at workshop and project sites.

Requirements: -

1. Diploma / ITI / Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, or a related field.
2. Minimum 2 years of experience in aluminum fabrication, preferably in boat manufacturing, shipbuilding, or marine industries.
3. Strong knowledge of aluminum fabrication processes, including cutting, bending, welding, fit-up, and structural assembly.
4. Practical understanding of MIG and TIG welding processes for aluminum.
5. Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, GA layouts, and fabrication drawings.
6. Knowledge of aluminum sheets, plates, pipes, extrusions, and marine-grade aluminum materials.
7. Experience in supervising welders, fabricators, fitters, and technicians.
8. Ability to independently manage workshop and on-site fabrication activities.
9. Good coordination, manpower management, production planning, and problem-solving skills.
10. Willingness to travel to project sites and work on-site whenever required.

Preferred Skills:-

1. Experience in aluminum boat hull fabrication and marine structural assembly.
2. Knowledge of marine-grade aluminum alloys such as 5083, 5086, and 6061.
3. Experience in MIG/TIG welding of aluminum.
4. Familiarity with CNC plasma cutting, laser cutting, nesting software, and material optimization.
5. Knowledge of hull structures, bulkheads, stringers, transoms, decks, cabins, and marine fittings.
6. Understanding of welding distortion control, structural alignment, and fabrication tolerances.
7. Experience in on-site fabrication, installation, modification, and repair work.
8. Ability to coordinate independently with project managers, engineers, and production teams.

What We Offer:-

1. Opportunity to work on high-performance and custom aluminum and FRP boat manufacturing projects.
2. Competitive salary with growth opportunities.
3. Exposure to advanced marine fabrication and boat-building technologies.
4. Opportunities to work on exciting workshop and on-site marine projects.
5. Collaborative and learning-focused work environment.

title: Credit Manager
description:
The Credit Manager is responsible for the delivery of high quality, ongoing operation of the credit and collections processes, applied to customers in a range of geographic territories. This role will be responsible for proposing changes and improvements to the existing Credit Risk & Collection Strategy and rolling out processes and procedures which are aligned to the existing S&N Control framework.
  
  
The Credit Manager will work with a cross-functional stakeholder base (Finance, Commercial & Legal) to improve process and resolve issues to ensuring that the target Day-Sales-Outstanding is met.
  
  
The role will design appropriate governance structures to minimize bad debt exposure to S&N over the credit management process (including monitoring & management of credit limit balances, blocked order releases and annual credit limit re-approvals) and the Collection Strategy in conjunction with Collections Team Lead (including AR monitoring, collections, dispute management, bad debt provision calculation and AR write-off).
  
  
The role holder will own the identification and implementation of Continuous Improvement in the operational processes and performance. This will include monitoring and optimization of activities currently performed, review and approval of all relevant Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), mentoring and training GBS team members, and identification and migration of further activities as appropriate.
  
  
The role holder works in close unison with commercial team and finance business partner. Where appropriate the Credit Manager will visit select customers in person to negotiate payment plans and improvement in debt.
  
  
Responsibilities:
  
  

* Devise and manage operation of the Credit Management and Collections Strategy
* Close cooperation with commercial teams and key distributor customers
* Working with Collections Team Leads and Finance Operation Controller/Business Partner to set up and monitor monthly collections targets in line with a standard framework
* Operation and maintenance of Global Credit Management timetable of activities – including execution of key financial controls
* Minimize DSO, Aging and write off of debt
* Liaise with management in other functions (Sales, Customer Service, Order management) to improve the end-to-end process and unblock / resolve long running disputes and identify their root causes
* Manage customer credit limits in accordance with the Business Unit Strategy, ensuring sign off in alignment with Delegated Authority Matrix (DAM). Proactively monitor customer credit limit headroom to minimize blocked orders.
* Set the Business Unit rules and monitor compliance for the approval or Order Releases in accordance with the S&N Delegation of Authority Matrix. Embed rules within the system workflows, if not possible, design a compliant and efficient manual workflow approval process.
* Ensure appropriate governance structures are in place for disputed customer balances which lead to alternative payment arrangements (e.g. Payment plans), transfer of aged debt into the legal process, write-offs of debt.
* Ensure appropriate reporting is in place for teams to proactively monitor credit worthiness (AR ageing, credit limit headroom) and determine actions where there are changes in status that may impact DSO
* Review and approve SOPs
* Mentor and train Credit & Collections staff on market specifics and the localized collections strategy
* Creating procedures and policies that ensure timely payments while maintaining a high level of customer retention
* Act as an escalation point for commercial, Customer Service and OTC teams
* Site visits / face-to-face contact with key customers

Requirements:
  
  

* A minimum of 5 years' experience in Credit Management and Collections.
* Demonstrates experience in analyzing financial data, drawing sound conclusions and developing proposals/solutions.
* Must have strong credit control experience.
* Must be able to demonstrate past track record of success in Order-To-Cash cycle deliverables
* Must be able to demonstrate working knowledge of financial statements and key ratios relevant for credit risk analysis
* Knowledge of SAP FI/CO within order-to-cash space, or other industry standard ERP
* Must have experience of working with cross functional senior stakeholders and be able to effectively influence commercial business outcomes
* Accounting qualification is an asset
* Must be fluent in English and Spanish (Portuguese is an asset)

title: Expert Service Delivery Manager
description:
**Overview:**
The Service Delivery Manager is a senior operations position providing leadership for rotational team and collaborate with duty managers supporting 100+ clients on a rotating shift pattern, responsible for the efficient and professional execution of activities associated with providing an exceptional level of hospitality for clients' mission-critical systems. The Service Delivery Manager also serves as the accountable owner of Change Management governance for the entire business unit under the Altera Cloud Operations Change Management Process (v2.1) — chairing the Technical Review Board (TRB), overseeing implementation and validation, and holding final closure authority across all towers and shifts.
  
  
Change Implementation, Validation & Closure
  
  

* Facilitate TRB meeting for change reviews across cloud BU.
* Staff and lead the Hosting Response Bridge (HRB), providing 24x7 monitoring across the post-change stability window; trigger swarms the moment an anomaly is detected.
* Enforce alert-suppression discipline and confirm pre-change baseline capture and post-change comparison before closure.
* Oversee validation against Validation Test Library pass/fail criteria and evidence — including mandatory application and technical validation for production changes.
* Hold final closure authority: confirm the 24-hour or TRB approved closure window with HRB observation if the change was clean and evidence is complete before authorizing closure; refuse closure otherwise.
* Invoke rollback directly against a pre-agreed trigger without further approval; escalate exceptions to the Tower Leader.
* Carry open items into shift handover with clear owners so closure is never missed across a shift boundary.

Operational Leadership & Incident Management
  
  

* Major incident / critical issue early detection and fast remediation for all matters during their shift.
* Ensure all client requests, incidents, and problems are addressed in a timely and professional manner.
* Run stand-up calls with their team, managing proper hand-over of activities and client status between shifts and teams.
* Allocate resources as necessary across teams to provide efficient, effective resolution of issues.
* Identify and implement operational process improvements across teams.
* Assist Shift Site Reliability Engineers with client communication and escalations.
* Drive results through agreed KPIs for alerts, monitoring tools, and case/ServiceNow (SNOW) metrics.

TRB Ownership & Change Process Governance
  
  

* Chair the Technical Review Board: the final gate reviewing risk classification, architectural impact, rollback adequacy, and monitoring plan for every change; approve, send back for rework, or escalate.
* Pre-agree and record rollback triggers at TRB, each with a maximum time-to-decide.
* Own and continuously improve the end-to-end process, intake template, and Validation Test Library across all towers.
* Track and report TRB gate-hold and rework rates monthly; a near-zero rework rate signals the board is a formality, not a control.

People Management
  
  

* Provide detailed and accurate job performance feedback for each resource working under their guidance.
* Supervise employee attendance and participation.
* Inspire and motivate employees on their rotating shift.

Reporting Relationships
  
  
The Service Delivery Manager has primary responsibility for the rating and review of each employee dedicated to rotating with them, with input from the Tower Manager. The Tower Manager is accountable for best practices, effective training/testing, and the overall architecture and direction of their service delivery tower, and provides functional direction and input into employee ratings. Employees have a hard-line reporting relationship into their Tower Manager, with a dotted line to the Service Delivery Manager.
  
  
Metrics Ownership
  
  

* Report monthly: peer-review SLA breaches, TRB gate-hold/rework rates, closure refusals, change success and change-caused incident rates (24-hr/7-day), rollback invocation/success rate, and process exceptions by tower, alongside case/SNOW and alerting KPIs.
* Success rate for changes driven thought TRB , all changes should be successful.
* Bi-weekly reporting of change management team control deck.

title: Engineering Manager VP
description:

Accountable for engineering strategy, delivery execution, engineering excellence, people leadership, architecture governance, and AI-enabled productivity improvements across the software development lifecycle.
  
  
To be successful as an Engineering Manager VP , you should have experience with:
  
  
  

* Own end-to-end delivery across multiple feature teams.
* Ensure delivery against business outcomes, OKRs, and strategic priorities.
* Govern engineering metrics including velocity, predictability, quality, deployment frequency, and operational stability.
* Manage delivery risks, dependencies, technical debt, incidents, and production support.
* Provide technical leadership across front-end, back-end, API, integration, and cloud technologies.
* Drive architecture reviews and ensure solutions are scalable, resilient, secure, and maintainable.
* Promote reusable platforms, frameworks, and engineering standards.
* Guide teams on modern engineering practices and technology adoption.

* Enable AI-assisted code generation, testing, impact analysis, documentation, and knowledge management.
* Continuously improve engineering efficiency and developer experience.
* Establish and govern standards across design, development, testing, DevOps, security, and reliability engineering.
* Drive platform stability, observability, and operational excellence.
* Reduce technical debt and improve maintainability across applications and services.
* Promote continuous improvement through metrics-driven engineering practices.
* Lead Engineering Managers, Software Engineers, QA Engineers, and Scrum Masters.
* Build high-performing, inclusive, and collaborative engineering teams.
* Drive talent development, succession planning, coaching, and mentoring.
* Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, and continuous learning.

**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**

* Extensive experience in software engineering with proven experience leading multiple engineering teams and managers.
* Strong track record of delivering large-scale digital transformation programmes.
* Experience driving engineering strategy and organisational change.
* Java, Spring Boot, and Microservices Architecture.
* Angular, React, and modern front-end frameworks.
* API-led and event-driven architecture.
* Cloud platforms (AWS).
* DevOps, CI/CD, SRE, and Observability.
* Secure and resilient software engineering practices.

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
The role is based out of Pune.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To lead and manage engineering teams, providing technical guidance, mentorship, and support to ensure the delivery of high-quality software solutions, driving technical excellence, fostering a culture of innovation, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to align technical decisions with business objectives.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Lead engineering teams effectively, fostering a collaborative and high-performance culture to achieve project goals and meet organizational objectives.
* Oversee timelines, team allocation, risk management and task prioritization to ensure the successful delivery of solutions within scope, time, and budget.
* Mentor and support team members' professional growth, conduct performance reviews, provide actionable feedback, and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Evaluation and enhancement of engineering processes, tools, and methodologies to increase efficiency, streamline workflows, and optimize team productivity.
* Collaboration with business partners, product managers, designers, and other stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions and ensure a cohesive approach to product development.
* Enforcement of technology standards, facilitate peer reviews, and implement robust testing practices to ensure the delivery of high-quality solutions.

**Vice President Expectations**

* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.

* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. description:

: Pune

Strong understanding of quality assurance principles, food safety regulations, and industry best practices.
  
  
Excellent attention to detail and a passion for maintaining high-quality standards.
  
  
Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify root causes and implement effective solutions.
  
  
Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills to manage a team and collaborate cross-functionally.
  
  
Proficiency in quality management systems and tools, as well as Microsoft Office Suite.
  
  
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and adapt quickly to changes.

Working at a Farm is fun and not quite literally though. But here we go with all the reasons that will help you choose Sid’s Farm as your preferred workplace.

that commitment and creativity.

Working in a growing D2C Brand just elevates your learning curve by leaps and

bounds.

* Doing what you Love - Here you will always end up doing what you love and in a more liberal way. Ideas and actions have no boundaries here as long as you have figured it all out.

title: VP - Statutory Accounting & Audit Lead
description:
**Who We Are**
VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About This Role**
We are seeking a Statutory Reporting & Audit Lead to lead the statutory reporting, statutory accounts production and audit coordination model across multiple supported markets within the VOIS Record to Report organisation. This role is responsible for ensuring statutory reporting calendars, audit readiness, evidence management, PBC workflows, filing mechanics and delivery governance are executed through a consistent and controlled operating model. The successful candidate will work closely with GFC, MFC, Chief Accountants, HOFOs, external auditors and finance stakeholders to deliver high-quality statutory reporting while maintaining clear ownership boundaries between production activities and accounting judgement, disclosure approvals and statutory sign-off responsibilities.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Lead the VOIS statutory production and audit coordination operating model across supported markets, ensuring robust governance, clear ownership and delivery discipline
* Establish and maintain a hub-and-spoke statutory reporting model, coordinating central production activities and local statutory support where required
* Manage statutory reporting calendars, milestones, dependencies, audit plans and escalation frameworks to ensure timely delivery against internal and local deadlines
* Coordinate statutory reporting activities across statutory teams, ARC, R2R, HOFOs, GFC, MFC, Chief Accountants and other finance stakeholders
* Drive statutory accounts preparation, including pack builds, financial statement drafts, note preparation support, tie-out processes and version control
* Standardise statutory reporting templates, working papers, evidence repositories and production artefacts wherever possible while accommodating local regulatory requirements
* Lead audit evidence management, PBC workflows and audit query tracking to ensure timely response and closure of audit requirements
* Coordinate external audit activities, ensuring production-related requests are resolved efficiently while routing accounting judgement and disclosure matters to the appropriate owners
* Manage statutory filing mechanics within VOIS scope, including filing calendars, submission preparation, proof-of-submission tracking and document retention requirements
* Maintain visibility of statutory readiness, open risks, delivery challenges and escalation requirements through structured governance and stakeholder reporting

**Who You Are**

* Experienced in statutory reporting, financial reporting, audit coordination, controllership, Record to Report operations or related finance disciplines within complex multi-entity environments
* Strong understanding of statutory accounts preparation, audit workflows, PBC management, filing processes, financial close activities and balance sheet substantiation
* Good knowledge of IFRS and local GAAP reporting environments, with the ability to differentiate between statutory production activities and technical accounting ownership
* Proven people leadership experience, including leading geographically distributed teams through demanding reporting and audit cycles
* Skilled in stakeholder management, influencing and collaboration across finance leadership, statutory reporting teams, external auditors and cross-functional partners
* Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities, regulatory deadlines, audit pressures and cross-market delivery requirements
* Experienced in process standardisation, governance implementation, issue resolution and operational excellence
* Finance, accounting or business qualification required; professional accounting qualification preferred
* Experience supporting external audits, evidence management, audit request resolution and issue closure

**Not a perfect fit?**
Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
  
  
**What's In It For You**

* Opportunity to lead a strategically important statutory reporting and audit coordination capability across multiple international markets
* Exposure to senior finance stakeholders including finance directors, chief accountants, HOFOs, audit partners and global finance leadership
* Influence the development of a scalable post-transformation statutory reporting operating model
* Opportunity to lead high-performing teams and drive standardisation, governance and operational excellence initiatives
* Work within a complex global organisation delivering meaningful impact on statutory compliance, audit readiness and stakeholder confidence
* Flexible location model with broad international collaboration and visibility

**What Skills You Will Learn**

* Advanced multi-market statutory reporting and audit coordination leadership
* Governance, risk management and escalation management within global finance operations
* Regulatory filing coordination across diverse statutory environments
* Large-scale stakeholder management, influencing and matrix leadership
* Continuous improvement, process harmonisation and operating model design
* Audit readiness management, evidence governance and control optimisation
* Global finance transformation and shared services delivery excellence

**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background.
  
  
**Join Us**
At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
  
  
We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
  
  
With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.

The Opportunity

As Procurement Operations Capability Lead you’ll build an end-to-end consistent, high-quality Business Analysis capability across Global Procurement. The role sets the methods, standards, skills and reusable deliverables that turn Procurement strategy and business needs into clear operating model choices and decision-ready recommendations. Working with senior stakeholders across Procurement and partner functions you’ll connect strategy, controls, data and technology considerations into coherent choices. Success looks like practical standards that are adopted across Procurement, high-quality reusable analysis assets and increased stakeholder confidence in decisions and outcomes.

What you'll be doing

* Define and maintain the Global Procurement Business Analysis capability strategy, maturity roadmap, operating approach and service proposition
* Establish standards, methods, templates, quality criteria and governance for analysis work and ensure consistent adoption across Procurement
* Build core reusable deliverables including capability maps, value streams, target operating models, journeys, process and service models and business requirements
