* Evaluate the current Procurement landscape to identify capability gaps, duplication, fragmentation, control weaknesses and simplification opportunities
* Create evidence-based options, impact assessments, trade-offs, benefits hypotheses and recommendations to support prioritisation and investment decisions
* Provide assurance and constructive challenge on the completeness, traceability, coherence and quality of analysis and operating model deliverables
* Build a community of practice that enables coaching, mentoring, peer review, knowledge sharing and reuse of proven approaches and assets

What we're looking for

* Bring significant experience in Business Analysis, operating model development, capability planning or a related discipline within a large complex organisation
* Demonstrate experience establishing and improving a Business Analysis practice including methods, standards, templates, assurance and competency development
* Apply strong working knowledge of procurement processes and services including sourcing, procure to pay, third-party management, supplier management or procurement operations
* Show proven expertise in capability mapping, value-stream analysis, target operating models, process and service modelling, requirements elicitation, options analysis and impact assessment
* Convert incomplete or complex information into coherent analysis, clear choices and decision-ready recommendations
* Use structured problem-solving, commercial judgement, facilitation, visualisation and storytelling to communicate complex work with clarity
* Define competency expectations and learning pathways and build skills through coaching, mentoring and feedback
* Partner effectively across business, technology, data, finance, risk and control disciplines and influence senior stakeholders

Building Procurement capability at scale

This role gives you the scope to set how analysis work is done across Global Procurement - from standards and governance through to the reusable assets teams rely on to make decisions. You’ll help create clearer operating model choices and more consistent delivery by strengthening traceability, quality and reuse. If you want to shape how Procurement turns strategy into practical designs and investment decisions we’d like to hear from you.

title: Product Development Manager, Rugs and Home Textiles
description:
**ABOUT QUINCE**
Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.
  
  
What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.
  
  
**OUR CULTURE**
Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.
  
  

* We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
* Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
* Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.
  
  
**Product Development Manager, Rugs and Home Textile**
Quince is a US-based, hyper-growth tech retail start-up experiencing 100%+ YoY growth and serving millions of users each month. Backed by over USD 500 million in funding, we continue to scale rapidly. At Quince, we didn’t just build a $2B+ retail brand—we completely rewrote the playbook on cross-border e-commerce.
  
  
We are seeking a
**Product Development Manager, Rugs and Home Textile**
to join our growing team at Quince. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring products are launched in a timely manner while achieving the highest quality standards.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Own and actively manage day-to-day product development timelines across new products, color and size extensions, vendor transitions, and refreshes, tracking milestones and escalating risks early.
* Serve as the central point of coordination across Merchandising, Sourcing, Fit, Technical Development, Materials, QA, Creative, and Vendors to ensure alignment on development status and dependencies.
* Ensure all required product documentation is accurate, complete, and ready prior to vendor handoff, including technical specifications, build documentation, testing requirements, and fit inputs.
* Coordinate and track all sample requests, shipments, reviews, fit requests, and revisions to drive efficiency and maintain momentum toward target timelines.
* Facilitate timely product reviews and approvals by Merchandising, Fit, and Technical teams; track testing requests and results to ensure quality outcomes are clearly communicated.
* Run in-person country development trips with Global Merchants, Global Fit, and Local PD teams to accelerate decision-making and strengthen vendor execution.
* Partner with Sourcing to support timely staging of materials and finished-goods production; coordinate delivery of photo samples to Creative to ensure marketing and launch readiness.
* Maintain clean, accurate, real-time data across all product development systems and tracking tools to ensure transparency and support fast execution.

**Qualifications required:**

* 10+ years in product development or factory-facing roles
* Deep functional category expertise, including product and material standards
* Extensive experience working directly with factories and sample rooms
* Comfortable operating independently and navigating ambiguity Highly organized, detail-oriented and analytical with focus on execution, problem-solving, improving processes and quality enhancement
* Clear communicator across language, cultural, and functional boundaries
* Proven track record of progressing within an organization and demonstrating continuous growth in roles and responsibilities
* Continuous learner and highly curious; always open to considering new perspectives; proactive when changing course and facing added challenges
* Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills
* Motivated by working in a fast-paced collaborative environment, where flexibility to stretch into or out of functional comfort zones is crucial for team success
* Bachelor’s Degree, preferred

**WHY QUINCE?**
Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.
  
  
**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY**
Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.
  
  
Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.
  
  
Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.
  
  
*Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds*
At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. title: Electrical Manager-Solar (Electrical DC & AC)
description:
**Objective:**

As Design Lead (Electrical – DC & AC), the person shall be capable of reviewing & executing Engineering Activities covering both DC and AC scope of Solar PV Power Plants — including Generation Estimate, Overall Plant Layout, DC SLD, Solar Module Selection, Inverter Sizing, SMB, AC SLD, Building Layouts, Earthing Layouts, Cable Sizing Calculations, Transformer Sizing, and LT / HT Breakers. She / He shall facilitate the modellers in development of BIM 3D Model for PV Solar Power plants. In addition, she / he has to coordinate with other departments including Inter-departmental checks covering Civil / Structural, Instrumentation, MEP and others.

She / He shall lead a team of Design Engineers and Draughts Persons to manage the Engineering activities within budget, deliver on time and maintaining a high quality of engineering.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Timely Delivery of Engineering Drawings & Documents
* Ensure deliveries are aligned to Project Schedule
* Review drawings by Design Engineers & Draughts Persons. Checking of design & sizing calculations of engineering electrical equipment (DC & AC) and obtaining approvals from the client
* Review of Vendor deliverables pertaining to Engineering
* Capable of Multitasking and deliver multiple things on time
* Estimate and Plan man-hour requirements
* Review BOQ and submit to contracts team and providing technical clarifications
* Coordinate with multiple disciplines for ensuring inter-departmental checks
* Provide support & clarifications to the Site Execution team
* Check pre-award evaluation of vendors (w.r.t. technical specifications requirement of the client) and forward the validation document to Supply Chain Management
* Inspect equipment from the finalized vendor after submission of validation document of the vendor
* Clarify issues w.r.t. the design & requirements of the client to the Site Execution Team
* Collect inputs for project details (plot details, feeder arrangements etc.) from client & Project Engineering Manager
* Coordinating with Operations team and informing Design specifications for obtaining approval
* Collect inputs for project details (General Arrangement Drawings) from Vendors
* Check deliverables such as Equipment Layouts, Cable Routing Layout, Cable Tray Layout, Earthing Layout, Lighting Layout & Lightning Protection Layout
* Provide support to Civil / Structural for reviewing Vendor drawings
* Submit requirement of man-hours for undertaking & reviewing of design & drawings of the project

**Technical Expertise**

The Design Lead (Electrical DC & AC) is required to have an overall knowledge of equipment layouts and necessary calculations.

The Design Lead (Electrical DC & AC) should have detailed knowledge of Solar PV Power Plants, with understanding of engineering activities covering Generation Estimate, Overall Plant Layout, DC SLD, Solar Module Selection, Inverter Sizing, SMB, Earthing Layouts, Cable Sizing Calculations, SLD Preparation, Layout Engineering, Cable Routing, Lighting, Lightning Protection, and Cable Tray Routing. She / he should be capable of performing design & sizing calculations of Busbar, UPS, Battery, LT Transformer, Earthing Conductor (including Short Circuit Force calculations).

The Design Lead (Electrical DC & AC) is required to have knowledge on National and International Codes and Standards, and must understand and interpret the contractual technical requirements to facilitate the Project Teams as and when required.

In addition, the Design Lead (Electrical DC & AC) should also have an overall understanding of the inter-disciplinary (Civil & Structural, Mechanical and Instrumentation) design aspects of electrical equipment.

title: Director of Vendor Program Management, 2 Hour Learning (Remote) - $200,000/year USD
description:
You’ve built dashboards. Tracked milestones. Chased vendors. Flagged risks. But your reports hit a ceiling. You weren’t the one making the calls.
  
  
2 Hour Learning is building an AI-powered education model designed to help students achieve a full day of academic progress in just two hours. Making that model work at scale requires dozens of initiatives, technology partners, contracts, and investment decisions to move in sync. Your job is to make the execution layer trustworthy enough for executives to act on it.
  
  
You will own the operating outputs behind those decisions: portfolio dashboards that expose slippage before it becomes a surprise, vendor scorecards tied to real contractual commitments, competitive bid packages that make trade-offs clear, and contract controls that prevent unsupported spend. AI will be part of your daily workflow, helping you standardize updates, detect anomalies, compare bids, analyze vendor performance, and validate invoices.
  
  
This is not a PMO role built around meetings, process compliance, or polished status decks. It is for an operator who wants their work to have consequences. When a vendor underperforms, your evidence should make that obvious. When spend drifts from the contract, your controls should catch it. When executives need to make a $5M decision, your outputs should give them the confidence to make it fast. If that sounds like the level of ownership you have been looking for, apply.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing**

* Own portfolio-level dashboards across 10+ concurrent initiatives, using AI to standardize updates, detect slippage, expose blockers, and maintain a trusted executive view of delivery, budget, and risk
* Run recurring vendor performance reviews and maintain rubric-based scorecards that combine delivery, quality, cost, contractual commitments, and qualitative performance signals
* Lead competitive technology-vendor procurement, including structured bid packages, normalized comparisons, scoring rubrics, SOW development, and evidence-backed recommendations
* Govern contracts and invoices by tracking fee caps, milestones, acceptance criteria, and amendments, then validating invoices against signed terms before spend is approved
* Use AI daily to analyze portfolio data, detect anomalies, surface underperformance, draft decision-ready outputs, and reduce manual PMO administration

**What You Won’t Be Doing**

* Producing status reports that executives read but never use to make decisions
* Running a meeting-heavy PMO where coordination matters more than measurable execution
* Treating vendor management as relationship maintenance while missed commitments go unchallenged
* Passing contracts, SOWs, invoices, or procurement decisions to someone else because they look too commercial or technical
* Using AI as an occasional productivity trick instead of a core part of how you operate

**Director Of Vendor Program Management Key Responsibilities**
Produce reliable, AI-powered dashboards, scorecards, procurement packages, and contract controls that give executives the clarity and leverage to hold vendors accountable, control costs, and accelerate delivery across a $50M EdTech portfolio.
  
  
**Basic Requirements**

* Directly owned a portfolio of 10+ concurrent initiatives with at least $5M in budget responsibility, including authority over budget allocation, vendor selection, or initiative prioritization
* Managed 5+ external technology vendors at the same time, such as SaaS providers, AI/ML platforms, marketing agencies, or engineering firms
* Built and maintained portfolio-level dashboards covering metrics such as delivery health, budget burn versus forecast, milestone completion, and major risks or blockers
* Can point to a case where C-suite leaders used your portfolio data to make a go/no-go decision on a vendor renewal, budget reallocation, or initiative deprioritization
* Directly led competitive technology procurement, including structured bid evaluation, vendor scoring, negotiation, and selection
* Authored or co-authored SOWs with measurable deliverables, milestone payments, SLAs, acceptance criteria, or other performance-based terms
* Negotiated commercial terms such as pricing, penalties, fee caps, or exit clauses and enforced those terms through invoice validation or corrective action
* Strong written communication skills, with the ability to turn complex financial and operational data into concise recommendations executives can act on
* Able to analyze financial and vendor-performance data quickly enough to recommend optimization, reallocation, or vendor elimination
* Able to work US business hours

**Nice-to-have Requirements**

* Experience using AI-enabled dashboards, anomaly detection, predictive alerts, or natural-language analysis in portfolio management
* Experience in EdTech, technology, consulting, or another environment managing complex portfolios of external technology partners
* Fluency with portfolio and delivery tools such as Linear, Jira, or similar systems

**About 2 Hour Learning**
Education is broken, but 2 Hour Learning is proving it doesn’t have to be. They’re tearing down the outdated one-size-fits-all model and replacing it with AI-driven personalized learning that helps kids master academics in just two hours a day.
  
  
**With students consistently ranking in the top 1-2% nationally and the top 20% achieving an astonishing 6.5x growth, they’re proving that smarter learning is possible. At 2 Hour Learning, it’s talent and performance that matter.**
They offer a dynamic, on-campus and remote-friendly environment where innovators, educators, and AI specialists can be a part of fixing a broken school system.
  
  
**2 Hour Learning is reprogramming learning for the AI era.**
**Here’s How They’re Fixing It.**
There is so much to cover for this exciting role, and space here is limited. Hit the Apply button if you found this interesting and want to learn more. We look forward to meeting you!
  
  
**Working with us**
This is a full-time (40 hours per week), long-term position. The position is immediately available and requires entering into an independent contractor agreement with Crossover as a Contractor of Record. The compensation level for this role is $100 USD/hour, which equates to $200,000 USD/year assuming 40 hours per week and 50 weeks per year. The payment period is weekly. Day-to-day tasks include analyzing retention data and trends, segmenting audiences, and designing campaigns to reduce churn and increase lifetime value. The Retention Manager will collaborate with fundraising, communications, and program teams to enhance supporter experience, manage feedback channels, and resolve issues promptly and professionally. The role also involves preparing regular performance reports, recommending improvements, and contributing to process optimization to strengthen overall relationship management.

**Job Title:**
Manager Retention (Acquisition)

**Company:**
Plan International (India Chapter)

**Location:**
Kailash Colony, New Delhi

**Job Description:**
Plan International India is looking for a target-oriented and experienced Manager – Retention to lead donor retention, engagement, and reactivation initiatives. The role involves managing calling teams, strengthening donor relationships, improving retention rates, and achieving fundraising and revenue targets.

The ideal candidate will have strong leadership skills, experience managing calling teams, and a proven track record in donor/customer retention, fundraising, or relationship management.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Develop and implement strategies to improve donor retention, reactivation, and engagement.
* Drive daily, weekly, monthly, and annual retention and revenue targets.
* Lead, train, motivate, and manage calling teams to achieve performance goals.
* Oversee donor acquisition, retention, and reactivation calling activities.
* Ensure accurate donor data management, CRM updates, and reporting.
* Build strong relationships with donors and resolve queries and escalations.
* Monitor team productivity, call quality, attendance, and performance.
* Analyze donor data to identify retention trends and reduce donor attrition.
* Organize donor engagement activities, corporate events, and donor meets.

**Requirements**

Team Leadership & People Management

* Donor/Customer Retention
* Fundraising & Relationship Management
* Calling Team Management
* CRM & Data Management
* Performance Monitoring & Reporting
* Target Achievement & Team Motivation

Interested candidates who meet the above criteria are encouraged to apply through LinkedIn with their updated resume.

title: Associate Director– Private Sector Partnerships
description:
**1. POSITION VACANT: Associate Director– Private Sector Partnerships, Ipas Development Foundation, New Delhi**

**2. ORGANIZATION BACKGROUND:**

**Ipas Development Foundation (IDF)**
has been working in India since 2001 to strengthen the sexual and reproductive health (SRH) ecosystem. In close collaboration with national and state governments, and through partnerships with public health systems and civil society organisations,
**IDF**
works to enhance access to comprehensive abortion care and choice-based contraception.

**IDF’s**
work spans comprehensive abortion care, comprehensive contraceptive care, youth-focused sexual and reproductive health, technical assistance to the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, and research and evidence building. The organisation’s interventions reach over 500,000 women and girls annually, contributing to improved health outcomes and expanded reproductive choice.

**IDF**
has been consistently recognized among India’s
**Best NGOs to Work For**
by the
**Great Place to Work Institute**
since 2017 and has also been honoured as a Social Impact Icon. The organization has featured five times in the prestigious list of
**India’s Great Mid-Size Workplaces**
and has been recognized as one of
**India’s Best Workplaces for Women**
for three consecutive years.

For more information about
**IDF**
, please visit: https://www.ipasdevelopmentfoundation.org/

**3. JOB DESCRIPTION/ RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**IDF**
is seeking to recruit an
**Associate Director– Private Sector Partnerships**
to lead partner and stakeholder engagement for a project on Heavy Menstrual Bleeding (HMB) Care

Heavy menstrual bleeding (HMB) is common but remains under-diagnosed and under-treated. IDF is implementing the HMB Care Program across selected districts of Bihar and Uttar Pradesh.

The incumbent will lead coordination with strategic & technical partners, suppliers and other institutional stakeholders, while supporting provider engagement and monitoring key programme indicators to track progress towards strengthening the private-sector ecosystem for quality HMB care.

The position will report to the
**Chief Program Officer**
and work closely with
**IDF’s**
technical, research and evaluation, communications and state teams.

The role calls for a
**senior, relationship-oriented public health professional**
with the ability to engage credibly with professional associations, healthcare providers, suppliers and technical experts, and effectively coordinate diverse stakeholders to ensure strong partnerships and smooth programme implementation.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**A. Partnerships, Stakeholder Engagement and Technical Collaboration:**

(1) Serve as IDF’s primary senior-level point of contact with project partners at national, state and district levels, building on the existing relationship and engaging with its senior leadership,

(2) Coordinate with technical partners, and implementation partners on the development, review and dissemination of training packages, treatment protocols, job aids, clinical resources and provider communication on HMB management,

(3) Facilitate coordination with professional medical associations at district, state and national levels to support provider engagement, technical sessions, conferences, webinars and other professional forums.

(4) Engage with suppliers (manufacturers and distributors) and other relevant stakeholders on product availability, provider requirements, pricing transparency, training needs and emerging market challenges, while maintaining IDF’s neutrality and adhering to its guidelines on engagement with commercial entities;

(5) Participate in partner meetings and periodic reviews, document key decisions and track agreed actions to closure.

**B. Program Coordination and Implementation Support:**

(1) Translate programme priorities into activity plans, timelines and partner deliverables, and track progress against the internal workplan;

(2) Coordinate with IDF’s technical, research and evaluation, demand-generation and communications teams to ensure alignment across workstreams and timely completion of trainings and other activities;

(3) Work with the Bihar and Uttar Pradesh state teams to support key rollout decisions and the implementation of provider engagement, capacity-building and awareness-generation activities;

(4) Identify implementation bottlenecks and facilitate timely resolution, or escalation to management where required;

(5) Contribute to documentation of implementation experiences, good practices and lessons learned.

**C. Monitoring, Reporting and Learning:**

(1) Monitor agreed programme indicators and milestones relating to partner engagement, provider participation, technical material development, awareness activities, service delivery, referrals, and product availability and pricing, as relevant to the role;

(2) Coordinate with state teams, partners and IDF’s research and evaluation colleagues to obtain timely and reliable programme data;

(3) Review progress against indicators, identify gaps and flag issues requiring management attention or corrective action;

(4) Prepare periodic progress updates, partner review presentations and programme reports;

(5) Contribute to documenting programme learnings and evidence to inform improvements in implementation and potential replication in other geographies.

**4. QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE AND COMPETENCIES:**

**Qualifications:**

A postgraduate degree in public health, health management, social sciences, management or a related discipline.

**Experience:**

(1) At least 10–12 years of experience in public health, healthcare partnerships, private-sector health programmes, healthcare market development or related fields, including substantial responsibility for managing external partnerships and multi-stakeholder initiatives;

(2) Demonstrated experience of engaging professional associations or healthcare provider bodies and networks at a senior level, with tangible outcomes such as jointly developed technical materials, CMEs, conferences or webinars;

(3) Working understanding of women’s and reproductive health, family planning or related clinical service delivery, sufficient to engage credibly with medical professionals. Deep clinical expertise is not required;

(4) Experience of coordinating multiple partners and internal teams, tracking agreed actions to completion and working to a programme workplan and indicators;

(5) Strong report-writing, presentation and documentation skills;

(6) Familiarity with the health systems and private-provider landscape of Bihar and Uttar Pradesh;

(7) Experience of coordinating with government health systems; experience supporting provider capacity-building and technical-material development; exposure to monitoring and evaluation, digital-first demand generation or private-sector health market development.

**Key Competencies:**

(1) Senior stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to build trust with senior medical professionals and commercial partners;

(2) Strong coordination, follow-through and problem-solving skills across multidisciplinary teams and geographies;

(3) Excellent written and verbal communication;

(4) Sound analytical skills and comfort with indicators, data and progress tracking;

(5) Integrity, neutrality and sound judgement in dealings with commercial entities;

(6) Ability to work independently in an early-stage programme and to take decisions in consultation with field teams;

(7) Willingness to travel frequently;

(8) A strong interest in public health and women’s health and commitment to IDF’s mission and values.

**5. IDEAL CANDIDATE:**

The ideal candidate will be a senior, relationship-oriented public health professional with experience of working with professional associations or provider networks, an understanding of women’s and reproductive health, and the discipline to run a multi-partner; multi location programme to defined indicators.

S/he should be able to serve as a dependable senior-level interface with partners, engage with suppliers on market-related issues while safeguarding IDF’s neutrality, and coordinate effectively across IDF’s technical, research and state teams to ensure smooth programme implementation.

The role will suit someone who is comfortable with frequent travel, communicates clearly and credibly with both clinicians and programme teams, and has a genuine interest in IDF’s mission.

**6. COMPENSATION OFFERED:**

The gross compensation budgeted for the position is up to Rs. 25 lacs per annum. The offer made to the selected candidate shall be commensurate with qualifications, experience, and salary history.

**7. LOCATION: New Delhi**

The role requires frequent travel, primarily to Mumbai and programme districts in Bihar and Uttar Pradesh, potentially involving up to 8–10 days of travel per month.

**8. REFERENCE: AD-PSP-IDF**

**9. CONTACT INFORMATION:**

Team SAMS

1/1B, Choudhary Hetram House, Bharat Nagar

New Friends Colony, New Delhi 110 025

Phone Nos.: 011- 4081 9900; 4081 9926

Eligible candidates interested in the position are requested to apply through the SAMS recruitment platform using the link below by the prescribed closing date.

https://www.samsstc.com/Jobs/job-description/associate-director-private-sector-partnerships-ipas-development-foundation-new-delhi-delhi/883

title: Programme Lead- Technology Futures
company: Council on Energy, Environment and Water (CEEW)
description:
**Purpose**

CEEW seeks to hire a suitable candidate for the Programme Lead position to anchor its work on critical minerals within the Technology Futures team. Working with the Team Lead for Technology Futures, the Programme Lead will help shape the research direction of the programme, track global market developments, and lead robust quantitative and qualitative analyses of new and upcoming critical minerals and clean energy technologies.

On critical minerals, the successful applicant will be expected to develop the team's expertise on mineral use beyond the clean energy sector and conduct analyses that detail the impact of competing use cases on India's energy transition. On clean energy technologies, the applicant will build detailed expertise on market movements, technology and material changes, and the geopolitics that can affect the competitiveness of India's manufacturing sector. The Programme Lead will also conceptualise and identify policy recommendations to support Indian policymakers in bringing new technology to India and scaling up domestic manufacturing, explore work with various stakeholders to conceptualise pilot projects for new technologies, and develop innovative market and financing solutions to support the energy transition.

We are looking for an experienced professional with hands-on experience and deep sectoral understanding, who can mentor a young team, work with donors and network with key stakeholders across government, industry and the investment community. In addition to the responsibilities outlined below, the candidate should be prepared to be agile responding to emerging national and global developments and taking on additional responsibilities as this workstream evolves.

**Job Duties and Accountabilities**

**Strategic leadership**

* Constantly review developments in the ecosystem linked with clean energy manufacturing and critical minerals, through the varied lenses of geopolitics, technology, economics, equity and jobs.
* Based on market tracking, identify new areas of opportunity for the Indian and global clean energy industry, and develop policy roadmaps to deploy new technology successfully.
* Conceptualise and identify policy recommendations that support Indian policymakers in bringing new technology to India and scaling up domestic manufacturing.
* Explore work with various stakeholders to conceptualise pilot projects for new technologies, and develop innovative market and financing solutions to support the energy transition.
* Support the Team Lead for Technology Futures in mentoring a growing and young team, and work closely with other teams such as Energy Transition, Power Markets and Industrial Sustainability.
* Participate in relevant conferences, workshops and training programmes as necessary to communicate research findings and gain insights on new research in focus areas.
* Take on responsibilities beyond research and research engagement to ensure the smooth functioning of the office.

**Research**

* Conceptualise original research projects and/or programmes in line with the internally approved strategy, and lead at least three research projects per year.
* Write reports, papers, issue briefs and policy briefs, with a minimum of three published papers or reports.
* Develop the team's expertise on mineral use beyond the clean energy sector, and analyse the impact of competing use cases on India's energy transition.
* Build detailed expertise on market movements, technology and material changes, and geopolitics, along the clean technology value chain exploration, mining, processing, procurement, manufacturing, deployment, reuse and recycling.
* Design primary data collection, data collation and analysis as necessary to drive novel research.
* Develop strong relationships with researchers and with industry, government and international agencies.
* Collaborative research is vital to this role, and establishing joint research or evaluation studies with other civil society organisations, industry or government agencies is an important part of it.

**Outreach**

* Co-design and execute an outreach plan for every research project, in collaboration with the Strategic Communications Lead.
* Undertake significant public interfacing on behalf of CEEW at various national and international forums.
* Ensure strict adherence to CEEW's branding guidelines and outreach SOPs.
* Publish at least one opinion piece every quarter and respond to media requests promptly.
* Oversee the maintenance and timely updating of stakeholder databases.

**Programme Assistance**

* Give programmatic structure to, and ensure cohesion across, various projects and teams enabling cross-cutting research and leveraging capacity in other teams to deliver.
* Prepare detailed donor reports and project completion reports.
* Develop an outcome map for projects and programmes, indicating clearly to funders the impacts corresponding to their own goals.
* Build a network of donors and partners and demonstrate buy-in from potential funders; fund-raising will play a key role in this position.
* Supervise and mentor Programme Associates, Research Analysts and interns.
* Deliver training to other staff on research, policy or other skills.

**Selection Criteria – Education & Experience**

* A Bachelor's degree (B.E./ B.Tech) in Mining Engineering. A postgraduate qualification an MBA, or a Master's in energy, minerals, economics, public policy or a related discipline will be an added advantage.
* 8 to 12 years of relevant experience, including academic projects, industry experience, or experience of working in a technical or management consulting firm.
* Working understanding of the minerals and metals value chain exploration, resource estimation, mining, beneficiation, processing and metallurgy and of how it connects to downstream manufacturing, reuse and recycling.
* Familiarity with critical mineral supply chains and clean energy technology markets, and with the trade policy and geopolitics that shape them.
* Experience of leading and managing projects (or aspects of some projects) independently scoping the research question, designing the approach, managing timelines and budgets, and delivering to quality.
* A track record of high-quality written output research reports, policy or issue briefs, journal papers, or client-facing techno-economic and transaction advisory studies.
* Experience of managing engagements with a range of stakeholders central and state governments, industry, investors, research institutions, and communities around mining and processing sites.
* Experience of managing research analysts, associates, consultants or interns.
* Ability to work in an interdisciplinary and multicultural environment.
* Strong communication skills for effective, efficient and adaptive verbal and written communication, and active listening.
* Willingness to travel to mine and processing sites, state capitals, and national and international forums as the work requires.

CEEW operates in a dynamic environment, and the candidate will be required to show flexibility in undertaking a variety of tasks.

Head Of Supply Chain

title: Program Officer CareVerse
description:
**Organisation:**
Protsahan India Foundation
  
  
**Location:**
New Delhi (with travel to program geographies)
  
  
**Reporting to:**
Founder & CEO
  
  
**Team Supervision:**
Care Academy Lead, Care Network Manager, M&E/Data Coordinator, Training Facilitators, Program Officers
  
  
**Role Purpose**
The Program Officer CareVerse leads the design, delivery, and performance management of the CareVerse program. The role ensures that training translates into measurable action by frontline workers and that those actions lead to protective factors for girls in targeted geographies. The position oversees the full program cycle: training delivery, network engagement, and evidence generation. The Program Officer ensures ensures discipline in execution, maintains program quality, and drives learning loops that improve the model over time.
  
  
This role anchors the shift from program activity to evidence-backed practice change.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Program Leadership and Strategy

Lead implementation of the CareVerse program across training cohorts, network engagement, and field validation.
  
  
Translate the CareVerse strategy into clear operational plans with defined milestones, budgets, and performance metrics.
  
  
Ensure program execution aligns with the CareVerse design framework and learning cycles. Maintain a clear implementation roadmap for Phase 1 cohorts and expansion geographies.
  
  
Drive coordination across Care Academy training, Care Network engagement, and research activities.
  
  

* Training Delivery Oversight (Care Academy)

Oversee the design and delivery of residential training cohorts for frontline workers. Supervise the Care Academy Lead and training facilitators.
  
  
Ensure training modules remain action-oriented and aligned with the six priority protective actions.
  
  
Maintain quality control across all training cohorts. Track training outputs including:
  
  

* Number of workers trained
* Completion rates
* Post-training assessment scores

Ensure 85 percent or higher completion rates across residential cohorts. Drive curriculum revision cycles based on learning insights from cohorts.
  
  

* Behaviour Change and Practice Adoption

Ensure that trained workers adopt protective actions in their work with girls and families. Track behaviour change indicators such as:
  
  

* Percentage of workers adopting at least one priority action within 30 days
* Percentage demonstrating trauma-informed language and practice
* Workers conducting resource mapping for girls
* Workers establishing economic linkages for families

Work with the Care Network Manager to monitor ongoing engagement and practice adoption. Ensure monthly reflection cycles capture practice insights and barriers.
  
  

* Network Engagement

Oversee the Care Network as a structured community of practice for trained workers. Ensure network systems support long-term engagement and professional learning.
  
  
**Supervise**

* Monthly check-ins with trained workers
* Micro-learning content drops
* Facilitated discussions and peer learning sessions Maintain target engagement metrics including:
* 60 percent or higher monthly check-in participation
* 50 percent or higher active participation at 12 months Strengthen retention and peer learning within the network.
* Monitoring, Evaluation, and Learning (MEL) Lead implementation of the CareVerse MEL system. Oversee the three evidence streams:
* Monitoring of training delivery and operational performance
* Evaluation of behaviour change among trained workers
* Continuous learning to refine program design

Ensure the MEL team captures data across the IOOI framework: inputs, outputs, outcomes, and long-term impact.
  
  
Supervise baseline research in targeted geographies and establish systems for longitudinal tracking.
  
  
Validate self-reported worker behaviour through spot-check field visits and qualitative follow-ups. Ensure the program generates credible evidence on:
  
  

* Protective factors established for girls
* Worker practice change
* Network engagement and retention

Work with external evaluators to conduct 6, 12, and 18-month program assessments.
  
  

* Evidence Generation and Knowledge Production

Lead the translation of program data into actionable insights.
  
  
Produce quarterly program learning reviews and annual evidence summaries.
  
  
Work with the Dialogues and Research teams to convert field insights into policy briefs and sector learning outputs.
  
  
Support development of research reports and public-facing evidence documentation. Ensure program data supports credible claims about practice change and protective factors.
  
  

* Team Leadership and Program Management

Recruit, manage, and mentor the CareVerse program team.
  
  
Lead weekly program reviews with the training, network, and MEL teams. Ensure clear performance metrics for each role.
  
  
Build strong internal coordination between program staff, research teams, and GEC teams. Create a culture of accountability and learning across the CareVerse program.
  
  

* Partnerships and Stakeholder Engagement

Support partnerships with civil society organizations, training partners, and research institutions.
  
  
Represent Protsahan in strategic conversations on trauma-informed care and child protection practice.
  
  
Contribute to sector dialogue platforms through the Hriday Dialogues initiative.
  
  
**Key Deliverables (First 12 Months)**
Launch and manage the first three CareVerse training cohorts. Build an active Care Network community of trained workers.
  
  
Establish baseline research in priority geographies.
  
  
Deliver validated evidence on practice change among trained workers. Produce the first CareVerse evidence reports on protective factor adoption.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Master’s degree in Social Work, Public Policy, Development Studies, or related field.
  
  
**Experience**
15–18 years of experience in child protection, gender programs, or community-based social development.
  
  
Demonstrated experience in hiring, managing and leading large program teams.
  
  
Strong experience in program monitoring, evaluation, and evidence-based programming. Experience managing partnerships with civil society or government systems is a must.
  
  
**Skills And Competencies**
Strong program leadership and operational management. Ability to translate strategy into structured program delivery.
  
  
Experience managing MEL systems and using data for decision-making. Excellent team leadership and mentoring skills.
  
  
Very strong research, writing and analytical skills.
  
  
Ability to work in high-complexity environments and maintain execution discipline.
  
  
**Personal Attributes**
Strong understanding of child protection and gender justice.
  
  
Ability to lead teams through ambiguity and early-stage program development. Comfort working in an iterative program design environment.
  
  
High level of integrity and accountability. Comfortable with extensive domestic travel.
  
  
**Job Location:**
New Delhi

* Maintain strong professional relationships with brand marketing teams and decision-makers.

* Build and maintain strong relationships with influencers, talent managers and creator management teams.

* Opportunity to work closely with the company's leadership team.

* A dynamic environment where your ideas, leadership and execution can directly contribute to company growth.

description:
**Our Mission**
At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
  
  
We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
  
  
**Job Summary**
**The Team**
Idira, a Palo Alto Networks business unit formed after its landmark acquisition of CyberArk, is the global leader in AI-driven identity security and privileged access management (PAM). Evolving beyond legacy administrative platforms, Idira unifies PAM mastery with Palo Alto Networks' security infrastructure to protect the modern AI enterprise. Operating on a single control plane, the platform eliminates identity silos by continuously discovering environmental risk and enforcing Zero Standing Privilege (ZSP) across human users, machine workloads, and autonomous AI agents through dynamic, just-in-time access controls.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the India Idira sales organization as the Regional Vice President by defining and executing the strategic vision to drive growth across the region.
* Partner cross-functionally with internal senior leaders, theater VPs, and technical solutions leadership to optimize go-to-market execution, driving alignment across India's complex, highly matrixed enterprise environment.
* Synthesize insights gathered from multiple enterprise customers in India to influence regional priorities, align sales districts to priority verticals and targeted accounts, and position Idira as a long-term strategic partner.
* Engage C-suite executives and internal senior leaders with a strong executive presence, maintaining composure and clarity to build trusted, strategic relationships at scale.
* Empower, mentor, and build a high-performing team of District Sales Managers (DSMs) across multiple regions in India, cultivating a culture of accountability, trust, autonomous decision-making, and continuous learning.
* Identify and execute tops-down Idira (AI-driven identity security and PAM) growth initiatives, ensuring consistent execution across the region while enabling specific district-level market opportunities.
* Enforce rigorous sales hygiene and operational discipline across districts (leveraging MEDDPICC-type methodologies) to ensure accurate forecasting, healthy pipelines, and consistent performance against bookings and revenue targets.
* Drive the adoption of full-suite platform selling—moving beyond single-product solutions to comprehensive identity and security architectures—by actively guiding sales teams through complex, multi-product enterprise deals.
* Distill and simplify complex technical concepts (such as Endpoint Privilege Manager [EPM] and Privileged Access Management [PAM]) and broad regional strategies into clear, actionable guidance that accelerates cross-functional alignment and execution.
* Balance an aggressive hunting motion to open doors into net-new 'Dark' accounts with a collaborative, relationship-driven style to drive upsells and renewals.
* Guide multiple districts through market or organizational shifts, demonstrating resilience and maintaining optimism to help teams overcome customer setbacks or lost opportunities.

**Qualifications**

* Significant leadership experience managing a quota-carrying sales team focused on platform selling; cybersecurity or identity management experience is highly preferred.
* A minimum of 2 years of proven second-line leadership experience (managing other sales leaders/managers).
* Extensive experience leading, developing, mentoring, and hiring top sales talent.
* Demonstrated success in value selling, solving complex business problems, and selling directly to C-suite and senior executive stakeholders.
* A track record of leading teams that sell a full suite of solutions (e.g., software/business applications vs. just hardware).
* Deep understanding of operational rigor, sales discipline, and structured sales processes.
* Strong domain experience in specialized "2nd line" models, with a background adjacent to or directly within the identity security, PAM, or broader cybersecurity landscape.
* Exceptional communication and soft skills, with the ability to articulate a strategic vision and mobilize cross-functional teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Direct background and experience in Privileged Access Management (PAM) or Identity Security.
* Experience running and scaling sales teams across multiple segments or regions within India.
* An existing network of trusted relationships with key decision-makers and C-level executives within the Indian enterprise market.
* Familiarity with Palo Alto Networks' internal stakeholders and go-to-market strategies, allowing for a quick ramp-up.

**Our Commitment**
We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

description:
**Description**
Manager, Quick Commerce Hub (Inbound & Outbound Operations)
  
  
At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people.
  
  
Amazon is seeking a Manager for our Quick Commerce Hub (HU) to lead both the Inbound (IB) and Outbound (OB) functions. Amazon is one of the most recognizable brand names in the world and we distribute millions of products each year to our loyal customers. In the fast-paced world of Quick Commerce, speed, accuracy, and reliability are everything — and this role sits at the heart of making that happen.
  
  
Four key areas that you'll always focus on are the safety, quality, customer experience, and productivity of your department.
  
  
Review the work forecasts and determine your productivity requirements to produce during the day/night to meet the overall building objectives.
  
  
Partner with other Area Managers to balance labor, ensuring that you are operating a balanced and efficient shift across both inbound and outbound while meeting all of your goals.
  
  
Support all safety programs and OSHA compliance to ensure a safe work environment for all associates.
  
  
Proactively identify and lead process improvement initiatives and Lean tools.
  
  
Own end-to-end Inbound and Outbound flow — from receive, stow, and inventory accuracy through pick, pack, and dispatch — to meet Quick Commerce delivery promises.
  
  
**Supervisory Responsibilities**
You and your team of warehouse associates are responsible for getting Amazon customers their orders. You are responsible for ensuring that you have properly trained people, and that their needs are addressed so they can focus on their jobs. This role involves directly leading a team of more than 500 associates across inbound and outbound operations.
  
  
In addition, one of the most important aspects of your job is to lead change at internet speed — innovation has made us the global company that we are today.
  
  
**Additional Job Elements**
Regular bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching both below the waist and above the head
  
  
Walking in the facility and around the area with great frequency; facilities are over a quarter mile in length
  
  
Continual standing and/or walking
  
  
Ability to work in distribution environments that may be noisy, not air-conditioned
  
  
Able to access all areas of the building (ascending and descending ladders, stairs, gangways safely and without limitation)
  
  
**Basic / Priority Requirements**
Experience managing both Inbound and Outbound operations — this is a priority requirement for the role
  
  
Night shift availability — candidates must be available to work night shifts regularly

title: Shift In-charge
description:
**Job Description: Warehouse Shift In-Charge**
**Position Summary:**
The
**Warehouse Shift In-Charge**
is responsible for supervising and coordinating warehouse activities during assigned shifts to ensure smooth inbound and outbound operations. The role focuses on maintaining inventory accuracy, ensuring adherence to SOPs and customer SLAs, and managing day-to-day operational activities related to storage, handling, and dispatch of goods.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****
**Operations Management:**
Supervise receiving, unloading, storage, picking, packing, and dispatch operations during the assigned shift in line with SOPs and customer SLAs.
  
  
Ensure timely delivery of orders and availability of stock for smooth warehouse operations.
  
  
Manage day-to-day warehouse activities during the shift, including monitoring inbound and outbound volumes.
  
  
Handle pre-pack brand stock within defined cut-off timelines while ensuring quality and SOP compliance.
  
  
**Inventory Management:**
Manage bulk inventory including onion, potato, garlic, and imported chilled items.
  
  
Ensure accurate daily stock records of fruits and vegetables.
  
  
Maintain optimal stock levels to prevent overstocking or shortages.
  
  
**Stock Accuracy & Compliance:**
Conduct daily inventory cycle count audits and ensure same-day variance closure.
  
  
Monitor product expiry and shelf life while ensuring FIFO/FEFO compliance.
  
  
Ensure timely identification and liquidation of damaged or expired stock to minimize losses and maximize cost recovery.
  
  
**Reporting & System Updates:**
Update and maintain inventory records in Quip and Google Sheets systems.
  
  
Maintain shift-wise operational records and support reporting requirements.
  
  
Coordinate with the warehouse manager and other teams to resolve operational issues.
  
  
****Qualifications****
Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Logistics, Supply Chain, Business Administration, or a related field (preferred).
  
  
3–6 years of experience in warehouse operations, preferably in FMCG, grocery, or fresh produce handling.
  
  
Strong knowledge of inventory management processes including FIFO/FEFO and cycle counting.
  
  
Basic knowledge of warehouse systems, inventory tracking tools, and reporting platforms.
  
  
Good coordination, supervision, and problem-solving skills.
  
  
Ability to manage teams and operations during assigned shifts.
  
  
**Job Description: Operations In-Charge**
**Position Summary:**
The
**Operations In-Charge**
is responsible for overseeing daily warehouse operations to ensure efficient handling, storage, and distribution of products. The role focuses on maintaining operational efficiency, inventory accuracy, cold chain compliance, and timely deliveries to dark stores while ensuring adherence to SOPs, customer SLAs, and cost optimization.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****
**Operations Management:**
Oversee day-to-day warehouse operations including sorting, grading, transformation, and dispatch of products.
  
  
Ensure timely delivery and stock availability for all dark stores.
  
  
Manage complete warehouse operations including cold chain processes while ensuring quality standards and SOP compliance within defined cut-off timelines.
  
  
**Inventory Management:**
Ensure inventory accuracy and maintain proper stock control processes.
  
  
Monitor stock levels and share daily stock audit reports with relevant stakeholders.
  
  
Ensure timely identification and liquidation of damaged and expired inventory as per SOP and customer SLA.
  
  
**Vendor & Resource Coordination:**
Coordinate with vendors to ensure timely availability of operational resources such as contract associates, security personnel, and transportation facilities.
  
  
Monitor vendor performance and ensure service delivery as per agreed requirements.
  
  
**Process Efficiency & Cost Control:**
Track productivity across warehouse processes and implement improvements to minimize operational waste.
  
  
Manage operational efficiency to control variable costs and improve process performance.
  
  
**Reporting & Compliance:**
Ensure daily KPIs agreed with customers are achieved and present operational performance reports during daily review meetings.
  
  
Ensure timely processing of vendor bills as per PR/PO process in SAP and maintain proper documentation.
  
  
****Qualifications****
Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field (preferred).
  
  
6–8 years of experience in warehouse or logistics operations, preferably in FMCG, grocery, or fresh produce supply chains.
  
  
Experience in handling cold chain operations and high-volume warehouse environments.
  
  
Strong knowledge of inventory management, warehouse processes, and vendor coordination.
  
  
Familiarity with SAP or similar ERP systems for billing and operational processes.
  
  
Strong leadership, coordination, and problem-solving skills.
  
  
Good communication and operational reporting abilities.

title: Head of Unit
description:
**Company Description**
Maarga Mind Care is a dedicated mental health care unit providing comprehensive outpatient, inpatient, and emergency services for a wide range of mental health needs. The organization focuses on delivering timely, evidence-based care in a safe and supportive environment. Its multidisciplinary approach combines clinical expertise with personalized care plans to support individuals and families. Maarga Mind Care aims to enhance overall well-being by promoting early intervention, continuity of care, and community awareness around mental health.

**Role Description**
The Head of Unit at Maarga Mind Care is a full-time, on-site leadership role based in Gurgaon.

1. Revenue and P&L Performance – Achievement of revenue targets, profitability and operating margins.

2. Sales Conversion – Conversion of enquiries into admissions and outpatient consultations.

3. Occupancy and Service Utilisation – Optimisation of inpatient bed occupancy, outpatient volumes and service utilisation.

4. ARPOB and ALOS Contribution – Improvement in Average Revenue per Occupied Bed (ARPOB) and appropriate Average Length of Stay (ALOS) in coordination with the clinical team.

5. Business Development and Partnership Revenue – Growth in corporate tie-ups, institutional partnerships, referral networks and associated revenue.

6. Patient Experience and Satisfaction – Improvement in patient satisfaction, service quality and timely grievance resolution.

7. New Centre and Business Growth – Achievement of centre-launch milestones, market expansion and new service development targets.

8. End-to-End Business Operations Management – Ensure seamless functioning of all unit business operations, including admissions, billing, collections, patient coordination, resource utilisation and cross-functional service delivery to achieve operational efficiency and business continuity.

9. Unit Administration and Operational Excellence – Ensure effective overall unit administration, including manpower coordination, infrastructure, facility management, statutory compliance, vendor management, support services and implementation of SOPs to maintain uninterrupted, efficient and compliant unit operations

**Qualifications**

* Strong leadership and team management skills, a Go-getter with experience supervising multidisciplinary clinical or healthcare teams.
* Clinical expertise in mental health care, preferably with experience in outpatient, inpatient, and emergency psychiatric services will be a plus point.
* Relevant advanced degree in hospital administration, or a related field.
* Familiarity with healthcare regulations, documentation standards, and ethical practices in mental health settings.
* Prior experience in a leadership or unit head role in a hospital or mental health care facility is highly beneficial.

We are looking for an exceptional senior, hands-on leader to lead the IMEA Contingent Workforce function. This is a highly visible position in a fast-paced professional services environment.
  
  
The role is accountable for the strategy, governance and end-to-end management of the region’s contingent workforce model, covering external talent access, procurement and vendor management, commercial frameworks, lifecycle service, data, technology and reporting.
  
  
The role partners closely with business and people leadership, leads the operational CWR team, acts as the senior escalation point for material matters and continuously improves the function’s contribution to the firm.

**Experience Required:**

* Bachelor's or master's degree in business, management, human resources, operations, procurement, finance or a related field

* Experience leading people and coordinating delivery across teams in a matrixed organization
* Demonstrated procurement and vendor-management experience, including commercial frameworks, supplier performance, cost transparency, negotiation and portfolio management
* Proven ability to engage, influence and constructively challenge senior business and functional stakeholders

* Excellent stakeholder influence and communication skills, with the confidence to challenge constructively and escalate material issues with sound judgment
* Proven team and service leadership, including setting expectations, developing team members and creating consistent service standards
* Ability to create accountability while enabling collaboration across organizational boundaries.

* Highly self-motivated, pragmatic and willing to roll up their sleeves in complex, sensitive or operationally demanding situations
* High integrity and discretion when working with confidential workforce, contractual and commercial information
* Regional experience in IMEA or another complex multinational environment would be advantageous

title: Head of GLS Service Hub
description:
A Snapshot of Your Day
  
  
As the Head of the Grid Solutions Lifecycle Services (GLS) Service Hub in India, you will lead a strategic global delivery organization supporting Siemens Energy's onshore grid service projects worldwide. You will be responsible for scaling engineering and execution capabilities, ensuring operational excellence, driving stakeholder collaboration across global regions, and building a high-performing technical workforce. Your leadership will play a critical role in enabling Siemens Energy to meet increasing global project demands while maintaining industry-leading quality, efficiency, and customer satisfaction.
  
  
How You’ll Make an Impact
  
  
Hub Operations & Global Project Execution (40%)
  
  

* Lead and scale the India GLS Service Hub to support global onshore grid service projects, ensuring delivery excellence in line with Siemens Energy quality, schedule, and cost objectives.
* Drive resource allocation, workforce planning, and capacity management across engineering and execution teams.
* Establish and monitor operational KPIs to enhance productivity, engineering efficiency, delivery quality, and turnaround times.
* Ensure effective execution governance while supporting global project pipelines and business growth initiatives.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement and operational excellence across all service activities.

Stakeholder Management & Global Collaboration (30%)
  
  

* Serve as the primary interface between the India Service Hub and global onshore service organizations.
* Align delivery priorities, project requirements, and execution expectations with international stakeholders.
* Collaborate closely with regional teams and sister organizations to standardize tools, processes, methodologies, and best practices.
* Represent the India Hub in global leadership reviews, providing insights on operational performance, capacity outlook, and strategic initiatives.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders to ensure successful project execution.

People Leadership & Capability Development (30%)
  
  

* Provide strategic leadership, mentorship, and direction to a diverse team of engineers and technical specialists.
* Drive recruitment, onboarding, succession planning, and talent retention strategies to support organizational growth.
* Develop workforce capability through structured learning programs, technical upskilling, and leadership development initiatives.
* Promote a high-performance, inclusive, and collaborative culture focused on innovation and continuous learning.
* Strengthen organizational capabilities in Grid Solutions Lifecycle Services and modern engineering methodologies.

What You Bring
  
  
Education
  
  

* Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

Professional Experience
  
  

* 12-15 years of experience in Grid Technologies, Power Systems, Electrical Engineering Services, or related industries.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in a senior leadership, engineering management, or service hub management role.
* Proven experience working within global delivery organizations, shared services environments, or multinational engineering operations.
* Demonstrated success in leading large engineering teams and managing complex cross-border project execution.

Certifications
  
  

* Project Management Professional (PMP) and/or equivalent IPMA certification preferred.

Technical & Functional Expertise
  
  
Leadership & Strategic Management
  
  

* Strategic Leadership
* Organizational Development
* Operational Leadership & Scaling
* Strategic Workforce and Capacity Planning
* Performance Management & KPI Governance

Grid Solutions & Engineering Excellence
  
  

* Grid Solutions Lifecycle Services (Onshore)
* Power Systems & Electrical Infrastructure
* Global Project Execution Methodologies
* Engineering Quality Assurance & Compliance Standards
* Lifecycle Service Delivery Models

Stakeholder & Collaboration Management
  
  

* Cross-Border Stakeholder Management
* Global Delivery Model Coordination
* Intercultural Communication & Collaboration
* Customer and Business Partner Engagement
* Change Management & Process Standardization

**About The Team**
The Grid Solutions Lifecycle Services organization supports Siemens Energy's global installed base by delivering high-quality engineering, modernization, maintenance, and lifecycle solutions for grid infrastructure. The India Service Hub serves as a strategic competence center, partnering with global regions to enhance service delivery capabilities, optimize resource utilization, and drive sustainable growth through engineering excellence and innovation.
  
  
Who Is Siemens Energy?
  
  
At Siemens Energy, we are more than an energy technology company. We meet the growing energy demand across more than 90 countries while helping our customers transition toward a more sustainable future. Our global team is committed to making reliable, affordable, and sustainable energy a reality by supporting decarbonization and advancing the energy transition worldwide.

title: Operations Manager (PV Systems)
description:
**Company Description**
Safety science and technology move forward here. So will you.
  
  
Prudentia, a PrimeVigilance company, is where safety science meets technology. We advise pharmaceutical companies on the processes and systems behind clinical and post-marketing safety, from selecting and implementing safety databases to managed services, data migration and turnkey tools that close the gaps in leading safety platforms.
  
  
It is specialist, high-trust work, and it depends on people who love solving hard problems. We are a team of curious minds, problem-solvers and experts brought together by a shared commitment to patient safety and to doing meaningful work well. Our culture values kindness, flexibility, growth and belonging, and we back one another to keep learning.
  
  
If you want a role with purpose, room to grow and the chance to make a real difference, we would love to hear from you.
  
  
**Job Description**
The Operations Manager is responsible for optimizing resource planning, utilization, and operational delivery across consulting, implementation, managed services, and product development engagements. This role serves as the primary link between sales forecasts, project delivery, and workforce planning by ensuring the right resources are available to meet current and future client demands.
  
  
**Role And Responsibilities**

* Manage resource allocation across internal initiatives and client projects using the organization's resource management tools.
* Balance forecasted project demand with available resource capacity to ensure optimal staffing and utilization.
* Monitor current and future resource utilization, including billable and non-billable hours, and provide regular utilization reports to leadership.
* Collaborate with leadership to evaluate resource requirements, project timelines, and staffing strategies for upcoming client engagements.
* Maintain up-to-date resource skills and experience matrix to support effective project staffing.
* Partner with project managers to assign resources based on technical skills, experience, availability, and career development objectives.
* Develop workforce forecasts and compare project pipeline demand against available capacity to identify resource gaps and hiring needs.
* Work closely with the Human Resources and Recruiting teams to identify staffing requirements, coordinate hiring activities, and build a qualified pipeline of employees and contractors.
* Support onboarding activities by coordinating project-specific training and ensuring resources are prepared for client engagements.
* Ensure timely submission of timesheets and accurate billing information to support project financials and revenue recognition.
* Understand and support the organization's service offerings, including Consulting, System Implementations, Managed Services, and Product Development.
* Support proposal development, resource planning, and contract preparation by providing staffing estimates and resource availability.
* Drive continuous process improvements in resource planning, operational reporting, and utilization management.

**Qualifications**
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Life Sciences, Finance, HR or a related discipline.
  
  

* 5+ years of experience in consulting, resource management, project operations or PMO.
* Experience in system implementation or consulting projects, preferably within the Life Sciences or Pharmacovigilance industry.
* Experience supporting process improvement, data migration, or enterprise implementation projects.
* Strong understanding of resource planning, capacity management, utilization forecasting, and workforce planning.
* Experience working with resource management and project management tools.
* Experience collaborating with Finance, Human Resources, Recruiting, and Delivery teams.
* Finance or project financial management experience is highly preferred.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior experience as a Pharmacovigilance (PV) Consultant or Operations Consultant.
* Experience with consulting services organizations or software implementation firms.
* Knowledge of project financials, revenue forecasting, and utilization reporting.
* Experience supporting global delivery teams and distributed resource models.

**Desired Skills**

* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including PivotTables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, charts, dashboards, and forecasting.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret operational, resource, and financial data.
* Resource planning and capacity management.
* Resource utilization forecasting and reporting.
* Workforce planning and resource allocation.
* Project operations and delivery support.
* Cross-functional collaboration with leadership, Finance, HR, Recruiting, and project teams.
* Financial and operational analysis.
* Stakeholder management and relationship building.
* Process improvement and operational efficiency.
* Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills.
* Strategic planning, forecasting, and execution.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with global stakeholders.

**Additional Information**
When you join Ergomed Group, you make a difference by helping to bring safe and effective pharmaceutical treatment to patients around the world. You’ll join a passionate and collaborative team of experts in clinical research, pharmacovigilance, and quality consulting.
  
  
We are diverse in many ways, yet our values unite us. Our values are how we work, not words on a wall. If they sound like you, you will feel at home here.
  
  

* Quality: we hold ourselves to the standard patients deserve.
* Integrity and trust: we do the right thing, especially when it is hard.
* Drive and passion: we care about the outcome, because someone is waiting on it.
* Agility and responsiveness: we move quickly, because patients cannot wait.
* Belonging: everyone is welcome, and every voice counts.
* Collaborative partnerships: we go further by going together.

We look forward to welcoming your application.

**Manager – Order Management (Team Head)**
