We believe that our diverse teams and strong company culture are key to the success of our products and technologies, that hundreds of millions of users around the world and around 645,000 customers across all industries rely on. With more than 1,900 employees worldwide, we celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each individual brings to the table and foster a dynamic work environment where new ideas thrive. Are you ready to join our team and make an impact?
  
  
**Responsibilities**
We are looking for an experienced, hands-on
**Team Manager, Customer Support – APAC**
to lead our regional Customer Support organization and contribute to our global support strategy.
  
  
You will drive customer experience, operational performance, people development and continuous improvement, while leading APAC’s contribution to our global follow-the-sun support model. This includes supporting the transition toward global queues, shared case ownership and seamless customer support across regions and time zones.
  
  
You will lead, coach and develop a diverse international team, building a high-performance culture focused on customer outcomes, accountability, collaboration and continuous development.
  
  

* Lead and develop the APAC Customer Support team, creating a high-performing, engaged and customer-focused organization with a strong culture of accountability, collaboration and ownership.
* Set clear expectations and actively manage individual and team performance against defined objectives and KPIs, supported by regular feedback, coaching, one-to-ones and development planning.
* Identify and develop high-potential talent, strengthen succession planning and empower team members to make decisions, take ownership and continuously improve the customer experience.
* Own the operational performance of APAC Customer Support, driving regional and global KPIs across responsiveness, resolution, service levels, quality, productivity and customer outcomes.
* Use operational data and insights to identify performance gaps, address root causes, effectively align resources and capacity, and drive sustainable improvements.
* Manage complex or high-impact customer escalations and identify recurring customer pain points, working cross-functionally to improve the broader customer experience.
* Lead APAC as an integral part of the global follow-the-sun support model, helping transition from regional ticket queues to global queues, shared case ownership and effective handover practices across regions.
* Partner closely with Support leaders in EMEA and the Americas to balance global workloads, capacity and skills, improve customer coverage and champion a global-first mindset.
* Drive transformation and continuous improvement by simplifying, standardizing and automating support operations, while championing the adoption of new technologies, tools, self-service capabilities and AI-enabled ways of working.
* Represent APAC within the Global Customer Support leadership team, partnering with Product, Engineering, Sales, Customer Success and regional Support leaders to establish consistent service standards, share best practices and provide clear insights on performance, customer trends, risks and opportunities.

**Requirements**

* 5+ years of leadership experience within Customer Support, Technical Support, Customer Experience or a related environment, ideally within SaaS or technology.
* Demonstrated experience leading, coaching and developing high-performing customer-facing teams, with a strong focus on performance, accountability and continuous development.
* Experience operating within, or transitioning toward, a follow-the-sun or global support model, including global queues, cross-regional case ownership, workload and capacity management.
* Strong understanding of the APAC region, with experience working across different markets, cultures and time zones while building shared global accountability.
* Proven ability to manage operational performance through KPIs, data, coaching and continuous improvement, translating operational insights into clear actions and business decisions.
* Experience managing complex customer escalations and communicating effectively with senior internal and external stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of modern Customer Support operations, including case management, self-service, automation and AI-enabled support, with the technical aptitude to quickly understand new products, systems and technologies.
* Experience leading organizational or operational change, improving processes and challenging existing ways of working within a growing or transforming organization.
* Excellent communication, collaboration and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to make decisions, challenge the status quo and drive accountability.
* Fluency in English is required, with Japanese, Korean, Thai or other APAC languages an advantage. A degree in Business, Information Technology, Computer Science, Economics or a related discipline is advantageous but not essential.

**What We Offer**

* Office Location: Mumbai or Noida.
* Competitive salary and benefits package, including performance-based incentives.
* Opportunity to play a key leadership role within a global Customer Support organization.
* The opportunity to help shape and evolve our global follow-the-sun Support model.
* International collaboration with Support, Product and other business teams.
* Opportunities for international travel and collaboration with global teams.
* Quarterly team events and company-wide celebrations.
* An open and collaborative working culture.
* Shared staff lunches and complimentary fruit, tea and coffee.
* Opportunities to participate in company and customer events, including F1-related events.
* Join a diverse APAC organization representing many nationalities and backgrounds.
* Opportunities to actively contribute to our diversity and CARE initiatives.

TeamViewer is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to building an inclusive culture where everyone feels welcome and supported. We C-A-R-E and understand that our diverse, values-driven culture makes us stronger. As we continue to grow as a company, we also focus on enabling our employees to grow both personally and professionally. We are proud to have an open and embracing workplace environment that will empower you to be your best no matter your gender, civil or family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education level, or race.

title: Branch:Branch Head
description:
About Branch Banking: With branches spread across the country, the branches act as the face of Axis Bank for millions of retail customers and is, hence, an integral part of the Bank’s strategy. Branches play a major role in deposit mobilization from New-To-Bank (NTB) customers, and are also core drivers of the Bank’s customer engagement strategy across products and services About the Role: The Branch Head (BH) is responsible for coordinating and overseeing all branch operations and implementing strategies to increase productivity and performance levels in order to achieve the branch’s financial targets. They are responsible for ensuring the smooth functioning of the branch and its compliance with the rules and regulations. They should maintain good relations with the key account holders of the Bank to ensure deepening of accounts and thus generating revenue. Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Ensure efficient daily operation of a branch, including lending, product sales and customer service in accordance with the bank’s objectives
* Prepare the plan for the growth of branch business in consultation with the Cluster Head
* Implement the plan through the Branch team so as to achieve the top line goals
* Establish and strengthen relations with key customers (e.g. top 10%) to generate sustained business.
* Review daily/ periodic reports (e.g. overdrawn accounts, temporary overdrafts, cash retention limit, office accounts, etc.) and take proactive action to ensure profitable and ethical business.
* Ensure audit related deliverables, both internal and external are met as per the prescribed norms
* Ensure compliance with due processes and guidelines
* Create a performance oriented environment leading to high employee motivation and productivity
* Ensure that all staff are adequately trained on the products of the bank, sales processes and various policies of the bank
* Resolve, report any disruptions (e.g. strike or local disturbance) and take appropriate action to ensure that the branch operations are run smoothly.
* Liaison with the cluster office and other branch offices to ensure the smooth management of operations and the achievement of overall business goals.
* Ensure proper upkeep of branch premises and assets including safety and security Qualifications: Optimal qualification for success on the job is:
* Graduate/ MBA (Marketing) preferred from a recognized institute
* NCFM and AMFI Certifications
* 10-15 years of experience in the BFSI sector Role Proficiencies: For successful execution of the job, the candidate should possess the following:
* Knowledge of banking products and services
* Knowledge of regulatory guidelines and norms
* Good communication (both verbal and written) skill in both English and the local language
* Ability to manage complex client situations
* Ability to manage risk and uncertainty for self and team within a dynamic priority-setting environment
* Ability to handle pressure and meet deadlines #ComeAsYouAre "We are dil se open. Women, LGBTQIA+ and PwD candidates of all ages are encouraged to apply"

title: Security Delivery Lead
description:
Integrated delivery owner for 24x7 L1 and L2 security operations across all SecOps towers.
  
  
**Role level**
Delivery Lead
  
  
**Domain**
Security Operations (SecOps)
  
  
**Scope**
NetSec, IDAM, Malware Tools, DLP &
  
  
SecOps Command Center (L1), Own delivery of the client security operations end to end. Manage SLAs, escalations, MIM, invoicing, resourcing and contractual reviews across NetSec, IDAM, Malware Tools, DLP and the SecOps Command Center.
  
  
**Service Delivery Ownership**

* Own end-to-end delivery of L1 and L2 security operations.
* Lead the SecOps Command Center (L1) and the NetSec, IDAM, Malware Tools and DLP pods.
* Act as single point of contact for the client security leadership.
* Run daily stand-ups and weekly service reviews with tower leads.
* Drive service improvement plans to closure.

**SLA, Reporting and Governance**

* Track response and resolution SLAs across all security towers.
* Publish weekly and monthly SLA, KPI and backlog reports.
* Present service performance at monthly and quarterly governance reviews.
* Maintain the RAID log for security services.
* Enforce ServiceNow ticket hygiene and closure quality.

**I**
**ncident, Escalation and MIM**

* Attend MIM bridge calls for P1/P2 and security incidents.
* Own client and internal escalations through to closure.
* Inform the client promptly of security issues, with remediation options.
* Drive RCA and problem management with corrective action plans.
* Coordinate with Infra towers, OEM vendors and client L3 teams.

**Commercials and Contract**

* Own monthly invoicing inputs and reconciliation for security services.
* Track deliverables against SOW scope and contractual obligations.
* Raise and manage change requests for scope changes.
* Lead contractual reviews, including service credits and penalties.

**Resourcing and People**

* Plan capacity, shift rosters and 24x7 on-call coverage.
* Hire, onboard and retain engineers; manage backfills and leave cover.
* Maintain the skill matrix and cross-skilling plan across pods.
* Run performance reviews, coaching and career plans for the team.

**Security Compliance and Risk**

* Ensure adherence to client security policies and standards.
* Track firewall, endpoint agent, patch and DLP policy compliance.
* Support internal and external audits with evidence.
* Oversee access reviews and privileged access governance.

**Continual Improvement**

* Drive automation, alert tuning and repeat-incident reduction.
* Keep SOPs, runbooks and knowledge-base articles current.
* Lead onboarding and transition of new security services.

**Tools Familiarity**

* Zscaler (ZIA / ZPA)
* Palo Alto Firewalls (Panorama)
* Microsoft Purview
* Email Encryption
* Symantec DLP and AIP
* Netskope
* Microsoft Defender for Endpoint
* CrowdStrike Falcon
* Entra ID (Azure AD) and Active Directory
* Okta
* CyberArk
* ServiceNow (ITSM, reporting and dashboards)
* Datadog & PagerDuty
* Splunk
* PPT / Excel for service reporting (good to have)
* Jira and Confluence (good to have)

**Technologies Knowhow**

* Network security: NGFW, secure web gateway, zero trust access
* Identity and access: SSO, MFA, PAM, joiner-mover-leaver
* Endpoint security: EDR, anti-virus, phishing response
* Data protection: DLP, data classification, encryption
* Email security and encryption
* ITIL service management: incident, problem, change, request
* Security frameworks: ISO 27001, NIST CSF
* Cloud security basics: Azure and AWS (good to have)

**Experience**

* 12+ years in IT and security operations
* 10+ years as Security Delivery lead in an infra managed services setup
* Led 24x7 multi-tower security operations for a global enterprise
* Managed onshore and offshore teams of 20+ engineers
* Basic knowledge of Zscaler, Palo Alto, MS Purview, email encryption, Defender for Endpoint,

CrowdStrike, Entra ID, CyberArk and Workday
  
  

* SLA management, invoicing and contract reviews in an MSP model

**Certifications Preferred**

* CISSP or CISM
* ITIL 4 Foundation

title: Assistant Manager Administration
description:
Job Description – Assistant Manager, Administration

Location - Noida

The Assistant Manager – Administration is responsible for overseeing and managing the day-to-day administrative functions of the site, ensuring seamless operations and high service standards. This role involves leading the administrative team, coordinating with internal stakeholders, and ensuring strict adherence to the Firm’s policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.

The role encompasses the following key areas:

1. People Management

* Lead, mentor, and supervise the site’s administrative team, including administrative assistants, front office executives, and support staff.
* Drive team performance through effective goal setting, continuous feedback, and structured performance management.
* Oversee recruitment, onboarding, and training of administrative personnel to ensure capability building and succession readiness.
* Foster a collaborative, service-oriented, and professional work environment.

2. Operational Management

* Establish and implement efficient administrative processes and standard operating procedures to enhance service quality and operational effectiveness.
* Ensure smooth functioning of all administrative services, including front office, office facilities, and support operations.
* Oversee procurement and management of office supplies and inventory, ensuring optimal stock levels and cost efficiency.
* Manage and monitor the site’s administrative budget with a focus on cost control and resource optimization.
* Review administrative expenses periodically, identifying opportunities for cost savings and process improvements.

3. Compliance & Governance

* Ensure strict adherence to the Firm’s policies, internal guidelines, and applicable legal and regulatory requirements.
* Monitor compliance with health, safety, and environmental standards across the site.
* Proactively identify, address, and resolve any administrative or compliance-related issues in a timely manner.
* Maintain proper documentation and audit readiness for all administrative processes.

4. Project Coordination & Stakeholder Management

* Provide administrative support for site-specific projects, initiatives, and events.
* Collaborate with internal teams and external stakeholders to facilitate smooth execution of projects.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure timely delivery and alignment with organizational objectives.
* Support leadership in implementing strategic administrative initiatives and improvements.

Qualifications & Experience

* **Education:**
  Graduate/Postgraduate in Business Administration, Hospitality Management, or a related field.
* **Experience:**
  8–12+ years of relevant experience in administration, facilities management, or operations, with proven team leadership exposure.

Skills & Competencies

* Strong leadership and people management capabilities.
* Financial acumen with experience in budgeting and cost optimization.
* Expertise in vendor negotiations and service delivery management.
* Sound knowledge of compliance, governance, and audit readiness.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Strategic mindset with the ability to drive process improvements.

*We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity. We do not discriminate based on gender, race, age, sexual orientation, and religious identities or any other applicable characteristics protected by law. We seek individuals who uphold the highest standards of integrity, demonstrate professionalism in every interaction, treat others with respect, and consistently align personal ambition with the collective goals of the firm.*

*The incumbent is required to comply with the Firm’s Information Security policies and procedures, including safeguarding confidential information, adhering to secure data handling practices, and promptly reporting information security incidents.*

title: Team Leader - Building Services, Middle East

The successful candidate, working with the ME based teams, will bring their expertise, capability, and knowledge to provide operational leadership to our existing team to enable them to meet the business and client needs.
  
  
As GCC Team Lead (TL) of ME Building Services, you will be responsible for the health, safety & welfare of the team. The TL is expected to demonstrate effective & visible leadership, focusing on the ongoing engagement and retention of employees through the development of individuals and building high performing teams. Your role is to drive performance, innovation, and efficiency to achieve defined commercial and growth targets.

You will be responsible for the operational, financial and commercial delivery of projects undertaken by the team.

title: Assistant Manager - Installation
description:
Site supervision:
  
  

* Accountable for safety, quality, and productivity during installation and handovers, and for raising and actioning corrective actions to any detected non-conformities.
* Responsible for the use of correct KONE installation methods and tools by the installation team, and for proper risk assessment for parts of installation where KONE method is not feasible.
* Responsible for proactive site preparations, site readiness, customer deliverables to KONE, site visits and audits, including resolution of non-conformities with customer (supported by Project Manager as needed)
* Responsible for verifying the site execution plan and field cost management as part of the pre-delivery review, assuming site execution responsibility, and thereafter installation activities and handovers.
* Responsible for maintaining realistic MS 3c (material delivery to site) throughout the S-plan, and for confirming of S-plan milestones 3 – 5z.
* Active support to Project Manager and Project Admin for the verification of payment status according to S-plan concept and contract terms
* Responsible for planning and organizing installation activities, site storage and logistics, and needed resources and tools.
* Requests materials to site (MS 3x), confirms arrival of KONE materials to site (MS 3c), receives other materials and services at the site, and performs Goods Receipt.
* Performs handover to installation team (KONE and subcontractors), clarifying the scope of work, completion date and other necessary customer milestone dates, as well as target installation hours for own KONE fitters.
* Organizes continuous huddles with the installation team to empower them and proactively prevent interruptions, ensure smooth, continual flow of work on site, with a focus on efficiency and waste reduction.
* Achieves targets for variation sales and change orders during installation, ensures costs attributable to others are claimed and collected.
* Verifies quality of installation and ensures installation the scope of work is completed. Is accountable for final testing of the equipment and for closing any raised items (tester, customer, third party inspector, as is applicable). Completes a successful handover to maintenance.
* Responsible for quality claims / feedbacks, time sheet approvals, installation documentation, reporting of installation progress, status, cost accumulation, and risks, and managing schedule and other changes.
* Responsible for the management of environmental aspects of the installation (waste and hazardous material handling).

Customer Relationship management:
  
  

* Acts as the primary contact for the customer regarding site management, proactively communicating and using related tools.
* Ensures customer satisfaction with proactive and timely communication, professional installation process, as well as safety and quality of installation.

People leadership and subcontractor relations:
  
  

* Responsible for verifying that installers, testers and other contractors on site are trained, certified, competent, and capable of performing each installation task.
* Accountable for site operatives’ safety, motivation and wellbeing.
* Responsible for identifying Installation operative training needs and communicating these to respective line managers, HR, installation subcontracting companies and procurement.
* Responsible for managing and developing the performance of the team and individuals.
* Responsible for developing and maintaining a proactive and professional relationship with subcontractors’ installation team and ensures they meet their commitments.

Continual improvement:
  
  

* Responsible to follow and continually improve standard ways of working according to LEAN principles.
* Motivates and empowers the installation team to identify waste and make improvements, with a focus on teamwork and collaboration.
* Supports and coaches the installation team to improve their standard ways of working.
* Continually identifies and shares opportunities, root causes and improvement ideas with the team and other collaborators, applying lean tools (Go & See, retrospectives, improvement sessions).
* Promotes success stories of team improvements, recognizing and rewarding efforts to drive continuous improvement.

title: Team Leader
description:
**Job Description**
Think of yourself as one of the leaders of your department and not just anyone is qualified for this role. title: Printing Supervisor
description:
**Company Description**
Shiv Shakti Printing & Trading Co. is a growing printing and trading business committed to delivering reliable, high-quality printed materials to a diverse range of clients. The company focuses on meeting customer deadlines while maintaining consistent production standards. Team members work closely together to coordinate printing, finishing, and delivery activities. The environment emphasizes accountability, attention to detail, and continuous improvement in printing processes. The company values individuals who take ownership of their work and contribute to operational efficiency.

**Role Description**
The Printing Supervisor is a full-time, on-site role based in Sonipat, responsible for overseeing day-to-day printing operations and production workflows. The role includes planning and scheduling print jobs, assigning tasks to printing and bindery staff, and monitoring job progress to ensure quality standards and timelines are met. The Printing Supervisor will inspect materials for accuracy and print quality, troubleshoot printing and bindery issues, and coordinate maintenance of printing equipment. This role also involves training team members on processes and safety practices, maintaining production records, and communicating with internal stakeholders to align production output with customer requirements.

**Qualifications**

* Strong Supervisory Skills and team leadership abilities, including task delegation and performance monitoring.
* Hands-on experience in Print Production and Printing processes, with familiarity with different machines, substrates, and inks.
* Knowledge of Bindery operations such as cutting, folding, stitching, and packaging of printed materials.
* Effective Communication skills for coordinating with team members, management, and, when required, customers.
* Attention to detail and quality control mindset to ensure accurate and consistent output.
* Ability to read and interpret job tickets, layouts, and specifications.
* Understanding of basic safety standards and ability to promote a safe working environment.
* Prior experience as a printing or production supervisor, or in a similar role within the print industry, is preferred.
* Basic computer skills for tracking jobs, maintaining production reports, and using relevant software.

title: Production Manager – Injection Molding
description:
We are looking for an experienced **Production Manager** with 10–15 years of hands-on experience in **Injection Molding Production**. The candidate will be responsible for managing the complete production process, ensuring production targets, quality standards, productivity and timely delivery are achieved.

Key Responsibilities

* Plan, organize and manage daily injection molding production activities.
* Prepare and execute production plans according to customer requirements and dispatch schedules.
* Manage manpower, machines, molds and materials to achieve production targets.
* Monitor production quantity, rejection, downtime and machine utilization.
* Improve **OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness)** and machine productivity.
* Control production wastage, rejection and material consumption.
* Identify production problems and conduct **Root Cause Analysis (RCA)** to prevent recurrence.
* Optimize injection molding processes to improve productivity and reduce production costs.
* Coordinate with Quality, Maintenance, PPC, Stores and other departments for smooth production.
* Implement and maintain **5S and Kaizen** practices on the shop floor.
* Ensure compliance with **ISO 9001** quality systems and standard operating procedures.
* Monitor process parameters and ensure consistent product quality.
* Develop and implement preventive actions for recurring production and quality issues.
* Train, guide and manage production supervisors, operators and workers.
* Maintain production reports and analyze daily/monthly production performance.
* Ensure proper housekeeping, discipline and safety practices on the production floor.

Technical Skills Required

* Strong knowledge of **Injection Molding Production**.
* Production Planning & Control (**PPC**).
* Knowledge of **OEE improvement** and productivity enhancement.
* **5S and Kaizen** implementation.
* **Root Cause Analysis** and problem-solving.
* Process optimization and cycle-time reduction.
* Rejection and waste control.
* Knowledge of **ISO 9001 quality systems**.
* Good manpower and shop-floor management skills.

**Added Advantage:** Experience in **PET Preform Production/Process** will be preferred.

Candidate Profile

Candidates should have strong hands-on experience in injection molding production and the ability to independently manage production operations, manpower and production targets. Good communication, leadership and problem-solving skills are essential.

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹60,000.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* Do you have 10–15 years of experience in Injection Molding Production?
* Have you independently managed injection molding production, including manpower, machines, production targets, rejection and downtime?
* Do you have hands-on knowledge of PPC, OEE improvement, 5S, Kaizen, Root Cause Analysis and process optimization?
* Do you have experience with PET Preform production? If yes, please mention your experience.

title: Operations Manager
description:
**Key Responsibilities**

**Operations Management:**  
Oversee day-to-day warehouse operations including sorting, grading, transformation, and dispatch of products.
  
Ensure timely delivery and stock availability for all dark stores.
  
Manage complete warehouse operations including cold chain processes while ensuring quality standards and SOP compliance within defined cut-off timelines.

**Inventory Management:**  
Ensure inventory accuracy and maintain proper stock control processes.
  
Monitor stock levels and share daily stock audit reports with relevant stakeholders.
  
Ensure timely identification and liquidation of damaged and expired inventory as per SOP and customer SLA.

Coordinate with vendors to ensure timely availability of operational resources such as contract associates, security personnel, and transportation facilities.
  
Monitor vendor performance and ensure service delivery as per agreed requirements.

Track productivity across warehouse processes and implement improvements to minimize operational waste.
  
Manage operational efficiency to control variable costs and improve process performance.

**Reporting & Compliance:**  
Ensure daily KPIs agreed with customers are achieved and present operational performance reports during daily review meetings.
  
Ensure timely processing of vendor bills as per PR/PO process in SAP and maintain proper documentation.

**Qualifications**

Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field (preferred).
  
6–8 years of experience in warehouse or logistics operations, preferably in FMCG, grocery, or fresh produce supply chains.
  
Experience in handling cold chain operations and high-volume warehouse environments.
  
Strong knowledge of inventory management, warehouse processes, and vendor coordination.
  
Familiarity with SAP or similar ERP systems for billing and operational processes.
  
Strong leadership, coordination, and problem-solving skills.
  
Good communication and operational reporting abilities.

title: Placement Manager
description:
**About Medhavi Group:**
Established in 2013, Medhavi Group is a unified ecosystem comprising MSU and various skill- promoting organisations, dedicated to advancing skill development, vocational training, and industry- integrated higher education. With a strong outcome-driven approach, the Group has trained over 6 lakh learners, achieving more than 70% employability outcomes, and currently supports 20,000+ active students across its diverse programs. Medhavi Group continues to bridge the gap between education and employment by building scalable, industry-aligned talent pathways across India. Work Integrated Skill based Higher Education (WISE) is Medhavi’s flagship industry-integrated initiative built on the principle of “Industry as Campus.” It combines academic learning with structured on-the job training, ensuring students graduate with real work experience and industry-ready skills. Through deep, outcome-driven partnerships with over 300+ leading industry and skill partners across 26+ sectors including Hyundai, Mahindra, IHG Group, Nephroplus, Barbeque Nation, Nexus Select Malls, ClassPlus, Tata Electronics, Marriott, ITC, and others- WISE enables learners to acquire role- specific competencies directly within live business environments. WISE creates a demand-driven talent pipeline for industries that enhances employability, improves workforce productivity, and bridges the industry skill gap.

For more information, visit
**https://msu.edu.in/wise/**

**Role Overview:**

The Manager will be responsible for establishing and strengthening partnerships with healthcare institutions, hospitals, rehabilitation centers, mental health organizations, clinics, NGOs, and industry partners to facilitate On-the-Job Training (OJT), clinical postings, internships, fieldwork, and experiential learning opportunities for students of Psychology and Allied Health Sciences. The role also involves developing and managing Memorandums of Understanding (MoUs) with partner organizations to support student training, research, and industry engagement initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Industry Partnership Development**

• Identify, approach, and onboard hospitals, clinics, diagnostic centers, rehabilitation centers, mental health organizations, NGOs, and healthcare providers for student training and placement opportunities.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with industry stakeholders and healthcare institutions.

• Explore new opportunities for collaboration in training, internships, research, and skill development.

**2. OJT & Clinical Posting Coordination**

• Facilitate OJT, internships, clinical postings, field visits, and practical training for Psychology and Allied Health Sciences students.

• Coordinate with academic departments and industry partners to ensure timely placement of students.

• Monitor student attendance, performance, and compliance during training and clinical postings.

• Resolve issues related to student deployment and industry coordination.

**3. MoU Development & Management**

• Draft, process, and coordinate Memorandums of Understanding (MoUs) with hospitals, healthcare institutions, NGOs, and industry partners.

• Ensure timely renewal and maintenance of partnership agreements.

• Maintain records and documentation related to all industry collaborations and MoUs.

• Coordinate with legal, administrative, and academic teams for approvals and execution of agreements.

**4. Stakeholder Coordination**

• Act as the primary point of contact between the university and partner organizations.

• Organize industry meetings, partnership discussions, and review sessions.

• Facilitate communication among students, faculty members, and industry partners.

**5. Compliance & Documentation**

• Maintain a database of industry partners, clinical sites, and training organizations.

• Prepare periodic reports on student postings, industry engagement activities, and partnership outcomes. • Ensure compliance with university policies, accreditation requirements, and regulatory guidelines related to clinical training.

**6. Student Support & Career Development**

• Guide students regarding internship and clinical posting requirements.

• Support employability initiatives and facilitate industry interactions.

• Assist in organizing workshops, guest lectures, industry visits, and career-oriented activities.

**Qualifications & Skills Required:**

• Master's Degree in Psychology, Hospital Administration, Healthcare Management, Social Work, Allied Health Sciences, Business Administration, or a related field.

• Additional certifications in healthcare management or industry relations will be an advantage.

• 5 - 10 years of experience in industry relations, healthcare partnerships, training coordination, placement activities, or academic-industry collaboration.

• Experience in working with hospitals, healthcare institutions, NGOs, or educational institutions is preferred.

• Strong networking and relationship management skills.

• Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal abilities.

• Knowledge of healthcare and mental health ecosystems.

• Experience in drafting and managing MoUs and partnership agreements.

• Strong organizational and documentation skills.

• Proficiency in MS Office and database management.

**What We Offer**

• Opportunity to architect and scale a future-focused, industry-integrated higher education ecosystem.

• Competitive compensation with performance-linked incentives.

• Leadership role in a rapidly growing national skills and university platform.

• A collaborative, mission-driven environment.

• The opportunity to create a measurable impact on employability and workforce transformation at scale.

Medhavi Skills University is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Director, Technical Consulting (Salesforce & Tableau Next)
description:
**Description**
Salesforce is currently seeking a Director,Technical Consulting (Tableau Next) to join our Global Delivery Centre (GDC) team. We are looking for an experienced professional services leader who has experience in scaling professional services delivery centers across the world.
  
  
In addition The Director — Tableau Next is an execution-focused technical leader responsible for designing and delivering migrations from legacy Business Intelligence and reporting platforms (Cognos, Business Objects, MicroStrategy, Power BI, Looker, legacy Tableau Server) to Tableau Next. As a foundational member of the Strategic Migration CoE and Migration Factory, you will act as primary technical authority for the Tableau Next track — owning the solution design, data architecture, subscriber migration strategy, journey migration blueprint, and Data Cloud unified profile design. You will be owning the analytics platform architecture, legacy BI content migration strategy, data source re-architecture, governance model design and Tableau Next feature adoption roadmap.
  
  
You will combine deep Tableau expertise with strong data engineering and cloud data platform knowledge to ensure that dashboards, data sources, calculated fields, permissions and governance structures are migrated with full fidelity, improved performance and accelerated time-to-insight for the client's business users. This role is of people leader and 50% billable role, you will work with our customers and partners as a senior technical architect/program architect/CTO to solve critically important business challenges using Salesforce’s Cloud.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead a team of up to 8 direct reports, comprising Architects and potentially Managers, providing technical direction, mentorship, and performance leadership.
* Serve as a Senior/Principal Technical Architect for Analytics migration projects, contributing hands-on technical expertise and architectural leadership at approximately 50% utilization.
* Serve as the Technical Lead for Tableau Next migration workstreams, architecting the end-to-end transition from legacy BI platforms to Tableau Next — including dashboard migration, data source re-architecture, semantic layer design and governance model.
* Design the legacy BI content migration strategy — inventorying, assessing and prioritising all legacy reports, dashboards, datasets and calculated fields for migration, retirement or rebuild in Tableau Next.
* Architect the Tableau Next data source framework — designing live connections, published data sources, virtual connections, data policies and extract schedules optimised for performance and governance.
* Design the Tableau Next site and governance model — including project hierarchy, permission groups, content certification workflow, data quality warnings and usage analytics configuration.
* Own the cloud data platform integration architecture — designing connections between Tableau Next and Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Azure Synapse and Salesforce Data Cloud as analytical data sources.
* Lead the semantic layer and data model migration — translating legacy BI semantic models, universe layers (Business Objects) and subject areas (Cognos) into Tableau Next published data source designs and calculations.
* Define end-to-end data lineage for all analytics objects — mapping source data fields through transformation layers to Tableau Next calculated fields, ensuring business logic equivalence is preserved or improved.
* Lead functional and technical discovery workshops with client business intelligence, data engineering and business analytics teams to assess legacy report complexity, data source dependencies and user adoption patterns.
* Manage the functional depth of Source vs. Target systems — maintaining deep understanding of how legacy BI platform features (Cognos report types, Business Objects universes, Power BI DAX measures) translate to Tableau Next capabilities.
* Serve as a Trusted Advisor to the client, driving conversations with CDOs, Analytics leaders and Enterprise Architects to shape the Tableau Next migration roadmap, data governance strategy and self-service analytics vision.
* Establish best-in-class standards for the Tableau Next migration practice — building reusable dashboard migration templates, data source connection templates, naming convention standards and governance configuration playbooks as factory accelerators.
* Lead performance optimisation — profiling legacy dashboard performance baselines, designing Tableau Next data extracts and published data sources to meet or exceed baseline performance, and establishing performance monitoring.
* Lead cutover planning and execution — including legacy BI platform deprecation scheduling, user access migration, Tableau Next URL/bookmark migration for key dashboards and post-go-live self-service training.
* Identify and mitigate technical risks proactively — data source credential migration, calculated field logic parity gaps, row-level security re-implementation, extract refresh SLA continuity and legacy report complexity underestimation.
* Contribute to the Migration Factory by building reusable Tableau Next migration playbooks, dashboard assessment tools, data source templates and performance benchmarking scripts to reduce wave delivery time.

**Experience Requirements**

* 18+ years of experience leading Salesforce technical consulting projects and handling as individual contributors.
* 8+ years of people management experience
* Strong application design skills combined with strong data, integration, and security architecture skills
* Demonstrated experience migrating large BI content estates (500+ reports/dashboards) from legacy platforms to Tableau.

**Salesforce & Platform Certifications**

* Tableau Certified Architect (Preferred)
* Tableau Certified Data Analyst (Required)
* Salesforce Certified CRM Analytics and Einstein Discovery Consultant (Required)
* Salesforce Data Cloud Consultant (Preferred)
* Snowflake SnowPro Core or Advanced (Preferred)
* Databricks Certified Associate Developer (Preferred)
* dbt Analytics Engineering Certification (Preferred)

**Cross Cutting Qualifications**

* Proven expertise in executing complex data migrations — multiple end-to-end migration projects from legacy systems to Salesforce or vice versa.
* Integration Architecture (Must Have): Understanding of how data flows between systems and the mechanisms for high-volume data transport.
* Data Architecture & Management (Must Have): Expertise in ERD design, data cleansing, managing high volumes of data and Large Data Volume (LDV) strategies.
* Platform Security (Must Have): Knowledge of data encryption, field-level security, Shield and compliance-aligned data movement during migration windows.
* Identity & Access Management (Must Have): Understanding of user migration, permission set mapping, SSO and visibility model design.
* Sharing & Visibility (Must Have): How migrated data will be secured and accessed post-deployment.
* Platform Development (Must Have): Proficiency in Apex, Async Design, Governor limit, LWC components and Salesforce Flows.
* Excellent communication skills — ability to articulate complex migration strategies to both technical teams and C-suite business stakeholders.
* Ability to work in a factory delivery model — reusing and contributing to shared accelerators, playbooks and templates across concurrent wave teams.
* Proven ability to analyze, design, and optimize business processes via technology and integration
* Resourceful and innovative thinker who can work through and solve problems
* Adept at navigating/mediating conflict and fostering healthy dialogue
* Exceptional analytical skills - experience overseeing and managing business metrics, productivity, and outcomes

title: Manager, Acquisition Fraud Strategy (L09)

Credit Team decisions credit actions across the lifecycle of a customer – from acquisition to account management to collections and recover – we work towards managing credit and fraud losses and elevating customer experience through powerful and proprietary insights on customer risk and credit behaviors. * Understand requirements and create reports based on ad hoc requests & streamline processes
* Create client requested performance summaries

* Strong Team Player in cross-functional environment
* Strong written/oral communication skills

* Clear thinker with an ability to think through processes Proven ability to successfully interact with all levels of an organization

* Work experience in a US financial institution or bank
* Systems Implementation experience

* Degree in following Majors – Mathematics/Statistics, Operations Research, Economics, Computer Science/Engineering or other quantitative majors with 2+ year hands on experience in SAS, SQL, Unix, Excel or in lieu of a degree 4+ years in SAS, SQL, Unix, Excel.

**Work Timings**
This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs) We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. As part of our EY Cyber Risk and Compliance Consulting (CRCR) team, you will contribute technically to Cyber Security client engagements and internal projects. The role involves managing Third-Party Cyber Risk Management (TPCRM) engagements, ensuring that our clients effectively identify, assess, and mitigate risks associated with third-party relationships. An important part of your role will be to actively establish, maintain, and strengthen internal and external relationships.

We are looking for TPCRM Senior with expertise in cyber security, risk management, and security controls testing concepts. * Third Party Due Diligence: Oversee the third-party due diligence process, including cyber, privacy, resiliency and compliance assessments.

Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world-class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Adani Energy Solutions Limited (AESL) is a leading player in India’s power transmission and energy infrastructure sector, enabling seamless and efficient energy flow across the nation. With a strong presence in both operational and under-construction projects, AESL manages over 20,000 circuit kilometers of transmission lines and substations. As a part of the Adani Group, AESL is driven by the philosophy of #GrowthWithGoodness, aiming to build a sustainable and resilient energy future. Through digital innovation, smart grid deployment, and a commitment to ESG excellence, AESL plays a vital role in strengthening India’s energy security and powering inclusive growth.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
The Engineering (I&C) Manager-ACSL supports the successful execution of district cooling system (DCS) projects by managing all instrumentation and control (I&C) aspects throughout the project lifecycle. This role ensures seamless integration of I&C systems, overseeing installation, testing, and commissioning while maintaining technical compliance and alignment with design specifications. The position focuses on optimizing system performance, mitigating technical risks, and ensuring timely delivery, contributing to the reliable, efficient, and sustainable operation of ACSL’s DCS portfolio.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Engineering (I&C) Manager-ACSL**
**Design And Technical Support**
Contribute to system accuracy by assisting in the design of I&C systems, ensuring compliance with project requirements, industry standards, and regulatory guidelines.
  
  
Support system reliability by reviewing and verifying technical drawings, specifications, and calculations, ensuring quality standards are met and minimizing post-installation issues.
  
  
Assist in the integration of I&C systems by providing support in cross-functional collaboration to improve project efficiency and ensure alignment with other engineering disciplines.
  
  
**Feasibility And Documentation**

Contribute to compliance efforts by supporting the preparation of technical documentation, including project specifications, tender documents, and system requirements to ensure timely project approvals.
  
  
Support decision-making by providing clear and accurate technical reports to stakeholders, helping to define project scope and timelines.
  
  
**Project Execution**
Support timely installation and commissioning by assisting in overseeing processes, ensuring adherence to budgets, and meeting quality standards across all project phases.
  
  
Minimize delays by proactively identifying issues during construction, testing, and commissioning, helping to ensure seamless execution and system performance.
  
  
Ensure compliance by supporting the coordination with contractors and suppliers to ensure I&C systems meet safety, quality, and performance standards.
  
  
**Technology And Innovation**
Assist in technology integration by supporting the incorporation of state-of-the-art control and automation technologies (e.g., SCADA, PLC, DCS) into I&C systems, contributing to system efficiency and operational reliability.
  
  
Promote continuous improvement by staying informed about emerging technologies and supporting their integration into I&C systems to maintain alignment with industry trends.

title: Warehouse Manager
description:
**About The Company**
We, RentoMojo, were founded by IITM alums and serial entrepreneurs who worked out of almost every major city in India in his first five years of corporate careers. Frustrated with the hassles of relocating from one place to the other, and tired of finding that perfect cluster of home essentials that suited their lifestyle.
  
  
**"The spending youth, especially the millennials & Gen Z's prefer staying light, desire flexibility and are value-conscious. Willing to experiment with new stuff across categories that make life simpler and not boring, these generations are also sensitive to our planet's sustainability. Our customers and employees identify with what we do '', is what Geetansh Bamania, our Founder and CEO has to say.**
RentoMojo caters to the needs of working professionals which is unmet due to the nonavailability of furnished rental flats by offering furniture and appliances on a rental basis, thus, providing more flexibility than owning the expensive furniture and appliances.
  
  
Currently, we have 130,000+ subscribers with a typical rental period of 1214 months. The current market size (as per a recent report by Grant Thornton) is estimated to be US$ 4.1 Billion and expected to grow to US$ 13 Billion by 2025.
  
  
With 1000+ people operations, the company has a presence in 16 cities across India. Looking back, Rentomojo has not only made a new market of leases which never existed for the consumer, they have also become market leaders in the consumer rental industry. Unlike the norm, they are now seeing a reverse trend wherein a version of ours is being copied in the US and UK. We are also profitable at monthly PAT since Oct 2021.
  
  
**Five Pillars Of Our Culture**
**Zoom InZoom Out :**

* We zoom in and go micro; our focus would be doing better in everything, including things we already do well.
* We zoom out a lot for creating successful pilots that can potentially scale into a lot of value add in the future, like strengthening our offline presence.

**Enterprising Mindset: If you are bold enough, you will have life-changing growth opportunities here.**

* We will continue to expand the responsibilities of hungry and willing people. If you are ready to do what you have never done, you will find roles that you have never managed.
* Growing people from within was a significant contributor to the Fortune Employers Choice Award that we won in 2022 and more importantly, that's one of the biggest reasons for our success & continued momentum

**Frugality: Measure Twice and Cut once.**

* It is always easy to spend more money to get more done, but it lacks any form of challenge. We have to grow and become better without a proportionate increase in cost.
* For every penny that we spend or that we put up to spend, expect a lot of discussions, debates, and conversations. Planning is going to be important, data has to be the foundation, detailing will be a must, and world-class execution is the only way we will move forward in this journey.

**Accountability: Less Why, more How.**

* We will always have more to bite than we can chew, we will always have to make choices and prioritize while we progress. We can have hundreds of reasons behind why something can not be done, but we have to remain focused on the how of things. The focus on how will help us find ways to get done, and what needs to get done.

**Think, decide, play, and act for the long term.**

* The only time we will make short-term decisions is when they help us in the longer term. To me, the long term is all about consistency and not intensity.

Recent Media Coverage: YourStory, Dec 2022

title: Operational Excellence Manager
description:
The Operational Excellence Manager will lead the site’s Lean transformation and continuous-improvement agenda across turbine and generator manufacturing operations. The role will improve safety, quality, delivery, cost, productivity, equipment effectiveness, and lead time through structured problem solving, standard work, value-stream improvement, daily management, and selective automation. Operational Excellence roles typically focus on eliminating losses, deploying Lean/Six Sigma methods, improving throughput and yield, and sustaining improvements through standardized processes and performance reviews.
  
  
This is a hands-on, shop-floor leadership role requiring deep engagement with heavy machining, fabrication and welding, assembly, and generator-component manufacturing team.
  
  
Function: Manufacturing / Operations
  
  
Location: Sanand, Ahmedabad (Gujarat)
  
  
Reports to: Operational Excellence Leader
  
  
Management level / band: LPB
  
  
**Manufacturing scope**
The role will support improvement across the full value stream, including:
  
  

* Machining of turbine rotors, casings, diaphragms, and other major nuclear components.
* Blade machining, inspection, handling, and preparation processes.
* Heavy fabrication, welding, stress relieving (PWHT), blasting-painting, machining, and assembly of fabricated structures.
* Turbine assembly, alignment, balancing, testing, and final inspection operations.
* Generator parts manufacturing, including stator green bar production, insulation and processing operations.
* Generator stacking, slotting, wedging, winding support, impregnation, and related assembly processes.
* Material flow, tooling, fixtures, cranes, handling equipment, machine loading, and layout optimization.
* Interface with Quality, Manufacturing Engineering, Maintenance, Planning, Supply Chain, EHS, and Production teams.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Lean transformation and daily management**

* Develop and deploy the site Operational Excellence roadmap aligned with plant safety, quality, delivery, cost, and productivity objectives.
* Lead daily management systems, including SQDC boards, tiered meetings, escalation routines, visual management, and action follow-up.
* Establish and monitor plant KPIs, including safety events and risks, quality performance, plan versus actual, schedule adherence, OEE, productivity, labor hours, lead time, 5S, TPM, and Kaizen effectiveness.
* Conduct structured performance reviews with production, support, and cross-functional teams to identify gaps and drive corrective actions.
* Ensure improvement actions are assigned, tracked, verified, and sustained through standardization.

**Process improvement and waste elimination**

* Lead Value Stream Mapping for turbine and generator manufacturing value streams, identifying bottlenecks, waiting time, transport, inventory, rework, and non-value-added activities.
* Conduct time studies, capacity analysis, line balancing, and cycle-time reduction studies for machining, welding, assembly, and generator-component operations.
* Define and improve work methods, standard work, work instructions, process sequences, tooling requirements, and shop-floor controls.
* Lead root-cause analysis and problem-solving reports (PSR/A3/8D as applicable) for recurring quality, productivity, delivery, and equipment issues.
* Reduce changeover, setup, material-handling, inspection, and waiting losses through Lean methods such as SMED, 5S, Kanban, pull systems, and flow optimization.
* Improve process repeatability, first-time quality, throughput, and on-time delivery while respecting product and process specifications.

**Machining, welding, and assembly improvement**

* Partner with Manufacturing Engineering and Production teams to improve heavy machining processes for rotors, casings, diaphragms, and blades.
* Analyze machine utilization, setup time, tool life, fixture changeover, inspection cycles, operator waiting, and material availability to improve machining output.
* Support improvement of heavy fabrication and welding operations, including weld sequencing, fit-up, distortion control, rework reduction, handling, and workflow design.
* Improve turbine assembly and generator stator manufacturing processes through better layout, kitting, sequencing, standard work, ergonomic design, and visual controls.
* Identify opportunities to reduce lead time and work-in-process across long-cycle, high-value components.

**Automation, ergonomics, and technology**

* Identify, evaluate, and implement cost-effective low-level automation, robotics, mechanized handling, digital tools, and assistive technologies.
* Lead feasibility studies, benefit calculations, investment justifications, supplier coordination, pilot trials, and implementation for selected automation projects.
* Apply human-factors and ergonomic principles to reduce manual effort, improve safety, and improve operator productivity in heavy-component handling and assembly areas.
* Stay current with Industry 4.0, AI, machine learning, robotics, digital performance management, and relevant manufacturing technologies; assess practical applications for the site

**Building Capability and Culture**

* Train, coach, and develop production supervisors, engineers, operators, and cross-functional teams in Lean thinking, structured problem solving, standard work, 5S, TPM, and daily management.
* Lead Kaizen events, improvement workshops, and cross-functional projects from diagnosis through implementation and benefit validation.

**Designation: Manager - Cutting**

**Department: Cutting & Sorting**

**Location: Gandhinagar**

**About the Role**

To manage the complete throughput of the Cutting Department — including cutting machines, manual cutting, and the sorting team — by ensuring high people productivity, optimal machine efficiency, minimal fabric and foam wastage, timely order execution based on ageing, accurate cut-kit dispatch to vendors, and error-free cutting and sorting to eliminate kit returns.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Throughput & Productivity Management**

* Own end-to-end throughput of all cutting machines and the sorting team.
* Monitor and drive machine efficiency (OEE) and operator productivity on a daily/shift basis.
* Track output vs. plan for cutting and sorting; identify and resolve bottlenecks in real time.
* Set and review productivity benchmarks (pieces/hour, kits/day, machine utilization %) for operators and machines.

**2. Cutting Operations (Fabric, Foam & Manual)**

* Plan and supervise fabric cutting, foam cutting, and manual cutting operations.
* Deploy manual cutting judiciously for small-scale/low-volume requirements to optimize material usage and reduce wastage.
* Continuously identify opportunities to reduce fabric and foam wastage through better marker planning, lay optimization, and cutting sequence.
* Ensure correct cutting specifications, patterns, and sizes are followed as per order requirements.

**3. Order Prioritization & Scheduling**

* Track ageing of all pending orders and use ageing data to prioritize the daily/weekly cutting schedule.
* Prepare and maintain a cutting schedule/plan aligned with dispatch commitments and order priority.
* Coordinate with planning, merchandising, and production teams to align cutting schedules with overall production flow.

**4. Sorting & Kit Management**

* Supervise the sorting team to ensure accurate sorting and kitting of cut components.
* Ensure cut kits are complete, correctly matched, and free of defects before dispatch.
* Ensure cutting and sorting processes are executed error-free to eliminate kit returns from vendors/downstream units.

**5. Vendor Kit Distribution**

* Ensure cut kits are distributed to vendors strictly as per the agreed dispatch plan and timelines.
* Maintain proper documentation and records of kits dispatched — including quantity, date, vendor, and order reference.
* Coordinate with logistics/dispatch teams to ensure timely and accurate handover of kits.
* Track and resolve any discrepancies or delays in kit distribution.

**6. Quality & Wastage Control**

* Implement checks/controls to minimize cutting errors, mismatches, and material wastage.
* Conduct root-cause analysis on kit returns or cutting errors and implement corrective/preventive actions.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce rework, wastage %, and kit rejection rate.

**7. Team Management**

* Lead, train, and manage cutting machine operators, manual cutters, and the sorting team.
* Plan manpower deployment/shift allocation based on order load and machine availability.
* Monitor attendance, discipline, and performance of the team; conduct performance reviews.
* Identify training needs and build a skilled, multi-tasking workforce.

**8. Records & Reporting**

* Maintain accurate records of cutting output, wastage, machine efficiency, kit dispatch, and returns.
* Prepare and share daily/weekly/monthly MIS reports with management on department performance.
* Ensure documentation is audit-ready and compliant with internal SOPs.

**9. Machine & Resource Management**

* Ensure preventive maintenance of cutting machines is planned and executed to avoid downtime.
* Coordinate with maintenance team for timely breakdown resolution.
* Monitor machine efficiency and take corrective action for underperforming equipment.

**Key Result Areas (KRAs)**

* Cutting & sorting throughput vs. plan
* Machine efficiency / OEE %
* Fabric & foam wastage %
* On-time cut-kit dispatch to vendors (%)
* Kit return rate (target: zero/near-zero)
* Order ageing compliance in scheduling
* Team productivity and attendance
* Accuracy of dispatch and production records

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Graduate in Textile/Mechanical, Production, Industrial Engineering, or related field (relevant experience may be considered in lieu).
* 5–10 years of experience in cutting department operations within furniture, mattress, upholstery, garment, or foam-based manufacturing.
* Proven experience managing cutting machines (fabric/foam) and sorting/kitting teams.
* Hands-on exposure to manual cutting operations is preferred.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Strong understanding of fabric and foam cutting processes and wastage optimization techniques.
* Good planning and scheduling skills, especially order-ageing-based prioritization.
* People management and team leadership skills.
* Data-driven approach — comfortable maintaining records/MIS in Excel or ERP systems.
* Strong coordination skills with planning, merchandising, dispatch, and vendor teams.
* Problem-solving mindset with focus on quality and error elimination.
* Attention to detail and process discipline.

**Designation: Manager/ Sr. Manager – Carrier & Freight Commercial**

**Location: Gandhinagar**

**Role purpose**

This position owns the commercial relationship with every carrier the business uses — rate negotiation, lane allocation, contract renewal and freight cost assurance. It sits directly under the Head of Supply Chain & Logistics and is separate from trade and customs compliance, which is a distinct function. The role carries a monthly express freight spend running in the order of 23 crore, against which no contracted rate table currently exists for the India entities.

**Key responsibilities**

* Own every carrier contract end to end — FedEx across both India entities and the US entity, UPS, Emirates and new entrants — including a renewal and expiry calendar with a named owner against every date, so that no term lapses unnoticed.
* Negotiate and benchmark rates, and build the rate card baseline the business does not currently hold. Roughly 89% of monthly freight spend is un-baselined today.
* Own lane allocation — routing volume to the right carrier by cost, transit time and service level — and document the logic so it can be audited and repeated.
* Govern dimensional divisors, fuel and surcharge concessions across all carriers, including the US amendment concessions that expire in February 2027 and revert to list.
* Own freight cost assurance — charged weight against company record, invoice audit before payment, and recovery claims through to credit.
* Drive down accessorial and exception charges by working with operations on root cause, not only by validating them after billing.
* Monitor volume commitments and surge clauses against contractual thresholds, and flag a breach before the carrier does.
* Run carrier governance — quarterly business reviews, SLA reviews, escalation matrices and service remedies.
* Report carrier cost monthly into the business review and into the gross margin programme.
* Support the trade and customs compliance function on carrier-side documentation, without owning compliance itself.

**Required skills, qualifications and experience**

* 10 to 14 years in freight procurement, carrier management or logistics commercial, with direct hands-on negotiation with international express carriers.
* Demonstrated contract negotiation on an annual freight spend of 100 crore or above.
* Deep working knowledge of express pricing mechanics — dimensional divisors, fuel tables, accessorial structures, zone and lane pricing, earned discount tiers and volume commitments.
* Freight audit and recovery experience, including building and defending a claim against a carrier.
* Strong commercial analytics — able to build a cost model, defend it to Finance, and put it in front of a carrier without it being picked apart.
* Exposure across air, ocean and parcel modes; export-led businesses preferred.
* Able to hold a senior carrier relationship and a difficult commercial conversation without damaging it.
* Graduate. MBA or postgraduate qualification in Supply Chain, or CIPS or equivalent procurement certification, an advantage.

**What good looks like in the first 90 days**

* A complete rate card and contract baseline across every carrier, in one register.
* A renewal and expiry calendar with a named owner against each date, including the February 2027 surcharge cliff.
* The open recovery claim either closed or on an agreed, dated path with the carrier.
* Lane allocation logic documented and agreed with operations.
* A first view of accessorial spend by type, with the three largest reduction opportunities quantified.

title: EHS & Maintenance Manager
description:
**Position Title:**
Environment, Health & Safety (EHS) & Maintenance Manager
  
  
*Hydro Prokav Pumps India Pvt Ltd*
*Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu*
**About Us**
*Hydro Prokav Pumps, part of Ingersoll Rand, a leading progressive cavity pump (PCP) manufacturer and exporter headquartered in Coimbatore, India. Hydro Prokav core expertise lies in PCP solutions, the perfect choice for handling tough, viscous, abrasive, and high-consistency mediums. Equipped with state-of-the-art machinery and testing facilities, our integrated plant ensures precision manufacturing and rigorous quality control for every pump produced.*
**Job Summary**
*The EHS & Maintenance Manager is responsible for leading and managing the site's Environment, Health & Safety, Sustainability, Engineering Maintenance, Utilities and Facility Management functions.*
**Responsibilities**
**Maintenance Planning & Execution**

* Full statutory and regulatory compliance
* Prevention of injuries, occupational illnesses and environmental incidents
* Implementation of corporate EHS policies and standards
* Effective ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 management systems
* Reliable and safe operation of plant machinery and utilities
* Preventive and predictive maintenance effectiveness
* Equipment reliability and reduction of unplanned downtime
* Effective energy and resource management
* Engineering and EHS project execution
* Sustainability and emission reduction
* Emergency preparedness
* Continuous improvement in safety, environmental and operational performance

**EHS, Compliance & Safety**

* Ensure compliance with all applicable EHS and statutory requirements, including TNPCB, DISH, Fire & Rescue Services, CEIG, DTCP and other regulatory authorities.
* Manage statutory licenses, consents, approvals, renewals, registers, inspections and regulatory submissions.
* Implement and maintain ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 management systems, including internal/external audits, management reviews and CAPA closure.
* Lead HIRA, JSA, Permit-to-Work, LOTO, contractor safety and high-risk activity controls.
* Drive accident prevention, SIF/Fatality Prevention, safety inspections, near-miss reporting and proactive safety programs.
* Lead incident investigations, Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and corrective/preventive actions.
* Maintain Emergency Response Plans and conduct periodic mock drills for fire, chemical spills, medical and other emergencies.
* Conduct EHS training, employee engagement and safety awareness programs to strengthen site safety culture.

**Environment & Sustainability**

* Manage environmental compliance covering air emissions, effluent, hazardous waste, chemical management, water, energy and waste disposal.
* Manage applicable EPR compliance, authorized waste vendors and environmental documentation.
* Drive energy efficiency, GHG emission reduction, renewable energy, water conservation, recycling and waste-reduction initiatives.
* Collect, validate and report EHS and sustainability performance data to corporate stakeholders.
* Support Scope 1, Scope 2 and relevant Scope 3 GHG accounting, ESG reporting, LCA and Product Carbon Footprint initiatives, as applicable.
* Develop and monitor environmental and sustainability KPIs against corporate targets.

**Maintenance, Engineering & Utilities**

* Lead overall mechanical, electrical, utility, facility and infrastructure maintenance activities.
* Develop and execute preventive, predictive and breakdown maintenance programs to improve equipment reliability and availability.
* Monitor equipment performance through PM compliance, downtime, MTBF, MTTR and repeat breakdown analysis.
* Lead RCA for major equipment failures and implement permanent corrective actions.
* Ensure reliable operation of electrical systems, compressors, HVAC, water systems, fire protection systems and other plant utilities.
* Manage electrical safety and CEIG compliance, including preventive maintenance and statutory inspections.
* Plan shutdown maintenance, critical spare requirements, AMCs and maintenance service contracts.
* Lead engineering, safety, sustainability and energy-efficiency improvement projects.
* Manage contractors and vendors for maintenance and engineering activities with strong EHS controls.
* Prepare and control EHS and maintenance budgets, optimizing cost without compromising safety, compliance or equipment reliability.

**Basic Qualifications**

* BE mechanical/Electrical with 10-15 years experience

**Key Competencies**

* EHS statutory and regulatory compliance
* ISO 14001 & ISO 45001
* HIRA, JSA, PTW & LOTO
* Incident Investigation & Root Cause Analysis
* SIF / Fatality Prevention
* Environmental & Chemical Management
* Sustainability & ESG Reporting
* GHG Accounting & Carbon Reduction
* Preventive & Predictive Maintenance
* Mechanical & Electrical Maintenance
* Equipment Reliability, MTBF & MTTR
* Utilities & Facility Management
* Energy Management
* Engineering Project Management
* Contractor & Vendor Management
* Budget & Cost Management
* Team Leadership & Cross-functional Coordination

**What We Offer**

* We are all owners of the company! Stock options (Employee Ownership Program) that align your interests with the company's success.
* Yearly performance-based bonus, rewarding your hard work and dedication.
* Leave Encashments
* Maternity/Paternity Leaves
* Employee Health covered under Medical, Group Term Life & Accident Insurance
* Employee Assistance Program
* Employee development with LinkedIn Learning
* Employee recognition via Awardco

* Ability to review work done by junior members, ensuring quality of work product during time sensitive deadlines

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organisations. **To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Qualified or Part/ nearly Qualified Actuary or Policy Admin System expect with at least 8+ years to 15 years of experience in Life Insurance industry, either within a consulting firm or an Insurer or an organisation providing Insurance services
* Ability to multi-task and flexible work attitude packed with good analytical skills
* Experience of handling a moderate sized team will be an advantage
* Proficiency in MS-Office Suite, Power BI, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, SPSS, etc., will be a plus

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Strong academic background with a bachelor’s degree with an emphasis in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics or finance related supplemented ideally with a professional qualification
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing industry studies and stakeholder presentations
* Ability to review work done by junior members, ensuring quality of work product during time sensitive deadlines
* The ability to build relationships with colleagues across the business, support them and promote a collaborative environment
* Overseas exposure (especially US/Canada/Europe/UK/Australia market experience)

**What We Look For**

* Deep knowledge and experience of the insurance industry and/or consulting. Relevant recent big 4 experience in leading actuarial engagement with recognised insurers will be an advantage. This ideally should be complemented by employment experience within the Insurance sector either at an insurer, intermediary or regulator
* Up to date knowledge of the regulatory environment impacting insurers and other financial service organisations
* Experience of supporting teams to high quality timely delivery, actively building relationships and promoting a collaborative culture when working with colleagues

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
