title: Head of E-commerce Marketplaces
description:
**Job Description – Head of E-commerce Marketplaces**

**Company:**
Helett Enterprises LLP

**Position:**
Head – E-commerce Marketplaces

**Department:**
Marketplace

**Experience:**
Minimum 6–10 years in E-commerce / Online Retail

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Industry:**
Electronics / E-commerce / Online Retail

**Language:**
English (Mandatory)

**Salary:**
Attractive salary package based on experience, expertise, and current industry standards. Final compensation and benefits will be discussed during the interview.

**1. About the Role**

Helett Enterprises LLP is looking for a highly experienced, strategic, and result-oriented
**Head of E-commerce Marketplaces**
to lead and manage the company's complete online marketplace business.

The candidate will be responsible for overall marketplace strategy, business development, revenue generation, profitability, advertising performance, account management, and team leadership.

This is a senior leadership position requiring strong hands-on expertise in Amazon Marketplace, along with experience managing multiple e-commerce platforms.

The selected candidate will be expected to take complete ownership of marketplace operations, establish business strategies, achieve ambitious revenue targets, improve profit margins, and build a high-performing marketplace team.

**Amazon Marketplace experience is mandatory.**

**2. Key Roles and Core Responsibilities**

**A. Overall Marketplace Business Leadership**

* Take complete ownership of the company's marketplace business, including sales, revenue, profitability, and operational performance.
* Develop and implement short-term and long-term marketplace business strategies.
* Prepare annual, quarterly, monthly, and weekly business plans with measurable targets.
* Establish revenue, sales growth, profitability, and market-share objectives.
* Identify business opportunities, new product categories, and potential marketplace expansion.
* Analyse business performance and take corrective action whenever targets are not achieved.
* Present regular business performance reports and strategic recommendations to management.
* Ensure marketplace operations align with the company's overall business objectives.

**B. Amazon Marketplace – Strategic and Operational Management**

* Independently manage and scale Amazon Seller Central and Vendor Central operations.
* Take responsibility for complete Amazon account management and business performance.
* Manage product listings, catalogue creation, variation listings, A+ Content, Brand Store, and product information.
* Develop strategies to improve product ranking, organic visibility, conversion rates, and Buy Box performance.
* Manage Amazon PPC campaigns, Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display advertisements.
* Plan and optimise advertising budgets to achieve profitable ROAS and ACOS targets.
* Monitor account health, policy violations, customer feedback, returns, cancellations, and operational issues.
* Develop strategies to improve product reviews, ratings, customer experience, and listing quality.
* Manage Amazon FBA, FBM, inventory replenishment, and fulfilment-related coordination.
* Monitor stock availability and coordinate with inventory and supply chain teams to avoid stockouts and excess inventory.
* Handle Amazon account escalations, policy compliance, and performance-related issues.
* Analyse competitor pricing, market trends, keywords, and product performance.
* Identify opportunities to improve sales velocity and marketplace profitability.

**C. Other E-commerce Platform Management**

* Lead and grow the company's business across Flipkart, Shopify, and other relevant e-commerce platforms.
* Develop individual growth strategies for each marketplace.
* Manage platform-specific product listings, catalogues, pricing, promotions, and advertising.
* Monitor sales performance, customer experience, returns, and operational efficiency across platforms.
* Explore new online sales channels and marketplace opportunities.
* Ensure consistent product information, brand positioning, and pricing strategies across platforms.
* Improve website traffic, conversion rates, customer retention, and direct online sales through Shopify.

**D. Sales, Revenue and Profitability Management**

* Take direct responsibility for achieving monthly, quarterly, and annual marketplace revenue targets.
* Develop strategies to increase sales volume, average order value, and product-level profitability.
* Monitor gross revenue, net sales, contribution margins, marketplace fees, logistics costs, and advertising expenses.
* Analyse product-wise and platform-wise profitability.
* Identify low-performing products and implement corrective strategies.
* Develop pricing and discount strategies without compromising profit margins.
* Prepare revenue forecasts and business projections.
* Identify opportunities to increase organic sales and reduce dependency on paid advertising.
* Ensure sustainable business growth rather than focusing only on revenue numbers.

**E. Advertising, Marketing and Brand Growth**

* Lead marketplace advertising and performance marketing strategies.
* Plan and manage PPC campaigns, sponsored advertisements, promotional campaigns, and seasonal sales.
* Set advertising budgets and monitor campaign performance.
* Improve ROAS, ACOS, TACOS, CTR, CPC, and conversion rates.
* Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and search-term optimisation.
* Work closely with the design and content teams to improve product images, videos, A+ Content, and listing quality.
* Develop strategies for product launches and new product marketing.
* Monitor campaign effectiveness and ensure marketing expenditure generates measurable business results.

**F. Product Launch and Business Expansion**

* Identify new product opportunities based on market demand, competitor analysis, and sales trends.
* Coordinate with product development, sourcing, procurement, and QC teams for new product launches.
* Prepare product launch plans, pricing strategies, advertising plans, and sales forecasts.
* Monitor new product performance during the initial launch period.
* Develop strategies for product portfolio expansion.
* Coordinate with management on international marketplace expansion and new business opportunities.

**G. Inventory, Supply Chain and Operations Coordination**

* Work closely with Inventory, Warehouse, QC, Finance, and Supply Chain departments.
* Prepare marketplace inventory forecasts based on sales trends and future demand.
* Ensure timely replenishment of Amazon fulfilment centres and other marketplace warehouses.
* Monitor stock ageing, slow-moving products, excess inventory, and stockout risks.
* Coordinate shipment planning with inventory and QC teams.
* Ensure products are properly inspected and ready before marketplace shipment.
* Monitor fulfilment performance, delivery issues, cancellations, and return rates.
* Develop operational processes to improve marketplace efficiency.

**H. Team Leadership and Performance Management**

* Lead, manage, and develop the complete marketplace team.
* Allocate responsibilities and establish clear departmental reporting structures.
* Set individual and team KPIs, targets, and performance expectations.
* Conduct regular performance reviews and ensure accountability.
* Identify training requirements and improve the team's technical and operational capabilities.
* Recruit and develop skilled marketplace professionals.
* Ensure coordination between Marketplace, Finance, Design, Inventory, QC, Customer Service, and Operations.
* Build a performance-driven culture focused on business results and continuous improvement.

**I. Reporting, Analysis and Management Review**

* Prepare daily, weekly, monthly, and quarterly marketplace performance reports.
* Monitor revenue, sales growth, profit margins, advertising expenditure, ROAS, ACOS, TACOS, and conversion rates.
* Prepare platform-wise, product-wise, and category-wise performance analysis.
* Identify gaps between targets and actual achievements.
* Present business performance, challenges, opportunities, and action plans to management.
* Develop data-driven recommendations for improving business performance.
* Maintain transparency and accuracy in all marketplace reporting.

**3. Mandatory Skills and Qualifications**

* Minimum 6–10 years of relevant experience in e-commerce and online marketplace management.
* Strong hands-on experience with Amazon Seller Central is mandatory.
* Experience in Amazon Vendor Central is highly preferred.
* Proven track record of independently managing and scaling marketplace businesses.
* Strong knowledge of Amazon PPC, advertising optimisation, SEO, catalogue management, and account health.
* Experience managing Flipkart, Shopify, and other e-commerce platforms.
* Strong understanding of revenue management, business profitability, pricing, and advertising ROI.
* Experience leading and managing marketplace teams.
* Excellent analytical, strategic planning, and decision-making capabilities.
* Strong knowledge of Excel, business analytics, reporting, and marketplace performance tools.
* Ability to work with management and independently take ownership of business targets.
* Excellent English communication and presentation skills.

**4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

The performance of the Head – E-commerce Marketplaces will be evaluated based on measurable business results, including:

1. **Revenue Achievement:**
   Achievement of monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets.
2. **Profitability:**
   Improvement in net contribution and product-level profit margins.
3. **Marketplace Growth:**
   Growth across Amazon, Flipkart, Shopify, and other platforms.
4. **Advertising Efficiency:**
   Improvement in ROAS, ACOS, TACOS, and advertising ROI.
5. **Organic Sales Growth:**
   Improvement in organic revenue and product rankings.
6. **Inventory Management:**
   Reduction in stockouts, excess stock, and inventory ageing.
7. **Product Launch Performance:**
   Successful launch and growth of new products.
8. **Account Health:**
   Maintaining healthy marketplace accounts and policy compliance.
9. **Team Performance:**
   Achievement of departmental and individual employee KPIs.
10. **Business Reporting:**
    Accurate reporting, forecasting, and timely management reviews.

title: Manager, Platform Software Engineering
description:
**Job Description**
Manages a platform team’s operational outcomes; provides technical/functional leadership for shared services, SDKs, and integration frameworks. Ensures adherence to compatibility, rollout, and security standards; resolves moderately complex cross-service issues. Guides team-level observability, capacity planning, and resilience improvements. Communicates scope and trade-offs to related teams; tracks platform adoption and developer experience within the team’s remit.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Platform Software Development:**

* Operate a platform team roadmap that enforces compatibility, versioning, and safe rollout policies for shared services and SDKs.
* Drive team-level observability baselines (SLOs, error budgets) and resilience patterns; ensure adherence during releases.
* Coordinate cross-team incident response for platform issues, ensuring downstream consumer safety and clear remediation paths.

**Software Development and Coding - Design, Testing, and Optimization:**

* Manages team and may contribute to the design and development of code and software solutions and identifies and analyzes requirements.
* Provides coaching and process execution for team to develop and guide new software features and enhancements following design specifications, ensuring accessibility, and to develop documents to clarify software design and code.
* Leads code reviews to drive improvements.
* Leads and reviews team to conduct debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix software issues within a single component or functional area.
* Ensures team implements software testing (e.g., functional and non-functional), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging.
* Leverages prior experience and analysis to conduct performance profiling and optimization of coding.
* Guides team in troubleshooting and resolving issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration.
* Manages team to implement API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies.

**Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design:**

* Manages team to design and develop software, systems, and services.
* Provides technical leadership and technical guidance and domain expertise in software architecture decisions and best practices.
* Guides team and conducts periodic reviews and ensures adherence to architectural framework(s) and internal development practices and standards.
* Collaborates with stakeholders within own group to align and build software architecture with business and/or customer goals and priorities
* Implements performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design.
* Impacts immediate team to conduct regular technology research and evaluation for architectural enhancements.

**Issue/Defect Collaboration - Software Products Support:**

* May collaborate and communicate with stakeholders to understand customer issues and align solutions.
* Manages team to provide technical guidance and appropriately prioritize support to customers regarding reported issues.
* Enables direct reports to advocate for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements based on feedback.
* Communicates regularly with stakeholders to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication.
* Provides guidance to team on processes for handling customer issues and/or defects and directs them to training opportunities as needed.
* Investigates and troubleshoots product maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short- and long-term solutions.

**Practices and Standards Compliance - Security and Compliance:**

* Collaborates with the team and other stakeholders to establish, follow, and enforce documented security criteria, development industry best practices and processes, and coding standards.
* Ensures team adherence to broad acceptance criteria.
* Implements moderately complex secure software development practices to prevent security vulnerabilities.

**Development Operations - System Maintenance:**

* Manages team to perform periodic maintenance and testing operations for systems that require upgrading or patching for (e.g., for critical vulnerabilities).
* Guides team to follow standard operating procedures (SOP) for development and drive improvements, ensuring automation, testing, and debugging of systems to ensure service/product availability, health, support, and reliability.

**Core Responsibilities**
**Planning & Execution:**

* Creates and owns the execution plan for the team's work and multiple projects or initiatives, monitoring timelines and budgets when applicable to ensure projects are completed on time and in adherence with requirements. Delegates work across the team and helps them prioritize their work. Identifies resource needs and adapts plans based on changing priorities and business needs.

**Collaboration & Partnership:**

* Strengthens collaborative partnerships across teams to align expectations and shared objectives. Guides team members to build relationships with business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure effective collaboration. Practices active listening and asks insightful questions to promote an inclusive culture.

**Problem Solving:**

* Leads team to identify and address moderately complex operational and/or technical issues in accordance with standard practices, providing guidance as appropriate. Directs team to analyze data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot moderately complex errors.

**Continuous Learning:**

* Actively seeks learning opportunities for self and team to enhance knowledge and skills in key areas and remain current with industry advancements. Uses feedback and training to elevate personal and team skills, modeling a commitment to learning. Identifies skill gaps within the team and supports team members in learning opportunities by providing resources and fostering an environment that encourages knowledge-sharing.

**Continuous Improvement:**

* Identifies and recommends improvements as well as encourages team to share ideas to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within a team. Reviews and provides feedback on team members’ ideas and seeks input from others on alternative approaches and methods for improving work.

* Coaches and provides direction to team members in alignment with performance management processes, guidelines, and expectations. Facilitates goal setting discussions with team members, ensuring individual goals are aligned with broader team goals. Identifies development opportunities to help team members improve performance. title: TC-CS-SRCR-Senior-TPCRM
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY- Cyber Risk Compliance and Resilience –TPCRM Senior**
As part of our EY Cyber Risk and Compliance Consulting (CRCR) team, you will contribute technically to Cyber Security client engagements and internal projects. The role involves managing Third-Party Cyber Risk Management (TPCRM) engagements, ensuring that our clients effectively identify, assess, and mitigate risks associated with third-party relationships. An important part of your role will be to actively establish, maintain, and strengthen internal and external relationships.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are looking for TPCRM Senior with expertise in cyber security, risk management, and security controls testing concepts. This role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to the growth of our TPCRM service offering while upholding EY’s commitment to quality and excellence. In line with EY’s commitment to quality, you will confirm that work is of the highest quality as per EY’s quality standards. You will help to create a positive learning culture, coach and counsel junior team members and help them to develop. As an influential member of the team, you will help to create a positive learning culture, coach and counsel junior team members and help them to develop.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
To assist in the delivery of third-party risk management engagements. This includes:
  
  

* Risk Assessment and Management: Conduct comprehensive risk assessments of third-party vendors to identify potential risks and vulnerabilities. Draft and explain risk mitigation strategies to minimize exposure to third-party risks.
* Policy Development and Compliance: Collaborate with stakeholders to develop or update third-party risk management policies and procedures. Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and internal policies related to third-party engagements.
* Third Party Due Diligence: Oversee the third-party due diligence process, including cyber, privacy, resiliency and compliance assessments.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with various departments (e.g., Security, Legal, Compliance, IT) to ensure a holistic approach to third-party risk management. Explain Risk/Findings or other assessment related deliverables to client stakeholders. Facilitate communication and training on third-party risk management best practices across the organization.
* Reporting and Analytics: Prepare and present regular reports on third-party risk exposure and management activities to client senior leadership. Utilize data analytics to identify trends and areas for improvement in third-party risk management processes.
* Incident Management: Lead investigations into third-party incidents and breaches, ensuring appropriate corrective actions are taken. Maintain an incident response plan specific to third-party risks.
* Continuous Improvement: Stay informed about industry trends, emerging risks, and best practices in third-party risk management. Recommend enhancements to the third-party risk management framework based on evolving business needs and regulatory changes.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Cyber Security Skills: Around 4-6 years of experience with key components of Cyber Security including (but not limited to):

+ Third Party Risk Management (End to end TPCRM lifecycle)
+ Cyber Governance, Risk and Compliance
+ Cyber Strategy & Transformation
+ Business Continuity & Disaster Recovery
+ Basic knowledge of general security concepts, including defence-in-depth, least privilege, security architecture and design, networking, architecture reviews, VAPT, IDS/IPS technologies, SIEM, and resiliency concepts such as business continuity and workplace safety.

* TPCRM Skills: Experience in client-facing roles, managing cyber security and resiliency-based third-party risk assessments from start to finish. Ability to lead third-party assessments, providing technical guidance to assessors and facilitating decision-making during evidence reviews.
* Analytical Skills: Strong ability to analyze complex data and risk factors to make informed decisions regarding third-party relationships.
* Attention to Detail: Meticulous attention to detail in assessing vendor documentation, contracts, and compliance requirements to ensure thorough evaluations.
* Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills to effectively convey risk assessments and recommendations to stakeholders at all levels.
* Problem-Solving Abilities: Proactive and strategic thinker with a knack for identifying potential issues and developing effective solutions to mitigate risks.
* Interpersonal Skills: Strong relationship-building skills to foster collaboration with internal teams and external vendors, ensuring alignment on risk management objectives.
* Project Management: Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Regulatory Knowledge: In-depth understanding of relevant regulations and compliance requirements related to third-party risk management, including data privacy and security standards such as ISO 27001, NIST 800-53, PCI DSS, HIPAA, HITRUST, GDPR, CCPA, COBIT, OWASP Top 10 etc.
* Technical Proficiency: Familiarity with risk management software and tools, as well as proficiency in data analysis and reporting tools (e.g., GRC enablement solutions, such as Process Unity, Prevalent, Archer, ServiceNow, etc.).
* Adaptability: Ability to adapt to changing business environments and evolving regulatory landscapes, demonstrating flexibility in approach and mindset.
* Leadership Qualities: Strong leadership skills to guide and mentor junior team members, fostering a culture of risk awareness and compliance within the organization.

**Qualify for the role, you must have.**

* A bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer/ electrical engineering, information technology or a related field
* At least 4 years of relevant experience cyber security and Third-Party Risk Management
* One mandatory certification - CISSP, CISA, CISM, CTPRP, CTPRA, CIPP
* Knowledge of TPCRM tools like OneTrust, ProcessUnity, ServiceNow, Archer along with external data providers like SecurityScorecard, BitSight, etc.
* Proficient in below areas of cybersecurity:

+ Access Control
+ Asset Management
+ Business Continuity Management
+ Communications Security
+ Information Security Incident Management
+ Information Security Policies
+ Operations Security
+ Physical and Environmental Security
+ Third Party Relationships
+ System Acquisition, Development, and Maintenance
+ Cloud Security
+ Compliance
+ Human Resource Security
+ Privacy

* Experience in client service delivery and be able to manage multiple engagement teams and projects.
* Program and Project Management skills.

**Ideally, you will also have**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Strong drive to excel professionally, and to guide and motivate others.
* Excellent interpersonal, written, verbal, communication, and presentation skills.

**What We Look For**

* Highly motivated individuals with excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to prioritize shifting workloads in a rapidly changing industry.
* An effective communicator, you will be a confident leader equipped with strong people management skills and a genuine passion to make things happen in a dynamic organization.
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 2000 + professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Consulting practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

title: Finance & Operations Manager - Dry Fruits Retail Chain
description:
**About us**

Sans Global Private Limited runs Fissans, a growing chain of dry fruit and nut stores in Kerala – 2 stores in Trivandrum and 1 in Palakkad – with new stores planned in Ernakulam, Thrissur and Kottayam. We need one strong person to take full charge of the numbers and operations of the business, so the current stores are profitable and under control and the new stores open on a sound system.

**Location:** Kochi (Ernakulam office), with regular travel to the stores in Trivandrum and Palakkad and to new store locations.

**What you will own**

* **Inventory control** – accurate stock in every store and the warehouse: GRN, FIFO/FEFO, wastage and expiry tracking, monthly physical stock counts and fixing any variances.
* **Pricing and margins** – set and control selling prices and margins for each product, make sure the right prices are used at the billing counter, and stop leakage from discounts or wrong prices.
* **Monthly P&L for each store** – sales, cost of goods sold, gross margin, expenses and net profit, closed and reported to the management by the 10th of every month.
* **Daily sales and cash control** – cash and UPI reconciliation, bank deposits, daily sales MIS and stock-movement reports.
* **Purchase** – vendor sourcing and negotiation, purchase orders and reorder levels, so stores neither run out of stock nor overstock.
* **Store operations and team** – store managers and staff report to you; set targets, SOPs, schedules and accountability, and visit the stores regularly.
* **Expansion** – site feasibility and budgets for new stores, set-up and opening, and putting the same system in place from day one.
* **Compliance** – GST, billing/POS/ERP discipline, FSSAI licences, and support to the accounts team and auditors.

**Who we are looking for**

* 8+ years in retail or FMCG, including 3+ years as a store, area or operations manager in charge of multiple outlets.
* Strong finance base: P&L, inventory accounting, costing and margins, GST; Tally and POS/ERP; good Excel.
* Experience in food, dry fruits, nuts, spices, supermarket or bakery retail strongly preferred.
* Proven record of fixing stock and margin problems, setting up systems and leading teams. Please give numbers in your CV: outlets handled, team size, results.
* Willing to work from Kochi and travel to the stores.
* Malayalam and English required.
* Education: B.Com / M.Com / MBA; CA Inter or CMA Inter is a plus.

**Why join**

Full ownership, a direct line to the founder, and room to grow as the chain expands.

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹75,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

The Product Pricing Analyst IV supports pricing execution, analytics, and continuous improvement across the Americas and Europe, the Middle East, India, and Africa. The role manages agreement pricing, evaluates margin and price-realisation performance, and delivers process and reporting improvements that strengthen profitability, pricing consistency, response time, and customer experience.
  
  
**Key Responsbilities**

* Pricing operations and agreement management: Manage agreement pricing across the Americas and Europe, the Middle East, India, and Africa, ensuring timely execution, policy compliance, and sustainable contract profitability.
* Commercial performance: Improve margin performance, limit price erosion, and reduce turnaround time for pricing requests through disciplined analysis, prioritisation, and execution.
* Pricing analytics: Analyse pocket margin, price realisation, profit waterfalls, and other commercial indicators using approved pricing platforms; translate findings into practical recommendations for pricing teams and business leaders.
* Management reporting: Develop and maintain strategic reports, KPI dashboards, and tracking tools that provide accurate and actionable insight into pricing performance, risks, and opportunities.
* Revenue and margin improvement: Identify, recommend, and execute initiatives that improve revenue, margin, and pricing effectiveness in line with management priorities.
* Process improvement: Define new processes and assess and redesign existing processes to improve efficiency, cost control, service quality, and customer experience. Apply Lean, Six Sigma, and TE Operational Advantage principles where appropriate.
* Governance and controls: Create and maintain procedures, standard work instructions, documentation, and control mechanisms; conduct periodic audits and address identified gaps.
* Stakeholder partnership: Work closely with Sales, Product Management, Finance, Customer Care, global pricing teams, and business-unit leaders to understand requirements, resolve issues, and secure alignment for cross-functional pricing initiatives.
* Data enablement: Apply knowledge of TE data structures and collaborate with Global Analytics to obtain, validate, and use relevant data for decision-making.
* Business continuity: Maintain effective backup coverage, knowledge transfer, and documented procedures to support stable and uninterrupted pricing operations.

* Strategic and commercial thinking: Connects pricing activities to business priorities and develops practical improvements that strengthen commercial performance.
* Analytical capability: Analyses complex pricing and profitability data, identifies risks and opportunities, and converts findings into clear recommendations.
* Judgement and decision-making: Evaluates alternatives, applies sound business judgement, and makes timely, evidence-based recommendations.
* Stakeholder influence: Builds productive cross-functional relationships and gains alignment among peers, leaders, and business partners across regions and business units.
* Communication: Presents complex information clearly and credibly to technical, commercial, and senior-management audiences.
* Executive presence: Communicates recommendations with confidence and professionalism, including when assumptions or decisions need to be constructively challenged.
* Execution excellence: Manages multiple priorities with strong organisational discipline, attention to detail, and a consistent focus on results.
* Collaboration and capability building: Contributes to effective global teams, supports knowledge sharing and backup coverage, and participates in talent identification and interviewing when required.

description:
**Job Description**
**Job Title: Aftermarket Operations Analyst**
**Location: Bengaluru, India**
**Function: Maintenance, Repair and Overhaul (MRO)**
**Why join Rolls-Royce?**
At Rolls-Royce we are proud to be a business that has truly helped to shape the modern world and are committed to always being a force for progress; powering, protecting and connecting people everywhere. Join Rolls-Royce and you could have the opportunity to work in a world-class engineering environment, supported by a culture that believes individuality is our greatest strength, and all perspectives, experiences and backgrounds help us innovate and enable our high-performance culture.
  
  
**Role Summary**
Join our Aftermarket Maintenance, Repair and Overhaul (MRO) function in Bengaluru and help keep the commercial side of engine repair and overhaul accurate, efficient and on time. We are hiring Finance Analysts for three focus areas: Invoice Vetting, Estimate Vetting and Clawback Support. Your work will support cost efficiency, protect profit margins, and ensure smooth operations for our customers and overhaul bases.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing**

* Manage invoice vetting: Review customer and Aftermarket MRO invoices against defined checklists, contracts and policies, including Fixed Price Repair Catalogue (FPRC), quantity and price analysis.
* Validate estimates: Review calculations, rates, quantities, assumptions and supporting evidence against approved standards, contracts, benchmarks and historical data to confirm accuracy, completeness and commercial reasonableness.
* Process clawback cases: Review, validate and process cases in line with approved policies, SOPs and authority limits, maintaining complete case records, trackers and supporting documentation.
* Investigate and resolve exceptions: Identify discrepancies, omissions, duplication, anomalies, incomplete information and potential cost risks; raise clarification queries and coordinate with vendors and cross-functional stakeholders to resolve data or system issues.
* Make and escalate decisions: Approve, reject, return or escalate invoices, estimates and clawback cases in line with the defined authority matrix and appropriate risk channels.
* Deliver on time and with quality: Meet agreed turnaround times, quality targets and service levels for Aftermarket MRO invoicing, estimate vetting and clawback activities while monitoring workloads, ageing, outstanding cases and performance.
* Maintain accurate records and documents: Digitise, validate and upload configuration, policy and supporting documents into designated systems, ensuring information is accurate, current, traceable and compliant with governance requirements.
* Report and provide insights: Produce Power BI and Excel reports and dashboards covering volumes, outcomes, exceptions, ageing, turnaround times, service performance and quality trends; use analysis to improve planning efficiency and reduce costs.
* Support controls and governance: Perform quality checks, maintain audit-ready records, support audits and governance reviews, and keep SOPs, procedures and reference materials current as requirements evolve.
* Improve and automate: Identify recurring issues and opportunities to strengthen controls, streamline processes, and digitise or automate analysis; partner with digital teams to design, test, implement and enhance approved solutions, and share knowledge across teams.

**Position Qualifications**

* 2–7 years of experience in invoicing, estimation, cost analysis, clawback processes, commercial review or financial analysis.
* Working knowledge of aftermarket repair and maintenance invoicing, and basic knowledge of ERP systems (SAP, Oracle or equivalent).
* Proficiency in Excel and Power BI for reporting and visualisation.
* Strong data management, analytical and problem-solving skills, with a sharp eye for detail.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder coordination skills, with confidence working in a mid-sized team.

**Preferred Requirements**

* A passion for continuous improvement, with knowledge of methodologies such as Lean or Six Sigma.
* Experience in aerospace or automotive aftermarket operations.
* An understanding of operational maturity best practices.

Our vision is to ensure that the excellence and ingenuity that shaped our history continues into our future. Our multi-year transformation programme aims to turn Rolls-Royce into a high-performing, competitive, resilient and growing company. Join us, and it can be your vision too.

title: Senior Associate
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Senior Executive - Accounts Receivable & Finance Operations**
As part of the GDS Finance team, this role will provide operational support across Accounts Receivable, billing and selected finance activities. The position will focus on reconciliations against statutory information, engagement setup and maintenance, monthly closing schedules, CS/ES billing, billing disputes, domestic billing and revenue-accrual support. The role will also contribute to targeted FP&A and AR improvement initiatives.
  
  
**The opportunity**
This role offers the opportunity to strengthen the connection between AR, FP&A and statutory finance processes. The successful candidate will help ensure billing completeness and accuracy, timely close execution, reliable reconciliations and effective resolution of operational billing matters in a global finance environment.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Reconciliations against statutory information: Prepare and maintain reconciliations between AR, billing and statutory accounting information. Investigate differences, document explanations and coordinate the timely resolution of reconciling items with the relevant finance teams.
* Engagement creation and maintenance: Coordinate the creation, update and maintenance of engagements and related financial attributes. Validate supporting information, approvals and master-data accuracy, and follow up on incomplete or incorrect setup impacting billing or accounting.
* Monthly closing schedules: Prepare, coordinate and monitor monthly closing schedules for AR and billing activities. Track deadlines, dependencies, completion status and open items, and escalate risks that may affect an accurate and timely close.
* CS/ES billing and related reconciliations: Support end-to-end CS/ES billing activities, including validation of billing inputs, invoice preparation and issuance, completeness checks and follow-up of exceptions. Perform reconciliations between FP&A and AR information to ensure consistency across revenue, billings, receivables and supporting records.
* Billing disputes and invoice resolution: Manage and track disputed invoices, rejected billings, short payments and other billing exceptions. Coordinate with FP&A, AR, engagement teams and other stakeholders to identify root causes, obtain the necessary support and drive issues to closure.
* Domestic billing: Support domestic billing activities, ensuring invoices are prepared accurately and on time and comply with the required financial, tax, customer and supporting-documentation requirements. Monitor pending items and coordinate corrections or reissuances as needed.
* Revenue monthly accrual support: Support the monthly revenue-accrual process by gathering and validating inputs, reconciling accrual information with engagement, billing and AR records, and providing schedules and explanations required for month-end review.
* FP&A and AR initiatives: Participate in targeted FP&A and AR initiatives focused on process improvement, standardization, reporting, controls, data quality and automation. Support testing, implementation, documentation and follow-up of agreed actions.
* Reporting and control support: Prepare operational reports and trackers covering billing status, reconciliation differences, disputed invoices, closing activities and relevant AR exceptions. Maintain clear supporting evidence and contribute to internal-control, statutory-audit and compliance requests.
* Stakeholder coordination: Collaborate with FP&A, AR, statutory finance, tax, engagement teams and other local or global stakeholders to resolve issues, clarify ownership and ensure activities are completed according to the agreed timetable.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong understanding of billing, accounts receivable, reconciliations and month-end close activities
* Accounting knowledge and ability to connect operational finance information with statutory records
* Ability to manage detailed schedules, multiple deadlines and cross-functional dependencies
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with close attention to accuracy and completeness
* Clear communication and stakeholder-management skills in a global and multicultural environment
* Confidence to follow up, challenge inconsistencies and escalate unresolved items appropriately
* Process-improvement mindset and ability to document and standardize finance activities
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; knowledge of SAP or another ERP system is preferred

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* CA with 1-3 years of work experience
* Strong Knowledge in Accounting, Finance, MIS etc
* Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills
* Demonstrated strong written and oral communication skills

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Project management skills
* Exposure to tools like Power BI, Hyperion etc.
* Credible experience working in a fast-moving, client-centric, multi- national environment

**What We Look For**

* A team player with a curious mindset – should be open to continuous learnings and improvements
* Self-driven with an ability to produce high quality output and self-checks with minimal supervision

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across nine locations – Argentina, India, Philippines, Poland, Hungary, Sri Lanka,Mexico,Spain and UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Associate Pricing & Supplier Performance Analyst [T500-29674]
description:
**About Officeworks:**

Officeworks’ purpose is “
**we bring**
**big ideas to life at low prices”.**
It’s how we create shared value for customers, team members, suppliers, communities and shareholders.

We are Australia’s leading omnichannel retailer of complete technology solutions, stationery, furniture, art supplies, and learning resources. We also offer services including Print & Create, and Geeks2U.

Our products and services provide solutions to our diverse range of customers across Australia from households, students, small to large sized businesses, governments and schools.

Our culture is built on beginning with customer, doing the right thing, executing with accountability, and leading with ambition. We are
**one team who are proud to “wear the blues”**
and
**deliver for our customers.**

We are an inclusive, forward-thinking organization where diverse perspectives enable innovation, continuous improvement and better outcomes for our customers and teams. The work we do plays an important role in helping Australians work, learn, create and connect.

**Our Values:**

Our values shape the way we work, our behaviours and how we interact with each other, our customers, suppliers and communities.

**We begin with customer:**

* We start with our customer’ needs in every decision.
* We offer simple, helpful and affordable solutions.
* We listen, learn and continuously improve.

**We do the right thing:**

* We lead with integrity and care for our team communities and planet.
* We work together safely and treat everyone with respect, inclusion, and trust.
* We collaborate across teams and think Officeworks-wide.

**We execute with accountability:**

* We are accountable for our decisions, actions, results, and mistakes.
* We stay across the details and focus on delivering what matters.
* We move with pace and agility to deliver outcomes.

**We lead with ambition:**

* We set bold ambitions that help us to win and transform.
* We are courageous with new ideas.
* We focus on transformation, not incremental steps.

**Individual Contributor:**

* Lives our Officeworks values and behaviours
* Proactively contributes to a safe working environment, escalates appropriately if there are unsafe conditions or inappropriate behaviour
* Operates in line with applicable Officeworks company policies and Code of Conduct
* Demonstrates a strong sense of personal accountability and curiosity to learn and develop
* Contributes to an inclusive and respectful environment where diverse perspectives are valued and everyone feels safe to speak up and belong

The Commercial team sits at the heart of Officeworks’ growth agenda. This function brings together customer needs, product innovation, services, supplier partnerships, merchandise planning, and channel growth to shape what Officeworks sells, how it competes, and the value it delivers across Retail, B2B, Government, and Education. This is a unique opportunity to contribute to one of the business’s most commercially impactful areas.

The team plays a key role in evolving Officeworks’ product and service offering, accelerating growth in high-potential channels (such as B2B and Education), expanding private label and exclusive ranges, strengthening supplier partnerships, and unlocking emerging category opportunities across areas like technology, gaming, mobility, VR, print, installation, telco, and managed services.

You will help build commercial capability from the ground up, shaping scalable ways of working, strengthening planning and decision-making, and driving outcomes that impact sales, margin, customer experience, inventory performance, and long-term growth.

**These roles are best suited for people who enjoy:**

* thriving in a growth-focused retail environment where commercial decisions directly influence customers, sales, margin, and competitiveness
* contributing to key growth areas, including B2B, Education, Government, private label, exclusive products, and emerging categories
* using insights (customer, competitor, category, supplier, financial, inventory) to identify opportunities and inform decisions
* collaborating cross-functionally to turn commercial strategy into practical outcomes

**Why this role exists:**

The Associate Pricing & Supplier Performance Analyst exists to provide accurate analysis and operational support across retail pricing and supplier commercial activity. The role helps maintain competitive prices and protect margin by analyzing cost prices, retail prices, competitor movements and supplier trading terms.

The role translates approved decisions into accurate price changes, completes pricing and ticketing checks and produces exception reporting and negotiation analysis. It also contributes to better data, automation and workflow improvements that increase the speed, quality and control of pricing and Better Buying activity.

**Where you will make a difference:**

**Pricing and Competitor Analysis:**

* Analyze cost-price, retail-price, margin and trading data to identify pricing risks, anomalies and commercial opportunities.
* Complete competitor price checks using approved market-data sources.
* Validate competitor product matches and investigate material price differences before producing recommendations.
* Monitor competitor movements, priority products and promotional activity to support timely pricing responses.
* Prepare clear analysis and reporting that translates complex pricing data into practical commercial insights.

**Price Change Execution:**

* Prepare, validate and load approved price-change files into SAP and supporting pricing systems.
* Confirm product, price, effective-date and channel information before releasing price changes.
* Coordinate price changes across store ticketing, digital channels and promotional materials within agreed timeframes.
* Complete post-load validation and reconciliation checks to confirm approved prices have been implemented correctly.
* Investigate pricing discrepancies and resolve or escalate data, system and execution issues.
* Maintain accurate records of price changes, approvals, exceptions and validation outcomes.

**Better Buying and Supplier Analysis:**

* Analyse supplier costs, rebates, trading terms and margin drivers to identify potential value leakage and improvement opportunities.
* Support the assessment of supplier cost-price increase requests by preparing cost, market and margin-impact analysis.
* Produce supplier profiles, cost models and analytical packs to support preparation for supplier negotiations.
* Prepare exception reporting that identifies missing terms, unrecovered costs, rebate variances and other commercial anomalies.
* Track agreed supplier and cost-price actions, maintaining accurate records of expected and delivered value.
* Support the adoption of standard negotiation playbooks, analytical methods and Better Buying tools.

**Pricing Governance and Quality Control:**

* Apply enterprise pricing policies, approval authorities and data-quality controls across all assigned pricing activity.
* Complete pricing, ticketing and promotional checks designed to support compliance with the Competition and Consumer Act 2010, the Australian Consumer Law and internal requirements.
* Monitor price accuracy, data quality, ticketing volumes and delivery against agreed service levels.
* Investigate exception reports and resolve flagged variances within agreed timeframes.
* Escalate material commercial, compliance, data or delivery risks through the appropriate channels.
* Maintain clear documentation and audit evidence for pricing and Better Buying activities.

**Platforms and Continuous Improvement:**

* Identify recurring manual effort, data issues and process friction across pricing and Better Buying workflows.
* Contribute to the design, testing and implementation of platform, reporting and automation improvements.
* Build and maintain standard templates, reports and analytical tools that improve consistency and efficiency.
* Document processes, controls and working instructions to support reliable execution and capability development.
* Monitor implemented improvements and recommend further changes based on performance and user feedback.

**Who you will be working with:**

* Category and Commercial Teams: Partner with Category Management, Category Planning and Finance teams to clarify analytical requirements and provide decision support for pricing and Category-led supplier negotiations.
* Operational and Data Partners: Collaborate with Store Operations, Technology and Data, and Product Data teams to coordinate, validate and load price files and maintain data accuracy.
* Risk and Compliance Partners: Work alongside Legal, Risk and Compliance teams to perform pricing, ticketing and regulatory compliance checks, investigate flagged variances and escalate material risks.
* External Market Providers: Act as the primary technical point of contact for competitor-pricing and market-data providers as well as analytics and automation vendors.

**What success looks like:**

* Analysis Accuracy and Rigour: Delivers high accuracy across all pricing, cost-price and better-buying analytical outputs, directly enabling informed category and commercial decision-making.
* Delivery SLA Performance: Achieves target service level agreements for competitor price checks, priority analysis and price-file loading timelines.
* Execution and File Quality: Maintains high price-file load accuracy, ensuring seamless execution across SAP, digital channels and store ticketing systems.
* Compliance and Governance: Achieves target pricing and regulatory compliance rates through rigorous checks, accurate exception reporting and swift resolution of flagged variances within SLA.
* Demonstrates behaviours aligned to Officeworks’ values, contributing to a respectful, inclusive and high-performing culture.

**Essential:**

* Education: Relevant tertiary qualification in Commerce, Business, Finance, Economics, Analytics or a related discipline (or equivalent practical retail, commercial or analytical experience).
* Experience: 2–4+ years of experience in pricing, commercial analytics, category support, procurement analytics or a related commercial analytical role.
* Technical Capability: Strong proficiency in Excel, data analysis, data visualisation and working with large datasets.
* Domain Knowledge: Working knowledge of retail pricing, cost prices, trading terms, category economics and competitor price checking methodologies.
* Systems Knowledge: Understanding of price-file preparation, loading workflows and system controls (e.g., SAP or supporting retail pricing platforms).
* Analytical Problem Solving: Capability to build accurate exception reports, investigate flagged variances and translate complex data into practical commercial insights.
* Governance and Compliance: Knowledge of pricing, ticketing and regulatory compliance controls (e.g., Competition and Consumer Act 2010, Australian Consumer Law).
* Continuous Improvement: Ability to support repeatable reporting, automation workflows and platform improvement builds.

**Preferred:**

* Experience operating within an omnichannel retail, FMCG or fast-paced commercial trading environment.
* Hands-on exposure to automated market-data platforms or analytics and automation tools.
* Experience preparing negotiation packs, supplier cost models or value-leakage analysis for Category-led negotiations.

* Translate complex commercial analysis into clear negotiation options, trade-offs and decision points.
* Guide the application of consistent, evidence-based negotiation methods across Category teams.
* Review negotiation outcomes and feedback to improve playbooks, benchmarks and analytical tools.
* Monitor adoption and use of Better Buying tools across priority categories.

**Exception Reporting and Commercial Analytics:**

* Design exception-reporting frameworks and materiality thresholds that identify margin leakage, missing rebates and uncollected trading-term value.
* Extract, normalise and analyse commercial data across SAP, STIBO/PIM, Snowflake and supporting data sources.
* Develop dashboards and reporting in Power BI or Tableau to track trading-term value, cost-price mitigation and category adoption.
* Investigate financial and commercial variances, identifying root causes and recommended corrective actions.
* Validate reported benefits and maintain clear definitions for identified, approved and delivered commercial value.
* Produce concise insights that highlight priority risks, opportunities and required decisions.

**Technical Guidance and Continuous Improvement:**

* Provide technical guidance to analysts on Better Buying methods, commercial modelling and data-quality requirements.
* Document analytical methods, playbook structures, workflow controls and standard operating procedures.
* Define business requirements for systems, data and automation enhancements.
* Support solution testing and implementation, ensuring changes meet commercial, data and control requirements.
* Identify opportunities to automate recurring analysis, reporting and workflow activity.
* Maintain current knowledge of supplier economics, trading-term practices and cost drivers relevant to retail categories.

**Who you will be working with:**

* Category Leadership: Partner with Category Managers, Category Planners, and Category Assistants to provide negotiation playbooks, cost-stack insights, and trading terms guidance.
* Commercial Leadership & Finance: Collaborate with the Pricing and Better Buying Manager, Commercial Leadership Team, and Finance business partners to report on margin recovery and trading terms performance.
* Technology & Data Partners: Work closely with Technology & Data, Product Data, and Legal, Risk & Compliance teams to govern automated systems, data feeds, and contract controls.
* External Market Providers
  **:**
  Liaise with market data benchmarking vendors, analytics technology partners, and external advisers to incorporate external market intelligence into playbooks

**What success looks like:**

* Trading Terms Value: Quantifiable commercial value identified and delivered through trading terms optimization and contract reviews.
* Cost Increase Mitigation: High percentage of supplier cost-price increases mitigated, delayed, or offset through structured playbooks.
* Playbook Adoption: High percentage of priority commercial categories utilizing current automated negotiation playbooks during trade reviews.
* Exception Reporting Precision: Accurate exception reporting delivered within SLAs, with a high proportion of material exceptions actioned by category teams.
* Demonstrates behaviours aligned to Officeworks’ values, contributing to a respectful, inclusive and high-performing culture

**Qualifications and work experience:**

**Essential:**

* Education: Tertiary qualification in Commerce, Business, Finance, Economics, Analytics, or a related discipline is required (or equivalent senior better-buying, procurement analytics, or commercial experience).
* Experience: 5–7+ years in commercial analytics, procurement analytics, category management, or a related commercial function
* Commercial Frameworks: Advanced knowledge of trading terms, cost-price management, supplier economics, and retail margin drivers
* Technical Analytics Mastery: Strong commercial modelling, financial analytics, and data-visualization capability (Power BI / Tableau) using large data sets
* Process & Tool Engineering: Practical experience building category negotiation playbooks, automated CPI workflow systems, and governance controls

CEO

: India-based, with regular coordination with the UAE office (open: city and travel frequency)

2.
**Receivables and Payables**

•       Raise invoices on time and follow up on collections from hospitals, hospital groups and distributors.

•       Maintain a weekly receivables ageing report and escalate overdue accounts to sales and the Managing Director.

•       Reconcile customer payments, credit notes and tender or rate-contract pricing.

•       Process supplier payments to principals (including foreign currency payments) as per agreed terms and approvals.

**3.Cash Flow**

•       Prepare a 13-week rolling cash flow forecast for each entity, updated weekly.

•       Manage bank accounts, payment approvals and day-to-day banking coordination.

•       Monitor foreign exchange exposure on USD, EUR and AED payments and flag significant movements.

•       Track funds movement between India and UAE and keep the related documentation in order.

4
**.Tax and statutory compliance – India**

•       GST: monthly and annual returns, e-invoicing, e-way bills, input credit reconciliation.

•       TDS / TCS deduction, deposit and quarterly returns.

•       Payroll compliance: PF, ESI, professional tax.

•       Support ROC / MCA filings with the company secretary.

•       Import compliance: customs duty, IEC and related documentation for medical devices.

**5.Tax and statutory compliance – UAE**

•       VAT returns and VAT record keeping.

•       UAE Corporate Tax registration, records and annual return.

•       WPS payroll processing and end-of-service gratuity provisioning.

•       Trade license renewals and related government fee tracking (with admin team).

**6.Budgeting and management reporting**

•       Prepare the annual budget for each entity with the Managing Director and department heads.

•       Deliver a monthly MIS pack: P&L, balance sheet, cash position, budget vs actual and key variances.

•       Report profitability by product line (ENT, Orthopedics, Spine, Gynecology, Urology, Sleep Diagnostics), principal and customer.

•       Prepare consolidated group view across India and UAE.

**7.Costing, pricing and commercial support**

•       Calculate landed cost for imported products, including freight, duty and clearing charges.

•       Support pricing for tenders, quotations and rate contracts with margin analysis.

•       Review commercial terms in distributor, principal and customer agreements from a finance angle.

•       Evaluate cost of new hires, new product lines and partnerships before approval.

**8.Audit, controls and governance**

•       Coordinate statutory audit, tax audit and any principal-required audits; prepare schedules and close audit points.

•       Set up and maintain approval matrices, expense policies and petty cash controls.

•       Ensure documentation for every payment and maintain a clean audit trail.

•       Keep the Managing Director informed of compliance deadlines through a statutory calendar.

**9.Stakeholder coordination**

•       Act as the main contact for external accountants, auditors, tax consultants and banks.

•       Support finance aspects of joint ventures, MOUs and new entity setup.

Work with HR on payroll, salary structures and employee reimbursements

**Required**

•       CA Inter / CMA Inter, or M.Com / MBA (Finance) with strong accounting grounding.

•       5–8 years in accounts and finance, with at least 2 years running the full accounting cycle for a company independently.

•       Hands-on experience with Indian GST, TDS and payroll compliance.

•       Working knowledge of UAE VAT and Corporate Tax, or clear willingness to learn quickly.

•       Experience in a trading, distribution or import-led business.

**Preferred**

•       Qualified CA / CMA or ACCA.

•       Experience in medical devices, pharma or healthcare distribution.

•       Exposure to multi-entity or cross-border (India–GCC) accounts and consolidation.

•       Experience handling hospital receivables, tenders and rate contracts.

**Skills and competencies**

•       Strong command of accounting software (Tally Prime, Zoho Books or similar) and advanced Excel.

•       Ability to build a cash flow forecast, budget and MIS pack from scratch.

•       High integrity and discretion with salary, banking and company financial data.

•       Organised and deadline-driven; owns the statutory calendar without reminders.

•       Clear communicator who can explain numbers to non-finance colleagues and push sales teams on collections.

•       Comfortable working in a lean team where the person both plans and executes

Fluent in English

Send your CV: hr@nextgenmedworks.com with the subject
**– “Senior Accountant ”**

title: Finance Associate
description:
**About the job**

Finance Associate

Job Description

Job Title: Finance Associate

Experience: 4–6 years in accounting

Location: Bengaluru (in-office)

Start Date: Immediate

**About Lumov**

Lumov is a venture-funded startup on a mission to transform musculoskeletal pain management. We are building India’s leading one-stop brand for patients, with a growing portfolio across orthotics and orthopaedic supports, rehabilitation aids, lifestyle, and over-the-counter products.Our founders, alumni of Harvard Business School and IIT Kharagpur, bring over 10 years of combined Private Equity experience and have invested more than $300 million in Indian healthcare. We are driven by innovation and a commitment to improving our customers’ quality of life, and we foster a collaborative environment where people are empowered to grow.

**The Role**

We are looking for a hands-on Finance Associate with strong fundamentals in accounting, reconciliations, and month-end closing. You will own the books end to end, from daily entries through a clean, timely monthly close, and make sure every ledger, bank account, and sales channel ties out. You will also support payments, statutory compliance, MIS, and cash flow planning.The ideal candidate is meticulous, process-driven, and takes complete ownership of accuracy. Hands-on experience with Zoho Books is mandatory, along with working knowledge of GST, TDS, PT, and EPF.

**Key Responsibilities**

A. Accounting & Bookkeeping

Own day-to-day accounting in Zoho Books, including leading the migration of existing books into Zoho.

Record sales across all channels (offline, distributors, Amazon, Flipkart, D2C) with correct revenue recognition, returns, discounts, and marketplace fees.

Post and review purchase, expense, payroll, and journal entries, keeping the chart of accounts clean and consistent.

Maintain accurate payables and receivables ledgers, along with invoices and delivery challans (own, vendors, distributors).

Track inventory movements and ensure stock records in the books match physical and warehouse records.

B. Reconciliations

Perform regular bank, credit card, and petty cash reconciliations, and resolve differences promptly.

Reconcile marketplace settlements (Amazon, Flipkart) and payment gateway payouts for D2C against orders, fees, and returns.

Reconcile vendor and distributor ledgers through periodic balance confirmations.

Reconcile GST input credit (books vs GSTR-2B), output GST (books vs GSTR-1/3B), and TDS (books vs Form 26AS / TRACES).

Investigate, document, and clear open and unreconciled items so that every balance sheet account is supported.

C. Month-End Close & Audit Readiness

Drive the monthly close against a defined checklist and timeline.

Book accruals, provisions, prepaid expenses, depreciation, and cut-off adjustments.

Prepare balance sheet schedules and supporting workings for every material account.

Produce monthly P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, and ageing reports.

Coordinate with external consultants and auditors for month-end review, quarterly closes, and year-end audit, and keep documentation audit-ready at all times.

D. Payments & Statutory Compliance

Process vendor, partner, and payroll payments on time through a maker-checker approval system.

Manage payroll processing and help design salary structures.

Prepare and file GST, TDS, PT, and EPF returns accurately and on time, and track all statutory due dates.

E. MIS, Cash Flow & Financial Planning

Maintain MIS dashboards and share key insights with leadership regularly.

Monitor cash flow weekly and monthly, and prepare cash flow projections.

Support budgeting, financial modelling, cost optimisation, and the implementation of internal financial controls.

Identify gaps in finance processes and propose practical improvements.

**Required Qualifications**

**Experience**
: Minimum 4 years of hands-on accounting experience, including ownership of month-end close.

**Tools**
: Zoho Books is a must; strong Excel / Google Sheets skills.

**Knowledge**
: Solid grounding in Indian accounting standards, accrual accounting, and financial statement preparation; proven experience in bank, ledger, marketplace, and statutory reconciliations; working knowledge of GST, TDS, PT, and EPF compliance.

**Skills**
: High attention to detail and strong ownership of numbers; organised, deadline-driven, and comfortable working independently across multiple responsibilities; able to explain variances and reconciling items clearly to leadership and auditors.

**Good to have**
: Experience in inventory-led businesses or companies selling across offline and online channels (marketplaces, D2C, distributors). CA Inter / CMA Inter / M.Com preferred.

**What We Offer**

Rapid professional growth and learning in a scaling startup.

A collaborative, entrepreneurial, and dynamic work culture.

Insurance for self and family

description:

**About CREW**
CREW is Swiggy's premium travel concierge, built to take the stress out of planning and traveling for busy professionals. We help people plan and book a trip without the stress of using five different apps. We handle flights, hotels, visas, forex, cabs, insurance and trip planning in one place, with real people supported by AI tools. CREW is early-stage, so many of our processes are still being built.
  
  
**Job Description**
**About the role**
You own CREW's finance operations: every amount we collect, refund and pay out is correct, on time and compliant, and leadership always knows how the business is doing.
  
  
You will lead the Finance Executives, set up the controls for a fast-growing travel business, and work closely with Swiggy's central finance, tax and audit teams.
  
  
**What You Will Own**

* Partner payments. Own payments to hotels, DMCs, airlines, visa partners and cab vendors. Make sure every payment is checked against the booking, approved and paid on time.

* PO / PR and controls. Own the PO / PR process and approval rules. Set up simple controls (maker-checker, invoice-to-booking-to-payment match) so nothing is paid twice or paid wrong.

* Month-end and audits. Run monthly closing for CREW, review partner payable balances, investigate unusual items and support internal and statutory audits.
* Risk. Spot and escalate high-risk items early: duplicate or unusual payments, old unreconciled balances, partners with repeated disputes.
* Business reporting and planning. Build monthly reports on revenue, margin per booking, partner dues and costs, and support budgeting and business planning, so leadership can make decisions quickly.
* The team. Hire, train and lead the Finance Executives. Set clear daily and monthly targets.
* Process and automation. Work with Product and Tech to automate reconciliation and payment tracking, including with AI tools.

* Based in Bangalore, or open to relocating to Bangalore

* 5-8 years in finance operations or accounts payable, ideally at an online travel platform, B2B travel company or consumer internet company

title: Credit Underwriter
description:
**About Rippling**
Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
  
  
Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.
  
  
Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.
  
  
We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.
  
  
**About The Role**
This individual will operate as an individual contributor (IC), responsible for conducting complex customer-level credit risk assessments and driving high-quality underwriting decisions across multiple Rippling products — including, but not limited to, the Spend Management Corporate Card portfolio, Employer of Record, Payroll, Bill Pay, and related financial offerings. This role is critical to maintaining strong credit discipline as Rippling continues to expand into new customer segments and geographies.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Learn, understand, and implement Rippling’s risk policies and procedures across all relevant products.
* Perform customer-level credit reviews using both external and proprietary data sources.
* Oversee customer escalations and respond to questions/requests from the Sales + Support functions.
* Investigate and take action on high-risk customer credit situations, as needed.
* Formulate and present credit recommendations to senior team members and the credit committee.
* Monitor portfolio-level performance against internal targets and required thresholds.
* Work effectively with cross-functional partners to resolve credit issues.
* Help drive projects related to improving the efficiency and scalability of risk control practices.

**What You Will Need**

* Strong financial analytics background: degree in Finance, Economics, or related field, progress towards CFA charter, or relevant on-the-job experience.
* Deep expertise in financial statement analysis and understanding of commercial credit products
* Minimum 4 years of credit risk experience, ideally related to SMB/MM commercial lending; working knowledge of financial and bank statements
* Experience working cross-functionally with Sales and/or Support teams.
* Highly organized with the ability to deliver on multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Ability to operate independently in a fast-paced environment and meet aggressive deadlines.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence across all levels of the organization.

title: Senior Business Systems Analyst – Billing & Quote to Cash
description:

**Overview**
------------

Our Enterprise Business Systems Group is seeking a Senior Business Systems Analyst – Billing & Quote to Cash to join our team connecting technology with evolving business needs.  
This role will serve as a senior business systems analyst supporting TNS's billing applications and end-to-end quote-to-cash processes. The position will partner closely with Finance, Commercial, Product, Sales Operations, and Technology teams to translate business needs into scalable system and process solutions across quoting, ordering, billing, invoicing, and related revenue processes.  
The successful candidate will develop deep functional and technical knowledge of the applications that enable TNS's quote-to-cash capabilities, with particular emphasis on Salesforce and Expedite Commerce and their integration with other enterprise and billing systems. The analyst will act as a subject matter expert for one or more applications and will help ensure that systems, integrations, data, and business processes work together effectively across the quote-to-cash lifecycle.  
The role will support both strategic initiatives and ongoing application improvement, including new products and capabilities, system enhancements, process optimization, integration activities, and resolution of complex application and business-process issues.  
The Senior Business Systems Analyst will work directly with business stakeholders, application teams, developers, and quality assurance resources throughout the solution lifecycle, including requirements definition, process and data analysis, functional design, testing, implementation, and post-implementation support.  
Experience with TNS's business, products, customers, and billing environment is a strong plus.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**What You Will Do In Your Role**

* Partner with business and technology stakeholders to understand business objectives and translate them into clear, actionable business and system requirements.
* Serve as a subject matter expert for applications and processes supporting **billing and the end-to-end quote-to-cash lifecycle**, including quoting, ordering, product/service configuration, billing, invoicing, and related downstream processes.
* Develop deep functional knowledge of **Salesforce, Expedite Commerce, and related applications and integrations** supporting TNS's commercial and billing ecosystem.
* Analyze complex business processes, system interactions, data flows, and integration points to identify gaps, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement.
* Facilitate requirements and solution-design sessions with stakeholders across Technology, Finance, Commercial, Product, and other business teams.
