* Partner with Software Quality Assurance and business users to develop test scenarios, coordinate testing and user acceptance testing, validate results, and ensure solutions meet defined business requirements.
* Evaluate the downstream impacts of new products, customer requirements, pricing models, acquisitions, and business-process changes on billing and quote-to-cash applications.
* Support application integrations and data flows between commercial, ordering, billing, financial, and enterprise platforms.
* Investigate and help resolve complex application and process issues, identifying root causes and sustainable solutions rather than relying on manual workarounds.
* Identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve data quality, eliminate manual effort and waste, strengthen controls, and increase automation.
* Serve as a liaison between business stakeholders, application teams, development teams, and other technology functions.
* Support application and process changes through requirements, design, testing, implementation, stakeholder communication, and stabilization.
* Apply Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid delivery methodologies as appropriate to the initiative.
* Demonstrate strong ownership, sound judgment, curiosity, and the ability to independently drive complex work across multiple stakeholder groups.

**The Experience You Will Bring**

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business, Finance, Computer Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* **5+ years of experience as a Business Systems Analyst, Systems Analyst, Business Analyst, or similar applications-focused role.**
* Demonstrated experience analyzing complex enterprise applications, business processes, integrations, and data flows.
* Experience gathering and translating business requirements into functional requirements, user stories, process flows, acceptance criteria, and system changes.
* Experience supporting **billing, order-to-cash, quote-to-cash, ERP, CRM, CPQ, commerce, or other transaction-oriented enterprise applications**.
* Experience working with software development, QA, architecture, and business teams throughout the application development lifecycle.
* Experience planning and supporting system testing and user acceptance testing.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to work across multiple interconnected systems and business processes.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with both business and technical audiences.
* Ability to prioritize and independently drive multiple initiatives in a changing business environment.

**Qualifications**
------------------

**What Will Put You Ahead**

* Experience with **Salesforce**, particularly in a complex enterprise environment involving commercial, quoting, ordering, or billing processes.
* Experience with **Expedite Commerce** or similar CPQ, product configuration, order management, or quote-to-cash platforms.
* Experience with enterprise billing platforms, billing integrations, invoicing, pricing, rating, usage-based billing, or recurring-revenue processes.
* Experience analyzing data and integration flows across **CRM, CPQ/commerce, order management, billing, and financial systems**.
* Experience supporting new-product introduction and understanding the implications of product and pricing decisions across quote-to-cash systems.
* Experience with MuleSoft or other enterprise integration technologies.
* Experience with process modeling and diagramming tools such as Microsoft Visio.
* Experience working in a telecommunications, payments, network services, or other transaction-intensive technology environment.
* **Previous experience with TNS's business, products, applications, or quote-to-cash processes is strongly preferred.**

title: Tax IT Analyst
description:
At Solventum, we improve lives by helping healthcare professionals do their best work. Join a team using innovation and insight to make a real impact on the future of healthcare. All roles listed are with Solventum, and we’re committed to protecting your personal information—learn more in our Privacy Policy: https://www.solventum.com/en-us/home/legal/website-privacy-statement/applicant-privacy/

**Job Description:**

**Job Description: Tax IT Analyst**

**3M Health Care is now Solventum**

At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue.

We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.

**The Impact You’ll Make in this Role**

Solventum is seeking a **Tax IT Analyst** to join its Global Capability Center (GCC) organization in India. The role will support the **design, implementation, enhancement, integration, and ongoing support of global Direct and Indirect Tax technology solutions**, with particular emphasis on Solventum's SAP S/4HANA ERP landscape.

The Tax IT Analyst will work at the intersection of **Tax, Finance, ERP, integration, and technology**, collaborating with global business and IT stakeholders to translate tax requirements into dependable, scalable, and supportable technology solutions.

The position is intentionally suited to a candidate with **strong fundamentals, learning agility, and potential to grow deeper into the Tax IT domain**, rather than requiring extensive senior-level experience from day one. The current business requirement specifically identifies support for the **TPIC Transfer Pricing solution** as an immediate priority.

**Key Responsibilities**

As a **Tax IT Analyst**, you will have the opportunity to build expertise across Solventum's global Tax technology landscape while working closely with business, ERP, integration, and application teams.

**Tax Technology & SAP S/4HANA**

* Support the design, configuration, implementation, enhancement, and ongoing operation of **Tax solutions integrated with SAP S/4HANA**.
* Translate Direct and Indirect Tax business requirements into clear functional and technical requirements.
* Participate in solution design workshops, requirements discussions, design reviews, testing, implementation, and post-production support.
* Support global Tax processes and applications across Solventum's technology landscape.
* Develop an understanding of the capabilities, architecture, interfaces, dependencies, and limitations of the assigned Tax applications.
* Assist in reviewing solution designs to ensure alignment with functional, security, integration, performance, quality, and operational requirements.
* Identify design or integration issues and collaborate with the appropriate business and IT teams through resolution.

**Tax Platforms & Integrations**

* Develop functional and technical expertise across Solventum's Tax technology portfolio, including **ONESOURCE, SAP S/4HANA and TPIC**, along with associated integrations.
* Support **ONESOURCE Tax Determination** processes and integrations with SAP.
* Support transaction and master-data flows between Tax platforms and connected enterprise applications.
* Assist with troubleshooting application, interface, configuration, and data-related issues.
* Support application changes, testing, deployment validation, production support, and continuous improvement.

Solventum's current architecture uses **ONESOURCE Indirect Tax Determination for tax determination on applicable SAP transactions**, with transactions passing between SAP and ONESOURCE for calculation of the appropriate tax code, rate, and amount.

The broader Tax landscape also includes integration among **SAP, Certify Tax, and ONESOURCE** for exemption certificate management and tax processes.

**Transfer Pricing**

* Build functional and technical understanding of Solventum's **TPIC Transfer Pricing solution**.
* Provide application and operational support for TPIC as knowledge and capability are developed.
* Partner with Tax stakeholders to understand Transfer Pricing technology requirements and support solution evolution.

Supporting the new TPIC Transfer Pricing tool is identified as the **most pressing requirement for this hire** in the approved position discussion.

**Business Partnership & Delivery**

* Collaborate with **Global Tax, Finance, ERP, Integration, and other IT teams** to design and deliver solutions meeting business requirements.
* Participate in regional and global workshops representing assigned Tax processes or subprocesses.
* Partner with business stakeholders during requirements definition, solution validation, UAT, deployment, and stabilization.
* Help evaluate process and technology improvements and advocate for standardized, scalable solutions.
* Communicate technical topics effectively to both business and IT audiences.

**Documentation, Testing & Operational Excellence**

* Create and maintain functional specifications, process flows, configuration documentation, test scenarios, support documentation, and knowledge articles.
* Support **SIT, UAT, regression testing, defect resolution, deployment, and post-production validation**.
* Contribute to incidents, problems, and change-management activities for supported Tax applications.
* Help drive root-cause identification and sustainable resolution of recurring application or integration issues.
* Build reusable knowledge and documentation within the India GCC to strengthen long-term Tax IT support capability.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* **Bachelor’s degree in computer science**, Information Technology, Engineering, Finance, Accounting, Commerce, Business, or a related discipline.
* Relevant 6+ years of experience in **ERP, Finance IT, Tax Technology, SAP, enterprise applications, or application support/implementation**.
* 5+ years of Experience with international ERP deployments, especially SAP S/4Hana
* Experience or exposure to requirements analysis, solution design, configuration, testing, implementation, or production support.
* Experience of the OneSource Tax Engine.
* Working understanding of enterprise business processes and the relationship between business requirements, applications, interfaces, and data.
* Strong analytical and structured problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to work effectively with geographically distributed business and IT stakeholders.
* Good written and verbal communication skills in English.

**Location: Bangalore (GCC) – Hybrid**  
**Travel: Upto 20%**

**About Carrier**
Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure safe transport of food, life-saving medicines and more. Since inventing modern air conditioning in 1902, we lead with purpose: enhancing the lives we live and the world we share. We continue to lead because of our world-class, inclusive workforce that puts the customer at the centre of everything we do. For more information, visit corporate.carrier.com or follow Carrier on social media at @Carrier.
  
  
**About The Role**
Manager - Procurement & Supply Chain will be responsible for leading Procurement, Material Planning, Inventory Management, and Supplier Performance activities for the Chiller Product Line. The role requires driving operational excellence across the end-to-end supply chain while ensuring uninterrupted production, optimized inventory, cost competitiveness, and superior supplier performance.
  
  
The position will lead a team of procurement and planning professionals and collaborate closely with Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, Logistics, Finance, and Suppliers to achieve business objectives.
  
  
**The Role Is Accountable For**

* Ensuring uninterrupted production through effective supply chain and material planning strategies.
* Optimizing procurement costs, inventory levels, and working capital.
* Strengthening supplier performance, capability, and risk management.
* Driving supply chain efficiency, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.
* Leading and developing a high-performing procurement and supply chain team.
* Achieving key supply chain performance metrics including Line Fulfilment, Plan Fulfilment, Inventory Health, E&O Reduction, Supplier OTD, and SPPM.

**Job Responsibility**
**Procurement & Supplier Management**

* Lead procurement activities to ensure timely availability of materials while meeting cost, quality, and delivery objectives.
* Develop and execute supplier management strategies to improve supplier performance, competitiveness, and reliability.
* Drive supplier development initiatives focused on quality, delivery, capacity enhancement, localization, and continuous improvement.
* Conduct supplier capacity assessments and evaluate supplier readiness to support business growth and demand fluctuations.
* Identify, assess, and mitigate supply chain risks through robust business continuity and contingency planning.
* Lead supplier reviews and performance governance to ensure compliance with quality and delivery expectations.

**Material Planning & Inventory Management**

* Oversee material planning activities to ensure optimum inventory levels while maintaining production continuity.
* Manage inventory health including inventory turns, excess and obsolete (E&O) inventory, and working capital improvement initiatives.
* Lead shortage management and material recovery actions to prevent production disruptions.
* Drive implementation and continuous improvement of MRP planning processes.
* Ensure timely execution of engineering changes and new product introductions while minimizing inventory exposure and obsolescence.

**Operations & Supply Chain Excellence**

* Collaborate with Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering, and Logistics teams to ensure seamless execution of production plans.
* Drive process improvements through Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, Continuous Improvement, and Operational Excellence initiatives.
* Lead initiatives such as Milk-Run, Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI), inventory optimization, and supply chain digitalization.

**Cost & Productivity Management**

* Drive procurement productivity and cost reduction initiatives through negotiations, value engineering, localization, and strategic sourcing.
* Identify and implement opportunities to reduce total cost of ownership and improve supply chain efficiency.
* Support annual budgeting, forecasting, and cost management objectives.
* Drive working capital improvements through inventory optimization and supplier collaboration.

**Team Leadership & People Development**

* Lead, coach, and develop the Procurement and Supply Chain team to achieve departmental and organizational objectives.
* Establish clear goals, KPIs, and development plans for team members.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous learning, and operational excellence.
* Conduct regular performance reviews and succession planning activities.
* Build organizational capability to support business growth and future leadership requirements.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**
**The Role Will Be Measured On**

* Line Fulfilment
* Plan Fulfilment
* Inventory Turns
* Inventory Accuracy
* Excess & Obsolete (E&O) Reduction
* Supplier On-Time Delivery (OTD)
* Cost Savings & Productivity
* Supplier Risk Management
* Team Performance and Capability Development

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering; MBA/Supply Chain specialization preferred.
* 15-18 years of experience in Procurement, Materials Management, Supply Chain, or Manufacturing Operations.
* Proven experience managing Procurement, Planning, or Supply Chain teams in a manufacturing environment.
* Strong understanding of procurement, material planning, inventory management, supplier development, and supply chain operations.
* Hands-on experience with SAP or equivalent ERP systems, including procurement, inventory management, and MRP processes.
* Expertise in Inventory Management, Lean Manufacturing, Milk-Run, Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI), and Supply Chain Optimization.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Power BI, and data analytics tools.
* Demonstrated experience in cost reduction, supplier negotiations, and working capital improvement initiatives.
* Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional leadership capabilities.
* Experience in HVAC, Industrial Chillers, Capital Equipment, or Engineering Manufacturing industries will be an added advantage.

**Benefits**
We offer a competitive total rewards package that may include other benefits and wellbeing programs. Offerings vary by role and location and are designed to support employees’ health, security, and success.
  
  

* Make yourself a priority with flexible schedules, parental leave
* Drive forward your career through professional development opportunities
* Achieve your personal goals with our Employee Assistance Programme

**Our commitment to you**
Our greatest assets are the expertise, creativity and passion of our employees. We strive to provide a great place to work that attracts, develops and retains the best talent, promotes employee engagement, fosters teamwork and ultimately drives innovation for the benefit of our customers. We strive to create an environment where you feel that you belong, with diversity and inclusion as the engine to growth and innovation. We develop and deploy best-in-class programs and practices, providing enriching career opportunities, listening to employee feedback and always challenging ourselves to do better. **About The Role**

This person will act as the bridge between business stakeholders and the SAP technical team: gathering and analyzing business requirements and designing and building the corresponding SAP solutions. * Configure and customize SAP FI: General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Bank Accounting.

* Lead or support testing cycles (unit, integration, UAT) for FI-related changes.
* Provide functional support for incidents and service requests.
* Collaborate with developers on custom developments, interfaces, and enhancements.

* Train and support end users on new functionalities.

* Strong functional knowledge of SAP FI: General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Bank Accounting.
* Technical/configuration expertise within SAP FI (customizing, organizational structure, account determination, etc.).
* Understanding FI integration points with other core modules.
* Proven ability to gather and analyze business requirements and translate them into robust SAP solutions.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication skills, comfortable interfacing with both business and technical teams.

* Experience with SAP S/4HANA.
* Familiarity with SAP Fiori apps.
* Exposure to e-Invoicing process.
* Ability to read and troubleshoot ABAP code (not full development).

title: Senior Associate Finance
description:
At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.
  
  
Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.
  
  
Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.
  
  
**About The Role**
**Role Description**
Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. The Sr Associate will support financial planning, forecasting, management reporting, consolidation, and continuous-improvement initiatives through accurate, timely, and decision-useful finance deliverables. This role will report to the Manager Finance.
  
  
This Sr. Associate serves as a finance partner, advancing financial and related cross functional planning excellence, automation, and data-driven decision-making. The role will strengthen forecasting accuracy, streamline reporting, and embed AI and technology-enabled solutions across finance and cross-functional teams.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Ensures that day-to-day reporting and forecasting for responsible functions is handled properly and according to internal guidelines, accounting principles and applicable laws and ethical business practices
* Execute planning-cycle activities for forecasts, actuals, budgets, long-range plans, quarterly business reviews, and leadership outlooks, including data collection, consolidation, reasonableness checks, and commentary preparation.

This includes template preparation and alignment, Anaplan inputs, Hyperion loading, and master-data maintenance.
  
  

* Support monthly close process, completing management/project reports, variance analysis, and presenting results and recommendations to Senior Management.
* Gather and analyze business performance and prepare clear financial commentary on growth investment trade-offs, forecast risks and opportunities, and market trends.
* Prepare management reporting materials, including Power BI dashboards, weekly sales reporting, PowerPoint presentations, and components-of-growth reviews.
* Perform ad-hoc analysis as needed
* Support budget coordination and expense-management activities, including purchase orders, SPOC and non-PO accruals, actuals tracking, and OPEX and T&E monitoring.
* Perform finance reviews of distributor claims, margins, free goods, royalties, profit-share arrangements, sales reconciliations, pricing set-up, contract-management activities, and related data validation.
* Identify and implement opportunities to standardize, automate, and continuously improve FP&A processes, templates, reporting tools, and data quality.
* Build trusted working relationships with global finance stakeholders; share knowledge and provide day-to-day support to colleagues as needed.
* Ensure assigned deliverables are completed accurately and on time, escalating issues promptly and communicating clearly with stakeholders.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Chartered accountant, Cost Accountant, Certified public accountant or a Master’s degree in Economics, Finance or Business & Administration
* 5+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, G&A Finance, Technology Finance, Project Controls, or a related finance discipline.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Pharmaceutical/biotechnology industry experience
* Experience collaborating effectively across functions and multiple time zones
* Knowledge and understanding of financial planning, forecasting, budgeting, long-range planning, management reporting, consolidation, and quarter-close activities
* Strong expertise in financial modeling, scenario planning, and advanced analytics.
* High digital fluency, including familiarity with AI tools, automation platforms (RPA), and large data concept
* Experience with ERP/EPM/BI systems (e.g., SAPS4, Anaplan, Power BI, Tableau) and data-driven decision support.
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and translate data into clear strategic insights.
* Strong project and change management skills in cross-functional, matrixed environments
* Strong attention to detail & ability to operate with a sense of urgency

**Good To Have Skills:**

* Experience working within a local affiliate in a global matrix organization.
* Strong understanding of commercial finance & analytics
* Familiarity with affiliate budgeting cycles (Plan, Forecast, LRS, Scenarios) and regional reporting requirements.
* Experience partnering closely with Business Unit leads and General Managers.
* Exposure to launch planning, lifecycle management, or portfolio re-prioritization at affiliate level.

**Soft Skills:**

* Analytical, interpersonal, collaboration, problem-solving, and stakeholder-management skills
* Effective verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain financial insights clearly to finance and business stakeholders
* Ability to work effectively with global, virtual teams
* High degree of initiative, accountability, and self-motivation
* Ability to manage multiple priorities successfully and meet demanding deadlines
* Collaborative, with a focus on achieving team goals

**What You Can Expect Of Us**
As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.
  
  
In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers competitive and comprehensive Total Rewards Plans that are aligned with local industry standards.
  
  
**Apply now for a career that defies imagination**
**Apply now**
Objects in your future are closer than they appear. Join us.
  
  
**careers.amgen.com**
As an organization dedicated to improving the quality of life for people around the world, Amgen fosters an inclusive environment of diverse, ethical, committed and highly accomplished people who respect each other and live the Amgen values to continue advancing science to serve patients. Together, we compete in the fight against serious disease.
  
  
Amgen is an Equal Opportunity employer and will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by applicable law.
  
  
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

description:

Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

ㅤ

The Associate, Record to Report (RTR) for Controllership will support RTR accounting and controllership activities for assigned Warner Bros. Discovery entities and business areas. This role will be based in Hyderabad and will report directly to the Manager RTR. The role is responsible for accurate and timely month-end, quarter-end and annual close activities, journal entries, account reconciliations, variance analysis, financial reporting support, SOX documentation, audit support, and compliance with US GAAP and company accounting policies.

The role will support transition, stabilization and scaling of RTR activities into the Hyderabad Accounting COE, while contributing to process standardization, simplification, automation and continuous improvement.

The role requires a strong controllership mindset, sound technical accounting knowledge, analytical capability and ownership. The Associate is expected to independently execute assigned activities, perform detailed analysis and quality checks on assigned work, identify and resolve issues, support process knowledge sharing, and escalate material accounting, reporting or control matters to the Manager RTR in a timely manner.

Your normal hours of work are 3:00 p.m. IST to 11:00 p.m. IST, Monday to Friday. However, due to business needs, you may be required to work outside these hours and on holidays for the proper performance of your role, subject to applicable laws and company policy.

**Your Role Accountabilities…**

**Controllership, Close and Reporting**

· Perform and support RTR accounting and controllership activities for the assigned scope, ensuring completeness, accuracy and timely delivery.

· Prepare month-end journal entries including accruals, prepaids, amortizations, reclasses and other standard or ad-hoc entries.

· Prepare balance sheet reconciliations, investigate reconciling items and aging, and support timely resolution of open items.

· Perform monthly and quarterly balance sheet and income statement variance analysis and provide clear explanations to controllership stakeholders.

· Prepare and Support intercompany reconciliations, investigate out-of-balance items and coordinate timely resolution with WBD counterparts.

· Ensure all assigned close activities are completed in accordance with the close calendar, accounting policies and reporting requirements.

· Prepare and support financial reporting schedules, management reporting requirements and other close deliverables as assigned.

**Governance, Controls and Audit Readiness**

· Ensure accounting and reconciliation supporting documentation meets SOX standards and internal control requirements.

· Execute assigned key controls, retain appropriate evidence and promptly escalate control exceptions or financial reporting risks.

· Support internal and external audits, statutory requirements, walkthroughs, testing and information requests, and help drive timely closure of open items.

**Transition & Process (as per business needs)**

· Support transition, knowledge transfer and documentation of RTR activities moving into the Hyderabad Accounting COE.

 · Participate in training, shadowing, reverse-shadowing, testing and readiness activities to support smooth transitions and business continuity

· Support process standardization and help update process documentation across RTR activities

· Support SAP/ERP changes and use advanced Excel, Power BI and other available tools for analysis where needed.

**Team Collaboration, Knowledge Sharing and Support**

· Knowledge sharing and training support to team members and new joiners without direct people-management responsibility.

· Support the Manager RTR in close coordination, issue tracking, backup coverage, prioritization and timely escalation of delivery risks.

· Maintain up-to-date process knowledge and contribute to a collaborative, accountable and quality-focused team culture.

· Perform other duties, special projects and ad-hoc activities requested by the Manager RTR or relevant stakeholders.

**Qualifications & Experience…**

**Required**

· MBA, B.Com, CA Inter, CMA Inter, M.Com or equivalent relevant finance/accounting qualification required; CA, CPA or CMA qualification is an advantage.

· 3-5 years of progressive accounting experience, preferably in a US GAAP environment.

· Strong experience in RTR, month-end close, journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations, variance analysis, financial reporting support, audit support and internal controls.

· Minimum 1 year of experience in SAP FI/CO or equivalent; exposure to SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA and BlackLine is preferred.

· Experience working in transitions, transformation, process stabilization or migration activities.

· Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including advanced functions; working knowledge of Power BI is preferred.

· Experience working in a multinational or multicultural matrix organization.

· Strong analytical, problem-solving and issue-resolution skills with the ability to manage competing priorities and tight deadlines.

· Very good written and verbal communication, interpersonal and stakeholder-management skills.

· High attention to detail, ownership mindset and commitment to quality, compliance and timely delivery.

· Able to work effectively across various time zones.

**Desired**

· Big 4 public accounting background and/or prior exposure to a captive Finance Shared Service Centre / Global Capability Center.

· Experience in media, entertainment, studio, production, distribution or related industries.

· Experience with finance transformation, automation, process standardization or system implementation initiatives.

· Self-driven attitude with willingness to learn, grow and take on additional responsibilities.

· Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and changing environment.

**Other Requirements**

· Required to be in the Hyderabad office three days a week after stabilization (specific days to be determined upon hire).

**About Skydance**

Skydance is a next-generation global media and entertainment company, comprised of three business segments: Studios, Direct-to-Consumer, and TV Media. Skydance's portfolio unites legendary brands, including Paramount, Warner Bros., HBO and HBO Max, Paramount+, Pluto TV, CBS, CNN, CBS Sports, TNT Sports, Nickelodeon, Cartoon Network, MTV, Food Network, BET, HGTV, and Comedy Central.

title: Manager, Controllership
description:
**Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.**

Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

ㅤ

The Manager, Record to Report for Controllership will provide end-to-end ownership for the Record-to-Report accounting and controllership activities. This role will be based in Hyderabad and will be responsible for ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant financial reporting, strong balance sheet governance, effective internal controls, and successful delivery of close, reporting, audit support, and compliance requirements.
  

This is a critical role within the Accounting COE and will play a key part in transitioning, stabilizing, and scaling controllership activities including transition from other regions. The Manager will partner closely within Controllership, Global Business Services (GBS), and other global and regional stakeholders to deliver high-quality financial outcomes at scale.

The role requires a strong controllership mindset, technical accounting knowledge, proven people leadership, and the ability to operate effectively in a complex, matrixed, global environment. The successful candidate will be expected to lead transition of accounting work to WBD’s Hyderabad center, drive operational discipline, process standardization, automation, continuous improvement, and a culture of accountability, quality, and compliance.

This role will manage ~5 Asst Manager and Sr Associate accounting positions in Hyderabad, supporting the controllership function. Your normal hours of work are 3:00 p.m IST. to 11:00 p.m IST. Monday to Friday. However, due to business needs, you may be required to work outside these hours and on holidays for the proper performance of your role without any additional pay. Subject to any applicable laws, the Company reserves the right to change your hours of work where this is essential to business needs and upon reasonable notice to you.
  

**Your Role Accountabilities…**

**Controllership, Close and Reporting Leadership**

* Manage RTR accounting and controllership activities.
* Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close processes, ensuring accuracy, completeness, timeliness, and compliance with applicable accounting and reporting requirements.
* Manage intercompany reconciliations and resolve out-of-balance items with WBD counterparts.
* Ensure strong balance sheet governance, account reconciliation quality, variance analysis, management reporting, and timely issue resolution.
* Analyze financial results against expectations and provide meaningful insights to controllership and business stakeholders.
* Review monthly and quarterly Balance Sheets and Income Statements, including part of footnotes disclosures and supplemental schedules, ensuring completeness and accuracy.
* Ensure accounting implications of business transactions are assessed timely.
* Responsible for system/manual reconciliations between the Business Unit boundary systems and SAP, ensuring data consistency and accuracy
* Continuous support in identifying, designing, and implementing process improvements and standardizations across areas of responsibility to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.
* Review and approve journal entries, applying independent judgment to determine appropriate accounting treatment in line with US GAAP and internal policies.

**Governance, Controls and Audit Readiness**

* Maintain a strong internal control environment and ensure compliance with SOX requirements.
* Partner with internal and external auditors to support audit planning, walkthroughs, testing, information requests, and timely closure of audit matters.
* Proactively identify financial reporting, compliance, and control risks and ensure appropriate escalation and resolution.

**Transition and Operating Model Buildout**

* Lead the transition, stabilization, and scaling of accounting activities being from other region into the Hyderabad Accounting COE.
* Establish clear ownership, process documentation, KPIs, service levels, governance routines, and escalation mechanisms.
* Partner with global and regional stakeholders to ensure business continuity, knowledge transfer, and successful transition outcomes.

**Stakeholder Management and Business Partnership**

* Act as the key connection point between the Hyderabad Accounting COE and business  Controllership.
* Collaborate with leadership to set department priorities and assist in problem resolution
* Understand the business model and operating drivers to provide informed controllership advice and support decision-making.
* Ensure effective communication of accounting decisions, process impacts, deadlines, and risks across relevant stakeholder groups.
* Serve as a liaison between Controllership and cross-functional groups including FP&A, Tax, and Corporate Financial Reporting.

**Transformation, Process Excellence and Systems**

* Drive process standardization, simplification, automation, and continuous improvement across RTR activities.
* Identify opportunities to improve close efficiency, reporting quality, control effectiveness, and team productivity.
* Support system implementations, ERP-related changes, integrations, reorganizations, and other finance transformation initiatives.
* Lead process improvement initiatives in partnership with controllership.

**People Leadership and Talent Development**

* Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of accounting professionals.
* Set clear goals, performance expectations, priorities, and accountability standards.
* Build strong succession depth and develop controllership capability within the Hyderabad COE.
* Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, integrity, continuous improvement, and high-quality execution.
* Assess workload, resource requirements, and capacity needs, and recommend changes as required.
* Provide training and guidance to team members on accounting processes, systems, and best practices to build a high-performing team.
* Support ad hoc projects and requests from senior management as needed.

**Qualifications & Experience…**

**Required**

* Chartered Accountant, CPA, MBA or equivalent professional accounting qualifications.
* 12+ years of progressive accounting, controllership, financial reporting, or audit experience with
  at least 3 years of supervisory role.
* Strong experience in RTR, close, balance sheet governance, financial reporting, audit support, and internal controls.
* Deep understanding of US GAAP, and SOX control requirements, including intercompany and foreign currency accounting.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel
* Proven experience leading accounting teams.
* Prior controllership experience in a multinational, matrixed, global organization.
* Strong stakeholder management experience with the ability to influence senior finance and business leaders.
* Demonstrated ability to operate in a fast-paced environment, manage competing priorities, deliver against tight deadlines, and manage composure under deadline pressure.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, present solution, and decision-making skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with high level transparency
* High attention to detail, strong ownership mindset, and commitment to quality and compliance.
* Able to work effectively across various time zones.

**Desired**

* Experience in media, entertainment, production, distribution, or related industries.
* Experience with SAP or other large ERP platforms.
* Experience in managing finance transformation, automation, process standardization, or system implementation initiatives.

**About Skydance**

Skydance is a next-generation global media and entertainment company, comprised of three business segments: Studios, Direct-to-Consumer, and TV Media. Skydance's portfolio unites legendary brands, including Paramount, Warner Bros., HBO and HBO Max, Paramount+, Pluto TV, CBS, CNN, CBS Sports, TNT Sports, Nickelodeon, Cartoon Network, MTV, Food Network, BET, HGTV, and Comedy Central.

**Some Important Details**

We embrace the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects a wide array of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit. In line with the laws of the country or region in which the role is based, this includes consideration without regard to race, color, ethnicity, national origin, citizenship status, religion or belief, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, pregnancy, parenthood, physical or mental disability, genetic information, military or protected veteran status, union status or any other category protected by applicable law.

title: Senior Manager – Corporate Finance & Treasury
description:
* **Trade Finance & Debt Fundraising Manager Location: Hyderabad Experience: 4–10 Years Department: Finance / Corporate Treasury**
  Department: Finance / Corporate Treasury
* Role Purpose: To source, structure, negotiate, and secure trade finance, working capital, alternative debt, and other funding facilities for import-export and cross-border trading operations.
* Develop relationships with international trade-finance platforms, fintech lenders, NBFCs, institutional lenders, and private credit funds.
* Take ownership of funding transactions from initial lender identification to successful fund disbursement.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. Trade Finance & Funding Sourcing

* Identify and research suitable domestic and international trade-finance providers.
* Map funding providers based on trade corridors, buyers, suppliers, and transaction requirements.
* Build relationships with international trade-finance platforms and lenders.
* Identify alternative funding sources beyond traditional bank financing.
* Explore unsecured, collateral-free, and collateral-light funding options.
* Identify suitable funding partners such as:
* Drip Capital
* Incomlend
* Tradewind
* Stenn
* KredX
* Velotrade
* Demica
* PrimaDollar

B. Financing Products & Instruments

- Evaluate and arrange different financing solutions, including:

* Invoice Factoring
* Invoice Discounting
* Receivables Financing
* Receivables Discounting
* Supply Chain Financing
* Purchase Order Financing
* Pre-Shipment Finance
* Post-Shipment Finance
* Trade Credit Facilities
* Letters of Credit (LC)
* Standby Letters of Credit (SBLC)
* Working Capital Finance

C. Lender Relationship Management

* Develop and maintain relationships with:
* International Trade Finance Companies
* Fintech Lenders
* NBFCs
* Institutional Lenders
* Private Credit Funds
* Alternative Financing Providers
* Present the company's business model, trade cycles, buyers, suppliers, and financial requirements to lenders.
* Identify and onboard new funding partners.
* Build a strong network of domestic and international lenders.

D. Funding Applications & Documentation

* Prepare and submit funding applications to lenders.
* Coordinate all documentation required for financing approvals.
* Collect and organize:
* Purchase Orders
* Commercial Invoices
* Import/Export Documents
* Buyer and Supplier Information
* Buyer/Supplier Credit History
* Financial Statements
* Bank Statements
* KYC Documents
* Corporate and Legal Documents
* Coordinate lender due diligence and respond to lender queries.
* Follow up until approval, sanction, documentation, and disbursement.

E. Negotiation & Financial Structuring

* Compare funding proposals from multiple lenders.
* Evaluate financing based on:
* Interest/Discount Rates
* Advance Rates
* Loan Tenure
* Processing and Arrangement Fees
* Collateral Requirements
* Recourse vs. Non-Recourse
* Repayment Structure
* Overall Cost of Capital
* Negotiate competitive interest rates, higher advance rates, longer tenures, and lower fees.
* Structure appropriate debt and working-capital facilities.
* Evaluate and structure blended funding solutions involving debt, equity, venture debt, trade finance, and working capital.

F. Regulatory & Compliance

* Coordinate with Legal and Compliance teams.
* Ensure financing transactions comply with applicable regulations:
* FEMA
* RBI Regulations
* RBI ECB Guidelines
* OFAC / Sanctions Requirements
* AML / KYC Requirements
* UCP 600
* Cross-Border Financing Regulations

G. Funding Pipeline & Monitoring

* Maintain a detailed funding pipeline covering:
* Potential Lenders
* Initial Discussions
* Applications Submitted
* Due Diligence
* Credit Approvals
* Sanctioned Limits
* Documentation
* Fund Disbursements
* Outstanding Facilities
* Future Funding Requirements
* Monitor credit limits, fund utilization, outstanding amounts, and repayment schedules.
* Track available credit limits and upcoming funding requirements.

H. Management Reporting

* Report regularly to the CFO and Senior Management.
* Provide updates on:
* Funding Opportunities
* Lender Discussions
* Approved Credit Lines
* Sanctioned Facilities
* Successful Disbursements
* Funding Pipeline
* Financing Terms
* Cost of Capital

3. Required Skills & Background

* 4–10 years of relevant experience in:
* Trade Finance
* Export-Import Banking
* Corporate Treasury
* Debt Fundraising
* Alternative Lending
* Fintech Lending
* NBFCs
* Banking / Financial Services
* Hands-on experience in raising or arranging trade finance, working capital, or alternative debt facilities.
* Strong knowledge of invoice discounting, factoring, receivables financing, supply chain finance, and purchase order finance.
* Practical knowledge of LC, SBLC, and trade credit.
* Experience dealing directly with international trade-finance fintechs, NBFCs, private credit funds, and institutional lenders.
* Strong lender network or ability to develop international funding relationships.
* Good financial analysis and structuring skills.
* Strong negotiation and relationship management skills.
* Excellent communication and documentation skills.
* Understanding of FEMA, RBI regulations, ECB guidelines, OFAC, AML/KYC, and UCP 600.
* Ability to independently manage funding transactions and secure actual disbursements.

4. Preferred Candidate Profile

Candidates with proven experience in the following areas will be strongly preferred:

* Personally sourcing and closing financing transactions.
* Securing unsecured or non-collateralized funding.
* Arranging collateral-light funding facilities.
* Raising trade finance and working capital.
* Building relationships with alternative lenders.
* Negotiating competitive financing terms.
* Managing lender due diligence.
* Closing financing documentation.
* Obtaining successful fund disbursements.
* Managing multiple lenders and financing facilities.
* Having an existing network of:
* Trade Finance Companies
* Fintech Lenders
* NBFCs
* Private Credit Funds
* Institutional Funding Providers

5. Key Hiring Expectations – What the Management Wants

The ideal candidate should be able to:

1. Source Funding: Identify domestic and international lenders who can finance the company's import-export business.
2. Build Lender Networks: Have existing relationships or the ability to establish relationships with alternative financing providers.
3. Arrange Finance: Understand and structure invoice discounting, factoring, receivables financing, and other trade-finance products.
4. Negotiate: Secure competitive interest rates, higher advance rates, and favorable financing terms.
5. Close Deals: Independently handle lender discussions, applications, due diligence, approvals, and documentation.
6. Secure Disbursements: Convert funding opportunities into actual sanctioned facilities and money disbursed into the business.

Most Important Hiring Criteria: The company is looking for someone who has actually raised and secured funding, rather than someone whose experience is limited to banking operations, accounting, financial reporting, or documentation.

The team does extensive tax compliance work for Partnerships and Corporations, relating to U.S. Hedge funds, U.S. Private Equity, and Management Company entities. The team performs a detailed review of tax workpapers and tax returns, a detailed analysis of financial products and their tax treatment, analyzes the book income, computes the taxable income, and its allocation to the investors using complex tax allocation methodologies. The team interacts with various internal and external stakeholders to understand the process workflows relating to trade and fund accounting and industry-wide tax practices and their reporting. The team plays a pivotal role in various tax process automation initiatives and generates tax analytical and visualization dashboards, which aid in creating efficiencies and alpha generation. Shaw’s various Financial Operations teams and the Tax Planning team. You will prepare, review, and issue quarterly investor tax estimate statements. You will compute funds’ taxable income calculations/allocations for various D. E. Shaw’s hedge funds, as well as for investors, which includes analyzing book-to-tax differences, and various taxable income allocation methodologies. You will be expected to periodically compute various state taxes, pay state tax authorities and address tax notices. Additionally, you will periodically present D. E. Shaw’s hedge funds taxable income analysis to senior management and address queries raised by investors on their taxable income calculations.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience managing the complete accounts function of a small or medium-sized business and should be able to work independently with minimal supervision.

Key Responsibilities

* Process vendor payments, employee reimbursements and other company expenses.
* Prepare payment schedules and ensure timely payments.
* Track customer collections and outstanding receivables.

**3. Taxation & Statutory Compliance**

* Maintain employee salary and statutory deduction records.
* Handle full-and-final settlements and leave encashment calculations.
* Coordinate statutory contributions and employee-related payments.

**5. Financial Reporting & Audit**

* Prepare monthly profit and loss statements, expense reports and basic MIS reports.
* Monitor cash flow, outstanding receivables and upcoming payment obligations.
* Assist with monthly and annual closing of accounts.
* Coordinate with the company's Chartered Accountant for audits, income tax filings and annual financial statements.
* Maintain accurate accounting records and supporting documentation.

**6. Inventory & Purchase Accounting**

* Record purchase invoices, supplier payments and purchase returns.
* Reconcile supplier statements and outstanding balances.
* Coordinate with procurement and production teams for invoice verification.
* Assist in tracking inventory purchases, material costs and stock reconciliation.

Qualifications & Skills

* **3–5 years of hands-on accounting experience**
  , preferably in a small or medium-sized company.

  **Tally Prime**
   and Microsoft Excel.
* Good working knowledge of GST, TDS, PF, ESI and other applicable Indian statutory compliances.
* Experience independently handling accounts payable, receivable, payroll and bank reconciliations.
* Strong attention to detail, accuracy and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage deadlines and work independently.

Preferred Candidate

We are looking for a 
**hands-on accounts professional, not just a data-entry operator**
, who can take ownership of the company's routine accounting operations, ensure timely statutory compliance and provide accurate financial information to management.

title: BIE II, Tax
description:
**Description**
Amazon is a fast-paced, dynamic, high-tech company based in Seattle. Global Tax Data (GTD) organization provides data management services and supports program and product initiatives that improve tax data integrity across Amazon's global indirect tax compliance operations. GTD ensures timely, accurate data is available for tax compliance reporting and audit readiness, and our teams manage the tax data infrastructure, pipelines, reconciliation tools, and operational reporting that compliance teams rely on worldwide.
  
  
As a Business Intelligence Engineer (BIE) II in GTD, you'll build gold-standard analytics datasets and data mart/warehouses while driving the data analysis, reconciliation operations, root-cause investigations, and process improvements that directly support Amazon's monthly tax compliance cycles. You'll partner cross-functionally with your customers in tax compliance and accounting, and with stakeholders across finance technology, to make sure the data behind every filing is complete, accurate, and delivered on time. You'll also work closely with Data Engineering, Software Engineering, and Solutions Architects.
  
  
This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys digging into large datasets — spotting patterns, explaining the story behind the variances, and driving issues to resolution independently.
  
  
You'll thrive here if you bring strong analytical skills, the ability (or a genuine eagerness to build it) to work with large-scale data, and the business judgment to translate tax and accounting context into the right system configurations.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Build and own the Gold standard data mart/warehouse for business reporting and analysys
* Perform hands-on reconciliation and detailed analysis of large financial datasets each month, investigating and resolving discrepancies across source systems, tax reporting warehouses, and the general ledger.
* Troubleshoot data quality issues, identify root causes, and drive corrective actions with upstream and downstream teams.
* Partner with compliance and customer teams to understand reporting requirements and translate business objectives into clear data specifications and technical development requirements.
* Develop and maintain operational reports, dashboards, and metrics that give visibility into reconciliation health and data readiness.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, controllership, and data quality — automating manual processes, reducing cycle time, and coaching customer teams on how to use the reporting and functionality you build.
* Own and manage SIM tickets and intake workflows, ensuring timely response and resolution for internal and external stakeholders.
* Support audit data requests by extracting, validating, and delivering data packages to auditors and tax authorities.
* Document standard operating procedures, runbooks, and process flows for recurring operational activities.
* Build strong relationships with key technology providers and technical teams across Amazon, and clearly explain financial and technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Contribute to Monthly and Quarterly Business Reviews (MBRs/QBRs) and operational readiness activities.

**About The Team**
We are a fast-growing team supporting the Corporate Tax function. We seek candidates who are eager and able to learn new content quickly, who are willing to venture into unfamiliar territory, and who bring ironclad judgment and integrity when handling confidential information.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
Work closely with Tech partners, non-tech customer and team to deliver the required solution.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Experience in analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc.
* Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
* Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
* Experience using SQL to pull data from a database or data warehouse and scripting experience (Python) to process data for modeling
* Experience with SQL
* Experience in the data/BI space
* Experience in tax, finance or a related analytical field
* Experience in Excel (including VBA, pivot tables, array functions, power pivots, etc.) and data visualization tools such as Tableau
* Experience defining requirements and using data and metrics to draw business insights
* Experience making business recommendations and influencing stakeholders
* Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, business, economics, engineering , analytics, mathematics, statistics or a related technical or quantitative field

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in data mining, ETL, etc. and using databases in a business environment with large-scale, complex datasets

title: Middle Office Reconciliation Onboarding - Emerging Lead
description:
Role overview
  
  
We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Senior Associate to support end-to-end client onboarding and conversion activities within the Middle Office Reconciliation Onboarding team. The role involves translating business requirements into reconciliation solutions, coordinating system and data readiness, supporting testing and production deployment, and ensuring a controlled transition to business-as-usual operations.
  
  
The candidate will work closely with investment managers, custodians, fund administrators, business teams, technology partners, and reconciliation operations. Strong experience in middle office reconciliation, data analysis, data mapping, and TLM/TLP reconciliation platforms is preferred.
  
  
Why this role is important to us
  
  
The Middle Office Reconciliation Onboarding team supports the implementation of new investment managers and funds onto State Street’s reconciliation platforms. The team acts as a central coordination point across business, operations, technology, clients, and external data providers to ensure that cash, position, transaction, and market-value reconciliation requirements are accurately configured, tested, deployed, and handed over to operations.
  
  
This role helps ensure complete system and data readiness, effective risk management, and a controlled, low-risk transition into live reconciliation services.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  
  

* Support assigned onboarding projects from requirements gathering through configuration, testing, production deployment, stabilization, and operational handover.
* Participate in discussions with clients, custodians, fund administrators, operations, and technology teams to understand reconciliation requirements and document agreed scope.
* Review fund matrices, account structures, reconciliation types, data sources, frequencies, tolerances, matching criteria, and reporting requirements.
* Analyse cash, position, transaction, and market-value data received through SWIFT messages, flat files, and custodian portals.
* Support validation of SWIFT MT940, MT950, and MT535 messages and identify data-quality, routing, and mapping gaps.
* Perform data analysis and mapping for non-SWIFT files and coordinate with ETL and deployment teams to establish appropriate file-processing solutions.
* Support account, reconciliation shell, lead-account, match-rule, workflow, and static-data setup in BUAT and production environments.
* Validate feed connectivity, system configuration, data completeness, and reconciliation results before implementation.
* Coordinate and execute functional testing, BUAT, DITL, conversion rehearsals, production parallel testing, and go-live readiness checks.
* Document test scenarios, expected results, defects, evidence, approvals, and sign-offs in line with project and control requirements.
* Investigate reconciliation exceptions and configuration issues, identify root causes, and coordinate corrective actions with the appropriate teams.
* Maintain project plans, open-item logs, Jira tickets, risk and dependency trackers, meeting notes, status reports, and implementation documentation.
* Monitor milestones, dependencies, and outstanding actions; escalate delivery risks or control concerns in a timely manner.
* Communicate conversion, rollout, and stabilization plans clearly to internal and external stakeholders.
* Prepare standard operating procedures, reconciliation playbooks, configuration records, and handover documentation for business-as-usual teams.
* Support post-production stabilization and ensure outstanding issues are tracked through closure.
* Maintain appropriate evidence and audit trails in accordance with operational-risk, information-security, and control requirements.
* Assist in identifying opportunities to standardize processes, improve controls, and reduce manual effort through automation.
* Provide guidance and knowledge support to junior colleagues and contribute to team training and knowledge-sharing activities.
* Participate in special projects, system enhancements, process-improvement initiatives, and management reporting as required.

Skills and competencies
  
  

* Strong understanding of middle office reconciliation and the investment-management lifecycle.
* Hands-on experience with cash, position, transaction, and market-value reconciliation.
* Working knowledge of TLM/TLP reconciliation platforms, including static setup, reconciliation configuration, matching rules, tolerances, and exception workflows.
* Experience in external custody data acquisition, SWIFT-message validation, file analysis, and ETL data mapping.
* Ability to analyse complex data issues, identify root causes, and coordinate practical solutions.
* Effective stakeholder-management skills and confidence interacting with global business, operations, technology, client, and custodian teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to provide concise status updates and escalate issues clearly.
* High attention to detail and a consistent focus on quality.
* Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a global team.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook.
* Familiarity with project-tracking, workflow, and process-documentation tools.

Education and experience
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Technology, or a related discipline.
* Approximately 3–5 years of relevant experience in middle office, reconciliation, investment operations, client onboarding, system implementation, or a related function.
* Practical experience using TLM/TLP or another recognized reconciliation platform.
* Experience working with custodians, investment managers, fund administrators, or global operations teams is preferred.
* Understanding of financial instruments, trade lifecycle, IBOR data, and custody operations is advantageous.

**Preferred Additional Skills**

* Exposure to PLM, RKS, CRD, or other investment-servicing platforms.
* Experience with JIRA, SharePoint, Power BI, Power Query, or workflow-automation tools.
* Knowledge of Agile or Waterfall project methodologies.
* Familiarity with root-cause analysis, operational-risk controls, audit requirements, and incident remediation.
* Experience supporting automation, system enhancements, or process-transformation initiatives.

**Shift Timings:**
EMEA/NA
  
  
**Location:**
Hyderabad/Bangalore
  
  
**About State Street**
**What we do.**
State Street is one of the world’s leading providers of financial services to institutional investors. From technology and product innovation to investment servicing, data and analytics, research, trading, and investment management, we help clients safeguard and steward investments around the world.
  
  
**Work, Live and Grow.**
We aim to create an environment where employees can perform at their best and continue to develop. Our benefits and development programmes vary by location and may include medical coverage, insurance, savings plans, flexible-work arrangements, learning opportunities, and educational support.
  
  
**Inclusion, Diversity and Social Responsibility.**
We value diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where employees can contribute and grow. We also support active engagement with communities through volunteering, charitable programmes, and employee networks.
  
  
****About State Street****

description:

GlobalData is a productivity and intelligence platform that empowers leaders to act decisively in a world of complexity and change.By uniting proprietary data, human expertise, and purpose-built AI into a single, connected platform, we help organizations see what's coming, move faster, and lead with confidence. Our solutions are used by over 5,000 organizations across the world's largest industries, delivering tailored intelligence that supports strategic planning, innovation, risk management, and sustainable growth.

Proprietary coverage of 95% of global GDP, synthesized in real time from internal and external sources, aligned under a single business taxonomy - giving you earlier insight, unified context, and decisions you can trust.
  
  
**What We Are Looking For**

* 3–5 years of experience in sales compensation or commission administration, including independently owning a full commission cycle from calculation through to payroll
* Hands-on experience with complex commission scenarios such as claw backs, split deals and retroactive plan changes
* Advanced Excel skills (complex formulas, lookups, pivots, data modelling)
* Strong experience working with CRM data, ideally Salesforce
* Experience with SQL, Snowflake or BI tools such as Astrato is a strong plus; exposure to ICM tools (e.g. CaptivateIQ, Spiff, Xactly) is also valued
* Exceptional attention to detail and a strong process and controls mindset
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to explain calculations and handle escalations

**Role Overview**
The Senior Commission Analyst owns sales commission execution across GlobalData Healthcare, accountable for the accuracy, timeliness and transparency of every payout. Sitting within Revenue Operations, the role administers sales commission plans end to end, resolves queries and disputes, and acts as a trusted adviser to Sales leadership and Finance on plan design and incentive costs. As the sole owner of this business-critical process, the role also builds the documentation and controls that keep the commission cycle resilient and auditable.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the monthly and quarterly commission cycle end to end, from data extraction and calculation through validation, approval and handover to Payroll
* Partner with Sales leadership, Finance and Payroll to ensure commission is paid accurately and on time
* Maintain high standards of commission master data quality, governance and documentation
* Build, maintain and analyze commission and attainment reporting in Astrato using Snowflake data
* Identify process gaps, inefficiencies and opportunities for automation
* Act as the go-to expert and trusted advisor on sales commission
* Interacting / Coaching team members in knowledge sharing and development

**Focus Areas**
**Commission Execution:**

* Calculate, validate and process sales commission, accelerators, bonuses and SPIFs
* Reconcile commission data against bookings, invoicing and contract records in Salesforce, and investigate and resolve discrepancies
* Handle complex scenarios such as claw backs, split deals, mid-period territory changes and retroactive plan amendments
* Ensure a clear approval and sign-off process before payouts are released

**Plan Administration & Modelling**

* Administer sales commission plans and maintain quotas, territories, rates and eligibility
* Model the cost and impact of proposed plan changes and incentive schemes, and advise leadership on plan design
* Support the annual and in-year plan design process, including plan documents and rep communications

**Stakeholder Support & Reporting**

* Serve as the first point of contact for commission queries and disputes, explaining outcomes clearly to reps and managers and handling escalations with confidence
* Provide reps and managers with real-time visibility of attainment and earnings
* Partner with Finance on commission accruals, forecasts and month-end close

**Controls & Resilience**

* Document processes, controls and runbooks so the commission cycle can be run reliably and audited
* Cross-train a nominated backup to provide cover during absence
* Handle confidential compensation data with discretion and in line with data protection requirements

**Key Success Metrics**

* Commission accuracy, with minimal post-payment corrections
* On-time delivery of commission to Payroll every cycle
* Speed and quality of query and dispute resolution
* Completeness of process documentation, controls and audit readiness
* Stakeholder confidence in commission statements and reporting

**Commitment To D&I And EEO**
We believe strongly in the value of diversity and creating supportive, inclusive environments where our colleagues can succeed. As such, GlobalData is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. GlobalData is determined to ensure that no applicant or employee receives less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, race, or is disadvantaged by conditions or requirements which cannot be shown to be justifiable.
