title: Global Banking & Markets - Negotiation and Transaction Management - Vice President - Bengaluru
description:
**WHO WE ARE**

  

The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc. is a leading global financial services firm providing investment banking, securities and investment management services to a substantial and diversified client base that includes corporations, financial institutions, governments and high-net-worth individuals. The firm is headquartered in New York and maintains offices in London, Singapore, Dallas, Warsaw, Frankfurt, Tokyo, Hong Kong and other major financial centres around the world.
  
Global Markets

Our core value is building strong relationships with our institutional clients, which include corporations, financial service providers, and fund managers. We help them buy and sell financial products on exchanges around the world, raise funding, and manage risk. This is a dynamic, entrepreneurial team that includes individuals who have a passion for the markets and who thrive in fast-paced, changing environments and are energized by a bustling trading floor.
  
At Goldman Sachs, our culture is one of teamwork, innovation, and meritocracy. We often say our people are our greatest asset and we take pride in supporting each colleague both professionally and personally. From collaborative workspaces and ergonomic services to wellbeing and resilience offerings, we offer our RDG professionals the flexibility and support they need to reach their goals in and outside the office.

**YOUR IMPACT**

RDG is seeking documentation professionals who will have the opportunity to strategize and negotiate a broad variety of trading and regulatory documentation.
  
The candidate will ideally have experience across a broad range of trading and regulatory documentation including Synthetic Prime Brokerage, Futures, Cleared OTC Derivatives Addendum, GMRA, GMSLA, CDEA, ISDA/CSA, Regulatory Initial Margin, MRA, Sponsored Repo, MSFTA’s suite of documentation and Master Confirmation Agreements for all Equity Derivative products.
  
NTM culture encourages individuals to bring purpose and authenticity to the team environment, where we role model behaviours and take responsibility for demonstrating our shared values. The candidate will be a self-motivated, results-driven, and proactive team player who takes ownership for their work. This is a growing team that encourages an entrepreneurial, innovative, and analytical approach to providing client solutions.

**OUR IMPACT**

  

We are the first line of defence, ensuring delivery on cross-border regulatory initiatives affecting Goldman entities worldwide. We develop and help shape robust policies on matters of regulation as they relate to our practice area and clients. The team is responsible for drafting, reviewing and negotiating complex, regulatory-driven documentation for derivative and other financial products.

**PRINCIPAL RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Engaging in strategic efforts to implement new and existing cross-border regulatory updates
* Develop and help shape robust policies on matters of regulation as they relate to our practice area and clients
* Responsible for drafting, reviewing and negotiating complex regulatory driven documentation for derivative and other financial products (i.e. US Treasury Mandatory Clearing, FINRA 4210, Uncleared Margin Rules, LIBOR, Brexit, etc.)
* Responsible for complete documentation process from drafting, reviewing and negotiating to execution & filing of the following documents: Synthetic Prime Brokerage, Futures, Cleared OTC Derivatives Addendum, GMRA, GMSLA, CDEA,ISDA/CSA and regulatory initial margin MRA, MSFTA’s suite of documentation and Master Confirmation Agreements for all Equity Derivative products and related ancillary documents;
* Review of legal opinions on netting and collateral enforceability including liaising with external counsel;
* Development and execution of negotiation strategies, outside of a playbook, to balance client and GS needs
* Independently lead complex and/or sensitive negotiations for high profile clients
* Working closely with the business teams related to our projects, in particular (Franchise) New Business Group and Client Services
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives and the development of policy and best practices within the trading documentation negotiation space including mentoring and coaching of junior team members and leading training/knowledge sharing sessions
* Responding to queries on the master documentation from various departments including the front office;
* Ongoing opportunity to challenge existing controls/processes and leverage your experience to identify risks and improve the effectiveness of the team; and
Develop and nurture relationships across the firm to build consensus and execute on initiatives.  

**Preferred Experience and Skills:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent or JD with a minimum of five years of PQE / extensive experience in Legal/Trading Documentation role (including within a Credit, Risk or Treasury function) or attorney/paralegal experience within a law firm.
* Knowledge of various legal entities including funds, insurance companies and pensions.
* Proven excellent organizational and prioritisation skills and attention to detail, especially under pressure.
* Proven ability to negotiate and review detailed legal documents with an eye for detail and accuracy, particularly around documentation terms.
* Ability to ensure consistency across documentation and know when to escalate issues.
* Good interpersonal and communications skills.
* Enthusiasm and interest in development of documentation skills and using such skills for the completion of negotiation process.
* Flexibility and willingness to learn new skills and develop full job ownership.
* Strong commercial acumen with a keen interest in derivative, repo, securities lending markets and products and/or prime brokerage products and services.
* Ability to interact with and influence business stakeholders and clients to negotiate, build consensus, control risks and improve operational efficiency.
* Proficient in IT and able to adapt to various databases/systems.
* Familiarity with the use of ai platforms to optimize and streamline negotiation lifecycles.

We Offer Best-In-Class Benefits

Healthcare & Medical Insurance

We offer a wide range of health and welfare programs that vary depending on office location. These generally include medical, dental, short-term disability, long-term disability, life, accidental death, labor accident and business travel accident insurance.

Holiday & Vacation Policies

We offer competitive vacation policies based on employee level and office location. We promote time off from work to recharge by providing generous vacation entitlements and a minimum of three weeks expected vacation usage each year.

Financial Wellness & Retirement

We assist employees in saving and planning for retirement, offer financial support for higher education, and provide a number of benefits to help employees prepare for the unexpected. We offer live financial education and content on a variety of topics to address the spectrum of employees’ priorities.

Health Services

We offer a medical advocacy service for employees and family members facing critical health situations, and counseling and referral services through the Employee Assistance Program (EAP). We provide Global Medical, Security and Travel Assistance and a Workplace Ergonomics Program. We also offer state-of-the-art on-site health centers in certain offices.

Fitness

To encourage employees to live a healthy and active lifestyle, some of our offices feature on-site fitness centers. For eligible employees we typically reimburse fees paid for a fitness club membership or activity (up to a pre-approved amount).

Child Care & Family Care

We offer on-site child care centers that provide full-time and emergency back-up care, as well as mother and baby rooms and homework rooms. In every office, we provide advice and counseling services, expectant parent resources and transitional programs for parents returning from parental leave. Adoption, surrogacy, egg donation and egg retrieval stipends are also available.

If you’re fueled by innovation and committed to delivering exceptional results, KLDiscovery is the perfect place to grow your career. This is a senior position with real scope and autonomy. Working primarily with our EMEA business and supporting APAC, you will own matters end to end and be a trusted, decisive advisor to the business.

* Working close with the Legal Director to support the business in EMEA, through direct contract negotiation, assessing data privacy risks, provision of ad hoc legal advice and solving legal challenges as they arise, advising independently and with confidence
* Act as one of the primary point of contact for EMEA and APAC commercial legal matters

Handle negotiations independently from first draft through to signature, including higher-value and non-standard deals.
* Provide legal counsel on the development, deployment, and commercialization of artificial intelligence and machine learning products and services, including advising on AI governance, responsible AI practices, and emerging AI regulation.
* Identify legal risks associated with new products, features, and business initiatives, and propose practical, business-oriented mitigation strategies.
* Give clear, decisive and commercially aware advice and stand behind it; spot risks and bring solutions proactively and manage stakeholders assertively and with confidence.
* Supervising and coordinating work of local external counsels as needed and manage litigation.
* Manage company secretarial (CoSec) work for the India business, working with external service providers and overseeing their delivery, cost and quality.
* Advise on data privacy, intellectual property, and regulatory compliance issues arising from commercial transactions and technology products.

* Leverage AI tools and legal technology to improve productivity, decision-making, and legal service delivery.

title: Senior Manager Compliance-GGI
description:

title: Contract Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
The SSP Contract Specialist is responsible for managing the full contract lifecycle for Verisk supplier engagements, from ServiceNow intake through drafting, negotiation support, routing for review, execution, and repository storage. This role requires strong attention to detail, the ability to apply SSP contract playbooks, and the capability to coordinate with internal partners across Legal, Privacy, Security, Insurance, Compliance, and business stakeholders.
  
  
This position is partially remote and requires strong independence, reliability, and clear communication, given the distributed nature of the SSP team and our global stakeholders.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Contract Intake & Validation (ServiceNow SSP Queue)
  
  

* Review and validate incoming SSP contract requests submitted in ServiceNow.
* Confirm request type (NDA, MSA, LA, SOW, Amendment) and ensure all required information is provided.
* Communicate with requesters to obtain and clarify missing details or correct ticket entries prior to drafting.

Review of Standard Contract Types
  
  

* Use Verisk‑approved templates and apply appropriate clauses using:
* SSP Contract Clause Playbook
* US MSA Playbook
* US Insurance Playbook
* Ensure accurate completion of template fields, supplier details, commercial terms, and risk‑related requirements.
* Incorporate guidance from prior redlines, negotiations, and best practices shared within SSP.

Cross‑Functional Routing & Approvals
  
  

* Route non‑standard terms to:
* Legal via Legal Front Door (LFD) Smartsheet ticket
* Privacy, Security, Insurance, Compliance, or Procurement teams as needed
* Track review timelines and follow up with internal teams to ensure progression of contract workflows.
* Record all communications and actions in ServiceNow.

Supplier Communication & Negotiation Support
  
  

* Send drafts and redlines to suppliers while maintaining professionalism and consistency with Verisk standards.
* Support negotiations by identifying non‑standard terms and escalating them appropriately.
* Facilitate alignment between supplier feedback and internal stakeholder expectations.

Signature & Execution
  
  

* Prepare final documents for signature through DocuSign or Icertis.
* Confirm all required internal approvals have been obtained prior to sending for signature.
* Ensure executed agreements are properly stored in the Icertis repository and attached to ServiceNow tickets.

Ticket Closure & Documentation
  
  

* Update ServiceNow with detailed notes, final documents, and confirmation of completion.
* Close tickets only after verifying that the executed contract is stored and all steps have been followed.
* Maintain a complete audit trail according to SSP process standards.

Cross‑Team Collaboration
  
  

* Partner closely with SSP leadership, Contract Specialists, Category Managers, and requesters across Verisk business units.
* Participate in knowledge‑sharing sessions, calibration meetings, and process improvement discussions.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, Law, Procurement, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience
* 5–10 years of experience in enterprise contract administration, including MSAs, Agreements for Services (AFS), License Agreements, Data, Cloud and AI Agreements, Statements of Work (SOWs), Order Forms (OFs), and RFPs
* Fluency in English, both written and verbal
* Strong understanding of contract terminology, workflow sequencing, and end to end contract review processes in both English and German is a must.
* High attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple contracts and priorities simultaneously
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience operating in a global, cross functional environment
* Ability to work independently at a remote capacity, with availability between 9:00 a.m. and 5:00 p.m. US EST.
* Demonstrated ability to independently manage contracts through execution, escalate legal or risk issues appropriately, and maintain accurate documentation in contract management systems

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Oracle, Icertis, DocuSign, ServiceNow, or similar contract systems.
* Prior experience applying contract playbooks or negotiating standard agreements.
* Comfort supporting stakeholder meetings and supplier discussions.
* Experience with negotiation of contract terms.

title: Manager / Sr. Manager - Taxation
description:
Manager / Senior Manager – Taxation
  
  
**Company:**
ADAMA India Private Limited
  
  
**Lead Tax Strategy. Strengthen Compliance. Drive Financial Governance.**
ADAMA India is looking for an experienced Chartered Accountant to lead its taxation and regulatory compliance function. This role offers the opportunity to drive tax governance across complex business operations, manage regulatory engagements, and strengthen tax processes through strategic oversight and continuous improvement.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  

* Lead GST Compliance: Oversee GST returns, annual filings, ITC-04, RCM liabilities and robust reconciliations across ERP records and government portals.
* Manage Tax Assessments & Litigation: Lead responses to GST notices, assessments and show cause notices, develop audit defence strategies, and represent the organisation before tax authorities.
* Drive Direct & Indirect Taxation: Oversee corporate tax computations, advance tax, income tax returns, transfer pricing, Customs compliance and TDS/TCS requirements.
* Ensure Regulatory Compliance: Monitor changes in tax laws, assess business implications, and ensure compliance with GST, Income Tax, Customs and FEMA regulations.
* Manage Audits & Stakeholders: Lead statutory, internal, tax and GST audits while partnering with external advisors, consultants and internal teams.
* Strengthen Governance & Processes: Drive process improvements, automation and internal controls to enhance tax compliance and reporting efficiency.

What We're Looking For
  
  

* Chartered Accountant (CA) with 4–7 years of post-qualification experience.
* Strong expertise in Indian taxation, particularly GST, Customs, Income Tax, Transfer Pricing and FEMA.
* Experience managing tax compliance across multi-entity and global corporate structures.
* Hands-on exposure to tax assessments, audits, regulatory proceedings and stakeholder management.
* Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills, with strong analytical and presentation abilities.
* Experience with Oracle or SAP S/4HANA ERP systems will be an added advantage.

Why Join ADAMA?
  
  

* Take ownership of a critical taxation and compliance function.
* Work across complex domestic and international tax matters.
* Partner with business leaders, consultants and regulatory authorities.
* Drive meaningful improvements in tax governance, controls and processes.

**Ready to lead taxation with impact at ADAMA? Explore this opportunity and take the next step in your career.**

title: Risk Analyst II
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.
  
  
**Job Description 1 IT Risk Analyst — Risk Operations (3–5 Years Experience)**
**Position Summary**
The IT Risk Analyst, IT Risk Operations is a judgment-driven role responsible for reviewing, interpreting, and acting on risk signals produced by BMS's automated risk assessment infrastructure. As BMS transitions to a more automated operating model — where structured tiering, continuous monitoring, and integrated assessment frameworks handle intake and classification — the analyst's focus shifts decisively toward review, challenge, exception handling, and stakeholder engagement.
  
  
This is not primarily a processing or intake role. It is an analytical and advisory role where sound risk judgment, clear communication, and accountability for final risk determinations are the core expectations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Risk Review & Judgment**

* Review and validate risk determinations produced through BMS's integrated risk assessment framework, including Cyber Tier assignments (Tiers 0–5), regulatory classifications (GDPR, EU AI Act, GxP, etc.), and control recommendations across 9 risk domains
* Apply independent analytical judgment to accept, challenge, or override system-generated risk outputs; document rationale clearly in ServiceNow (SNOW) for all override decisions
* Identify missing context, ambiguous scope, or inconsistencies between risk outputs and known project characteristics; engage project teams to resolve gaps before closing records
* Interpret and communicate risk signals and outputs in clear, stakeholder-facing language — translating technical determinations into actionable guidance without relying on raw tier scores or regulatory jargon

**Exception Handling & Escalation**

* Own exception handling for edge cases, novel technology types, cross-jurisdictional complexity, and cases where risk assessments indicate insufficient or ambiguous input
* Escalate material discrepancies to Risk Leads, BISOs, or Privacy SMEs with documented rationale; serve as the first line of analytical accountability for the risk record
* Support periodic review of auto-approved projects, identifying patterns or anomalies that warrant re-evaluation

**Stakeholder Engagement**

* Lead or participate in structured touchpoints with project teams, informing them of assessment status, applicable controls, and required documentation
* Serve as a point of contact for project team questions about risk outputs; translate technical risk determinations into clear, actionable guidance
* Collaborate with Legal/Privacy SMEs (DPIA, TIA, SCC workflows) at defined handoff points to ensure risk findings are correctly consumed downstream

**Audit Readiness & Documentation**

* Maintain auditor-ready records in SNOW and GRC platforms; ensure every determination — accepted, challenged, or overridden — is traceable with documented rationale
* Prepare concise, high-quality assessment summaries and control attestations for management and compliance audiences
* Support internal and external audit activities by clearly articulating the basis for risk determinations and the human review actions that followed

**Continuous Improvement**

* Identify patterns in override rates, exception types, and assessment flags that may indicate framework gaps or emerging risk themes
* Apply a continuous improvement mindset to enhance assessment quality, SLA performance, and the overall stakeholder experience

**Required**
**Qualifications & Experience**

* 3–5 years of experience in IT risk management, cybersecurity risk, IT audit, privacy compliance, or a directly related field
* Demonstrated ability to interpret and act on risk outputs or signals — not just execute process steps — with a clear track record of sound analytical judgment
* Working knowledge of NIST Cyber Risk Management Framework and NIST 800-53 controls library
* Familiarity with major data privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA, EU AI Act, GxP)
* Experience with GRC platforms (ServiceNow GRC or equivalent)
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to explain risk determinations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
* Experience with pre/post-implementation risk assessments, cybersecurity, data privacy, and/or digital transformation initiatives

**Preferred**

* Exposure to AI/ML risk assessment frameworks or emerging technology risk
* Experience working in automated or tool-assisted workflow environments
* Relevant certifications CISA, CRISC, CISSP, CISM, or equivalent

**Desired Candidate Characteristics**

* Strong analytical and risk judgment instincts — comfortable forming a defensible view from incomplete information
* Inquisitive and bold; willing to challenge outputs, ask difficult questions, and escalate when warranted
* Collaborative across IT, Legal, Privacy, and Business functions
* Comfortable working with system-generated risk signals and outputs rather than manually gathering inputs
* Adaptable to a continuously evolving, automation-enabled operating model with a growth mindset
* Commitment to healthcare and patient impact as the guiding north star for all risk decisions

We hire for skills and capabilities, not just credentials – if this role excites you, but doesn’t perfectly match your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway.

title: Legal Lead - Infrastructure
description:
**Role Purpose**

The Senior Legal Counsel - Infrastructure will be the dedicated legal lead for the infrastructure business. The role owns legal execution of infrastructure M&A, financing and corporate matters end to end, from term sheet to closing and post-closing integration.

The counsel will work independently across several live transactions, manage external law firms, and act as the trusted legal partner to the deal, asset management, and finance teams.

**Key responsibilities**

**Infrastructure M&A**

* Lead legal execution of acquisitions and divestments of road (HAM, toll, BOT) and renewable (solar, wind, hybrid) assets, at platform and single-asset level.
* Draft, review, and negotiate term sheets, NDAs, share purchase agreements, shareholders' agreements, business transfer agreements, escrow arrangements and transaction ancillaries.
* Scope, coordinate and review legal due diligence; translate findings into conditions precedent, indemnities, specific protections and price adjustments.
* Manage concession-specific issues: change-in-control and substitution approvals from authorities such as NHAI and state agencies, lock-in periods, and lender consents.
* Handle renewable-specific issues: PPA review, land title and lease structures, grid connectivity, open-access and regulatory approvals.
* Run signing and closing: CP trackers, closing agendas, completion deliverables and post-closing actions.

**Financing and lender interface**

* Support acquisition financing, refinancings and lender substitutions at SPV, fund and InvIT level.
* Review facility agreements, security documents, escrow and substitution agreements, NOCs and consent letters.
* Coordinate with lenders, trustees and their counsel to keep transaction timelines on track.

**General corporate and transactional**

* Advise on corporate governance and secretarial matters for SPVs and holding entities, working with the company secretarial team.
* Draft and negotiate commercial contracts for the platform, including O&M, EPC, asset management, advisory and service agreements.
* Advise on regulatory compliance relevant to the platform, including FEMA, SEBI (AIF/InvIT), the Companies Act and sector rules.
* Support portfolio asset management: concession compliance, claims, disputes, arbitration and termination matters, with external counsel.

**Stakeholder and process management**

* Act as the single legal point of contact for the infrastructure deal and asset management teams.
* Present legal risks and recommendations clearly to senior management and investment committees.
* Build and maintain templates, playbooks and checklists for repeat transactions.
* Track multiple concurrent workstreams and escalate risks early.

**Required qualifications and experience**

* LL.B. from a recognised university and enrolment with a State Bar Council in India.
* 10+ years PQE at a reputed Indian law firm and/or in the in-house legal team of an infrastructure developer, fund, InvIT, NBFC or bank.
* Hands-on experience leading infrastructure M&A, with demonstrable deals in road and/or renewable assets.
* Solid grounding in general corporate and transactional work, including shareholder arrangements, joint ventures and commercial contracting.
* Working knowledge of concession agreements (NHAI model concession, HAM/BOT), PPAs and the related approval framework.
* Strong drafting and negotiation skills, with the ability to hold a position against counterparties and senior counsel.
* Proven ability to run several transactions at once with minimal supervision.

**Preferred (good to have)**

* Combination of tier-1 law firm training and in-house experience.
* Experience with InvIT or AIF structures, including acquisitions by or transfers into InvITs.
* Exposure to infrastructure project finance and lender-side documentation.
* Familiarity with concession disputes, arbitral claims and termination payment mechanics.

This is a hands-on leadership role. The successful candidate will combine strong commercial contracting expertise with proven people leadership, sound judgment and a practical understanding of the shipping and logistics industry. The Legal Manager will be expected not only to advise on more complex contractual matters, but also to develop the team, maintain high standards of quality and consistency, improve ways of working, and use technology and AI to enable an increasingly efficient and scalable contracting function.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
**People Leadership**

* Lead, coach and develop a team of approximately 5 to 10 legal professionals responsible for customer contract review and negotiation.
* Set clear priorities and expectations and ensure effective allocation of work across the team.
* Provide guidance and escalation support on complex negotiations and contractual issues while developing the team's ability to operate independently.
* Establish and maintain high standards for quality, consistency, responsiveness and commercial judgment.
* Help the team develop strong capabilities in the effective and responsible use of AI tools, including appropriate human review and validation of AI-supported work.

**Customer Contracting**

* Oversee the review, drafting and negotiation of customer contracts, primarily relating to ocean transportation and international logistics services.
* Personally support or lead negotiations involving complex, high-value, strategically important or escalated contracts.
* Ensure adherence to applicable contracting policies, templates, playbooks, approval processes and risk parameters.
* Work closely with commercial, product and other legal teams to resolve contractual issues and support timely conclusion of customer agreements.

**Technology & AI**

* Manage a high-volume contracting environment, balancing turnaround expectations with appropriate legal quality and risk management.
* Continuously improve contracting processes, including workflows, templates, playbooks, escalation mechanisms and standard positions.
* Use data and operational insights to identify recurring negotiation issues, bottlenecks and opportunities for standardization or automation.

**Candidate Profile**
The successful candidate must have:
  
  

* A law degree and strong professional grounding in commercial and contract law.
* Fluent written and spoken English, with the ability to draft and negotiate sophisticated commercial agreements in English.
* Significant experience in commercial contract drafting, review and negotiation.
* Previous people-management experience, including direct responsibility for managing and developing professionals.
* Strong commercial judgment and the ability to distinguish material legal risks from issues that can reasonably be managed or accepted.
* Ability to operate effectively in a high-volume, fast-moving multinational environment, managing competing priorities without compromising critical legal standards and dealing with contracts or stakeholders across multiple jurisdictions.
* Demonstrated willingness and ability to use AI-enabled tools and technology as part of day-to-day legal work.
* A strong process and continuous-improvement mindset.

It is also highly desirable:
  
  

* Previous experience in the shipping, transportation or logistics industry, in particular:
* Ocean carriers;
* freight forwarders and NVOCCs; and
* airlines or air-cargo businesses.

Candidates from adjacent sectors may also be highly relevant where they have meaningful exposure to international transportation, trade or logistics, for example:
  
  

* marine insurance;
* commodities and international trading;
* conglomerates with substantial international logistics procurement activities; and
* general logistics and transportation businesses; and
* candidates without direct industry experience, but with strong commercial contracting expertise together and credible understanding of the shipping/logistics business.

We are looking for a leader who is:
  
  

* coaches a team member through a difficult negotiation rather than simply taking over the matter;
* make sound and pragmatic decisions when legal and commercial considerations compete;
* maintain quality and consistency across a large volume of negotiations;
* recognize which matters require escalation and which can be resolved by the team;
* communicate effectively with senior stakeholders across cultures and jurisdictions; and
* use technology and AI confidently while maintaining appropriate legal judgment and accountability.

We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with all legal requirements.

title: Senior Manager - Legal
description:
**Job Description: Senior Manager – Legal**
**Target Experience: 8–12 years**
**Job Summary**
As a Senior Legal professional, you will be responsible for managing and driving the legal function with a sharp focus on business enablement, compliance, and governance. This role requires an experienced legal professional with proven expertise in managing end-to-end complex contractual negotiations and closures, conducting due diligence, ensuring adherence to regulatory requirements, and safeguarding the company’s interests while enabling strategic growth.
  
  
The position demands a proactive leader who can anticipate risks, balance business objectives with legal safeguards, engage effectively with senior management, regulators, investors, and law firms, and ensure the highest standards of corporate governance in a listed environment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Contractual Drafting & Deal Negotiations
* Lead the closure of complex, high-value agreements, including strategic partnerships, technology collaborations, customer/vendor contracts, and IP licensing.
* Draft, review, and negotiate contracts with a focus on practical risk mitigation, business objectives, and long-term enforceability.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders (Sales, Procurement, Finance, Tech, R&D) to ensure business needs are achieved while safeguarding legal boundaries.
* Build contract negotiation strategies, clearly defining fallback positions, escalation mechanisms, and closure timelines.
* Maintain contract lifecycle management processes and ensure effective use of digital tools for execution and tracking.
* M&A Transactions & Due Diligence (DD)
* Lead and manage end-to-end legal due diligence (DD) for target acquisitions, strategic investments, and cross-border ventures.
* Draft, vet, and review comprehensive transaction documents related to M&A transactions, Joint Ventures, fund-raises, and shareholder agreements.
* Cross-Border Transactions & International Engagement
* Lead engagement with global law firms and external counsel on cross-border contracts and compliance across key global markets (US, EU, APAC).
* Drive foreign customer and vendor agreement closures, ensuring strict compliance with US laws, export controls, and international insurance frameworks.
* Oversee and navigate dispute resolution and arbitration in overseas jurisdictions where required.
* Litigation & Dispute Management
* Manage disputes, arbitrations, commercial claims, and litigation matters, coordinating overarching strategy with external law firms where needed.
* Manage end-to-end civil proceedings, including drafting and reviewing pleadings, plaints, written statements, affidavits, and appeals.
* Ensure strict adherence to procedural timelines, court processes, and evidentiary requirements under applicable civil procedure codes.
* Represent the company and coordinate effectively with external counsel during court hearings, mediation, and conciliation proceedings.
* Develop and execute litigation strategies to defend the company''s interests in commercial suits, recovery proceedings, and injunction matters.
* Handle regulatory notices, inquiries, or audits with proactive strategy preparation.
* Oversee civil, criminal, and IP-related litigations, ensuring cost-efficient and business-sensitive resolutions.
* Regulatory & Sectoral Compliance
* Ensure continuous compliance with Drone Rules, DGCA regulations, export control laws, Import-Export policies, insurance, and defense procurement compliances.
* Conduct legal research on various topics related to drone manufacturing, intellectual property, contract law, regulatory compliance, and various allied legislations related to the drone industry.
* Monitor global regulatory developments affecting drones and assess business impact.
* Build internal compliance frameworks, policies, and SOPs for proactive adherence to domestic and international laws.
* Risk & Strategic Advisory
* Provide clear legal inputs to senior leadership on business-related matters, cybersecurity/data privacy implications, and export transactions.
* Identify and assess legal, regulatory, contractual, and reputational risks; propose actionable mitigations.
* Act as a strategic partner, not just a legal reviewer, enabling senior management to take informed business decisions confidently.
* Training & Awareness
* Conduct internal training for leadership and teams on evolving industry-specific regulations, drone laws, corporate compliance, anti-bribery/anti-trust, and contract best practices.
* Build a compliance culture across functions through awareness programs and practical guidance.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Education: LLB/LLM from a recognized institution (Company Secretary qualification is a plus).
* Experience: 7–10 years of progressive legal experience, preferably within the manufacturing, tech, aerospace, or defense industries.
* Core Competencies:
* Strong expertise in contract negotiation and closure of complex business agreements.
* Proven track record in conducting legal due diligence (DD) for M&A and corporate transactions.
* Strong litigation and law firm coordination background, particularly in civil procedure and court processes.
* In-depth knowledge of corporate, securities, and compliance laws relevant to a listed company.
* Stakeholder Management: Demonstrated ability to partner effectively with CXOs, business teams, regulators, and investors.
* Environment: Proven ability to thrive in a fast-evolving, regulated, high-growth listed company environment.

**Key Traits for Success**

* Business-enabling mindset with strong negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
* Strategic thinker with hands-on problem-solving capability.
* Ability to independently lead legal closures under tight timelines.
* High levels of integrity, professional ethics, and ownership.
* Excellent communication, drafting, and presentation skills.

title: Company Secretary and Compliance Officer
description:
**Job Description: Company Secretary & Compliance Officer**
**Company:**
ideaForge Technology Limited
  
  
**Position:**
Company Secretary & Compliance Officer
  
  
**Experience:**
7–9 Years (In a Listed Company)
  
  
**Location:**
Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra
  
  
**Reporting To:**
Director-Finance / CFO
  
  
**About IdeaForge Technology Limited**
ideaForge is a pioneer and the undisputed market leader in the Indian unmanned aircraft systems (UAS) market. As a publicly listed technology enterprise, we design, develop, and manufacture world-class drones for defense, homeland security, and enterprise applications. We are seeking an experienced and legally astute Company Secretary & Compliance Officer to lead our corporate governance, ensure rigorous statutory compliance, and act as the principal liaison for regulatory authorities.
  
  
**Role Summary**
The Company Secretary and Compliance Officer will be the principal anchor for all corporate governance, statutory, and regulatory compliances under the Companies Act, 2013, SEBI Regulations, and other applicable corporate laws. The ideal candidate will have robust experience navigating the regulatory landscape of a publicly listed entity, managing automated compliance tools, executing capital market transactions (like QIPs), and advising the Board of Directors on strategic statutory matters and M&A activities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Board & Corporate Governance**

* Organize, convene, and seamlessly conduct Board Meetings, AGM & EGM, and various Board Committee meetings (Audit, Nomination & Remuneration, Stakeholders Relationship, etc.).
* Draft, finalize, and circulate notices, agendas, and comprehensive agenda notes for all corporate meetings in a timely manner. Record and maintain accurate minutes of meetings in strict adherence to Secretarial Standards.
* Formulate, implement, and review corporate governance policies and ensure the Board is consistently updated on recent legal and regulatory developments.

**SEBI & Stock Exchange Compliances**

* Act as the designated Compliance Officer under SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (LODR).
* Ensure timely execution of all periodic disclosures, event-based filings, and financial result publications to BSE and NSE.
* Insider Trading & Compliance Tools: Administer strict adherence to SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015. Take complete ownership of managing designated persons, trading window closures, and actively operating/managing advanced compliance platforms like Structured Digital Database (SDD) software, InsiderLens or similar insider trading management tools.
* ESOP Management: Oversee compliances related to SEBI (Share Based Employee Benefits and Sweat Equity) Regulations, 2021. This includes end-to-end ESOP compliance management and tracking seamlessly integrated within the ESOP tool, ensuring accurate records of grants, vesting, and exercises.
* Pledge Management: Handle the entire lifecycle of creation, modification, registration, and removal/release of pledges on shares with Depository Participants (DPs), ensuring timely and accurate disclosures under SEBI SAST and related regulations.
* Manage investor relations, address shareholder grievances, and coordinate seamlessly with the Registrar and Share Transfer Agent (RTA) and depositories (NSDL/CDSL).

**Corporate Actions, M&A & Fund Raising**

* Fund Raising & QIP Compliances: Lead and execute the end-to-end secretarial, SEBI, and stock exchange compliances for capital market transactions, including Qualified Institutions Placements (QIP), Preferential Allotments, Rights Issues, and other fund-raising avenues.
* M&A Support & Due Diligence: Provide robust secretarial and legal support during Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A), corporate restructuring, and strategic tie-ups.
* Investment/Divestment Execution: Actively manage and assist in comprehensive legal, financial, and secretarial Due Diligence exercises during foreign investments (FDI/ODI), joint ventures, and divestments. Coordinate closely with external legal counsels, investors, and regulatory bodies to ensure smooth transaction closures.

**Statutory & Regulatory Compliances**

* Ensure absolute compliance with the Companies Act, 2013, and the rules framed thereunder.
* File all necessary e-forms, returns, and applications with the Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) / Registrar of Companies (RoC).
* Manage the preparation and finalization of the Annual Report, including the Board’s Report, Corporate Governance Report, and Business Responsibility and Sustainability Report (BRSR).
* Liaise and coordinate with external regulatory bodies, including SEBI, Stock Exchanges, MCA, and RBI (specifically regarding FEMA guidelines for foreign investments and divestments).
* Work closely with internal auditors, statutory auditors, and secretarial auditors to facilitate seamless audits and effectively resolve any compliance observations.

**Other Assignment:**

* Track, vetting and get approved the insurance & risk mitigation policies of the Company from time to time.
* Any other miscellaneous tasks and assignment

**Qualifications & Requirements**

* Professional Qualification & Experience: Must be a qualified Company Secretary and an Associate/Fellow Member of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI) with 7 to 9 years of post-qualification experience, with a mandatory and substantial stint working independently or in a senior capacity within the secretarial department of a publicly listed company.
* Strategic Experience: Proven, hands-on experience in handling QIPs, fund-raising, M&A support, and conducting investment-related due diligence is highly desirable and will be a distinct advantage.
* Technical Expertise: Exceptional command over the Companies Act, 2013, SEBI LODR, SEBI PIT, SEBI SAST, FEMA regulations, and depository operations. Demonstrated high proficiency in the interpretation of complex laws, regulatory frameworks, and case laws. Ability to translate statutory jargon into actionable, business-aligned advisory for the management.
* Communication & Stakeholder Management: Impeccable written and verbal English communication skills. Proven track record of interacting with Promoters, Board of Directors, investors, and external regulatory authorities with confidence and maturity.
* Technology & Tools Proficiency: Highly proficient with MCA21, stock exchange filing portals (BSE Listing Centre, NSE NEAPS), ERP tools, and specialized compliance automation tools (SDD systems, InsiderLens, etc.).

description:
**About The Role And Team**
Working on Uber’s Government Affairs and Public Policy team means moving beyond traditional corporate relations to become a true advocate for change. You will act as the bridge between our market-leading technology and the policymakers, regulators, and third-party stakeholders who shape the future of urban mobility. In this role, you aren’t just managing a brand; you are navigating complex political landscapes to unlock the full potential of our services for earners, riders, and cities.
  
  
The environment is fast-paced, often heated, and highly ambiguous. You will lead proactive campaigns to challenge entrenched interests and outdated regulations, requiring a unique blend of intellectual firepower and resilient grit. If you are a self-starter who thrives when the stakes are high and the answers aren’t predefined, this is where you can do career-defining work that has a tangible impact on how the real world moves.
  
  
**What The Candidate Will Do**

* Develop and execute end-to-end engagement strategies for public policy issues, managing relationships with governments, academics, and third parties.
* Navigate shifting regulatory frameworks and internal complexities to build the positive case for change, ensuring Uber's model is understood and supported.
* Collaborate across operations, legal, tax, and communications to provide strategic advice that balances business goals with local political realities.
* Lead proactive advocacy campaigns involving diverse stakeholders to demonstrate better alternatives to the status quo, even in highly contested environments.
* Represent Uber externally in public speaking engagements and direct negotiations with national and local politicians.
* Stay ahead of industry trends and research to advise the business on corporate strategies that respond to evolving government expectations and global policy directions.

**What The Candidate Will Need**

* 5+ years of experience in public policy, government affairs, or regulatory advocacy within a corporate or government setting.
* Professional proficiency in English and local language
* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Public Policy, Government, Economics, Law, or a related field.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in the technology sector or working with disruptive business models.
* Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders and build trust in complex, cross-functional environments.
* Strong analytical capabilities to identify policy trends and assess their business impact.
* Resilience and adaptability to remain calm and effective under significant public and political pressure.

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you.

Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing this form.

5 - 10 years of relevant experience

title: Counsel Special Law / Senior Counsel Special Law
description:

Our offerings are engineered to enhance the reliability, durability, and efficiency of power networks, enabling resilient and sustainable operations. Our product portfolio covers Power Transmission, Power Generation and Industries.

Siemens Energy India Limited aims to be a pure play energy company along the energy technology and service value chain with a comprehensive and differentiated product portfolio of solutions and services. Further, we aim to be one of the valued energy technology companies supporting its customers in transitioning to a more sustainable world through sustainable energy systems.

This position in Siemens Energy India Limited is responsible for providing Company Secretarial support to the Siemens Energy business.

**Your new role – challenging and future-oriented**

Come, Change the future with us!

In your primary role, you will be responsible for the following:

* You will ensure compliance with all statutory and regulatory compliances under corporate laws e.g. Companies Act, various SEBI Regulations (including but not limited to Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements, Prohibition of Insider Trading, Takeover code, FEMA etc.)
* You should have a sound knowledge of Directors, Committees & Shareholders Meetings – including drafting of notices, agenda and minutes and should also be familiar in handling tools / automation in the secretarial arena – e.g. board portal, legal compliances, secretarial matters and insider trading.
* You should have experience in handling M&A matters, special projects, carveouts etc., cross border compliances with respect to permanent establishments, RBI compliances such as filing of form FCGPR, FCTRS, FLA etc.
* You should have a sound knowledge of Related Party Transactions and provide secretarial support and advice to business and various functions.
* You will be required to co-ordinate with various functions and business to prepare the Annual Report which will also include drafting of relevant modules and regulatory assessment regarding its accuracy and completeness.
* You will have to review Secretarial Compliances, formulation of checklists for various secretarial activities and ensure adherence thereto.
* You will have to prepare and maintain various statutory registers required to be maintained by the Company and also the documents related to Directors such as Disclosures from Directors, updation of KYC and providing any other support to the Directors.
* You will have to ensure Secretarial compliances emanating from Company’s investment in subsidiary / associates, if any.
* You will have to deal with the Auditors in completing Corporate Governance Audit, Secretarial Audit and Secretarial Compliance Report related formalities.
* You should be a master in resolving shareholders’ queries, IEPF/Unclaimed Suspense Account etc. related compliances, co-ordination with Registrar and Share Transfer Agents lawyers and regulatory authorities.
* You should have a sound knowledge of filings with Registrar of Companies and ensure timely filing of forms with ROC.
* Any other secretarial support/ compliances as may be required from time to time.

Additionally, your role would also from time to time include the following:

* You will have to provide trainings to the employees on Insider Trading Regulations and Disclosure of Material Events.
* You should be research oriented and update the Secretarial Team on various amendments in the Corporate Laws and SEBI Regulations from time to time.
* You will guide the business and project teams on secretarial matters to ensure compliance with applicable laws and regulations.
* You will have to provide timely secretarial support to various departments and meet the business/functional expectations.

**We don’t need superheroes, just super minds with a winning attitude!**

Desired Qualifications & Traits

* You are a Company Secretary (Member of ICSI) having sound knowledge of Companies Act, Securities Laws, Listing Regulations, Foreign Exchange Laws, Stamp Act etc. with at least 5 to 10 years (post membership qualification) experience of working with cross-functional and cross-business teams preferably in a large equity listed company having a set of group companies. Additional qualification – Law graduate (LL.B.) will be an added advantage.

* You will be our preferred candidate if you have good (spoken and written) communication skills, drafting and presentation skills as well as a problem-solving and solution-oriented approach with a dedicated, result oriented, team player attitude. You should have a professional, structured and organized approach to your work and an ability to handle critical topics in strict timeframes. You should have a growth mindset with an interest and aptitude for knowledge sharing with legal, compliance, company secretarial and business colleagues across the organisation.

  

Make your mark in the cool & exciting world at Siemens Energy!

This role is based in Airoli, Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra.

Last but not the least, we're dedicated to equality and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us craft tomorrow.

title: Legal Head
description:
West Avenue Realty, a fast-growing luxury real estate development company, is looking for an experienced and commercially driven **Head – Legal** to lead its legal function, manage regulatory and statutory matters, oversee property transactions and safeguard the company's legal interests across its real estate projects.

The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in real estate law, corporate law, property due diligence, litigation and project-related legal documentation.

Key Responsibilities

* **Legal Drafting & Documentation:** Draft, review and negotiate Joint Development Agreements (JDAs), MoUs, Development Agreements, Sale Deeds, Conveyance Deeds, Agreements for Sale, contracts and other legal documents.
* **Land Acquisition & Due Diligence:** Lead legal due diligence, title verification, property searches and documentation for land acquisitions and real estate development projects.
* **Litigation Management:** Oversee ongoing litigation, cheque bounce matters under the Negotiable Instruments Act (NI Act), dispute resolution and coordination with external advocates and legal consultants.
* **Corporate & Regulatory Compliance:** Advise on corporate legal matters, statutory compliances, regulatory requirements and applicable real estate laws, including RERA.
* **Project Financing:** Coordinate with banks, financial institutions and lenders for legal documentation, financing agreements, security creation and related transactions.
* **Legal Advisory:** Work closely with the leadership team on legal strategy, commercial negotiations, contractual obligations and risk mitigation.
* **MIS & Reporting:** Maintain litigation trackers, legal documentation records and project-wise legal MIS, ensuring timely updates and reporting to management.
* **Risk Management:** Identify potential legal risks, recommend corrective measures and ensure the company's legal interests are protected across all business operations.

What We're Looking For

* LLB/LLM from a recognised university.
* Minimum **8+ years of relevant experience** in real estate and corporate law.
* **Prior experience in the real estate or property development industry is mandatory.**
* Strong expertise in property title verification, land acquisition and legal due diligence.
* Proven experience in drafting and negotiating complex real estate and corporate agreements.
* Sound knowledge of RERA, Companies Act, Contract Act, Transfer of Property Act and other applicable laws.
* Experience in handling litigation, NI Act matters and coordinating with external legal counsels.
* Strong negotiation, analytical, communication and leadership skills.
* A commercially minded professional with the ability to independently manage legal matters in a fast-paced real estate development environment.

**About the Company**

Easebuzz is India’s one of the first and foremost end-to-end SAAS enabled payments platform. We are a SaaS-unifying payment aggregation platform interconnecting banks, networks, acquirers and processors for merchant payments. We create value by enabling seamless workflows which help merchant to have a better collection efficiency. Our vision is to verticalize payments with industry

specific solutions that can increase the online GDP of India. We’ve been building on business value for our merchants since 2014 and are trusted by more than 1.5 lacs merchant base . We are unique in terms of our offering to our merchants and our excitement lies in building together where we all can thrive for future.

Headquartered in Pune, we also have a presence in Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata, Bengaluru, and Gurugram.

**Role Overview**

Easebuzz is looking for an experienced Head of Compliance to oversee regulatory compliance across its payment businesses, including Payment Aggregator (PA), Payment Gateway (PG), BBPS, and PACB-related operations. The role will ensure adherence to applicable RBI regulations, NPCI/NBBL guidelines, statutory requirements, and internal compliance policies. The Head of Compliance will work closely with business, operations, technology, finance, legal, audit, and the separate Risk Management function.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Regulatory Compliance:**
  Ensure adherence to applicable RBI directions, payment system regulations, NPCI/NBBL guidelines, and other statutory requirements.

  Oversee regulatory requirements relating to merchant onboarding, KYC/KYB, escrow accounts, settlements, refunds, chargebacks, data security, and applicable technology controls.
* **BBPS Compliance:**
  Ensure compliance with applicable BBPS guidelines, biller onboarding requirements, transaction processing, settlements, reconciliation, audits, and regulatory reporting.
* **Cross-Border Compliance:**
  Oversee applicable cross-border payment regulations, PA-CB requirements, FEMA obligations, transaction documentation, and authorised dealer bank requirements, as relevant.
* **Regulatory Reporting:**

* **Compliance Monitoring:**
  Conduct periodic compliance reviews, identify gaps, implement corrective actions, and ensure regulatory requirements are embedded in business processes.
* **Policies and Training:**
  Develop compliance policies, SOPs, and employee awareness programmes.
* **Cross-Functional Coordination:**
  Work with the Risk Management Head and other functional heads while maintaining clear ownership of regulatory compliance responsibilities.

**Key Requirements**

* CA, CS, LLB, MBA ,or a relevant postgraduate qualification.
* 10–15+ years of experience in regulatory compliance within fintech, banking, digital payments, PA/PG, or financial services.
* Strong knowledge of RBI regulations, PA/PG compliance, BBPS/NBBL guidelines, and applicable cross-border payment regulations.
* Experience handling regulatory audits, inspections, reporting, compliance monitoring, and remediation.
* Strong stakeholder management, analytical, communication, and team leadership skills.

Full Time

description:
**Role level: Associate**

**Preferred industry background: Telecom, technology, shared services, consulting, or regulated environments**

**Stakeholder coverage: India-based team supporting US, UK and global business stakeholders**

**Work schedule: Comfortable supporting UK shift and international stakeholder calls**

**Role Overview:**

* We are seeking an experienced Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) professional to manage and execute activities across the complete third-party lifecycle.
* The role will cover vendor onboarding, inherent and residual risk assessments, due diligence, compliance monitoring, remediation tracking, exception management and management reporting.
* The candidate should be able to work independently with vendors, internal business owners and global stakeholders, with strong preference for prior exposure to telecom, technology or large vendor ecosystems.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Manage end-to-end TPRM activities across vendor onboarding, risk classification, due diligence, periodic reassessment, ongoing monitoring and exit or termination support.
* Conduct and review inherent and residual risk assessments for third parties, including documentation of risk rationale, risk ratings, control gaps and approvals.
* Perform due diligence across information security, cybersecurity, privacy, business continuity, disaster recovery, financial, operational, regulatory, compliance and concentration risk domains.
* Review vendor questionnaires, evidence, certifications, attestations, policies, audit reports and other supporting documentation to identify control gaps and follow-up actions.
* Assess third-party compliance against contractual, regulatory, organizational and client-specific requirements, including SOW or contract clauses where applicable.
* Track remediation actions, exceptions, overdue items and open risks to closure, while maintaining clear action owners, target dates and escalation paths.
* Support ongoing monitoring and periodic reassessment of third parties based on risk tiering, criticality, service dependency and materiality.
* Prepare TPRM dashboards, MIS packs and management reports covering assessment status, key risks, overdue actions, SLA adherence and remediation progress.
* Coordinate with procurement, legal, information security, privacy, business continuity, finance, compliance and business teams to support timely completion of assessments.
* Contribute to process improvements, template enhancements, quality checks and standard operating procedures for TPRM execution.

**Required Skills and Knowledge:**

* Strong understanding of TPRM, Vendor Risk Management, Supplier Risk and third-party lifecycle concepts.
* Good working knowledge of key vendor risk domains: information security, cybersecurity, data privacy, business continuity and disaster recovery, financial risk, regulatory and compliance risk, operational risk and concentration or dependency risk.
* Ability to review vendor risk documentation, interpret evidence, identify control gaps and articulate risk impact in a clear and business-friendly manner.
* Understanding of risk assessment methods, control testing concepts, risk scoring, risk ratings and issue management workflows.
* Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills for data analysis, dashboards, MIS reporting, and senior management updates.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with proven ability to interact confidently with vendors, internal stakeholders and US, UK or other global teams.
* Strong stakeholder management, follow-up discipline, and ability to manage multiple assessments simultaneously without compromising quality.
* High attention to detail and comfort working within defined SLAs, quality standards and governance expectations.

**Preferred**
**Experience**
:

* Experience in telecom, technology, consulting, shared services, or other vendor-intensive environments.
* Exposure global stakeholder management, preferably with US or UK business teams.
* Experience using TPRM, GRC, procurement, case management, or workflow tools.
* Working knowledge of common frameworks and standards such as ISO 27001, SOC reports, NIST, GDPR, privacy regulations, business continuity standards or other relevant control frameworks.
* Experience reviewing contracts, SOWs, risk clauses, service criticality, subcontracting, cross-border data transfer or termination-related risk considerations.

title: Manager -Legal & Compliance
description:
**About Arbolus**

Arbolus is the next-generation customer diligence platform, redefining how private equity investors and consultants access real, actionable and differentiated customer insight on SaaS and technology companies.

At the core of our platform is the world's largest database of attributable B2B customer reviews, giving investment and origination teams direct access to unique customer sentiment and a true strategic advantage to run faster, more confident diligence on the world's leading software assets.

Since 2018, we've redefined the traditional expert network model with a tech-driven approach that delivers high-impact insight at the speed of modern dealmaking. Arbolus stands out through its unique database of customer reviews accessible via the Arbolus Customer Review Library, Canopy, our market-first automated Q&A tool, and our unmatched standard of client service — because great technology should always be backed by great people.

Headquartered in London, Arbolus is a venture-backed scale-up with employees across four global hubs, including Barcelona, Costa Rica and Gurgaon. Following a $20M Series B, we are rapidly expanding our U.S. presence as we execute our mission: to digitize human knowledge and make it instantly accessible and actionable.

**About the role**

We are seeking a Manager – Legal & Compliance to join our team, with a primary focus on managing and overseeing client-specific compliance requirements across global business accounts. The role will be responsible for ensuring that client contractual obligations, compliance standards, policies, and regulatory requirements are effectively understood, implemented, monitored, and adhered to throughout the client engagement lifecycle.

This is a hands-on, operational role involving close collaboration with Commercial, Professional Services, Operations, and other internal stakeholders to ensure compliance with client requirements, manage client audits and assessments, oversee compliance documentation, address client queries, and drive timely closure of compliance gaps and remediation actions.

In addition to client compliance management, the role will oversee contract lifecycle management, support legal and regulatory matters, and contribute to the protection of the organization's intellectual property. The ideal candidate should combine strong legal and contractual knowledge with practical experience in managing client compliance obligations and translating contractual commitments into effective operational controls.

Key responsibilities

### **Client Compliance & Operational Support**

* Take ownership of client-specific compliance requirements and ensure their effective implementation across the organization.
* Review, interpret, and operationalize client contracts, compliance policies, codes of conduct, security requirements, and other contractual obligations.
* Manage client onboarding compliance, including due diligence, compliance documentation, assessments, certifications, and required approvals.
* Ensure internal teams adhere to client-specific policies, contractual commitments, applicable regulatory requirements, and agreed operational standards.
* Work closely with Commercial, Professional Services, Operations and other relevant teams to implement and monitor client-specific compliance controls.
* Manage client compliance questionnaires, vendor assessments, due diligence requests, audits, and periodic compliance reviews.
* Monitor compliance obligations across active client engagements and proactively identify gaps, risks, and areas requiring corrective action.
* Ensure that compliance commitments made during client onboarding and contract negotiations are effectively implemented and sustained throughout the engagement.

### **Contract Management, IP & Execution**

* Own the end-to-end global contract lifecycle, including intake, drafting, review, negotiation support, internal approvals, execution, storage, amendments, and renewals.
* Review, draft, and manage client agreements, including Master Services Agreements (MSAs), Statements of Work (SOWs), Service Agreements, NDAs, and other commercial contracts.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders and client legal teams to negotiate contractual terms and resolve legal and commercial deviations.
* Support business teams in partnership agreements, vendor contracts, and client service agreements.
* Review contractual clauses relating to liability, indemnification, confidentiality, termination, warranties, payment terms, and service-level obligations.
* Maintain and update contract templates, standard clauses, playbooks, and approval workflows to streamline contract execution.
* Actively contribute to building, managing, and protecting the organization's intellectual property (IP) portfolio.
* Identify potential IP risks, infringements, or violations and coordinate with relevant teams to ensure timely mitigation.

### **3. Legal, Data Privacy & Regulatory Support**

* Ensure compliance with applicable laws, data protection regulations, and confidentiality requirements.
* Review privacy clauses, data processing agreements, and information-sharing arrangements.
* Develop and maintain legal policies, compliance procedures, and standard documentation.
* Provide legal support to internal teams on contracts, client requirements, disputes, and regulatory matters.
* Coordinate with external counsel and support legal notices, audits, and compliance training.

Requirements to succeed in this role

* Bachelor’s degree in Law, Business Administration, or related field.
* 6–8 years of experience in contract management, legal operations, or corporate legal support.
* Strong background in client compliances ,contract drafting and contract lifecycle management.
* Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail.
* Excellent communication skills
* Exposure working with global teams would be greatly appreciated.

What we offer

* Annual performance-based bonus on top of your base salary
* 25 days of paid time off per year, plus all local bank holidays
* Comprehensive health insurance and gym membership
* Top-notch equipment to keep your work efficient and smooth
* Free coffee, tea, snacks and lunch to keep your energy up through the day
* Regular social activities run by our local Social Committees

**EY- Cyber Risk Compliance and Resilience –TPCRM Senior**
As part of our EY Cyber Risk and Compliance Consulting (CRCR) team, you will contribute technically to Cyber Security client engagements and internal projects. description:
For a **Reputed Company Into Operation & Maintenance - Oil & Gas Industry** - @ Ahmedababd

**Requirement -**GST Manager - The individual functions as the primary bridge between the company’s management, its shareholders, and regulatory authorities.:

**Job description:**

* **GST Compliance & Filings:** Prepare, review, and file monthly and annual returns (GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-9, and GSTR-9C) within statutory deadlines.
* **Reconciliation:** Perform regular matching and reconciliation of books of accounts with GSTR-2A/2B data, Input Tax Credit (ITC) tracking, and e-invoice/e-way bill records.
* **Litigation & Notices:** Handle departmental audits, scrutiny, investigations, and assessments. Draft replies to Show Cause Notices (SCNs), demand orders, and prepare appeals.
* **Advisory & Research:** Analyze GST laws, notifications, circulars, and case laws to advise management or clients on tax impact, risk mitigation, and cost optimization.
* **ERP & Accounting Integration:** Manage division- or project-wise GST accounting entries, General Ledger (GL) reconciliations (including Reverse Charge Mechanism or RCM ledgers), and MIS reporting in systems like SAP or Tally.
* **Audit & Team Support:** Provide data for statutory, cost, and tax audits, and mentor junior team members.
* The **GST Manager (Appeals & Litigation)** will act as the core specialist managing high-stakes tax disputes, audits, and judicial interventions. This role focuses on **drafting legal replies, filing appeals, and executing representation strategies** across various appellate levels, with a specific focus on the **Goods and Services Tax Appellate Tribunal (GSTAT)**.Key Responsibilities
* **Tribunal & Appellate Representation:** Act as the primary interface for legal proceedings. Prepare cases, compile paper books, and represent the organization/clients before the **GST Appellate Tribunal (GSTAT)**, Joint Commissioners (Appeals), and Commissioner (Appeals).

Qualifications & Education

* **Professional Certifications:** Inter Chartered Accountant ( Inter CA) or a Bachelor of Laws (LLB / Corporate Law) is **highly preferred** for this litigation-focused track.
* **Experience:** Minimum **5 to 8 years** of dedicated experience in Indirect Tax litigation, with a proven track record of handling independent appeal filings and tribunal matters.

Required Skills & Tools

* **Judicial & Legal Knowledge:** Deep expertise in the GST Act, rules, constitutional provisions, and procedural laws governing the GSTAT. Strong capability in leveraging case law research tools (e.g., Taxmann, SCC Online).
* **Advocacy & Drafting:** Exceptional legal drafting capabilities and oral arguments skills for hearings.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Calm under pressure, with the ability to handle aggressive departmental actions and communicate technical legal risks to executive board members.
* **Tribunal & Appellate Representation:** Act as the primary interface for legal proceedings. Prepare cases, compile paper books, and represent the organization/clients before the **GST Appellate Tribunal (GSTAT)**, Joint Commissioners (Appeals), and Commissioner (Appeals).
* **Litigation Strategy:** Analyze complex tax disputes, assess legal risks, and formulate defense strategies for Show Cause Notices (SCNs), demand orders, and adverse audit findings.
* **Drafting & Documentation:** Draft highly technical grounds of appeal, cross-objections, rejoinders, condonation of delay applications, and legal submissions for the Tribunal and High Court writ petitions (in coordination with legal counsel).

* **Software & Systems:** Proficiency in ERP platforms (SAP, Tally Prime) and the official GSTN portal.
