title: Senior AI / Python Engineer - Innominds Software Pvt Ltd - Bangalore
description:
Job Title: Senior AI / Python Engineer @ Innominds Experience: 6-12 Years 
 Location: Bangalore Work Mode - Hybrid Senior AI / Python Engineer Enterprise Data Platform (EDP) Role Summary We are hiring a Senior AI / Python Engineer for one of the AI Initiative, which delivers an enterprise MCP (Model Context Protocol) platform connecting ChatGPT Enterprise to governed data in Databricks Unity Catalog. You will design and build core platform components, including the orchestration layer, account and entity resolution, and observability. You will also enhance the MCP server, engineer and evaluate prompts and agent instructions, enable new features, and own upgrades, releases, and production quality. Key Responsibilities Platform development Design and build the multi-agent orchestration layer: intent classification, semantic routing (embedding similarity with LLM fallback), agent handoffs, and clarification flows. Build and evolve account and entity resolution: alias indexes, fuzzy and semantic matching, batch index publishing with versioned swaps, and shadow-to-enforce rollouts, delivered as versioned, tested Python packages. Enhance the MCP server (FastMCP): tools, agents, and new features from requirements through release. Write design documents before coding and document trade-offs across accuracy, latency, and cost. Prompt engineering and agent configuration Develop and refine prompts, agent instructions, tool descriptions, and semantic examples; reduce hallucination and tool-selection errors. Onboard and maintain agents: configuration, vector stores and recipe files, retrieval tuning, and SQL logic against Databricks Unity Catalog. Observability, evaluation, and quality Instrument agents and tools with Langfuse (or equivalent) tracing; track prompt versions, token cost, latency, and quality per agent. Maintain evaluation suites (e.g., Promptfoo) with LLM-as-judge grading; add regression tests for every prompt or agent change and gate releases on the results. Own the audit and activity pipeline (CloudWatch, S3, Databricks); use logs, traces, and user feedback to improve routing, prompts, and retrieval. Platform lifecycle and operations Plan and run dependency upgrades (OpenAI Agents SDK, openai, pydantic, FastMCP): breaking-change analysis, compatibility testing, phased rollout, and rollback. Manage CI/CD (GitHub Actions), nonprod-to-prod promotion, configuration and secrets, and Kubernetes (EKS) rollouts. Integrate external services and MCPs (e.g., Salesforce/MuleSoft, APISIX-based MCPs). Triage and resolve production issues; write and maintain runbooks. Scale, security, and governance Optimize performance and cost: concurrency, rate limiting, connection pooling, Redis caching, retries and timeouts, model selection, token usage, and multi-pod consistency. Implement enterprise controls: OAuth (Azure AD) with user impersonation (OBO), row-level security compatibility, input validation, prompt-injection defenses, PII handling, and audit logging. Collaboration Work with the OpenAI team, AWS/EKS infrastructure, security owners, and business users. Use AI-assisted development and review tools while owning design decisions and verifying every change with tests. Required Qualifications 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong Python (3.10+): async programming, typing, packaging, and testing (pytest). Hands-on experience building LLM applications: prompt engineering, tool/function calling, and multi-agent or orchestration design. Proven ownership of a production system component (e.g., orchestration, routing, matching, or search) from design through operations. Experience with entity matching, NLP, or retrieval (fuzzy matching, embeddings, RAG). API and security fundamentals: REST, OAuth 2.0 / OIDC. Working knowledge of AWS (EKS, S3, CloudWatch, DynamoDB, Redis/ElastiCache), Docker, and Kubernetes. Strong SQL and a cloud data platform (Databricks or similar), including notebooks/PySpark. Git and CI/CD (GitHub Actions); track record of managing breaking dependency upgrades safely. Clear written and verbal communication; able to work independently in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment. Preferred Qualifications Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP), FastMCP, OpenAI Agents SDK, or comparable agent frameworks (LangChain / LangGraph). Experience with LLM observability and evaluation tools (Langfuse, OpenTelemetry, Promptfoo). Familiarity with Databricks Unity Catalog governance, row/column-level security, and metric views or semantic layers. Background in enterprise security: Azure AD / Entra ID, identity propagation, secrets management. Experience optimizing cost and latency of LLM workloads. Life sciences, commercial, or enterprise data domain experience. Technology Stack Python 3.11 • FastMCP • OpenAI Agents SDK / ChatGPT Enterprise • Databricks Unity Catalog • AWS (EKS, CloudWatch, S3, DynamoDB, Redis, ALB, WAF) • Azure AD OAuth • Langfuse • Promptfoo • GitHub Actions • Docker / Kubernetes Why Innominds? A note for those who want more than just a job ISV-First DNA Innominds was purpose-built for the ISV ecosystem. We speak the language of product engineering, SaaS velocity, and platform scale not generic IT services. Global Reach, Startup Soul With 2,500+ engineers across the US, India, and EMEA, we combine enterprise delivery muscle with the agility and ownership culture of a growth-stage company. Cutting-Edge Work From AI/ML and cloud-native platforms to embedded security and digital transformation ,you will work on whats next, not what’s left. Real Career Ownership We believe in promoting from within. Your KPIs here translate into a growth trajectory —Delivery Director, AVP, or beyond. You own your arc. Customer Intimacy at Scale You will have direct access to senior customer leadership — not filtered through layers. Real relationships, real impact, real accountability. Competitive Rewards Market-leading compensation, performance bonuses. If you believe delivery is an art and customer trust is currency, Innominds is your stage.

title: Systems and Infrastructure Engineer III
description:
Position Summary... What youll do... Position Summary: As a Store Reliability Operations Engineer within the Global Technology Platforms (GTP) CCC team you will work with other CCC, TDO, SRE, DevOps and Engineering practitioners to pro-actively maintain mission-critical infrastructure, cloud platforms, micro-services, tools, and processes that will ensure highest levels of availability and reliability across our Global Technology platforms. 
 About the team CCC team also known as Command and Control Center forms the nerve center of Walmart . The team works across multiple technology groups to ensure the stability and reliability of the companys critical e-commerce infrastructure. The team functions by collaborating internally with TDO (Technical duty officers and SRE (Site reliability engineering) for faster detection and mitigation of incidents The team is aimed at proactively maintaining mission critical infrastructure, cloud platforms, micro services, tools and processes to ensure highest levels of availability and reliability across the Global technology platforms. CCC plays a important role in leading all major incident responses and orchestrating for faster mitigation. 
 What You ll Do Youre right for the job if you are comfortable leading our major incident response team as part of a technical team of engineer s laser focused on restoring service across complex distributed systems. Youll excel if you have enthusiasm for digging deep, and a flare for sharp technical communication, prioritization and organization. You will work directly with our SRE, Engineering and DevOps teams to support our next generation always up cloud-based e-commerce platforms. The CCC Site Reliability Operations Engineer is responsible for pro-actively monitoring, detecting and resolving site issues before they become customer and availability impacting. Technically you will understand the full end to end stack and use this knowledge to detect errors/failures and take corrective action to mitigate. During a major incident, you will draw on your technical skills and knowledge to triage and troubleshoot, differentiating between symptom and cause, to help restore impacting issues. Your ability to continuously challenge yourself and develop a strong network within your peer group will see you exceed in this role. Our goal is to protect the customer experience and deliver outstanding levels of availability. 
 What You ll bring Xmatters workflow integration with scalability, resiliency and performance Assist Walmart Store/Distribution Center associate s in their day-to-day issues related to store functions. Support through Call functioning for internal escalations. Follow the SOP for troubleshooting and get resolutions for issues reported by Store operations team. Must be able to do multitasking whenever needed. Flexible in Shift Support hours Expert level understanding of incident management processes and procedures. Calm under pressure when participating in major incident response. Deep technical understanding of core infrastructure, cloud services, platforms and micro-services. Ability to understand and capture key data from logs at an expert level. Ability to understand traffics flows and key dependencies between services. Ability to effectively triage - be able to detect and determine symptom vs cause. Detect and quantify impact. Expert level troubleshooting skills using a diverse set of tools and methods Analyze trends to pro-actively prevent incidents. Focus on immediate restoration vs root cause. Research and recommend alternative actions for incident resolution - Develop procedures and documentation to support this. Create and maintain procedural documentation. Identify and drive continuous improvement efforts to reduce waste (eliminate, automate or streamline). Absorb knowledge and understand complex distributed systems - ability to share and impart this knowledge into your peer group and beyond. Build tools to improve visibility, pro-actively detect issues and restore system availability. Develop automation and self-healing with DevOps, Engineering and SRE partners. Strong focus on collecting and inferring metrics. Clear communication skills. Ability to contribute to multiple incidents at any given time. Analyze systems and make recommendations to prevent possible problems. Takes lead on issue resolution activities using knowledge of complex and company-wide systems. Scripting and software development to automate and help enhance existing solutions. Experience owning, developing and evangelizing a product. Ability to gather requirements and build solutions into a product. Evangelize operational excellence 
 Additional responsibilities may include: Actively provide data for and participate in root cause analysis. Define CCC onboarding process and ensure they are adhered to when accepting new systems into service. Share knowledge globally between CCC teams. Analyze systems and make recommendations to prevent possible incidents. Strive for continuous improvement and make recommendations based on CCC process. Act as a technical focal point for the CCC team. Transition observability projects in the command centre for better visibility. Other duties and responsibilities as assigned. 
 Technical qualifications: Candidate should have overall work experience of 3 to 4 years in IT operations domain with the following technical expertise. Experience building and scaling distributed, highly available systems Experience developing applications for a cloud environment such as Google Cloud Platform or Microsoft Azure Experience with frameworks/tools such as GIT, xMatters workflow integration, Service Now Integration etc Comfortable building metrics, monitoring, and alerting for micro-services 4+ years in an infrastructure, systems, engineering or development environment delivering operational excellence to highly complex distributed systems. Bachelors Degree in Computer Science or a related field, or relevant work experience. Strong and demonstrable incident management skills with relevant experience in an enterprise organization. 3+ Years of relevant experience on Major Incident Management with ITIL4 Certification Experience and exposure working is a 24/7 operations support environment. Methodical and systematic problem-solving approach, combined with a solid awareness of ownership, initiative and drive. Experience investigating, analyzing and troubleshooting large scale enterprise systems. Networking knowledge and understanding of network concepts, such as different protocols (TCP/IP, UDP, ICMP, etc.), MAC addresses, IP packets, DNS, OSI layers, and load balancing). Programming experience in one or more of the following languages: Go, Java, Python, Ruby, Shell. Experience administering Unix/Linux in a production environment. Understanding of Unix/Linux systems from kernel to shell and beyond, taking in system libraries, file systems, and client-server protocols along the way. Experience working with and developing enterprise monitoring/tooling solutions like Grafana, Kibana, Splunk, Graphite, Nagios, New Relic and DynaTrace. Working knowledge of one or more cloud technologies such as AZURE, GCP and OpenStack. Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines. About Walmart Global Tech

title: Senior Systems Administrator, Billing Systems
description:
Job Summary Billing infrastructure is revenue infrastructure. In a business running an enterprise sales-led motion and a product-led self-serve motion in parallel, the configuration quality of that stack directly determines what Finance can close cleanly, what customers are billed accurately, and how much revenue is recovered when payments fail. We\'re hiring a systems administrator who treats it that way. The Senior Systems Administrator, Billing Systems is the senior platform expert across Quickbase\'s billing stack and a trusted operational partner to Finance, RevOps, and Product Engineering. This role owns day-to-day administration of and production support across the billing systems landscape in a scaled, dual-motion SaaS environment, currently anchored on BillingPlatform and Stripe, with the platform landscape expected to evolve. As the senior-most administrator on the team, this role also carries a higher bar for platform strategy, complex problem-solving, and mentorship of other billing systems administrators. Title : Sr Systems Administrator, Billing Systems Reporting to : Sr Manager, Systems Engineering Location : Bangalore, India Department : Enterprise Business Systems Responsibilities Billing Systems Administration Own multiple billing platform administration for both our product-led self-serve motion and sales-led enterprise grade invoicing and billing, including: payment methods, product and pricing catalog, subscription lifecycle, webhook monitoring, and dispute handling Maintain pricing configurations, billing templates, and subscription structures as directed by Finance and RevOps. When the price book changes, Billing Systems reflects it cleanly Own dunning and revenue recovery configuration: retry schedules, smart retry settings, grace period logic, and dunning email sequences. Monitor recovery rates and optimize the sequence over time Monitor platform health proactively. Identify processing failures, data integrity issues, and configuration gaps before they surface in Finance reporting or customer invoices Serve as the primary Stripe and enterprise billing platform contact for Finance, RevOps, and the billing engineering team Execute configuration changes following change management controls: documented, tested, and deployed cleanly Lead the evaluation, planning, and execution of billing platform changes and migrations, and serve as the escalation point and subject matter expert for the most complex billing systems issues Quote-to-Cash Integrations Maintain the integration between Selling/Quoting systems and Billing Systems so quote-to-cash data flows are intact and deals land correctly in relevant billing systems Support CPQ-related billing configurations in partnership with the CPQ Lead: price book alignment, quote output formats, and contract-to-subscription linkages Configure and test PLG self-serve billing flows for new product and drive resolution ahead of launches and pricing changes Provisioning Connectivity Partner with Product Engineering on the billing-to-provisioning handoff across both PLG self-serve and SLG right data for downstream customer access Monitor the billing-to-provisioning handoff and escalate with context when subscription or order events fail to propagate cleanly into customer access Support provisioning impact assessment when pricing, packaging, or tier structures change on the billing side Lead root-cause analysis on recurring or high-impact billing-to-provisioning failures and drive title: Sr Business Analyst
description:
Job Description In this role, you will be part of a team that builds and runs the digital platforms for healthcare organizations. As a Senior Business Analyst, you will be the bridge between business stakeholders and engineering, QA, cloud and data teams. You will turn loosely defined business needs into clear, prioritized and estimated work, keep delivery visible to leadership every week, and make sure what we ship is validated by the business before it reaches production. This is a hands-on role for someone who is as comfortable running a stakeholder working session as they are writing acceptance criteria or chasing an open action item to closure. Key responsibilities Requirements and solution analysis Run discovery and working sessions with business owners to capture requirements for new applications and enhancements, and document them as epics, user stories and acceptance criteria. Define MVP scope with stakeholders, separating what must ship first from later phases, and keep scope changes visible. Work with UX and engineering to review wireframes and prototypes, and turn stakeholder feedback into concrete design changes. Analyse data and reporting needs: map data sources across CRM, data warehouse and application databases, write data specifications, and validate that portal and report data match existing business reports. Define role-based access models aligned to real job functions, and gather business justification for privileged access during access reviews. Identify privacy and compliance considerations early, including what protected health information each user type may see. Delivery coordination and governance Facilitate weekly internal and stakeholder sync meetings, and publish clear notes with key takeaways, decisions and action items with owners, status and dates. Maintain the product backlog with clearly named, individually tracked items, T-shirt sizing and remaining effort, so business owners can prioritize competing work. Prepare weekly status reports and leadership decks covering completed work, in-progress items, delivery dates, risks and dependencies, and next priorities. Coordinate release planning across development, QA, UAT and production, distinguishing development completion from UAT and go-live dates. Communicate timeline changes, risks and options to business leadership with a clear rationale and recommendation. Help the team adopt and improve a structured Agile delivery process, including sprint planning, estimation and capacity visibility. ead techno-functional design and solution definition for complex payment systems, translating business requirements into scalable and resilient solutions

The ideal candidate should possess strong sales skills, excellent communication abilities, good destination knowledge and a passion for achieving business targets. 
 Key Roles & Responsibilities 1. Corporate & MICE Business Development Identify and acquire new corporate clients for Meetings, Incentives, Conferences and Exhibitions (MICE). Promote domestic and international corporate incentive tours, conferences, annual meetings and team-building programmes. Develop relationships with HR Heads, Administration Managers, Procurement Heads and corporate decision-makers. Conduct corporate presentations, client meetings and business development visits. Prepare customised MICE proposals in coordination with the operations team. Negotiate commercial terms and convert proposals into confirmed business. 
 2. Leisure & Group Tour Sales Generate business for domestic and international holiday packages. Promote fixed-departure group tours, customised holidays, family vacations and premium travel experiences. Lead Generation & Market Development Identify new business opportunities through direct visits, networking, referrals and digital leads. Build a strong database of corporate clients, associations and potential customers. Conduct regular field visits and client meetings. Develop partnerships with educational institutions,professional associations and business networks. Participate in travel exhibitions, networking events and promotional activities.

Coordinate with the operations team for itinerary planning, costing and supplier quotations. Follow up consistently to improve enquiry-to-booking conversion. Negotiate effectively while protecting company profitability.

Identify repeat business and referral opportunities. Maintain relationships with key decision-makers and institutional clients. Coordinate with operations teams to ensure smooth service delivery.

Focus on profitable sales rather than only booking volumes. Monitor enquiry conversion, sales performance and revenue generation. Identify cross-selling and upselling opportunities across Traveltron's services.

Track quotations, pending confirmations, and business closures. Coordinate with operations and accounts teams for booking confirmation and payment collection. Provide regular market intelligence and competitor feedback.

title: Linux Administrator
description:
Job Description: Linux Administrator L2 
 Role Summary The Linux Administrator L2 will be responsible for the administration, maintenance, availability, performance, and security of enterprise Linux server environments. The role will provide L2 operational support, troubleshoot infrastructure issues, perform patching and upgrades, support security compliance, and ensure services are delivered within agreed SLA requirements. 
 Key Responsibilities Administer and support Linux server environments , primarily Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), and other supported Linux distributions. Perform Linux OS installation, configuration, upgrade, patching, and ongoing maintenance . Handle L2 incidents and service requests , perform technical troubleshooting, and restore services within defined SLA timelines. Monitor server health, CPU, memory, filesystem, disk I/O, processes, services, and overall system performance. Perform Linux OS patching, vulnerability remediation, security hardening, and compliance activities . Manage users, groups, permissions, sudo access, file ownership, and other OS-level security configurations. Manage Linux filesystems, LVM, mounting, disk management, filesystem expansion, and storage-related activities . Configure and troubleshoot Linux services, network interfaces, DNS, NTP/chrony, SSH, and system connectivity. Troubleshoot server boot issues, service failures, high CPU/memory utilization, filesystem utilization, and OS-level performance problems. Perform log analysis using tools such as journalctl, syslog/rsyslog, dmesg, sar, vmstat, iostat, top, and system logs . Support backup, restore, recovery, and Disaster Recovery (DR) activities for Linux infrastructure. Perform routine system health checks and take proactive actions to improve availability, stability, capacity, and performance . Support security controls including CIS hardening , access controls, vulnerability remediation, and audit/compliance requirements. Support EOL/EOS remediation, OS upgrades, server migration, and infrastructure refresh initiatives. Participate in incident, problem, change, configuration, and release management processes. Perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for recurring or major Linux infrastructure incidents and implement corrective/preventive actions. Create and maintain SOPs, runbooks, technical documentation, configuration details, and operational procedures . Coordinate with application, database, VMware, cloud, storage, backup, network, and security teams for troubleshooting and planned activities. Work with OEM/vendor support, including Red Hat Support , for complex issues requiring L3/vendor intervention. Support automation of routine administration activities using Shell/Bash scripting and, where applicable, Ansible. Participate in planned changes, maintenance windows, DR drills, infrastructure migrations, and production support activities. Provide 24x7 rotational/on-call support for business-critical environments where required. Technical Skills Mandatory/Core Skills: Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) Linux Administration & Troubleshooting OS Installation, Configuration & Patching Linux Security & Hardening User & Access Management LVM & Filesystem Management Performance Monitoring & Troubleshooting Network & Service Troubleshooting Shell/Bash Scripting Incident, Problem & Change Management Backup/Restore & DR Support Vulnerability & Compliance Remediation Good to Have: Ansible Automation VMware/Virtualization knowledge Red Hat Satellite SAN/NAS concepts Cloud exposure such as AWS or Microsoft Azure Monitoring tools such as Nagios, Zabbix, SolarWinds, or enterprise monitoring platforms ITIL-based managed services experience Experience & Competencies Typically 5 to 6+ years of hands-on Linux administration experience , depending on the complexity of the environment. Strong troubleshooting skills across Linux OS, filesystem, network, performance, and security issues. Experience supporting enterprise production environments and 24x7 managed services . Ability to perform RCA and implement preventive actions for recurring infrastructure issues. Good communication and documentation skills with the ability to coordinate with technical teams, vendors, and customer stakeholders. Preferred Certifications RHCSA: Red Hat Certified System Administrator RHCE: Red Hat Certified Engineer , preferred for stronger L2 profiles ITIL Foundation Relevant AWS/Azure certification is an added advantage

Consulting India works with drug commercialization teams at top pharma and biotech companies to understand their complex business needs and help them make informed decisions. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands-on operational support so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency. Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals. If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health including the opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health. 
 About the Role We are seeking a motivated and customer-oriented Tier 1 Help Desk Agent to join our Help Desk team. In this role, you will be the first point of contact for users interacting with AI-driven Tier 0 systems in the context of clinical trial products. You will provide technical assistance, troubleshoot issues, and ensure seamless operations for Signant Health systems and applications. This role requires strong problem-solving skills, empathy, and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. Candidates must be flexible to work rotational 24/7 shift timings and must be available to work onsite. 
 What You Will Do Collaborate with AI-driven Tier 0 support systems to diagnose and escalate issues, ensuring smooth transitions between automated responses and human support Provide first-line technical support for users — clinical trial teams, researchers, patients, and others — experiencing issues with Signant Health-related products, applications, and software tools Log and track support requests, ensuring timely resolution, and escalate unresolved issues to Tier 2 or other relevant technical teams Troubleshoot basic hardware, software, and network issues related to clinical trial products and systems Assist users in navigating Signant Health products, ensuring they have the resources and support to use systems effectively Maintain detailed records of troubleshooting efforts, solutions provided, and user interactions, including proper documentation for recurring issues and resolutions Maintain clear and concise communication with users, keeping them updated on the status of their support request and ensuring satisfaction with the outcome Work closely with resolver groups to identify recurring issues, suggest improvements, and support the success of trial operations Stay current on new tools, technology, and best practices in clinical trial management and IT support Work rotational 24/7 shift timings and be available for onsite work as required 
 Preferred Qualifications At least 1–2 years of experience in a help desk or IT support role, preferably in the healthcare or clinical trials sector Understanding of AI-driven support tools and how they interact with human agents to ensure smooth user experience and issue resolution Strong analytical skills and the ability to think critically when troubleshooting technical issues Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively with both technical and non-technical users Understanding of common IT issues related to software, hardware, networking, and databases High attention to detail, ensuring accurate logging and resolution of issues Willingness and ability to work flexible, rotational 24/7 shift timings and to work onsite High school diploma or equivalent required.

EY Consulting is made up of three sub-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services. We help our clients in identifying and managing the interplay between upside and downside risk in order to make the long-term decisions to prevent risk and impact on their organizations ability to meet its future business strategy and objectives. The 3 key fields of play are : Enterprise Risk - helps clients identify and address key risk areas, while building the agility to respond quickly. The areas of focus include Enterprise risk and resilience, Internal audit, Compliance and Internal controls Technology Risk - helps clients to achieve sustainable growth by supporting their efforts to protect their business performance and by providing trusted communications on internal control and regulatory compliance to investors, management, regulators, customers and other stakeholders. title: Senior QA Engineer ( Automation & Manual )
description:
Designation : Senior QA Engineer (Manual & Automation) Experience: 6+ years Role type: Full-time | Permanent Location: Whitefield, Bangalore | Hybrid 
 About IDrive Software IDrive is a leading provider of secure and scalable cloud backup, S3-compatible object storage, and remote access solutions. Trusted by over 5 million users worldwide, we empower individuals and businesses to protect, access, and manage their data with high-performance tools built for speed, reliability, and security. 
 IDrive 360 Enterprise Disk Image Backup is an agent-based, centrally managed enterprise backup and recovery solution for Windows systems. An agent installed on each protected machine discovers its disks and volumes and creates complete disk images, including the operating system, installed applications, system configuration, partition layout, and user data. It enables IT administrators to recover an entire machine, individual disks, or selected volumes following hardware failure, operating-system corruption, ransomware, or data loss. 
 About the Job As a Senior QA Engineer (Manual & Automation) , you will take end-to-end quality ownership of the IDrive 360 Enterprise Disk Image Backup and Recovery application. You will bring strong experience in manual testing, test automation, performance testing, and failure analysis across storage, databases, networking, cloud services, and Windows environments. In this role, you will design real-world test scenarios, investigate complex issues, and build reliable automated regression tests to validate backup and restore workflows. You will focus on data integrity, system performance, scalability, and failure recovery to ensure the product is stable, reliable, and production-ready. 
 What you will be doing: Test Strategy & Planning Own the overall quality strategy for the DiskImage product. Prepare test plans, test scenarios, acceptance criteria, and release-validation checklists. Test full, incremental, volume, disk, system, and entire-machine backup workflows. Validate file-level, volume-level, complete-disk, and bootable restore operations. Verify restored data using file hashes, metadata comparisons, filesystem validation, and boot testing. Functional & Data Integrity Testing Design tests for file creation, modification, deletion, rename, movement, copy, and metadata changes. Validate backups involving millions of files, multi-terabyte volumes, large and small files, sparse files, and mixed workloads under different storage & network conditions. Test local and cloud-based repositories under different network and storage conditions. Verify deduplication, compression, encryption, incremental-change detection, and storage-consumption results. Test cache deletion, missing metadata, damaged indexes, incomplete recovery points, and other recovery scenarios. Test Automation & Regression Testing Build and maintain automated functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end test suites. Automate CLI, Windows service, API, configuration, scheduling, and recovery workflows. Integrate automated tests into CI/CD and release pipelines. Maintain test environments, test datasets, virtual machines, automation scripts, and reusable workload generators. Performance & Scalability Testing Perform performance, scalability, endurance, stress, and resource-utilization testing. Measure backup and restore duration, disk throughput, network utilization, CPU usage, memory consumption, and repository growth. Establish repeatable performance baselines and detect regressions between builds. Failure & Recovery Testing Test interrupted backups, application crashes, system restarts, network failures, disk errors, repository failures, and low-resource conditions. Validate retry, cancellation, fallback, resume, cleanup, and recovery behavior. Investigate failures using application logs, Windows Event Viewer, performance metrics, crash dumps, and diagnostic tools. Validate Windows-version, filesystem, disk-layout, and hardware compatibility. Defect Analysis & Quality Assurance Reproduce customer-reported issues and provide developers with clear evidence and reliable reproduction steps. Collaborate with developers to identify root causes and verify fixes without introducing regressions. Track defects, assess release risk, and provide evidence-based release recommendations. Document testing procedures, known limitations, performance results, and release-quality reports. AI-Assisted Testing & Collaboration Use AI-assisted tools responsibly for test generation, log analysis, scripting, documentation, and failure investigation. Validate AI-generated test cases and scripts instead of relying on them without verification. Collaborate with developers to identify root causes and verify fixes without introducing regressions. What we expect from you: 6+ years of professional software-testing or quality-engineering experience. Strong experience in functional, integration, system, regression, and end-to-end testing. Experience designing and maintaining automated test frameworks. Programming or scripting experience with Go, Python, PowerShell, C#, Java, or a similar language. Lead software modernization and technical-debt reduction by assessing legacy components, defining migration/refactoring approaches, and balancing business priorities with long-term product health. Work with Development and Test/QA leadership to establish quality strategies, improve testability, resolve systemic defects, and strengthen product reliability. Provide technical leadership for complex debugging, root-cause analysis, customer escalations, and cross-component integration issues. Mentor and coach engineers and technical leads; promote knowledge sharing, design reviews, and stronger architectural capability across the team. Support effective Agile execution by helping establish clear technical scope, identifying dependencies and risks early, and aligning sprint commitments with architecture and delivery priorities. Collaborate with Product Management, Support, QA, DevOps, and other corporate functions to communicate product capabilities, clarify requirements, and drive cross-functional decisions. Identify opportunities for AI-assisted engineering, automation, developer productivity, and innovation; assess practical use cases and help translate suitable ideas into measurable improvements. Contribute to technology roadmaps, architecture standards, technical proposals, proof-of-concepts, and engineering improvement initiatives. QUALIFICATIONS: Minimum Qualifications: Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. Extensive software engineering experience with strong capability in system design, software architecture, and delivery of complex products. 15+ years of industries experience. Strong experience with Linux-based software systems and relevant programming/scripting technologies used across the product stack, such as C/C++, Go, Python, and shell scripting. Strong experience designing and developing service-based software and APIs, including REST and/or gRPC, and familiarity with asynchronous messaging or distributed-system patterns. Experience with software configuration management and collaborative development workflows using Git-based platforms such as GitHub or GitLab. Understanding of CI/CD pipelines, automated build and deployment practices, and containerized application environments such as Docker. Demonstrated ability to evaluate architecture trade-offs and address non-functional requirements including performance, reliability, security, scalability, and maintainability. Strong debugging, root-cause analysis, and problem-solving skills across software and system boundaries. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions to engineering teams and cross-functional stakeholders. Demonstrated technical leadership, mentoring, design-review, and cross-team collaboration capabilities. Preferred Qualifications: Deep product knowledge in access appliances, device-management platforms, ACS, or related KVMS solutions. Experience with cloud architecture and deployment models, preferably Microsoft Azure, and virtual-appliance deployment considerations. Experience with software modernization, legacy-system refactoring, platform evolution, and technical-debt management. Knowledge of object-oriented design, design patterns, multi-threading, distributed systems, and service-oriented architecture. Experience with protocol buffers, databases such as MySQL or PostgreSQL, database schema design, and SQL. Knowledge of web/server technologies such as NGINX and network or server-management protocols such as SNMP, SMTP, and TCP/IP. Experience partnering with QA, DevOps, Product Management, Support, and other teams to deliver integrated product capabilities. Experience with AI-assisted software development, engineering automation, or applying AI/ML concepts to practical engineering workflows. Experience leading Agile/Scrum execution, coordinating dependencies, improving delivery predictability, and enabling team members to deliver effectively.

title: Senior SDET  Automation Framework Architect
description:
Role: Senior SDET Automation Framework Architect (Playwright | Selenium | API Automation | CI/CD) 
 Location: Pune, India (Hybrid 2 days onsite) Experience: 610+ years Reports to: Director of Quality Engineering Job Type: FTE Shift Hours: 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM 

 WHAT YOU'LL DO Own the quality bar. Define what "passing" means for client: establish written quality criteria covering scheduling correctness, data integrity, access control, and performance that gate production releases. Test the rules engine. Design and implement automated test suites covering Autoassign placement logic - student choice, teacher priority, must-attend assignments, rostered and restricted sessions, at-risk designations, seat and room capacity, separation (contact control) rules, conflict detection, and the guarantee that manual registrations are never overwritten - plus the edge cases around them: conflicting rules, boundary conditions, concurrent registrations at capacity limits and sign-up cutoffs, API calls that skip UI validation, and permission boundaries. Gate every release. Build CI/CD quality gates that prevent regressions from reaching production; own the pipeline configuration and ensure the quality bar is enforced, not advisory. Set performance baselines. Measure and establish written performance baselines for peak-load moments: sign-up windows opening and closing, Autoassign runs before each client period, and attendance taking across thousands of concurrent users; define the thresholds that constitute a performance regression. Cover web, mobile, and integrations. Own end-to-end coverage across web, mobile, and integrations: student, teacher, and admin workflows; the student mobile app; email, in-product, and push notifications; roster imports and attendance exports to the SIS; and the shared rostering and single sign-on client runs on with client Pass. Build the framework. Architect and build the client automation framework: reusable libraries, test data utilities for roster and attendance files, parallel execution, and reporting that the whole team extends - and contribute fixes to product code where it improves testability. Mentor and scale. Mentor engineers on test architecture as a first-class discipline, and bring AI-assisted tooling into how the team generates scenarios, triages failures, and scales coverage. Shape architecture. Partner with your technical lead and the Distinguished Engineer on architecture and testability decisions, and influence testing standards across teams beyond your own squad. Own incidents. Join the on-call rotation and own the full incident lifecycle for quality regressions: detection, diagnosis, resolution, and retrospective. 
 SKILLS & REQUIREMENTS Must-Have Test framework architecture - designing automation frameworks from scratch (page object or screenplay patterns, BDD where it fits, parallel execution, reporting) that other engineers extend. You build the platform, not just the scripts. 
 Test automation (SDET-level) - Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium for UI plus API-level automation (REST, contract testing). Must automate business-rule behavior - placement decisions, capacity and eligibility rules, state transitions - not just UI interaction tests. CI/CD quality gates - integrating test suites into pipelines; defining and enforcing regression gates for a multi-tenant product used daily by 1,000+ schools. At this level you own the definition of the bar, not just the tests that check it. Rules-engine and data-integrity testing - designing deterministic test data and fixtures for scheduling, allocation, or eligibility logic; building data utilities that validate rosters, registrations, and attendance across CSV/XML imports, exports, and concurrent edits. Strong programming - JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Python at production quality (TypeScript strongly preferred). Your test code is held to the same review standard as product code. Technical communication - ability to produce written quality criteria, test strategy and edge-case documentation, and performance baseline documents that the implementation team, engineering manager, PM, Support, and leadership can act on. Education & experience - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, with 6 to 10+ years of hands-on SDET / test automation experience. 
 Strongly Preferred Performance & concurrency testing - k6, JMeter, Gatling, or Locust; modeling burst traffic (thousands of users acting in the same minute) and catching race conditions at capacity limits and sign-up cutoffs. AI-assisted test engineering - using AI tools to generate test scenarios, triage failures, or scale framework adoption across teams. Security & access-control testing - role-based permissions (student / teacher / admin), multi-tenant data isolation between districts, and student data privacy expectations. 
 Nice to Have Mobile test automation - Appium, Maestro, Detox, or similar for iOS and Android; push notification and device-fragmentation coverage. Integration testing - SIS data import/export, rostering sync, single sign-on, and notification delivery (email, in-product, push). K-12 EdTech domain - understanding of bell schedules, advisory periods, MTSS intervention tiers, and how districts manage SIS data helps design realistic test scenarios. 
 WHO YOU ARE You test the edge cases, not just the happy path. You test the ways the system should fail and doesn't, and you document those cases so the implementation team designs against them. You have built automation frameworks from the ground up - not just inherited them - and other engineers have built on what you designed. You treat test architecture as a first-class engineering discipline. A feature without a regression suite is not finished - and you enforce that standard through CI/CD gates, not just code review comments. You define what "quality" means on a product that decides where students are supposed to be, and produce written criteria that hold the codebase to that standard across every engineer and every release. You are hands-on at a senior level - you still write the framework code, and you raise the bar for everyone who writes tests after you. Experience shipping product feature code is a bonus, not a requirement. Your edge-case documentation and performance baselines are used by the implementation team to make better architecture decisions. Your influence extends past your own work. You own your area end to end with minimal oversight, and you resolve ambiguity in requirements and design tradeoffs instead of waiting for a fully formed spec.

title: Finance Systems Administrator
description:
Job Summary 
 As a Finance Systems Administrator at Teads, you will manage and support our core finance systems, including NetSuite, Planful, Lease Query and FloQast. You will play a key role in ensuring these systems run smoothly, supporting finance users, resolving technical issues and improving processes across a global organisation with 50+ subsidiaries. Working closely with the Finance Systems Manager in London and the Director of Finance in Gurugram, you will help maintain system configurations, integrations, reporting and security controls. We are also looking for someone curious about AI and automation, who can identify opportunities to reduce manual work across reconciliations, reporting, data extraction and user support while maintaining appropriate financial data controls. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 1. NetSuite Functional Support Maintain NetSuite modules and integrations, including Tipalti, Coupa and Concur. Monitor integrations and investigate and resolve failures. Manage user accounts, roles, permissions and security settings. Maintain GL accounts, segments and chart of accounts configurations. Build and maintain saved searches, dashboards and reports. Manage system enhancements from initial request through to release. 2. Planful Administration Monitor the daily Planful-NetSuite integration and resolve failures. Maintain GL mappings, account levels and company dimensions. Prepare and load exchange rates for review and approval. Support monthly Planful-NetSuite reconciliations and investigate discrepancies. 3. User Support Provide first-line support to NetSuite users. Troubleshoot and resolve system-related issues. Train end users on new features, modules and best practices. Maintain requests, issues and resolutions in the Service Desk. Develop how-to guides to address recurring user queries. 4. System Maintenance Monitor NetSuite performance and identify improvement opportunities. Plan and conduct release testing and support user acceptance testing (UAT). Conduct regular data audits, clean-ups and user access reviews. Administer FloQast, including user management, troubleshooting, new company setups and enhancements. 5. Projects, Customisation and Development Work with the Finance Systems Manager and developers on custom fields, forms, workflows and scripts. Test new customisations against business requirements. Troubleshoot workflow and scripting issues, including stuck approvals. 6. Process Improvement and AI Identify and implement automation opportunities across NetSuite, Planful and FloQast. Use approved AI tools such as Claude and Gemini to improve reconciliations, data extraction, reporting and user support. Review AI-generated outputs before using them in finance processes. Document automation processes and share best practices with the team. Gather and document business requirements for new projects and enhancements. 7. Compliance and Security Follow data security policies across NetSuite and connected systems. Use only company-approved AI tools and protect confidential financial and personal information. Support SOX controls, including access reviews, change documentation and audit evidence. Act as a point of contact for audit queries relating to system access, configuration and changes. 
 
 What will you bring to the team 
 Your skills and experiences Bachelors degree in Information Technology, Business, Finance or a related field, or equivalent experience. 8-10 years of hands-on ERP experience, ideally in NetSuite administration or support. Strong understanding of core accounting concepts, including general ledger, chart of accounts, multi-currency, revaluations and intercompany transactions. Working knowledge of NetSuite saved searches, SuiteAnalytics and SuiteFlow. Strong Excel skills, including lookups, pivot tables and SUMIFS-style formulas. Practical experience using AI tools such as Claude and Gemini for analysing data, writing queries or scripts, and automating tasks. Good understanding of data privacy and security when working with financial information. Bonus points Experience working in a multi-entity, multi-currency organisation. Experience in a publicly listed company with SOX requirements. Familiarity with SuiteScript and SuiteQL. Experience with Planful, FloQast or similar FPA and financial close tools. NetSuite Administrator certification. 
 
 Values 
 Relentless Customer Focus: You put customers at the heart of everything, building strong relationships, understanding customers needs, and making decisions that keep their perspective front and center. Act Today, Not Tomorrow: You make smart decisions quickly, prioritize action over perfection, and keep things moving forward.

title: Lead Application Support Analyst (Dot Net/Dot Net Core/AMS/DevOps)
description:
Job Summary 
 At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people-Kyndryls-that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive. As an Application Support Analyst, you will be responsible for supporting, maintaining, and troubleshooting enterprise applications built on .NET and .NET Core technologies. You will work within an Application Managed Services (AMS) environment to ensure application stability, availability, performance, and service quality. The role combines production support, incident management, DevOps practices, automation, and continuous service improvement while collaborating with development, infrastructure, database, and business teams. 

 Responsibilities 
 Provide production support for enterprise applications by monitoring system health, resolving incidents, troubleshooting application, API, database, and performance issues, and performing root-cause analysis. Manage incidents, service requests, problems, and changes using ITSM processes while meeting agreed SLAs, KPIs, and operational standards. Support CI/CD pipelines, deployments, configuration management, release validation, rollback planning, post-deployment monitoring, and DevOps activities across multiple environments. Analyze logs, alerts, metrics, and monitoring dashboards to identify issues, improve reliability, optimize performance, and reduce recurring incidents. Utilize approved AI-enabled support tools and automation capabilities to assist with incident triage, log analysis, knowledge retrieval, and operational efficiency improvements. Maintain technical documentation, support runbooks, troubleshooting guides, known-error databases, and operational knowledge repositories. Collaborate with development, infrastructure, database, network, security, and business teams to resolve technical issues and support service delivery activities. Participate in operational reviews, knowledge transitions, service improvement initiatives, on-call support, rotational shifts, and application modernization efforts as required. 

 Required Technical and Professional Experience 
 3-6 years of experience in application support, maintenance, development, IT operations, or Application Managed Services (AMS) environments. Strong hands-on experience with C#, .NET Framework, .NET Core/Modern .NET, ASP.NET Core, Visual Studio, object-oriented programming, debugging, exception handling, and REST API support. Experience supporting enterprise applications in production environments, including incident management, root-cause analysis, troubleshooting, and service restoration activities. Good knowledge of SQL Server or equivalent relational databases, including query execution, troubleshooting, performance analysis, and data connectivity support. Experience with ITIL-based service management, including Incident, Problem, Change, Service Request Management, SLA tracking, and escalation management. Exposure to DevOps practices, including Git, CI/CD pipelines, deployment validation, release management, rollback procedures, and tools such as Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or GitHub Actions. Experience using monitoring and observability tools such as AppDynamics, Dynatrace, Splunk, Azure Monitor, or equivalent platforms, along with basic scripting skills in PowerShell, Python, or Bash. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, stakeholder management, customer support, and documentation skills with the ability to work in SLA-driven enterprise support environments. 

 Preferred Professional and Technical Expertise 
 Experience with ASP.NET MVC, ASP.NET Core Web API, middleware components, and enterprise integration services. Exposure to Microsoft Azure services, including Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Azure DevOps, cloud monitoring, and cloud-hosted application support. Experience supporting application modernization, migration, automated deployments, infrastructure monitoring, and Agile/DevOps delivery models. Experience working within industries such as BFSI, Retail, Healthcare, or Manufacturing and supporting business-critical enterprise applications. Relevant certifications in Microsoft Azure, .NET, ITIL 4, DevOps, or related technologies are preferred. 

 Who You Are 
 You re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important - you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused - someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you re open and borderless - naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
